* EY is looking for inspired, result oriented and quality focused professional with strong mindset to understand client requirement and propose fit for purpose enterprise level Threat Detection and Response (TDR) and Security Operations Center (SOC) solutions
* The candidate will need to contribute and involve in Go-To-Market activities including TDR / SOC sales, pre-sales, and business development for the firm and actively engage in responding to RFPs/proactive proposals, Oral presentations to clients and negotiations/BAFO (best and final offer)
* The candidate will be expected to effectively leverage the global Threat Management capabilities and resources of EY, its alliance partners, technology and digital service providers, vendors and provide best-in-class consulting services on Solution/Enterprise architecture, and technology solutions to complex business problems to enable digital transformation journey of the client

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Provide advice on long term TDR / SOC Security Solution / Enterprise architecture decisions to Client’s senior management of their Business and IT streams
* Build and develop the Threat Management specific Solution / Enterprise Architecting capability through pro-active engagement with EY practice teams, partners, and clients.
* Perform sales, pre-sales, business development for the firm and actively engage in responding to RFPs, Oral pitches and negotiations
* Plan and run workshops for Client’s Business and Technology Executives and involving client partners and vendors, on Solution Architecture exclusively, driving Transition of applications and solutions from incumbent vendors of clients, or as part of Digital Transformation, addressing Business, Digital and IT Strategy and objectives of the client.
* Work closely with professionals spanning strategy, business, application, infrastructure security and data architecture disciplines to accelerate our clients’ enterprise SIEM architecture maturity definition and transformation journey, leveraging internal capabilities and tapping into an ecosystem of partners and technology vendors and service providers.
* Interface and communicate with the various onsite and/or offshore stakeholders and coordinators on a regular basis to ensure smooth execution of RFPs and proactive proposals

  

**Skills and Attributes for Success**

* BTech/MCA from a reputed Institution
* Extensive consulting experience in Big-4s, IT Industry Majors or Management Consulting firms
* 8-12 years of experience in solutioning and proposing Security Incident and Event Management (SIEM) products like MS Sentinel, Splunk, Crowdstrike etc including NextGen security products like Carbon black, MS Defender, Crowdstrike, SOAR platform like Phantom, logoicApp etc.
* Excellent team player who can reach out and collaborate very effectively with geographically distributed technology, business function and support teams to deliver to the client.
* Experience in creating and conducting impactful client presentations specific to SIEM / SOC and articulate the technical and non-technical deliverables to clients at various levels
* Experience in running physical and virtual workshops independently and well versed with SIEM tools and technologies to enable the same.
* Demonstrable professional technical writing expertise, visual representation and language skills.
* Experienced in productivity and diagramming tools like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio
* Comprehensive understanding of solution lifecycle methodologies, project planning, and execution across multiple cyber domains and business functions.
* Expertise in identifying and mitigating risks during solution, and the ability to develop robust solution strategy.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience in coordinating between clients, internal teams, and third-party vendors to ensure seamless solution
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of clearly conveying complex solution plans and updates to diverse audiences.
* Ability to work independently, prioritise multiple RFP solution, and adapt to dynamic environments while maintaining high quality standards.

  

**Core Capabilities**

* Structured and methodical approach towards managing solutions
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address client challenges
* Excellent presentation and communication skills for stakeholder engagement
* Quality-focused mindset ensuring high standards throughout solution phases

  

**Functional Capabilities**

* Highly motivated and results-driven, ensuring seamless solution response
* Exceptional organisational skills, adept at multitasking and prioritising solutions
* Effective time management to meet solution milestones and deadlines

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Comprehensive understanding of SIEM / SOC managed services products and offerings
* Knowledge of various managed services delivery models (on-premise, cloud, hybrid)
* Strong understanding of legal, compliance, and contractual requirements in managed services environments

  

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Self-motivated and proactive in managing RFP
* Attention to detail and logical reasoning for effective solution and planning
* **Experience engaging professionally with diverse cultures and international teams, working with different stakeholders providing coverage during Europe / US work hours as required**
* Ability to manage multiple RFPs simultaneously
* Skill in establishing a collaborative environment based on trust, open communication, innovation, and teamwork
* Robust skills in presenting, communicating, organising, multitasking, and time management
* Strong networking abilities for cross-functional collaboration

  

**What we look for**

* Expertise in cost optimisation and resource planning
* Experience in opportunity and renewals
* Exceptional communication skills for managing client and internal stakeholder expectations

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning**: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you**: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Proposal Engineer
description:
Job Role Description
  
  
Are you a seasoned proposal professional who thrives on turning complex technical requirements into winning, compliant bids for engineered water solutions? Then join our mission to pioneer smarter water solutions that reduce energy use and improve lives.
  
  
As our new Senior Project Proposal Engineer, IND, you'll be managing and coordinating end-to-end proposal efforts for complex projects — from Bid/No Bid decisions through submission and negotiation — that help Grundfos deliver engineered-to-order solutions to customers across India. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well-being, and a sense of belonging.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**
As a key part of the Industry Project Proposals team, you'll create impact by leading the development of technically excellent, commercially competitive proposals that win strategic projects and strengthen Grundfos's position in the industrial water market.
  
  
Your main responsibilities include:
  
  

* Lead the preparation of winning proposals for complex projects in line with Grundfos processes.
* Develop optimized technical and commercial solutions, including BOMs, costing, pricing, GA drawings, and 2D/3D designs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Sales, CSU, SCM, Product Management, Application Specialists, suppliers, consultants, and contractors.
* Ensure compliant, accurate, and on-time tender submissions.
* Build technical and commercial proposals by interpreting client requirements, contractual terms, and specifications.
* Develop project cost models and manage inputs from suppliers and subcontractors during the tender phase.
* Drive proposal governance, internal reviews, and continuous process improvements.
* Support pre-qualification activities and customer negotiations alongside sales and management teams.
* Contribute to preliminary project execution planning, including scope, budgets, schedules, and procurement strategies.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**
Above all, you're a subject matter expert in estimation and proposal management with a strong technical background in engineered-to-order solutions, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to bridge commercial and technical teams to deliver winning bids. We'd also imagine that you are/have:
  
  

* 15+ years of experience in proposal engineering, estimation, quotation management, or solution selling within an Engineered-to-Order business.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or a related field.
* Strong experience in pump systems, skid design, pipe sizing, P&IDs, and fluid characteristics.
* Knowledge of Water Treatment, HVAC, ETP, and STP applications.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, 2D/3D modelling, SAP (R3/CRM/BW), and Microsoft Office.

It's a plus if you also:
  
  

* Exposure to project management
* Industry experience within the water or pump technology sector
* Track record of driving process improvements within a proposal or bid management function

**Why you'll love working here**

* Flexible and hybrid working opportunities.
* Supportive and inclusive culture focused on employee well-being and development.
* Three additional paid volunteering days each year.

At Grundfos, we believe diverse perspectives create better solutions. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive hiring experience.
  
  
Join Grundfos, apply today!

title: Associate Solution Consultant - IND
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Elevate your career journey by embracing a new challenge with Kinaxis. We are experts in tech, but it’s really our people who give us passion to always seek ways to do things better. As such, we’re serious about your career growth and professional development, because People matter at Kinaxis.
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, and support 40,000+ users in over 100 countries. As a global leader in end-to-end supply chain management, we enable supply chain excellence for all industries. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Our journey in India began in 2020 and we have been growing steadily since then! Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai
  
  
**About The Team**
As part of our Professional Services team, you will apply your expertise to help businesses solve their
  
  
supply chain planning challenges through the successful implementation of Maestro solutions. You will
  
  
support Senior consultants and Architects for end-to-end product implementations, delivering advanced
  
  
planning capabilities across diverse, multi-industry supply chains
  
  
Associate Solution Consultant is an entry level position within Kinaxis’s Professional Services (Consulting)
  
  
organization. You will work closely with other team members in order to deliver customer projects using
  
  
Kinaxis Maestro software.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Participate in in-depth discovery sessions with customers to understand business requirements and assist the Solution Architect/ Senior Consultants in developing detailed specifications.
* Collaborate closely with delivery, product, and services teams to configure and implement Maestro software solutions tailored to customer needs.
* Support senior team members in translating business requirements into Maestro solution specifications and designing creative solutions for complex user requirements while aligning with supply chain industry standards and Kinaxis best practices.
* Participate in data management and integration activities, including data transformation, loading, cleansing, and validation from source systems.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback for continuous improvement

****What we are looking for****

* Min 2 – 4 years of overall experience in the supply chain industry or in end to end product implementation projects.
* Sound domain expertise in Supply Chain concepts and advanced planning business processes such as statistical forecasting, inventory management, MRP, scheduling, etc
* A passion for working in customer facing roles with high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Candidates with results-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, contributing to Kinaxis’s success.
* Strong intent to learn and master our first in class product “Maestro”
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment and co-ordinate effectively with stakeholders at all organization levels.
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to solve complex problems, think critically, and make sound decisions
* Ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
* Tech savvy with a good understanding of Agentic AI, data models, SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc. is preferred
* Implementation experience with advanced planning solutions such as SAPAPO, Blueyonder, ERP etc. is an added advantage

**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis strongly encourages diverse candidates to apply to our welcoming community. We strive to make our website and application process accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com . This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

title: Senior Admissions Counselor
description:
Senior Admission CounselorAbout Spellzee

Spellzee is an IITM-incubated language learning platform trusted by over 20,000 parents for building strong communication skills in children.

We provide structured, learner-centric programs across eight languages, including Indian and international languages, along with specialized programs in Phonics, Reading, Grammar, Public Speaking, Spoken English, and Accent Training.

With 500+ certified tutors and more than 3 million minutes of live classes delivered, Spellzee is focused on making high-quality language learning affordable, accessible, and outcome-driven.

Our team combines pedagogy, technology, and scale to create meaningful impact in children's language development across the world.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**Senior Admission Counselor**
to join our growing admissions team.

In this role, you will manage the
**complete admissions funnel**
, from the initial interaction with prospective parents to counseling, demo coordination, follow-ups, objection handling, and final admission closure.

We are looking for someone who understands consultative selling, can independently manage leads, build trust with parents, communicate the value of our programs, and consistently convert qualified leads into admissions.

**The ideal candidate should have at least 2 years of experience in sales, admission counseling, inside sales, or a similar customer-facing role, along with excellent English communication skills and fluency in Tamil.**

You will take ownership of your sales pipeline, maintain consistent follow-ups, achieve admission targets, and contribute to the overall growth of Spellzee.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Admission Management

* Manage the complete admissions process, from the first parent interaction to successful admission closure.
* Connect with prospective parents through outbound calls and follow up with incoming enquiries.
* Understand the child's learning requirements, identify parent expectations, and recommend suitable programs.
* Explain Spellzee's programs, teaching methodology, learning outcomes, and value proposition.
* Guide parents through the admission process and address their concerns at every stage.

2. Sales Conversion and Closing

* Conduct consultative sales conversations to understand parent needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Handle objections related to pricing, program suitability, class schedules, and learning outcomes.
* Follow up consistently with interested parents to move leads through the sales pipeline.
* Build confidence and trust with parents to improve conversion rates.
* Negotiate professionally within approved pricing and offer guidelines.
* Take ownership of achieving individual admission and revenue targets.

3. Demo Coordination and Follow-ups

* Coordinate demo sessions based on the availability and requirements of parents and students.
* Ensure parents understand the demo process and are encouraged to attend scheduled sessions.
* Follow up with parents before and after demo sessions to understand their feedback and address concerns.
* Work closely with demo tutors and internal teams to ensure a smooth parent experience.
* Convert completed demos into paid admissions through timely and effective follow-ups.

4. Lead and Sales Pipeline Management

* Maintain accurate lead records, follow-up schedules, and sales pipeline updates in the CRM.
* Prioritize leads based on interest level, readiness to enroll, and potential conversion.
* Ensure no qualified lead is missed due to delayed or inconsistent follow-ups.
* Track daily calls, meaningful conversations, demos scheduled, follow-ups completed, admissions closed, and revenue generated.
* Maintain disciplined lead management and accurate reporting.

5. Target Achievement and Performance

* Work towards daily, weekly, and monthly admission and revenue targets.
* Monitor individual performance and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Demonstrate ownership, consistency, and accountability for sales outcomes.
* Continuously improve counseling, objection-handling, and closing techniques.
* Contribute ideas to improve the admissions process and overall sales performance.

6. Team Collaboration and Continuous Improvement

* Coordinate with the sales manager, marketing team, demo tutors, and operations team to improve the parent journey.
* Share recurring parent objections, lead quality feedback, and conversion insights with the team.
* Follow established sales processes, communication standards, and admission policies.
* Participate in training sessions, performance reviews, and sales improvement initiatives.

Who Can Apply?

We are looking for experienced professionals who want to build their careers in admissions, inside sales, education sales, or customer acquisition.

Candidates with experience in the following areas are encouraged to apply:

* Admission Counseling
* EdTech or Education Sales
* Inside Sales
* Telecalling and Telesales
* Business Development
* Consultative Sales
* Customer Acquisition
* Other target-driven sales roles

Experience in selling educational programs, online courses, subscriptions, or services directly to customers will be an advantage.

Mandatory Requirements

* Minimum
  **2 years of relevant sales or admission counseling experience**
  .
* **Excellent spoken English communication skills.**
* **Fluency in Tamil and the ability to communicate confidently with parents in Tamil.**
* Proven ability to manage leads, conduct follow-ups, handle objections, and close sales.
* Confidence in conducting sales conversations over phone calls.
* Strong persuasion, negotiation, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable working with daily activity metrics and monthly sales targets.
* Ability to independently manage a sales pipeline and prioritize leads.
* Comfortable using CRM systems, spreadsheets, and basic digital tools.
* A reliable work-from-home setup with a laptop or desktop and stable internet connection.
* Self-motivated, disciplined, accountable, and focused on achieving results.
* Willingness to work full-time from home, Monday to Saturday, from 11 AM to 9 PM.

What We Offer

* Full-time work-from-home opportunity.
* Performance-oriented compensation based on experience and role suitability.
* Structured onboarding and product training.
* Opportunity to take ownership of the complete admissions funnel.
* Career growth opportunities within the Admissions and Sales function.
* Exposure to a growing, IITM-incubated EdTech company.
* A supportive and performance-driven work environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to children's education and language development.

Work Environment

This is a full-time, work-from-home position involving outbound calls, parent counseling, demo coordination, lead management, regular follow-ups, and admission closures.

The role requires strong ownership of the sales pipeline, consistent performance, and a commitment to achieving measurable business outcomes.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond simply making calls and take responsibility for converting opportunities into admissions.

**If you have at least 2 years of sales experience, excellent English communication, fluency in Tamil, and a strong track record of working towards targets, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Manager - Cyber IOT
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Cyber**
**Title: Manager, OT Cybersecurity**
**Work You'll Do**
Lead client engagements to strengthen cybersecurity posture across OT, ICS, and industrial environments. The role will involve engagement leadership, client relationship management, solution oversight, business development, and team management.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Lead OT cybersecurity engagements end-to-end, from scoping through delivery, ensuring quality, timeline, and budget adherence.
* Own client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor on OT/ICS security strategy and risk management.
* Oversee design and deployment of OT security solutions, including asset management, network monitoring, segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Lead OT gap assessments, cyber risk assessments, and maturity assessments; guide teams in prioritizing and remediating findings.
* Drive proposal development, scoping, and pricing; identify and pursue follow-on opportunities with existing clients.
* Manage, mentor, and develop consulting teams, including performance feedback and career development.
* Engage senior client stakeholders (e.g., CISO, plant and operations leadership) and coordinate with engineering, network, cloud, and cybersecurity teams.
* Contribute to practice development, including methodology, tools, and thought leadership.

**Required Skills:**

* 10-15 years of experience in OT, ICS, industrial cybersecurity, or a related field, including experience leading teams and engagements.
* Proven experience managing multi-workstream projects and client relationships in a consulting environment.
* Deep knowledge of OT devices, network architectures, and industrial protocols.
* Experience with at least three of the following:
* OT asset management
* OT network segmentation
* Secure remote access
* OT monitoring or IDS
* OT Automation solutions
* OT incident response
* IoT security
* SCADA/ICS security
* Hands-on and oversight experience with OT cybersecurity platforms such as Claroty, Nozomi, Dragos, or equivalent.
* Strong command of ISA/IEC 62443, NIST 800-82, NISTIR 8183, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and OT cyber risk management frameworks.
* Experience developing proposals, statements of work, and pricing for cybersecurity engagements.
* Track record of managing, mentoring, and developing junior and mid-level consulting staff.
* Experience presenting to executive and plant-level stakeholders, and building trusted advisor relationships.
* Ability to leverage GenAI and agentic AI tools to improve assessment, documentation, and delivery efficiency across teams, with appropriate governance and oversight.
* Understanding of AI governance and responsible AI controls in cybersecurity contexts.
* Strong business acumen, including budget and financial management of engagements.
* Excellent communication, executive presence, and problem-solving skills.

**Additional Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related field; Master's degree (MBA, M.Tech, or MS in Cybersecurity) is a plus.
* Experience leading proposals and business development in a consulting environment.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent engagements and teams.
* Willingness to travel based on client requirements.

**Preferred:**

* Certifications such as ISA/IEC 62443, CISSP, CISM, CISA, GICSP.
* PMP, Scrum, or similar project-management certification.
* Experience in Power and Utilities, Oil and Gas, Manufacturing, or Industrial Products.
* Experience with CyberPHA or OT maturity assessments.
* P&L or account management experience.

**Location:**
Hyderabad/Bengaluru/Pune/Chennai
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

* Work towards daily and monthly admission goals.

We are looking for
**recent UG graduates**
who are confident, energetic, competitive and interested in building a career in
**Admissions, Inside Sales, Education Sales or Customer Success**
.

**6 months–1 year of experience**
in any of the following areas are preferred:

* Admission Counseling
* Telecalling
* Inside Sales
* Education Sales
* Customer Support
* Customer Success
* Business Development
* Other customer-facing roles

* Recent UG graduate — preferably graduated in
  **2025 or 2026**
  .
* Excellent
  **spoken English communication**

* Strong listening, interpersonal and convincing skills.
* Comfortable making outbound calls and conducting regular follow-ups.
* Comfortable working with targets and measurable outcomes.
* Self-motivated and capable of working independently.
* Should have a reliable
  **work-from-home setup**
  , including a laptop/desktop and stable internet connection.

What We Offer

* **Work From Home**
* **₹15k-25k per month**
* Competitive and performance-oriented compensation
* Complete training provided by Spellzee
* Structured onboarding and product training
* Training in admission counseling, parent communication and lead management
* Opportunity to grow within the Admissions and Sales function

This is a
**full-time work-from-home position**
involving regular communication with parents, outbound calling, follow-ups, demo scheduling and admission-related activities.

.

title: Senior Solution Consultant
description:
**About Parexel**
Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.
  
  
We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose – moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Senior Solution Consultant (Pharmacovigilance Consultant, Drug Safety Solutions Specialist) to join our team. As a Senior Solution Consultant, you will drive the design and delivery of innovative pharmacovigilance and drug safety solutions that advance patient safety and regulatory compliance.
  
  
This position plays a key role in solution development, client engagement, pre-award support, and post-award delivery oversight. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams across sales, delivery, and therapeutic areas, follow industry-standard processes, and contribute to solution development from initial client discovery through successful implementation and account management.
  
  
Responsibilities include developing bespoke safety solutions, supporting strategic sales initiatives, and ensuring seamless handovers to delivery teams, with opportunities to deepen your expertise in pharmacovigilance and influence the strategic direction of Parexel's drug safety business.
  
  
You'll join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through innovative solution design, client-centric consulting, and operational excellence. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Senior Solution Consultant can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research and commercial operations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead solution development and design of bespoke pharmacovigilance and drug safety solutions that maximize value for clients and differentiate Parexel in the market
* Support sales initiatives through strategic guidance, opportunity identification, and participation in client discovery sessions to understand business objectives and system need
* Develop efficient, competitive, and profitable solutions, including scope definition, budget preparation, and commercial proposals for pre-award and post-award engagement
* Manage client relationships and provide account oversight to ensure solutions meet expectations for time, cost, quality, and customer satisfaction
* Maintain extensive knowledge of pharmacovigilance products, pipelines, competitors, and industry trends to position Parexel for competitive advantage and business growth
* Ensure effective handover of solutions to delivery teams and drive lessons learned feedback loops to achieve continuous improvement
* Partner with cross-functional teams across enterprise accounts, growth accounts, delivery, and marketing to support SBU-specific sales targets and strategic objectives
* Develop and present customer-focused, well-articulated proposal content and budgets that clearly communicate Parexel's value proposition and differentiation

**Candidate Profile**
**You'll Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in strategic thinking, client relationship management, and solution design
* Experience working in pharmacovigilance, drug safety, clinical research, or a regulated healthcare environment
* The ability to collaborate across matrix teams, communicate complex ideas clearly, and build strong cross-functional relationships
* A patient-focused mindset, strong attention to detail, and a pragmatic approach to solving business challenges
* Comfort working with commercial systems, proposal management tools, and industry-standard processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in life sciences, pharmacy, health sciences, or related field
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Drug Safety Services, or clinical research
* At least 2 years of experience in developing and designing client-specific safety solutions or consulting services
* Proven client-facing experience with strong stakeholder management and consulting skills
* Knowledge of pharmacovigilance regulations, ICH-GCP, and clinical trial processes
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in life sciences, business, or related field
* Experience with process improvement methodologies and automation technologies in drug safety or clinical research
* Active participation in industry forums and professional organizations related to pharmacovigilance
* Willingness to travel up to 30% as needed for client engagement and business development

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
  
  
If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

title: Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships, Accion Advisory
description:
**About Accion**
Accion is a global nonprofit on a mission to create a fair and inclusive economy for the 1.6 billion people who are failed by the global financial system. We develop and scale responsible digital financial solutions for small business owners, smallholder farmers, and women, so they can make informed decisions and improve their lives. Through targeted investment strategies, advisory solutions, and expert thought leadership, we work with local partners to develop and scale cheaper, more accessible, and customer-friendly financial solutions. Since 1961, Accion has helped build 299 financial service providers serving low-income clients in 77 countries, reaching over 500 million people. More at https://www.accion.org.
  
  
**About Accion Advisory**
Accion Advisory is a global team helping companies deliver innovative, affordable financial solutions for underserved customers in emerging markets. We work with local ecosystem partners, leveraging philanthropic capital and new technologies, to test, improve, and scale solutions that strengthen economic well‑being.
  
  
Our 60+ advisors deliver 30+ active projects across Africa, Asia, and the Americas, collaborating with financial service providers, fintech companies, digital platforms, and other stakeholders to demonstrate the viability of reaching end customers often considered too risky or costly to serve. Through AI- and data-driven digital transformation and embedded financial products, we drive impact across four key pillars: livelihoods, agriculture, climate, and women's economic empowerment.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Accion Advisory is seeking a Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships to expand access to credit and risk-sharing products for smallholder farmers, agricultural MSMEs, and climate-vulnerable communities across India and beyond. You will build and lead Accion's relationships with financial service providers: MFIs, fintechs, small finance banks, and NBFCs. Taking partnerships from first conversation through executed agreement and into live pilots, and shaping the financial products those partnerships deliver. The role also supports donor and commercial fundraising for Accion's climate and agricultural finance agenda.
  
  
Based in Mumbai on a hybrid basis with two days on site, this is an open-ended position reporting to the Senior Director, Global Agri & Climate Lead, Accion Advisory. You will work closely with regional delivery teams across India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
**Product Design and Development**

* Lead the design and commercial structuring of financial products for smallholder farmers and agricultural MSMEs, including risk frameworks, credit guarantees, de-risking instruments, and blended finance incentives.
* Assess market opportunity, partner viability, and product pricing using existing models and analytical inputs, working with technical specialists where detailed financial modeling is required.
* Conduct market and customer research to identify unmet needs and opportunities for product innovation across agricultural value chains.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Sharing**

* Build legal and regulatory structuring capacity, in-house or retained, across active markets including India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
* Represent Accion Advisory at conferences and industry forums, contribute to knowledge products and publications, and deliver training and technical assistance to staff and partners on product development and partnership approaches.

**Financial Service Provider (FSP) Partnership and Engagement**

title: Senior Planning Advisor - Dry Utilities Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Job Description — Senior Dry Utilities Planning Advisor
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a Dry Utilities Planning Advisor to provide strategic leadership in the planning and integration of electrical power and telecommunications infrastructure for complex, large-scale developments, including city-scale masterplans, industrial zones, corridors, mixed-use and giga-project programs. The role requires deep experience across electrical and telecommunication network planning and design, including primary/secondary substations, distribution networks, and grid interface/tie-in strategies, as well as strong capability in demand forecasting, renewable energy integration, and energy modelling. This is India based role and will be supporting the Middle East advisory business – mainly KSA and UAE projects.
  
  
You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, coordinate across multidisciplinary teams, and produce decision grade technical outputs from early feasibility and optioneering to enable robust, policy aligned, and future ready infrastructure outcomes, including preparation of indicative dry utilities layout plans and spatial schemes at strategic planning and master planning levels of detail.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide strategic advisory leadership on dry utilities planning across power and telecommunication systems, supporting master planning, vision plans, and development frameworks from early feasibility through concept and pre-design stages
* Translate land use, density, development mix, and phasing into high-level power and telecom infrastructure strategies, spatial reservations, and servicing principles that enable master plan outcomes
* Define planning-level network architectures, including grid interface strategies, primary and secondary substation allocation, HV corridors, MV routing/looping concepts, LV distribution principles, and district-level infrastructure reservations, supported by indicative layout plans and corridor alignments appropriate to master planning and framework plan stages
* Assess and advise on grid connection options, reinforcement requirements, and interface risks, aligning utility strategy with developmental sequencing, authority constraints, and long-term capacity needs
* Lead demand forecasting and capacity planning using land-use-driven methodologies, diversity assumptions, and scenario-based growth trajectories, translate results into staged infrastructure investment and delivery pathways
* Support the integration of renewable energy generation and storage solutions at district or city scale, advising on grid impacts, phasing implications, and strategic interface considerations rather than detailed system design
* Undertake feasibility studies, technical optioneering, and advisory reviews to inform client decision-making, investment prioritization, and downstream design development
* Prepare and review conceptual and masterplan-level dry utilities layout plans, including substation plots, HV/MV routing, telecom corridor planning, and utility plot safeguarding, ensuring alignment with land use, urban design intent, and phasing strategies
* Act as client-facing technical advisor, clearly communicating planning strategies, risks, and recommendations through reports, workshops, and senior forums

Mumbai

- Maintain the BD action tracker, CRM and sales MIS with disciplined weekly pipeline reporting to the Business Head.

**Skills & Competencies:**

- Sound understanding of credit ratings, the rating process and the distinction between global-scale and national-scale ratings.

title: Senior Business Development Manager
description:
**Background**

Praan (Praan, Inc.) is an impact focused deep-tech startup democratizing clean air using breakthrough filterless technology. The company is backed by top tier VCs and CXOs globally and currently operates between the United States and India. Our team puts extreme attention to detail and loves building technology that's aspirational. Praan's team and culture is positioned to empower people to solve large global problems at an accelerated pace.

**Why?**

Everyone worries about the dooms-day in climate change which is expected to occur in the 2050s. However, there's one doom's day which is the reality for millions of people around the world today. Air pollution takes more than 7 Million lives globally every single year. Over 5% of premature children death occur due to air pollution in developing countries. Everyone has relied on governments or experts to solve the problem, but most solutions up until today have either been too expensive or too ineffective. Praan is an attempt at making the future cleaner, healthier, and safer for the generations to come.

**The role**

You'll own the architect, interior designer and developer ecosystem in your city — building the relationships that get Praan specified into projects, and driving those specifications through to closed,
*billed*
revenue. This is a true hunter seat: you open doors, you own the number, and you carry the deal from first design-stage conversation all the way to payment in the bank.

**What you'll do**

* Build and own deep relationships with top architects, interior designers, PMCs and developers in your market
* Drive specification-led sales — getting Praan designed into projects at the earliest stage
* Own the full deal cycle: pitch, technical proposal, commercial negotiation, close
* Lock payment terms and billing
  *before*
  projects mobilise — you own revenue, not just pipeline
* Track and convert your pipeline to collected cash, keeping receivables tight
* Represent Praan credibly in the design and architecture community

**What we're looking for**

* **5–7 years selling to architects, interior designers and developers**
  — specification or project sales, where you got a product designed into projects and closed the deal.
* **An existing network you can activate on day one**
  — real relationships with architects, IDs, PMCs or developers in Mumbai/Delhi, ideally from premium building materials, lighting, sanitaryware, furniture or luxury interiors.
* **A closer, not a pipeline-builder**
  — you can point to specific deals
  *you personally*
  won, with real numbers, not team wins.
* **Commercial ownership**
  — you lock payment terms up front, structure milestone billing, and chase collections. A delivered project sitting unbilled is your problem, not finance's.
* **Credibility with designers**
  — architects treat you as a peer who understands their world, not just a vendor pitching product.
* **Based in Mumbai/Delhi**
  (or ready to relocate), and comfortable owning a number in a fast-moving startup.

**Praan is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, religion, caste, gender, disability or any other criteria. We just care about working with great human beings!**

on performance and demonstrated character.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a driven, ecosystem savvy sales professional to own and grow our Startup segment business. This role sits at the intersection

of cloud infrastructure, data & AI, and the AWS partner ecosystem, working directly with founders and CTOs to help fast growing startups adopt

cloud and AI capabilities, while maximizing the commercial and funding levers available through AWS.

This is an end to end ownership role: from sourcing and qualifying opportunities within the AWS ecosystem, to closing deals, to ensuring startups

are set up for long term success on the platform. High performers in this role will be given the opportunity to step into a segment leadership

position.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the Startup Sales Motion End to End

Own the complete sales cycle: discovery, qualification, solutioning, proposal development, commercial negotiation, and deal closure.

Manage opportunities sourced through AWS referrals, marketing generated leads, inbound inquiries, outbound prospecting, and startup

ecosystem partnerships.

Maintain accurate pipeline visibility and forecasting.

AWS Partner Ecosystem & Program Execution

Build and manage the AWS partner ecosystem relationship, working closely with AWS Startup AMs and PSMs to source leads, co sell, and

align on account strategy.

Structure and execute large PPA and MAP engagements, managing commercial and technical stakeholders through to signature.

Leverage AWS funding and enablement programs, including AWS Activate, MAP, Well-Architected Reviews, GenAI-specific programs, and

other funding initiatives, to structure well funded, compelling deals for startup customers.

Represent the company at AWS and startup ecosystem events, building a personal network of founders, investors, and AWS ecosystem

stakeholders.

Consultative Selling to Founders & CTOs

Engage directly with Founders, CTOs, and technical decision makers, understanding their business and technical priorities.

Maintain a strong working understanding of the Data & AI landscape, including relevant AWS services, competitive tooling, and startup

buying patterns, to have credible, consultative conversations.

Articulate business value, ROI, scalability, and operational benefits, not just technical fit.

Startup Ecosystem Development

Build and maintain relationships beyond the immediate buyer, including accelerators, incubators, venture capital firms, and startup

communities.

Build ecosystem driven lead generation channels and create long term strategic relationships within the startup ecosystem.

Account Growth & Expansion

Drive new logo acquisition within the startup segment.

Identify upsell and cross sell opportunities within existing accounts as they scale (migration, modernization, managed services, data & AI,

security).

Develop long term account growth strategies rather than treating deals as one off transactions.

Cross Functional Collaboration

Work closely with Marketing, Presales, Delivery, and various AWS teams to ensure deals are well solutioned and well supported post sale.

Provide market intelligence and customer feedback to help refine messaging, offerings, and GTM strategy for the startup segment.

Contribute to startup focused sales playbooks and best practices.MUST-HAVE REQUIREMENTS

Proven experience working within the AWS partner ecosystem.

Demonstrated experience engaging with Founders and CTOs as primary buyers/stakeholders.

Strong working understanding of the Data & AI landscape (platforms, tooling, and buyer priorities).

Track record of owning and driving deals end to end, with full accountability for closure.

Hands on experience executing large PPAs and MAPs.

Deep, working understanding of AWS funding programs.

Direct experience working with AWS Startup AM/BD/CSR/DGs and PSMs.

AWS certifications (e.g. Cloud Practitioner, Solutions Architect Associate).

GOOD TO HAVE

Proficiency with APN (AWS Partner Network) portals and AWS funding/co sell portals.

Prior experience at a cloud consulting/reseller partner, systems integrator, or a startup focused GTM function.

Existing network within startup, VC, accelerator, or founder communities.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Entrepreneurial mindset with a genuine interest in the startup ecosystem.

Hunter mentality paired with an ability to grow and expand existing accounts.

Ability to simplify complex technology into clear business outcomes.

High ownership, urgency, and ability to operate independently.

Curiosity, resilience, and a continuous learning mindset.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Consistent, predictable pipeline generation and conversion within the startup segment.

Well structured, funded deals that maximize both customer value and AWS program benefits.

Strong, trusted relationships with AWS AMs/PSMs that translate into reliable deal flow.

Growth of AWS sourced and ecosystem driven opportunities over time.

Strong pipeline hygiene and forecasting accuracy.

Demonstrated readiness to take on broader leadership responsibility for the segment.

GROWTH PATH

This role is structured as a growth seat. Based on performance and the character displayed in how deals, relationships, and the team are

handled, the successful candidate will be positioned to take on leadership of the Startup segment.

title: Customer Success Executive, Strategic Accounts

* Experience at large India enterprise accounts, with solid judgment navigating multiple stakeholders
* Strong command over knowledge of digital transformation — design, implementation, and management
* Emerging expertise in one industry

* 2–5 years of experience on large, multi-tracked programs, ideally including organizational change management

FD21

* Work cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering, Marketing, and Support teams to drive revenue goals, improve customer experience, and influence product direction based on market feedback.

* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with the ability to design innovative and scalable solutions.

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Familiarity with telecom ecosystems including SIP, PSTN, and CPaaS platforms.

title: Consulting Architect - Search

Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.
* Experience working closely with a pre-sales organization in scoping customer needs and delivering against a Statement of Work (SOW).
* Experience as a technical instructor or public speaker on enterprise infrastructure software.
* Experience contributing to an open-source project or documentation.

Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. title: Technical Account Manager - 3
description:
**The Role:**

You own the technical success of Cashfree Payment’s largest merchants from first scoping call to scaled production. You're the person, merchant CTOs call when something matters and the person internal teams trust to bring order to complex, high-stakes integrations.

This role sits where engineering depth meets executive presence. You'll debug an API edge case before lunch and align a merchant's leadership on go-live readiness after it.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Enterprise implementations, end-to-end:**
  Scope, plan, integrate, launch, stabilize. You own the timeline, the risks, and the outcome.
* **Technical relationship:**
  You're the primary point of contact for merchant engineering, product and business stakeholders. You translate payment infrastructure into solutions that fit their architecture, growth stage and risk posture, not a standard playbook.
* **Program rigor:**
  Project plans with real dependencies. Risks surfaced before they bite. Internal coordination across Product, Engineering, Risk, Ops and Support to keep delivery on track.
* **Integration health, post go-live:**
  Monitor transaction performance and success rates proactively. Spot optimization opportunities before they become incidents and own resolution when they do.
* **Escalations:**
  You lead the response end-to-end. Root cause, stakeholder comms and resolution. Merchants walk away with the issue fixed and their confidence intact.
* **The merchant signal loop:**
  Patterns you see in the field, friction points, gaps, recurring asks! They become structured inputs into the product roadmap.
* **Launch readiness for high-stakes go-lives:**
  Scale tests, production readiness reviews, white-glove support during peak windows.
* **Solutioning from use case, not catalog:**
  You start with the merchant's business model and work backwards, mapping their use case to the right mix of Cashfree products, not the full suite.
* **SLA-grade resolution**
  When merchant revenue is on the line, you operate to stringent SLAs, coordinating engineering and ops in real time, holding the line on both speed and fixed quality.
* **Team leverage:**
  Better playbooks, sharper integration guides, faster onboarding for the next merchant and the one after that.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **4+ years**
  in technical account management, implementation engineering or solutions engineering, B2B SaaS or fintech, with end-to-end ownership of complex multi-stakeholder programs.
* **Trusted advisor on the highest-stakes integrations:**
  You're the TAM Cashfree puts on the launches that can't go wrong, new product lines, regulated flows & marquee logos.
* **Force multiplier for the team:**
  You mentor L1s and L2s through hard escalations, codify what works into playbooks the team actually uses and shape how Integration operates as a function.
* **Consultative with conviction:**
  You surface the unsaid constraints, challenge assumptions that don't hold and guide merchants to the right answer, not just the asked one.
* **Technically credible:**
  Strong fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns. You don't ship production code, but you read it, reason about it and hold your own in a technical war room.
* **Working knowledge of at least one modern language:**
  Go, Python or Java, with hands-on experience you can point to. Familiarity with mobile platforms (Android, iOS) is a plus, especially when integrations span SDKs.
* **Comfortable in the tools merchants live in:**
  Strong with SQL for slicing through transaction data and fluent with Postman (or equivalent) for testing and debugging APIs in real time.
* **Fintech context is a strong plus:**
  Payment flows, reconciliation, settlements or compliance frameworks, anything that lets you skip the ramp.
* **Range of audience:**
  You translate cleanly in both directions: technical complexity for business stakeholders, business context for engineering, without losing precision either way.
* **High ownership:**
  Merchant outcomes are your outcomes. You follow through without being chased and escalate with context, not noise.
* **Built for ambiguity:**
  Enterprise implementations rarely go to plan. You re-sequence, adapt and keep merchants confident through it.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

**Overview**
**About Cvent:**
www.cvent.com
  
  
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999, Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business.
