Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.
  
  
Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.
  
  
***Recruitment Scam Notice:***
*Beware of recruitment scams. Legitimate Cvent recruiting communications will come from accounts formatted as “*
*name@cvent.com*
*” email address. Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*
*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*
*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.*
*https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud*
*.*
**About The Role**
Goldcast, a Cvent company, is a B2B video and event marketing platform that helps marketing teams run webinars, virtual and hybrid events, and on-demand video experiences at scale. Our clients often run high-visibility events with thousands of attendees, so they need a confident, experienced expert the moment something needs attention. As a Senior Product Consultant, Customer Support, you will be the voice of Goldcast for our customers. You will resolve complex technical queries and own cases from start to finish across phone, chat, and email, while partnering with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to improve the client experience. This is a senior role: we are looking for someone who can handle our most complex and escalated cases, think on their feet during live events, and help raise the bar for the wider support team.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**
 Handle complex client queries across phone, live chat, and email, including bug triage, event and webinar setup, and issues requiring specialized product expertise
  
  
 Provide live, day-of-event support, troubleshooting in real time to keep high-visibility events running smoothly
  
  
 Diagnose audio, video, streaming, registration, and attendee-experience issues, and escalate to Engineering with clear, reproducible detail when needed
  
  
 Support integrations with marketing automation and CRM platforms (e.g., Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot), including data sync, field mapping, and API or webhook configuration
  
  
 Manage enterprise client cases from start to finish with clear ownership, proactive updates, and follow-through
  
  
 Conduct in-depth research and make recommendations that help clients get more value from Goldcast and expand their use of the platform
  
  
 Use AI tools daily to analyze issues, summarize cases, draft responses, and surface insights, while verifying accuracy and protecting client data
  
  
 Document client history, workflows, known issues, and best practices to build and maintain internal support guides and knowledge base content
  
  
 Act as a senior point of contact for the team: handle escalations, mentor new hires, and contribute to projects and process improvements
  
  
**Overall Experience**
**Here's What You Need:**
 6 to 8 years of experience in technical support, technical consulting, or a similar client-facing role supporting SaaS customers. We are open to candidates with a minimum of 3 years of customer handling experience in a technology environment who demonstrate strong depth and senior-level capability
  
  
 Confident verbal communication, with comfort handling live phone and chat conversations calmly under pressure, plus clear, professional written communication for email and documentation
  
  
 Technical aptitude to troubleshoot browser, network, audio/video, and streaming issues, and to read and explain logs, errors, and integration behavior
  
  
 Familiarity with SaaS platforms, preferably in event tech, video, marketing automation, or CRM
  
  
 Experience supporting enterprise clients and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  
  
 Comfort using AI-powered tools to speed up research, analysis, and drafting, with sound judgment on accuracy, confidentiality, and responsible use
  
  
 Strong time management and prioritization skills, including flexibility to support scheduled live events
  
  
 Bonus: Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and API or webhook setup, or a background in live events, webinars, or video production tools
  
  
**Education credentials**
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field preferred (equivalent experience welcome)

title: Aggregate/Grit/Building Material Field Sales Manager
description:
**Job Description – Field Sales Manager (Grit / Aggregates/Building Material), Delhi NCR**

We are hiring a field Sales Manager to build and grow our B2B customer base for crushed stone grit(aggregates and stone dust) across Delhi NCR, supplied from our manufacturing plant in Alwar, Rajasthan.

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Reporting:**
Director / Head of Sales

**Location:**
Gurugram (field role), with regular visits to the Alwar plant

**Targeted Area:**
Territory Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida, Greater Noida, Jewar, Ghaziabad, Sonipat, Rewari, Bhiwadi, Dharuhera and Neemrana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, permanent

**Experience**
: 4–8 years in B2B sales of construction materials (Travel 70–80% field work; own two-wheeler or car preferred)

**About us and the role**

**MPG Group**
runs a grit manufacturing plant in
**Alwar, Rajasthan**
, producing graded crushed stone
**(6 mm, 10 mm, 20 mm, 40 mm)**
, stone dust and manufactured sand. Our plant sits within 120–160 km of most NCR construction sites, which gives us a delivery-time and freight advantage.

**The Field Sales Manager**
will open new accounts in Delhi NCR, win repeat bulk orders, and make sure every order is delivered, invoiced and paid on time. This is a hunting role first: you will build the market for us, not inherit a ready client list.

**Key responsibilities**

**Business development**

• Identify and map RMC plants, builders, infrastructure contractors and other bulk buyers across the territory.

• Generate leads through site visits, cold calls, references, tender portals and industry networks.

• Meet purchase heads, project managers and site engineers to present our grit grades, quality and delivery terms.

• Convert leads into trial orders, then into rate contracts and repeat monthly supply.

**Pricing and negotiation**

• Prepare quotations on a delivered (FOR site) basis, factoring freight, royalty and GST.

• Negotiate rates, volumes, payment terms and credit limits within approved policy.

• Track competitor rates and supply sources in NCR and report market prices weekly.

**Order and logistics coordination**

• Pass confirmed orders to the plant and dispatch team with grade, quantity, site and delivery schedule.

• Coordinate with transporters so trucks reach site on time, with correct weighbridge slips and e-way bills.

• Resolve customer complaints on quality, quantity or delay within 24–48 hours.

**Collections and account management**

• Own receivables for your accounts and keep outstanding within agreed credit days.

• Do KYC, credit checks and documentation before extending credit to new customers.

• Visit key accounts regularly to protect volumes and grow share of their requirement.

**Reporting**

• Maintain daily visit reports, lead pipeline and order data in CRM or the shared tracker.

• Share monthly sales, collections and market-intelligence reports with management.

**Must have**

• Graduate in any discipline; BBA, MBA (Sales/Marketing) or Diploma/B.Tech in Civil Engineering is a plus.

• 4–8 years of field B2B sales in aggregates, cement, RMC, steel, bricks or other construction materials.

• An existing network of RMC plants, builders or contractors in Delhi NCR.

• Working knowledge of aggregate grades, IS 383 specifications, freight costing, GST, e-way bills and royalty documents.

• Proven record of collecting payments and managing credit risk.

• Fluent Hindi; working English for emails and quotations.

• Comfortable with MS Excel, WhatsApp Business and a CRM or sales tracker.

• Valid driving licence and willingness to travel daily across NCR.

**Good to have**

• Experience with government or PSU tenders (NHAI, DMRC, PWD, CPWD).

• Contacts with transporters and fleet operators on the Alwar–NCR route.

**Personal qualities**

• Self-driven hunter who is comfortable building a market from scratch.

• Strong negotiator who protects margins and payment terms.

• Reliable follow-through on delivery and customer issues.

title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
Agilent inspires and supports discoveries that advance the quality of life. We provide life science, diagnostic, and applied market laboratories worldwide with instruments, services, consumables, applications, and expertise. **OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.
  
  
This role is ideal for candidates who combine hands-on laboratory experience with technical software implementation skills. Successful candidates typically have experience working in laboratory informatics, scientific software, LIMS, ELN, LES, or laboratory automation environments.
  
  
As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. * Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals

* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)

/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.

**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**

description:

title: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. A strong grasp of both AI-based solutioning and traditional SCM technical architecture is needed, along with depth in at least one functional area of Supply Chain.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**
Presales
  
  

* Own first-level technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs - AI/agentic solutions and traditional custom builds (integrations, data architecture)
* Map requests to existing solution patterns; escalate novel or complex asks to senior architecture review
* Provide effort sizing and feasibility calls under bid deadlines
* Draft technical solution sections of proposals - architecture, differentiators, risks, dependencies
* Apply Cognizant pricing model with reuse in mind

Customer Pilots
  
  

* Run customer pilots for SC AI solutions - scoping, execution, and measurement against KPIs
* Act as technical point of contact through the pilot lifecycle, coordinating with client and internal teams
* Convert pilot outcomes into case studies and reusable proof points

Solutions Architecture
  
  

* Design solution architecture for new SC/AI offerings - data models, integration patterns, platform-to-play mapping
* Liaise with platform teams (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, SAP) on new capabilities
* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients

**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude -**

* 8-12 years in SCM technology consulting, with presales/solution architecture exposure
* Hands-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred
* Familiarity with AI maturity frameworks a plus
* Strong communication skills - clear technical writing under deadline pressure, confident client engagement during pilots
* Self-driven, proactive and attention to detail necessary
* Based in India (Bangalore/Chennai preferred); limited travel for pilot engagements

title: Enterprise Platform Advisor
description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Platform Advisor
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provide consulting services and advice on complex enterprise transformations involving one or more technology platforms. Advise on platform selection, technology cost optimization and/or value levers. Develop and implement market-leading industry- and/or function-specific technology assets.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Change Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:

title: Solution Architect - Network Performance
description:

You'll collaborate with diverse stakeholders across the organization, so being a strong communicator and team player is key.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
As an Packet Core Performance Consultant, you'll dive deep into customer challenges and ambitions, leverage your expertise in Ericsson's portfolio (and third-party products), and craft end-to-end strategies that optimize network performance and customer experience.

Deliver innovative, cost-effective solutions that create real business value. You'll need to adapt quickly to change and show leadership across both Ericsson and customer teams.
  
  
**The Impact:**
You'll be at the center of major network transformation projects for Ericsson's biggest customers. This means collaborating closely with Product Units, Customer teams, Technical groups, and Marketing/Business Development.
  
  
You'll design and deploy solutions that enhance network capacity, functionality, and end-user services—working across IMS and Packet Core portfolios with a focus on leading the charge into 5G Core and in the E2E chain.
  
  
**Why This Role Rocks:**

* Work on next-gen 5G technology and beyond
* Global customer exposure
* Drive real transformation project
* Shape innovative solutions from the ground up

**Join our Team**
****What will you bring:****
**People & Communication**

* Customer relationship pro who can build trust and drive conversations
* Craft and deliver compelling technical presentations and proposals
* Strong consultative mindset—you see the forest and the trees
* Bridge the gap between engineers, developers, and sales teams

**Mindset & Approach**

* Innovative, creative spirit with a healthy appetite for risk-taking
* Strategic thinker who can pivot to tactical execution when needed
* Thrive under pressure and tight deadlines
* Open to traveling (25%+)

**Technical Chops**

* Solid experience delivering end-to-end solutions in domains like Packet Core, TCP Optimization and Routing.
* Expert-level knowledge in some of the following Core Network Functions: AMF, SMF, MME, SGW/PGW-C/U, UPF, DNS
* Deep understanding of 4G/5G mobile networks, E2E optimization, and network design
* Strong grasp of 3GPP standards—and how to apply them in real-world implementations

**Networking & Protocols**

* Signaling-Plane and User-Plane analysis (familiar with major monitoring systems and Wireshark)
* TCP/QUIC protocol knowledge
* Routing and switching expertise

**Data & Analysis**

* Data analytics skills: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Parquet, etc), MySQL, Excel, Tableau
* Comfortable translating data into actionable insights

**Collaboration & Growth**

* Work closely with R&D—provide feedback and spark new ideas
* Stay current on emerging tech and share knowledge to build customer competence
* Active participant in knowledge transfer and documentation

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience defining new business models
* Design Thinking knowledge and rapid prototyping experience
* Hands-on experience building cloud infrastructure and NFV (Network Function Virtualization)
* 5+ years in technology leadership roles
* Background in system testing & troubleshooting
* Knowledge Cloud & Virtualization,
* Knowledge of virtualization techniques
* Routing and Switching Certifications (Ericsson or Cisco)
* AI/ML & Automation: Familiarity with AIOps, machine learning for network optimization, and intelligent automation tools
* Python/Scripting: Programming skills for automation and data analysis
* Cloud-Native Expertise: Experience with multi-cloud environments, microservices, and cloud-native network functions (CNF)
* Emerging Tech: Knowledge of network slicing, edge computing, and intent-based networking
* Security Forward: Understanding of Zero Trust architectures and modern security frameworks
* Continuous Learner: Demonstrated ability to quickly adopt new technologies and methodologies

description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

Within Sales, we're focused on achieving outperformance across all of our channels, operating in highly competitive categories. This focus results in a dynamic, fast paced environment where cross functional teams are encouraged to collaborate to achieve success. We have around 10,000 sales people across the world, within market roles and ranging in areas like Field Sales, Key Accounts, Trade Marketing and Category Development.
  
  
**About The Role**
Embark on a fulfilling journey as a Pharmaceutical Sales Representative with Reckitt. In this position, you'll harness your passion for the healthcare field to introduce life-enhancing pharmaceutical products to professionals who care for patients every day. Armed with a deep understanding of our products and the compassion to make a difference, you'll be the bridge between our breakthrough solutions and the healthcare community. Join us and channel your drive into a career that helps improve lives.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Be the go-to expert for product knowledge, providing insightful information on our pharmaceutical range and its application in therapy areas.
* Meet and exceed sales targets, ensuring Reckitt's pharmaceutical products reach the hands of healthcare providers.
* Develop lasting relationships with healthcare professionals, becoming a reliable source of expertise and support.
* Convey the benefits of our pharmaceutical products through engaging and informative presentations.
* Analyse market data to stay ahead of industry trends, identifying growth opportunities and delivering on them.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* A track record of success in pharmaceutical sales.
* A deep understanding of medical terminologies, products, and therapeutic areas.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to connect and influence healthcare professionals.
* A proactive approach to building and nurturing relationships with a diverse range of medical authorities.
* Committed to ethical practises and familiar with the regulatory landscape of the pharmaceutical industry.

The skills for success
  
  
Sales Targets, product Knowledge, Customer Relationships, Product Presentations, Market Analysis, Compliance, Territory Management, Training and Development, Sales Reporting, Collaboration.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Officer, Branch Relationship Manager, Growth, Consumer Banking Group
description:
**Business Function**
As the leading bank in Asia, DBS Consumer Banking Group is in a unique position to help our customers realise their dreams and ambitions. As a market leader in the consumer banking business, DBS has a full spectrum of products and services, including deposits, investments, insurance, mortgages, credit cards and personal loans, to help our customers realise their dreams and aspirations at every life stage. Our financial solutions are not only the best in the business – they were made just for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* To deliver exceptional volume and revenue performance with a primary focus on acquiring new-to-bank (NTB) DBS clients having an AUM ≥ INR 1 million through a “need-based approach,” while also engaging and growing existing clients.
* To drive sustained acquisition momentum through active sourcing, local market penetration, and network building, and ensure client coverage and product penetration via cross-sell and up-sell of DBS products and services.
* To manage & maintain the highest customer satisfaction and service levels through proactive client engagement & relationship management, coordinating internally with DBS Service, Distribution, and Product teams.
* Primary ownership of NTB acquisition: Consistently acquire and upgrade quality clients in the branch catchment with a strong focus on sourcing new affluent clients into the Treasures segment.
* Build and execute a robust acquisition pipeline through self-sourcing, referrals, branch walk-ins, local area prospecting, corporate and community engagement.
* Engage with existing customers to deepen the wallet share through retention and growth of AUM.
* Accountable for achieving monthly & annual volume and revenue objective, as agreed.
* Ensure activation of e-Channels (I-Banking / M-Banking/ Online MF/Debit Card) and Savings Book growth for both newly acquired and existing clients.
* Ensure proper implementation & execution of product strategies through effective relationship management.
* Develop the client trust and loyalty for entrenched relationship with DBS through lifestyle and beyond banking propositions
* Ensure optimum product mix and new- to- product clients aimed at customer level profitability and enhancing client coverage.
* Drive and deliver exemplary customer service in the local market and uphold DBS service standards.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance through strict adherence to DBS sales process, timely risk reviews and exercising due diligence while on-boarding.
* Ensure exemplary service delivery of these clients by building appropriate workflows and processes incl. doorstep banking etc.
* Establish DBS as the primary banker for newly acquired clients and strengthen its position as a prominent banking provider through consistent acquisition and superior service delivery.
* Establish, manage and grow the AUM of mapped Client segment by acquiring and nurturing the client having AUM => INR 1 M
* Ensure complete knowledge of all products & services through continuous skill and knowledge improvement.
* Resolve customer queries and complaints within the agreed TAT as per the DBS customer service policy.
* Coordinate and work closely with CBG colleagues, Service teams, Product specialist to ensure that team objectives are met through an environment that nurtures harmony and collaboration through teamwork
* Work closely with the Line Manager and City / Cluster Head to ensure achievement of common team and Branch objectives.
* Ensure internal and regulatory compliance and address operational risks if any, e.g. Health & Safety standards, security of premises, AML / KYC and ongoing risk reviews.
* To exercise appropriate due diligence while on-boarding and engaging with clients.
* Establish DBS as a primary banker for clients and as a prominent banking provider in India.

**Requirements**

* Minimum 2 years of experience in a reputed bank and proficient in banking products
* Preferably MBA (not mandatory)
* Mandatory - Graduate (10+2+3 years of education)
* AMFI / IRDAI / FEDAI certified candidates with BCSBI certification would be an added advantage
* Strong Relationship Management and influencing skills
* Strong service orientation, customer-centric behavior
* Effective probing and listening skills.
* Self-driven and ambitious.
* Good written and verbal communication skills
* Results-orientated & the ability to deliver results under pressure
* In-depth knowledge of local market and competition.
* Understanding of competitive positioning
* Focused on developing image and goodwill of the brand
* Creative, inquisitive mind with problem solving abilities
* Ability to deliver results within tight timelines
* Attention to details, analyzing abilities
* Understanding of HNI Sales/ wealth management product suite, platforms and operational procedures
* Understanding of banking and para-banking guidelines issued by RBI (local regulations in India) and local laws and regulations that impact businesses in general.
* Understanding of KYC requirements & Anti-money Laundering Policies.
* Knowledge of financial markets and products to assist in meaningful engagement with client
* Management of clients and prospects for acquisition and deepening of wallet share
* Close interaction with Branch Manager, BOSH, CSO, CH, RH, Treasures RM’s and Treasures Elite Team Leader
* Operations team to ensure consistent delivery of volume and revenue targets.
* Close and regular interaction with Branch Product specialists for effective skill / knowledge
* Development of self and explore potential in existing books through joint engagement with clients

title: Process Reengineering Specialist
description:
**Redesign Business Processes to Redefine Global Performance**

Turn complex business challenges into opportunities for meaningful transformation! Join Emapta as a
**Process Reengineering Specialist**
and lead process discovery, operational analysis, and AI opportunity assessments. Influence global business strategies, drive measurable efficiency improvements, and build a long-term international career where top 1% talent creates lasting business impact.

**Job Overview**

* Employment Type: Full-time
* Shift: Day Shift, Weekends Off
* Work Setup: Hybrid, Meena Gateway, India

**Exciting Perks Await!**

* Competitive package
* Medical life insurance
* Standard government and Emapta benefits
* Well-equipped, modern, and accessible offices
* Employee engagement initiatives
* Mentorship and exposure to global leaders and teams
* Diverse, inclusive, and supportive culture
* Transparent performance management
* Unlimited upskilling through Emapta Academy courses (Want to know more? Visit:
  **https://emapta.com/training-calendar/**
  )

**The Qualifications We Seek**

Educational Background

* Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Business, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

Professional Experience

* **At least 5 years of experience in process analysis, business analysis, or process improvement, preferably within BPO, shared services, or consulting environments**
* Hands-on experience in operational process mapping and measurement, including transaction volumes, cycle times, and cost drivers
* Experience in identifying AI and automation opportunities and supporting their implementation

Technical & Analytical Skills

* Strong proficiency in process mapping and documentation using
  **Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN)**
  or equivalent methodologies and tools, such as
  **Visio, Lucidchart, or Miro**
* Strong analytical skills in data collection, baseline development, and benefit quantification
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to facilitate process discovery workshops and stakeholder discussions
* Working knowledge of AI and automation capabilities and their applications in operational processes
* Proficiency in time-and-motion studies and data triangulation techniques to establish reliable, evidence-based baselines
* Ability to assess, score, and prioritize improvement opportunities based on business value, feasibility, and organizational readiness

Preferred Qualifications

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or an equivalent process improvement qualification
* Experience with process mining tools, such as Celonis or UiPath Process Mining
* Familiarity with workflow automation platforms, such as n8n or Microsoft Power Automate

**Your Daily Tasks**

Discovery Planning & Execution

* Design discovery plans for each engagement, including project scope, methodologies, data requirements, stakeholder maps, and sprint schedules, in coordination with the Vice President, Digital Solutions.
* Lead structured discovery sprints with client teams through facilitated workshops, stakeholder interviews, side-by-side observations, and time-and-motion studies.
* Conduct data-driven process discovery alongside qualitative assessments by extracting and analyzing system data, applying process mining where event data is available, and cross-validating evidence to ensure reliable findings.
* Map current-state business processes according to consistent standards and document transaction volumes, cycle times, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and cost drivers.

Opportunity Assessment

* Apply the team's assessment methodology to evaluate and score improvement opportunities based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and change impact.
* Establish quantified operational baselines and develop benefit hypotheses for each opportunity to support subsequent verification by the Value & Excellence Office.
* Develop opportunity heatmaps across business processes and functions to demonstrate the scale and location of potential AI-driven improvements to executive stakeholders.
* Validate the technical feasibility of shortlisted opportunities with the AI Engineering team before their inclusion in transformation roadmaps.

Read-Out & Roadmap Support

* Prepare comprehensive discovery reports, opportunity portfolios, prioritized transformation roadmaps, and supporting evidence for all presented metrics.
* Present detailed findings to client project teams and support the Vice President, Digital Solutions, and Transformation Advisor during executive presentations.
* Translate approved transformation roadmaps into implementation-ready documentation, including process specifications, operational baselines, and measurable success criteria for delivery teams.

Growth & Pre-Sales Support

* Support business development initiatives through scoped discovery previews, project effort estimates, and process analysis content for client proposals.
* Develop and maintain reusable discovery toolkits, process patterns, and industry reference models to accelerate future engagements and strengthen proposal quality.

Internal Efficiency Support

* Apply established process discovery and analysis methodologies to Emapta's internal operations as directed.
* Follow the Value & Excellence Office's discovery standards to ensure accurate, measurable, and independently verifiable internal operational baselines.

Other Responsibilities

* Perform additional duties as assigned by authorized company representatives through direct written instructions or verbal assignments.

Role Dimensions

Project Scope

* Deliver process discovery and business analysis across multiple concurrent client engagements within the Digital Solutioning & AI Advisory team.
* Support internal operational efficiency initiatives as directed.

Business Impact

* Establish accurate operational baselines and credible opportunity assessments to strengthen the quality and reliability of Emapta Labs' transformation proposals.
* Provide defensible, evidence-based analyses to enable subsequent verification of realized business benefits.

Decision-Making Authority

* Own process mapping methodologies and maintain analysis quality throughout assigned engagements.
* Escalate decisions related to project scope, commercial considerations, and opportunity prioritization to the Vice President, Digital Solutions.

**Join the Top 1% Talent. A Better Career. A Better Life.**

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With
**over 1,200 international clients**
and a decade of proven success, we provide a strong foundation for your career growth. Here, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning are part of everyday life, and work-life balance is more than just a promise-it's a reality.

**#EmaptaEra #EmaptaIndia**

title: Relationship Manager
description:
We are seeking a motivated and dynamic Relationship Manager to join our team in Tamil Nadu. The primary purpose of this role is to drive business through our channel partners' sales teams and distribution networks. As a Relationship Manager, you will be responsible for building strong relationships across the partner network and growing the business by driving sales of KLI products through these partners. Key responsibilities include organizing catch-up meetings with partners and their clients to introduce KLI products into their portfolios, activating the maximum number of mapped sub-brokers, RMs, and lead generators on a monthly basis, and achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets. You will ensure the smooth issuance of all cases from start to finish and maintain the persistency of all issued policies. Additionally, you will prepare and send daily reports on meetings and sales numbers to all stakeholders, track the status of logged-in policies in the central MIS, and update on tasks assigned for driving focused business through the task MIS. Training partner RMs on KLI products and processes will also be a key part of your role. To be successful in this position, you should possess a graduate or post-graduate degree and have relevant experience in insurance sales, particularly in broking or banca sales. Strong customer orientation, partner management skills, and planning abilities are essential. Behavioral competencies such as business excellence, collaboration, and execution excellence will also contribute to your success in this role. If you are passionate about sales and building relationships in the life insurance sector, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities As a Manager in this area, you will:**

* Provide solutions proficiency to analyse and identifying gaps, to lead the solution design, and implement the Rapid Response application to meet business requirements
* Lead in implementation, configurations, testing, training, knowledge transfer and documentation activities
* Able to conduct workshops to understand end to end business process requirements and propose the best possible solution
* Deliver high quality client solutions that meet and exceed client/EY expectations and are delivered on-time and on-budget
* Manage client solution delivery, including defining project approach, motivating project teams, monitoring, managing project risks, managing client and EY key stakeholders and successfully delivering client solutions
* Identifying new business opportunities, including building strong client relations, understanding client needs and EY solution offerings, communicating client opportunities to EY leadership, and helping develop client opportunities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Gather Business requirements/ lead design discussions with customer & business teams
* Work on Proposal and RFP’s
* Lead the implementation and enhancement of Kinaxis Maestro solutions across supply chain domains
* Analyse business requirements and Perform Fit-Gap Analysis
* Develop detailed solution design based on business requirements
* Strong expertise in detailed configuration and testing of Kinaxis Rapid Response planning tool
* Assist customer/business teams during UAT phase
* Prepare and Review project documentations

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Functional: In-depth knowledge of demand planning ,supply planning, Inventory optimization, Constraints Planning .
* Technical: Workbook development – Table based, composite, data modification, Alerts – Monitoring, Hierarchies & Filters, Scenario hierarchy setup, Control Table Configuration, Planning Engine Knowledge, Data Model modification including custom fields and custom tables

* Consulting experience, including assessments and implementations
* Functional and technical Experience SCM Planning
* Documenting requirements and processes (e.g., Process flows)
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

title: Salesperson
description:
**Company Description**
evm vinfast is an automotive dealership focused on delivering modern, reliable vehicles and a streamlined purchasing experience. The company emphasizes transparent sales practices, attentive customer service, and long-term relationships with vehicle owners. Team members are encouraged to collaborate, share product knowledge, and contribute to a positive showroom environment. evm vinfast values professional growth and supports sales staff with training and tools to succeed in a competitive market. The dealership is committed to serving the local community by matching customers with vehicles that fit their needs and budgets.
  
**Role Description**
This full-time on-site Salesperson role is based in Kottayam and involves engaging directly with customers throughout the vehicle buying process. Day-to-day responsibilities include welcoming customers to the showroom, understanding their needs, presenting suitable vehicle options, and explaining key features, pricing, and financing or leasing options. The Salesperson will conduct test drives, prepare and follow up on quotations, and support customers with documentation and delivery procedures. The role also includes maintaining product knowledge, updating customer records, and meeting individual and team sales targets. The Salesperson is expected to collaborate with colleagues, maintain a professional showroom appearance, and uphold company standards for ethical and customer-centered sales.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong customer service and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and communicate clearly with diverse customers.
* Sales and negotiation capabilities, including experience meeting targets, handling objections, and closing deals in a professional manner.
* Basic understanding of automotive products and willingness to learn vehicle features, specifications, and financing options.
* Solid organizational skills, including accurate record-keeping, follow-up on leads, and time management in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficiency with common office and CRM software, and comfort using digital tools to manage customer information and sales processes.
* Ability to work on-site in Kottayam, including weekends or extended hours as required by showroom operations.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; a degree in business, marketing, or a related field is an advantage.
* Prior experience in automotive or retail sales is preferred but not mandatory; a strong motivation to learn and grow in sales is essential.
* Professional, gender-neutral, and non-discriminatory approach to interacting with customers and colleagues, aligned with company values.

title: Business Operations Associate
description:
**About Vidyalai**

Vidyalai is an Ed-Tech startup revolutionising education by providing personalised learning solutions to students worldwide. We focus primarily on the secondary and higher education market, serving middle school, high school, and college students. Founded by a team of IIT Madras alumni, Vidyalai has rapidly emerged as one of India's fastest-growing startups, with a global user base spanning over 30 countries. Your primary responsibility is to pitch our innovative solutions to students and parents, understand their needs, and devise tailored solutions to convert them into delighted customers. * Plan and organise daily work schedules to efficiently manage existing customers and convert new leads.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

* Strong interpersonal skills, problem-solving abilities, and a flair for presentations.

* Adept at balancing persuasion with professionalism in sales interactions.

: Cochin, Kerala

6 day work week

Performance bonus

*About Agilitas*

Agilitas is building India’s first global sports company by bringing together world-class product innovation, manufacturing excellence, iconic brands, and an integrated retail ecosystem. We are creating category-defining products and experiences for athletes and consumers while building businesses with global ambition.

Agilitas’ integrated sportswear ecosystem spans:

*About the Role*

We are looking for a results-driven Growth & Performance Marketing professional to drive customer acquisition, revenue growth and marketing efficiency across digital channels. This role will own growth strategy, performance marketing, media planning and budget optimisation while improving the customer journey from acquisition to conversion and retention.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with hands-on expertise in digital advertising, commercial thinking and a test-and-learn mindset to deliver measurable business outcomes.

*Key Responsibilities*

**1. Growth Strategy & Business Performance**

* Develop and execute growth strategies aligned with business objectives and revenue targets.

* Identify growth opportunities across customer segments, channels, campaigns and product categories.

**2. Performance Marketing & Media Buying**

* Plan, execute and optimise performance marketing campaigns across Meta, Google and other relevant digital platforms.
* Own media planning, budget allocation, campaign execution and performance optimisation.
* Drive efficient customer acquisition while improving key metrics such as CAC, ROAS, LTV, AOV and conversion rate.

**3. Funnel Optimisation & Customer Growth**

* Drive initiatives to improve conversion rates, average order value, customer retention and repeat purchase.
* Partner with CRM and lifecycle marketing teams, where applicable, to improve customer engagement and lifetime value.
* Use customer behaviour and funnel insights to improve marketing effectiveness.

**4. Budget Management & Marketing ROI**

* Own growth and performance marketing budgets, ensuring efficient allocation of spends across channels.
* Monitor campaign performance against revenue, CAC, ROAS and profitability targets.
* Analyse marketing investments and identify opportunities to improve returns.
* Balance short-term acquisition goals with sustainable, long-term business growth.
* Build regular performance reports and share actionable recommendations with stakeholders.

**5. Analytics, Experimentation & Optimisation**

* Establish a strong test-and-learn culture across creatives, audiences, channels and campaigns.
* Use data, analytics and consumer insights to identify performance gaps and growth opportunities.
* Track campaign effectiveness and develop dashboards to monitor key growth metrics.
* Conduct structured experiments to improve acquisition efficiency, conversion and retention.
* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, platform developments and emerging growth opportunities.

**6. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Brand, Creative, E-commerce, Product, Merchandising, CRM and Analytics teams.
* Align growth campaigns with product launches, seasonal campaigns and key commercial moments.
* Ensure consistent coordination between brand-building initiatives and performance marketing objectives.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to deliver growth plans effectively.

*What We’re Looking For*

* 5–7 years of experience in growth marketing, performance marketing, digital marketing or D2C business growth.
* Experience scaling consumer brands, preferably in fashion, footwear, sportswear, lifestyle, retail or related categories.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Meta Ads, Google Ads and digital media buying.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth, customer acquisition and marketing efficiency.
* Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV, AOV, conversion rates and other key growth metrics.
* Experience managing marketing budgets, campaign performance and ROI.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business decisions.
* Familiarity with analytics, attribution, experimentation and funnel optimisation tools.
* Excellent stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* An entrepreneurial mindset with high ownership, agility and a strong bias for action.

*The Ideal Candidate*

Someone who combines performance-driven thinking with commercial acumen, can turn marketing investments into sustainable business growth, and is comfortable owning both strategy and execution in a fast-paced environment.

title: Growth & Social Media Lead
description:
**About us**

Protein Balance is a clean-label protein brand from Bengaluru. Every batch is tested by third-party NABL labs, and we put the numbers out in public. Our whole thing is “Math Not Marketing.”

Yes, we see the irony of hiring for marketing. That’s exactly why we need the right person.

**About the role**

You’ll own how Protein Balance grows online: what we say, where we say it, what we spend on ads, and whether any of it is working.

It’s a strategy role where you also do the work. You’ll set the direction, and you’ll also fix a weak hook or rewrite a bad caption yourself. We’re early and small, so there’s no one to hand things off to yet.

**What you’ll do**

* **Set the strategy:**
   Decide what each channel is for (Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Threads, X, LinkedIn), and change course when the numbers say so.
* **Run paid ads:**
   Plan, launch and optimise campaigns on Meta and Google, including YouTube. Kill what isn’t working, scale what is.
* **Run the content calendar:**
   Plan formats and posting across platforms, balancing education with timely, trend-led content.
* **Work with our editor:**
   Brief and review reels, statics and thumbnails. Set the bar for hooks and captions.
* **Grow the audience:**
   Drive reach, engagement and followers. Test new formats, collaborations and creator partnerships.
* **Live in the data:**
   Track performance weekly, run experiments, and turn the numbers into clear decisions. Tell us what the data says, even when we don’t want to hear it.
* **Manage community:**
   Set the tone for comments and DMs, and bring recurring questions back to us.
* **Protect the brand:**
   Keep every claim accurate and backed by a source. In our category, a wrong number costs more than a missed post.

**What success looks like**

* **30 days:**
   You’ve audited every channel and our ad setup, mapped what’s working, and shared a first-pass plan.
* **90 days:**
   A running content calendar, a weekly reporting rhythm, live ad campaigns, and at least three format experiments shipped and reviewed.
* **180 days:**
   Measurable growth in reach, engagement and sales against targets we set together, and a playbook we can hire around.

**What we’re looking for**

* A track record of growing something, with numbers you can walk us through. A brand, a campaign, a side project, your own account. All count.
* Hands-on experience running Meta and Google ads with real money.
* Current knowledge of how Instagram, YouTube and the rest reward content, and how that’s changing.
* Strong editorial judgment. You can tell a good hook from a weak one and explain why.
* You read analytics and turn them into decisions, not just reports.
* Ideas. Lots of them. Especially the ones nobody else in protein is trying.

**What we don’t care about**

Degrees, qualifications or certifications. Years of experience either. Someone who grew one account from zero last year beats someone with ten years of reports. Show us what you’ve actually grown.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in D2C, food, nutrition or health content.
* Familiarity with ASCI and FSSAI guidelines on food and health claims.
* Short-form video skills: scripting, basic editing, or being on camera.
* Creator or influencer partnership experience in India.

**How we work**

* **Remote for now.**
   We don’t have an office yet. Once we set one up in Bengaluru, we’ll work from there together, so you should be based here or be open to moving.
* **Full-time,**
   with a 3-month probation. We’ll check in at the halfway mark so you always know where you stand.
* You’ll work directly with both founders. No layers, fast decisions.

**How to apply**

Email 
**careers@proteinbalance.in**
 with the subject line 
**“Growth Lead – Your Name”**
 and include:

1. Your resume
2. Links to work you’ve grown, with the numbers
3. One idea you’d try for Protein Balance in your first 30 days

The idea doesn’t need to be perfect. We just want to see how you think.

Send the resume. We’ll read the work first.

title: Search Engine Marketing Manager
description:
ABOUT CATALYSTS

Catalysts is a Bangalore-based performance marketing agency - 5 years old, 70+ people, 50+ active clients, INR 500+ Crore in managed media spend. We run digital marketing for brands like Duroflex, Sleepyhead, Tally, TTK Prestige, Shoppers Stop etc. We won the DG+ Best Emerging Digital Agency award in 2024.

THE ROLE

You will manage paid media campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads for our active clientele. The client mix includes D2C brands (performance-led, ROAS-focused), B2B SaaS companies (LinkedIn-heavy, pipeline-focused), EdTech brands (lead generation, CPL-sensitive) etc. You will be expected to think beyond execution - understanding the commercial objective behind every campaign, suggesting structural changes when performance demands it, and communicating clearly with clients about what is working, what is not, and why.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Google Ads - Full Stack - Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaigns. You structure accounts well - proper campaign and ad group architecture, tight keyword themes, systematic negative keyword management, and bid strategies matched to the client's funnel stage.

Meta Ads - Performance and Awareness - Build and optimise campaigns across campaign objectives - Lead Generation, Conversions, and Traffic. You understand audience layering (custom audiences, lookalikes, broad with signals), creative fatigue diagnosis, and how to structure creative testing methodically.

LinkedIn Ads - B2B and ABM - Run Sponsored Content, Message Ads, and Lead Gen Forms for B2B clients. You understand ABM (Account-Based Marketing) targeting - company list uploads, job title and function targeting, and how to structure a LinkedIn campaign for pipeline generation rather than just brand awareness.

Budget Management and Pacing - Own the day-to-day budget across accounts. You pace spend to avoid end-of-month underspend or overspend, flag anomalies early, and reallocate across campaigns based on live performance - not just what the plan originally said.

Reporting and Client Communication - Produce weekly performance summaries and monthly strategic reviews. You explain metrics in business terms - revenue impact, pipeline contribution, CPL vs quality of lead - not just channel metrics. You are comfortable presenting data that shows underperformance with a clear plan.

Creative and Landing Page Intelligence - While you do not produce creative, you brief it and you review it for performance. You know what makes a good ad headline, why a landing page is leaking conversions, and how to give actionable feedback to a design team.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Quality

What It Looks Like at 3+ Years

Google Ads Proficiency

You have managed Google Search campaigns with active keyword management, bid optimisation, and negative keyword hygiene. You understand Quality Score, Ad Rank, and the second-price auction. You have run Performance Max and have a considered view on when to use it vs. standard campaigns.

Meta Ads Depth

You have diagnosed ad fatigue, managed creative refresh cycles, structured campaigns for the right funnel stage, and understood the implications of iOS attribution changes on Meta's reporting. You do not just set campaigns and wait - you actively optimise.

LinkedIn Ads / ABM Awareness

You have run at least one B2B campaign on LinkedIn - even a small one. You understand how ABM targeting works (company lists, job function + seniority filters, matched audiences). You know that LinkedIn's CPL is higher than Meta's and why that can still be justified for B2B.

Analytical Rigour

You read campaign data to find patterns, not to confirm assumptions. When ROAS drops, you investigate systematically - audience overlap, creative fatigue, competitor activity, auction pressure - before drawing a conclusion.

Commercial Judgement

You understand that ROAS and CPL are not the same as profit. You can have a conversation about margins, LTV, and what the client actually needs to grow - not just what looks good on the dashboard.

TOOLS YOU SHOULD KNOW

Proficiency required in: Google Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager. Familiarity expected with: Looker Studio for reporting, Meta CAPI setup, LinkedIn Insight Tag, and basic UTM tracking discipline.

QUALIFICATIONS

2+ years of hands-on paid media experience - agency or in-house (mandatory).

Active management of at least INR 5 Lakhs/month in ad spend at some point in your career (can be across multiple clients or accounts).

Experience across at least 2 of the 3 platforms: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads.

Strong written English - you write reports, client summaries, and ad copies regularly.

Google Ads certification is a positive signal but not a substitute for live account experience

title: D2C Growth Lead
description:
FemiSafe is a fast-growing D2C brand for women building high-functional products to solve daily physical annoyances like sweat,body odour,friction and poor sleep.

We are building an aspirational, digital-first consumer brand with a strong presence across marketplaces, our own website and retail channels. We're looking for an entrepreneurial D2C Growth Lead who can take ownership of our direct-to-consumer business and build a scalable, profitable growth engine.

**Role Overview:**

The D2C Growth Lead will own the growth and profitability of FemiSafe's website business, from customer acquisition and conversion to retention and repeat purchases.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who understands the complete D2C funnel, can translate data into action, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, resource-conscious startup environment.

We need someone who combines strategic thinking with execution and takes ownership of business outcomes-not just marketing activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1.D2C Revenue and Business Ownership**

* Own website revenue, growth targets, contribution margins and overall channel profitability.
* Build and execute monthly and quarterly growth plans aligned with company objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve average order value (AOV), conversion rate, repeat purchase rate and customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Develop product bundles, cross-sell and upsell strategies, offers and promotions to increase revenue per customer.
* Track business performance and proactively identify gaps against targets.

**2.Performance Marketing and Csutomer Acquisition**

* Plan, manage and optimise customer acquisition across Meta, Google and other relevant digital channels.
* Work towards sustainable customer acquisition costs (CAC), healthy return on ad spend (ROAS) and profitable scaling.
* Collaborate with the creative team to develop high-performing ad creatives, UGC concepts, hooks and landing-page messaging.
* Build a structured creative testing framework and continuously iterate based on performance data.
* Monitor campaign performance, attribution and budget allocation, taking timely corrective action when performance deteriorates.

**3.Website Conversion and Customer Experience**

* Own the performance and customer journey of the FemiSafe website.
* Improve conversion rates through landing-page optimisation, product-page improvements, checkout optimisation and A/B testing.
* Work with the technology and design teams to improve website speed, usability, navigation and mobile shopping experience.
* Ensure product descriptions, pricing, offers, trust signals and FAQs are optimised for conversion.
* Identify and reduce cart abandonment and checkout drop-offs.

**4.Retention,CRM and Customer Lifecycle**

* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
* Own retention channels such as WhatsApp, email, SMS and other relevant CRM platforms.
* Build automated customer journeys for welcome flows, abandoned carts, post-purchase engagement, replenishment and win-back campaigns.
* Segment customers based on purchase behaviour, product category and engagement.
* Drive repeat orders through personalised communication, loyalty initiatives and relevant product recommendations.

**5.Analystics and Performance Management**

* Build and maintain a clear D2C performance dashboard covering revenue, sessions, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, repeat purchase rate and contribution margin.
* Analyse channel performance and customer cohorts to identify growth opportunities.
* Track the complete funnel from advertising impressions to customer acquisition and repeat purchase.
* Monitor discounting, refunds, cancellations, COD returns and other factors affecting net revenue and profitability.
* Present regular performance reviews with insights, action plans, owners and timelines.

**6.Crossfunctional Collaboration**

* Work closely with creative, design, product, operations, customer support and finance teams.
* Ensure marketing campaigns are aligned with inventory availability and fulfilment capacity.
* Coordinate product launches, promotional calendars and seasonal campaigns.
* Establish clear priorities, execution timelines and accountability across stakeholders.
* Build repeatable systems and processes as the D2C business scales.

**Required Experience and Skills:**

* 2-3 years of experience in D2C, e-commerce growth or performance marketing, preferably with a consumer brand.
* Demonstrated ownership of a D2C website and measurable growth outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, analytics and conversion optimisation.
* Experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform.
* Hands-on knowledge of CRM, retention marketing and WhatsApp/email automation.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and make commercially sound decisions.
* Experience managing budgets and balancing growth with profitability.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and lead execution without depending entirely on external agencies.

**What we are looking for:**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes responsibility for business outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks.
* **Commercial thinking:**
  Understands revenue, margins, CAC, LTV, cash flow and profitability.
* **Bias for action:**
  Identifies problems, proposes solutions and executes quickly.
* **Data-driven decisions:**
  Uses evidence to guide decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
* **Creative problem-solving:**
  Collaborates effectively with creative teams to improve marketing performance.
* **Reliability:**
  Communicates proactively, honours commitments and manages deadlines.
* **Growth mindset:**
  Experiments, learns from failures and continuously improves.
* **Startup adaptability:**
  Comfortable working with constraints, prioritising effectively and building processes from the ground up.

title: Website Manager
description:
**Organisation Name:**
One World One Family Mission

**Job Title:**
Website Manager

**Location:**
Muddenahalli, Karnataka

**About Us:**

One World One Family Mission provides free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare to those in need across 100 countries. Under the visionary leadership of the globally acclaimed humanitarian, Sadguru Sri Madhusudan Sai, the Organisation is dedicated to uplifting the most marginalised communities. The mission is grounded in the ethos of selfless service, guided by the belief that all are a part of ‘One World, One Family’.

**About the Mission’s websites**

1. Mission Website - The Mission has its own website which provides an overview of the mission and the member organisations worldwide. This is managed by the Mission Website Team.

1. Parent Trusts and Foundations - In addition to this, there are parent trusts and foundations in India that primarily focus on specific verticals (Health, Education, Nutrition). Many of these organisations have their own websites, which are managed by dedicated website teams, while others are managed by the Mission Website Team.

1. Institutional Websites - The Mission also manages multiple institutions such as Hospitals, Schools, Colleges and Universities. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.

1. Country Websites - For countries in which our organisation has a presence, some of them have their own websites. Many of these countries do not have a website. However, for those that do, their websites are managed by local teams. The Mission Website Team provides advice, guidance and instructions on the content, branding, function and usability of these sites.

The Mission is currently undergoing a rebranding phase wherein we are consolidating and enhancing the existing websites to ensure that it is clear to website visitors that all these websites fall under one Mission.

**Position Description**

The Website Manager will be responsible for the management, maintenance and enhancement of the key websites under the
**One World One Family Mission**
. The role will ensure that all websites remain accurate, up-to-date, secure, user-friendly, and aligned with the mission's vision, values, and objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Website Management & Operations**

* Manage and oversee all websites under the One World One Family Mission.
* Ensure websites are regularly updated with relevant and accurate content.
* Monitor website functionality, performance, and availability.
* Maintain consistency in design, branding, content, and user experience across all mission websites.
* Implement website enhancement initiatives and support new website launches when required.
* For mission websites that are managed by other individuals and parties, the Website Manager is responsible for providing support, guidance and instructions to ensure that these websites maintain a standard of care, quality and professionalism and are in line with the Mission’s branding guidelines.
* Initiate and manage a dashboard or ticketing system for managing website updates.

**2. Content Management**

* Coordinate with departments, project teams, and content owners to collect and publish website content.
* Establish a systematic review process to ensure information remains current and relevant.
* Update news, events, announcements, programs, reports, and other digital content regularly.
* Ensure content follows organisational guidelines and quality standards.
* In areas where there are no existing processes or guidelines, the Website Manager is responsible for defining and developing new processes/guidelines.

**3. Stakeholder Coordination**

* Act as the central point of contact for all website-related requirements.
* Collaborate with mission leaders, departments, partners, and external vendors for website updates and improvements.
* Gather stakeholder requirements and translate them into actionable website enhancements.
* Facilitate periodic review meetings to address website needs and priorities.

**4. Website Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct regular audits of website content, links, forms, and functionality.
* Ensure compliance with organisational standards, accessibility requirements, and digital best practices.
* Maintain documentation related to website structures, processes, and update logs.
* Ensure information accuracy and consistency across all websites.

**5. Technical Coordination**

* Liaise with developers, hosting providers, and IT teams for website maintenance and troubleshooting.
* Monitor website security, backups, software updates, and performance optimization.
* Coordinate implementation of new features, integrations, and technical improvements.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues affecting website operations.

**6. Analytics & Reporting**

* Monitor website traffic, engagement, and performance metrics.
* Generate periodic reports on website usage and effectiveness.
* Provide recommendations to improve user experience, engagement, and website performance.
* Track the impact of digital initiatives and content updates.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Digital Media, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
* 8-10 years of experience in website management, digital communications, or related roles, including at least 2 years in a role leading or supervising a team.
* Extensive experience working with Content Management Systems (CMS) such as WordPress or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with website analytics and digital marketing tools.

**Required Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Strong working knowledge of website technologies, hosting, and security practices, sufficient to liaise confidently with developers and IT teams and troubleshoot issues independently where possible. Solid understanding of SEO, accessibility standards, and digital best practices.
* Able to work on tight deadlines to ensure websites are updated on a timely basis and establish/adhere to agreed SLA timelines.
* Demonstrated experience managing and developing a small team, including delegating responsibilities, setting priorities, and building team capability over time.
* Able to confidently communicate with internal and external stakeholders.
* Able to collaborate with other teams, including the content team, institutional leadership, design team, branding team and social media team.
* Able to manage multiple websites and priorities simultaneously.

**Location/Work Environment:**
This is a full-time on-site job role.

**Why Join Us?**

Joining the OWOF mission offers a chance to impact marginalized communities globally. With a focus on free Nutrition, Education, and Healthcare across 100 countries, your efforts directly contribute to positive change. Being part of our mission means experiencing the joy of helping others and knowing your contributions bring happiness to those in need.
