title: Content & Script Writer- SkinCare
description:
Job Description: Content & Script Writer

**Company:** Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.  
**Brand:** SAEMORA  
**Location:** JP Nagar, 8th Phase, Bangalore  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time | On-Site  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Email:** skintheta@gmail.com  
**Phone:** +91 7996301234

About Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd.

Skin Theta Global Pvt. Ltd. is a next-generation skincare company driven by innovation, research, and design excellence. Rooted in advanced cosmetic science and inspired by global beauty standards, we create high-performance skincare solutions that combine functionality with refined aesthetics.

Our brand philosophy is built on precision, minimalism, and elevated design, bringing together science, creativity, and technology to deliver a premium skincare experience.

Through our brand SAEMORA, we aim to make skincare more informed, engaging, and accessible through thoughtful products and compelling brand communication.

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, curious, and detail-oriented **Content & Script Writer** who can transform ideas, product benefits, skincare science, and consumer insights into compelling content and engaging video scripts.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of storytelling, audience psychology, digital content formats, and current social media trends. You should be able to develop creative concepts, write attention-grabbing hooks, build engaging narratives, and simplify skincare-related information into clear, credible, and relatable communication.

This role will primarily focus on writing scripts for Instagram Reels, short-form videos, educational content, product explainers, influencer collaborations, brand campaigns, and other digital formats.

We are looking for someone who can balance creativity with research, understand what captures audience attention, and develop content that strengthens brand awareness, builds consumer trust, and drives engagement.

Key Responsibilities1. Script Writing for Short-Form Videos

* Write engaging scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other short-form video platforms.
* Develop compelling hooks that capture attention within the first few seconds.
* Create scripts with clear storytelling, strong narrative flow, and effective calls to action.
* Write scripts in different formats, including educational, conversational, entertaining, problem-solution, myth-busting, and product-focused videos.
* Develop multiple script variations to test different hooks, angles, messaging styles, and storytelling approaches.
* Structure scripts with appropriate dialogue, voiceovers, visual cues, on-screen text, and scene transitions.
* Adapt scripts to different video durations and audience attention spans.
* Collaborate with the production team to ensure scripts translate effectively into engaging visual content.

2. Skincare Research & Educational Content

* Research skincare ingredients, formulations, routines, skin concerns, and emerging beauty trends.
* Translate complex skincare science into simple, engaging, and consumer-friendly language.
* Develop educational scripts on ingredients, product usage, skincare routines, common misconceptions, and frequently asked consumer questions.
* Research topics such as skin hydration, skin barrier care, sunscreen, exfoliation, acne-prone skin, pigmentation, and other relevant skincare subjects.
* Ensure content is factually accurate, credible, and aligned with approved product information.
* Verify claims using reliable sources and coordinate with the relevant internal team when technical clarification is required.
* Avoid exaggerated, misleading, or medically unsupported skincare claims.

3. Product Content & Brand Storytelling

* Develop scripts that communicate product features, key ingredients, benefits, usage instructions, and differentiating factors.
* Translate product specifications into meaningful consumer benefits.
* Create compelling product introduction videos, explainers, demonstrations, and launch content.
* Develop narratives that communicate the brand's philosophy, product development approach, quality standards, and design principles.
* Create content that builds consumer trust while maintaining a premium, science-led brand voice.
* Ensure consistent messaging across product pages, video scripts, campaign materials, and other consumer-facing content.

4. Creative Concept Development

* Brainstorm original content ideas for Reels, Shorts, product videos, and digital campaigns.
* Develop creative concepts based on audience questions, consumer pain points, skincare trends, and product positioning.
* Identify relatable situations, storytelling angles, and creative formats that make skincare content more engaging.
* Develop recurring content series and distinctive storytelling formats for the brand.
* Convert trending topics into relevant, brand-appropriate content ideas without blindly following every trend.
* Create content around skincare myths, common mistakes, routines, ingredient education, frequently asked questions, and consumer experiences.
* Prepare creative briefs and content outlines for shoots and campaigns.

5. Research, Trends & Audience Insights

* Monitor social media trends, emerging content formats, creator styles, and developments in the beauty and skincare industry.
* Research competitor content to identify opportunities for differentiation and stronger storytelling.
* Study audience comments, questions, reviews, and feedback to discover relevant content topics.
* Analyse successful content formats and identify the storytelling elements that may have contributed to their performance.
* Maintain a structured repository of content ideas, references, hooks, scripts, and creative inspiration.
* Continuously explore new approaches to improve content relevance, originality, and audience retention.

6. Influencer & Creator Script Writing

* Develop briefs and scripts for influencers, content creators, and brand collaborators.
* Create clear talking points that communicate product benefits while allowing creators to maintain their natural style.
* Adapt scripts to different creator personalities, audiences, and content formats.
* Develop concepts for product demonstrations, testimonials, unboxing videos, routines, and educational collaborations.
* Ensure that creator content remains aligned with brand guidelines, approved claims, and campaign objectives.

7. Campaign & Marketing Copywriting

* Write headlines, captions, taglines, hooks, calls to action, and short-form promotional copy.
* Contribute creative ideas and messaging for product launches, seasonal campaigns, and brand-building initiatives.
* Develop copy for advertisements, landing pages, product descriptions, and promotional materials when required.
* Adapt messaging for organic social media, paid campaigns, website content, and other digital channels.
* Maintain consistency in brand tone, messaging, terminology, and communication standards.
* Collaborate with the marketing team to ensure content supports campaign objectives.

8. Script Development & Production Coordination

* Prepare structured scripts with scene-by-scene breakdowns, dialogue, voiceovers, visual references, and on-screen text.
* Develop shot suggestions and visual storytelling cues to help production teams execute the concept.
* Participate in brainstorming sessions, shoot planning, and creative reviews.
* Work closely with videographers, editors, designers, marketers, and on-camera talent.
* Review edited videos to ensure that the final content communicates the intended message accurately.
* Incorporate feedback and revise scripts based on creative direction, production requirements, and campaign needs.
* Maintain an organised record of script versions, approvals, and content deliverables.

RequirementsExperience & Qualifications

* 1-3 years of experience in content writing, script writing, copywriting, digital content creation, or a related field.
* A portfolio demonstrating original writing, short-form video scripts, storytelling, or digital campaign content.
* Experience writing scripts for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, or similar video formats is preferred.
* Experience in skincare, beauty, wellness, lifestyle, D2C, or e-commerce brands will be an advantage.
* A degree or qualification in English, Journalism, Mass Communication, Advertising, Marketing, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory for candidates with a strong portfolio.

Skills & Competencies

* Excellent writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills.
* Ability to write attention-grabbing hooks and engaging scripts.
* Strong understanding of audience psychology, narrative structure, and short-form video formats.
* Ability to simplify technical information without compromising accuracy.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Understanding of social media trends, creator content, and digital storytelling.
* Ability to develop original ideas rather than simply reproduce trending formats.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, feedback cycles, and deadlines.
* Openness to feedback and willingness to refine ideas based on creative direction.
* Interest in skincare science, beauty, consumer behaviour, branding, and design.

Tools & Platforms

Familiarity with the following tools and platforms will be an advantage:

* Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts
* Google Docs and Google Sheets
* Google Drive
* Canva
* CapCut and InShot
* ChatGPT or other AI-assisted research and writing tools
* Basic video editing and script-formatting tools
* Online research tools and social media trend discovery platforms

AI tools may be used to support brainstorming and research, but the candidate must demonstrate independent thinking, fact-checking, original writing, and editorial judgement.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond writing words and understands how to turn an idea into a compelling story.

Someone who constantly asks:

* What will make the audience stop scrolling?
* How can we communicate this idea in a simple and memorable way?
* What makes this product relevant to the consumer?
* How can we make skincare education interesting without compromising scientific accuracy?
* What storytelling angle will make our content distinctive?
* How can we turn a good idea into a script that works on camera?

The ideal candidate will be curious, proactive, research-oriented, creatively ambitious, and comfortable taking ownership of a script from initial idea to final production.

What You'll Gain

* The opportunity to shape the content voice of an emerging premium skincare brand.
* Creative ownership in developing original scripts, video concepts, and campaigns.
* Exposure to skincare science, product development, brand positioning, and consumer marketing.
* Hands-on experience with video production, influencer collaborations, and digital campaigns.
* Opportunities to experiment with storytelling formats and creative approaches.
* Collaboration with marketing, design, and production teams.
* A growth pathway into senior content, creative strategy, brand communication, or creative direction roles.

Work Environment

* Full-time, on-site role based in JP Nagar, 8th Phase, Bangalore.
* Collaborative and creativity-driven work culture.
* Fast-paced environment with opportunities to contribute original ideas.
* Strong emphasis on research, accuracy, quality, and attention to detail.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding and marketing teams.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their resume and portfolio of relevant writing samples, video scripts, or content projects at **skintheta@gmail.com**.

For enquiries, contact **+91 7996301234**.

Please include at least two or three examples of short-form video scripts or content pieces that demonstrate your storytelling ability, creativity, and writing style.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Healthcare Marketing Strategist
description:
**Healthcare Marketing, Brand & PR Strategist**

Location: Hyderabad · Experience: 4–8 years · Industry: Healthcare / Hospitals / HealthTech / Healthcare Agencies

**About the role**

Cognibee Media is a content and technology company in Hyderabad. We're looking for a Healthcare Marketing, Brand & PR Strategist who can work closely with hospitals, doctors and healthcare businesses to build their brand, reputation, digital presence and patient growth.

This is a strategic, client-facing role. You'll understand what a hospital wants to achieve commercially and as a brand, turn that into a clear marketing strategy, and work with creative, digital and PR teams to execute it.

**1. Hospital marketing strategy**

* Understand the hospital's business objectives, specialties, target patients and competitive landscape
* Develop annual, quarterly and monthly marketing plans
* Identify priority departments, specialties, doctors and services to promote
* Create campaigns around specialties, procedures, health awareness and hospital initiatives
* Present plans and recommendations directly to hospital management

**2. Hospital branding**

* Develop and strengthen the hospital's brand positioning, messaging and content pillars
* Ensure consistency across social media, website, advertising and offline communication
* Differentiate the hospital from competitors and build trust, credibility and recall

**3. Doctor personal branding**

* Build individual strategies for doctors based on their specialty, expertise and target patients
* Develop ideas for Reels, educational videos, interviews, articles and podcasts
* Help doctors explain complex medical topics simply, and find media, podcast and event opportunities for them
* Track the growth of doctor profiles. The goal is trust, authority and relevance, not popularity

**4. Content strategy**

* Build content pillars and monthly calendars for hospitals and doctors
* Work with videographers, editors, designers and writers to execute
* Ensure content is medically responsible and aligned with hospital guidelines

**5. Digital & performance marketing**

* Plan and oversee Meta and Google Ads, lead generation and patient acquisition campaigns
* Guide SEO, local SEO and website optimisation
* Track CPL, CAC, enquiries, conversions and ROI. You don't need to run every campaign yourself, but you must be able to plan, brief, monitor and optimise them

**6. PR & reputation**

* Develop PR strategies and story ideas for hospitals and doctors
* Get doctors into newspapers, digital publications, TV, podcasts and industry platforms
* Coordinate with PR agencies and journalists, and support reputation management

**7. Client relationship**

* Meet regularly with hospital leadership, present strategies and performance reports
* Turn hospital requirements into clear briefs for creative and marketing teams
* Manage timelines and expectations, and spot problems before they become client issues

**What we're looking for**

* 4–8 years in hospital marketing, a healthcare agency, HealthTech, healthcare PR or a digital agency with healthcare clients
* Strong in branding, positioning, content strategy and social media
* Working knowledge of Meta Ads, Google Ads, SEO and PR
* Comfortable presenting to hospital management and senior doctors
* Uses AI tools for research, content strategy and marketing
* Can turn vague client requirements into clear marketing plans

**The ideal candidate**

Someone who can walk into a hospital, sit with management, and come back with: how we should position the hospital, which specialties and doctors to build, what content and campaigns to run, which PR opportunities to pursue, and how we'll measure whether it worked. A marketing strategist and brand partner, not just a social media manager.

**How to apply**

Apply with your CV and 2–3 examples of healthcare campaigns or brands you've built, along with your expected salary and notice period.

description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

This position is responsible for creating and/or customizing content for marketing assets like emails, advertisements, social media posts, infographics, flyers, brochures, presentations, etc. This position will work closely with other members of the digital marketing team, business units, internal graphic designers and communication team, regional colleagues, freelance graphic designers and agencies.

Ensure all content is aligned with campaign messaging, audience needs, and brand voice. Work closely with campaign managers and content strategy lead to translate requirements into clear, accurate, and effective content deliverables. Ensure consistency, accuracy, and timely delivery across all assigned tasks.

Contribute to and leverage structured content repositories, ensuring proper organization, version control, and alignment with content standards. Identify opportunities to reuse and adapt existing content.
* Organic Content & Channel Support – Support the development and execution of content for organic channels such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and thought leadership initiatives. Adapt content formats and messaging for different platforms while maintaining consistency with overall campaign objectives.

**Example**
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Life Sciences, or a related field
* 2–5 years of experience in digital content creation or ecommerce content
* Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or scientific content domains
* Strong understanding of SEO/GEO/AEO fundamentals and content optimization for digital discovery
* Experience writing for multiple formats including campaign content, emails, landing pages, and ecommerce/product content

title: Associate Manager Omnichannel Retail Marketing
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
**The Opportunity:**
The E-commerce/Quick commerce marketing lead owns end-to-end ownership of performance in terms of sales and ROI/ROAS for each brand across platforms and takes direct accountability for POS. With a deep knowledge of the of the platforms and the nature of the marketplace, this role leans towards analytical mindset with the acumen to take tactical decisions under an over-arching revenue growth strategy. The position combines strategic leadership, data-driven decision-making, and operational excellence to scale online sales, optimize customer acquisition and retention, and strengthen brand presence in high-velocity commerce environments.
  
  
**What Your Impact Will Be**
**Strategic Leadership & Growth**

* Define and own the eCommerce and quick commerce marketing roadmap aligned with global and regional business goals
* Drive topline (GMV/revenue) and bottom-line (profitability, ROI efficiency) growth
* Identify new growth levers across channels, geographies, and customer segments
* Lead annual and quarterly planning, budgeting in alignment with the sales targets and the brand campaigns

**Campaign Management**

* Strategize and execute integrated, full-funnel marketing campaigns aligned with global frameworks and local commercial needs.
* Oversee media planning, agency management, and marketing budgets to maximize efficiency and impact.
* Establish robust measurement frameworks across platforms including ROAS, attribution, experimentation, and campaign effectiveness tracking.
* Continuously innovate marketing formats and test new approaches to drive growth and relevance.
* Optimize funnel metrics such as CTR, CVR, CAC, and ROAS
* Scale campaigns using data insights, A/B testing, and automation tools
* Collaborate with global teams/agencies to implement best practices

**Quick Commerce & Marketplace Management**

* Own relationships and growth strategy across platforms (e.g., Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, Flipkart etc.)
* Plan and execute platform-specific promotions, visibility campaigns, and sponsored listings
* Drive hyperlocal and inventory-led marketing strategies to maximize conversions
* Ensure alignment between demand generation and supply availability
* Own marketplace share of visibility and sales

**Data Analytics & Insights**

* Own marketing dashboards and reporting cadence
* Track and optimize key KPIs GMV, CAC, LTV, retention rate, AOV, contribution margin
* Use analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, app analytics platforms) to derive actionable insights
* Lead experimentation roadmap and conversion rate optimization (CRO) initiatives
* Develop lifecycle marketing strategies onboarding, engagement, retention, and reactivation

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work with brand, sales and category teams to align promotions with inventory and pricing
* Coordinate with brand marketing for integrated campaigns and launches
* Engage with global stakeholders to ensure alignment with brand guidelines and strategy
* Coordinate with the customer POC’s to align o monthly budgets, finance and campaigns management
* Identify the need for creative refresh tracking the key metrics. Analyse, strategize, brief and execute the create refresh required for each platform

**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage customers, agencies and vendors
* Present senior leadership with data-backed recommendations
* Foster a culture of experimentation, accountability, and agility
* Daily interaction with the agency and customers, weekly and monthly review meetings for constant campaign optimisation.

**A&P Budget Management**

* Own end-to-end planning, allocation, and governance of the A&P budget across brands and customers.
* Track and manage A&P spends against plans, ensuring strong financial discipline and timely course correction.
* Prioritize investments based on business objectives, channel needs, and ROI, balancing brand building and performance outcomes.
* Partner with Finance, Sales, and Regional teams on budgeting cycles, phasing, and accrual management.
* Evaluate effectiveness of A&P investments and reallocate resources to maximize impact and returns.
* Own the end-to-end finance process for all activations

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7-8 years of marketplace experience, ideally across FMCG, consumer durables, toys, or omnichannel businesses.
* Strong track record in brand management, performance marketing, and commercial partnership.
* Strategic, tactical and analytical rigor with the ability to translate data into action.
* Understanding of the ecommerce marketplace and the quick-commerce ecosystem
* Flair in operating and understanding the dashboards such as Amazon Pi and IRIS. Know-how of seller central/vendor central/ads portal of all E-comm/Q-comm players
* Strong understanding of eCommerce ecosystems and quick commerce dynamics
* Ability to operate in fast-paced, high-growth environments
* Experience working with multinational teams or in global organizations

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
  
  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
  
  
Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
  
  
Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

****The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.****
****For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.****
****This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.****
Job Description: Integrated Campaign Marketing Manager
  
  
**Overview**
We’re seeking an
**Integrated Campaign Marketing Manager**
to lead the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of high-impact brand and marketing campaigns.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of
**campaign strategy, brand marketing, and digital activation**
, translating business and brand priorities into integrated campaigns that reach the right audiences across the right channels. The Campaign & Digital Marketing Manager will lead cross-functional campaign teams, develop audience and persona strategies, and directly shape paid digital programs across platforms including LinkedIn and Google.
  
  
This person will also serve as a key partner to our media agencies and external vendors, ensuring that our investments, targeting strategies, creative approaches, and channel mix are continuously optimized against campaign objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Strategy & Leadership**

* Own the strategy, planning, execution, and optimization of integrated brand-level marketing campaigns.
* Translate brand, business, and go-to-market priorities into compelling campaign strategies, audience journeys, and activation plans.
* Define campaign objectives, target audiences, personas, messaging priorities, channel strategies, KPIs, and measurement plans.
* Lead a cross-functional campaign team spanning Brand, Content, Product Marketing, Digital, Web, Social, Field Marketing, Marketing Operations, and other key stakeholders.
* Drive campaigns from initial brief and planning through activation, measurement, optimization, and retrospective.
* Ensure campaign activities connect into a cohesive audience journey rather than operating as individual channel tactics.

**Digital & Paid Media Strategy**

* Develop the paid digital strategy that supports brand and integrated campaign objectives.
* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Google Ads, and other relevant paid digital channels.
* Develop targeting strategies based on priority personas, audiences, accounts, funnel stages, geographies, and campaign objectives.
* Partner with creative and content teams to develop and test campaign assets, messaging, offers, and formats.
* Monitor campaign performance and continually optimize targeting, creative, channel mix, and investment.
* Explore new digital channels, platforms, and promotional opportunities that can expand campaign reach and effectiveness.

**Agency & Vendor Management**

* Serve as the primary strategic and day-to-day partner for paid media agencies.
* Set clear agency priorities, campaign briefs, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and performance expectations.
* Challenge agency recommendations and ensure media strategies align to broader campaign and business objectives.
* Lead regular campaign planning, optimization, reporting, and performance reviews with agency partners.
* Research and scope new media, technology, agency, and vendor opportunities.
* Develop requirements and scopes of work and participate in vendor evaluation and selection.
* Evaluate partner performance and ROI to inform future investment decisions.

**Campaign Planning & Cross-Functional Execution**

* Build integrated campaign plans that clearly define audiences, messaging, content, channels, activation, milestones, owners, and success measures.
* Partner with stakeholders to ensure campaign strategies address business priorities while maintaining a consistent brand narrative.
* Facilitate campaign planning sessions and keep cross-functional teams aligned throughout execution.
* Manage campaign timelines, dependencies, approvals, and deliverables.
* Identify execution risks and proactively remove roadblocks to keep campaigns moving.

**Measurement & Optimization**

* Establish clear KPIs and measurement frameworks for campaigns and individual digital channels.
* Analyze campaign performance across awareness, engagement, demand, and business-impact metrics as appropriate to the campaign objective.
* Partner with Marketing Operations, agencies, and other stakeholders to understand performance and identify optimization opportunities.
* Translate campaign and media results into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders and leadership.
* Apply learnings from completed campaigns to improve future targeting, messaging, channel strategy, and investment decisions.

**Closing**
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.
  
  
For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.
  
  
Visit johnsoncontrols.com for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

**Role: Marketing Leader - India**
**Location: Mumbai**
As the Leader, Marketing India, you will be responsible for driving go-to-market strategies and demand generation campaigns in India for Johnson Controls, supporting the growth targets across both direct sales and indirect channel partner businesses. You will lead a team of marketers in India and serve as a strategic partner to the business, commercial, and sales leaders. This role will drive and track demand creation, demand capture, lead conversion, and customer expansion through digitally enabled marketing programs, while enabling channel partners and field sales teams to achieve growth objectives. The ideal candidate is ambitious, collaborative, customer-focused, and willing to roll up their sleeves as JCI continues to grow.
  
  
As a key member of the APAC Marketing Team, this individual will champion a culture of growth, collaboration, accountability, and ROI-driven marketing.
  
  
**How You Will Do It**

* Lead demand generation strategy and execution in India, driving measurable growth for both direct sales and indirect channel partner businesses.
* Serve as the country champion for digitally enabled marketing programs, including SEO, paid media, marketing automation, social media, webinars, events, account-based marketing, and lead nurturing.
* Partner with the India General Manager and India commercial leaders to deliver impactful campaigns that drive results along all stages of the customer lifecycle and drive demand across all channels to market including build and execute integrated go-to-market plans that drive awareness, pipeline, revenue growth, and customer retention.
* Develop localized campaigns that translate global brand and value propositions into market-relevant programs aligned to business, customer, and industry priorities.
* Lead and develop a team of India-based marketing professionals.
* Build and execute marketing programs that support the full customer lifecycle, including demand creation, lead generation, lead conversion, customer expansion, and account growth.
* Collaborate with direct sales teams and channel partners to improve lead quality, lead management, pipeline progression, and revenue conversion.
* Drive account-based marketing strategies for strategic accounts and priority customer segments.
* Define and execute regional event strategies including virtual events, webinars, tradeshows, partner events, proprietary events, and networking activities.
* Partner with channel leaders to develop partner marketing, co-marketing, and enablement programs that accelerate demand generation and business growth through distributors, resellers and other channel partners.
* Manage the marketing budget in India.
* Report out regularly on KPIs, results and progress related to each stage of the funnel.
* Work collaboratively with local sales and services teams to ensure holistic view of demand generation activity and ensure connectedness with APAC regional marketing teams, Global product marketing teams and Marketing Centers of Excellence teams for efficiency and impact.

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams and initiatives around digital marketing.
* Deep understanding of demand generation disciplines including lead scoring, lead nurturing, MQL/SQL management, funnel optimization, CRM systems, in a distributed, multi-line of business environment.
* Experience supporting both direct sales organizations and indirect/channel partner business models.
* Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, campaign execution, account-based marketing, and customer lifecycle marketing.
* Proven ability to develop and execute marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline, revenue growth, and customer engagement.
* Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills and presents convincingly to peers, executives, partners, and customers.
* Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities within a matrixed global organization.
* Strong project and budget management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and workstreams simultaneously.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex concepts into actionable business recommendations.
* Effective relationship builder with experience leading geographically distributed teams.
* Willingness to travel.

**Preferred**

* Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent).
* Experience working in India and managing high growth impact marketing programs.
* Experience with channel marketing, partner ecosystem development, and account-based marketing in a B2B environment.

**What We Offer**
We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents
  
  
***Diversity & Inclusion**
Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.*

title: SEO Executive
description:
**Job Title - SEO Executive**
EC-Council is the world’s largest cyber security technical certification body. We operate in 170 countries globally and we are the owner and developer of various world-famous cyber security programs. We are proud to have trained and certified over 400,000 information security professionals globally that have influenced the cyber security mindset of countless organizations worldwide.
  
  
www.eccouncil.org
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an analytical and results-driven SEO Executive to strengthen organic visibility of multiple brands within EC-Council and drive leads, sales, and revenue. The ideal candidate will have hands-on e commerce SEO experience and a strong understanding of on-page, off-page, and technical SEO.
  
  
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) will be important aspects of this role. You will work closely with content, marketing, and development teams to improve the brands’ discoverability across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan and execute SEO strategies that align with business goals and performance targets.
* Manage on-page, off-page, and technical SEO activities across assigned websites.
* Develop and implement AEO and GEO strategies to improve visibility across AI-powered search and answer platforms.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, content optimization, and website audits using industry tools.
* Support website updates and coordinate implementation with content, marketing, and development teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic traffic, qualified leads, online sales, and conversions.
* Analyze website and user data to identify trends and recommend improvements.
* Stay updated on SEO trends, search algorithm changes, and developments in AEO and GEO.
* Provide regular reports on performance, progress, and future action plans.
* Support related organic growth projects and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* 2 - 4 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably within a digital marketing agency.
* Experience supporting B2C lead generation and e commerce websites are preferred.
* Proficiency in relevant SEO, analytics, AI, and reporting tools.
* Ability to connect organic growth activities with lead quality, conversions, and revenue.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple websites, prioritize independently, and take initiatives from identification through implementation and evaluation.

**About Our Culture**
EC-Council is driven by a mission to strengthen global cybersecurity capability and advance the profession of ethical hacking and information security. Our teams operate across regions and cultures, united by integrity, professionalism, and a commitment to meaningful impact. Continuous learning and accountability are encouraged, empowering individuals to take ownership of their contributions. Respect, trust, and ethical conduct guide how we work with colleagues, partners, and the global cybersecurity community.
  
  
**Additional Information**
EC-Council is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. We do not discriminate based on these or any other characteristics protected by applicable laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. EC-Council is dedicated to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you have a medical condition or disability that limits your ability to complete any part of the application process and require reasonable accommodation, please contact us at ecchr@eccouncil.org and let us know how we can assist. To be eligible for this position, candidates must be able to provide proof that they are either a citizen of the country or have legal authorization to work in the country where the position is posted and are currently residing there. EC-Council does not offer employment to ineligible candidates and reserves the right to revoke employment in case the candidate loses the authorization to work. If, as part of the recruitment process, you are required to complete or submit any form of work, project, case study, or assignment, please note that such material will be considered the exclusive property of EC-Council. By submitting such work, you acknowledge that EC-Council retains all rights, title, and interest in the submitted content, including any intellectual property contained therein. Candidates further waive any intellectual property or moral rights in such submissions, confirm that the work is original and free of third-party infringement, and acknowledge that it is provided solely for evaluation purposes, with no ownership or other rights retained.
  
  
Our Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process. This may include information such as your name, contact details, employment history, qualifications, and any other details you provide as part of your application. All data is handled in compliance with applicable data protection and privacy regulations.
  
  
Please review our policy here: EC-Council Privacy Policy- User & company | Data Protection.

title: Intern SEO
description:
**Position:**
Intern – SEO

**Job Type:**
Full Time

**Location:**
Belapur, Navi Mumbai

**Duration:**
6 Months

**Stipend:**
₹5,000 per month

**Minimum Education:**
Bachelor’s Degree

The Adroit is looking for a highly motivated and passionate
**SEO Intern in Navi Mumbai**
who is eager to build a successful career in
**Search Engine Optimization and Digital Marketing**
. This
**SEO Internship**
is ideal for fresh graduates who want hands-on experience in improving website rankings, increasing organic traffic, and implementing effective SEO strategies.

As an SEO Intern, you will work closely with our digital marketing team to analyze websites, perform keyword research, and execute on-page and off-page SEO activities. This internship offers practical exposure to real-world SEO projects and provides an excellent opportunity to learn industry best practices from experienced professionals.

**Work Profile:**
​​​​

* Perform comprehensive website audits to identify SEO issues, technical gaps, and opportunities for search engine optimization improvements.
* Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, keyword mapping, and search trend analysis to support SEO strategies.
* Execute on-page SEO activities including meta tags optimization, content optimization, keyword placement, URL structure improvements, and internal linking strategies.
* Optimize website content to improve search engine rankings, user engagement, and organic traffic performance.
* Implement off-page SEO strategies including link building, guest blogging, article submissions, social bookmarking, and outreach campaigns.
* Conduct backlink creation and outreach activities through blog posting, directory submissions, classified submissions, and Q&A platforms such as Quora.
* Support website optimization initiatives to improve organic search visibility, indexing, and overall search engine performance.
* Monitor website traffic, keyword rankings, backlink performance, and search visibility using tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO platforms.
* Analyze SEO performance metrics and prepare detailed reports with actionable recommendations for improvement.
* Perform competitor research and benchmarking to identify market trends, content opportunities, and ranking strategies.
* Collaborate with content writers, developers, and marketing teams to implement SEO best practices across websites and digital campaigns.
* Provide SEO recommendations for website structure, content strategy, technical improvements, and user experience optimization.
* Support digital marketing initiatives aligned with SEO objectives to improve online visibility and lead generation.
* Stay updated with the latest SEO trends, search engine algorithm updates, tools, and industry best practices to ensure effective optimization strategies.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree (Computer Science, Mass Media, Marketing, or related field preferred).
* Basic knowledge of
  **Search Engine Optimization (SEO) techniques**
  .
* Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO activities.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics and Google Search Console (preferred).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Fast learner with strong analytical and research skills.
* Self-motivated and eager to build a career in digital marketing.
* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines with quality output.

* Monitor and communicate progress against digital goals at both client and campaign levels.
* Build awareness and understanding of the wider marketplace to identify opportunities for timely and topical initiatives on digital and AI.
* Responsible for supporting the business in creating and updating digital value propositions and product and solutions collateral.

**What you need to have:**

* Minimum 15 years experience overall. Experience working in a medium to large, complex, and matrixed environment, collaborating with a wide variety of stakeholders to develop and execute digital and communications strategies, campaigns, and tactics.
* Extensive experience in roll out of digital tools, digital analytics, and proving ROI, enabling maximized commercial success.
* Significant stakeholder management experience with gravitas and credibility
* Team-oriented and highly motivated self-starter with a proven track record for collaboration within and across teams.
* Strong track record of independent leadership and influencing skills with proven experience of acting as a change agent to transform the ways of working

* You will be comfortable managing multiple complex stakeholder groups to support the delivery of results
* You will be digital literate, with a good understanding and track record of implementing new digital tools.
* Ability to understand, tailor, and communicate complex business, legal, and technical issues for various audiences.
* Proven ability to build a team without direct reporting lines through coaching, credibility, and leadership.
* Proven ability to serve as a trusted and influential advisor and counselor to senior executives, cultivating meaningful relationships with senior leaders and individuals of influence.

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on making Spotify Premium an increasingly desirable music experience in India. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives.
  
  
In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define and execute the Premium desirability strategy for India, using artist-led and culturally relevant initiatives to drive consideration and conversion.
* Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.
* Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.
* Partner with local Music & Podcasts, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to identify and activate artists, creators, and partners that can help grow Premium.
* Design and run desirability initiatives with clear success metrics, using performance data and audience behaviour to understand what works and continuously improve the strategy.
* Own the fandom value opportunity for Premium end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to partnering with Product on fan-facing Premium features and experiences.
* Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of desirability, artist, and partner initiatives to inform where we invest and scale.
* Capture and share learnings that strengthen the India Premium Growth playbook, contribute to cross-regional Growth initiatives, and support adjacent growth priorities when business needs require it.
* Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience across growth, marketing, partnerships, strategy, or related roles in a digital consumer business such as streaming, music, entertainment, media, or technology.
* You have strong experience with music and fandom and understand how fan communities form, what drives engagement, and how fandom can translate into measurable business outcomes.
* You understand growth marketing and connect cultural and creative ideas to measurable outcomes such as consideration, conversion, and subscriber growth.
* You have experience independently owning and scaling artist-led campaigns, partnerships, live experiences, or similarly complex consumer initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
* You are comfortable using data and audience insights to make decisions, test hypotheses, measure impact, and refine your approach.

title: Content Strategist (B2B SaaS)
description:
**Title: Content Strategist (B2B SaaS)**

**Location:**
[On-site, Janakpuri, New Delhi] ·

**About Infrasity**

Infrasity is an engineering-led developer marketing and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) agency. We help DevTool and B2B SaaS companies get discovered by developers on Google, in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini), on GitHub, and in communities like Reddit.

Our clients build in infrastructure, Kubernetes, CI/CD, AI/LLM tooling, security, and APIs. Their audience is engineers, who can tell real technical content from marketing fluff instantly. That's the bar we hold ourselves to.

**The role**

You'll own content strategy and editorial quality for a portfolio of client accounts. You'll plan what gets created and why, write the highest-priority pieces yourself, edit and QA the rest, and prove impact through rankings and AI citations. You'll work closely with our SEO/GEO, Reddit, influencer, and GitHub teams, and directly with client founders and marketing leads in the US and Europe.

**What you'll do**

* Own content roadmaps for 4–6 client accounts, including keyword and AI-prompt research, competitor gap analysis, and topic prioritisation across SEO, GEO/AEO, GitHub, and community channels.
* Write high-priority pieces yourself, and edit and QA work from writers. Formats include:
* blogs, pillar pages, and landing pages
* comparison ("X vs Y") and alternatives pages
* product docs, READMEs, and case studies
* video and creator scripts
* Structure every piece for both search and AI citation, using answer-first sections, FAQs, schema, clear entities, and strong internal linking.
* Get hands-on with client products: read the docs, run the quickstart, and test the code, so the content holds up with engineers.
* Use AI tools to research and draft faster, then fact-check, add technical depth, and cut the filler.
* Repurpose each piece into Reddit posts, creator briefs, and GitHub repo content, working with the respective teams.
* Track performance in GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, and Infrasity's GEO Dashboard. Metrics include rankings, organic traffic, AI citation rate, and share of voice. Report monthly with clear next actions.
* Manage async communication and review calls with overseas clients, and ship to the agreed cadence on time.
* Support the sales team with content audits and proposal sections for prospects.
* Contribute to Infrasity's own content, including our blog, newsletter, and research assets.

**What we're looking for**

* 1–2 years of experience in content marketing, content writing, or SEO, with a portfolio of published work. Internships count.
* Comfort with technical material. You can read API docs, use Git/GitHub and a terminal at a basic level, and write in Markdown. A CS or engineering background, or experience writing for developers, is a strong plus.
* Clear, concise writing and strong editorial judgment. You can tell substance from filler, including in AI-generated drafts.
* Working knowledge of Ahrefs, GSC, and GA4, and the ability to turn data into a plan.
* Curiosity about GEO/AEO, meaning how AI assistants decide what to cite. We'll train you, and we expect you to own it within your first 30 days.
* The organisation to run multiple accounts in parallel, and the confidence to handle calls with overseas founders and marketing leads.
* Availability for some evening overlap with US/EU time zones.

**What success looks like**

* **1 week days:**
  You're onboarded on our GEO workflow and tools, you own roadmaps for 2 accounts, and your first pieces have shipped.
* **30 days:**
  You're running 4–6 accounts on cadence with minimal revision rounds.
* **45 days:**
  You can show measurable movement in rankings or AI citations on at least one account.

**Why Infrasity**

* You'll work on real DevTool and AI companies, not generic SaaS.
* You'll get hands-on experience with GEO, the fastest-moving area in marketing right now, using our proprietary tooling.
* You'll have high ownership early, work directly with the founding team, and have a clear growth path into content strategy leadership.

**About us**

Josh Talks believes that every person irrespective of the background they come from has the potential in them to do well in life. Josh Talks, while serving as an elder brother figure, is working to help young India unlock their true potential.

Being an elder brother figure, firstly, Josh Talks inspires the youth by providing them access to relatable role-models through stories. These stories feature individuals who come from backgrounds similar to the majority of us in India, who have faced similar life struggles yet, against all odds, managed to achieve great success in life. As of January 2024, 5 cr Indians watch a Josh Talk every month. Across all Youtube channels, The Josh Talks Family has over 25mn subscribers. The largest individual channel is Josh Talks Hindi that has over 10mn subscribers.

Another duty that Josh, as an elder brother, undertakes is teaching English to young Indians. Spoken English has become critical to anyone doing well in the workplace. Josh teaches English through its Josh Talks English Speaking app, available on the android play store. Our Indian brothers and sisters can learn to speak in English from 6 other languages including Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam and Punjabi. Josh Talks priced the course at a meager Rs. 499 so that every Indian from any part of the country can afford to speak fluently and confident in English, what Josh considers a basic human right. Over 4L students have completed the Josh Talks Spoken English course.

This however, is just the beginning. Over the coming decades Josh Talks intends to continue building more products that will help advance its objective of helping each Indian unlock their potential.

There is a common trait visible in anyone of the Josh team members who have done incredibly well over the last 10 years and it is that they are
*relentless*
.

If you have an itch inside you to serve your nation, you feel a sense of duty towards your fellow countrymen, and you have a deep seated desire to make your society and the country better, and you want to do all this while building a prosperous career, then Josh Talks is right organization for you to join. * Conduct research on Josh Talks and inspirational content to gain a deeper understanding of the brand and its mission.

* Ability to develop the strategy wrt the projection of content trends and audience consumption.
* Proven ability to craft compelling narratives and translate them into engaging digital content (e.g., scripts, videos, thumbnails, marketing materials).
* Experience in curating and analyzing diverse content formats (long-form & short-form) for maximum impact.
* Experience in scriptwriting, ensuring all key elements are captured for maximum audience relatability.
* Deep understanding of Josh Talks' target audience: Demonstrates strong empathy for the aspirations, challenges, and preferred content formats of Josh Talks viewers, ensuring all content aligns seamlessly and resonates with viewers.

**Creative & Analytical Mindset:**

* Highly creative with a knack to understand audience insights and performance to drive data oriented story telling.
* Structured thinker with the ability to dissect complex problems into easy-to-understand language and an understanding of audience retention.

**Communication & Networking:**

* Exceptional communication skills in English as well as Hindi, both written and verbal. Ability to tailor communication to diverse audiences (film directors, artists, civil servants, sensitive topics).
* Strong public speaking and storytelling skills, capable of captivating audiences.

**Additional Preferences:**

* Fluency in Hindi and English
* Familiarity with Tier 2 & Tier 3 city and rural psychology.
* Experience in media, radio jockeying, creative writing, copywriting, theater, or performing arts (a plus).
* "Getting shit done" attitude and willingness to travel for work.
* Seeking a highly intuitive, problem solver, self motivated and highly curious individual.

National Media Award 2019: President of India

Forbes 30 Under 30 Asia: Batch of 2018

Inc42:

This is a full-time role, based in our Gurgaon office. We actively seek teammates from diverse backgrounds and only hire extremely driven people.

The Josh core team is composed of people who are ambitious and intend to create something that is bigger than themselves. Things that will last forever and will go on to impact and change the world. We have big dreams that are backed by our relentless pursuit to achieve them.

These data points include Customs Declarations, Shipping Data, Satellite Data, AIS Data, Vessels, Web Footprints, Global Tariffs & Duties, FTAs, Import/Export Controls, Export Licenses, Key Personnel & Ownership, Company Financials, and Company Legal information.

By analyzing trade data from 200+ countries, Trademo uses AI to provide deep insights, ensuring visibility and compliance across global supply chains.

Founded by Shalabh Singhal, who is a third-time tech entrepreneur and an alumnus of IIT BHU, CFA Institute USA, and Stanford GSB SEED. Trademo is backed by a remarkable team of leaders and entrepreneurs like Amit Singhal (Former Head of Search at Google), Sridhar Ramaswamy (CEO, Snowflake), and Neeraj Arora (MD, General Catalyst & Former CBO, WhatsApp Group).

**What You Will Do?**

1. Market Research & Data Operations

* Research target accounts, contacts, and buying signals based on defined Ideal Customer Profiles (ICPs) and buyer personas to support GTM campaigns.
* Build, consolidate, and maintain standardized data repositories for account-based marketing (ABM), outbound, and other campaigns.
* Establish consistent data enrichment and contact identification workflows across Business Development, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams.
* Manage data mining operations across tools and platforms, optimizing workflows and credit usage for efficient data sourcing.
* Ensure data deduplication, accurate account and contact ownership, and resolution of ownership conflicts during BDR assignment.

2. Salesforce Data Management & Automation

* Maintain accurate and standardized Salesforce (SFDC) records across accounts, contacts, leads, and opportunities through data cleansing, deduplication, and field standardization.
* Manage lead imports, routing, and assignment for ABM, outbound, marketing-sourced, and third-party campaigns, ensuring correct ownership by BDRs and sales teams.
* Build and maintain Salesforce Flows, validation rules, and declarative automation to streamline lead management, improve data quality, and support reporting.
* Integrate Salesforce with Slack, GPT tools, data mining platforms, and sales automation tools to improve visibility into data ownership, campaign volumes, engagement, and pipeline effectiveness.
* Apply an understanding of Salesforce data models, object relationships, and security settings, including profiles, permission sets, roles, and sharing rules, to support accurate data access and report visibility.

3. Pipeline Analytics & Reporting

* Track pipeline performance, lead progression, and conversion metrics, including prospect-to-lead, MQL-to-SQL, and lead-to-opportunity conversions.
* Create, update, and maintain reports and dashboards to monitor sales performance, pipeline effectiveness, campaign engagement, and data hygiene, providing actionable insights to stakeholders.

**Desired Profile**

* 1–3 years of experience in Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, Data Analysis, Revenue Operations, MIS, Business Operations, or a similar role.
* Good understanding of sales pipeline tracking, sales funnel metrics, lead conversions (MQL/SQL), and sales forecasting.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets, data cleaning and standardization, raw data management, and reports/dashboard creation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret stakeholder requirements and engage in efficient project management workflows to deliver sales data, maintain data accuracy, and generate actionable business insights.

title: Head of Communications
description:
**1. POSITION VACANT:**

Head of Communications | Confidential Organisation | Gurugram, Haryana

**2. ORGANISATION OVERVIEW**

A well-established not-for-profit organisation works to strengthen learning outcomes in government schools by partnering with State Education Departments, teachers and communities. The organisation has evolved towards a systems-strengthening model that brings education improvements to scale through government partnerships.

The organisation’s teacher-centric, consultative approach supports improvements across the school education continuum, from foundational learning and school readiness to secondary education through capacity building, locally relevant learning resources, assessment and institutional strengthening. Working within public education systems, it emphasises practical, sustainable solutions that are co-designed with teachers and government stakeholders.

The organisation values mutual respect, integrity, transparency, excellence, collaboration and trust, and seeks to foster an inclusive work environment.

**3. JOB DESCRIPTION / RESPONSIBILITIES**

The Head of Communications will provide strategic and operational leadership to the organisation’s communications function, strengthening the organisation’s identity, visibility, thought leadership and stakeholder engagement. Reporting to the CEO, the incumbent will turn complex programme work, evidence and outcomes into accurate, memorable and accessible narratives, while ensuring high standards of creative and editorial execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**(A) Strategy, Brand and Creative Storytelling**

(1) Develop and lead the implementation of the organisation’s communications strategy, ensuring alignment with organisational priorities, programme objectives and resource mobilisation goals.

(2) Translate strategic priorities into annual communication plans, key messages, content priorities and outreach initiatives, with clear deliverables and timelines. Establish and maintain consistent messaging, positioning, branding and storytelling across all platforms, media, publications and communication materials.

(3) Oversee the development of high-quality communication materials, including organisational profiles, brochures, reports, presentations, visual storytelling videos, publications and digital content. Safeguard brand integrity by establishing and maintaining brand guidelines, editorial standards and quality assurance processes.

**(B) Impact Communications and Thought Leadership**

(1) Work closely with Programme and MEL teams to identify, validate and communicate programme results, learning outcomes, evaluation findings and stories of change.

(2) Oversee the development of knowledge products, including case studies, white papers, policy briefs, research-based articles and publications that showcase the organisation’s experience, insights and contributions to the education sector. Identify and pursue opportunities to position the organisation and its leadership as credible voices in education.

(3) Establish processes for identifying, documenting and communicating human-interest stories that illustrate the experiences of children, teachers, parents, schools and other stakeholders, ensuring accuracy, dignity and appropriate consent. Oversee field-based documentation and a repository of impact stories and other communication assets; enforce clear consent guidelines, including written parental/guardian sign-off where children are subjects.

**(C) Donor and Stakeholder Communications**

(1) Work closely with the Resource Mobilisation team to develop donor proposals, presentations, impact reports, newsletters and other fundraising materials that articulate the organisation’s value proposition, achievements and potential for scale.

(2) Translate programme information, evidence and organisational priorities into clear, persuasive narratives tailored to different donor and stakeholder audiences. Ensure consistency between programme evidence, organisational messaging and donor-facing narratives, maintaining accuracy and credibility across all external communications.

(3)Communications supports fundraising initiatives;

**(D) Publications, Digital Outreach and Internal Communication**

(1) Lead the organisation’s content strategy, defining content priorities, formats, editorial calendars and publication plans in line with organisational and stakeholder needs. Oversee audience-specific communication materials, including impact reports, case studies, programme publications, teaching and learning collaterals, textbooks and other knowledge products.

(2) Lead the organisation’s digital communications strategy, overseeing its website, social media channels and other relevant platforms. Ensure digital platforms are regularly updated; use digital analytics and audience insights to improve engagement, and identify and manage digital and social media risks.

(3) Lead initiatives to strengthen internal communications, promote organisational alignment and facilitate information sharing across teams and locations. Establish effective processes for gathering programme information, evidence, updates and stories from Programme, MEL and other teams.

**(E) Team, Agency and Function Management**

(1) Lead and manage the communications function, ensuring effective planning, prioritisation, coordination and delivery across all workstreams. Build and manage internal resources, consultants and external partners as applicable; set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations.

(2) Define briefs, deliverables and quality expectations for external partners, and monitor performance, timelines and costs. Establish effective systems and processes for content planning, approvals, production, publication, documentation and performance monitoring; manage the communications budget and ensure effective utilisation of funds.

(3) Foster a culture of creativity, collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement. Maintain the highest standards of personal and professional integrity and model the organisation’s values of openness, innovation, teamwork and performance; ensure adherence to organisational policies and procedures.

**4. EXPERIENCE AND COMPETENCIES**

**Qualifications and Experience:**

(1) Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, English, Marketing, Social Sciences, or any relevant discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification will be an advantage. Strong demonstrated capability may be considered over academic qualifications.

(2) Approximately 14 -15 years of relevant communications experience, including around three years leading a team and a substantial communications portfolio; flexibility for outstanding candidates.

(3) Applications welcomed from corporate communications, agency, brand management and people with active social media fluency. Prior NGO employment or specialist Communication for Development (C4D) credentials are not a prerequisite.

**Skills and Attributes:**

(1) Outstanding English writing, editing and storytelling, with an ability to develop original ideas and communicate complex information engagingly to different audiences.

(2) Strong strategic judgement, brand stewardship to actively build the organisation’s brand and hands-on capacity to deliver high-quality content, campaigns, publications and digital communication.

(3) Ability to interpret and accurately communicate programme evidence and outcomes; excellent judgement on ethics, permissions and sensitive representations involving children.

(4) Confident stakeholder management, collaboration with technical teams, and oversight of creative partners, schedules, budgets and production quality.

(5) Creative, resourceful, audience-aware and results-oriented; able to combine conceptual thinking with disciplined execution and uphold integrity and collaboration.

(6) Multilingual content or Indian regional contexts would be advantageous, but not a prerequisite.

(7) Strong working proficiency in English is a prerequisite; proficiency in Hindi/other Indian languages is an advantage.

**6. LOCATION AND WORK SCHEDULE**

Gurugram, Haryana.

Office-based Monday to Thursday; work from home on Friday. Saturday and Sunday are normally weekly holidays, although occasional weekend work may be required.

Travel to programme locations and other duty stations, as required.

**7. REFERENCE**

SAMS/CONF/HOC/2026

**8. CONTACT INFORMATION**

Team SAMS

Strategic Alliance Management Services Pvt. Ltd.

1/1B, Choudhary Hetram House, Bharat Nagar

New Friends Colony, New Delhi 110 025

Phone: 011-4081 9900; 4165 3612

**9. APPLICATION PROCESS**

SAMS (Strategic Alliance Management Services Pvt. Ltd.) is supporting the hiring organisation on this search. Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn or the SAMS recruitment platform. All applications and enquiries will be handled in confidence. Further details of the selection process will be shared with shortlisted candidates.

By submitting an application, candidates acknowledge that SAMS will collect and process their personal information for recruitment and selection purposes, and may share their application, CV and other relevant information with the hiring organisation in connection with this search mandate. Candidate information will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, as applicable.

Confidential content may be redacted.*
