title: Marketplace Growth Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Heads Up For Tails is looking for a Marketplace Growth Associate to drive growth across Amazon and Flipkart. The role combines hands-on execution with market research, product performance tracking and growth strategy. You will manage live ad campaigns, turn marketplace data and competitor intelligence into clear insights, and help shape category penetration initiatives. It suits someone who is equally comfortable in a bulk sheet and in a growth discussion, and who wants to work on a substantial live budget within a growing performance marketing team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities / What You Will Do**

* Campaign Execution, Optimisation & Reporting
* Set up, launch and optimise Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns on Amazon and equivalent formats on Flipkart, managing bids, budgets and keywords daily.
* Publish daily and weekly dashboards on spend, sales, ACOS and TACOS, with clear commentary on key movements.
* Search Term Analysis & Competitor Tracking
* Analyse search term and placement reports to uncover new keywords, reduce wasted spend and scale high-converting queries.
* Track competitor ad presence, pricing and share of voice to identify conquesting and defence opportunities.
* Market Research & Competitive Benchmarking
* Conduct category and market research using Helium 10, Amazon Brand Analytics and Amazon PI to understand demand, trends and share.
* Benchmark HUFT products against competitors and share actionable insights with the wider team.
* Product Performance Tracking & Growth Ideas
* Track sales, bestseller status, rankings and conversion at product level, and flag listing, content, pricing or stock issues that affect performance.
* Recommend and test data-backed ideas to grow visibility, conversion and sales.
* Marketplace Growth Strategy & Category Penetration
* Contribute to Amazon and Flipkart growth plans, including category expansion, hero ASIN scaling and deeper penetration in existing categories.
* Partner with performance marketing, category, catalogue and operations teams to execute initiatives and measure impact.
* Inventory, Regional Utilisation & Operational Hygiene
* Monitor inventory, regional utilisation and other operational metrics, flagging stock-outs and imbalances early.
* Maintain campaign structures, trackers and documentation to a standard that allows seamless handover.

**Qualifications & Skills / What You Need**

* 1–3 years of hands-on marketplace experience (advertising, account management or growth), either brand-side or with an agency.
* Strong working knowledge of Amazon Ads and Amazon Seller/Vendor Central, with exposure to Flipkart Ads and Seller Hub.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or a degree in marketing, business or analytics is a plus. Amazon Ads certification is an advantage.
* Strong analytical ability: advanced Excel and Google Sheets (pivots, lookups, basic modelling) and comfort working with large datasets.
* Experience with marketplace research tools such as Helium 10, Jungle Scout, Amazon Brand Analytics or similar, and the ability to turn data into clear insights.
* Understanding of marketplace dynamics such as rankings, buy box, listing quality, pricing, promotions and inventory impact on sales.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present insights and coordinate with catalogue, category and operations teams.
* A high level of accuracy, attention to detail and ownership of a daily reporting cadence.

**Good To Have**

* Experience running Meta ads.
* Exposure to quick commerce platforms and their advertising tools.
* Experience in category planning or marketplace growth strategy.
* Basic SQL, Power BI or Looker Studio skills.
* An interest in pets and pet care.

title: E-commerce Growth Manager(Amazon)
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Marketplace Growth Manager to help build and scale our marketplace business, with Amazon as the primary focus and exposure to other large platforms such as Flipkart, Myntra and Ajio. This is a business growth role, not a traditional Key Account Manager role. We are looking for someone who can look at a marketplace as a business, understand what is driving growth, identify gaps, build the plan and work with internal and external teams to deliver results. The role will require hands-on marketplace knowledge, especially Amazon Seller Central, but the larger expectation is ownership of growth across assortment, pricing, visibility, merchandising, marketing, inventory, conversion and profitability.

**Responsibilities**

*What You Will Own*

* Drive marketplace growth with clear ownership of revenue, sales, assortment, conversion and profitability.
* Build and execute marketplace growth plans across assortment, pricing, promotions, visibility, merchandising, marketing and inventory.
* Identify growth opportunities using marketplace data, customer behaviour, category trends and platform-level insights.
* Track performance closely and turn data into clear actions rather than just reporting numbers.
* Work with marketplace teams to unlock visibility, events, category opportunities and commercial programs.
* Take initiatives end-to-end — from identifying the opportunity to building the plan, driving execution and measuring the outcome.

***Amazon – Primary Marketplace***

* Own the growth agenda for Amazon and understand the key levers that influence marketplace performance.
* Have hands-on knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, including catalog, listings, variations, attributes and listing health.
* Improve product discoverability and conversion through better titles, keywords, content, images, A+ and merchandising.
* Monitor traffic, conversion, search performance, assortment and product-level performance to identify opportunities.
* Plan assortment and inventory readiness for launches, events and key trading periods.
* Work with marketing teams/agencies to improve marketplace visibility and marketing efficiency.

***Other Marketplaces***

* Bring hands-on experience of scaling at least one other major marketplace, preferably Flipkart.
* Understand how growth levers differ across Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces.
* Support growth initiatives across Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio and other strategic platforms as required.
* Use platform-specific insights to improve assortment, visibility, pricing, promotions and conversion.

***Commercial & Business Ownership***

* Work closely with finance to understand unit economics, contribution and profitability.
* Identify opportunities to improve ASP, discounts, marketing efficiency and overall marketplace contribution.
* Partner with supply chain and operations teams to improve availability, launch readiness and marketplace SLAs.
* Participate in commercial discussions and build strong relationships with marketplace/category teams.
* Bring a strong point of view on what we should do next — not just what happened last week.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in e-commerce, marketplaces or digital commerce.

**Required Skills**

* Strong hands-on experience with Amazon and experience scaling another major marketplace, preferably Flipkart.
* Experience in marketplace growth, business management, category management or e-commerce — not only account servicing.
* Strong understanding of marketplace metrics including revenue, traffic, conversion, ASP, inventory, ROAS and profitability.
* Good understanding of marketplace cataloging, merchandising, pricing, promotions and visibility levers.
* Strong analytical and Excel skills with the ability to convert data into business actions.
* Strong ownership, bias for action and ability to work independently.
* Confident communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A high-energy, ambitious person who wants to build and scale a business rather than simply manage a marketplace account.

**Preferred Skills**

* Amazon Ads / Sponsored Products / Sponsored Brands.
* Helium10 or similar marketplace analytics tools.
* Experience managing a large SKU portfolio and frequent product launches.
* Experience with marketplace negotiations, events or visibility programs.
* Experience working in a fast-growing D2C / consumer brand environment.

***Why This Role***

* You will be part of a growing e-commerce team and will have the opportunity to directly influence how the brand scales across India's largest marketplaces.
* The role offers broad exposure to growth, merchandising, marketing, commercials, inventory and business performance.

***A Good Fit If You***

* Think in terms of business outcomes, not just tasks.
* Enjoy finding the next growth opportunity and figuring out how to unlock it.
* Are comfortable working with numbers and making decisions from data.
* Move fast, take ownership and follow through.
* Want to build something rather than just manage what already exists.
* Preferred from Retail/Apparel Industry

title: D2C Growth Lead
description:
FemiSafe is a fast-growing D2C brand for women building high-functional products to solve daily physical annoyances like sweat,body odour,friction and poor sleep.

We are building an aspirational, digital-first consumer brand with a strong presence across marketplaces, our own website and retail channels. We're looking for an entrepreneurial D2C Growth Lead who can take ownership of our direct-to-consumer business and build a scalable, profitable growth engine.

**Role Overview:**

The D2C Growth Lead will own the growth and profitability of FemiSafe's website business, from customer acquisition and conversion to retention and repeat purchases.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who understands the complete D2C funnel, can translate data into action, and is comfortable working in a fast-paced, resource-conscious startup environment.

We need someone who combines strategic thinking with execution and takes ownership of business outcomes-not just marketing activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1.D2C Revenue and Business Ownership**

* Own website revenue, growth targets, contribution margins and overall channel profitability.
* Build and execute monthly and quarterly growth plans aligned with company objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve average order value (AOV), conversion rate, repeat purchase rate and customer lifetime value (LTV).
* Develop product bundles, cross-sell and upsell strategies, offers and promotions to increase revenue per customer.
* Track business performance and proactively identify gaps against targets.

**2.Performance Marketing and Csutomer Acquisition**

* Plan, manage and optimise customer acquisition across Meta, Google and other relevant digital channels.
* Work towards sustainable customer acquisition costs (CAC), healthy return on ad spend (ROAS) and profitable scaling.
* Collaborate with the creative team to develop high-performing ad creatives, UGC concepts, hooks and landing-page messaging.
* Build a structured creative testing framework and continuously iterate based on performance data.
* Monitor campaign performance, attribution and budget allocation, taking timely corrective action when performance deteriorates.

**3.Website Conversion and Customer Experience**

* Own the performance and customer journey of the FemiSafe website.
* Improve conversion rates through landing-page optimisation, product-page improvements, checkout optimisation and A/B testing.
* Work with the technology and design teams to improve website speed, usability, navigation and mobile shopping experience.
* Ensure product descriptions, pricing, offers, trust signals and FAQs are optimised for conversion.
* Identify and reduce cart abandonment and checkout drop-offs.

**4.Retention,CRM and Customer Lifecycle**

* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer lifetime value.
* Own retention channels such as WhatsApp, email, SMS and other relevant CRM platforms.
* Build automated customer journeys for welcome flows, abandoned carts, post-purchase engagement, replenishment and win-back campaigns.
* Segment customers based on purchase behaviour, product category and engagement.
* Drive repeat orders through personalised communication, loyalty initiatives and relevant product recommendations.

**5.Analystics and Performance Management**

* Build and maintain a clear D2C performance dashboard covering revenue, sessions, conversion rate, AOV, CAC, ROAS, repeat purchase rate and contribution margin.
* Analyse channel performance and customer cohorts to identify growth opportunities.
* Track the complete funnel from advertising impressions to customer acquisition and repeat purchase.
* Monitor discounting, refunds, cancellations, COD returns and other factors affecting net revenue and profitability.
* Present regular performance reviews with insights, action plans, owners and timelines.

**6.Crossfunctional Collaboration**

* Work closely with creative, design, product, operations, customer support and finance teams.
* Ensure marketing campaigns are aligned with inventory availability and fulfilment capacity.
* Coordinate product launches, promotional calendars and seasonal campaigns.
* Establish clear priorities, execution timelines and accountability across stakeholders.
* Build repeatable systems and processes as the D2C business scales.

**Required Experience and Skills:**

* 2-3 years of experience in D2C, e-commerce growth or performance marketing, preferably with a consumer brand.
* Demonstrated ownership of a D2C website and measurable growth outcomes.
* Strong understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, analytics and conversion optimisation.
* Experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform.
* Hands-on knowledge of CRM, retention marketing and WhatsApp/email automation.
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and make commercially sound decisions.
* Experience managing budgets and balancing growth with profitability.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and lead execution without depending entirely on external agencies.

**What we are looking for:**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes responsibility for business outcomes rather than just completing assigned tasks.
* **Commercial thinking:**
  Understands revenue, margins, CAC, LTV, cash flow and profitability.
* **Bias for action:**
  Identifies problems, proposes solutions and executes quickly.
* **Data-driven decisions:**
  Uses evidence to guide decisions rather than relying on assumptions.
* **Creative problem-solving:**
  Collaborates effectively with creative teams to improve marketing performance.
* **Reliability:**
  Communicates proactively, honours commitments and manages deadlines.
* **Growth mindset:**
  Experiments, learns from failures and continuously improves.
* **Startup adaptability:**
  Comfortable working with constraints, prioritising effectively and building processes from the ground up.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.
  
  
Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

* Revenue Management: Own the top-line and bottom-line growth for the category. Define monthly, quarterly, and annual operating plans. Lead the category demand management team in setting strategic direction and goals.

* Monitor and forecast product demand, inventory levels, and revenue performance to make data-driven decisions
* Ensure timely and accurate execution of demand plans.
* Track key performance indicators and metrics to measure the success of demand management initiatives.

Key Traits: Pricing Acumen | Data Analytics | Growth Mindset | Rigour led Approach | Ecommerce Demand Generation
  
  
In addition to the core responsibilities outlined above, the Deputy Director - Category Demand Management is expected to possess strong leadership skills, excellent analytical abilities, and a strategic mindset. The role requires effective communication and collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to drive business results and achieve targets. pricing, market intelligence, data analytics, demand management, commercial acumen

description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
  
  
We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
  
  
If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
This isn’t a typical Head of Product role. The expectation is not just to optimize flows, but to fundamentally redefine how trading works for millions of users. You’ll step in at a critical inflection point, owning the next phase of growth for a platform already operating at scale. This role is about expanding into new product frontiers, unlocking new opportunities, and building category-defining trading experiences. It’s a high-impact mandate to drive innovation and shape the future of trading at scale.

* Identifying and defining KPIs and metrics for the team to set targets and drive overall team performance.

* Trading experience in the past, with a strong understanding of financial markets—especially Indian markets—and a genuine passion to build and scale products in this space
* 14+ years of Product Management experience with 4+ years in scaling digital B2C products with customer first focus
* A deep understanding and appreciation for good design and user experience
* A track record of building exceptional products that delight your users and produce clear business impact
* Demonstrated ability to lead projects affecting many functions, including product, engineering, finance, compliance, and support.
* Ability to direct major cross-functional initiatives with effective prioritization and influence
* Experience collecting both internal and external customer feedback and requests, empathizing with their challenges and opportunities, and prioritizing roadmaps to optimize results
* Experience in A/B testing and in working with data analytics/data science teams to get metric driven analysis

* Worked in an agile environment or on the scrum methodology
* Passion for cryptocurrency, financial markets, and the CoinDCX mission

**Bengaluru**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.

title: Head of Product, Credit Outcome
description:
**About Tide**
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
  
  
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
  
  
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
  
  
**Tide Facts**

* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

**About The Team**
PCS helps small businesses find and take the right credit. The Credit Outcome vertical is the heaviest part of PCS: it owns the journey from a business's intent to a successful credit outcome, measured by our north-star metric, % 1st Outcome. It spans several markets and combines market-focused product teams (Scaled Markets, New Markets, India) with horizontal teams (Sales Engine and Platform). You will work hand in hand with a dedicated Engineering Director, Design, Product Operations, Analytics and Commercial Heads.
  
  
**About The Role**
Vision, strategy and outcomes
  
  

* Own the vertical's north star: set the strategy and roadmap to grow % 1st Outcome, balancing margin, efficiency and member experience.
* Place the big bets: prioritise across routing, human connection, integrations and decisioning (e.g. pre-qualification), and be explicit about what we will not do.
* Regional focus: make sound trade-offs between markets, including scaling established markets and building new ones such as India.

Leadership and team growth
  
  

* Lead and grow product leaders: hire, coach and develop Product Leads and Senior PMs, giving each a self-contained area of the business to own.
* Clear ownership: ensure one accountable PM/EM pair per workstream, with no ambiguity on who owns what.
* Operating rhythm: run planning, OKRs and reviews that connect team work to vertical and company goals.

Partnership and delivery
  
  

* Engineering partnership: work as a true pair with the Engineering Director on roadmap, capacity and technical investment, including platform health.
* Cross-functional influence: align Design, Data, Risk & Compliance, Commercial and Operations on priorities and launches.
* Data and experimentation: use funnel analytics and experiments to find friction, make decisions and show impact in commercial terms.
* Applied AI: identify where automation and AI (e.g. lead scoring, agentic sales tooling) can raise conversion and efficiency.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Experience: 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years leading product managers or product leads [TBC level/years].
* Commercial acumen: you tie product decisions to revenue, margin and unit economics.
* Data-native: comfortable with funnel analytics, experimentation and BI tools.
* Technical fluency: you can engage confidently with engineers on APIs, integrations and data flows.
* Leader of leaders: you coach strong PMs, set a high bar and create room for people to grow.
* Influence without authority: you align senior stakeholders across functions and regions.
* Nice to have: experience in lending, credit marketplaces, fintech or regulated financial services; experience building products in multiple markets, ideally including India.

**What You’ll Get In Return**

* Competitive Compensation - competitive salary and share options
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top-up options.
* Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks & Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. description:

We are looking for a **Group Product Manager** Leader passionate about building customer-centric products and experiences. In this role, you will help define product vision and strategy, collaborate closely with engineering and design teams, engage directly with customers, and deliver productivity solutions in a flagship app in the M365 suite. Our teams are building the next generation of AI capabilities in the M365 suite for millions of users worldwide to improve how people communicate, organize information, and get work done, all while working in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.

title: Senior Category Manager (Global)
description:
**Role Snapshot:**

As the Senior Category Manager, you will own the business P&L and drive its growth by building a relevant product catalog, defining pricing strategies, identifying new business opportunities, and improving app orders and customer conversion.

You will work closely with the puja calendar owner, marketing, creative, product, and retention teams, to translate regional rituals, festivals, and customer insights into commercially successful offerings.

This role offers the opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up, with significant ownership and the ability to shape category strategy.

**What you’ll Champion:**

**1.Growth & App Order Expansion**

* Drive growth in business orders through relevant category initiatives and customer-focused offerings.
* Identify opportunities across app discovery, merchandising, conversion funnels, and customer journeys.
* Partner with product and growth teams to improve category visibility, conversion, and repeat engagement.
* Analyse customer behaviour and business data to identify growth levers and prioritise high-impact initiatives.

**2.Cross-functional Execution**

* Collaborate with marketing,Retention team, creative teams to develop compelling campaigns, product communication, and festival-led initiatives.
* Work with product, operations, and other relevant teams to ensure smooth execution of category launches and business initiatives.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders and ensure timely execution of priorities.
* Take ownership of outcomes while operating with limited hand-holding in a fast-paced environment.

**3. Business** **& P&L Ownership**

* Own the end-to-end P&L , driving revenue growth, profitability, and sustainable business performance.
* Define business goals, key performance indicators, and category-level growth plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve margins, increase average order value (AOV), and drive repeat purchases.
* Track business performance, identify gaps, and take data-backed decisions to improve outcomes.

**4.Category Strategy & Catalog Development**

* Define product assortment, SKUs, bundles, and offerings for key rituals, festivals, and everyday devotional needs.
* Identify underserved customer segments and new category opportunities.
* Work with relevant teams to evaluate product feasibility, availability, and operational readiness before launching new offerings.
* Continuously refine the catalog based on customer demand, sales performance, and emerging opportunities.

**5.Pricing & Commercial Strategy**

* Define pricing strategies for new and existing offerings, balancing customer value, competitiveness, and profitability.
* Run pricing experiments to understand customer willingness to pay and improve conversion.
* Evaluate product-level economics, margins, discounts, and promotional effectiveness.
* Develop strategies for bundling, upselling, and cross-selling to improve revenue per order.

**6.Festival, Ritual & Consumer Insights**

* Partner closely with the puja calendar owner to understand upcoming festivals, regional rituals, and high-intent purchase occasions.
* Translate festival calendars and ritual insights into relevant products, bundles, campaigns, and launch plans.
* Develop a deep understanding of Indian devotional practices and differences in customer preferences across regions.
* Use customer feedback, market research, and sales trends to continuously improve the category proposition.

**What is needed for this role**

* **Category management experience:** Experience managing a category or business with clear ownership of commercial outcomes, revenue, or P&L.
* **Strong commercial acumen:** Ability to make sound decisions on pricing, assortment, margins, promotions, and business growth.
* **Entrepreneurial mindset:** Comfortable building from the ground up, navigating ambiguity, and taking end-to-end ownership.
* **Analytical thinking:** Ability to interpret business metrics, identify opportunities, and convert insights into actionable growth plans.
* **Customer-centricity:** Strong understanding of consumer behaviour and the ability to build offerings around customer needs.
* **Execution excellence:** Ability to work cross-functionally, manage multiple priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* **Learning agility:** Curiosity to understand Indian rituals, regional nuances, and devotional customer needs, even without prior domain expertise.

**You'll thrive if you**

* Experience in quick commerce, e-commerce, D2C, online marketplaces, or other consumer internet businesses.
* Experience managing a category or business with revenue and profitability targets.
* Exposure to assortment planning, pricing experiments, promotions, merchandising, and conversion optimization.
* Familiarity with devotional categories is an advantage, but not mandatory.

* Write and improve content across onboarding screens, home screens, banners, tooltips, pop-ups, buttons, empty states, and error messages..

title: Compliance and Ops Risk Test Specialist
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

This role is instrumental in identifying and mitigating risk by assessing the control environment, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation. You will execute testing with precision and accountability, producing clear documentation that supports conclusions. You will collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams to complete walkthroughs, gather evidence, and report results in a timely manner.

**Job summary:**

As a **Compliance and Operations Risk Test Specialist** within **compliance and operational risk testing**, you will assess the control environment to identify gaps and support remediation to mitigate risk. You will execute testing with precision and accountability to deliver high-quality outcomes aligned to the firm's highest risks. You will apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to break down complex objectives into manageable tasks and activities. You will contribute to a cohesive and efficient testing framework through strong documentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement of testing methods.

**Job responsibilities:**

* **Understand** and evaluate the assigned function's control environment, with proven experience assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to ensure alignment with SOX, other regulatory frameworks, and the firm's risk priorities.
* **Execute** testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation including process documents, process flows, and overview documents that support testing conclusions.
* **Collaborate** with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule; obtain walkthroughs of processes; document process changes; gather evidence; analyze potential issues; and facilitate timely reporting.
* **Partner** with control owners to support issue validation, action plan quality, and closure discipline, ensuring remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
* **Lead** walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight.
* **Read** and interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements, and continuously improve control evaluation methodologies, including interpretation of control ratings and metrics.
* **Propose** and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of risk management.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience; **minimum of 2 years** of experience in controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment.
* Domain knowledge of banking products and the ability to interpret financial statements; experience across one or more of the following: product control, balance sheet substantiation, month-end close processes (journal entries, accruals, financial close procedures), treasury (liquidity management, capital management, Basel capital, securities operations, front and middle office operations, asset liability management), reconciliation processes (account reconciliation, position matching, break resolution), valuation controls (independent price verification, fair value adjustments), regulatory reporting, financial reporting (daily financial reporting, external disclosures, off-balance-sheet review), and control testing (SOX testing, risk assessments, key control reviews, issue identification, remediation tracking).
* Demonstrated proficiency in advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving, including analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns and evaluating key information.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to recognize risks and gaps.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
* Demonstrated expertise in **Microsoft Office** applications, with advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Professional qualifications such as **Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance, or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)**.
* Audit and control testing background and experience.
* Comfortable using intelligent solutions such as Alteryx and Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.

title: Manager - Legal Counsel
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

**What you will do**

Provide sound and independent legal counsel and advice across corporate, commercial, contract, compliance, litigation and regulatory matters. Partner with business leaders and functions to identify legal risks, develop pragmatic solutions, and support the organization in achieving its business objectives while maintaining very high level of legal and compliance standards. Support the business as a strategic legal partner across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR, Finance and other functions.

**Your key responsibilities**

**Legal Advisory & Business Partnering:**

  

* Provide day-to-day legal advice to business functions on operational, commercial, and strategic matters.
* Understand business requirements and provide practical legal solutions while identifying and mitigating legal and commercial risks.
* Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR and other functions on legal matters.
* Conduct and coordinate legal research on a variety of legal issues.

**Contracts & Commercial Matters:**

  

* Draft, review, negotiate and finalize a variety of commercial contracts, NDAs, SLAs, and SOWs.
* Conduct due diligence reviews considering applicable global and local requirements, business complexity and organizational policies, with a focus on mitigating legal and commercial risk.
* Review commercial terms relating to purchase orders, invoices, letters of credit, bank guarantees, etc.

**Corporate, Compliance & Regulatory:**

  

* Advise on applicable corporate, commercial, labour and other regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen legal compliance processes and support internal audits of legal documentation and processes.
* Provide compliance awareness trainings.
* Liaise with various regulatory authorities and respond to legal notices, regulatory queries, etc.

**Litigation & Dispute Management:**

  

* Manage and coordinate civil, criminal, consumer, arbitration, product liability, service liability, IPR and labour-related disputes.
* Develop litigation strategy, coordinate with external counsel and support matters through investigation, documentation, negotiation and resolution.
* Draft/review legal notices, petitions and documents in consultation with management & external counsel.
* Ensure timely follow-up, effective case management and speedy resolution of disputes.
* Support litigation avoidance and legal risk minimization through stronger contracts, processes and preventive legal controls.

**Intellectual Property & Technology:**

  

* Provide legal support on intellectual property, trademarks, technology-related matters, software licensing, IT services and digitalization initiatives.
* Review technology and digital business arrangements and advise on related legal and commercial risks.
* Provide legal guidance on new products, technologies, AI initiatives and digital transformation projects, coordinating with specialist teams where required.

**E-Legal / Legal Digitalization:**

  

* Support implementation and effective use of legal digitalization tools.
* Review relevant checklists and coordinate with stakeholders for effective implementation.
* Identify opportunities to improve legal processes and systems, enabling effective compliance, efficient ways of working, and better coordination with internal teams.

**Data Privacy, AI & Cybersecurity:**

  

* Design and implement Data Privacy and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework, with an understanding of GDPR and other applicable privacy frameworks.
* Draft, review and negotiate privacy-related clauses, agreements, notices and policies.
* Support data mapping, data retention, consent management, and cross-border data transfer reviews.
* Provide legal guidance on AI/Generative AI governance and associated legal or compliance risks, as well as new products, technologies and digital transformation initiatives.
* Understand cybersecurity / information security legal risks sufficiently to identify key legal implications, ask the right questions, and coordinate with specialist teams.
* Coordinate with IT, Cybersecurity, HR, Procurement and business teams on privacy and technology-related compliance initiatives.

Knowledge of handling assets and employee-related insurance matters, including insurance renewal requirements and claims support, will be an advantage.

**Who are you?**

You are a LLB or LLM from a leading University with 10–15 years of relevant legal experience, preferably with strong in-house legal exposure in a multinational, automotive, manufacturing and technology organization, including exposure to R&D environments. You can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and advise senior stakeholders with sound legal judgement under high-stress, time-critical conditions. You have strong capabilities in contracts, commercial law, corporate law, IPR, compliance, litigation, and legal risk management. Exposure to Data Privacy/DPDP, AI, and Cybersecurity related legal topics are an additional advantage. Excellent analytical, legal research and problem-solving skills with the capability to challenge status quo. You can take a firm stand, are a team player, maintain a positive and collaborative approach, and handle conflicts constructively. You have experience in a global organization and exposure to international stakeholders. You have very good written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex legal matters clearly and simply to business stakeholders. If you can read and write Kannada, it will be an added advantage.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**  
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

**Group Legal & Compliance** contributes to realizing the vision of the Volvo Group by coordinating and providing services within the following areas: Legal, Governance, Security and Internal Audit. With Volvo Group Legal & Compliance you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

title: Senior Data Partnerships Manager I
description:
**Company Description**

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.

  
  
**Job Description**

About the role

We are looking for a hands-on technical customer success leader to be the go-to expert for Nielsen’s newest data products: Audience Builder, Data Driven Linear (DDL), data clean rooms, API-based offerings such as N1 advanced audiences, and the Media Data Engine (MDE).

Working from Bengaluru with clients and colleagues in the US, you will design how clients connect to our data, build the APIs, clean rooms and scripts that make it work, and help them get measurable value from it. You will also co-lead Quality 2.0, a program with Engineering that tracks data quality by its impact on customers, not just delivery metrics.

Responsibilities

Technical solutions and client integrations

* Lead technical discussions with client data, engineering and analytics teams, and design integrations that fit each client's systems.
* Set up and troubleshoot REST and GraphQL API integrations, including authentication, paging, rate limits and error handling.
* Configure and query data clean rooms (for example Snowflake, Databricks), and support audience matching and overlap analysis.
* Write production-quality SQL and Python scripts and reusable code samples that speed up client onboarding.
* Run in-depth technical training for internal teams and client technical staff.

Product expertise and adoption

* Become the expert on a portfolio of audience and measurement data products, including their data models, APIs and main client use cases.
* Support audience workflows that combine first-party, third-party and Nielsen data, and help clients activate audiences in downstream platforms through the UI, APIs and AI-agent connections.
* Help media sellers, agencies and ad tech platforms use measurement data through APIs for planning, pacing, forecasting and deal reconciliation.
* Lead onboarding and adoption for new API-based data products. Deliver tailored training, define best practices, track usage, and turn client feedback into product improvements.

Data quality and customer impact (co-lead with Engineering)

* Build and maintain a quality scorecard that combines delivery metrics, customer impact and customer feedback.
* Analyse escalation trends and customer feedback to find recurring issues and their root causes.
* Push for preventive controls, such as automated data-freshness monitoring, more reliable reprocessing, and contract tests before each release, to reduce quality issues reported by customers.

Customer success and advocacy

* Lead onboarding for new clients, with demos, training and learning materials tailored to their needs.
* Track customer health and adoption metrics, and run plans to grow usage and retention.
* Represent the client inside Nielsen, sharing their needs and market trends with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales.
* Resolve complex client issues quickly by working with internal teams across time zones.

 **Qualifications**

What you will bring

Must have

* 5+ years of experience, including at least 4 years in a client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Implementation or Data Consultant, or Technical Customer Success.
* Advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning) on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.
* At least 2 years of hands-on Python for data work and automation (pandas, requests, scripting).
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs (Postman, OAuth/API keys, JSON, troubleshooting) and GraphQL APIs.
* Experience working directly with US or other global clients, including presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Data clean rooms: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp Habu, AWS Clean Rooms or Google Ads Data Hub.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS & Data pipelines and quality tools: Airflow, dbt, redshift, monitoring and alerting.

Good to have

* Media, ad tech or measurement: TV/CTV, GRPs/impressions, audience-based buying, programmatic (DSP/SSP), post-buy reconciliation.
* AI and agent tools: LLM APIs, MCP or similar agent integrations.
* BI tools (Tableau,powerbi) and work-tracking tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce).

 **Additional Information**

Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

Job Title: Field Sales Manager – Education Sales & Institutional Partnerships

Job Overview

Emversity is hiring a Field Sales Manager to drive education sales, school outreach, institutional partnerships, and student enrolments in Bengaluru.

This is a field-based sales role, ideal for candidates with experience in field sales, education sales, school sales, institutional sales, B2B sales, or direct marketing. The primary responsibility is to visit schools and educational institutions, deliver presentations and course demonstrations, build relationships with key stakeholders, and generate prospective student leads for Emversity’s healthcare and hospitality programmes.

Emversity works with multiple university partners to offer career-oriented education programmes. The selected candidate will represent these programmes at schools and institutions, explain course offerings and career opportunities, conduct presentations and student engagement activities, and convert institutional outreach into qualified leads and enrolments.

Candidates who enjoy fieldwork, meeting people, giving presentations, building partnerships, and achieving sales targets are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities

* Conduct regular field visits to schools, colleges, and educational institutions across Bengaluru to promote Emversity’s healthcare and hospitality programmes.
* Deliver course presentations, product demonstrations, information sessions, and career-orientation sessions to students, teachers, counsellors, and school management.
* Explain programme details, university partnerships, course benefits, eligibility criteria, and career opportunities to prospective students and institutional stakeholders.
* Identify and establish relationships with school principals, management teams, teachers, career counsellors, placement teams, and other decision-makers.
* Generate qualified leads through school visits, institutional outreach, direct sales, networking, seminars, workshops, and promotional activities.
* Develop and maintain institutional partnerships to expand programme reach and support student admissions.
* Follow up with interested students and institutional contacts to drive lead conversion and enrolments.
* Coordinate with internal counselling and admissions teams to ensure timely follow-up on generated leads.
* Identify new schools, colleges, and potential institutional partners within the assigned territory.
* Maintain daily field visit reports, lead records, follow-up updates, and sales activity reports.
* Achieve monthly targets for institutional coverage, lead generation, conversion, and student enrolments.

Eligibility Criteria

* A Master’s degree in any discipline is mandatory.
* An MBA or a Master’s degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with experience in field sales, education sales, school sales, institutional sales, B2B sales, educational product sales, or direct marketing are preferred.
* Experience in selling educational programmes, courses, training solutions, or other services to schools and institutions will be an advantage.
* Must own a personal two-wheeler or other suitable vehicle for regular field visits and local travel.
* Must be comfortable with extensive fieldwork, face-to-face meetings, presentations, and target-based sales.
* Candidates should be willing to travel across Bengaluru for school visits and institutional meetings.

Required Skills

* Strong communication, presentation, and convincing skills.
* Experience in lead generation, prospecting, follow-ups, and sales conversion.
* Ability to conduct presentations and explain products or programmes confidently.
* Relationship management and institutional networking skills.
* Strong negotiation, persuasion, and objection-handling abilities.
* Ability to plan daily field visits and manage a sales pipeline.
* Target-driven approach with a focus on measurable business outcomes.
* Familiarity with Bengaluru’s school and educational institution network will be an added advantage.

Work Environment

* Full-time, field-based position.
* Six working days per week.
* Working hours: 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
* Regular school visits, institutional meetings, presentations, and student engagement activities.
* Local travel within Bengaluru is an essential part of the role.
* Personal vehicle is mandatory.

What We Offer

* An opportunity to build a career in field sales, education sales, and institutional business development.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**Location:** India (In-House)  
**Reporting to:** Customer Success Lead  
**Working Hours / Shift Timings :** UK Shift (1:00 PM IST to 10:00 PM IST), subject to changes in UK daylight saving time.  
  
**About Bark**

Bark is an online services marketplace connecting customers with professionals across over 1,000 categories. Operating in nine countries including the UK, US, Australia, Canada, and New Zealand, we're transforming how people find trusted service providers for everything from home improvement to professional services.  
  
Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to match customers with the right professionals quickly and efficiently. With a global team of over 220 people, we're currently undergoing an exciting transformation: migrating from a lead generation model to a full marketplace platform with subscription based pricing.  
  
As a profitable, PE backed scale up (EMK Capital), Bark offers the best of both worlds: the agility and innovation of a fast moving business combined with financial stability and resources for growth. We recently launched our new marketplace model in Australia (Q4 2025) and are preparing for rollout to the UK and US markets in 2026. You'll have genuine ownership, responsibility, and the opportunity to shape our commercial strategy during a pivotal transformation phase with the chance to make your own contribution to our journey.

**About Bark India**

Bark India is the largest operation of Bark outside the UK, with more than 50 staff members. Bark India started operations in December 2022 and currently manages Marketing and Sales functions for India, South Africa and Singapore. In addition, there is also customer support team that provides support to India and Global operations.

**About the Role**

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Bark you will play a key role in helping Bark Professionals get the most out of the platform, achieve an early return on investment (ROI) and build long-term success.

You'll do this by managing a portfolio of Professionals (sellers) across defined categories, supporting them from onboarding through to ongoing engagement and retention. By understanding their goals, monitoring performance and identifying potential challenges early, you'll provide practical guidance to help them improve their results.

A key part of the role is coaching Professionals on how to use Bark effectively, from building a strong profile and responding to enquiries to improving conversion. You'll take a proactive, data-led approach to identifying those who may be struggling or at risk of disengaging, helping them develop the right behaviours for sustainable success.

Ultimately, your focus will be on helping Professionals recognise the ongoing value of Bark and continue investing in the platform.

**Responsibilities**

* Own post-activation onboarding for a defined portfolio of Professionals
* Reduce time to success on the platform through support with set-up
* Ensure Professionals understand how to succeed on Bark
* Monitor Professional health scores and behavioural signals
* Proactively intervene with at-risk Professionals using defined playbooks
* Diagnose underperformance (setup, behaviour, expectations, supply)
* Coach Professionals on how to handle enquiries, setting up a great portfolio and conversion
* Effectively communicate Professional issues internally
* Drive sustainable behaviour change rather than short-term fixes
* Execute core CSM playbooks consistently
* Maintain clean CRM hygiene and accuracy
* Escalate genuine product issues appropriately

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 2+ years' experience in a phone-led customer-facing role, such as Customer Success, Account Management, Inside Sales or Retention
* Experience working with customers in the UK market
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build relationships and influence customer behaviour
* Strong coaching skills, with the ability to turn performance insights into practical, actionable advice
* Data literate, with experience using CRM systems and performance metrics to manage a large customer portfolio
* Proactive approach to identifying underperformance, resolving challenges and improving customer retention
* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing needs across a high-volume portfolio
* Experience working with trade professionals or within a marketplace environment is advantageous

**What does success look like in this role?**

* Professional retention (logos & revenue)
* Time to first positive outcome
* Health score improvement
* Reduction in early-life churn
* Professional Upgrades

**Perks and Benefits**

* Flexible working policy with the India office located in CBD Bangalore
* Insurances - Family Floater Mediclaim, Employee Personal Accident and Employee Term Life
* Personal annual L&D Budgets to spend on your development
* Enhanced Gympass membership for all employees with access to mental health courses and fitness classes
* Fully stocked snacks in pantry, Monthly team lunches, Quarterly All-site Socials
* Being at the forefront of an industry with new and exciting problems to solve

**Interview Process**

* Screening with Talent Partner
* 1st Stage - Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)
* 2nd Stage - Technical Task & Interview (60 mins)
* 3rd Stage - Values interview (30 mins)

**Diversity Statement**

At Bark, we are a platform for people, revolutionising the way professionals and individuals connect since 2014. Our culture is defined by excitement, ambition, and a commitment to raising the bar. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) and are dedicated to embedding these principles into everything we do. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, and our focus is on hiring, retaining and developing a globally diverse workforce that is passionate about excelling our platform and supporting our customers succeed. Be part of our dynamic team, where bold ideas thrive, and create a future worth shouting about.

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

We are looking for a Director of Global Account Management to lead, scale, and inspire our team of 20+ account managers and 3 team managers globally through our next phase of hyper-growth.

JumpCloud is a comprehensive cloud directory platform solving complex IT and cybersecurity challenges for organizations worldwide. Because our platform offers immense expansion potential, we need a revenue-focused leader who thrives in technically advanced environments, is genuinely fascinated by the cybersecurity landscape, and brings a track record of selling or expanding technical products. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must love getting into the weeds of a technical product and understanding how it transforms our customers' security posture.

In this role, you’ll be an active, hands-on leader who leads from the front. When a customer calls, you’re the type of leader who remembers their account context, steps into the trenches alongside your team, and jumps on calls to drive value. You will foster a culture of supportive coaching and continuous growth, pushing your account managers to excel while setting the bar through your own actions.  
This role reports directly to the SVP of Global Customer Success and collaborates closely with executive leadership across Product, Marketing, Alliances & Channel, and Professional Services.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Actively engage** with JumpCloud’s evolving product suite and cybersecurity ecosystem. Help AMs effectively translate complex platform capabilities into clear business value for technical buyers (CIOs, CISOs, IT Directors).

* **Define** best practices, programs, standards, and processes, including account planning, ABM, pricing, and QBRs.

* **Connect** directly with customers at all levels to support the development of a strong Account Management function within the organization
* **Drive** the delivery of strategic initiatives in collaboration with sales, professional services and product marketing
* **Partner** with marketing to ensure consistent brand experience across all customer interactions.

### **You'll Be a Great Fit if You Have:**

* 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams of account managers
* A demonstrated track record of driving proactive expansion within existing accounts, consistently increasing ARR and securing upsells while retaining key customers
* 3+ years of experience selling a SaaS platform for a high growth US-based company into customers in multiple geographies (including Enterprise in the US)
* Experience working with technically complex software platforms and selling into technical customers
* Strong ability to inspire all levels of your team.
* Ability to listen, articulate positions, and advocate for customers. And, challenge assumptions respectfully and give and receive feedback with grace
* Creative problem solving ability to identify obstacles and viable solutions
* Outcome-orientation. Ability to articulate the desired outcome and work collaboratively to create a path to achieve it.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and presentation skills, at all levels of the organization and with customers

### **Bonus points for:**

* Direct experience leading sales operations/deal desk team members
* Domain relevant experience with IT-related technologies such as directory services, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, MultiFactor Authentication, MDM, or similarly complex technologies

###### **#LI-KF1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

title: Associate Director
description:
**Designation :** **Associate Director**

**Level : L5**

**Location :** **Chennai**

**Experience : 11 to 17 Years**

  
  

**Job Role** :

You will be the senior analytics and AI leader for a set of Technology and Media & Communications clients- the person who owns the client relationship, shapes the analytics and AI roadmap, and makes sure it ships into production and moves a business metric.

Clients in these groups are digital-native and run product telemetry, clickstream, ad-impression and subscriber data at billions of rows, and they buy outcomes (net revenue retention, ARPU, ad yield, cost to serve), not dashboards. The role therefore blends three things: a consulting partner who can hold a VP-level conversation, a data science leader who can review a causal model or an LLM evaluation plan, and a P&L owner who grows the account.

You will also build the practice: reusable accelerators, GenAI and agentic solutions for these industries, and a lead and groom reporting members to run accounts independently.

  
  

**Responsibilities** :

**Client and account leadership**

* Own multiple strategic accounts end to end: relationship, delivery, margin and growth, with Director/VP/CXO stakeholders in product, growth, marketing, revenue operations, finance and similar functions.

* Work with the client & internal teams to build analytics and AI roadmap per account, prioritizing use cases by value, feasibility and data readiness.

* Grow accounts by identifying new problem spaces, writing proposals and SOWs, and converting pilots into multi-year programs.

* Run quarterly business reviews that tie delivered work to client KPIs and documented value.

**Solution design and delivery excellence**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into analytical framings, solution architectures and delivery plans across analytics, data science, ML engineering and data engineering.

* Collaborate with AI CoE and act as technical co-reviewer on model design, experimentation, causal inference, forecasting and GenAI/LLM solutions; challenge assumptions and validate business logic.

* Ensure models reach production with MLOps discipline: versioning, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and documentation.

* Govern delivery health across onsite–offshore teams: scope, estimates, risk, quality gates, utilisation and gross margin.

**GenAI, agentic AI and innovation**

* Support teams in design of GenAI use cases such as conversational analytics, sales and support copilots, content tagging and summarisation, and agentic workflows for marketing and customer operations.

* Set standards for LLM evaluation, guardrails, cost-per-query and responsible AI (privacy, bias, IP and content-rights constraints common in media).

* Partner with hyperscaler and platform alliances (AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake) on joint solutions and go-to-market as needed.

**Solution building and thought leadership**

* Build reusable accelerators and IP for the industry groups (for example, SaaS churn-and-expansion kit, Media Mix tool kit...).

* Support sales for new logos: discovery workshops, solution demos and orals.

* Publish points of view, speak at industry forums and contribute to analyst briefings.

**People leadership**

* Lead 25–60 people through Managers and Senior Managers; own hiring, staffing, performance calibration and promotions for the portfolio.

* Develop successors who can independently run an account.

* Build a culture of rigour, client focus and continuous learning, including GenAI upskilling.

  

**Required skills** :

10+ years in analytics, data science or AI consulting or a captive analytics/CoE (preferably focused on Tech B2B SaaS or Media & Ent ).

familiarity with at least one cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery); understanding of MLOps (MLflow, Airflow, CI/CD). • Delivered at least one GenAI/LLM solution beyond proof of concept, including evaluation and guardrails.
