title: Director, Content & Creative Services
description:
****Description****
**Who is USP?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
****Brief Job Overview****
USP is seeking a Director, Content & Creative Services to source content into compelling, customer-centric digital experiences. The role will build the operating model, creative standards, workflows, technology, and partner ecosystem needed to produce reusable video, audio, articles, social content, infographics, email modules, campaign assets, and internal training at speed and with consistent quality.
  
  
This role will
**build and scale USP’s Digital Studio**
, with a strong focus on:
  
  

* Content atomization strategy and studio operations
* Multiformat digital production and creative quality
* Cross-functional governance, distribution, measurement, and reuse

Working across Scientific Affairs, Education, Global Communications, Digital Marketing, Industry Programs, regional teams, and external partners, this leader will turn high-value source material into coordinated content journeys that expand customer knowledge, strengthen thought leadership, improve engagement, generate leads, and support measurable business and education outcomes.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The following are the main responsibilities for the Director, Content & Creative Services
  
  

* Digital Studio Strategy & Operating Model
* Establish the vision, roadmap, service model, and annual plan for USP’s Digital Studio and content atomization capability.
* Build a scalable operating model that progresses from agency-supported pilot to a sustainable insourced center of excellence.
* Define intake, prioritization, briefing, production, review, publishing, and reuse workflows.
* Translate enterprise priorities and customer needs into a focused studio portfolio and production roadmap.
* Content Atomization & Multiformat Production
* Turn webinars, seminars, expert presentations, education programs, and other source assets into coordinated suites of reusable content.
* Lead production of short-form video, audio and podcasts, articles, social posts, infographics, email snippets, campaign modules, and internal training.
* Ensure each asset is audience-relevant, channel-appropriate, accessible, on brand, and designed for reuse across the customer journey.
* Apply AI-enabled and digital production tools responsibly to improve speed, consistency, versioning, and scale.
* Creative Direction, Quality & Governance
* Set creative direction, production standards, templates, and quality controls across video, audio, design, and digital content.
* Partner with scientific and communications owners to preserve scientific accuracy while making complex topics clear and engaging.
* Embed brand consistency, accessibility, rights management, and SMRP/PMRC requirements into studio workflows.
* Maintain review discipline, version control, and production documentation for every deliverable.
* Agency, Technology & Studio Operations
* Select, brief, and manage agency and production partners against clear scope, quality, timeline, and budget expectations.
* Own studio capacity planning, production schedules, vendor performance, and investment decisions.
* Define requirements for video and audio editing, design, recording, collaboration, and digital asset management tools.
* Build repeatable processes and internal capability that reduce one-off effort and improve time to market.
* Cross-Functional Activation & Content Reuse
* Lead collaborative planning with Scientific Affairs, Education, Industry Programs, Global Communications, Digital Marketing, and regional teams.
* Convert shared priorities into actionable creative briefs, channel plans, and coordinated content packages.
* Enable distribution across USP-owned channels, the Education LMS, webinars, email and Marketo nurture, social platforms, regional channels, and the USP Store.
* Promote systematic tagging, storage, discovery, adaptation, and reuse through the content library and digital asset management ecosystem.
* Measurement, Learning & Scale
* Define and report studio KPIs, including throughput, reuse, engagement, views, leads, education impact, conversion contribution, and production efficiency.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve formats, workflows, channel activation, and investment choices.
* Document pilot results, codify lessons learned, and scale successful approaches across topics, regions, and business priorities.
* Present studio performance, risks, recommendations, and roadmap decisions to senior leadership.

****Note:****
As part of the recruitment process, USP's Global Talent Acquisition team may contact candidates through a variety of communication channels, including Microsoft Teams, telephone, email, and WhatsApp (voice calls and text messages). These communications may be used to schedule interviews, provide updates on application status, discuss career opportunities, and answer questions about employment with USP.
  
  
To help ensure timely communication, candidates are encouraged to keep their contact information current and to engage only with individuals who clearly identify themselves as authorized USP representatives. USP will never request payment, banking details, or other financial information as part of the hiring process.
  
  
****Fraud Alert:****
USP is committed to protecting job seekers from recruitment fraud. Legitimate employment-related communications will come only from authorized USP representatives. If you are unsure whether a communication is authentic, please verify it through USP’s official careers website before sharing personal information.
  
  
**Who is USP Looking For?**
****Standardized Language For Consistency (do Not Delete):****
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the below competencies and experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, digital media, design, journalism, business, or a related field.
* 12+ years of progressive experience in digital content, creative services, studio operations, content marketing, or integrated production.
* 7+ years leading teams, agencies, vendors, or multidisciplinary production operations.
* Demonstrated success building or scaling a content studio, center of excellence, or high-volume content production capability.
* Strong portfolio of multiformat work spanning video, audio, design, editorial, social, email, and campaign content.
* Experience translating technical or complex subject matter into clear, audience-relevant digital experiences.
* Expertise in creative operations, production planning, agency management, budgeting, briefing, and quality assurance.
* Proven ability to lead across a global, cross-functional, matrixed environment and influence senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of accessibility, brand governance, content rights, review workflows, digital asset management, and performance measurement.

****Additional Desired Preferences****
Desired preferences include highlighting any additional preferred levels of expertise for the role—reminder: items listed here are not requirements and do not disqualify a candidate from consideration.
  
  

* Experience in scientific, healthcare, education, standards, or another regulated or technically complex environment.
* Deep expertise in:
* Content atomization and modular content strategy
* Video, audio, visual design, editorial, and social production workflows
* Digital asset management, metadata, and enterprise content reuse
* Familiarity with:
* AI-enabled content tools, marketing automation, analytics dashboards, webinar and recording platforms, and creative design suites
* Experience launching a new capability, managing an agency-to-insource transition, or operating within a global center of excellence.

****Supervisory Responsibilities****
Yes, 1 report (Content Strategy Lead)
  
  
****Benefits****
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

Sales & Marketing

Full-Time

title: Associate Director, Advertiser Solutions - South Asia
description:
**About The Role**
PubMatic is looking for a strategic and commercially driven Associate Director, Advertiser Solutions to help grow our buyer-side business across South Asia. This role will focus on building and scaling relationships with advertisers, agencies, trading teams, and other demand-side stakeholders, while driving adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused programmatic solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem, strong understanding of buyer and DSP workflows, and a proven ability to win new business, grow strategic accounts, and influence go-to-market priorities. This role requires strong direct brand relationships in addition to agency connectivity, with the ability to engage senior marketing, media, and programmatic decision-makers and translate PubMatic’s capabilities into clear commercial value.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Drive business growth
  
  

* Own and grow revenue for PubMatic’s Advertiser Solutions business across South Asia.
* Build, manage, and convert a strong pipeline of opportunities across advertisers, agencies, trading desks, and other buy-side partners.
* Identify, prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new business opportunities.
* Expand PubMatic’s footprint with both existing and new buyers through strategic account planning and targeted growth initiatives.
* Drive adoption of PubMatic’s buyer-side solutions, including private marketplace, preferred, programmatic guaranteed, curated, and Activate-led opportunities.

Build strategic client relationships
  
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with brands, agency investment teams, trading desks, and programmatic leads across South Asia.
* Strengthen PubMatic’s direct access to brand-side decision-makers across digital, media, and marketing teams.
* Build senior-level relationships with strategic clients and position PubMatic as a consultative partner for premium supply access, efficiency, transparency, and performance.
* Partner closely with agencies and advertisers to uncover growth opportunities and drive long-term adoption.

Lead strategic customer engagement
  
  

* Own strategic engagements with key accounts, ensuring high-quality pre-sales support, thoughtful solutioning, and strong post-sale alignment with internal teams.
* Map customer business goals to PubMatic solutions and develop account strategies that drive measurable outcomes.
* Support renewals, account expansion, and deeper buy-side integration through proactive relationship management and opportunity development.
* Provide clear market and customer feedback to improve solution adoption and account growth.

Influence product and market strategy
  
  

* Bring actionable customer feedback, market insight, and competitive intelligence into internal product and commercial discussions.
* Help shape go-to-market strategy based on customer needs and evolving buyer dynamics.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions teams to refine positioning, strengthen messaging, and improve sales readiness.
* Develop a strong understanding of PubMatic’s marketplace design, supply dynamics, and advertiser value proposition.

Represent PubMatic in market
  
  

* Build PubMatic’s visibility and credibility across the South Asia buy-side ecosystem.
* Stay current on industry trends, supply path optimization, privacy and addressability changes, and shifts in advertiser buying behavior.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Meets or exceeds monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for Advertiser Solutions.
* Builds a strong pipeline and converts strategic opportunities into long-term customer value.
* Expands PubMatic’s direct relationships with both brands and agencies in South Asia.
* Increases adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused solutions across key accounts.
* Contributes meaningful customer and market insight that helps shape strategy and execution.

Who You Are
  
  
**Must Have**

* 9–12+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, AdTech, media sales, agency partnerships, DSP, SSP, or advertiser-facing platform roles.
* Strong understanding of the buyer-side and DSP ecosystem and how advertisers and agencies buy programmatically.
* Proven success in new business development, pipeline building, and strategic account growth.
* Strong direct relationships across brands, agencies, and trading teams in South Asia.
* Experience selling or positioning programmatic advertising solutions to advertiser and agency stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of private marketplace deals, programmatic guaranteed, supply path optimization, curation, and premium programmatic buying models.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate technical and platform capabilities into compelling client value.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with strong ownership and accountability.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience at an SSP, DSP, agency trading desk, media platform, or advertiser technology company.
* Experience managing strategic partnerships and complex commercial negotiations.
* Familiarity with South Asia market dynamics, major holding groups, independent agencies, and key advertiser categories.
* Experience contributing to product feedback loops, go-to-market planning, or market enablement initiatives.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Senior Growth Manager
description:
You’ll join the Premium Growth India team within the Markets & Subscriptions organisation, focused on making Spotify Premium an increasingly desirable music experience in India. Sitting at the intersection of marketing, product, music, and strategy, the team works closely with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to grow Premium through cultural relevance and artist-led initiatives.
  
  
In this role, you’ll own Premium desirability and the artist and partner Premium flywheel for India, shaping how we work with artists, cultural moments, fandom, and partnerships to drive Premium consideration and measurable conversion at scale.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Define and execute the Premium desirability strategy for India, using artist-led and culturally relevant initiatives to drive consideration and conversion.
* Own the artist and partner flywheel for Premium growth, evolving artist advocacy, fan experiences, and partnership programs toward measurable Premium outcomes.
* Shape and execute the Premium opportunity within existing in-person activations, including film partnerships, bespoke music events, festivals, and other relevant cultural moments.
* Partner with local Music & Podcasts, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to identify and activate artists, creators, and partners that can help grow Premium.
* Design and run desirability initiatives with clear success metrics, using performance data and audience behaviour to understand what works and continuously improve the strategy.
* Own the fandom value opportunity for Premium end-to-end, from identifying opportunities to partnering with Product on fan-facing Premium features and experiences.
* Develop business cases and evaluate the impact of desirability, artist, and partner initiatives to inform where we invest and scale.
* Capture and share learnings that strengthen the India Premium Growth playbook, contribute to cross-regional Growth initiatives, and support adjacent growth priorities when business needs require it.
* Integrate AI-driven tools and workflows thoughtfully to improve decision-making and execution efficiency.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience across growth, marketing, partnerships, strategy, or related roles in a digital consumer business such as streaming, music, entertainment, media, or technology.
* You have strong experience with music and fandom and understand how fan communities form, what drives engagement, and how fandom can translate into measurable business outcomes.
* You understand growth marketing and connect cultural and creative ideas to measurable outcomes such as consideration, conversion, and subscriber growth.
* You have experience independently owning and scaling artist-led campaigns, partnerships, live experiences, or similarly complex consumer initiatives from strategy through execution and measurement.
* You are comfortable using data and audience insights to make decisions, test hypotheses, measure impact, and refine your approach.
* You work effectively across functions and can influence outcomes without direct authority, particularly when collaborating with Music, Marketing, Partnerships, Product, and other teams.
* You are curious about cultural trends and user behaviour in India and enjoy testing, learning, and iterating to understand what drives Premium consideration and conversion.
* Experience working directly with artists, labels, fan platforms, music or entertainment marketing, or Product teams on consumer-facing experiences can help you succeed in this role.

Where You’ll Be
  
  

* This role is based in Mumbai
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice

title: Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships, Accion Advisory
description:
**About Accion**
Accion is a global nonprofit on a mission to create a fair and inclusive economy for the 1.6 billion people who are failed by the global financial system. We develop and scale responsible digital financial solutions for small business owners, smallholder farmers, and women, so they can make informed decisions and improve their lives. Through targeted investment strategies, advisory solutions, and expert thought leadership, we work with local partners to develop and scale cheaper, more accessible, and customer-friendly financial solutions. Since 1961, Accion has helped build 299 financial service providers serving low-income clients in 77 countries, reaching over 500 million people. More at https://www.accion.org.
  
  
**About Accion Advisory**
Accion Advisory is a global team helping companies deliver innovative, affordable financial solutions for underserved customers in emerging markets. We work with local ecosystem partners, leveraging philanthropic capital and new technologies, to test, improve, and scale solutions that strengthen economic well‑being.
  
  
Our 60+ advisors deliver 30+ active projects across Africa, Asia, and the Americas, collaborating with financial service providers, fintech companies, digital platforms, and other stakeholders to demonstrate the viability of reaching end customers often considered too risky or costly to serve. Through AI- and data-driven digital transformation and embedded financial products, we drive impact across four key pillars: livelihoods, agriculture, climate, and women's economic empowerment.
  
  
**Position Summary**
Accion Advisory is seeking a Manager, Financial Products & Partnerships to expand access to credit and risk-sharing products for smallholder farmers, agricultural MSMEs, and climate-vulnerable communities across India and beyond. You will build and lead Accion's relationships with financial service providers: MFIs, fintechs, small finance banks, and NBFCs. Taking partnerships from first conversation through executed agreement and into live pilots, and shaping the financial products those partnerships deliver. The role also supports donor and commercial fundraising for Accion's climate and agricultural finance agenda.
  
  
Based in Mumbai on a hybrid basis with two days on site, this is an open-ended position reporting to the Senior Director, Global Agri & Climate Lead, Accion Advisory. You will work closely with regional delivery teams across India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**
**Product Design and Development**

* Lead the design and commercial structuring of financial products for smallholder farmers and agricultural MSMEs, including risk frameworks, credit guarantees, de-risking instruments, and blended finance incentives.
* Assess market opportunity, partner viability, and product pricing using existing models and analytical inputs, working with technical specialists where detailed financial modeling is required.
* Conduct market and customer research to identify unmet needs and opportunities for product innovation across agricultural value chains.

**Capacity Building and Knowledge Sharing**

* Build legal and regulatory structuring capacity, in-house or retained, across active markets including India, Sub-Saharan Africa, and Southeast Asia.
* Represent Accion Advisory at conferences and industry forums, contribute to knowledge products and publications, and deliver training and technical assistance to staff and partners on product development and partnership approaches.

**Financial Service Provider (FSP) Partnership and Engagement**

* Identify, prioritize, and engage financial service providers: MFIs, fintechs, small finance banks, and NBFCs to pilot credit and risk-sharing products for climate-smart assets and underserved agricultural and MSME segments.
* Lead FSP partnership development end to end, from initial outreach through MoU/LoI execution, and coordinate onboarding and pilot implementation with partners.
* Maintain a structured engagement tracker and stakeholder plan across active and prospective FSP relationships, and report pipeline progress to Advisory leadership.

**Business Development and Fundraising**

* Support donor and commercial partner prospecting for climate and agricultural finance initiatives, identifying funding opportunities and potential co-funders.
* Draft concept notes and contribute to full proposals for grant and blended finance opportunities, and support scoping conversations with commercial partners as part of Accion's partner diversification strategy.

**Position Qualifications**

* Master's degree in agricultural economics, finance, business, development studies, or a related field; a Bachelor's degree with equivalent work experience will be considered.
* 10+ years of total professional experience, including 6+ years in financial services partnerships, origination, or business development, and at least 2 years at manager level or equivalent.
* Demonstrated experience taking partnerships from initial outreach through executed agreement and into implementation.
* Experience in the agriculture sector or agritech companies, with agriculture as the primary focus.
* An established network across MFIs, fintechs, small finance banks, and NBFCs in India.
* Working knowledge of credit, risk-sharing and guarantee structures, and product pricing principles.
* Ability to interpret financial models and analysis to inform commercial decisions.
* Knowledge of agricultural value chains, smallholder farmer dynamics, and the rural finance ecosystem.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-cultural and collaborative environment.
* Fluency in English.
* Right to work in India.
* Willingness to embody our values of excellence, respect and passion for social change.

+ Excellence: Accion staff should always put forth their best effort in all activities, strive for high quality of collective and individual performance; and demonstrate honesty and integrity at all times while in the workplace and while working on behalf of the organization.
+ Respect: Accion staff should value one another’s roles and responsibilities as much as their own, be encouraging, and value the diverse and unique perspectives of colleagues. They should honor obligations and commitments to each other and to external partners.
+ Passion for Social Change: Accion staff should be committed to making a difference in the lives of those less fortunate, value the greater good of the organization over personal gain, and promote a productive workplace by acknowledging the accomplishments of others.

**Preferred**

* Experience designing or structuring financial products for smallholder farmers, agricultural value chains, or MSMEs.
* Working exposure to adjacent climate-smart sectors such as clean energy, e-mobility, or circular economy.
* Experience working in African or Southeast Asian markets.
* Experience within the development consulting space.
* Experience drafting concept notes and proposals for grant or blended finance funders.
* Working proficiency in Hindi or another relevant local language.
* Interested in our mission and working globally.

This role requires travel averaging up to 30% of the time, primarily domestic within India, with occasional international trips.
  
  
Accion is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace culture. Accion seeks qualified applicants without regard to race, color, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, military and veteran status, gender identity or expression, genetic information, change of sex or transgender status, or any other basis protected by law. Accion is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**About the role**

As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.

Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.

**What you will own**

Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.

**Revenue and conversion**

* **Storefront conversion rate.**
  Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
* **Cross sell and attach rate.**
  Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
* **Average order value and revenue per session.**
  Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.

**Experience and performance**

* **Site performance.**
  Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
* **Experience quality.**
  Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
* **Consistency across brands.**
  A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.

**Delivery and process**

* **Experimentation velocity.**
  An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
* **Roadmap delivery.**
  Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
* **Delivery against Strategi Project.**
  Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations

**A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**

**Core deliverables**

* Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
* Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
* Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
* Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
* Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in-house stacks.
* Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
* Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
* Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
* Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.

**Stakeholder management**

* Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
* Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
* Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
* Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
* Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
* Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.

**Data and analysis**

* Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
* Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
* Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
* Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
* Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
* Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.

**What you will need to succeed**

* Seven or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
* A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
* A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
* A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
* Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
* Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
* Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
* Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
* A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
* Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar. You will be responsible for driving the right kind of reporting setup required to measure performance in the areas you are responsible for.
* Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
* Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
* Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Driven by delivery, delivering on time and to a high standard.

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days.**
You know our stacks, our funnels and our numbers. You have audited the storefronts across brands, established a clean baseline for conversion, attach and performance, and shipped a first set of quick wins.

**First six months.**
A prioritized storefront roadmap is agreed with brand and engineering leads, a regular testing cadence is running, and reporting is in place that everyone trusts and uses.

**First twelve months.**
Measurable improvement against your conversion, attach and performance targets, a shared experience standard applied across brands, and a healthy backlog of tested, evidenced ideas ready for the following year.

**Why you'll love us.**

* **Weve evolved**
  ; we provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from- home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment.
* **Work-life balance**
  . Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
* **We celebrate one another’s differences**
  . We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
* **We care about you**
  . At Newfold, taking care of our employees is our top priority. we make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place to for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community one domain at a time, one employee at a time.
* All our employees are eligible for a
  **free domain and WordPress blog**
  as we sponsor the domain registration costs.
* **Where can we take you?**
  We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold

title: Strategy & Business Development Director
description:
**Job Description**
The Strategy & Business Development Director will shape and accelerate Honeywell Technologies’ growth across APAC & India through two connected mandates.
  
  
**Software & Software ARR Growth:**
The Director will drive software-led growth with a dedicated focus on Software revenue and Software ARR, defining portfolio and market strategies, identifying and developing high-value growth opportunities, and building the commercial mechanisms required to expand predictable, profitable Software ARR.
  
  
**Acquisitions Growth & Revenue Synergies:**
For a focused set of acquisitions, the Director will act as the regional commercial lead in APAC & India, owning the translation of growth strategy into commercial outcomes. This includes accelerating the total revenue contribution of these businesses, unlocking cross-business growth across Honeywell, and ensuring agreed revenue synergy targets are met.
  
  
Working across business units and functions, the Director will connect customer needs, market dynamics, technology roadmaps and go-to-market execution to create scalable growth platforms and maximize shareholder value.
  
  
**Acquisitions Growth & Revenue Synergies**

* Acquisition growth strategy: set the APAC & India growth strategy that drives acquisitions contribution to Honeywell's growth, covering market opportunity, share of demand, priority segments, target accounts and routes to market, and translate it into clear execution plans with accountable owners.
* Offering fit and regional readiness: Assess the fit and readiness of acquired offerings for APAC & India markets, including customer needs, localization, pricing, channel and delivery or support capabilities, informed by a clear understanding of each offering’s NPI roadmap. Prioritize where each offering can win, and work with offering owners to close the gaps that limit growth and align roadmap priorities with regional demand.
* Cross-sell and cross-business growth: As the main lever for acquisition growth, drive cross-selling and pull-through between acquired businesses and Honeywell business units through integrated customer offerings, joint account pursuit plans and opportunities identified with strategic account leaders. Convert these into qualified pipelines, commercial wins and realized revenue.
* Revenue synergy delivery and barrier resolution: Serve as the APAC & India point person tracking and ensuring agreed revenue synergy targets are met. Track performance against targets, identify gaps early, and resolve the commercial, operational or offering barriers that prevent growth.

**Operating rhythm:**
Establish governance, metrics and reviews that move strategic initiatives from concept to measurable commercial outcomes.
  
  
**Measures of Success**

* Growth of Revenue and Software ARR across the APAC & India software portfolio.
* Realization of acquisition revenue synergies against agreed base and aspirational targets, by acquisition and operating region.
* Quality, value and conversion of the strategic opportunity pipeline.
* Adoption and performance of new commercial models, partnerships and routes to market.
* Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, ARR and strategic plan execution.
* Delivery of the on-premise-to-SaaS migration roadmap, including customer conversion, retained revenue and ARR uplift.
* Coverage, quality and commercial use of APAC & India customer references and associated communications.
* Closure of priority portfolio-readiness gaps for target APAC & India markets.

**Responsibilities**
**Software & Software ARR Growth**

* Market intelligence: Assess market size, customer economics, competitor positioning, regulatory developments and technology trends to identify attractive growth spaces.
* Portfolio readiness and market fit: Assess the software portfolio’s readiness and fit for APAC & India markets, including customer needs, localization, deployment model, cybersecurity, data residency, regulatory requirements, pricing, support and channel capabilities; maintain a strong understanding of the NPI roadmap to anticipate which gaps upcoming releases will close, and translate remaining gaps into prioritized actions and investment recommendations.
* Regional customer references: Build and maintain a catalogue of APAC & India customer references with quantified outcomes and reusable proof points. Work with Communications Team to build amplification plan in the media.
* Subscription and SaaS acceleration: Create and orchestrate a phased plan to migrate on-premise applications and customers to SaaS, addressing portfolio sequencing, commercial conversion, customer value, technical dependencies, channel enablement, retention risks and ARR impact.
* Installed Base Mining Go-to-Market: Partner with sales, marketing, product and customer success teams to define segmentation, routes to market, channel strategies, demand generation and account expansion plays.
* Decoupled software growth: Identify customer entry points that allow software to be sold and scaled independently of hardware or major capital projects, and develop repeatable acquisition and expansion plays around them.
* Identify & Scale Strategic Partnerships: Identify and prioritize the partners most critical to software growth in APAC & India, define joint value propositions and business plans, and execute agreed go-to-market, co-sell, integration and customer-development strategies with them.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, computer science, economics or a related field; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Significant experience in strategy, business development, corporate development, mergers and acquisitions, product strategy or commercial leadership within industrial technology, enterprise software, SaaS or a related sector.
* Demonstrated success building software growth strategies and translating them into commercial outcomes.
* Strong command of software recurring-revenue economics and metrics, including Software ARR, annual contract value, net revenue retention, churn, customer acquisition cost, lifetime value and gross margin.
* Experience developing subscription pricing, packaging, channel and go-to-market models.
* Track record of shaping complex partnerships and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Experience working across multiple APAC & India markets in a matrixed, multinational environment.
* Fluent English; additional regional languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively across APAC & India and, when required, internationally.

title: Analyst I, Core & Inno Capabilities
description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

**OVERVIEW**

The “Insights and Analytics” organization within General Mills’ Strategy and Growth function is responsible to deliver integrated consumer, customer, category, and business performance insights to power smarter, faster decisions and next-best actions, enabling precision in brand strategies, campaign execution, media and investment optimization across our US businesses and brands. The Insights and Analytics org has integrated teams operating from our Minneapolis and India offices.

  

We are seeking a curious, analytical, and motivated **Analyst I – Quantitative Research** to join our Mumbai team within the Insights & Analytics (I&A) function at General Mills India Center. This team leads in-house consumer research to understand and interpret consumer behavior. We are looking for an individual to work closely on the **in-house quantitative research** - someone who loves using data to tell stories and deeply understand stakeholders’ needs and the business requirements to provide strategic insights. The role holder should be able to apply research methodologies effectively, manage global projects end to end, able to multi-task, demonstrate strong cross-functional collaboration and establish oneself as a trusted advisor to stakeholders.

  

Based in the General Mills India Center (GIC), this role will operate as part of General Mills’ global model, with day-to-day work direction and priorities closely connected to U.S.-based functional partners and managers.

  

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**Project management and execution**

* The candidate will be accountable for end-to-end Quantitative project management which includes –
  + Gaining expertise in using the tools developed in-house and by external vendors
  + Multitasking and managing multiple research projects end to end i.e. from designing a questionnaire, programming surveys to data analysis and reporting
  + Developing knowledge and skills required to apply advanced statistical techniques like Heat maps, Driver’s analysis, Cluster analysis etc. in order to identify patterns and trends from the data.
  + Should be able to design and execute methodologies that involve Concept test, Product test, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitude, Segmentation etc.
* Should be able to create a story out of the insights using compelling narratives, visuals, and data-driven evidence
* Should be able to proactively learn and apply new tools to find unique solutions to business questions
The candidate will be responsible for establishing best practices, standardized ways of working and building internal benchmarks  

**2. Vendor management**

* The candidate must partner with external research agencies and ensure projects are completed within agreed timelines and as per agreed quality standards
Should be able to lead partnership with vendors independently and establish ways of working to gain cost and time efficiency  

  

**3. Stakeholder management**

* Should proactively connect with internal stakeholders to understand their requirements and suggest appropriate research methods to fulfill those requirements with minimum manager supervision.
* Become a trusted advisor and the go-to person for the internal stakeholders, when they need guidance on answering research questions.
Is able to effectively communicate key findings to the stakeholders and the leadership team in meetings  

  

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* **2 - 3 years** of relevant market research experience including experience in quantitative research, client management, questionnaire design, data analysis and reporting
* Master’s degree or MBA with specialization in Marketing or Market research
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively interact with stakeholders and team members
* Should have experience in different research methodologies like Concept test, Product test, Brand tracking, Maxdiff, Conjoint analysis, Usage & Attitudes etc.
* Must be able to multitask and effectively manage multiple stakeholders, vendors and projects together
* Should possess strong time management, teamwork, critical thinking, analytical, and influencing skills
Should showcase an openness to learn, and willingness & drive to make meaningful business impact in all projects  

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Has independently led multi-country Quantitative research studies
* Has experience working with cross-functional teams
* Candidate with experience working with CPG industry and global markets will be preferred
* Experience working on DIY research platforms like Qualtrics, QuestionPro etc. will be an added advantage

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

**Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack**

Gilbarco Veeder-Root, a Vontier company, is the worldwide technology leader for retail and commercial fueling operations, offering the broadest range of integrated solutions from the forecourt to the convenience store and head office. Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company powering the way the world moves. We empower businesses in the transport sector to adapt to a fast-changing landscape by uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies.

Our smart, connected solutions serve roadside convenience retail stores, fleet operators, and auto repair technicians. From integrated payments and EV charging software to carwash technology and retail automation, we help customers stay productive and prepared for a rapidly evolving industry.  
  
With decades of expertise and a balanced portfolio, Vontier enables businesses to navigate complexity, unlock growth, and build a cleaner, safer future. Driven by continuous improvement and the dedication of Team Vontier, we empower businesses to think bigger, act boldly, and thrive on the road ahead. Learn more at www.vontier.com

Join our community of passionate people working together to navigate challenges and seize new opportunities. CARECIL PRIVATE LIMITED is a growing paints and coatings company focused on Automotive Refinish, OEM Paints and High-Performance Coatings.

The Retail Sales Manager will be responsible for developing automotive refinish paint sales through dealers, distributors, retailers, bodyshops, garages and automotive painters across the assigned territory.

The candidate will support sales growth, expand the dealer network, acquire new customers, conduct product trials, develop painter relationships and increase market penetration.

The ideal candidate should have at least 1 year of relevant experience in automotive refinish paint sales, a good understanding of the automotive aftermarket and the ability to build strong relationships with dealers, garages, bodyshops and painters.

· Build long-term relationships with workshop owners, painters and purchasing decision-makers.

· Build relationships with automotive painters, applicators and workshop supervisors.

· Polyester Putty

· 1K and 2K Primers

· Epoxy Primers

· Surfacer / Filler

· Basecoats

· Solid and Metallic Binders

· 2K Clearcoats

· Hardeners

· Thinners and Reducers

· Other Automotive Refinish Consumables

The candidate should be able to explain product benefits, understand customer requirements and coordinate technical support for product trials and application-related issues.

6. Market & Competitor Intelligence

· Monitor competitor brands, pricing, dealer margins, schemes and product launches.

· Understand local customer preferences and competitor product strengths.

· Identify opportunities to convert customers from competing automotive refinish brands.

· Identify high-potential dealers, retailers, bodyshops and automotive repair clusters.

· Share regular market intelligence, customer feedback and competitor updates with management.

7. Collections & Sales Administration

· Follow up on outstanding payments and support timely collections.

· Coordinate with accounts, logistics and internal sales teams for order processing and delivery.

· Maintain accurate customer, dealer, retailer, bodyshop and painter databases.

· Submit daily, weekly and monthly sales and market visit reports.

· Monitor sales performance, customer retention and territory development.

Target Market – Mumbai & Surrounding Areas

The candidate will be responsible for developing automotive refinish business across Mumbai and nearby markets, including:

· Andheri, Jogeshwari and Goregaon

· Malad, Kandivali and Borivali

· Kurla, Ghatkopar and Vikhroli

· Chembur, Sion and Wadala

· Bhandup and Mulund

· Thane and Kalwa

· Navi Mumbai, Vashi and Airoli

· Bhiwandi and Kalyan-Dombivli

· Mira Road and Vasai-Virar

· Other nearby automotive aftermarket markets as assigned

The territory may be expanded based on business requirements.

Candidate RequirementsMandatory Experience

· Minimum 1 year of relevant experience in automotive refinish paint sales or automotive refinish products.

· Experience with automotive paint manufacturers, distributors or refinish companies will be preferred.

· Practical experience in dealer, retailer, garage or bodyshop sales will be an advantage.

· Candidates with an existing network of automotive paint dealers, garages, bodyshops and painters in Mumbai and the Mumbai Metropolitan Region will be strongly preferred.

· Candidates with a strong willingness to learn, develop new customers and achieve sales targets are encouraged to apply.

Education

· Graduate in any discipline.

· MBA / PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

· Technical qualifications in Paints, Coatings or Automotive Technology will be beneficial.

Required Skills

· Good sales, negotiation and business development skills.

· Ability to generate product trials and convert them into regular business.

· New bodyshop and garage acquisition

· Product trials and conversion rates

title: Category Manager - AT
description:
1. Product development & range architecture

* Lead end-to-end new product development across hardside, soft side, and duffle – from consumer insight to shelf-ready product.

* Build a clear range architecture by size (cabin, medium, large, sets), material, and price ladder – and by channel: what goes to GT, MT, ecommerce, CSD, retail, and B2B, with no range overlap and sharp price-point logic.

* Benchmark features that drive choice in this category – weight, durability, wheels, locks, expandability, warranty – against competitors at every price point.

* Write detailed product briefs with the India design team and the Singapore regional design office, translating consumer needs, trend direction, and commercial parameters into actionable design direction.

* Own the development pipeline with suppliers outside India and domestic manufacturing partners – timelines, sample reviews, cost negotiations, and quality sign-offs.

* Balance global brand standards with India-specific consumer expectations, retail requirements, and price sensitivity.

Deliver products to defined price points, target margins, and launch timelines without compromising design or quality.

2. Business management & P&L

* Own the commercial performance of the company's largest category across all channels – revenue, sell-through, margins, inventory health, and return on marketing investment.

* Build and manage the annual category plan – SKU-level launch calendar, pricing architecture, channel allocation, and trade promotion budgets – built around the category's seasonal peaks.

* Work with supply chain on demand forecasting and stock planning so the right sizes and colours are available ahead of wedding, holiday, festive, and sale-event peaks.

* Define and execute consumer promotions, seasonal offers, and trade schemes for each channel, understanding the distinct levers in GT vs MT vs ecommerce vs CSD vs B2B.

* Partner with Sales so the right product is in the right channel at the right time, with a clear commercial story for each range.

Track performance closely – spotting trends, gaps, ageing stock, and risks early, and course-correcting fast.

3. BTL execution & content ownership

* Own all BTL assets for the category: catalogues, POSMs, in-store creatives, shelf-talkers, display units, and trade collateral across channels.

* Lead ecommerce content for the category – A+ and B+ content on Amazon and Flipkart, size-wise listings, and conversion-optimised imagery and copy.

Develop channel-specific content for Modern Trade activations, CSD catalogues, and B2B pitch decks and range presentations.

4. Communications support

* As the brand's lead category, Travel & Duffle is at the heart of most American Tourister campaigns. Give the Communications Head accurate category, product, and consumer inputs for ATL campaign planning and production.

* Act as the category subject-matter expert for the communications team, so product details, range logic, and consumer context are clear before campaigns go into production.

Contribute category direction for digital and ecommerce content where the range has a distinct story to tell.

5. Consumer & market intelligence

* Keep a sharp, current view of the competitive landscape in luggage – Indian competitors, D2C brands, and global entrants – across price points and channels.

* Track consumer trends across key buyer groups – first-time flyers, young professionals, families, frequent travellers, and wedding and gifting buyers – and turn insights into product and marketing action.

* Understand channel-specific purchase behaviour – what makes a trolley convert on Amazon vs what makes it sell off a GT shelf.

title: Specialist-Legal
description:
Job Description

**Job Description**

**Title:** Specialist – Legal
  
**Location:** Mumbai
  
**Work arrangement:** 5 days , On-site

**About Upstox**
  
At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We’re one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We’re not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you’re in the right place.

**The Role: Senior Specialist / Specialist – Legal**
  
We’re looking for a commercially minded lawyer to partner with our business, product and tech teams across contracting, data protection, regulatory advisory, brand protection and disputes. You’ll support a group that holds multiple regulatory registrations and is expanding into new areas, which means wide exposure across financial products, technology, marketing and operations.

**What You’ll Own**

* Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, including vendor and service agreements, MSAs, SaaS/cloud and software licensing, technology and outsourcing arrangements, partnership and distribution agreements, NDAs and data processing agreements.
* Own the contract lifecycle end-to-end (initiation, approval, execution, storage and renewals) using our CLM tool and SOPs, and track key obligations and renewal timelines so nothing slips through the cracks.
* Handle a steady flow of contracting for new products and services, including agreements with banks, insurers, NBFCs and distribution partners, balancing quick closure with strong protection of Upstox’s interests.
* Advise on technology law, including the IT Act, 2000 and related rules, cybersecurity requirements and outsourcing of IT services.
* Drive implementation of the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025 in line with their phased timelines (Consent Manager framework from November 2026; all obligations from May 2027), covering privacy notices, consent and withdrawal flows, breach-notification processes, data processing terms and vendor due diligence.
* Review advertisements, marketing campaigns, brand positioning and new taglines against advertising norms, the ASCI Code and the CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023.
* Track and interpret regulatory developments applicable to the group (RBI for NBFCs, payments and digital lending; IRDAI for corporate agency and insurance broking; TRAI), communicate their impact to stakeholders, and support new business initiatives and licence applications.
* Draft and update internal policies, SOPs, website terms, customer-facing terms and disclosures.
* Manage police and law-enforcement requests (Section 94 BNSS notices, FIR data requests, lien-marking and unfreeze orders, NCRP), legal notices, customer complaints, fraud and impersonation cases and escalations, coordinating responses with internal teams within statutory timelines.
* Coordinate with external counsel on litigation, arbitration, writ petitions, recovery suits (including those arising from cyber incidents) and trademark suits, track hearings and court orders, and support responses to regulatory proceedings.
* Support internal and external audits and inspections (ISO 27001/27701/22301, SEBI system audit, depository inspections), compliance checks and the legal ISMS/PIMS risk register.

**What we’re looking for**

* LLB from a recognised university; an additional qualification in technology law, data privacy or CS is a plus.
* 2–4 years of post-qualification experience in BFSI or at a reputed law firm.
* Strong drafting, negotiation and contract review skills, with sound knowledge of contract law, IP, data protection and technology law.
* Working knowledge of India’s financial services and fintech regulatory landscape (SEBI, RBI, IRDAI); experience with law-enforcement requests, consumer complaints or disputes is a bonus.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management, sharp attention to detail, and the ability to juggle priorities and turn work around quickly.
* A commercial, solution-oriented mindset, with the judgment to run routine matters independently and escalate complex ones smartly.

**Why This Role Rocks**
  
You’ll be at the centre of how a fast-scaling fintech launches products, protects its brand and stays ahead of regulation — with the breadth of exposure most lawyers take years to get.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our Prospective Employee Privacy Notice, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information (“PI”). I accept Upstox’s Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

title: Compliance and Ops Risk Test Specialist
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

This role is instrumental in identifying and mitigating risk by assessing the control environment, identifying gaps, and supporting remediation. You will execute testing with precision and accountability, producing clear documentation that supports conclusions. You will collaborate with process and control owners and cross-functional teams to complete walkthroughs, gather evidence, and report results in a timely manner.

**Job summary:**

As a **Compliance and Operations Risk Test Specialist** within **compliance and operational risk testing**, you will assess the control environment to identify gaps and support remediation to mitigate risk. You will execute testing with precision and accountability to deliver high-quality outcomes aligned to the firm's highest risks. You will apply analytical thinking and problem-solving skills to break down complex objectives into manageable tasks and activities. You will contribute to a cohesive and efficient testing framework through strong documentation, collaboration, and continuous improvement of testing methods.

**Job responsibilities:**

* **Understand** and evaluate the assigned function's control environment, with proven experience assessing the adequacy, effectiveness, and design of controls to ensure alignment with SOX, other regulatory frameworks, and the firm's risk priorities.
* **Execute** testing processes with precision and accountability to assess the control environment, identify gaps, and prepare robust documentation including process documents, process flows, and overview documents that support testing conclusions.
* **Collaborate** with process and control owners and cross-functional teams on the testing schedule; obtain walkthroughs of processes; document process changes; gather evidence; analyze potential issues; and facilitate timely reporting.
* **Partner** with control owners to support issue validation, action plan quality, and closure discipline, ensuring remediation aligns with risk acceptance and compliance expectations.
* **Lead** walkthroughs and other meetings with business owners, fostering collaboration across engagements with minimal oversight.
* **Read** and interpret policies, standards, and procedures to support accurate implementation of compliance requirements, and continuously improve control evaluation methodologies, including interpretation of control ratings and metrics.
* **Propose** and implement improvements to current testing methods, contributing to the efficiency and effectiveness of risk management.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, or a related field, or equivalent work experience; **minimum of 2 years** of experience in controls testing, audit, or operational risk management within a risk and control environment.
* Domain knowledge of banking products and the ability to interpret financial statements; experience across one or more of the following: product control, balance sheet substantiation, month-end close processes (journal entries, accruals, financial close procedures), treasury (liquidity management, capital management, Basel capital, securities operations, front and middle office operations, asset liability management), reconciliation processes (account reconciliation, position matching, break resolution), valuation controls (independent price verification, fair value adjustments), regulatory reporting, financial reporting (daily financial reporting, external disclosures, off-balance-sheet review), and control testing (SOX testing, risk assessments, key control reviews, issue identification, remediation tracking).
* Demonstrated proficiency in advanced analytical thinking and problem-solving, including analyzing large data sets to identify exceptions or patterns and evaluating key information.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships with key stakeholders and collaborate with business and functional experts to recognize risks and gaps.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to remain flexible and productive through shifting priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence business leaders in a meaningful and actionable manner.
* Demonstrated expertise in **Microsoft Office** applications, with advanced skills in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills:**

* Professional qualifications such as **Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Master of Business Administration (MBA) in Finance, or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)**.
* Audit and control testing background and experience.
* Comfortable using intelligent solutions such as Alteryx and Tableau to support testing activities or metrics reporting.
* Ability to innovate, challenge the status quo, and identify automation opportunities.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**  
  
  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

  

Control Management maintains a strong and consistent control environment through a joint accountability model that aligns managers with each function and region to mitigate operational risk. The team focuses on four areas: Control Design & Expertise, Risks & Controls Identification/Assessment, Issues & Control Deficiencies and Control Governance & Reporting.

title: Information Security Associate
description:
#### **At a Glance: The Story Behind AMINA**

Founded in April 2018 and headquartered in Zug, AMINA Bank is a pioneer in the financial industry. In August 2019, AMINA received a Swiss banking and securities dealer license from FINMA. The broad, vertically integrated spectrum of services, combined with the highest security standards, make AMINA’s value proposition unique.

AMINA operates globally from its regulated hubs in Switzerland, Abu Dhabi, and Hong Kong to offer fiat and crypto services to progressive investors, traditional and crypto-native alike, whether individuals, corporates, or institutions.

CVVC Global Report and CB Insights named AMINA as one of the Top 50 Companies within the blockchain ecosystem. Aite Group awarded AMINA their 2021 Digital Wealth Management Impact Innovation Award in the ‘Digital Startup of the Year’ category, and LinkedIn listed AMINA as one of the Top Startups 2021 in Switzerland. In 2022, AMINA won the Digital Assets Offering or Service at the WealthBriefing Swiss EAM Awards, and the bank was also recognised for its product offering SEBAX and won the Best ETP of the Year award at the Swiss ETF Awards 2022. In 2023, AMINA won the European WealthBriefing Award in the Digital Assets Solution, Fund Manager category.

AMINA India is a wholly owned subsidiary of AMINA Bank AG. AMINA India acts as a virtual extension of the bank supporting activities spanning trading & liquidity management, digital assets research, marketing, investment solutions, risk management, account management, mid/back-office, product management, technology & engineering, IT support, finance and human resources.

#### **Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It)**

AMINA is looking for an Information Security Associate to help run and improve its Information Security Management System (ISMS). The role supports day-to-day security governance, risk and control oversight, regulatory and audit activities, and the follow-up of agreed actions across the organization.  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone at the beginning of their career who enjoys working with both detail and people. The Associate will work closely with the CISO and with colleagues in Risk, Compliance, Legal, Technology, Operations, and business. The role requires good judgment, clear writing, and the confidence to follow up on open points.

#### **Your AMINA To-Do List**

* Support and enhance the Information Security Management System (ISMS) by maintaining security governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls, ensuring alignment with regulatory, compliance, and business requirements.
* Coordinate security risk and control oversight activities by supporting risk assessments, monitoring remediation plans, validating control effectiveness, and providing management reporting to strengthen the organization's security posture.
* Drive compliance and assurance initiatives through the coordination of internal and external audits, regulatory reviews, evidence collection, and tracking of findings to ensure timely closure of identified gaps and control weaknesses.
* Partner with the CISO/DPO and cross-functional stakeholders to support data protection and privacy programs, including DPIAs, technical and organizational measure (TOM) assessments, incident follow-up, and the protection of sensitive and personal data.
* Facilitate third-party security and due diligence reviews by assessing vendor security controls, certifications, and risk profiles, supporting onboarding decisions, and ensuring remediation of identified security and privacy risks.
* Develop and promote security awareness and communication programs by creating engaging training, guidance materials, and stakeholder communications that foster a strong security-conscious culture across the organization.
* Maintain security governance, risk, and compliance reporting by tracking key metrics, action plans, policy exceptions, and risk registers, enabling informed decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Information Security function by supporting strategic security initiatives, researching emerging threats and regulatory developments, and collaborating with business, technology, legal, and compliance teams to strengthen organizational resilience.

#### **Your golden ticket to the AMINA team:**

**Required**

  

* Up to 3 years of experience in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, IT Audit, Compliance, Technology Governance, or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, Business Administration, Law, or a related discipline.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Understanding of information security governance, risk management, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with AI-powered productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) and an understanding of responsible AI usage.

**Preferred**  

* Experience within banking, financial services, fintech, or other regulated industries.
* Exposure to Microsoft Purview or similar data protection and information governance solutions.
* Certifications such as ISC2 CC, CompTIA Security+, ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation, or equivalent security/compliance credentials.
* Knowledge of data protection, privacy, and third-party risk management practices.

**Personal Attributes**  

* Curious, proactive, and committed to continuous learning.
* Strong attention to detail with a structured and quality-focused approach.
* Ability to explain complex security and compliance topics in a clear and practical manner.
* Professional, trustworthy, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across teams.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve security and governance objectives.

#### **Why We’re Awesome**

We owe our exponential growth to our innovative and collaborate team spirit and talented workforce. Every voice counts as we are always committed to learning from diverse perspectives and backgrounds because our people make the difference at AMINA Bank. Regardless of your age, gender, belief, and background, at AMINA EVERYONE is welcome!
