title: Technical Quote Lead – Displays
description:
**Enabling a software-defined, electrified future.**
Visteon is a technology company that develops and builds innovative digital cockpit and electrification products at the leading-edge of the mobility revolution. Founded in 2000, Visteon brings decades of automotive intelligence combined with Silicon Valley speed to apply global insights that help transform the software-defined vehicle of the future for many of the world’s largest OEMs. The company employs 10,000 employees in 18 countries around the globe. To know more about us click here .
  
  
**Mission of the Role:**
The Technical Quote Leader is responsible for leading new business pursuits/quotes for the Display product line and coordinating with all Display Product Line functions (Customer Regional Engineering, Mechanical, Display & Lens teams, Hardware & Platform Software teams, Program & Commodity Purchasing and Manufacturing) and lead & coordinate associated internal engineering activities. This role will have a clear understanding of why, what, and when of an assigned product and will communicate its story and the business value concisely to all stakeholders.
  
  
**Typical Duties:**
Technical lead of Display related engineering activities for Customer RFIs & Quotations: Lead multi-functional global engineering internal team to Establish & direct engineering team supporting pursuits/quotes within the Displays Product Line.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders:**
Multiple internal cross-functional stakeholders (example: sales, manufacturing, engineering); OEM customers; strategic suppliers.
  
  
**Key Objectives of the Role:**

* Technical Lead for RFx Quotations:

+ Lead global engineering team.
+ Direct engineering team for new product line pursuits/quotes.
+ Review new product requirements (Mechanical, HW, SW).
+ Coordinate technical deliverables for quote timeline.
+ Develop optimal designs and review BOM costs.
+ Ensure timely completion of quote documentation (TDR, BOM, assumptions).
+ Work with Product Management & commercial team on cost targets.
+ Identify and initiate long lead items.
+ Align make/buy strategy with Manufacturing & Purchasing.
+ Review supplier quotes with Purchasing.
+ Optimize assembly process with Manufacturing.

* Should Cost/Should Price:

+ Lead should-cost and should-price estimations (Display, Lens, eBOM, mBOM).
+ Review should-cost and should-price with stakeholders.
+ Collaborate with Purchasing and Customer Groups on cost/price targets.
+ Align strategies on winning cost targets and prices with related teams and management.

* Process Compliance:

+ Ensure compliance during the quote process.
+ Support customer milestones and requirements.

**Key Year One Deliverables:**

* Strategic Growth : Develop strategies to expand Display products and increase market share.
* Should Cost and Should Price Management: Increase winning rate by estimating the cost and price precisely.
* Roadmap Validation : Continuously validate and adjust the product roadmap based on customer feedback and industry trends.
* RFQ Acquisition : Secure RFQs from auto OEMs to ensure significant lifetime value for the Display business.
* Technology Leadership : Introduce cutting-edge technologies to drive product and feature competitiveness.
* Cost Optimization : Create product value propositions and cost reduction proposals to optimize costs.

**Qualifications, Experience, and Skills:**
**Key experience required:**

* Years of Experience: 3+ years of Automotive Display product experience or similar;
* Degree Strongly Preferred: Bachelor of Science (minimum), in Mechanical, Displays, or Electronic Engineering (EE), or a related field with equivalent experience.

**Desired Competencies/Experience:**

* Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously;
* Flexibility to support regions/countries in different time zones;
* Proven ability to lead and manage multi-functional global engineering internal team .
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with global cultural sensitivity.
* Strong presentation skills;
* Ability to understand, at a high level mechanical, display design, electronics & associated implementation;
* Good MS Office skills (Excel, Word, PowerPoint);
* Good communication skills especially with Customers;
* Ability to work within a constrained deadline (quotes are tight and time-bound);
* Ability to work closely with suppliers for part selections and negotiations;
* A Plus – deep understanding of displays & touch technology;
* A Plus –understanding of commercial/business/financial measurement (NPV, IRR, EBIT, etc.);
* A Plus – experience with Jira, Confluence and AI agents
* Fluent in English;
* Self-motivated with the ability to lead a global team toward a common goal.
* Special Requirements (i.e. overtime, travel, etc.): Domestic and international travel to internal and customer locations may be required (~5-10%).

**Key Behaviors:**

* Collaboration;
* Result – oriented;
* Critical thinking;
* Evaluating problems;

**Reporting Structure:**
Reports to the Associate Manager of the Display Quote team.
  
  
**In the fast**
lane of technology. At Visteon, we’re redefining how the world connects through its vehicles. Our innovations transform the driving experience for millions, powered by a high-performance culture that challenges the status quo and sparks new possibilities—in careers and communities. Join us and help shape the future.

title: Instructional Design Project Manager
description:
**About Cornerstone**
  
  
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
**About the Role**
  
  
The Credentialing Team Lead owns the day-to-day operations and outcomes of Cornerstone's certification and credentialing programs across India and Costa Rica. You will set the operational rhythm for the team, hold accountability for program quality and delivery timelines, and ensure credentials are valid, current, and reaching candidates on time. You will report to [Manager title] and directly influence the metrics that connect certification to partner and customer performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
  
  

* Coordinate and lead the daily work of the team, providing task prioritization, workload management, and day-to-day guidance, while fostering a collaborative environment and supporting the professional development of team members.

  

* Communicate team progress, blockers, and updates to senior leadership on a regular basis, and prepare status updates, reports, and program summaries as needed.

  

* Oversee the execution of certification program operations, ensuring timely and consistent delivery across all initiatives, and monitor program workflows to identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.

  

* Own the management of certification assets, documentation, and program records, and assist with vendor coordination and platform administration as needed.

  

* Partner with the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs) with credential development and updates, including content review, item writing support, and documentation, and coordinate exam development cycles, blueprint reviews, and content refresh activities.

  

* Work with the Certification Platforms Specialist to support platform operations, including badge issuance, system updates, and user experience improvements; coordinate integrations between certification platforms, proctoring solutions, and the LMS; and escalate technical issues and platform needs to the appropriate stakeholders.

  

* Lead the implementation of quality assurance processes across program content and delivery, and adherence to assessment quality standards and certification best practices.

  

* Help ensure program activities align with relevant industry standards and data privacy requirements, and flag compliance concerns to senior leadership for resolution.

  

* Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal teams on day-to-day certification questions and operational matters, collaborating with teams such as Marketing, Customer Support, and IT to support program needs.

  

* Identify, test, and implement AI-enabled automation for routine operational work; measure impact and retire unnecessary manual processes.

  

* Use AI to prepare status updates, reports, and program summaries, with human review before anything is shared with leadership.

  

* Continuously maps the routine and repeatable tasks within this role, identifies automation opportunities using AI and workflow tools, proposes and implements solutions, and measures whether the automation delivers the expected time and quality improvement.

  

* Perform other duties as assigned.

  
**What Success Looks Like**
  
  

* Delivery: 95% or more of committed program milestones and team deliverables delivered on or before their dates each quarter.

  

* Reporting: Status updates to Sr. Manager of Certifications delivered on schedule 100% of the time, with blockers escalated within 2 business days.

  

* Compliance: Every compliance or data privacy concern flagged to Sr. Manager of Certifications within 2 business days of being identified.

  

* Program readiness (influenced): January 2027 launch milestones tracked weekly and on track, with every at-risk item escalated before it becomes a delay.

  

* AI transformation: Baseline hours spent on status reporting and routine coordination measured in the first 90 days, then reduced by 30% within 12 months, with review controls maintained.

  

* Candidate pass rates and renewal rates are tracked per credential and reviewed quarterly; trends are reported to program leadership with a recommended action when rates fall outside defined thresholds.

  

* Paid exam revenue and voucher redemption revenue are reported accurately each period; discrepancies are identified and resolved within 3 business days.

  

* Certification data (pass rates, badge issuance, renewal status) is delivered to the Strategy & Operations and partner performance teams on the agreed schedule with no missing records.

  

* All active exams are current within 3 weeks of each major product release.

  

* Badges are issued within 48 business hours of a passing result being confirmed.

  
**Required Experience**
  
  

* Experience with LMS content administration and learner-facing content management.

  

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail in managing program assets and documentation.

  

* Experience in customer or partner-facing support roles.

  

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  

* Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

  

* Ability to evaluate AI outputs and apply sound judgment about when a human must decide.

  

* Experience managing communications across multiple digital channels (email, community platforms, support portals, learning portals).

  

* Experience with localization workflows including machine translation tools and human post-editing processes; able to assess translation quality without necessarily being fluent in the target language.

  
**Preferred Experience**
  
  

* Experience with assessment or instructional design practices.

  

* Experience designing or improving AI-enabled workflows.

  
**AI & Continuous Learning**
  
  

* Uses AI to streamline team coordination, status reporting, and program documentation, and guides the team in adopting AI responsibly, with human review where it matters.

  

* Uses AI tools every day in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.

  

* Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.

  

* Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.

  

* Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.

  

* Defines and enforces the team's standards for AI use in exam development, including when AI-generated items require SME review, what bias and accuracy checks must be completed before an item enters the bank, and how AI-assisted proctoring tools are evaluated and approved.

  

* Owns the governance framework for AI in candidate support, including escalation paths when AI-assisted responses are insufficient or incorrect.

  
**How You Work**
  
  

* Customer obsessed: Start with the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.

  

* Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.

  

* Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.

  

* Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.

  

* Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.

  

* AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.

  

* Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

title: State Manager - FM (MH West)
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As the State Manager - Farm Machinery (MH West) at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd within the Farm Division, you will hold a pivotal role in driving the success of our distributor network and overall FM sales performance. Your key responsibilities will include:

* Strategically identifying and selecting optimal locations to establish distributor outlets, based on an in-depth analysis of competitor activities and emerging market opportunities, to facilitate market expansion and penetration.
* Ensuring the achievement and maintenance of predefined revenue targets from the distributor channel on an annual basis, aligning with broader business objectives.
* Gaining a comprehensive understanding of distributor needs and challenges; developing innovative sales incentive programs and promotional campaigns that effectively motivate distributors to increase sales volumes.
* Conducting thorough evaluation of diverse markets to tailor sales promotion activities aimed at boosting visibility and market share for specific products.
* Fostering strong, long-term, and mutually beneficial relationships with high-volume distributors, serving as a trusted advisor and partner.
* Providing leadership and actionable guidance to distributors to assist in their efforts to expand retail networks, thereby enhancing market coverage and customer accessibility.
* Analyzing distributor cash-flow dynamics and implementing optimized delivery and collections schemes to support financial stability and operational efficiency.
* Driving supplier performance improvements through effective supplier consequence management strategies, facilitating a robust supply ecosystem.
* Collaborating closely with Zonal and State teams to synergize efforts in boosting business growth through distributor channels, ensuring alignment on objectives and execution plans.
* Implementing a structured review mechanism to monitor and assess distributor volume performance on a weekly and monthly cadence, enabling timely course corrections and support.

* Demonstrated success in managing large sales territories, focusing on revenue growth and market expansion through distributor channels, showcasing an ability to navigate competitive and diverse market landscapes.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as manufacturing, supply chain, and marketing to synchronize efforts and optimize product availability and promotional activities.
* Proven competency in leading teams and mentoring distributor partners, with a focus on building sustainable business relationships and enhancing partner capabilities.

* Solid understanding of distributor business financial operations, including cash flow management, credit control, and collections methodology.
* Adeptness at applying data-driven decision-making and engaging in strategic foresight to anticipate market trends and adjust sales strategies proactively.

**Critical Experience**
-----------------------

The role requires critical experience and competencies that underpin effective leadership and business execution, including but not limited to:

* Deep expertise in dealer management and channel profitability, with a history of successfully designing and implementing distributor selection, evaluation, onboarding, and performance review processes.
* Strong capabilities in market analysis, including benchmarking and trend analysis, to accurately assess competition and identify new market opportunities for strategic expansion.
* Advanced skills in sales planning, revenue management, and forecasting, critical to ensuring product availability and meeting sales targets through robust distribution networks.
* Proven ability to build and nurture sustainable distributor relationships by understanding and addressing their latent needs through tailored sales schemes and motivation programs.
* Competency in managing supplier relationships and improving supplier performance via consequence management strategies, ensuring seamless supply chain operations.
* Experience in liaising with governmental bodies and managing government business pipelines, enabling distributors to participate effectively in this sector.
* Demonstrated strategic business orientation encompassing anticipation and leveraging of business opportunities, strategic foresight, and a global mindset aligned with sustainable leadership principles.
* Leadership qualities encompassing stakeholder focus, frugal and sustainable approaches, fostering innovation, change management, and risk-taking with accountability.
* A strong customer focus, including sensitivity and commitment to customer delight, serving orientation, and building long-term customer relationships.
* Excellent project management skills, underpinned by passion for quality, agility, discipline, and accountability for results.
* Human capital leveraging competencies such as team development, appreciation of diversity, entrepreneurial engagement, and cultivating synergistic team environments.
* Attributes reflecting passion for work, barrier-free collaboration, infusing enjoyment into work, and a positive approach to learning from setbacks.

Bringing together these experiences and competencies will enable the successful candidate to lead the distributor network effectively while aligning with the core values and strategic objectives of Mahindra & Mahindra's Farm Division.

title: Senior Manager
description:
**Job Description: Principal Engineer, Data Platform (Databricks)**

**About the Role**

We are building our next-generation data platform on Databricks. The Principal Engineer sets the technical direction for how the bank ingests, models, governs and serves data. This is a hands-on role: you will design the detailed lakehouse implementation, set engineering standards for SQL and pipelines, lead the migration from legacy platforms, and mentor engineers across several teams. You will work within the target-state architecture owned by the Solution Architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lakehouse design:** Own the detailed design of the Databricks lakehouse: ingestion, bronze/silver/gold layers, Delta Lake design, Unity Catalog setup, and workspace and cluster configuration.
* **Migration:** Lead the hands-on migration of legacy Hadoop/Hive/Spark and warehouse workloads to Databricks, including re-platforming HQL and SQL, validating data parity, and safe cutover.
* **Engineering standards:** Set standards for SQL, PySpark and Delta Live Tables/Lakeflow pipelines, covering code review, testing, CI/CD and observability.
* **Performance and cost:** Tune performance and cost: partitioning, liquid clustering/Z-ordering, file compaction, join and shuffle tuning, Photon, cluster right-sizing and DBU spend governance.
* **Data modeling:** Design canonical, auditable entity models (applications, accounts, customers, transactions) across source systems.
* **Security and compliance:** Implement PII protection, encryption and tokenization, row/column-level security, lineage, retention and audit readiness with Security, Risk, Compliance and Data Governance.
* **Design reviews:** Lead technical design reviews, write architecture decision records, and resolve cross-team technical trade-offs.
* **Mentoring:** Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and raise engineering quality across the data organization.
* **Data products:** Work with Analytics, Data Science/ML, Risk, Fraud and Finance to turn business needs into reliable, documented data products.
* **Evaluation:** Evaluate new Databricks capabilities and tools and recommend adoption where there is clear value.

* **Experience:** 12+ years in data or software engineering, with at least 5 years in a technical lead, staff or principal role.

* **Spark and big data:** Deep experience with Apache Spark (PySpark and/or Scala) and the ecosystem: Hadoop, Hive, Kafka, Parquet/ORC/Delta.

* **Data security:** Implementation of PII protection: encryption, tokenization, and row/column-level security.
* **Leadership and communication:** Mentoring engineers, and explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and executives.

* Data modeling for Marketing (campaign, attribution, funnel) and Collections (delinquency, contact, payments)

title: Area Manager
description:
**Challenge Yourself and Impact the Future!**

  

MacDermid Enthone Industrial Solutions operates as a business of Element Solutions Inc (NYSE: ESI). Element Solutions Inc is a leading specialty chemicals company whose businesses supply a broad range of solutions that enhance the products people use every day.

  

MacDermid Enthone Industrial Solutions is a global supplier of industrial metal and plastic finishing chemistries. We primarily design and manufacture chemical systems that protect and decorate surfaces. Our high-performance functional coatings improve resistance to wear and tear, such as hard chrome plating of shock absorbers for cars, or provide corrosion resistance for appliance parts. Our decorative performance coatings apply finishes for parts in various end markets such as automotive interiors or jewelry surfaces. As part of our broader sustainable solutions platform, we also provide both chemistry and equipment for turnkey wastewater treatment, and recycle and reuse solutions. Our industrial customer base is highly diverse and includes customers in the following end markets: appliances and electronics; automotive parts; industrial parts; plumbing goods; construction equipment; and transportation equipment.

  

We strive to embody the five 'Elements of our Culture'- our '5C's'; Challenge, Commit, Collaborate, Choose, and Care. These core values are the foundation of our organization which our employees embrace in their interactions with customers, colleagues and other stakeholders, to drive financial performance and create a rewarding work environment.

  

**Who are we looking for?**
---------------------------

We are seeking a commercially driven Sales Area Manager to lead sales activities within a designated territory for a global chemical company. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving revenue growth, strengthening customer relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and delivering exceptional customer service while supporting the company's strategic objectives.

**What will you be doing?**
---------------------------

* Develop and execute territory sales plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets.
* Manage and grow relationships with existing customers across key market segments.

description:
About CARECIL PRIVATE LIMITED

CARECIL PRIVATE LIMITED is a growing paints and coatings company focused on Automotive Refinish, OEM Paints and High-Performance Coatings.

We are expanding our automotive refinish business in Maharashtra and are looking for a result-oriented Retail Sales Manager to develop and grow our retail and aftermarket business across Pune and surrounding markets.

Job Overview

The Retail Sales Manager will be responsible for developing automotive refinish paint sales across the assigned territory through dealers, distributors, retailers, bodyshops, garages and automotive painters.

The candidate will drive sales growth, expand the dealer network, acquire new customers, conduct product trials, develop painter relationships and increase market penetration.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in automotive refinish paint sales, a strong understanding of the automotive aftermarket and an established network of dealers, garages and bodyshops in Pune and nearby markets.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Sales & Business Development

· Achieve monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the assigned territory.

· Develop and execute territory-wise sales plans to increase market share.

· Identify new business opportunities and convert prospects into active customers.

· Generate sales through dealers, retailers, distributors, garages and bodyshops.

· Conduct regular market visits and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

· Develop new markets and increase penetration of Carecil automotive refinish products.

2. Dealer & Retail Network Development

· Identify, appoint and develop automotive paint dealers and retailers across Pune and nearby markets.

· Build strong relationships with existing channel partners.

· Expand the distribution network in uncovered and high-potential areas.

· Monitor dealer inventory, product movement and secondary sales.

· Ensure product availability and encourage repeat orders.

· Introduce new products, promotional schemes and channel development initiatives.

· Help dealers increase sales by developing business with local garages and bodyshops.

3. Bodyshop & Garage Development

· Identify and develop relationships with independent garages, car bodyshops and accident repair centres.

· Generate product trials and convert customers from competing brands.

· Visit workshops to understand product requirements and application challenges.

· Coordinate product demonstrations and technical support with the company's technical team.

· Develop key bodyshops into regular users of Carecil automotive refinish products.

· Build long-term relationships with workshop owners and decision-makers.

4. Painter & Influencer Development

· Build relationships with automotive painters, applicators and workshop supervisors.

· Identify influential painters who play a key role in paint brand selection.

· Conduct product demonstrations and application trials.

· Communicate product benefits, application techniques and performance advantages.

· Collect feedback on shade matching, drying time, coverage, gloss, finish and ease of application.

· Develop painter loyalty and encourage repeat product usage.

5. Product Promotion

Promote Carecil's automotive refinish portfolio, including:

· Polyester Putty

· 1K and 2K Primers

· Epoxy Primers

· Surfacer / Filler

· Basecoats

· Solid and Metallic Binders

· 2K Clearcoats

· Hardeners

· Thinners and Reducers

· Other Automotive Refinish Consumables

The candidate must be capable of explaining product benefits, identifying customer requirements and coordinating technical support for product trials and application-related issues.

6. Market & Competitor Intelligence

· Monitor competitor brands, pricing, dealer margins, schemes and product launches.

· Understand local customer preferences and competitor strengths.

· Identify opportunities to convert customers from competing automotive refinish brands.

· Identify high-potential dealers, retailers, bodyshops and automotive repair clusters.

· Share regular market intelligence and customer feedback with management.

7. Collections & Sales Administration

· Follow up on outstanding payments and ensure timely collections.

· Coordinate with accounts, logistics and internal sales teams for order processing and delivery.

· Maintain accurate customer, dealer, retailer, bodyshop and painter databases.

· Submit daily, weekly and monthly sales and market visit reports.

· Monitor sales performance, customer retention and territory development.

Target Market – Pune & Surrounding Areas

The candidate will be responsible for developing automotive refinish business across Pune and nearby markets, including:

· Pune City

· Pimpri-Chinchwad

· Bhosari and Chakan

· Talegaon Dabhade

· Hinjawadi and Wakad

· Hadapsar and Wagholi

· Kondhwa and Katraj

· Shirur and surrounding markets

· Other nearby automotive aftermarket and industrial clusters as assigned

The territory may be expanded based on business requirements.

Candidate RequirementsMandatory Experience

· Minimum 1 years of relevant experience in automotive refinish paint sales or automotive refinish products.

· Experience working with paint manufacturers, distributors or automotive refinish companies is preferred.

· Practical experience in dealer, retailer, garage and bodyshop sales.

· An established network of automotive paint dealers, garages, bodyshops and painters in Pune will be a strong advantage.

Education

· Graduate in any discipline.

· MBA / PGDM in Sales & Marketing will be an added advantage.

· Technical qualifications in Paints, Coatings or Automotive Technology will be beneficial.

Required Skills

· Strong sales, negotiation and business development skills.

· Good understanding of automotive refinish products and their applications.

· Ability to develop dealers, retailers, garages and bodyshops.

· Strong communication, relationship-building and networking skills.

· Ability to generate product trials and convert them into regular business.

· Commercial awareness and a target-oriented approach.

· Good reporting, planning and follow-up skills.

· Willingness to travel extensively across the assigned territory.

· Valid driving licence and personal two-wheeler will be preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

· Monthly sales target achievement

· New dealer and retailer appointments

· Growth in active dealers and repeat orders

· New bodyshop and garage acquisition

· Product trials and conversion rates

· Secondary sales growth

· Territory coverage and market visit productivity

· Customer retention and painter engagement

· Collection performance

· New market development

· Overall territory profitability and growth

Compensation

**Salary:** Competitive and based on relevant experience, current compensation, market exposure and demonstrated sales performance.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a proactive sales professional who understands the automotive refinish market, knows how dealers and bodyshops purchase paint products, and can independently develop the Pune territory.

Candidates with direct automotive refinish paint sales experience and an established local market network will be given preference.

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with the following details:

· Current Location

· Total Work Experience

· Current CTC

· Expected CTC

· Notice Period

· Existing Dealer, Garage and Bodyshop Network

title: Territory Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area-level, product-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential & preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-** Graduate with science background.  
  
**Minimum work experience-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.

  
**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.

 **Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

**Quick Commerce Manager | Sneakare**

**Location:** Kirti Nagar, New Delhi (On-site)  
**Department:** eCommerce  
**Experience:** 3-6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

**About Sneakare**

Sneakare is a New Delhi-based, fast-growing sneaker care brand built for people who love what they wear on their feet. Our premium, no-nonsense range of cleaning kits, insoles, suede care, and storage solutions helps sneaker fans protect what they paid for and wear it longer.

We started small, made it to **Shark Tank India**, and haven’t slowed down since. Our team is young, fast-moving, and obsessed with getting the details right, whether that’s a product formula, a listing, or a customer interaction. We value quality over shortcuts, ownership over excuses, and learning over ego.

**The Role**

As Quick Commerce Manager, you will own Sneakare’s presence and performance across quick commerce platforms such as **Blinkit, Zepto, and emerging dark-store networks**. You will drive cataloguing, availability, visibility, and sell-through, working closely with supply chain, marketing, and the founder’s office to turn this channel into a significant revenue engine.

This is a high-ownership role. You will run the channel P&L, and your decisions will directly move revenue.

What You’ll Do

**Platform Ownership**

* Manage end-to-end operations on each platform: onboarding, cataloguing, content quality, and store-level availability.

**Revenue & Growth**

* Own the quick commerce P&L, set GMV targets, and drive week-on-week growth.
* Maximise share-of-shelf, search ranking, and brand visibility.

**Inventory & Supply Planning**

* Work with the supply chain team to forecast demand and plan replenishment by city and dark store.
* Manage FIFO, reduce stock-outs, and keep fill rates healthy.

**Campaigns & Promotions**

* Plan and run platform-specific promotions, banner ads, and seasonal campaigns with the marketing team.
* Improve CTR, conversion, and ROAS on every rupee spent.

**Analytics & Reporting**

* Track fill rate, return rate, sell-through, SOV, availability, and ranking through platform dashboards and internal tools.
* Present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership with clear insights and next actions.

**KAM & Platform Relationships**

* Build strong working relationships with Key Account Managers to secure better placements, promotional slots, and priority listings.

**New Product Launches**

* Coordinate go-lives of new SKUs with accurate content, pricing, and stock aligned to launch timelines.

**Pricing & Competitiveness**

* Monitor competitor pricing, discounting, and category trends.
* Recommend pricing and margin adjustments that balance growth with profitability.

What We’re Looking For

* 3-6 years of experience in quick commerce, eCommerce, or marketplace account management, ideally with a D2C or consumer brand.
* Hands-on experience managing at least one major quick commerce platform (Blinkit, Zepto, or similar), including vendor panels and ad dashboards.
* Strong command of channel metrics: GMV, fill rate, availability, sell-through, SOV, and ROAS.
* Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and data analysis, with the ability to turn numbers into decisions.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills for working with KAMs and internal teams.
* A self-starter mindset with the ability to prioritise and execute in a fast-paced environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in fashion, lifestyle, footwear, or sneaker-adjacent categories.
* Familiarity with dark-store operations, last-mile logistics, and quick commerce supply chains.
* Background at a startup or high-growth D2C brand where you owned outcomes end-to-end.
* Working knowledge of Unicommerce, Increff, or similar OMS/WMS tools.
* Understanding of digital marketing: search ads, banner placements, and platform promotional mechanics.

**Why Join Sneakare**

* Own a high-impact, high-growth channel with real P&L responsibility.
* Work directly with the founder’s office and see your decisions drive results.
* Join a Shark Tank India-backed brand with a loyal and growing community.
* Grow fast in a team that values learning, speed, and accountability.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

title: Associate Director - Business Strategy & Growth
description:
**Role Overview**
Minfy is seeking a senior professional with experience working within a hyperscaler or leading cloud partnership programs at a systems integrator or cloud consulting firm.
  
  
You will lead the execution of strategic collaboration programs with major hyperscalers, translating joint business plans into coordinated action across sales, delivery, alliances, technology practices and finance.
  
  
The role requires firsthand understanding of how cloud partnerships operate, including co-sell programs, partner investments, capability development and executive business reviews, and the ability to turn these mechanisms into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Working closely with Minfy’s executive leadership and senior cloud partner stakeholders, you will own the several programs, performance visibility, governance and resolution of cross-functional execution challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Joint Business Planning and Program Ownership**
Translate partnership objectives and agreed commitments into an integrated plan with owners, milestones, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Coordinate joint business planning and align functional priorities, resources and capability development with program objectives.
  
  
Maintain a clear baseline of commitments and manage changes through appropriate review and approval.
  
  
**Cross Functional Execution**
Mobilise sales, delivery, alliances, practices and finance teams to execute agreed priorities and resolve dependencies.
  
  
Coordinate program workstreams covering market initiatives, co-sell activity, customer adoption and partner capability requirements.
  
  
Identify execution gaps, agree recovery plans with accountable leaders and drive actions to closure.
  
  
**Partner Engagement and Executive Governance**
Act as the central program coordination point for cloud partner stakeholders, working alongside Minfy’s alliance leadership.
  
  
Lead program reviews and prepare executive business reviews with clear performance assessments, recommendations and decision requests.
  
  
Escalate risks and unresolved issues early, presenting practical options and the impact of delayed decisions.
  
  
**Commercial Oversight and Performance Management**
Work with Finance to track approved investments, expenditure and benefits, and coordinate applicable partner submissions and reconciliation.
  
  
Maintain reliable dashboards and supporting evidence; distinguish planned, forecast and realised outcomes.
  
  
Monitor program obligations, approval requirements and deadlines, maintaining confidentiality and audit readiness.
  
  
**Required Experience And Capabilities**
Typically 12–18 years of relevant experience, including at least five years leading complex, cross-functional programs with executive visibility.
  
  
Direct experience in partner programs, partner business operations, strategic initiatives or business planning at a hyperscaler; or cloud alliance programs and strategic collaboration execution at a systems integrator or cloud services partner.
  
  
Demonstrated ownership of joint business plans, executive reviews, program commitments and partner investment processes.
  
  
Working knowledge of cloud partner ecosystems, co-sell motions, commercial models and capability development requirements.
  
  
Strong program governance, financial tracking, risk management and analytical skills, with evidence of delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountability across functions without direct reporting authority.
  
  
Clear executive communication and commercial judgment, combined with hands-on ownership of plans, dashboards and issue resolution.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Exposure to cloud migration, modernization, managed services, data or AI programs.
  
  
**Experience Coordinating Programs Across Geographies And Multiple Business Functions.**
Experience building or improving a program office or partnership operating model. Relevant program management qualifications are useful.
  
  
**Measures of Success**
Delivery and acceptance of agreed commitments and milestones within planned timelines.
  
  
Validated business outcomes and effective use of approved program investments.
  
  
Timely closure of cross-functional dependencies, corrective actions and partner submissions.
  
  
Accurate executive reporting, complete evidence, and early visibility of material risks.
  
  
**Working Relationships**
The role will work closely with Minfy’s executive sponsor, alliance leadership and functional heads, alongside senior cloud partner stakeholders.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Bring your experience into a role with broad program ownership, executive visibility and the opportunity to help shape Minfy’s growth across cloud, data and AI.

title: Zonal Manager - Chains
description:

**About The Function**
The Hotels business at MakeMyTrip is one of the largest and fastest-growing verticals within the organization, driving exceptional travel experiences for millions of customers every year. With a strong focus on customer delight, technology-led innovation, and deep partnerships, the Hotels team curates and manages an extensive portfolio of domestic and international stays across leisure and business destinations. The function works closely with supply partners, revenue management, marketing, product, and operations teams to ensure the right balance of availability, pricing, and quality delivering unmatched value to travelers while strengthening partner relationships.
  
  
The Chains team is a part of the Domestic Hotel Supply Function and this team manages the overall business growth and supply of branded chain hotels headquartered in India. This team manages key Indian brands such as IHCL (Taj, SeleQtions, Vivanta & Ginger), ITC, Leela, Sarovar etc. and has direct contracts with 1000+ hotels.
  
  
**About The Role**
The incumbent in this role will be accountable for enhancing the productivity of the portfolio, meeting or exceeding supply targets, identifying market opportunities, and guiding the team to attain their KRAs. Additionally, the role holder will develop strategic insights to improve business profitability, pinpoint opportunities for process improvement, and collaborate closely with business teams to assess process adherence and prioritize areas for enhancement.
  
  
**What Will You Be Doing**
Relationship and Account Management:
  
  

* Lead meetings with C-level executives of reputed hotel brands to foster strategic engagement and ensure portfolio performance on defined KPIs
* Collaborate with portfolio partners, providing expertise, analyzing metrics, and offering recommendations based on industry best practices
* Travel across various cities to meet relevant decision-makers, aiming to understand the hotels and micro-markets and applying ground intelligence in crafting portfolio strategies
* Portfolio Management and Drive Growth for units:
* Review regular production reports and guide the team in providing feedback to portfolio hotels. Plan and execute market visits, conducting review meetings (virtually and in person) to discuss regular performance
* Create review reports and share market insights and analyses with hotels to drive unit growth, involving relevant team members.
* Ensure continuous work on inventory availability and price competitiveness throughout the year.

* Lead and inspire team members to achieve monthly Key Result Areas (KRAs) and meet growth targets for the designated portfolio

MBA from a reputed institute with 6 to 10 years of experience in sales, Travel Trade, Key Account Management, Contracting, or B2B Sales.

* Mindset that will constantly think about Return on Investment, business.
* Strong communication skills, Influencing skills, great interpersonal & stakeholder management skills.
* High on energy, team player coupled with a great attitude.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint is essential.

Position Title: Sales Manager Department: Immigration Sales

About Y-Axis

At Y-Axis, our mission is to empower individuals to become Global Indians—ready to thrive and make an impact on the world stage. As the world's leading overseas career, immigration, and visa company, we guide clients through their international journeys. With 50+ offices across India, Australia, the UAE, the UK, and Canada, and a dedicated team of 1500+ professionals, we have helped over 1 million clients achieve their global aspirations.

About the Department

The Immigration Sales team assists individuals and families in navigating complex immigration processes to countries like Canada, Australia, the UK, the USA, and Germany. We focus on understanding clients' goals, assessing eligibility, and recommending the most suitable pathways for skilled migration, family reunification, or permanent residency. As a Sales Manager, you will lead and grow this team to achieve organizational targets and drive innovation.

Your Role: Sales Manager

As a Sales Manager, you will be responsible for building, leading, and motivating a team of Inside Sales Consultants. You will develop and implement strategies to drive sales performance, support marketing initiatives, create new products, and ensure client satisfaction. Your role is

pivotal in helping Y-Axis maintain its leadership position and in creating more success stories for aspiring Global Indians.

Key Responsibilities

* Recruit, train, and manage a team of Inside Sales Consultants.

* Identify sales opportunities and develop pan-India strategies to achieve revenue targets.

* Plan and manage advertising budgets and roll out innovative marketing campaigns.

* Monitor, analyze, and report on sales campaign performance, prospect generation, and conversion rates.

* Lead new product development initiatives and drive their success through effective advocacy, training, and marketing.

* Conduct regular market intelligence and competition analysis; identify threats and opportunities and recommend strategies.

* Ensure the Y-Axis website is updated with the latest information, services, and marketing campaigns.

* Review Google Analytics to monitor website performance and lead conversions.

* Track, evaluate, and improve the sales team's performance weekly and monthly.

* Provide key business metric analysis and help shape long-term departmental strategy.

What We’re Looking For

Education: Bachelor’s degree in any field (Master’s degree preferred).

**Experience:**

* 5 to 12 years of proven experience in sales management roles, leading a team, and developing new business.

* Experience in the immigration and visas industry is a plus.

Skills:

* Strong leadership and team management skills.

* Target-driven with a demonstrated ability to perform under pressure.

* Excellent planning, organizational, and analytical abilities.

* Outstanding interpersonal and English communication skills.

* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to execute tactical plans.

* Experience in using CRM systems and online marketing tools.

* Motivational leadership with a team-first attitude.

* Adaptability to market trends and evolving client needs.

* Solution-oriented problem solver.

Why Y-Axis?

Be a part of a global leader in overseas education and immigration, where you can make a real impact on individuals' lives. Drive change, lead a dynamic team, and help clients turn their international dreams into reality.

Why This Department?

Join a high-performing, fast-growing team dedicated to providing world-class immigration solutions. Your leadership will directly influence success stories across the globe.

title: General Manager
description:
**Company:** Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Business Operations & Management  
**Reports To:** CEO / Managing Director  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall business operations of Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd., ensuring operational efficiency, business growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and effective coordination across all departments. The role involves implementing management strategies, monitoring departmental performance, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that company objectives are achieved.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Business Operations & Strategy**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the company and ensure smooth functioning across departments.
* Develop and implement business strategies in line with company objectives.
* Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish policies, procedures, SOPs, and performance standards.
* Ensure coordination between the Head Office, warehouse, and other business units.

**B. Sales & Business Development**

* Monitor sales performance and ensure achievement of monthly and annual targets.
* Develop strategies to increase revenue, customer acquisition, and repeat purchases.
* Identify new business opportunities, products, markets, and revenue streams.
* Analyse sales reports, customer trends, and competitor activities.
* Work with the sales team to improve productivity and conversion rates.

**C. Marketing & Ecommerce Management**

* Supervise marketing activities, campaigns, promotions, and digital marketing performance.
* Monitor website performance, online sales, product listings, and order conversion.
* Evaluate campaign ROI, customer acquisition costs, and marketing expenditure.
* Coordinate with marketing teams to improve brand visibility and customer engagement.
* Ensure promotional offers and product campaigns align with business objectives.

**D. Warehouse & Logistics Management**

* Monitor inventory management, stock accuracy, order processing, packing, dispatch, and returns.
* Ensure timely order fulfilment and efficient coordination with courier partners.
* Review shipping costs, delivery performance, RTO rates, and damaged or lost shipments.
* Implement procedures to minimise stock discrepancies, wastage, and operational losses.
* Ensure proper warehouse documentation, stock reconciliation, and safety standards.

**E. Financial & Cost Management**

* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability, budgets, and operating costs.
* Coordinate with Accounts & Finance to review financial reports and cash flow.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor outstanding payments, COD settlements, vendor payments, and logistics expenses.
* Ensure financial controls and compliance with company policies.

**F. Human Resources & Administration**

* Coordinate with HR on manpower planning, recruitment, employee performance, and training.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and departmental staffing requirements.
* Ensure clear reporting structures, accountability, and performance evaluation.
* Supervise administrative functions, facilities, procurement coordination, and resource utilisation.
* Support employee engagement and the development of a performance-oriented work culture.

**G. Customer Service & Customer Retention**

* Monitor customer complaints, returns, refunds, and service quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and escalations.
* Develop strategies to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat purchases.
* Analyse customer feedback and implement corrective actions.

**H. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with suppliers, courier partners, service providers, and business associates.
* Review vendor quotations, service quality, delivery commitments, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate favourable business terms and monitor vendor performance.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for new product launches and business requirements.

**I. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Define KPIs and performance targets for departments and team leaders.
* Conduct regular departmental review meetings and track action items.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Identify deviations from targets and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure timely completion of management decisions and assigned projects.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of sales and revenue targets.
* Improvement in gross margin and overall profitability.
* Reduction in operational costs and logistics expenses.
* Order processing and dispatch efficiency.
* Delivery success rate and reduction in RTO percentage.
* Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock discrepancies.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat purchase rate.
* Departmental productivity and achievement of KPIs.
* Timely implementation of SOPs and management decisions.
* Vendor performance and cost optimisation.

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is preferred.

5. Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in operations, business management, ecommerce, retail, or distribution.
* Prior experience managing multiple departments and cross-functional teams is preferred.
* Experience in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, logistics, sales, and business development will be an advantage.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Leadership, team management, and decision-making.
* Strong business planning and operational execution.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Financial awareness, budgeting, and cost control.
* Sales, marketing, and ecommerce understanding.
* Vendor negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, ERP, and business management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work towards deadlines.

7. Authority & Accountability

* Recommend and implement operational improvements within approved authority.
* Monitor departmental performance and require corrective action where necessary.
* Review departmental reports, budgets, and operational expenses.
* Recommend staffing, vendor, process, and resource changes to management.
* Escalate significant financial, operational, compliance, and customer-related risks to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Ensure confidentiality, compliance, and adherence to company policies.

8. Working Relationships

**Internal:** CEO / Managing Director, HR, Sales, Marketing, Accounts & Finance, Purchase, IT, Customer Relationship Management, Warehouse, and Administration.

**External:** Vendors, suppliers, courier partners, service providers, customers, and other business associates.

9. Overall Responsibility

The General Manager is accountable for ensuring that Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd. operates efficiently, achieves its business targets, maintains cost discipline, improves customer experience, and develops a structured, accountable, and performance-driven organization

title: Client Handling Manager
description:
**Job Title: Client Handling Manager – Account Management & Business Growth**

**Experience: 2–5 Years**

**Location: Bangalore**

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Client Handling Manager responsible for managing existing client accounts, strengthening client relationships, driving account farming, and generating incremental business opportunities.

The individual will act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, understand client business requirements, coordinate with internal delivery and recruitment teams, and identify opportunities to expand existing business.

The primary objective of this role is not just client servicing but also account growth, revenue expansion, client retention, and increasing wallet share across existing accounts.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Client Relationship Management**

**-**
Act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts.

- Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders, including TA Heads, HR Heads, Procurement, Hiring Managers, Engineering Heads and Business Leaders.

- Conduct regular client meetings, business reviews and feedback sessions.

- Understand client hiring plans, workforce requirements, project expansions and future business needs.

- Ensure timely resolution of client escalations and maintain high client satisfaction.

- Develop strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within each client organization.

**B. Account Farming & Business Growth**

**-**
Develop and execute account farming strategies to increase business from existing clients.

- Identify new hiring opportunities, departments, business units and project requirements within existing accounts.

- Expand vendor engagement across multiple locations, business divisions and service lines.

- Increase the number of active requirements and improve business penetration within assigned accounts.

- Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling staffing, permanent hiring, RPO, ODC and engineering services.

- Build account growth plans with quarterly and annual revenue targets.

- Convert inactive clients into active business accounts.

- Develop strategies to increase the company's share of business against competing staffing vendors.

**C. Requirement Generation & Coordination**

**-**
Proactively collect and generate new requirements from existing clients.

- Understand JDs, skill requirements, experience levels, budget, hiring timelines and client expectations.

- Coordinate with the Talent Acquisition Head and recruitment team to ensure timely delivery.

- Conduct requirement briefing sessions with recruiters.

- Monitor submission ratios, interview conversion, offer releases and joining ratios.

- Ensure proper follow-up on submitted profiles and pending interview feedback.

- Work with delivery teams to resolve recruitment challenges and improve closure rates.

**D. Revenue & Account Management**

**-**
Own revenue generation and business growth targets for assigned accounts.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual account revenue forecasts.

- Track client-wise billing, business pipeline, closures and collections in coordination with finance.

- Identify opportunities to improve margins and commercial terms.

- Negotiate staffing rates, service agreements and commercial proposals.

- Ensure timely contract renewals, purchase orders and billing approvals.

- Monitor account profitability and revenue contribution.

**E. Client Retention & Escalation Management**

**-**
Maintain strong client engagement to ensure long-term business relationships.

- Proactively identify risks of losing business or vendor disengagement.

- Address delivery-related concerns and client escalations.

- Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve issues within agreed timelines.

- Monitor client satisfaction and take corrective actions wherever required.

**F. MIS & Business Reporting**

**-**
Maintain client-wise business development and account growth trackers.

- Prepare weekly and monthly account performance reports.

- Track active clients, active requirements, submissions, interviews, offers and joinings.

- Monitor revenue growth, account penetration and client-wise performance.

- Present account growth plans and business forecasts to management.

**3. Required Skills & Competencies**

- Strong client relationship and stakeholder management skills.

- Proven experience in account farming and business development.

- Excellent negotiation, presentation and communication skills.

- Understanding of IT staffing, contract staffing and permanent recruitment.

- Ability to identify business opportunities and generate requirements.

- Strong commercial and revenue management understanding.

- Experience handling large enterprise clients and MNC accounts.

- Ability to coordinate with recruitment and delivery teams.

- Strong analytical skills and MIS reporting capabilities.

- Ownership mindset with a strong focus on revenue growth.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Intern who can take end-to-end ownership of hiring for a set of open roles, from sourcing and screening to coordinating interviews and closing offers. This is a 4-month internship with a clear path to a full-time role based on performance.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Sourcing: Proactively find and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, referrals, and campus networks — no waiting for applications to come in.
* Screening: Review applications and conduct initial screening calls to assess skills, motivation, and expectations.
* Interview coordination: Schedule interviews across hiring managers and time zones, and ensure a smooth, timely process for every candidate.

* Hiring manager partnership: Work with managers to understand role requirements, refine JDs, and follow up for timely interview feedback.
* Candidate experience: Be the main point of contact for candidates — communicate clearly, follow up promptly, and represent Inkle well.
* Offers & onboarding handoff: Support offer rollouts and ensure a smooth handoff to People Ops for onboarding.

* Extreme ownership & proactiveness: You’ll own multiple open roles at once — you must be independent, organized, and relentless about follow-ups.

* People skills: You enjoy talking to people, build rapport quickly, and can assess fit beyond what’s on a resume.
* Communication skills: Strong written and verbal English; clear, concise communication with candidates, hiring managers, and leadership.
* Tool proficiency: Comfortable with Google Sheets, LinkedIn, and a variety of SaaS tools.
* Education: Recent graduate or postgraduate in any discipline (MBA/HR preferred) with a genuine interest in recruiting and HR.
* Location & Work mode: Based in Bengaluru; full-time, in-office, Mon-Fri (10 am to 7 pm).

**Note: Candidates must be based in Bangalore or willing to relocate. Immediate to 30-day joiners preferred.**
**About Channel Factory**
Founded in 2010, Channel Factory is an award-winning marketing technology company that helps top global brands and agencies maximize their digital advertising performance across YouTube, social platforms, and beyond, serving over three hundred of the Fortune 500 with scalable, brand-safe, contextually aligned advertising solutions. We have a strong start-up culture that values diversity, collaboration, and results.
  
  
Channel Factory is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on any protected characteristic, and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs
  
  
**IT Recruitment (~70%)**

title: Platform Backend Engineers
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Seniority level: Mid-Senior level  
Industry: Software Development

  

Min Experience: 3+ years  
Location: Bengaluru, Chennai  
JobType: full-time

We are looking for a skilled Platform Backend Engineer to build and scale the backend infrastructure that powers enterprise AI and supply chain decision-intelligence products. The role involves developing core platform services, reusable APIs, execution frameworks, and agentic systems that enable product teams and AI agents to operate reliably in production.

You will take ambiguous technical problems from initial design through implementation, deployment, and continuous improvement. The work spans core backend platform engineering and the agentic layer, including frameworks for building and orchestrating AI agents and the agents built on top of them.

Hiring is open at both Senior and Staff levels, with the level determined by the scope of ownership, technical depth, and impact demonstrated.

  

**About the Platform**
----------------------

The platform enables enterprises to solve complex supply chain challenges using AI-driven decision intelligence. It combines ready-to-use AI capabilities for network optimization, inventory allocation, route scheduling, fulfillment planning, order promising, demand forecasting, prediction, and scenario analysis with a flexible development platform.

Business and technical users can build and refine solutions using no-code tools, custom code, or extensible platform components. The engineering team focuses on providing the scalable, composable infrastructure that makes these capabilities reliable and accessible to enterprise customers.

**Requirements**
----------------

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own platform capabilities end to end, from problem definition and architectural design to development, release, and continuous iteration.
* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and reusable execution patterns that other engineering teams can build upon.
* Develop robust data models and handle concurrency, failure recovery, performance optimization, and observability.
* Build and improve the frameworks used to develop, execute, and orchestrate AI agents.
* Develop production-ready agent loops, tool integrations, orchestration mechanisms, and user-facing experiences built on agentic systems.
* Translate ambiguous business and technical requirements into practical, maintainable engineering solutions.
* Debug complex production issues, identify root causes, and improve system reliability based on real-world behaviour.
* Make sound technical decisions around system design, APIs, databases, and underlying execution mechanisms.
* Collaborate with product teams and other engineers to deliver reusable platform capabilities that support multiple downstream consumers.
* Take ownership of production systems, monitor their performance, and evolve their architecture as requirements and usage change.
* Communicate design decisions, trade-offs, implementation details, and technical challenges clearly across teams.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**
--------------------------------------

* Strong fundamentals in backend engineering, including problem decomposition, data structures, low-level design, and debugging.
* Hands-on experience building and owning production-grade backend systems.
* Ability to explain system behaviour beyond the framework layer, including API design, database interactions, concurrency, and failure handling.
* Experience taking technical projects from initial design through production deployment and subsequent improvements.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous requirements without relying on predefined solutions.
* A practical, hands-on approach to engineering, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions, trade-offs, and production incidents.
* Experience working in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment where engineers are expected to take initiative and deliver end-to-end solutions.

**Must-Have Skills**
--------------------

* Backend Engineering
* Platform Engineering

**Good-to-Have Skills**
-----------------------

* Experience building developer platforms, workflow orchestration systems, or services consumed by multiple downstream teams.
* Familiarity with AI agent evaluation, tracing, tool integration, and cost-control mechanisms.
* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience designing reusable platform abstractions and execution frameworks.

**Location and Work Arrangement**
---------------------------------

**Location:** Bengaluru or Chennai  
**Work Model:** Hybrid

**Interview Process**
---------------------

The selection process consists of the following stages:

* Recruiter screening.

* Conversation with engineering leadership.

* Live system design and problem-solving round.

* Half-day in-office build exercise, where candidates can use AI tools of their choice and explain their implementation decisions.

* Build teardown and values conversation.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Product Support Analyst
description:
### **Description**

As an Infor POS Product Support Analyst, you will provide technical support to customers using the Infor Point of Sale (POS) product. You will troubleshoot software, hardware, networking, and related technical issues while ensuring customers receive timely and high-quality support.

The role requires strong technical aptitude, excellent English communication skills, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to work effectively within a team. You will support customers across Canada, the Americas, and Europe through available support channels.

The position is based in the Bangalore office and requires flexibility to work in shifts, including India night hours, depending on business requirements.

### **A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**

  

* Provide technical support to customers using the Infor POS product through available support channels, including customer cases and live support interactions.
* Pick up and manage customer cases from the Product Support queue based on priority and Service Level Agreement (SLA) timelines.
* Take ownership of cases from initial response through resolution, following established support processes and procedures.
* Troubleshoot POS-related software, hardware, operating system, and networking issues and escalate cases internally when additional technical expertise is required.
* Maintain clear and timely communication with customers throughout the case lifecycle, including regular case updates and resolution information.
* Deliver a positive customer experience through effective written and verbal communication.
* Attend daily team huddles and other required meetings.
* Continuously develop knowledge of the Infor POS product by participating in product releases, webinars, internal training, and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Work toward meeting or exceeding defined individual and team KPI goals.
* Collaborate with team members and technical support resources to resolve complex customer issues efficiently.

* Strong PC troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities.
