title: Senior Assigned Support Engineer-(Designated / Premier Support)
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

* *Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.*

**An overview of this role**
----------------------------

As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be a trusted technical advisor to GitLab’s largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, helping them avoid operational disruption and get the most from GitLab. You’ll combine deep Linux systems expertise, GitLab and CI/CD knowledge, and a proactive support mindset to understand each customer’s environment, anticipate and prevent issues, and solve complex technical and business challenges. In a typical week, you might be prioritizing strategic blockers with customer stakeholders, partnering with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales to drive defect resolution and influence the roadmap, or diving into code, logs, and tools like strace to troubleshoot performance issues. Your impact in the first year will be measured by customer trust, reduced critical incidents, and clear, reusable support content that empowers customers and GitLab teams alike.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Provide technical support to our largest Self-managed, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab.com customers, ensuring their GitLab environments remain stable and performant.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex, critical, and sensitive support issues using tools like Zendesk, logs, and Linux utilities such as strace, through email and video conferencing.
* Build strong, proactive relationships with key customer stakeholders, helping them prioritize and address their most important technical blockers.
* Collaborate with Product, Development, Infrastructure, Customer Success, and Sales teams to drive bug fixes, influence feature development, and help shape product goals and roadmap.
* Act as a technical expert on GitLab and CI/CD implementations, advising customers on how incidents and service interruptions impact their workflows and how to mitigate them.
* Create and improve support content, including documentation and knowledge articles, to help customers and GitLab team members resolve issues more efficiently.
* Partner closely with Support Engineering team members through pairing sessions and stable counterpart relationships to share knowledge and solve problems together.
* Contribute to team growth by participating in hiring processes, including reviewing applications and assessments and joining interviews.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

* Background managing complex, customer facing support cases end to end, from initial inquiry and triage through reproduction, escalation, and resolution.
* Advanced troubleshooting skills with the ability to investigate ambiguous, multi-layered technical issues and identify root causes across applications, infrastructure, and integrations.
* Strong Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent), including performance analysis and low-level debugging tools.
* Practical experience with GitLab and continuous integration / continuous delivery (CI/CD), including how different deployment models and outages affect customers.
* Ability to write and maintain clear, reusable support content such as knowledge articles, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Proficiency with scripting languages (such as Ruby or Bash) and familiarity with model-view-controller (MVC) frameworks, preferably Ruby on Rails.
* Effective communication skills for explaining complex technical topics to audiences with varying technical backgrounds and for building rapport with customer stakeholders.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and technologies such as Kubernetes and serverless platforms, with openness to applying transferable skills from related domains.

**About the team**
------------------

The Support team is a fully distributed, global group across the AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions, focused on helping customers get the most from GitLab by troubleshooting complex issues and digging into code and logs to understand why something is not working as expected. As an Assigned Support Engineer, you’ll be part of our broader Support Engineering organization, working closely with other Support Engineers through regular pairing sessions, 1:1s, coffee chats, and Slack conversations to stay connected while collaborating asynchronously across time zones. We balance autonomy with accountability, giving you flexibility to structure your shift in a way that fits your life while ensuring we can reliably address customer issues. Thanks to GitLab’s Transparency value, you can see what we are working on in our Support Team page. Additionally, you can see our company roadmap and meetings to see what we are working on at any time.

#### **How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

**Country Hiring Guidelines:** GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

**Privacy Policy:** Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Position: HR Generalist

Experience: 2–3 years

Department: Human Resources

Location: Chennai

Employment type: Full-time

Role Overview

iBytes Bits and Bots Private Limited is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented HR Generalist to join its Human Resources team in Chennai. The successful candidate will manage the full employee life cycle – from talent acquisition and onboarding to employee relations, HR operations and statutory compliance – and will serve as a trusted point of contact for employees and managers across the organisation. This role offers broad exposure to all areas of HR and a clear pathway to a senior HR or HR Business Partner position.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition

• Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for assigned positions, including drafting job descriptions, sourcing, screening and coordinating interviews.

• Collaborate with hiring managers to understand workforce requirements and close positions within agreed timelines.

• Maintain the applicant tracking system and recruitment trackers and report on key hiring metrics such as time-to-hire and source effectiveness.

Onboarding and Employee Life Cycle

• Deliver a seamless onboarding and induction experience, including offer letters, joining documentation and background verification.

• Administer employee life-cycle changes, including probation confirmations, transfers, promotions and separations.

• Conduct exit interviews, analyse feedback and manage full and final settlement documentation.

HR Operations and Payroll Support

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in the HRMS and personnel files.

• Oversee attendance and leave management and provide accurate monthly inputs for payroll processing.

• Prepare HR letters, MIS reports and dashboards covering headcount, attrition and leave trends.

Employee Engagement and Relations

• Serve as the first point of contact for employee queries on HR policies, benefits and processes.

• Support the fair and timely resolution of employee grievances and disciplinary matters in line with company policy.

• Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, pulse surveys and recognition programmes.

Performance, Learning and Compliance

• Coordinate the annual performance management cycle, supporting goal setting, appraisals and calibration.

• Identify training needs and organise learning and development programmes with internal and external facilitators.

• Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements and contribute to the periodic review of HR policies.

Qualifications and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a related field is preferred.

• Sound working knowledge of recruitment, onboarding, HR operations and employee relations.

• Good understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• High standards of integrity, confidentiality and professional discretion.

• Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.

• A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a commitment to continuous learning.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in a fast-paced start-up or mid-sized organisation.

• Exposure to payroll processing or compensation and benefits administration.

• A professional HR certification such as SHRM-CP, CIPD or equivalent.

TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Think of yourself as the one that will take the lead in identifying and attracting the best IT, Data Science/Analytics, and Digital talents to TaskUs. You will be doing end-to-end talent delivery - from sourcing, interviewing, onboarding, and new-hire aftercare. You will act as a business partner and SME, delivering top-notch candidates in a time-sensitive manner.

title: Infra Intermediate Technical Analyst
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

Do you enjoy supporting technology operations on a global level? Are you willing to partner with multiple teams across various functions to deliver premier services? At the Production Support Command Centre Infrastructure Operations team, we operate multiple services and technologies and are currently seeking a talented person to support our operations within Network & Distributed technology. As the “Senior Technical Analyst” you will play a key role in supporting the Service Monitoring, Level 1 and Level 2 Infrastructure Support and Change Implementation. This is all done from our state-of-the-art regional Command Centre in partnership with the Shift Managers, Regional leads, Staff Managers and the analysts in Network/Distributed Team in cooperation with our other Operations centers located in North and South America, Europe and Asia. This role will have a direct reporting line into “Regional Lead” to promote collaboration and consistency. This job description provides a high-level review of the types of work performed. Other job-related duties may be assigned as required.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

In this individual contributor role, you will be responsible for handling the incidents and changes in network and distributed environment to ensure that operational aspects of the service delivery are being completed on time.

* Support the Shift Lead/Manager/Staff manager/Regional lead by executing the processes in network and distributed platforms inline to the KB procedure.

* Engage higher level support, Platform leads, upper management, and other stakeholders when required.

* Provide inputs to operations, projects and other areas and contribute to achieving the franchise goals.

* Partner with multiple management teams to ensure appropriate integration of functions to meet goals as well as identify and define necessary system enhancements to support process improvements.

* Provide Tier I and T II Technical Support for Citi’s global technology infrastructure.

* Resolve simple, automated and scripted incidents

* Execute/Coordinate or implement simple, automated and scripted changes for infrastructure requests.

* Provide timely response to phone calls into the Command Centre Technical Support hotline from internal colleagues within CTI, Citi business clients, vendors, and technology teams.

* Problem solving, methodical with analytical skills. High energy with ability to adjust changes.

* Good level of knowledge in network and distributed technologies.

* Able to communicate technical terminology at the appropriate level to the audience

* Good organizational and coordinating skills, able to set priorities

* High-reaching and with dedication towards continual growth and self-improvement

* Good time management skills with high sense of urgency and dedication

* Clear personal work ethic that inspires quality and enthusiasm

* Resilient and highly responsive in overcoming adversity

* Ability to work through a multitude of challenges/obstacles to achieve the desired result

* Ability and willingness to operate within tightly controlled operational procedures

**Experience & educational preferences:**

* Technical Operations/Support experience of **6+ years is required**.

* Network technical knowledge at **CCNA level is required with Enterprise Switching and Routing Troubleshooting expertise.**

* Distributed knowledge related to servers is required. Understanding of a multilayer environment is helpful.

title: Enterprise Product - Engineer
description:
**Req ID:** 396555
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Enterprise Product - Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Description:**  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our Enterprise Product team focused on Product Data Master (PDM), Product Information Management (PIM), Product Catalog, and Product Configuration systems.
  
  
This role will design, develop, and operate scalable enterprise solutions that serve as the foundation for product data across ERP, PLM, CPQ, eCommerce, DAM, and other enterprise platforms. You will partner with product managers, architects, and global engineering teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable solutions that enable business growth and operational excellence.
  
  
What You'll Do
  

* Design, develop, and operate scalable Product Data Master (PDM), PIM, Product Catalog, and Product Configuration platforms on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Build and support integrations between Product Data Master and enterprise platforms including ERP, PLM, CPQ, DAM, CMS, eCommerce, and distributor systems.
* Develop microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven workflows that process and distribute product data across multiple platforms.
* Own software delivery end-to-end, including infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes deployments, monitoring, and operational support.
* Write automated tests as part of shipping, not as a follow-up.
* Build observable systems using logging, metrics, tracing, and telemetry.
* Build data-driven capabilities that improve product intelligence, catalog completeness, and operational efficiency.
* Review peer code, mentor engineers, and contribute to engineering best practices.
* Partner with product managers, architects, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.

What We're Looking For
  

* 8+ years of experience building and operating enterprise software products in production environments.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, SOLID principles, design patterns, and distributed system architecture.
* Deep fluency in at least one modern backend language and the ability to learn another quickly. We build primarily in C#/.NET, so that is ideal. Strong Java, Go, or Kotlin engineers who are willing to work in C# are equally welcome.
* Experience building microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven architecture.
* Hands-on production experience with Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD, and cloud-native operations.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using APIs and modern integration patterns.
* Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, data modeling, and scalable data platforms.
* Comfort owning infrastructure, deployment pipelines, and operational support responsibilities.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills.
* Genuine interest in the engineering domain. Curiosity about how products are designed, revised, and released matters more here than it does on most teams.
* Clear writing. Design notes and runbooks are part of the job.
* Authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

Nice to Have
  

* Experience with Product Data Management (PDM), Product Information Management (PIM), Product Catalog, Pricing, CPQ, DAM, or MDM platforms.
* Experience building product master data platforms, including taxonomy, classification, attributes, and product relationships.
* Experience integrating ERP, PLM, PIM, CPQ, DAM, CMS, and eCommerce platforms.
* Experience with Elasticsearch, Databricks, Graph databases, and analytics platforms.
* Experience applying AI/Generative AI to catalog intelligence, metadata enrichment, classification, or attribute generation.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies and globally distributed teams.
* Experience with observability and reporting tools such as Grafana and Power BI.

On AI-Assisted Development
  
  
We expect our engineers to use AI tooling and get real leverage from it across implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. The order matters: strong fundamentals first, AI as an accelerant second.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. • Exposure to international maritime recruitment across tankers, bulk carriers, offshore, and specialist

vessels

9001:2015, MLC 2006 compliant

• Growth opportunity within crewing operations and business development and to work with global

clients across Europe, Middle East, Asia etc.

**Project Description**

You’ll partner directly with hiring managers, recruitment leads, and HR to map out talent pools, run targeted outreach, and handle preliminary checks—from work visas in the US to notice periods in India. title: Technical Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a
**Technical Recruiter**
who can source, screen, and qualify candidates for niche engineering roles across
**automotive, aerospace, embedded systems, EV, manufacturing, mechanical design, validation, digital transformation and product engineering**
.

The recruiter must be able to understand engineering requirements, break down technical JDs, create strong search strategies, identify the right target companies, and screen candidates beyond keyword matching.

Key Responsibilities

1. Requirement Understanding

* Understand technical requirements from hiring managers or client teams.
* Break down JDs into
  **must-have**
  ,
  **good-to-have**
  , and
  **deal-breaker**
  criteria.
* Identify whether the role is related to development, design, validation, testing, integration, manufacturing, or support.
* Ask the right clarification questions before starting the search.
* Build a clear sourcing plan for every role.

2. Candidate Sourcing

* Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, internal databases, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Create Boolean search strings for niche engineering roles.
* Identify relevant target companies for each role.
* Search for candidates across automotive OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, ER&D service companies, aerospace companies, manufacturing companies, and engineering consulting firms.
* Build talent pipelines for recurring niche engineering roles.

3. Technical Screening

* Conduct first-level screening calls with candidates.
* Validate candidate experience beyond resume keywords.
* Ask project-specific questions to understand actual hands-on exposure.
* Check domain relevance, tools used, project ownership, notice period, salary fit, location preference, and motivation.
* Identify red flags before submission.

4. Candidate Submission & Coordination

* Prepare high-quality candidate submission notes.
* Clearly explain why a candidate fits the requirement.
* Maintain accurate trackers with candidate status and next steps.
* Coordinate interviews and follow-ups with candidates and internal teams.
* Collect feedback and improve future searches based on rejection reasons.

5. Market Mapping

* Build target company lists for automotive, aerospace, embedded, EV, and engineering roles.
* Track where relevant talent is available.
* Share market feedback on salary, notice period, availability, and skill scarcity.
* Help improve search strategy for difficult or low-supply roles.

· Synthesize model outputs into decision-ready materials that clearly outline key findings, trade-offs, risks, and actions for leadership review

**System, Process, and Quality Ownership**

· Use automation and AI-enabled tools to reduce manual work and improve reporting efficiency

· Identify opportunities to streamline recurring analytical and operational workflows

· Apply AI appropriately in areas such as documentation, issue triage, process mapping, and insight summarization

· Help improve how analytics and reporting work is produced, maintained, and scaled

**Your Role On The Team**

· Serve as a self-directed analytical partner who can move work forward independently while staying aligned with U.S.-based stakeholders and leadership priorities

· Take ownership of complex workforce, reporting, and modeling questions from intake through analysis, resolution, and communication of outcomes

· Bring leadership practical solution options, trade-offs, and recommendations while identifying more scalable ways for the team to approach recurring work

· Escalate thoughtfully when needed by clearly summarizing what was requested, what was tried, what was learned, what remains blocked, and what decision or support is needed

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING:**

**Required**

· Bachelor’s degree in analytics, business, finance, economics, information systems, HR, operations, or a related field

· 3+ years of experience in workforce analytics, business analytics, operational analytics, financial modeling, or a related field

· Experience building repeatable models for headcount planning, utilization, capacity, labor cost, and workforce forecasting

· Advanced Excel and Power BI skills, including model building, scenario analysis, data modeling, dashboard development, and data validation

· Strong understanding of workforce and HR metrics, including headcount, labor cost, turnover, hiring, utilization, capacity, and productivity

· Ability to work with business stakeholders to understand needs, translate requirements into models and reports, and generate actionable insights and recommendations

· Experience improving reporting and analytical workflows through automation, AI-enabled tools, process design, and documentation

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing accurate, reliable, and high-quality analytical outputs, reporting, documentation, and stakeholder-ready materials

· Strong business writing, presentation, communication, and organizational skills

· Proven ability to think critically, solve ambiguous problems independently, identify root causes, test solutions, evaluate trade-offs, and determine when escalation is needed

· Ability to translate complex analysis into clear, actionable, leadership-ready recommendations, including options, trade-offs, risks, and implications

· Strong intellectual curiosity and resourcefulness; proactively seeks answers through analysis, documentation, systems, and cross-functional context

· Expert-level English fluency and availability to work during U.S. business hours across mainland U.S. time zones

**Preferred**

· Master’s degree in analytics, business, finance, human resources, operations, data science, or a related field

· Relevant certifications in analytics, business intelligence, data visualization, process improvement, or project management

· Experience in professional services, consulting, managed services, staffing, or another labor-driven business model

· Experience using AI tools to improve reporting, workflow efficiency, or analytical processes

· Demonstrated success working with remote or internationally distributed teams supporting

U.S.-based stakeholders, with high ownership, strong independent judgment, and proactive problem solving

title: Assistant Manager - HR Operations
description:

Rupeek, established in 2015 and headquartered in Bangalore, stands as India's leading asset-backed digital lending fintech platform. Committed to making credit accessible to Indians in a fair and convenient manner, Rupeek pioneers innovative financial products focused on monetizing India's $2 trillion gold market. With a customer base exceeding 5,00,000+, the company's strategic partnerships with top banks and financial institutions underscore its commitment to building gold-backed assets through low-risk, low-touch, and friction-free processes.

Join us in redefining the future of finance through innovation, technology, and a commitment to financial inclusivity.

**Role Overview:**

AM– HR Operations will be responsible for ensuring seamless execution of key HR operations processes, including Payroll & Compliance, Onboarding, Background Verification (BGV), and HR Vendor Management. The role will work closely with HR, finance, legal, and business stakeholders to deliver an efficient employee experience while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and internal policies.

The incumbent will supervise a small HR operations team and drive process excellence through standardization, governance, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Payroll & Compliance**

* Manage end-to-end payroll processing, ensuring accurate and timely salary disbursement.
* Validate payroll inputs, payouts, deductions, reimbursements, and statutory contributions.
* Ensure compliance with PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Gratuity, LWF, Bonus, and other applicable labor laws.
* Support payroll reconciliations, audits, Form 16 issuance, and year-end activities.
* Coordinate with Finance for payroll accounting and statutory reporting.
* Resolve employee payroll queries within agreed timelines.
* Maintain payroll records and ensure audit readiness.

**Onboarding**

* Manage the end-to-end onboarding process for new hires.
* Ensure completion of pre-joining documentation and employee records.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, and Hiring Managers to ensure Day-1 readiness.
* Facilitate induction and onboarding activities.
* Track joining status and maintain onboarding dashboards and reports.
* Support campus and lateral hiring onboarding requirements.

**Background Verification (BGV)**

* Coordinate and track background verification for all new hires.
* Work closely with empanelled vendors to ensure adherence to turnaround timelines.
* Review BGV reports and escalate discrepancies for appropriate action.
* Maintain documentation and records in accordance with company policies.
* Support process improvements and governance related to BGV operations.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with HR operations vendors, including BGV agencies, staffing partners, and payroll service providers.
* Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels.
* Support contract renewals, invoicing, and documentation requirements.
* Resolve operational escalations and coordinate with internal stakeholders.

**Team Supervision & Process Excellence**

* Guide and support HR operations team members in day-to-day activities.
* Ensure adherence to established SOPs and process controls.
* Maintain process documentation and operational trackers.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.
* Support knowledge sharing and capability building within the team.

**Benefits Administration**

* Support administration of employee benefits programs, including health insurance, gratuity, and wellness initiatives.
* Coordinate employee enrollment, claims processing, and vendor interactions.
* Provide operational support during compensation review and benefits renewal cycles.

**Qualifications:**

* Graduate or equivalent qualification.
* Certifications in payroll, labor laws, or HR operations will be an added advantage.
* 5–7 years of experience in HR operations.
* Hands-on experience in payroll processing, statutory compliance, HR Operations.
* Exposure to onboarding, BGV, and vendor management processes.
* Prior experience guiding or mentoring junior team members is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

**Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian payroll processes and statutory compliance.
* Familiarity with labor laws and HR operations best practices.
* Experience with HRMS/payroll platforms such as Darwinbox, Keka, GreytHR, SAP, or similar systems.
* Strong Excel and HR MIS reporting skills.
* Vendor coordination and stakeholder management capabilities.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* High ownership and accountability.
* Strong attention to detail and process orientation.
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work within timelines.
* Collaborative approach and team-oriented mindset.
* Professional integrity and confidentiality in handling employee data.

* Experience with managing learning/ other talent programs/ processes (from design, delivery, execution, communication, logistics, follow through and closure)

* Support periodic audits and compliance checks (data privacy, statutory, and internal controls) related to employee records and HR transactions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams — Payroll, Talent Acquisition, Compensation & Benefits, and IT/HRIS — to ensure seamless upstream and downstream data flow.
* Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and rollout activities during SuccessFactors enhancements, releases, or migration projects.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation within HR operations workflows, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.Required Skills & Experience

* Strong, hands-on working knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors is critical — including Employee Central; exposure to Onboarding/Offboarding, Performance & Goals, or Compensation modules is a plus.

* Strong reporting skills — ability to build and interpret HR reports/dashboards; advanced MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, data validation; Power Query/Power BI a plus).

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience supporting global or cross-geography stakeholders.
* Experience contributing to or supporting an HRIS/SuccessFactors implementation or migration project is a strong plus.Preferred / Good to Have
* SuccessFactors certification (Employee Central or related module).
* Exposure to other HRIS/HCM platforms (e.g., ADP Workforce Now, Workday) in addition to SuccessFactors.
* Experience working with SOP development and process standardization in a shared services setup.
* Basic familiarity with data privacy/compliance requirements relevant to HR data (e.g., GDPR or regional equivalents).EducationGraduate/Postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA (HR) is an advantage.What We Offer

Master's Degree

* Experience managing escalations, service delivery metrics, and stakeholder expectations.

* Experience driving process improvements, operational excellence initiatives, and customer experience enhancements.

* Strong customer service and employee-centric mindset.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

title: Dir HR CoE
description:
**We Are Teva**
We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.
  
  
**Our Team, Your Impact**
The Director, Employee Relations & Workplace Investigations, India will lead the employee relations and workplace investigations agenda across Teva’s India operations.
  
  
The role will provide independent, consistent and professional oversight of complex employee relations matters, workplace concerns and investigations. It will also establish a trusted and accessible employee relations framework that enables employees and managers to seek guidance, raise concerns early and resolve workplace issues constructively.
  
  
This position will serve as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted adviser to HR and business leaders, while maintaining appropriate independence, confidentiality, procedural fairness and alignment with Teva’s global standards and applicable Indian employment laws.
  
  
The role will complement, rather than replace, existing Speak Up, OBI, POSH, Legal, Compliance and grievance channels.
  
  
**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
**Workplace Investigations**

* Lead and conduct complex, sensitive and high-risk workplace investigations across India.
* Manage cases involving alleged harassment, bullying, retaliation, discrimination, management conduct, conflicts of interest, misuse of authority, unfair treatment and other potential workplace misconduct.
* Independently assess allegations, define investigation scope, conduct interviews, review documentation and prepare clear, evidence-based findings.
* Ensure investigations are timely, objective, confidential, well documented and conducted in accordance with procedural fairness and applicable legal requirements.
* Handle matters involving senior leaders or situations in which the local HR team may have an actual or perceived conflict of interest.
* Partner with Legal, OBI, Compliance, POSH Internal Committees and Global Security to determine appropriate ownership and investigation protocols.
* Provide clear recommendations regarding corrective, disciplinary, organizational or preventive actions.

**Employee Relations Case Governance**

* Establish and maintain a consistent India-wide ER case-management framework.
* Develop clear protocols for case intake, triage, ownership, escalation, investigation, documentation, closure and follow-up.
* Maintain appropriate case records and ensure compliance with confidentiality and data-privacy requirements.
* Monitor the timeliness, quality and consistency of case handling across sites and business units.
* Establish severity and risk-assessment criteria for complex or high-risk cases.
* Ensure that investigation findings and recommendations are followed through and appropriately documented.
* Identify cases requiring escalation to India or global leadership.

**Open-Door and Early-Resolution Framework**

* Design and implement a visible and trusted open-door employee relations program across India.
* Provide employees with a confidential and accessible route to seek advice or raise concerns before issues escalate.
* Ensure employees understand the available reporting channels and the protections against retaliation.
* Provide consultations to employees and managers regarding workplace concerns, interpersonal conflict and appropriate resolution options.
* Facilitate early resolution, mediation or other informal interventions when appropriate.
* Reinforce that the open-door program complements, and does not restrict, employees’ ability to use anonymous or formal reporting channels.
* Partner with Communications and HR teams to build awareness and confidence in the program.

**Required Skills**
**HR and Manager Capability Building**

* Build employee relations and investigation capability across the India HR organization.
* Develop and deliver training for HR professionals on intake, triage, interviewing, evidence review, documentation and investigation reporting.
* Coach HRBPs and site HR leaders on complex employee relations matters.
* Train managers on respectful workplace expectations, retaliation prevention, grievance handling and early intervention.
* Develop practical ER toolkits, templates, checklists and decision frameworks.
* Create a qualified pool of HR professionals who can support lower-risk workplace reviews under appropriate supervision Risk, Trends and Preventive Action
* Analyze ER data to identify recurring themes, locations, functions or leadership practices requiring intervention.
* Provide periodic, anonymized reporting to India and Global HR leadership.
* Identify systemic issues relating to culture, manager capability, workload, fairness, communication or organizational practices.
* Recommend preventive actions, including leadership coaching, policy changes, team interventions and organizational reviews.
* Track completion and effectiveness of agreed corrective actions.
* Use employee feedback and case trends to strengthen trust, leadership accountability and workplace culture.

**ER Policy and Standards**

* Develop and implement India employee relations policies, standards and investigation protocols aligned with Teva’s global framework.
* Review existing grievance, disciplinary, conduct and escalation practices and identify gaps.
* Establish standards for handling informal concerns, including concerns raised without a formal written complaint.
* Partner with Legal and POSH stakeholders to ensure alignment with applicable Indian legislation and statutory processes.
* Support the development of clear standards concerning confidentiality, documentation, non-retaliation and conflicts of interest.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of employee relations policies across sites and functions.

**Your Qualification And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, Industrial Relations, Business or a related field.
* Advanced degree in Law, Human Resources, Industrial Relations or a related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive HR or employee relations experience.
* Significant experience leading complex workplace investigations in a large, multinational organization.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, disciplinary processes, principles of natural justice and workplace investigation practices.
* Experience handling sensitive matters involving senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound judgments in high-risk situations.
* Experience working with Legal, Compliance, Ethics, Security and senior HR stakeholders.
* Strong interviewing, fact-finding, analysis and report-writing capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* High level of discretion, integrity, cultural awareness and professional courage.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing or other highly regulated industry preferred.

**How We’ll Take Care Of You**
At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging. That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.
  
  
Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.
  
  
Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.
  
  
**Already Working @Teva?**
Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development
  
  
**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years of relevant change management experience
  
  
Locations: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida
  
  
Education: 15 years of full-time education graduate degree or equivalent, MBA/PGDM preferred
  
  
Certification: PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification preferred
  
  
Mobility: May require mobility to client locations across India
  
  
Soft Skills required: Structured thinking, Communication, Storytelling, Collaboration, Adaptability, Ownership, Flexibility

title: OPERATIONS TRAINING LEADER
description:
**Introduction**
The Operations Training Leader will design, establish and govern an enterprise Training and Capability Framework for Business Orchestration Services - India. The role converts client requirements, operating procedures, process changes and performance risks into structured learning journeys across Finance & Accounts, HRTT and R&C, supporting voice, chat, email and back-office operations. The position owns training governance, needs analysis, curriculum design, facilitator capability, certification, production readiness, learning analytics and continuous capability improvement.
  
  
**PRIMARY OUTCOME**
**A scalable, data-led and client-aligned learning system that accelerates speed to proficiency, strengthens control adherence and sustains performance after go-live.**
Operations Training Framework: six accountability pillars
  
  
**Pillar**
**Leadership accountability**
**Expected outputs**

* Learning strategy & governance

Define & institutionalize the operation training framework, operating model, decision rights and review cadences across accounts and sites.
  
  
Framework, RACI, governance calendar, standards catalogue and annual capability plan.
  
  

* Training need analysis & process curriculum architecture

Translate role, process, client and risk requirements into role-based curricula and learning journeys.
  
  
Training needs analysis, competency maps, curriculum blueprints and content standards.
  
  

* Readiness, assessment & certification

Establish measurable proficiency tool gates before employee’s transition to production or expanded scope.
  
  
Assessment strategy, certification criteria, readiness dashboard and remediation paths.
  
  

* Delivery excellence & faculty capability

Standardise facilitation, practice, simulation and trainer accreditation across classroom and virtual delivery.
  
  
Facilitator playbook, train-the-trainer, observation rubric and faculty certification.
  
  

* Performance transfer & learning analytics

Connect training evidence with nesting, quality, productivity and customer outcomes.
  
  
Learning dashboard, proficiency trends, transfer checks and intervention recommendations.
  
  

* Knowledge, change & continuous learning

Embed learning for process updates, policy changes, tools and recurring performance gaps.
  
  
Knowledge-change workflow, refresher cadence, learning campaigns and lessons learned.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Build and deploy the framework
  
  

* Design the end-to-end Operations Training and Capability Framework, including governance, standard methods, decision rights and minimum readiness requirements.
* Convert contracts, client SOPs/DTPs, controls, policies and role expectations into measurable learning objectives, curricula and proficiency standards.
* Create deployment roadmaps for new and existing accounts, covering discovery, content build, trainer readiness, learner certification, nesting and stabilisation.
* Establish document control and version governance for curricula, facilitator guides, learner materials, assessments, simulations and training evidence.

Lead learning design, delivery and certification
  
  

* Govern training needs analysis and instructional design across voice, chat, email and back-office processes, using role-based and risk-based prioritisation.
* Oversee classroom, virtual and blended delivery; ensure sufficient practice, scenario application, systems simulation and knowledge checks.
* Define assessment quality standards, pass criteria, retake rules, exception governance and certification evidence for production readiness.
* Build trainer and subject-matter-expert capability through selection, accreditation, observation, coaching and periodic recertification.

Drive speed to proficiency and performance transfer
  
  

* Integrate training data with nesting, quality, productivity, compliance, complaint and employee-performance signals to identify capability gaps.
* Partner with Operations and Quality to establish structured nesting, floor support and post-training reinforcement until proficiency criteria are met.
* Lead root-cause analysis of learning-related performance gaps using 5 Whys, fishbone, Pareto and learner-data segmentation.
* Govern targeted remediation, refresher learning and knowledge interventions, including owners, due dates, effectiveness checks and sustainment reviews.

Govern measurement and executive reviews
  
  

* Define a balanced learning scorecard and KPI dictionary with calculation logic, data ownership, thresholds and drill-downs by site, account, role and cohort.
* Lead weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews; present readiness, risks, learning effectiveness, interventions and decisions required to delivery and client leadership.
* Distinguish activity measures, learning measures, behaviour transfer and business outcomes rather than relying on attendance or test scores alone.
* Track capability actions to closure and validate that reported improvement is supported by evidence from the operating environment.

Lead people capability and stakeholder alignment
  
  

* Lead, mentor and develop Training Managers, Process Trainers and local learning specialists across locations and accounts.
* Partner with Operations, Quality, Workforce Management, Technology, Risk/Compliance, HR and client teams to embed learning into workforce and change plans.
* Create capacity models for faculty, rooms, virtual delivery, systems access and production-support coverage aligned to hiring and transition demand.
* Act as the learning change leader for new tools, processes, policies and behaviours through communication, adoption tracking and feedback loops.

Success measures
  
  
**Role**
The final KPI set should be tailored by service line, role complexity and client contract. The role is accountable for establishing measures across the following categories:

title: Dir HR CoE
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------

We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**Our Team, Your Impact**
-------------------------

The Director, Employee Relations & Workplace Investigations, India will lead the employee relations and workplace investigations agenda across Teva’s India operations.

The role will provide independent, consistent and professional oversight of complex employee relations matters, workplace concerns and investigations. It will also establish a trusted and accessible employee relations framework that enables employees and managers to seek guidance, raise concerns early and resolve workplace issues constructively.

This position will serve as a senior subject-matter expert and trusted adviser to HR and business leaders, while maintaining appropriate independence, confidentiality, procedural fairness and alignment with Teva’s global standards and applicable Indian employment laws.

The role will complement, rather than replace, existing Speak Up, OBI, POSH, Legal, Compliance and grievance channels.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------

**Workplace Investigations**

* Lead and conduct complex, sensitive and high-risk workplace investigations across India.
* Manage cases involving alleged harassment, bullying, retaliation, discrimination, management conduct, conflicts of interest, misuse of authority, unfair treatment and other potential workplace misconduct.
* Independently assess allegations, define investigation scope, conduct interviews, review documentation and prepare clear, evidence-based findings.
* Ensure investigations are timely, objective, confidential, well documented and conducted in accordance with procedural fairness and applicable legal requirements.
* Handle matters involving senior leaders or situations in which the local HR team may have an actual or perceived conflict of interest.
* Partner with Legal, OBI, Compliance, POSH Internal Committees and Global Security to determine appropriate ownership and investigation protocols.
* Provide clear recommendations regarding corrective, disciplinary, organizational or preventive actions.

**Employee Relations Case Governance**

* Establish and maintain a consistent India-wide ER case-management framework.
* Develop clear protocols for case intake, triage, ownership, escalation, investigation, documentation, closure and follow-up.
* Maintain appropriate case records and ensure compliance with confidentiality and data-privacy requirements.
* Monitor the timeliness, quality and consistency of case handling across sites and business units.
* Establish severity and risk-assessment criteria for complex or high-risk cases.
* Ensure that investigation findings and recommendations are followed through and appropriately documented.
* Identify cases requiring escalation to India or global leadership.

**Open-Door and Early-Resolution Framework**

* Design and implement a visible and trusted open-door employee relations program across India.
* Provide employees with a confidential and accessible route to seek advice or raise concerns before issues escalate.
* Ensure employees understand the available reporting channels and the protections against retaliation.
* Provide consultations to employees and managers regarding workplace concerns, interpersonal conflict and appropriate resolution options.
* Facilitate early resolution, mediation or other informal interventions when appropriate.
* Reinforce that the open-door program complements, and does not restrict, employees’ ability to use anonymous or formal reporting channels.
* Partner with Communications and HR teams to build awareness and confidence in the program.

**Required Skills**
-------------------

**HR and Manager Capability Building**

* Build employee relations and investigation capability across the India HR organization.
* Develop and deliver training for HR professionals on intake, triage, interviewing, evidence review, documentation and investigation reporting.
* Coach HRBPs and site HR leaders on complex employee relations matters.
* Train managers on respectful workplace expectations, retaliation prevention, grievance handling and early intervention.
* Develop practical ER toolkits, templates, checklists and decision frameworks.
* Create a qualified pool of HR professionals who can support lower-risk workplace reviews under appropriate supervision **Risk, Trends and Preventive Action**

* Analyze ER data to identify recurring themes, locations, functions or leadership practices requiring intervention.
* Provide periodic, anonymized reporting to India and Global HR leadership.
* Identify systemic issues relating to culture, manager capability, workload, fairness, communication or organizational practices.
* Recommend preventive actions, including leadership coaching, policy changes, team interventions and organizational reviews.
* Track completion and effectiveness of agreed corrective actions.
* Use employee feedback and case trends to strengthen trust, leadership accountability and workplace culture.

**ER Policy and Standards**

* Develop and implement India employee relations policies, standards and investigation protocols aligned with Teva’s global framework.
* Review existing grievance, disciplinary, conduct and escalation practices and identify gaps.
* Establish standards for handling informal concerns, including concerns raised without a formal written complaint.
* Partner with Legal and POSH stakeholders to ensure alignment with applicable Indian legislation and statutory processes.
* Support the development of clear standards concerning confidentiality, documentation, non-retaliation and conflicts of interest.
* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of employee relations policies across sites and functions.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Law, Industrial Relations, Business or a related field.
* Advanced degree in Law, Human Resources, Industrial Relations or a related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 15 or more years of progressive HR or employee relations experience.
* Significant experience leading complex workplace investigations in a large, multinational organization.
* Strong knowledge of Indian employment law, disciplinary processes, principles of natural justice and workplace investigation practices.
* Experience handling sensitive matters involving senior leaders.
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently and make sound judgments in high-risk situations.
* Experience working with Legal, Compliance, Ethics, Security and senior HR stakeholders.
* Strong interviewing, fact-finding, analysis and report-writing capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* High level of discretion, integrity, cultural awareness and professional courage.
* Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, manufacturing or other highly regulated industry preferred.

**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging. That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.

Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Already Working @Teva?**
--------------------------

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist—your one-stop shop for career development

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: Manager Culture
description:
**InMobi (Corporate)**

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

**InMobi Advertising**

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

**Glance**

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

**Manager Culture & Organizational Transformation**
---------------------------------------------------

### **About InMobi**

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. We've built a way of working. Across 16 offices globally, we are builders, dreamers, doers—fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, human enough to care deeply. Culture is at the core—embedded in how we work, how we decide, how we show up for each other.

### **About the Role**

This is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of organizational behavior, psychology, people experience design, and transformation. You'll diagnose how the organization actually functions, design the rituals and experiences that shape culture, and lead a team executing both strategy and craft.

This is not program management. This is strategic thinking and deep organizational diagnosis.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Culture Strategy & Organizational Diagnostics (30%)**

* Map organizational behavior patterns: where decisions get made, who has real influence, what behaviors get rewarded, where informal systems create flow or friction
* Identify gaps between espoused culture and lived culture
* Design culture strategy grounded in organizational behavior and psychology—translate aspirations into operating systems that actually shift behavior
* Challenge assumptions; test strategy against organizational reality
* Connect culture impact to business outcomes

**People Experience Design & Large-Scale Rituals (30%)**

* Design company rituals, events, and ceremonies that embody culture—not as engagement tactics, but as intentional experiences that build belonging and shift how people see themselves
* Lead ritual design at scale across the organization
* Design the touchpoints and infrastructure through which people experience culture daily
* Execute major company experiences with both strategic intent and craft

**Internal Communications & Narrative (15%)**

* Develop and lead internal communications strategy that brings culture and organizational transformation to life across the company
* Craft compelling narratives that help people understand why culture matters and how it connects to their work
* Design multi-channel communication campaigns that reinforce culture initiatives and shift organizational thinking
* Ensure consistent, authentic communication across leadership and all levels of the organization

**Team Leadership (15%)**

* Lead and develop a culture team that combines strategic thinking with execution
* Hire for mindset: systems thinking, psychological curiosity, rigor
* Build organizational development capability within the team

**Executive Influence & Partnership (10%)**

* Coach leadership on culture leadership and their role in shaping organizational behavior
* Partner with business leaders on org design and transformation
* Bring culture perspective into business strategy discussions

### **What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 8+ years in culture, organizational development, organizational psychology, or org design (not HR/people operations)
* Track record of shaping organizations through strategic partnership and influence, not just program execution
* Experience designing human experiences at scale—rituals, events, organizational ceremonies
* Evidence of helping organizations shift actual behaviors and patterns, not just improve sentiment
* Experience leading internal communications and narrative design around organizational change or culture initiatives

**Mindset & Capabilities**

* **Systems thinker with behavioral lens.** You see organizations as interconnected systems. You understand how structure shapes behavior, how incentives drive culture, how informal networks operate
* **Expert at behavioral diagnosis.** You can map organizational patterns—where decisions happen, who has influence, what gets rewarded. You understand the gap between stated and lived culture
* **Grounded in organizational behavior and psychology.** You read and apply organizational behavior science, change psychology, and org development frameworks. You're informed by research, not trends
* **Strong internal communications capability.** You can craft compelling narratives that help people understand complexity. You know how to design messages and campaigns that actually shift thinking and behavior across large organizations
* **Willingness to challenge.** You push back with evidence. You're comfortable saying I think we should reconsider to a peer. You're not a yes person
* **Equal parts strategist and craftsperson.** You can design org systems and design rituals that move people. You don't divorce strategy from lived experience
* **Comfort with complexity.** Culture work is messy. You model learning, not certainty

**Communication**

* Excellent at translating complex organizational concepts for different audiences
* Strong stakeholder influence—people listen because you've done the work
* Comfortable in difficult conversations and organizational discomfort

### **Why Join Us**

This isn't a traditional culture role. You won't plan happy hours. You'll be a strategic peer working on one of the most fascinating challenges: how to scale an organization while preserving what makes it distinct. You'll apply organizational science to real business problems. You'll lead a team. You'll influence executives. You'll shape how 1000+ people across 16 offices experience work.

We value deep thinking, evidence-based perspectives, and the willingness to challenge. You'll find that here

**The InMobi Culture**

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

InMobi is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace.

Visit https://www.inmobi.com/company/careers to better understand our benefits, values, and more!

As a Compassionate Care Case Manager, you will help employees and their loved ones navigate the processes, paperwork, and challenges involved with a loss or illness. Our Compassionate Care Case Manager are skilled in answering challenging questions, understanding complex employee and family situations, communicating available benefits for each specific case, assisting in navigating internal departments and external vendors, and responding to changing circumstances and needs to pave the way for a connected and trusted case management experience.  
  
High-level judgment is crucial in the time-critical nature of this role. Compassionate Care Case Manager must be highly attuned to how people are responding and focus on the details of each individual case. They must step back from these cases to see emerging patterns and adjust processes and support mechanisms as needed. Active listening, empathy, and problem solving are a must.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as an empathetic point of contact and provide holistic case management services to employees and their families in times of death, critical illness, crisis, and other times of need  
Leverage best practice tools and Amazon and vendor resources to understand all options available  
Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to the timing of changing needs  
Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers for an employee  
Respond to issues that may arise and ensure the right communication occurs with accurate details at the right time  
Identify and solve problems, sometimes with limited information  
Communicate regular updates to employees, vendors, and stakeholders both verbally and in writing  
Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state/country regulations, and company policies  
Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation  
Consult, coordinate, and partner with our HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members, and other departments/systems as appropriate

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of professional or military experience, or Bachelor's degree
* 2+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience using computers and Microsoft Office tools such as Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in counseling or mentoring others, preferably in HR, Healthcare, or Crisis Management
* Experience with global service and employee delivery
* Strong problem solving, time management, and priority-setting skills
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 5+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience working with speech and text language data in multiple languages
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
