title: Junior Manager - Global Benefits Administration
description:
**Job Description :**

**About us:**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.

Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

**About the Function:**

Human Resources is about shaping the experience of working at Diageo and helping our people learn and grow everyday.

From attracting talent to developing careers, this team plays a central role in building a culture where people feel supported, challenged and able to grow. They work closely with teams across the business, bringing insight, care and commercial understanding to everything they do.

You’ll help create an environment where different perspectives are valued and where people can learn new skills and thrive, unlocking potential across a truly global organisation.

**About the team:**

**About the role:** Yes — then the role should be positioned as **Global Benefits Operations**, not Europe-focused. I would change the scope throughout the JD to explicitly cover **EMEA, North America, APAC and Africa**.

### **Revised Purpose of Role**

The **Junior Manager – Global Benefits Operations** will be responsible for the effective delivery, governance and continuous improvement of employee benefits administration across **EMEA, North America (NAM), APAC and Africa**.

The role will manage critical benefits operations including **benefits enrolment, annual enrolment, vendor management, Purchase Order creation and management, invoice validation and reconciliation, benefits reporting, employee query management and operational controls**.

Working closely with Global Reward, Payroll, HR, Finance, Procurement and external benefit providers, the role will ensure employees are enrolled accurately and on time, vendors deliver against agreed service levels, and benefit-related financial transactions are appropriately controlled and reconciled.

A key objective will be to **standardise and simplify benefits processes across regions**, while recognising market-specific regulatory, vendor and operational requirements.

### **Core Accountabilities**

* **Benefits Enrolment:** Manage and govern employee benefits enrolment across **EMEA, NAM, APAC and Africa**, including new joiners, life events, benefit changes and leavers.
* **Annual Enrolment:** Coordinate end-to-end annual enrolment activities across applicable markets, including planning, vendor readiness, employee data validation, communications, enrolment monitoring, issue resolution and post-enrolment reconciliation.
* **Vendor Management:** Manage operational relationships with global and local benefit providers, including **SLA/KPI monitoring, issue resolution, service reviews, escalations and continuous improvement**.
* **PO Management:** Coordinate **Purchase Order creation, amendments, extensions and funding requirements** for benefit vendors, ensuring appropriate financial governance and timely availability of POs.
* **Invoice Management & Reconciliation:** Validate vendor invoices against **employee eligibility, enrolment records, contractual rates and POs**, resolve discrepancies and ensure timely payment.
* **Financial Controls & Governance:** Perform required **CARM controls, reconciliations and governance activities**, ensuring appropriate evidence and timely resolution of exceptions.
* **Data & Reporting:** Reconcile benefit data across **Workday, payroll, vendor platforms and financial records**, and deliver accurate operational and management reporting.
* **Employee Experience:** Ensure benefits queries are resolved accurately and within SLA and that employees receive clear communications relating to eligibility, enrolment and benefit changes.
* **Process Governance:** Maintain and regularly update **Work Instructions, process maps, Benefits Matrices, Benefit Guides, Factsheets and FAQs** across markets.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Identify opportunities to **simplify, standardise and automate** benefits administration and reduce manual intervention, errors and employee queries.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Partner effectively with **Reward, Payroll, HR, Finance, Procurement and external vendors** across multiple regions, markets and time zones.

### **Experience Required**

I would make the essential experience more specific:

**Strong hands-on experience in Benefits Operations**, preferably supporting multiple countries or regions, with demonstrated experience in **benefits enrolment and annual enrolment, vendor management, Purchase Order management, invoice** **validation/reconciliation** **and employee benefits administration**.

Candidates should also demonstrate experience working across **multiple regions/time zones**, ideally including exposure to **EMEA, NAM, APAC and/or Africa**, and be comfortable managing both global vendors and market-specific providers.

Strong experience with **Workday, Excel, benefits data reconciliation, operational controls, reporting and process documentation** should be preferred. The role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical capability, attention to detail and the ability to independently drive operational issues through to closure.

**Role Responsibilities:**

title: Compensation Senior Specialist Advisor
description:
**Req ID:** 391674
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Compensation Senior Specialist Advisor to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Role Purpose
  

* Work closely with People Culture, Total Rewards colleagues, and business stakeholders to support the full Total Rewards lifecycle across a complex organization, supporting sustainable growth through competitive, compliant, inclusive, and scalable reward solutions.
* Guide and support Total Rewards activity for an assigned portfolio within NTT DATA Inc., including implementation and governance of the company pay philosophy, reward policies, pay programs, and related decision frameworks.
* Manage Performance Development for the assigned portfolio, partnering with People Culture and business leaders to enable goal setting, quality conversations, evidence-based feedback, and effective year-end outcomes that support a great employee experience.

Key Responsibilities
  
  
Compensation Strategy Programs
  

* Support the planning, governance, and execution of compensation processes, including:
* annual compensation review cycles and salary planning
* bonus calculations and short-term and long-term incentive programs
* variable bonus program changes
* benchmarking, market pricing, and salary survey participation
* job evaluation, job architecture, and grading
* salary structures, salary increase budgets, and salary structure movement recommendations
* pay governance, compensation policies, and remuneration program documentation
* Support the evolution of an aligned compensation framework that enables consistency, transparency, competitiveness, and scalability across the organization.
* Ensure compensation programs align with the company reward philosophy, business strategy, workforce planning priorities, attraction and retention needs, and financial objectives.
* Monitor salary structures and recommend actions that balance cost control, affordability, internal equity, market competitiveness, and employee attraction and retention.
* Partner within the broader Total Rewards CoE to design, build, test, validate, and continuously improve pay ranges and salary structures, using market data, internal equity, affordability, and employee experience considerations.
* Analyze remuneration data, trends, cost implications, and cost-containment opportunities to inform business decisions and reward program design.
* Drive continuous enhancement of compensation structures, methodologies, and processes to improve effectiveness and employee experience.

Recognition Strategy Employee Value Proposition
  

* Partner in the development and implementation of global recognition programs that reinforce company values, high-performance culture, and employee engagement.
* Ensure recognition initiatives are scalable, inclusive, and aligned with organizational culture and talent priorities.
* Evaluate recognition program effectiveness using participation, engagement, and impact metrics.

Business Partnership Stakeholder Management
  

* Model NTT DATA values in how work is delivered: actively seek and respect diverse perspectives, create space for constructive challenge, and ensure stakeholders feel heard and included in reward decisions.
* Collaborate across the Total Rewards CoE and broader People Culture organization, sharing expertise, solving problems collectively, and prioritizing enterprise outcomes over functional or individual ownership.
* Think big and be bold by challenging established approaches, using data and insight to test new ideas, and translating innovative reward concepts into practical, scalable solutions.
* Partner closely with the broader Total Rewards CoE and People Culture Business Partners to deliver solutions that balance enterprise consistency with market and business needs.
* Consult with and advise People Culture teams and business leaders on reward and remuneration policy interpretation, new hire offers, promotions, salary adjustments, market analysis, job evaluation, and other reward initiatives.
* Support Performance Development for the assigned portfolio, including process planning, stakeholder enablement, adoption tracking, quality conversations, evidence-based feedback, and leader guidance.
* Review proposed salary adjustments for conformance with established guidelines and recommend corrective or alternative actions to resolve compensation-related issues.
* Build strong, collaborative relationships with Finance, IT, Legal, Payroll, People Culture, Total Rewards colleagues, and business stakeholders to ensure effective delivery and governance of reward programs.
* Act as a trusted advisor to leaders on compensation-related matters including pay decisions, incentive design, job evaluations, market competitiveness, and remuneration governance.

Job Evaluation, Benchmarking Analytics
  

* When required, conduct job evaluation and salary benchmarking in partnership with Total Rewards colleagues and internal stakeholders to support internal equity and external competitiveness.
* Interpret compensation surveys to understand the company competitive position across relevant labor markets.
* Extract and validate data required to compile weekly, monthly, and annual reporting, including remuneration analysis, cost modelling, and supporting documentation.
* Prepare clear insights, recommendations, and documentation to support reward decisions, governance forums, audit requirements, and stakeholder communications.

Governance, Compliance Operational Excellence
  

* Ensure reward programs comply with applicable legislation, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards.
* Maintain robust governance frameworks, controls, documentation, and audit trails across reward processes.
* Support efforts to improve operational efficiency, automation, and process simplification across compensation and recognition activities.
* Collaborate with HR technology teams to optimize reward tools, systems, reporting, and data integrity.
* Administer or support reward and remuneration programs as required.

Transformation Change
  

* Support organizational transformation initiatives, including MA integration, organizational redesign, and harmonization of legacy reward programs.
* Lead or contribute to enterprise reward projects focused on modernization, digital enablement, process standardization, and scalable policy implementation.
* Develop communication materials, training, and change management plans to support successful adoption of reward initiatives.

Qualifications Experience
  

* 8-10+ years of progressive experience in compensation, remuneration, and Total Rewards within complex, multinational organizations.
* Strong expertise in compensation strategy, salary structures, incentive design, variable pay, benchmarking, job evaluation, job architecture, grading, and pay governance.
* Demonstrated experience executing annual compensation review cycles, bonus calculations, salary planning, and complex reward projects.
* Experience supporting Performance Development processes, including goal setting, manager enablement, evidence-based feedback, and year-end conversations.
* Strong analytical capability with experience interpreting market data, remuneration trends, compensation analytics, cost impacts, and salary survey outputs.
* Knowledge of compensation and benefits regulations, pay transparency trends, pay equity practices, audit requirements, and compliance processes across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience supporting employee recognition programs within a complex organizational environment.
* Experience working in transformation, integration, or high-growth environments is highly desirable.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex reward concepts into practical business insights and clear recommendations.
* Experience with HRIS and compensation management tools (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, or similar platforms).
* Bachelor degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or related discipline preferred.
* Demonstrated behaviors aligned to NTT DATA values, including Respect Every Voice, strong collaboration and teamwork, and the courage to Think Big. Be Bold.
* Professional certifications (e.g., WorldatWork CCP/GRP or equivalent) are advantageous.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. title: Principal Solutions Architect
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Summary**  
We are seeking a Principal Solutions Architect - Data to provide architectural leadership across enterprise data, reporting, and analytics initiatives. The role will define scalable solutions across data platforms, integration services, semantic models, and business intelligence while ensuring security, governance, performance, and operational readiness.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end-to-end solution and data architecture, including target-state designs, conceptual and logical data models, integration patterns, data flows, security controls, lineage, and technology standards.
* Partner with enterprise architects and governance teams to guide solutions through Permit to Design, Permit to Build, and Permit to Operate, ensuring design, security, risk, infrastructure, support, and operational-readiness requirements are addressed.
* Define scalable engineering and integration patterns across Snowflake, cloud platforms, APIs, batch processing, and event-driven services, balancing resilience, performance, security, and cost.
* Own reporting and analytics architecture, including Performance Reporting, Client Reporting, Power BI, and semantic models. Establish standards for Import, DirectQuery, hybrid models, aggregation, incremental refresh, caching, and query optimization.
* Lead resolution of complex performance issues across source systems, data platforms, transformations, calculation layers, semantic models, and Power BI.
* Define measurable non-functional requirements for performance, scalability, availability, resilience, data freshness, observability, security, supportability, and cost.
* Establish reusable patterns for data modeling, metadata, lineage, data quality, auditability, governance, and access control to reduce technical debt.
* Provide architectural leadership across client, account, product, legal agreement, performance, benchmark, reference, and other strategic data domains.
* Act as a senior design authority by reviewing solutions, challenging technical choices, identifying risks and dependencies, mentoring teams, and communicating decisions to business and technology stakeholders.
* Maintain concise architecture deliverables, including diagrams, data models, integration flows, architecture decisions, deployment views, and operational-readiness documentation.

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms and data-driven applications.
* Deep expertise in Snowflake, data warehousing, relational and dimensional modeling, ETL/ELT, metadata, lineage, data quality, and audit controls.
* Strong experience with Power BI architecture, semantic models, DAX, Import and DirectQuery patterns, incremental refresh, aggregation, and performance optimization.
* Experience diagnosing performance across SQL, transformation, semantic, and visualization layers.
* Experience with cloud architecture, APIs, services, batch and event-driven integration, security, observability, and operational resilience.
* Proven ability to define target-state architecture, reusable technical patterns, roadmaps, and measurable non-functional requirements.
* Strong technical leadership, stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Technical Skills**

* **Data & Analytics:** Snowflake, advanced SQL, Power BI, semantic modeling, DAX, ETL/ELT, data warehousing, data modeling, performance optimization, metadata, lineage, and data quality.
* **Cloud & Integration:** Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, REST APIs, microservices, batch and event-driven integration, security, Key Vault/secrets management, observability, and resiliency patterns.
* **Application Engineering:** Python, FastAPI or similar service frameworks, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, and modern application architecture patterns.
* **Architecture & Governance:** Solution and data architecture, architecture lifecycle governance including Permit to Design, Permit to Build, and Permit to Operate, non-functional requirements, security architecture, operational readiness, and architecture decision records.
* **Engineering Practices:** CI/CD, DevSecOps, source control, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code concepts, production supportability, and performance monitoring.
* **Leadership:** Architecture reviews, design authority, technical roadmaps, mentoring, stakeholder communication, and collaboration across engineering, security, infrastructure, data governance, and enterprise architecture teams.

**Preferred Experience**

* Investment management, asset management, financial services, or another highly governed data environment.
* Performance and client reporting, benchmark and reference data, account and client hierarchies, and legal-entity or agreement data.
* Modernization of legacy reporting and analytics solutions, architecture governance, data catalogs, business glossaries, and regulatory reporting.
* Applied knowledge of machine learning, artificial intelligence, and modern analytics within established security and governance standards.

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

title: Oracle Incentive Compensation Product Owner
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

  

**Department Overview**
-----------------------

Would you like to become a part of a company that uses the newest technology platforms in communications, software, video and services? Do you want to work with people who help save other people’s lives? Do you consider yourself to be a creative thinker and complex problem solver? If the answer is yes, join our rapidly expanding IT team.
  
Our IT organization isn’t just here to support our business. We’re here to reinvent it – by changing the way our customers, partners and employees interact with our company. To do that, we’re looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners’ ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it.

**Job Description**
-------------------

As the Oracle Incentive Compensation (OIC) Product Owner, you will drive the strategic implementation, optimization, and governance of our global Incentive compensation platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, Sales Operations, Finance, and IT engineering teams, ensuring incentive compensation plans, crediting logic, and payout calculations align with business strategy and operate seamlessly. By applying a data-driven approach and scalable product management principles, you will enhance accuracy and deliver high-impact automated compensation solutions. The role will involve driving the successful delivery of the solution while considering the end-to-end view.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Product Vision & Roadmap:** Define and maintain the product roadmap for Oracle Incentive Compensation for new acquisitions, aligning with global sales strategy.
* **Backlog Management:** Author detailed user stories, define acceptance criteria, and prioritize the sprint backlog to ensure the engineering team delivers maximum business value.
* **Requirements Gathering and Analysis:** Collaborate with stakeholders, customers, and internal teams to gather requirements. Conduct research, stakeholder analysis, and user feedback analysis to inform product decisions.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Collaborate with Sales Operations, Finance, and HR to translate complex compensation plans and quota models into functional system requirements.
* **Process Optimization:** Identify opportunities to automate manual processes.
* **UAT & Quality Assurance:** Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new releases, ensuring accurate incentive calculations.
* **Data and Process Governance:** Ensure seamless data flow between OIC (actuals/payouts) and upstream and downstream systems.
* **Data Driven / Prioritization:** Bring a data-driven approach to the product and provide insights into how the product is performing and capturing business value. Using those data insights, prioritize effectively to drive the product forward using data insights to make decisions

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* **Experience:** 6+ years of experience in Product Ownership or Business Analysis, specifically within the **Oracle Incentive compensation/Sales planning** suite.
* **Core Expertise:** Deep functional knowledge of **Oracle Incentive Compensation** (Rules engine, Plan components, Credits, and Payouts) and Sales planning process
* **Agile Mastery:** Proven track record working in an Agile/Scrum environment, managing ceremonies and using tools like Jira. Leading cross-functional teams and curating product backlogs.
* **Analytical Mindset:** Ability to troubleshoot complex logic within compensation formulas and SQL-based data sets.

* **Domain Knowledge:** Deep comprehension of product features, industry standards, and security protocols.
* **Solving:** Skill in maneuvering through ambiguous scenarios and resolving operational roadblocks independently.
* **Proactive Execution:** High initiative with a focus on achieving strategic objectives autonomously.
* **Analytical Aptitude:** Exceptional capacity for synthesizing intricate requirements into actionable functional specs.
* **Communication & Leadership:** Superior written and verbal skills, proficient at driving consensus across diverse stakeholder groups.

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

None

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

No

***EEO Statement***

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic.

We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. title: People Operations Manager
description:
**Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully-autonomous food production sites**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully automated facilities that can produce fresh food year-round - addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.

**About the Role**
------------------

We’re hiring a HR/People Operations Manager to run the day-to-day people operations that keep a fast-growing, global team healthy and high-performing. Based in our Bengaluru office, you’ll support core HR operations across India, Germany, and remote team members, building systems that scale while keeping the employee experience human and consistent.

You’ll work closely with our Talent Recruiter, team leads, and finance operations to make sure hiring, onboarding, compliance, and people processes are tight, fair, and easy to run.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

##### **Own the employee lifecycle end-to-end**

You’ll run the operational backbone for employees from onboarding through role changes, performance cycles, and offboarding. You’ll make sure every stage is clear, timely, and consistent, so managers can lead well and employees can do their best work.

##### **Build scalable HR systems for a fast-growing team**

You’ll design and implement the processes that help us scale without chaos: policies, workflows, and self-serve documentation that people actually use. You’ll continuously simplify removing friction, tightening handoffs, and making “how we do things” easy to follow across locations.

##### **Run multi-country compliance with confidence**

You’ll coordinate employment law, HR compliance, and documentation across India, Germany, and remote arrangements working with external counsel and local experts where needed. You’ll ensure contracts, statutory requirements, and internal practices stay up to date as regulations and the team evolve.

##### **Own payroll, benefits, and HR administration**

You’ll manage HR operations with precision: payroll coordination, benefits administration, leave policies, reimbursements, and employee records. You’ll be the person who catches issues before they become problems and who builds repeatable workflows so nothing depends on heroics.

##### **Partner with Talent on hiring and onboarding**

You’ll work closely with our Talent Recruitment Specialist to ensure smooth candidate-to-employee handoff, onboarding plans, and first-week readiness (accounts, equipment coordination, documentation, and team intros). You’ll help improve onboarding based on feedback and outcomes, not just checklists.

##### **Bring structure to performance and feedback**

You’ll implement lightweight, consistent performance practices that fit a startup context - goal setting, check-ins, calibration support, and clear documentation. You’ll help managers handle feedback well, address issues early, and keep decisions fair and transparent..

**Who You Are**
---------------

#### **Core requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master's degree in human resources, business, or related field.
* **2+ years of** experience in People Operations / HR, ideally in a fast-growing startup or high-change environment
* Strong hands-on experience running People Operations across **India** (and coordinating with other countries or remote employment models)
* Experience **owning employee lifecycle processes**: onboarding, performance cycles, role changes, offboarding
* Operational excellence: you’re organized, detail-oriented, and reliable with confidential information
* Strong communication skills and good judgment: you can handle sensitive topics with clarity and care
* High ownership mindset: you see gaps, propose solutions, and make the system better without waiting for perfect direction

#### **Bonus points if you have**

* Built HR processes from scratch (workflows, performance cycles)
* HR analytics comfort (dashboards, basic automation, lightweight reporting)
* Experience supporting remote-first or distributed teams across time zones
* Familiarity with common HR tools (e.g., Humaans, Deel/Remote, TeamTailor) and improving workflows across them.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

**Real ownership:** You’ll own the people-ops engine that supports a global team and your work will directly influence how well we scale.  
**Build from scratch** (with support): You’ll establish the foundations, systems, and rhythms that the company will run on for years.  
**High-leverage work**: Great people operations unlock faster hiring, smoother onboarding, stronger teams, and better retention.  
**Global team**: Work across our Cologne HQ and Bengaluru office with a tight, mission-driven team and short feedback loops.  
**Mission that matters:** Help build the team enabling fully automated greenhouses and more resilient, sustainable food production worldwide.

**Apply Now**
-------------

Send us a short note with:

* A few lines on what motivates you about building great people operations in fast-growing companies (and why eternal.ag)
* Your CV and/or LinkedIn profile

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

*eternal.ag* *is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.*

We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

**Responsibilities**

The Microsoft Purview SME will be responsible for the implementation, administration, monitoring, and operational management of Microsoft Purview solutions. The role includes managing information protection, data loss prevention, data lifecycle management, records management, eDiscovery, insider risk, and compliance capabilities to ensure organizational data remains protected and governed according to business, security, and regulatory requirements.

  

**Roles and responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Microsoft Purview solutions in accordance with organizational security, compliance, and data governance requirements.
* Design, configure, and maintain sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption settings, and protection controls across Microsoft 365 services.
* Implement and manage manual, recommended, and automatic data classification and labeling capabilities.
* Configure and maintain Data Loss Prevention policies across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 applications, and managed endpoints.
* Monitor and investigate DLP alerts, policy matches, data leakage incidents, and user-reported data protection concerns.
* Analyze false-positive and false-negative DLP detections and perform policy optimization and tuning.
* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management, including retention policies and retention labels.
* Support Records Management requirements, including regulatory records, event-based retention, disposition reviews, and proof of disposition.
* Configure and support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard and Premium capabilities.
* Assist Legal, Compliance, HR, and Security teams with legal holds, content searches, collections, review sets, investigations, and evidence exports.
* Configure and maintain Insider Risk Management policies, indicators, alerts, and investigation workflows.
* Support Communication Compliance policies and investigations in coordination with authorized business stakeholders.
* Manage Microsoft Purview Audit capabilities and assist with audit log searches, compliance investigations, and evidence collection.
* Develop and maintain data classification schemas, sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and keyword dictionaries.
* Support Microsoft Purview Data Map and Data Catalog capabilities where included within the organizational data governance scope.
* Perform periodic reviews of Microsoft Purview configurations, policies, alerts, incidents, and compliance posture.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Purview policy behavior, configuration issues, service limitations, and integration-related problems.
* Support integrations between Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, and other security monitoring platforms.
* Collaborate with Security Operations Center, Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Messaging, Workplace, Infrastructure, and End User Support teams to resolve information protection and compliance-related issues.
* Coordinate with Microsoft Vendor Support for product defects, technical limitations, and complex service-related incidents.
* Generate operational reports, compliance dashboards, security metrics, policy effectiveness reports, and trend analysis for management and customer review.
* Participate in compliance assessments, security audits, service reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into appropriate Microsoft Purview technical controls.
* Maintain operational documentation, high-level designs, low-level designs, standard operating procedures, implementation standards, support runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Provide L3 technical support and subject matter expertise for Microsoft Purview-related incidents, service requests, changes, and projects.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to operational and support teams.
  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Compliance, Information Protection, Data Governance, or related technologies.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing or administering Microsoft Purview solutions.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto-labeling, and data classification.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention policies across Microsoft 365 workloads and managed endpoints.
* Experience managing retention policies, retention labels, Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management, and disposition processes.

* Experience configuring or supporting Insider Risk Management and Communication Compliance solutions.

* Experience integrating Microsoft Purview capabilities with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, or security monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, and Microsoft 365 administrative tools.

title: HR Operations Advisor
description:
**Overview**
At Quest Software, we build technology that simplifies IT management and strengthens cybersecurity resilience for organizations around the world.
  
  
Our people are central to our success, and we are committed to delivering an HR experience that reflects our global footprint, growth mindset, and employee-first culture .
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Quest Software is seeking an HR Operations Advisor, based in India, to serve as an advanced, globally connected subject-matter expert within our HR Operations function, with a strong anchor in our growing APJ population. While this role is based in India, it is global in scope and mindset — we are looking for a seasoned operator who works beyond regional boundaries, brings deep functional expertise, and helps shape how HR Operations runs enterprise-wide.
  
  
This is an advanced individual-contributor role for someone who owns the most complex work in the function. You will resolve ambiguous, high-impact cases that lack clear precedent, determine methods and procedures on new assignments, and guide the development of new policies and processes. You will act as a trusted advisor to HR Business Partners and global HR Operations colleagues, mentor less-experienced team members, and be accountable through the team for tactical business outcomes — while supporting the systems that underpin our service delivery, including Dayforce and HR ServiceNow.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Advanced Operational Delivery & Complex Case Resolution
  
  

* Own the most complex, ambiguous, and high-impact cases across the employee lifecycle — onboarding and offboarding, employee changes, data management, immigration, leaves of absence, and compliance — where solutions are not clearly defined and require in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
* Manage escalated HR ServiceNow cases end to end, exercising independent judgment to resolve issues that fall outside standard procedure and setting the standard for quality and responsiveness.
* Serve as an advanced regional expert for APJ while championing a “one HR Operations team” approach across all geographies.

Policy, Process & Standards Development
  
  

* Guide the development of new policies, procedures, and repeatable processes — directing the application of existing principles and shaping how the global function operates.
* Determine methods and procedures on new assignments and initiatives, adapting complex techniques and evaluation criteria to deliver results consistent with departmental objectives.
* Lead standardization and automation efforts that scale across regions, partnering with HRIS, Payroll, and IT to strengthen data integrity and system workflows in Dayforce.

Trusted Advisor & Cross-Functional Influence
  
  

* Advise HR Business Partners, managers, and global HR Operations colleagues on complex matters, adapting style and using persuasion to deliver messages that relate to the wider business.
* Network with key contacts outside your own area of expertise — including Finance, Legal, and Payroll — to drive accurate, compliant, and aligned employee administration.
* Act as an informal team leader: mentor and up-skill less-experienced colleagues and raise the capability of the broader team.

Global Alignment, Projects & Scaling
  
  

* Take a leading role in HR projects and initiatives — including system changes, implementations, and vendor transitions — accountable through the team for delivery of tactical business targets.
* Contribute to the long-term design of global HR Operations standards, documentation, and governance as the organization continues to scale.

**Qualifications**

description:
**Description**
Would you like to be part of an organization that is helping Amazon build a fast-growing, highly innovative workforce? Do you get excited about working with a highly diverse population cutting across multiple countries, cultures, and values? Getting interested? Please read on!
  
  
Join our team and make a difference for Amazonians and their families. Amazon’s dedicated team that provides concierge-level support for Amazon employees and their families in their time of need is growing.
  
  
Amazon's Compassionate Care Services is here for employees if they are facing the loss of a loved one or a life-threatening illness. As a Compassionate Care Case Manager, you will help employees and their loved ones navigate the processes, paperwork, and challenges involved with a loss or illness. Our Compassionate Care Case Manager are skilled in answering challenging questions, understanding complex employee and family situations, communicating available benefits for each specific case, assisting in navigating internal departments and external vendors, and responding to changing circumstances and needs to pave the way for a connected and trusted case management experience.
  
  
High-level judgment is crucial in the time-critical nature of this role. Compassionate Care Case Manager must be highly attuned to how people are responding and focus on the details of each individual case. They must step back from these cases to see emerging patterns and adjust processes and support mechanisms as needed. Active listening, empathy, and problem solving are a must.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Serve as an empathetic point of contact and provide holistic case management services to employees and their families in times of death, critical illness, crisis, and other times of need
  
  
Leverage best practice tools and Amazon and vendor resources to understand all options available
  
  
Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to the timing of changing needs
  
  
Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers for an employee
  
  
Respond to issues that may arise and ensure the right communication occurs with accurate details at the right time
  
  
Identify and solve problems, sometimes with limited information
  
  
Communicate regular updates to employees, vendors, and stakeholders both verbally and in writing
  
  
Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state/country regulations, and company policies
  
  
Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation
  
  
Consult, coordinate, and partner with our HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members, and other departments/systems as appropriate
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of professional or military experience, or Bachelor's degree
* 2+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience using computers and Microsoft Office tools such as Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in counseling or mentoring others, preferably in HR, Healthcare, or Crisis Management
* Experience with global service and employee delivery
* Strong problem solving, time management, and priority-setting skills
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 5+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience working with speech and text language data in multiple languages
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Familiarity with case management systems, reviewing cases for benefits eligibility, determining the appropriate benefits that apply to a specific situation, and establishing/executing a case management plan

title: Compassionate Care Case Mgr, High Touch Support
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Would you like to be part of an organization that is helping Amazon build a fast-growing, highly innovative workforce? Do you get excited about working with a highly diverse population cutting across multiple countries, cultures, and values? Getting interested? Please read on!  
  
Join our team and make a difference for Amazonians and their families. Amazon’s dedicated team that provides concierge-level support for Amazon employees and their families in their time of need is growing.  
  
Amazon's Compassionate Care Services is here for employees if they are facing the loss of a loved one or a life-threatening illness. As a Compassionate Care Case Manager, you will help employees and their loved ones navigate the processes, paperwork, and challenges involved with a loss or illness. Our Compassionate Care Case Manager are skilled in answering challenging questions, understanding complex employee and family situations, communicating available benefits for each specific case, assisting in navigating internal departments and external vendors, and responding to changing circumstances and needs to pave the way for a connected and trusted case management experience.  
  
High-level judgment is crucial in the time-critical nature of this role. Compassionate Care Case Manager must be highly attuned to how people are responding and focus on the details of each individual case. They must step back from these cases to see emerging patterns and adjust processes and support mechanisms as needed. Active listening, empathy, and problem solving are a must.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Serve as an empathetic point of contact and provide holistic case management services to employees and their families in times of death, critical illness, crisis, and other times of need  
Leverage best practice tools and Amazon and vendor resources to understand all options available  
Critically assess and adjust the case management plan to the timing of changing needs  
Troubleshoot issues and seek to remove barriers for an employee  
Respond to issues that may arise and ensure the right communication occurs with accurate details at the right time  
Identify and solve problems, sometimes with limited information  
Communicate regular updates to employees, vendors, and stakeholders both verbally and in writing  
Ensure compliance with standard work, federal/state/country regulations, and company policies  
Maintain system records to ensure accurate and timely information/documentation  
Consult, coordinate, and partner with our HR, Safety, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, team members, and other departments/systems as appropriate

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of professional or military experience, or Bachelor's degree
* 2+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience using computers and Microsoft Office tools such as Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint
* Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
* Experience handling confidential information
* Experience in counseling or mentoring others, preferably in HR, Healthcare, or Crisis Management
* Experience with global service and employee delivery
* Strong problem solving, time management, and priority-setting skills
* Experience providing guidance to employees or managers on leave of absence, disability plan, accommodation, human resources, benefits, or employee matters

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree in Human Resources, Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, Business/Management, Psychology, or a related field
* 5+ years of case management experience, or Bachelor's degree in business, HR, or a related field
* Experience working with speech and text language data in multiple languages
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Familiarity with case management systems, reviewing cases for benefits eligibility, determining the appropriate benefits that apply to a specific situation, and establishing/executing a case management plan

description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Job Overview**
As a Change Analyst, you will partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives from a change management lens. You will help bring structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex change by translating business and project needs into practical change approaches that drive adoption and measurable outcomes. You will also leverage reusable enterprise assets, tools, and practices that help make change more consistent and effective over time.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Support Transformation Initiatives**

* Partner with the GIC Change Lead to support transformation initiatives through a structured change management lens.
* Support the design and execution of change strategies, plans, and activities that drive adoption and sustain business outcomes.
* Translate business and project requirements into practical change interventions, including development of the change narrative, stakeholder analysis, change plans, and supporting resources.
* Leverage GMI’s Change Playbook, tools, templates, and reusable assets to promote consistent and effective change practices across GIC initiatives.

**Evaluate Change Impact and Readiness**

* Assess and organize change impacts across initiatives, stakeholder groups, and ways of working.
* Manage change impact data and reporting through the change dashboard to support visibility, tracking, and decision-making.
* Evaluate organizational readiness and help shape approaches that enable effective adoption of change.

**Collaborate with Project Teams**

* Coordinate with project teams, business stakeholders, and functional partners to gather inputs, align on priorities, and support execution of change activities.
* Partner with Learning and Development, Communications, Project Managers, and business leaders to activate engagement plans and drive adoption actions.
* Support the execution of change activities with a focus on quality, consistency, and business relevance.

**Sustain the rigor through continuous learning and feedback**

* Capture lessons learned and stakeholder feedback throughout initiatives, and apply insights to refine approaches and lead change with agility.
* Identify recurring themes, risks, and opportunities across the GIC change portfolio and escalate relevant insights to the Change Lead.
* Provide feedback to the CoE to support ongoing improvement of change methodologies, tools, and practices.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in change management, business, communications, human resources, organizational psychology, or a related field.
* 2 to 4 years of experience supporting change management work on transformation, process improvement, or organizational change initiatives.
* Experience supporting core change management deliverables
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels to gather inputs, support alignment, and help execute change activities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize information into clear, concise, leadership-ready updates/presentations.
* Strong organizational and project coordination skills, including the ability to navigate the organization and manage multiple priorities with attention to detail and follow-through.

**Preferred Qualifications**
Up to 7 years of experience supporting change management work on large-scale, cross-functional transformation initiatives in complex stakeholder environments.
  
  

* Consulting experience in change management, transformation, and/or program delivery, with the ability to:
* bring structure to ambiguity
* synthesize inputs
* turn insights into actionable recommendations
* Experience supporting change intake, prioritization, tiering, and governance processes, including maintaining intake artifacts and preparing decision-support materials.
* Experience facilitating:
* working sessions
* stakeholder discussions
* change enablement activities
* Experience leveraging reusable change assets – including playbooks, templates, tools, and reporting materials – to drive consistency, while applying the art of of change through judgement, adaptation and continuous improvement
* Change management certification, education, or formal training such as Prosci.

title: Senior Associate, HR Operations
description:
**Overview**
CACTUS is a remote-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Associate, Payroll and HR Operations to front end manage payroll coordination and support lifecycle HR operations for the India entity, and to provide oversight of payroll delivery across our global offices. This is not a hands-on payroll processing role — payroll is managed by an external vendor for India (and by local vendors for each global office). Instead, this role owns the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of payroll outcomes by collating inputs, validating vendor outputs, and coordinating closely with in-country points of contact (POCs). The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing vendors and cross-border stakeholders to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
**Please note: We are looking only for external candidates and not accepting any internal applications for this position at the moment.**
**Responsibilities**

* Manage end-to-end India payroll coordination with external vendors, including monthly payroll inputs, validation, payroll calendars, salary disbursement, and resolution of discrepancies.
* Coordinate statutory payroll compliance across applicable states, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, and TDS, while tracking filing timelines and supporting Form 16 issuance and TDS reconciliations.
* Manage employee exit-related payroll activities, including full & final settlements, gratuity calculations, leave encashment, and coordination with payroll vendors.
* Oversee global payroll coordination across multiple locations by working with regional POCs and in-country vendors to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing and compliance.
* Maintain accurate HRIS and employee master data and ensure timely processing and communication of employee lifecycle changes, including new hires, exits, transfers, promotions, and compensation changes.
* Act as the primary point of contact for payroll-related employee queries and support internal and external payroll audits, compliance checks, and vendor SLA reviews.
* Drive payroll process improvements through accurate trackers and dashboards, SOP documentation, vendor management, and initiatives to improve payroll accuracy, timeliness, and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3–5+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll coordination, and generalist HR operations, preferably with exposure to vendor-managed or outsourced payroll models.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance, including PF, ESI, PT, LWF, and TDS, with the ability to review and validate vendor payroll outputs and filings.
* Proven experience managing external vendors, tracking SLAs and deadlines, and coordinating with stakeholders across different time zones and geographies.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUP, pivot tables, and other data management and analysis functions.
* High level of accuracy, confidentiality, discretion, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage sensitive employee data and multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Prior experience with multi-country payroll, HRIS platforms, vendor management or procurement, and familiarity with the Indian Labour Codes and their impact on payroll and compliance will be an added advantage.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**Accelerating from Anywhere**
As a remote-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.
  
  

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.

**About CACTUS**
Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.

title: Talent Acquisition Operations Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
  
  
We are seeking a Specialist, Global TA Operations to support the continued development and evolution of our Global Talent Acquisition function. This role will assist with developing recruiting metrics and reporting, ATS process improvements, and the documentation of TA processes and policies. The Specialist will play an important role in strengthening our recruiting operations and compliance infrastructure, enabling greater consistency, efficiency, and scalability across the function.
  
  
**What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:**

* You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
* You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance

* You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards

+ We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create new solutions
+ We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
+ Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work

**What Work You Will Be Responsible For:**
Recruiting Analytics & Reporting (20%)
  
  

* Assist with recruiting data analysis, recurring reporting, and the identification of trends and insights.
* Support the enhancement and ongoing maintenance of the Talent Acquisition analytics suite and dashboards.
* Monitor data quality and partner with stakeholders to resolve reporting inconsistencies.
* Help develop standardized metrics and reporting practices across the Global Talent Acquisition function.

ATS Testing & Process Improvement (30%)
  
  

* Coordinate and perform pre-deployment testing of Workday ATS updates, enhancements, and configuration changes.
* Develop test scenarios, document results, and track identified issues through resolution.
* Gather stakeholder feedback and help identify opportunities to improve ATS workflows and the user experience.
* Maintain documentation related to system updates, testing activities, and process changes.

Policy, Process & Compliance Documentation (30%)
  
  

* Support the development, execution, and ongoing maintenance of standard Talent Acquisition policies, processes, and procedures.
* Create clear process maps, job aids, reference guides, and other operational documentation.
* Assist with efforts to standardize recruiting practices and strengthen compliance controls across the function.
* Help ensure documentation remains current as systems, policies, and business requirements evolve.

Global TA Operations & Project Support (20%)
  
  

* Support Talent Acquisition projects and initiatives that improve consistency, efficiency, and scalability.
* Coordinate with recruiters, HR technology, compliance, and other partners to support operational priorities.
* Track project activities, action items, risks, and deliverables to help ensure timely completion.
* Respond to operational questions and provide guidance on established Talent Acquisition processes and tools.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline
* 4 years of experience supporting Talent Acquisition or in a related field (such as HR operations) with exposure to recruiting processes and coordination

**Preferred/Desired Qualifications:**

* Direct experience with Workday Recruiting
* Familiarity with recruiting metrics, dashboards, and data visualization tools like Power BI or Tableau
* Experience with recruiting and human resources processes
* Exposure or familiarity with US employment compliance strongly desired
* Experience with testing ATS features and processes a strong plus
* Ability to operate under ambiguity and craft process and policy documentation to establish SOP framework
* Able to effectively leverage AI tools like CoPilot or Claude as an accelerator for routine administrative work

**About EisnerAmper:**
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 475+ partners and 5000+ employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
  
  
Our clients represent enterprises of every form, ranging from sophisticated financial institutions to startups, global public firms to middle-market companies, governmental entities as well as high-net-worth individuals, family offices, nonprofit organizations and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, investors, and key stakeholders who serve these clients.
  
  
**About EisnerAmper India:**
EisnerAmper (India) Consultants Pvt. Ltd. (“EA India”) is a subsidiary of Eisner Advisory Group LLC (“EA Group”), which practices in an alternative practice structure with EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees provide advisory services to clients of EA Group and audit services to clients of Eisner Amper LLP and comply with the professional standards applicable to each of EA India, EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. EA India employees also provide operational services to EA Group and EisnerAmper LLP. The policies and procedures of EA India, including obligations of confidentiality and non-disclosure, apply to all services provided by EA India employees. All applicants are applying to positions for employment with EA India, and not EA Group or EisnerAmper LLP.
  
  
EA India opened its first office in Mumbai in 2007. Over the years, our India footprint has expanded to include offices in Ahmedabad, Bangalore and Hyderabad. We are a culturally diverse pool of over 1000 professionals supporting our global clientele from a range of startups to Fortune 500 entities.

title: L&D Coordinator
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Learning & Development (L&D) Coordinator supports the planning and day-to-day delivery of learning programs. Working under the guidance of the ONWARD Connected Lead and program managers, this role helps keep timelines, participant communications, enrollment details, logistics, records, and follow-up activities organized and on track.

The L&D Coordinator partners with subject matter experts (SMEs), facilitators, Learning Operations, Learning Communications, Learning Impact, Connected Capabilities Leads, Learning & Performance Business Partners (LPBPs), HR Business Partners (HRBPs), and external vendors. The role is suited to an early-career professional who is organized, service-minded, eager to learn, and ready to build program coordination skills while contributing to a positive participant experience.

This is for UK Shift.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

Program Planning & Coordination

* Help maintain program calendars, workplans, schedules, task trackers, and key deadlines; update them as plans change.
* Gather planning information from program leads, SMEs, facilitators, Learning Operations, and other partners, and keep shared materials current.
* Coordinate routine details across program activities such as marketing, nominations, preparation, delivery, evaluation, and follow-up.

Nominations & Participant Administration

* Support nomination and enrollment activities using established criteria, processes, forms, and timelines, in partnership with Learning Business Partners.
* Maintain participant lists, registration status, waitlists, and alumni records, checking information for accuracy and completeness.
* Prepare participant rosters and provide enrollment details to Learning Operations and other partners as requested.
* Track participation changes or gaps and bring them to the program lead's attention for review and follow-up.

Participant Communications & Support

* Prepare and send routine participant communications using approved templates and guidance, including invitations, welcome information, reminders, logistics, and follow-up resources.
* Help keep communication plans, templates, FAQs, and send dates organized and up to date.
* Monitor program inboxes or communication channels; respond to routine questions using approved information and route complex or sensitive issues to the appropriate partner.
* Provide timely, courteous support and help participants understand where to find program information and materials.

Digital & On-Demand Program Support

* Responsible for LMS setup and enrollment following established processes.
* Check that program information such as descriptions, dates, links, prerequisites, and instructions matches the approved source materials.
* Use available reports to track enrollment, progress, and completion; send reminders according to the program plan and share potential concerns with the program lead.
* Record access or technical issues and route them to Learning Operations or the appropriate support contact.

Program Logistics & Delivery

* Use program checklists to help prepare virtual sessions, including meeting links, platform settings, breakout rooms, recordings, and technology checks.
* Coordinate in-person logistics such as room arrangements, audiovisual needs, materials, and onsite details with the relevant partners.
* Organize and distribute agendas, participant materials, facilitator resources, and other approved program content.
* Support session-day operations, maintain attendance records, and share required information with Learning Operations for tracking and reporting.
* Help identify logistical gaps early and bring them to the program lead's attention.

Evaluation, Reporting & Follow-Up

* Help prepare and distribute program evaluations, surveys, and pulse checks; monitor responses and send planned reminders.
* Compile attendance, enrollment, completion, and evaluation information in established trackers or templates.
* Prepare basic status updates and summaries for review by the program lead; flag notable feedback, recurring questions, or participation issues.
* Keep follow-up tasks and resource distribution organized after program sessions.

Documentation & Process Support

* Maintain shared program files, calendars, participant records, and materials so information is current, easy to find, and appropriately organized.
* Follow established version-control, privacy, data-handling, and governance practices when working with program materials and participant information.
* Update FAQs, checklists, standard operating procedures, and other program documentation as directed.
* Share practical ideas with the team for making recurring coordination tasks clearer, more consistent, or more efficient

**EDUCATION, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:**

* Minimum 3 years' experience in Learning & Development.
* Organization & attention to detail: Keeps information accurate and follows through on assigned tasks and deadlines.
* Clear communication: Writes and speaks courteously, shares updates, and asks questions when expectations are unclear.
* Service mindset: Responds helpfully to participant and stakeholder needs and knows when to seek support.
* Teamwork & learning agility: Collaborates well, accepts feedback, and builds knowledge of learning program operations over time.
* Coordination & prioritization: Tracks multiple tasks, adapts to changing details, and raises capacity or timing concerns early.
* Problem solving & judgment: Notices issues, gathers relevant details, and escalates appropriately rather than making unsupported decisions.
* Comfort with digital tools: Willingness to learn collaboration, scheduling, learning-management, and survey tools used by the team.
