title: GM - Employee Experience Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced employee experience professional to lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the end-to-end employee experience across VOIS. This role will shape employee journeys throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business strategy, organisational culture, employee value proposition (EVP), workplace experience priorities and transformation ambitions.
  
  
Working across multiple geographies and national cultures, the successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to create meaningful, engaging and data-led employee experiences that improve engagement, productivity, retention, wellbeing and organisational effectiveness. The role will also champion AI-enabled and technology-driven employee experience solutions, ensuring that the employee voice is at the centre of decision-making and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and drive the Employee Experience (EX) strategy aligned with business goals, EVP, culture ambitions and talent priorities.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end employee journeys across onboarding, development, mobility, career progression and offboarding.
* Leverage employee feedback, engagement data and workforce insights to identify priorities and deliver impactful interventions.
* Lead employee listening programs, surveys and feedback mechanisms, translating insights into measurable actions.
* Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Culture and Communications teams to create seamless and consistent employee experiences.
* Drive adoption of digital, workplace and AI-enabled solutions through effective change management and employee engagement initiatives.
* Develop recognition, appreciation and belonging programs that strengthen employee engagement and connection to the organization.
* Establish employee experience KPIs, dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and business impact.
* Introduce innovative practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity and retention.
* Collaborate with business leaders, Group HR and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, influence decision-making and deliver sustainable employee experience outcomes

**Who You Are**

* Significant experience in employee experience, engagement, organisational effectiveness or related people functions
* Proven success designing and improving employee journeys across the employee lifecycle
* Experience delivering people initiatives across global, multi-cultural and matrixed organisations
* Strong analytical capability with experience translating data and employee insights into meaningful business outcomes
* Skilled in stakeholder engagement, collaboration and influencing across diverse functions and leadership levels
* Strong understanding of employee listening methodologies, engagement frameworks and experience design principles
* Knowledge of AI-enabled ways of working, technology adoption and modern workplace practices
* Excellent communication, change enablement and relationship management skills
* Ability to balance long-term strategy with pragmatic execution
* Passion for creating inclusive, employee-centred environments where people can thrive and perform at their best

**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to shape the employee experience strategy for a large, global organisation
* Exposure to senior leaders and key stakeholders across HR, business functions and Group teams
* Ability to influence culture, EVP activation, employee engagement and organisational transformation
* Opportunity to lead innovative employee listening, workplace and AI-enabled experience initiatives
* Work across multiple countries, cultures and business environments
* Play a visible role in driving organisational effectiveness, productivity and employee satisfaction

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced employee experience strategy and lifecycle design
* Employee listening, sentiment analysis and data-driven decision-making
* Global stakeholder management and influencing within complex matrix organisations
* AI-enabled employee experience and workplace transformation practices
* Organisational culture, EVP activation and engagement programme leadership
* Experience measurement, analytics and impact assessment methodologies
* Cross-functional collaboration across HR, Technology, Communications, Property and business teams

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

title: Senior Human Resources Specialist
description:
**Title: HR Operations Specialist**

**Job Family: Human Resources**

**Open positions: 01**

**Work Location: Faridabad, Pune, and Hyderabad**

**Lindstrom Services India Private Limited**

**Purpose of the Role:**

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented, and execution-focused
**HR Operations Specialist**
professional to manage day-to-day HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, HR data management, payroll coordination, and off-roll workforce administration.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and organizational skills, the ability to manage multiple operational priorities, and the confidence to collaborate with internal stakeholders across functions and locations.

The role requires hands-on HR operational experience, strong data management capabilities, and a solution-oriented approach. Working knowledge of payroll and statutory compliance is expected, while specialized compliance activities will be managed through a centralized support structure.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage end-to-end employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, employee documentation, confirmation, transfers, employee data changes, and separation processes.
* Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of employee records, personnel files, and HR documentation.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to facilitate seamless onboarding and offboarding experiences.
* Handle employee queries related to HR processes, policies, documentation, and operational matters.

**2. HR Data Management, HRIS & MIS Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, updated, and reliable employee master data across HR systems and databases.
* Prepare and maintain periodic HR MIS reports, dashboards, and operational trackers.
* Monitor workforce-related metrics such as headcount, attrition, attendance, leave, employee movements, and off-roll workforce data.
* Conduct regular data validation, reconciliation, and quality checks to ensure data integrity.
* Support HR leadership with workforce analytics, operational insights, and data-driven reporting.

**3. Payroll Inputs & Coordination**

* Coordinate monthly payroll inputs, including attendance, leave, loss of pay, new joiners, exits, salary revisions, and other employee-related changes.
* Validate payroll-related data and ensure timely submission to the payroll processing team.
* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, and relevant stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and employee queries.
* Ensure adherence to established payroll timelines and internal processes.

*The role requires practical payroll knowledge and coordination capabilities rather than specialized end-to end payroll processing expertise.*

**4. Off-Roll Workforce & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate HR operational activities relating to off-roll, contractual, and third-party employees across business locations.
* Maintain accurate off-roll employee databases, deployment records, attendance information, and workforce movement trackers.
* Facilitate onboarding, documentation, deployment changes, and separation processes for off-roll employees.
* Track and resolve operational issues concerning contractual workforce administration.
* Support standardization and continuous improvement of off-roll workforce management practices.

**5. Statutory Compliance Coordination**

* Possess working knowledge of applicable statutory requirements, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, gratuity, and other relevant labour regulations.
* Coordinate with the centralized team and relevant stakeholders for compliance-related data, documentation, and operational requirements.
* Support timely submission of employee and workforce information required for compliance processes.
* Maintain relevant records and facilitate documentation for internal reviews and audits.
* Follow up on compliance-related observations and coordinate their closure with the responsible teams.

*Specialized statutory compliance management will be handled centrally through GI. The position focuses primarily on operational coordination, data accuracy, and process adherence.*

**6. Process Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identify process gaps, recurring operational challenges, and opportunities for automation.
* Support standardization of HR processes, documentation, reporting formats, and workflows.
* Improve efficiency, accuracy, and turnaround time across HR operational activities.
* Maintain process trackers, checklists, and control mechanisms to improve execution.
* Support HR transformation initiatives, system enhancements, and continuous improvement projects.
* Contribute to a consistent and employee-friendly HR service delivery experience.

**Qualifications & Experience**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources is preferred but not mandatory.

**Professional Experience**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience in HR Operations, HR Generalist, or People Operations roles.
* Demonstrated experience managing employee lifecycle processes, HR data, and operational reporting.
* Practical exposure to payroll inputs, validation, and coordination.
* Experience coordinating off-roll or contractual workforce administration is strongly preferred.
* Experience working with multiple internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Exposure to centralized or shared-service HR operating models would be an advantage.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

**Functional Skills**

* HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management
* HRIS & Employee Master Data Management
* HR MIS, Reporting & Data Analytics
* Payroll Inputs & Coordination
* Off-Roll / Contract Workforce Administration
* Vendor & Stakeholder Coordination
* Working Knowledge of Statutory Compliance
* HR Process Documentation & Standardization

**Technical Skills**

* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, data validation, and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with HRMS/HRIS platforms.
* Good working knowledge of MS Office applications.

**Why Join Lindström**

Lindström is a Finland-headquartered, global textile services company specializing in workwear rental, cleanroom solutions, and sustainable textile services. With a strong international presence, Lindström supports businesses through innovative, sustainable, and customer-focused solutions.

At Lindström India, we are committed to building an efficient, people-centric HR function that enables business growth, operational excellence, and a positive employee experience.

At Lindström, you'll play a critical role in ensuring a seamless employee experience through accurate HR operations while partnering closely with business and operations teams. This role offers exposure to a diverse workforce, multi-location operations, and opportunities to drive process excellence in a growing international organization.

title: People Consulting-HRT WorkDay-Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line -People Consulting Position Title:**
**HR Transformation Technology – Manager**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Workday Manager, you will lead Workday-enabled HR transformation engagements across implementations, optimization initiatives, post-production support, and operating model transformation programs.
  
  
You will work closely with client HR, IT, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders to translate complex organizational requirements into scalable Workday solutions. You will be responsible for functional delivery, solution quality, team leadership, stakeholder management, and the successful execution of project milestones.
  
  
You will also support business development activities, contribute to proposals and solution design, and help strengthen EY’s Workday capabilities, methodologies, and market presence.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the techno-functional design, configuration, testing, deployment, and optimization of Workday HCM solutions.
* Configure and provide functional oversight across at least two Workday modules, including Core HCM, Compensation, Absence, Time Tracking, Talent, Recruiting, Learning, Benefits, Payroll, or related modules.
* Design and maintain business processes, security groups, domain policies, calculated fields, custom reports, dashboards, and notifications.
* Translate business requirements into scalable functional designs, integration requirements, data mappings, and technical specifications.
* Coordinate with technical teams on EIBs, Core Connectors, APIs, Workday Studio integrations, and third-party interfaces.
* Lead data conversion, validation, reconciliation, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and defect resolution.
* Manage functional and technical workstreams, including plans, deliverables, dependencies, risks, and quality reviews.
* Conduct tenant health checks, troubleshoot production issues, and identify opportunities for automation and system optimization.
* Manage client stakeholders and provide clear updates on solution decisions, delivery status, risks, and issues.
* Lead and mentor Workday consultants while supporting proposals, effort estimates, demonstrations, and practice-building initiatives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Workday HCM functionality and HR business processes.
* Hands-on experience in Workday configuration, business processes, security, reporting, and calculated fields.

description:

We provide HR, Finance, IT & Business operations support to 31 countries, speak 24+ languages and process over 18,000 transactions a day. We are setting tomorrow’s standards for customer focus, digital solutions, and sustainable business models. For over 10 years, we have been providing services and solutions from our two locations in Pune and Szczecin. This has allowed us to gain extensive experience in how we can best serve our internal customers with high quality and passion. Website: https://www.metro-gsc.in  
Company Size: 600-650  
Headquarters: Pune, Maharashtra, India  
Type: Privately Held  
Inception: 2011

 **Job Description**

**Job Purpose**

The IT Infrastructure & Business Information Security Officer will be responsible for supporting and maintaining enterprise IT infrastructure operations while ensuring that information security requirements are implemented across the assigned business or organizational entity.

The role combines hands-on IT infrastructure expertise with business information security responsibilities, including security risk identification, vulnerability management, compliance monitoring, security policy implementation, and coordination with central Cybersecurity, IT Infrastructure, application, and business teams.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in managing IT infrastructure environments, with practical experience in IT security governance and the ability to translate cybersecurity requirements into actionable business and technical activities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**IT Infrastructure Management and Operations — Primary Responsibility**

* Manage and support enterprise IT infrastructure, ensuring availability, performance, stability, and operational continuity.
* Administer and support Windows Server environments, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and related infrastructure services.
* Support Microsoft 365, endpoint management, identity and access management, and enterprise collaboration platforms, as applicable.
* Manage and coordinate server, desktop, laptop, network, and endpoint infrastructure operations.
* Support network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, firewalls, switches, routers, and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Coordinate server patching, operating system upgrades, software deployment, endpoint updates, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, system health, capacity, and performance; identify and resolve operational issues.
* Manage incidents, problems, and change management processes in accordance with IT service management practices.
* Work with internal IT teams, managed service providers, and external vendors to ensure timely resolution of infrastructure issues.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, asset inventories, configuration records, support procedures, and operational reports.
* Ensure appropriate access controls, privileged account management, system hardening, and secure infrastructure configuration.
* Support infrastructure audits and ensure compliance with internal IT standards and operational policies.

**Business Information Security Officer (BISO) Responsibilities**

* Act as the primary coordination point between business/IT infrastructure teams and the central Information Security or CISO organization.
* Support the implementation of corporate information security policies, standards, procedures, and control requirements.
* Identify and assess information security risks associated with infrastructure, endpoints, servers, applications, and business processes.
* Support business security risk assessments and coordinate risk treatment plans with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor compliance with corporate security requirements and applicable regulatory or industry standards.
* Coordinate with business owners and technical teams to ensure security requirements are understood, assigned, and implemented.
* Support security awareness activities and communicate relevant security requirements to IT and business stakeholders.
* Support internal and external security audits, evidence collection, control validation, and remediation tracking.
* Escalate significant security risks, unresolved findings, policy deviations, and overdue remediation activities to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Support the assessment and approval workflow for security exceptions, ensuring documented risk acceptance by authorized stakeholders.
* Participate in security incident response activities and coordinate with the central Security Operations Center (SOC), IT teams, and business stakeholders.
* Support business continuity and disaster recovery planning from an information security perspective.
* Promote a security-first culture while balancing business requirements and operational priorities.

* Support security reviews of infrastructure changes, new technologies, and third-party service arrangements.
* Ensure security exceptions and deviations are documented, reviewed, and approved through the established governance process.

**Experience Requirements**

* **Overall experience:** 10–12 years or more in IT, with the required infrastructure and security experience.
* **IT Infrastructure:** Approximately 10 years of hands-on experience in enterprise infrastructure operations, administration, support, or management.
* **IT Security / BISO:** minimum 2-3 years of experience supporting information security, IT risk management, security governance, compliance, or BISO-related activities.
* Experience working in a medium-to-large enterprise or a complex, multi-location IT environment.
* Experience coordinating with infrastructure teams, business stakeholders, service providers, and central security functions.
* Experience preparing operational reports, management dashboards, compliance evidence, and remediation tracking reports.

**Technical Skills and Competencies**

**IT Infrastructure**

* Windows Server administration and troubleshooting.
* Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
* Endpoint and device management.
* Networking fundamentals, including LAN, WAN, VPN, firewalls, and wireless networks.
* Server and endpoint patch management.
* Backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
* Cloud infrastructure fundamentals, preferably Microsoft Azure or AWS.

**Information Security**

* Information security governance, risk, and compliance (GRC).
* Security risk assessment and remediation tracking.
* Endpoint security and EDR platforms.
* Security incident coordination.
* Security control assessment and audit support.
* Security policies, standards, and exception management.
* Understanding of ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and relevant organizational security requirements.

Candidates do not need to hold every certification. One or more relevant certifications would be advantageous.

 **Qualifications**

**Mandatory:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* Relevant professional experience in enterprise IT infrastructure management and IT security coordination.

**Preferred:**

* Master’s degree in information technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Equivalent practical experience and recognized professional certifications may be considered in accordance with company policy.

**Experience:**

10+ years in IT Infrastructure and 2–3 years in IT Security / BISO responsibilities

**IT Infrastructure:**

* Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate.
* Cisco CCNA or an equivalent networking certification.

**Information Security and Governance:**

* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.

Experience supporting web applications and data integration platforms.

title: HR Manager
description:
**About Prescient Automation LLP**

Prescient Automation is a well-established engineering organization, promoted by a group of engineers. Incepted from the seed of a single great idea – to empower the customer, with every Possible Automation solution under one roof. Prescient Automation is a team of engineers where excellence is not just word but a Habit. Founded in 2010; our main aim is to help the customer put automation into their Turnkey / Greenfield projects in new and efficient ways, through the delivery of our effective and timely products and services. Prescient is, where technology and engineering come together to create solutions for the benefit of our customers, driven without compromise for a world in action.

**Profile Summary**

An HR Manager oversees all aspects of human resources within an organization, including recruitment, employee relations, training, and compliance. They are responsible for developing and implementing HR strategies, managing employee benefits, and ensuring a positive and productive work environment. The role can vary depending on the company size, but generally involves aligning HR strategies with overall business objectives.

**HR Manager work responsibilities**

**1. Manpower Budget** : Defining Manpower budget in concern with management planning and future activities.

**2. Recruitment and Staffing:** Managing the hiring process, from creating job descriptions and posting job ads to interviewing candidates and making hiring decisions.

**3. Employee Onboarding and Training:** Overseeing the orientation process for new hires and organizing training programs to develop employee skills and ensure compliance with company policies.

**4. Employee Relations:** Addressing and resolving employee concerns, mediating conflicts, and fostering a positive work environment through effective communication and problem-solving.

**5. Performance Management:** Implementing performance evaluation systems, setting goals, providing feedback, and managing employee performance issues.

**6. Compensation and Benefits:** Designing and administering compensation structures, benefits programs, and ensuring competitive and equitable pay practices.

title: Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning
description:
At Aristocrat, we believe in creating the world's greatest gaming and entertainment experiences through innovation, and meticulous investment. Our success is driven by our focus on delivering value to players, customers, and shareholders. We are looking for a highly organized and analytically strong finance professional to join our Development & Design Finance group as a Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning. This role is pivotal in bringing greater structure, consistency, and coordination to our annual planning, rolling forecasts, and headcount planning activities.
  
  
For individuals eager to improve processes, promote alignment across teams, and ease complex planning cycles, this position offers extensive interaction with Finance, People & Culture, Group Finance, RCOE, and D&D leadership.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As Senior Analyst, Enterprise D&D Planning, you will support the core planning and forecasting operating rhythm for D&D. You will assist in structuring timelines, templates, inputs, assumptions, and follow-ups so finance partners and business leaders can plan with greater accuracy, consistency, and accountability.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:

* Support the planning and forecasting calendar across D&D, including annual plan, rolling forecast, monthly updates, and key submission achievements.
* Assemble and synchronize inputs across Finance, Studios, Product, Technology, People & Culture, Group Finance, and RCOE to support alignment and timely delivery of planning assumptions.
* Keep transparent trackers for forecast submissions, open items, risks, delayed inputs, approvals, and follow-up actions.
* Help prepare planning outputs that are consistent, comparable, and ready for D&D Finance and leadership review.
* Develop, sustain, and enhance headcount planning templates across D&D, incorporating role-level, location, cost center, hiring, attrition, and transfer inputs.
* Help establish a more structured operating rhythm for planning across D&D, reducing last-minute churn and improving transparency.
* Partner closely with People & Culture and Finance teams to align headcount assumptions, open roles, hiring timing, compensation inputs, and workforce changes.
* Create repeatable processes and controls that improve data quality, reduce rework, and make headcount planning easier to manage across cycles.
* Support clear variance explanations for headcount, compensation, and related cost movements across plan, forecast, and actuals.
* Find opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve planning and forecasting processes across D&D.
* Maintain planning documentation, process maps, templates, and operating guides to support consistency and knowledge transfer.
* Build trusted relationships by being responsive, organized, and clear on ownership and next steps.
* Support alignment across collaborators by bringing structure, clarity, and follow-through to complex, multi-participant planning cycles.

What We're Looking For
  
  
Required Experience:

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, planning, forecasting, business operations, finance transformation, project management, or related analytical roles.
* Working knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, headcount planning, and recurring finance operating rhythms.
* Strong organizational skills, including the ability to manage timelines, dependencies, collaborators, and follow-ups across multiple workstreams.
* Advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint, paired with a focus on detail and the talent to generate clear, accurate, and logically arranged work products.

You Will Thrive In This Role If You:

* Are very organized and enjoy simplifying complex planning processes to make them more predictable.
* Can balance detailed data work with project management, collaborator coordination, and executive-ready communication.
* Have strong communication skills and can make timelines, asks, risks, and decisions clear to different audiences.
* Build credibility through accuracy, responsiveness, ownership, and strong follow-through.
* Bring a continuous improvement outlook and look for ways to reduce rework, standardize inputs, and improve the planning experience for partners.

*This job description may have been reviewed and enhanced using AI-assisted tools to improve clarity, consistency, and inclusivity. All final content, role requirements and hiring decisions remain subject to human review and approval by Aristocrat.*
**Compensation Philosophy**
We offer a comprehensive pay and benefits package designed to stay competitive in the market, support your wellbeing, and recognise your contribution to our success. Our approach is underpinned by a pay-for-performance belief in rewarding individual impact. Your specific compensation package will be determined by factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location.
  
  
Depending on your role and location, you may be eligible for annual bonuses and incentives, health and wellbeing benefits, paid time off, retirement plans, insurance coverage, and other local or statutory benefits.
  
  
Specific details about compensation and benefits for this position will be discussed during the recruitment process.

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
About the Job We are seeking two People Operations Specialists to support day-to-day People Operations activities across APAC and other supported regions. The ideal candidates will have strong experience in HR operations, employee lifecycle management, payroll coordination, Workday administration, and employee support. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage sensitive employee information while working across multiple systems and stakeholders. Job Details Required Skills
  
  

* Employment Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor
* Department: Information Technology (IT)
* Job Level: Intermediate
* Experience: 3 Years
* Qualification:
* 3–5 years of progressive experience in HR Operations, People Operations, HR Generalist, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, and payroll coordination.
* Hands-on experience with Workday or a comparable HRIS.
* Experience supporting payroll operations and employee benefits administration.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to handle confidential employee information.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Fluent English proficiency.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including People, Finance, IT, Payroll, and business stakeholders.
* Experience supporting employees across multiple countries or regions is a plus.
* General Skills: HR Administration, Strategic HR Planning, HRIS Management
* Soft Skills: Attention to Detail, Communication, Critical Thinking, Agile Mindset, Interpersonal Skills, Confidentiality, Organizational Skills, Presentation Skills, Active Listening
* Additional Skills: English language proficiency (fluent), Regional employment law knowledge (India, Australia, APAC) Responsibilities Onboarding & Offboarding - Initiate background check packages and validate completion for employees in India and Australia. - Lead weekly in-office People Team orientation sessions for new hires in India, in coordination with the Office Manager and IT. - Oversee Workday onboarding tasks, ensuring completion of required new hire documentation prior to payroll processing. - Enroll new hires in payroll systems, benefits, pension, and other applicable programs. - Prepare and distribute separation agreements. - Process employee offboarding across payroll systems and benefits providers as needed. - Generate experience letters and final payslips for departing employees. Workday & Employee Data Administration - Review and approve Workday business processes for APAC employees, including legal name changes, home contact information updates, and leaves of absence. - Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in Workday and other relevant HR systems. - Generate employment verification letters, travel letters, and No Objection Certificates (NOCs) for employees in India and Australia. Payroll Operations - Manage end-to-end submission and approval of regional payroll adjustments, ensuring recurring and variable pay changes are accurately recorded and submitted ahead of payroll deadlines. - Pull and review monthly Workday payroll reports to ensure all applicable changes and payments are accurately captured for each pay period. - Prepare termination reports for India to support final pay disbursement within two days of an employee's final working day. - Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, and People teams to resolve payroll-related discrepancies and ensure timely processing. Employee Support & People Operations - Monitor and resolve requests submitted through the Jira ticketing queue, People Operations inbox, and local Slack channels. - Respond to Internal Audit and Finance requests as needed. - Partner with Finance and People Business Partners on employee communications and announcements related to payroll, benefits, and People Operations processes. - Provide timely and professional support to employees regarding HR policies, processes, payroll, benefits, and other People Operations matters. Salary & Benefits
* Pay: Hourly, $ 8.00 – 8.00 Additional Requirements
* Tech Requirements: Windows or Mac
* Language: English About the Company 1840 & Company is a global organization focused on delivering innovative business solutions that help companies grow, scale, and succeed. Operating in over 150 countries, we support organizations through a range of workforce, operational, and business services designed to drive efficiency and long-term success.

title: Analyst, HR Operations,
description:
**This is where**
your work makes a difference.
  
  
At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.
  
  
Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.
  
  
Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.
  
  
The future of HR Operations is being redefined at Baxter. Across the company, HR is unlocking new ways to deliver value — not just through processes, but through experiences that empower people and build confidence. This is a moment of transformation, and HR Operations is at the center of it.
  
  
We are shaping a world‑class HR Operations organization that blends scale, precision, and innovation. By harnessing technology and process excellence, we are creating solutions that strengthen compliance, accelerate change, and elevate the employee journey. Joining Baxter means stepping into a role where your expertise will directly support employees worldwide and help define what great looks like.
  
  
**Your Role in the Transformation**
As an Analyst in HR Operations EDM (Employee Data Management), you will handle complex Tier 1 inquiries, manage queue operations, and serve as an escalation point for junior analysts. You’ll ensure SLA compliance, support Workday transactions, and safeguard data integrity while contributing to process improvement and documentation. This role places you at the heart of Baxter’s transformation, where your expertise strengthens service delivery, builds trust, and enhances the employee experience.
  
  
**What You’ll Drive And Deliver**

* Handle escalated Tier 1 inquiries requiring deeper investigation.
* Monitor queue performance and ensure SLA compliance.
* Coach and mentor junior analysts on customer service best practices.
* Identify trends in employee inquiries and recommend updates to the knowledge base.
* Collaborate with HRBPs and Tier 2 teams to resolve complex employee concerns.
* Support quality assurance by reviewing call/chat interactions.
* Contribute to FAQ and knowledge article development.
* Lead team huddles and share process updates.
* Process complex Workday transactions and manage escalations.
* Manage end‑to‑end HR operations (onboarding, movements, exits).
* Support Workday data integrity, audits, and reporting.
* Create and maintain employee documentation and records.
* Support system enhancements, UAT, and automation initiatives.
* Maintain and update SOPs and knowledge articles.
* Provide input on decision‑making and process improvement ideas.
* Liaise with HRBPs and onshore partners on complex cases.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Excellent English verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven customer service experience with issue resolution track record.
* Experience handling escalations and difficult conversations.
* Strong knowledge of HR policies and employee lifecycle.
* Proficiency with ticketing systems and queue management.
* Coaching and mentoring abilities.
* Analytical mindset to identify inquiry trends.

**Your Background**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Graduate/Degree in Business Administration, HR, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in HR customer service or contact center.
* Lean certification (optional).
* Flexibility to work rotational shifts.

**Work Schedule**
This role operates on rotational shifts across regions. Working hours will vary depending on shift schedules, requiring adaptability to support operations seamlessly across Europe and the Americas.
  
  
At Baxter, this role is more than a position in HR Operations — it is a chance to be part of Baxter’s global transformation. As we redefine how HR delivers value, your expertise will support processes, strengthen compliance, and elevate employee experience across regions. The work you do here will not only drive operational excellence but also set new benchmarks for what great looks like in HR. At Baxter, you will grow, contribute, and leave a lasting mark on the future of our people and our business.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**
Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. Baxter evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, disability/handicap status or any other legally protected characteristic.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations**
Baxter is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities globally. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or interview process, please click on the link here and let us know the nature of your request along with your contact information.

To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

title: HR Manager Business Partner, APAC
description:
**Position Summary**
The HR Manager Business Partner (HRBP) APAC position strengthens our company's culture by partnering with practices to develop strategies that support retention, performance management and a high level of employee engagement. This role provides strategic and some operational HR support across work force planning, employee relations, talent development, performance management, training, and other key HR initiatives. The role includes oversight of the Talent Acquisition function, HR Administration and HR Business Partnering team, working with the Director of HR to provide leadership to develop the HR function as required. Experience of working in a global matrixed environment is essential, ideally in consulting or professional services.
  
  
This role is based out of the Gurgaon office will focus primarily on Milliman India for the initial 12 months.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work collaboratively with the broader HR teams to ensure that Milliman practices receive the highest standards of HR support.
* Builds the business partner relationship with executives, management, and teams; understands the business, goals, and challenges; and identifies and develops solutions to address systemic issues.
* Provides advice to executives and supports management teams in areas of organizational effectiveness, workforce planning, employee engagement, performance management, training, and development.
* Analyzes HR trends and metrics, including conducting exit interviews, reviewing turnover data and engagement results, partners with practice leaders to develop effective and consistent people solutions, programs and policies throughout the business.
* As a steward of the company's values, advises, influences and coaches to build and support a diverse, inclusive, productive and high integrity work environment.
* Provides guidance and input on restructures, workforce planning and succession planning.
* Coach and counsels managers on maintaining positive employee relations for a wide range of issues. Supports managers with PIPs and involuntary terminations. Conducts investigations in response to complex employee relations issues and recommends/implements courses of action based on investigation results.
* Collaborate with business leaders on employee development and talent planning decisions. Assists leaders with annual reviews and development plans for employees.
* Develop strategies for practices to leverage tools, such as our HCM tool, UKG, to help them grow their business.
* Produce HR-related information, on ad hoc basis, for the practice/discipline during the RFP process.
* Maintain knowledge of legal requirements related to the management of employees, reducing legal risks and ensuring regulatory compliance. Partners with the legal department as needed/required.
* Drive key HR team projects by taking a leadership role and managing project efforts including scheduling and resources as well as owning responsibility for holding project team members accountable for deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to develop and implement process improvement initiatives.
* Responsible for monitoring status, managing issues, and escalating when appropriate.
* Work with the HRST to ensure operational efficiency. Ensure Operational HR matters are dealt with accurately and effectively.
* Ensure POSH compliance and records are maintained, with any concerns being dealt with appropriately by the relevant team.
* Ensure that all HR data is managed with a zero tolerance for error or inaccuracy.
* Deal with annual review of all Employee Benefits. To work with Finance leader to ensure accurate maintenance of all employee benefits administration.
* Support the Performance Review Processes for local practices, ensuring that any performance issues are dealt with appropriately.
* Support the Talent Acquisition Manager in developing strategic partnerships across the local practices to support all hiring needs whilst developing solid talent pipelines for future recruitment needs. Provide oversight and support the end-to-end recruitment delivery across actuarial, technical and non-technical roles, requisition management, sourcing and interviewing through to onboarding.

**Skills & Qualifications Required**

* Bachelor's degree and/or relevant industry experience.
* The ideal candidate must have a minimum of 15 years' experience in resolving complex employee relations issues.
* The ideal candidate must have working knowledge of multiple human resource disciplines, including compensation practices, organizational diagnosis, employee relations, diversity and inclusion, performance management, and respective employment laws.
* The ideal candidate must have previous experience working in a matrix environment, ideally consulting or professional services.
* Demonstrates a professional and consultative approach when working with executives, leaders, management, and employees at all levels, with a strong ability to influence decisions, build alignment, and drive outcomes.
* Must have strong communication skills.
* CIPD or SHRM certification or similar preferable.
* Must have previous experience with organizational design.
* Must have the demonstrated ability to handle confidential and sensitive information as well as possessing skills to handle situations in a professional and diplomatic manner.
* Must have the demonstrated ability to manage and follow through on multiple priorities and assignments.
* Must have the ability to be flexible, but also to distinguish when appropriate to maintain boundaries.
* Thrives in entrepreneurial environments with a high degree of autonomy and variability, using strong judgment and adaptability to navigate ambiguity and differing approaches across teams and practices.

**About Milliman**
Independent for over 77 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
  
  
Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.

Drafting content such as agenda, panel questions, speaker briefs and event run-of-show. Creating cost model for budget. What You'll Bring
  
  

* Post-Graduate certificate in any field
* 5+ years of relevant experience into DEI / HR Ops / HRBP / HR Generalist / Employee Engagement

* Comfort with evening calls and operating across multiple time zones
* Good with numbers, Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook
* Experience driving cross-functional and regional initiatives

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of the AP people team, working with AP UP Senior Manager and AP Consulting People Team Executive Director. Your other stakeholders include UP Global BST team, AP System UP BST teams and other AP functional teams (e.g., recruitment, learning & development etc.)

* Attention to details, and have a strong drive for excellence
* Prioritizing and working flexibly in a deadline-driven environment
* Managing stakeholders, with strong verbal and written communication
* Crunching data for effective analysis of efforts, outcomes, trends and gaps.
* Interpersonal skills, working independently and effectively in a virtual team environment, partnering across functions, geographies, cultures, and staff levels within BCG

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

title: HRA (Associate Experience)
description:
**About this Role:**

The HR Associate supports business unit clients by providing first-line support for HR issues, concerns and programs. This individual is responsible for communicating and responding to basic policy and procedure inquiries, benefits questions, and training matters. Additionally, the HR Associate will assist the HR partner team with data analysis, change management and talent management activities, organizational design and compensation initiatives, and management of projects.

**What you’ll do:**

* Provide strong business unit partnership and general administrative support to the aligned HR partner teams and overall HR department.
* Takes initiative to respond to questions from associates regarding payroll, benefits, etc. in a timely manner and resolves routine problems.
* Support and execute employee lifecycle processes from onboarding through offboarding, ensuring accurate record management and a positive associate experience.
* Process and maintain personnel transactions within the Workday, including hires, transfers, promotions, job changes, and terminations.
* Maintain employment records and personnel files in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.
* Draft and maintain employment agreements, transfer letters, and other employment-related documentation, ensuring accuracy and timely updates.
* Assist with associate separation processes, including exit documentation and timely completion of final settlement activities.
* Provides employment verification support and responds to requests for employment-related documentation.
* Processes and analyzes HR data for reporting purposes.
* Provides project support for HR programs, initiatives, and change management activities.

**What you’ll need:**

* Bachelor's Degree
* 1+ years of relevant experience in administrative/operations in Human Resources
* Strong understanding of HR processes and the ability to apply business rules.
* Outstanding customer service skills and sense of urgency in a services environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to handle sensitive and confidential documentation.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple high-priority tasks simultaneously and meet deadlines.
* High level of proficiency in Microsoft applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint; familiarity with HRIS systems preferred (Workday).
* Strong report writing/data analysis skills and a solid understanding of HR and employee data.
* Effective research and project management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work as part of a virtual team.
* Demonstrated initiative and a strong desire to learn, with the ability to quickly acquire new skills and responsibilities.

**Who you are:**

* Individual who always understands the necessity for confidentiality and professionalism.
* Outstanding ability to multi-task as well as excellent organizational skills.
* Demonstrate a desire to learn and take initiative.
* Strong analytical skills and reporting capability.

**Who are we?**

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

**What do we offer?**

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Job Title:** Talent Acquisition Partner (TAP)

  

**Reports to:** Head of Talent Acquisition - ISC and GCC, Haleon South Asia

  

**About Haleon**

Hello. We’re Haleon. A new world-leading consumer health company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people. By growing and innovating our global portfolio of category-leading brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. What’s more, we’re achieving it in a company that we’re in control of. In an environment that we’re co-creating. And a culture that’s uniquely ours. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.

  

This is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future. It’s an opportunity to be part of something special.

  

**About the team**

Right now we’re on a journey to transform our in-house Talent Acquisition capabilities, and you’ll be joining and contributing at a critical point in our evolution. Your role will stretch you as we advise the business and stakeholders on talent strategies, truly living our values of Go Beyond, Do What Matters Most and Keep it Human where you will be seen as a trusted partner across the HR function and the business. The work you do will leaving a lasting and positive imprint on the candidates, hiring leaders and colleagues that you work with.

  

**About the role**

The **Talent Acquisition Partner** (TAP) at Haleon will be responsible for managing the full recruitment cycle for multiple functions and/ or countries. The role drives recruitment strategies and partnering with leaders and hiring managers to deliver top talent to the organization. This role will leverage experience and knowledge of recruitment best practices to attract and hire top talent while delivering a positive candidate experience.

  

**Key responsibilities**

* Acting as a talent advisor with hiring managers and leaders, to understand their business needs, develop effective recruitment strategies, aligned with business objectives, workforce plans, and diversity and inclusion goals.
* The role will be responsible for delivering on critical strategic recruitment mandates, including leadership and senior management roles.
* Manage the full recruitment cycle for functions, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management and hiring.
* Coordinate the offer process aligned to the company rewards policy, including negotiating salaries and benefits with candidates.
* Drive candidate engagement and a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Use data to drive recruitment decisions and provide regular updates to stakeholders, hiring managers and/ or HRBPs.
* Influence peers, mentoring other members of the recruitment team, providing guidance and support on recruitment best practices and process improvements.
* Ensure compliance with relevant employment laws, regulations, and internal policies throughout the talent acquisition process. Promote diversity and inclusion initiatives in recruitment practices.
* Identifies and effectively drive changes to local process, focused on continuously improving recruitment processes and procedures to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.
Partnering within the HR team on strategic TA initiatives and transformation projects.  

  

**Qualifications and skills**

  

**Essential**

* Experience in in-house recruiting or Search Agencies, ideally in consumer goods or related industry.
* Experience with recruitment technology, including applicant tracking systems and social media platforms.
* Proven experience managing and developing effective recruitment strategies.
* Strong knowledge of recruitment best practices and market trends as well as local employment law policies & regulations.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships within the organization and with the candidates.  

  

**Preferred**

* Organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
* Results-driven mindset, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Analytical skills, with the ability to use data to drive recruitment decisions.
Experience managing senior stakeholders and critical recruitment mandates.  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-10  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Talent Consultant- Associate Director
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Strategic**
**Talent**
**Consultant- Associate Director**
If you are looking for a rewarding career experience as a Strategic Talent Consultant in a high-growth organization, we have a role here. In EY GDS we value wellbeing, curiosity and agility as an individual. We create teams of inspiring, teaming and belonging. We care for our business, society and client. Our purpose is building a better working world. Does that resonate with you? We look forward to working with you.
  
  
**The opportunity**
As a trusted partner and advisor to the GDS Service Line/Functions, you are considered an extension of the business leaders, working closely with the leadership team to support growth objectives and help meet future talent needs.
  
  
You will build a deep understanding of both the business direction and HR/Talent priorities to ensure successful implementation of key high-touch people processes and initiatives.
  
  
You will also partner closely with the other Center of Excellence within talent function, such as Talent Attraction & Acquisition, Talent Development, Total Rewards etc. to ensure seamless execution of talent initiatives across the organization.
  
  
You will also be responsible for managing and developing a team of Talent Consultants to deliver exceptional services to the client stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with Talent and Service Line Leadership to align business priorities with talent priorities
* Translate the business strategy into practical and innovative talent solutions at the business unit level
* Advise the business on developing a culture within the business unit that underpins our values, promote high performance teaming and enables the delivery of exceptional client service
* Challenge and coach lSenior Management to drive change and support the implementation and successful adoption of projects and initiatives at EY Global/GDS level
* Guide business leaders in effective change management strategies and the deployment of change (e.g. for restructuring, acquisitions)
* Act as a coach to leadership in relation to delivering the people strategy agenda
* Champion GDS D&I agenda and embed within strategy
* Influence the Talent COEs in the development of best-in-class models and programs
* Facilitate change and support the implementation and successful adoption of talent initiatives within business unit
* Contribute to workforce planning activities in the context of understanding capability, skills development and manage workforce planning efforts to meet business unit needs
* Work with business leaders to develop and manage their long-term talent pipeline (e.g. Talent Review, Succession Planning, Partner and Executive Director/Director promotions process etc.)
* Manage the development of leaders and contribute to the design of career path models and development programs along with Learning & Talent Development Team
* Support the business unit in the development and retention of top performers, build a pipeline of diverse future leaders for the sustainability and success of business unit
* Be the Talent SPOC for the location

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong business acumen and commercial awareness, ability to develop clear, actionable plans in support of an overall business unit strategy
* Strong client focus with the ability to build good relationships with multiple stakeholders across the organisation at all levels
* Strong Employee Relations experience of complex disciplinary, grievance and performance management activities ,especially with employees in senior management/ level
* Motivate team members through effective monitoring, coaching, counselling and providing a positive working environment

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduate or a post graduate qualification in a Business or Human Resource discipline is desirable.
* 15+ years of proven HR generalist experience (e.g. performance management, employee relations)
* Experience in managing and mentoring teams

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* A professional accreditation or HR specialization certification
* Experience working in a consulting organization or in a similar professional services environment
* Experience of working in a cross-border, virtual environment would be beneficial

**What We Look For**

* Be an enabler of high-performance Talent team
* Keen interest to invest time for self-learning, seeking opportunities to work on cross-functional HR projects
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* A self-starter, independent-thinker, curious and creative person with desire and passion

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years of relevant change management experience
  
  
Locations: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida
  
  
Education: 15 years of full-time education graduate degree or equivalent, MBA/PGDM preferred
  
  
Certification: PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification preferred
  
  
Mobility: May require mobility to client locations across India
  
  
Soft Skills required: Structured thinking, Communication, Storytelling, Collaboration, Adaptability, Ownership, Flexibility
