title: General Manager
description:
**Company:** Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Business Operations & Management  
**Reports To:** CEO / Managing Director  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall business operations of Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd., ensuring operational efficiency, business growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and effective coordination across all departments. The role involves implementing management strategies, monitoring departmental performance, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that company objectives are achieved.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Business Operations & Strategy**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the company and ensure smooth functioning across departments.
* Develop and implement business strategies in line with company objectives.
* Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish policies, procedures, SOPs, and performance standards.
* Ensure coordination between the Head Office, warehouse, and other business units.

**B. Sales & Business Development**

* Monitor sales performance and ensure achievement of monthly and annual targets.
* Develop strategies to increase revenue, customer acquisition, and repeat purchases.
* Identify new business opportunities, products, markets, and revenue streams.
* Analyse sales reports, customer trends, and competitor activities.
* Work with the sales team to improve productivity and conversion rates.

**C. Marketing & Ecommerce Management**

* Supervise marketing activities, campaigns, promotions, and digital marketing performance.
* Monitor website performance, online sales, product listings, and order conversion.
* Evaluate campaign ROI, customer acquisition costs, and marketing expenditure.
* Coordinate with marketing teams to improve brand visibility and customer engagement.
* Ensure promotional offers and product campaigns align with business objectives.

**D. Warehouse & Logistics Management**

* Monitor inventory management, stock accuracy, order processing, packing, dispatch, and returns.
* Ensure timely order fulfilment and efficient coordination with courier partners.
* Review shipping costs, delivery performance, RTO rates, and damaged or lost shipments.
* Implement procedures to minimise stock discrepancies, wastage, and operational losses.
* Ensure proper warehouse documentation, stock reconciliation, and safety standards.

**E. Financial & Cost Management**

* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability, budgets, and operating costs.
* Coordinate with Accounts & Finance to review financial reports and cash flow.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor outstanding payments, COD settlements, vendor payments, and logistics expenses.
* Ensure financial controls and compliance with company policies.

**F. Human Resources & Administration**

* Coordinate with HR on manpower planning, recruitment, employee performance, and training.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and departmental staffing requirements.
* Ensure clear reporting structures, accountability, and performance evaluation.
* Supervise administrative functions, facilities, procurement coordination, and resource utilisation.
* Support employee engagement and the development of a performance-oriented work culture.

**G. Customer Service & Customer Retention**

* Monitor customer complaints, returns, refunds, and service quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and escalations.
* Develop strategies to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat purchases.
* Analyse customer feedback and implement corrective actions.

**H. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with suppliers, courier partners, service providers, and business associates.
* Review vendor quotations, service quality, delivery commitments, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate favourable business terms and monitor vendor performance.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for new product launches and business requirements.

**I. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Define KPIs and performance targets for departments and team leaders.
* Conduct regular departmental review meetings and track action items.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Identify deviations from targets and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure timely completion of management decisions and assigned projects.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of sales and revenue targets.
* Improvement in gross margin and overall profitability.
* Reduction in operational costs and logistics expenses.
* Order processing and dispatch efficiency.
* Delivery success rate and reduction in RTO percentage.
* Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock discrepancies.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat purchase rate.
* Departmental productivity and achievement of KPIs.
* Timely implementation of SOPs and management decisions.
* Vendor performance and cost optimisation.

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is preferred.

5. Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in operations, business management, ecommerce, retail, or distribution.
* Prior experience managing multiple departments and cross-functional teams is preferred.
* Experience in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, logistics, sales, and business development will be an advantage.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Leadership, team management, and decision-making.
* Strong business planning and operational execution.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Financial awareness, budgeting, and cost control.
* Sales, marketing, and ecommerce understanding.
* Vendor negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, ERP, and business management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work towards deadlines.

7. Authority & Accountability

* Recommend and implement operational improvements within approved authority.
* Monitor departmental performance and require corrective action where necessary.
* Review departmental reports, budgets, and operational expenses.
* Recommend staffing, vendor, process, and resource changes to management.
* Escalate significant financial, operational, compliance, and customer-related risks to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Ensure confidentiality, compliance, and adherence to company policies.

8. Working Relationships

**Internal:** CEO / Managing Director, HR, Sales, Marketing, Accounts & Finance, Purchase, IT, Customer Relationship Management, Warehouse, and Administration.

**External:** Vendors, suppliers, courier partners, service providers, customers, and other business associates.

9. Overall Responsibility

The General Manager is accountable for ensuring that Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd. operates efficiently, achieves its business targets, maintains cost discipline, improves customer experience, and develops a structured, accountable, and performance-driven organization

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**
We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!
  
  
**CloudSEK**
**,**
one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.
  
  
Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:
  
  
**CloudSEK’s Product Suite:**

* CloudSEK XVigil constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* A powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. CloudSEK's BeVigil uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.
* CloudSEK’s AIVigil is an AI-native Attack Surface Monitoring platform that continuously discovers, monitors, and secures exposed AI infrastructure, MCP servers, leaked AI credentials, vector databases, agentic workflows, and shadow AI across the internet.

**Key Milestones:**

* 2016: Launched our first product.
* 2018: Secured Pre-series A funding.
* 2019: Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* 2020: Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* 2021: Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* Awards & Recognition: Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* 2025: Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

The Technical Account Manager (TAM) is the primary post-sale point of contact for assigned accounts, blending commercial ownership with hands-on cybersecurity expertise to ensure clients realize continuous value from CloudSEK's platform. This is a travel-intensive role requiring at least 60% travel to customer sites.
  
  
The TAM serves as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders — from security teams to CXOs, CISOs, and partners — driving engagement through QBRs/ABRs/EBRs, while also acting as a security analyst who triages platform findings, conducts configuration reviews, and delivers actionable threat intelligence. The TAM also owns the account's commercial health: driving product adoption, running product walkthroughs, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and ensuring on-time renewals to reduce churn and grow NRR.
  
  
Success requires balancing customer advocacy with commercial accountability, coordinating with internal teams and partners to resolve issues and close wins, and channeling client feedback into product improvement — alongside contributing to team knowledge-sharing and training.
  
  
**Travel Requirements**

* Extensive travel role — at least 60% travel to customer sites

**Relationship Management & Customer Engagement**

* Manage and nurture relationships with assigned accounts, ensuring high satisfaction and retention
* Be a trusted advisor to clients
* Develop and execute engagement strategies for key stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs, procurement teams, partners/distributors)
* Foster customer champions to drive advocacy and referrals
* Source referrals and participate in revenue generation and customer marketing events

**Business Reviews & Reporting**

* Conduct QBRs, ABRs, and EBRs to assess and enhance customer engagement
* Triage platform findings and report threat insights to clients frequently

**Technical & Security Advisory**

* Provide expert guidance on threat intelligence, data leak prevention, and cybersecurity issues
* Act as a security analyst, offering insights/recommendations based on platform-generated threats
* Conduct configuration reviews and provide product enhancement recommendations

**Adoption & Product Enablement**

* Drive 100% adoption of CloudSEK's solutions with customer security teams
* Conduct independent product walkthroughs using battlecards/collateral
* Collaborate with the POC team for quick technical and financial wins

**Revenue Growth & Renewals**

* Identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities; own renewals and expansion in assigned accounts
* Collaborate with partners/distributors for smooth renewals and account expansion
* Ensure on-time renewals to reduce churn and increase NRR every quarter

**Feedback & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Gather and analyze customer feedback for product development
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive product and delivery enhancements

**Operational & Internal Contribution**

* Maintain accurate records of customer interactions/activities in CRM
* Share knowledge, conduct training sessions, and write internal articles

**What we are looking for:**
**Experience-**

* 3+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, in a client-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Security Consulting
* Proven track record of managing renewals, driving upsell/cross-sell, and owning revenue targets (NRR/retention) for enterprise accounts
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders (CXOs, CISOs) and navigating procurement/partner ecosystems
* Prior exposure to BFSI or other regulated-sector clients is a plus

**Technical/Domain Knowledge-**

* Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts — threat intelligence, digital risk protection, data leak prevention, attack surface management, or brand/fraud monitoring
* Ability to independently interpret security findings/alerts and translate them into client-facing recommendations
* Comfortable conducting product demos, configuration reviews, and technical walkthroughs without heavy pre-sales/engineering support
* Familiarity with SaaS security platforms and their integration into customer security workflows

**Skills-**

* Strong executive communication and presentation skills — able to run QBRs/ABRs/EBRs with CXO/CISO audiences
* Consultative, advisory selling approach — balances customer advocacy with commercial outcomes
* Analytical mindset for triaging findings, spotting expansion opportunities, and analyzing customer feedback
* Proficiency with CRM tools for pipeline and account record management
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills

**Other Requirements-**

* Willingness to travel extensively (60%+) to customer sites
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, IT, Cybersecurity, or related); relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, Security+, CISM) are a plus but not mandatory

**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**
We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:
  
  

* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.

And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!
  
  
CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Client Handling Manager responsible for managing existing client accounts, strengthening client relationships, driving account farming, and generating incremental business opportunities.

The individual will act as the primary point of contact for assigned client accounts, understand client business requirements, coordinate with internal delivery and recruitment teams, and identify opportunities to expand existing business.

The primary objective of this role is not just client servicing but also account growth, revenue expansion, client retention, and increasing wallet share across existing accounts.

- Ensure timely resolution of client escalations and maintain high client satisfaction.

**B. Account Farming & Business Growth**

Own revenue generation and business growth targets for assigned accounts.

**F. MIS & Business Reporting**

**-**
Maintain client-wise business development and account growth trackers.

- Prepare weekly and monthly account performance reports.

- Track active clients, active requirements, submissions, interviews, offers and joinings.

title: Senior Data Partnerships Manager I
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
About the role
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on technical customer success leader to be the go-to expert for Nielsen’s newest data products: Audience Builder, Data Driven Linear (DDL), data clean rooms, API-based offerings such as N1 advanced audiences, and the Media Data Engine (MDE).
  
  
Working from Bengaluru with clients and colleagues in the US, you will design how clients connect to our data, build the APIs, clean rooms and scripts that make it work, and help them get measurable value from it. You will also co-lead Quality 2.0, a program with Engineering that tracks data quality by its impact on customers, not just delivery metrics.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical solutions and client integrations
  
  

* Lead technical discussions with client data, engineering and analytics teams, and design integrations that fit each client's systems.
* Set up and troubleshoot REST and GraphQL API integrations, including authentication, paging, rate limits and error handling.
* Configure and query data clean rooms (for example Snowflake, Databricks), and support audience matching and overlap analysis.
* Write production-quality SQL and Python scripts and reusable code samples that speed up client onboarding.
* Run in-depth technical training for internal teams and client technical staff.

Product expertise and adoption
  
  

* Become the expert on a portfolio of audience and measurement data products, including their data models, APIs and main client use cases.
* Support audience workflows that combine first-party, third-party and Nielsen data, and help clients activate audiences in downstream platforms through the UI, APIs and AI-agent connections.
* Help media sellers, agencies and ad tech platforms use measurement data through APIs for planning, pacing, forecasting and deal reconciliation.
* Lead onboarding and adoption for new API-based data products. Deliver tailored training, define best practices, track usage, and turn client feedback into product improvements.

Data quality and customer impact (co-lead with Engineering)
  
  

* Build and maintain a quality scorecard that combines delivery metrics, customer impact and customer feedback.
* Analyse escalation trends and customer feedback to find recurring issues and their root causes.
* Push for preventive controls, such as automated data-freshness monitoring, more reliable reprocessing, and contract tests before each release, to reduce quality issues reported by customers.

Customer success and advocacy
  
  

* Lead onboarding for new clients, with demos, training and learning materials tailored to their needs.
* Track customer health and adoption metrics, and run plans to grow usage and retention.
* Represent the client inside Nielsen, sharing their needs and market trends with Product, Engineering, Marketing and Sales.
* Resolve complex client issues quickly by working with internal teams across time zones.

**Qualifications**
What you will bring
  
  
Must have
  
  

* 5+ years of experience, including at least 4 years in a client-facing technical role such as Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, Implementation or Data Consultant, or Technical Customer Success.
* Advanced SQL (CTEs, window functions, performance tuning) on a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Databricks.
* At least 2 years of hands-on Python for data work and automation (pandas, requests, scripting).
* Hands-on experience integrating REST APIs (Postman, OAuth/API keys, JSON, troubleshooting) and GraphQL APIs.
* Experience working directly with US or other global clients, including presenting to senior stakeholders.
* Excellent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Data clean rooms: Snowflake Data Clean Rooms, LiveRamp Habu, AWS Clean Rooms or Google Ads Data Hub.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.
* AWS & Data pipelines and quality tools: Airflow, dbt, redshift, monitoring and alerting.

Good to have
  
  

* Media, ad tech or measurement: TV/CTV, GRPs/impressions, audience-based buying, programmatic (DSP/SSP), post-buy reconciliation.
* AI and agent tools: LLM APIs, MCP or similar agent integrations.
* BI tools (Tableau,powerbi) and work-tracking tools (Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce).

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

description:

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced Customer Success leader to drive strategic relationships with Vodafone Business customers across Europe, the Americas and APAC. Based in Pune, this role will lead customer success activities for Global Enterprise accounts with contract values of approximately €10–40 million.
  
  
You will develop customer success strategies focused on improving retention, reducing churn, increasing product and service adoption and strengthening customer satisfaction. You will also manage high-impact customer escalations and engage with senior customer stakeholders through face-to-face and virtual interactions.
  
  
The role requires strong knowledge of enterprise telecommunications products and services, particularly Fixed Line and Mobility, complemented by experience across areas such as SD-WAN, Cybersecurity, IoT, SaaS, Mobile Private Networks (MPN), Cloud and Unified Communications.
  
  
Commercial and financial capability is important, including P&L management, account profitability and identifying opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling. The role also involves leading and mentoring a Customer Success team of approximately 10–20 members.
  
  
Working hours will align with customer headquarters, including APAC, European and Americas schedules. Shift working is therefore required. Travel requirements are rare.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive service development across Sell, Build/Delivery and Run functions
* Work effectively with internal teams, vendors and carriers across global markets
* Support digitalisation and automation of customer reporting using technologies such as Power BI, SQL and Python

Key measures of success include team NPS, account profitability, P&L performance, employee retention, customer experience and development of service strategy.
  
  
**Who You Are**
Essential experience and capabilities
  
  

* 8+ years' experience in Customer Success Management, including responsibility for global customers and face-to-face relationship management
* Strong telecommunications product knowledge, with in-depth understanding of at least two areas such as Fixed Line, Mobility, Cybersecurity, IoT, SaaS, MPN, Cloud or Unified Communications
* Experience presenting product and service performance to senior customer and internal stakeholders
* Ability to develop trusted relationships with international customers and represent Vodafone professionally
* Experience leading and mentoring customer-facing teams, setting objectives and establishing service standards
* Financial acumen, including the ability to interpret P&L statements and contribute to account profitability
* Understanding of budgeting and forecasting
* ITIL 4 knowledge and understanding of service capability across Sales, Build/Delivery and Run
* Understanding of transmission, LAN/WAN, MPLS Layer 2 and Layer 3, internet access, DSL, Fixed Voice and SD-WAN fundamentals
* Strong critical-thinking and data-driven decision-making capabilities
* Ability to manage customer conflicts and de-escalate complex situations
* Experience collaborating with vendors and carriers
* Strong communication, influencing, stakeholder-management and time-management capabilities
* Knowledge of Power BI, SQL or Python for customer dashboard automation and digitalisation
* Understanding of Agile or Scrum ways of working
* Bachelor of Engineering in any discipline
* Relevant technical/product certification such as CCNA/CCNP, AWS Solution Architect or Azure Fundamentals
* Relevant professional certification such as ITIL Intermediate, PRINCE2 Practitioner or PMP

**Desirable Experience And Capabilities**

* Sales experience and the ability to identify opportunities for cross-selling and up-selling enterprise telecommunications products
* Experience managing Customer Success or Operations teams
* Knowledge of SD-WAN architecture, MPN, IoT Connected Spaces, Automotive solutions and Device Management
* Advanced ITIL Service Lifecycle or Service Capability knowledge
* Engineering degree in Electronics and Communications or Computer Science
* MBA in Sales or Marketing
* Certifications such as CCNP Routing and Switching, Azure Administrator Associate, Meraki CMNA, Juniper Network Design Associate or AWS IoT-related credentials
* Proficiency in German, Spanish, French, Mandarin, Japanese or another European or Asian language

You will demonstrate strong customer advocacy, accountability, empathy, adaptability and resilience. You will be comfortable working across global, cross-functional teams, operating under deadlines and SLAs, and translating complex technical information into clear customer-focused communication.

title: Director, Engineering – Personalization & Recommendations API (PNR)
description:

FOX Corporation is looking for an experienced **Director, Engineering – Personalization & Recommendations API (PNR)** to lead the engineering organization responsible for building scalable personalization and recommendation platforms that power content discovery and individualized user experiences across FOX's digital products. You will be responsible for defining the engineering strategy, building and scaling high-performing teams, and driving technical excellence across one of the most strategic areas of our Digital Product ecosystem.

Our Personalization & Recommendations engineering team develops and maintains intelligent platforms that deliver personalized content recommendations, user experiences, and engagement capabilities across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV applications. Working closely with Product, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Platform Engineering teams, the organization builds highly scalable services that leverage customer behavior, content metadata, and machine learning models to provide relevant and engaging experiences for millions of users worldwide.

As the Director, Engineering – Personalization & Recommendations (PNR), you will provide strategic and technical leadership across multiple engineering teams responsible for recommendation services, personalization platforms, user profile services, experimentation frameworks, and content discovery capabilities. You will partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Platform Engineering, and executive leadership to define technology strategy, deliver business-critical initiatives, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

**A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead and grow multiple engineering teams responsible for Personalization and Recommendation platforms across FOX's Digital Product ecosystem.
* Define and execute the engineering strategy and technology roadmap aligned with FOX's Digital Product vision.
* Drive architecture decisions for highly scalable, resilient, and low-latency recommendation and personalization services.
* Build a culture focused on engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, Analytics, Platform Engineering, and DevOps teams to deliver strategic business initiatives.
* Establish engineering best practices around software architecture, coding standards, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, and operational excellence.
* Lead organizational planning including hiring, talent development, succession planning, performance management, and team growth.
* Mentor Engineering Managers and Senior Engineers while building future technical leaders within the organization.
* Drive continuous improvements in engineering processes, release management, platform reliability, and developer productivity.
* Balance feature delivery with long-term platform scalability, modernization, and technical debt reduction.
* Lead the development of experimentation platforms including A/B testing capabilities to support data-driven product decisions.
* Ensure recommendation services deliver high availability, scalability, performance, and measurable business impact.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate recommendation services across Web, Mobile, and Connected TV applications.
* Communicate engineering strategy, delivery status, risks, trade-offs, and business outcomes to executive leadership.
* Foster an inclusive engineering culture focused on ownership, innovation, customer experience, and continuous learning.

**WHAT YOU WILL NEED**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams or organizations.
* Proven experience building scalable backend platforms and distributed systems serving millions of users.
* Strong experience developing personalization, recommendation, customer engagement, search, or content discovery platforms.
* Experience working with Machine Learning Engineers and Data Science teams to productionize ML models.
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, APIs, and cloud-native application development.
* Experience designing and operating highly scalable services on AWS or similar cloud platforms.
* Proven experience leading Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, and Senior Technical Leaders in AI or ML area..
* Strong knowledge of Agile software development, DevOps, CI/CD, observability, and engineering operational excellence.

* Strong business acumen with the ability to align engineering investments with product strategy and customer outcomes.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience building recommendation engines, personalization platforms, customer segmentation systems, or content ranking services.
* Experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, and A/B testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with Machine Learning lifecycle tools, feature stores, and real-time inference systems.
* Experience working with streaming platforms, digital media, or consumer-facing applications.

title: Senior Manager, Application Software Engineering
description:
Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new application software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents that clarify application design and code. Leads application-focused code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project. Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix application issues across multiple components or functional areas. Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality, integration, and service-to-service interactions. Leads teams to design and develop application software, systems, and services. Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer use cases and align application solutions. Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding application-related issues. Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of the group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, application development best practices and processes, and coding standards. Ensures clarity of teams’ operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria. Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for application systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
  

**Key Responsibilities**  
**Application Software Development:**

* Leads multiple teams or a small group owning a significant application surface area (e.g., multiple services/features) with measurable reliability, security, and performance outcomes.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements.
* Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.
* Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas.
* Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
* Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
* Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
* Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**  
**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met.
* Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs.
* Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams.
* Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success.
* Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions.
* Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning.
* Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements.
* Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight.
* Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations.
* Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals.
* Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

title: Escalations Technical Leader
description:
Meet the Team
  
Join a dynamic, globally distributed group of technical program managers and escalation specialists who lead the charge on major security incidents and customer escalations. Our team is at the heart of Cisco’s unified security platform, partnering closely with engineering, product, support, and account teams to ensure customers are protected and critical issues are resolved quickly. With a dozen talented professionals based in San Jose and around the world, the team thrives on collaboration, ownership, and a fast-paced, high-impact environment. You'll work alongside distinguished engineers and leaders, interact directly with customer executives, and help shape the future of our security products. If you’re excited to solve complex problems, drive innovation, and make a tangible difference for customers and the business, this team is the place to be.
  
  
Your Impact
  
Drive the response to major incidents and complex customer escalations to ensure rapid restoration of critical services and customer satisfaction. Coordinate cross-functional teams, assign actions, track progress, and deliver timely updates to stakeholders, minimising risk and business disruption. Prepare operational reports, outage summaries, and follow-up actions to promote transparency and continual improvement. Partner with Problem Management to document root causes and implement corrective measures, preventing repeat incidents. Lead post-incident reviews, develop and refine playbooks, and leverage automation to enhance efficiency and organizational readiness. Success in this role means consistently resolving high-impact issues, improving incident management processes, and helping shape the reliability and resilience of Cisco's security platform.
  
  

* Lead P1/P2 incidents and complex customer escalations, coordinating cross-functional teams through resolution.
* Drive action tracking, ownership, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation.
* Lead post-incident reviews, root-cause analysis, and corrective actions.
* Improve incident-management processes, playbooks, governance, and operational reporting.
* Conduct crisis simulations and tabletop exercises to strengthen readiness.
* Leverage automation and AI to enhance incident response and prevent recurring issues.
* Mentor incident managers and engineers.
* Partner with Architecture, Product, and Engineering to improve reliability, resilience, and observability.

title: Lead - Distributor Markets
description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

Position Summary

Leads commercial sales for AbbVie products across distributor markets in Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka, and for a key customer in India. The role is accountable for delivering business objectives through effective distributor partnership, market planning, sales execution, forecasting and compliant customer engagement.

Working closely with commercial leadership, regional teams, distributors and cross-functional partners, the role translates brand priorities into market-relevant plans, strengthens route-to-market effectiveness and drives high-quality execution. It provides performance governance and actionable market insight while ensuring activities align with AbbVie standards, local regulations and distributor operating requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Market Strategy, Business Planning and Distributor Governance

* Develop and execute commercial plans for Bangladesh, Nepal, Sri Lanka and the assigned key customer in India, aligned with brand priorities, affiliate strategy and regional direction.
* Partner with distributors to translate annual brand and sales objectives into country plans with clear targets, investment priorities, milestones and performance measures.
* Establish and lead distributor governance routines, including business reviews, scorecards, action tracking and escalation processes.
* Identify market opportunities, access challenges, competitive dynamics and execution gaps; translate insights into practical initiatives to improve performance and customer reach.
* Monitor distributor capability, field reach, inventory health, channel coverage and execution quality to support business continuity and sustainable growth.
* Ensure distributor activities comply with AbbVie standards, local regulations, contractual requirements and ethical business practices.
* Maintain a strong understanding of pharmaceutical market dynamics and evolving access, channel and route-to-market models in assigned markets.

Sales Delivery, Forecasting and Performance Management

* Own sales delivery across assigned distributor markets, track performance against monthly, quarterly and annual objectives, and drive timely corrective action.
* Lead demand-planning and forecasting inputs with Supply Chain, Finance and distributors, ensuring assumptions are evidence-based and reflect market conditions.
* Review sales, inventory and execution measures regularly, identifying risks and opportunities and aligning stakeholders on appropriate actions.

Distributor Operations, Channel Execution and Access

* Drive effective distributor operations, including order planning, product availability, secondary-sales visibility, claims processes and resolution of operational issues.
* Strengthen channel coverage and route-to-market execution by identifying priority accounts, institutions, hospitals, wholesalers and customer segments with distributors.
* Partner with Medical, Regulatory, Market Access, Supply Chain, Finance and Compliance to enable market initiatives with appropriate governance and documentation.
* Ensure commercial activities, field-force support, promotional materials and distributor-led execution are consistent with approved plans, brand strategies and compliance requirements.
* Build distributor capability through structured performance reviews, execution coaching and reinforcement of AbbVie ways of working.
* Represent market performance, risks and opportunities in affiliate and regional forums, providing leadership with timely visibility and recommendations.

Customer Engagement, Field Execution and Capability Building

* Enable distributor field teams to execute approved brand priorities through high-quality customer engagement, clear call objectives and disciplined follow-through.
* Coordinate training and capability-building activities to strengthen distributor teams’ understanding of AbbVie products, relevant therapeutic areas, compliance expectations and customer engagement standards.
* Work with Commercial and Medical colleagues to prioritise key-account engagement, congress activities, scientific initiatives and local programmes within approved frameworks.
* Use field activity, customer feedback and market intelligence to improve execution, close capability gaps and focus resources on high-value opportunities.

Market and Sales Planning and Analysis

* Provide quantitative and qualitative market insights to support financial planning, S&OP, forecasting, brand planning and long-range planning for assigned markets.
* Recommend commercial strategies involving route-to-market improvements, channel priorities, access opportunities, pricing inputs, promotional investment, distributor capability and targeted customer engagement.
* Analyse sales trends, secondary-sales data, inventory movement, account performance and competitive intelligence to evaluate initiatives and inform course corrections.

Leadership and Collaboration

* Partner with distributors, commercial teams and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute plans across complex distributor-led markets.
* Use sales, inventory, forecast and execution metrics to assess performance and course-correct activity.
* Influence distributors, regional colleagues and affiliate stakeholders without direct authority.
* Drive accountability, collaboration and results across multiple markets and operating models.

Main Contacts

* Commercial Director, Business Unit Director, General Manager, Brand Teams and Sales and Marketing Leads
* Distributors and distributor field leadership in Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka
* Finance, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Medical, Compliance and Market Access teams
* Regional Commercial teams

Essential Skills and Competencies

* Commercial leadership and a hands-on approach to shaping market strategy and driving disciplined execution through distributors.
* Strong understanding of ethical sales and marketing practices, compliance requirements and customer-focused engagement in healthcare.
* Strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting and business acumen, with the ability to connect market insight, customer needs, access priorities and operational execution.
* Knowledge of distributor management, route-to-market models, sales execution, inventory monitoring, forecasting and performance management.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust and align internal and external stakeholders.
* Analytical, numerical, creative and conceptual thinking, including the ability to translate data and market intelligence into clear commercial choices and measurable actions.
* Strong personal effectiveness, including prioritization, responsiveness, flexibility and resilience; able to work with limited supervision and exercise sound judgment about when to consult, escalate or inform.
* A track record of driving growth, strengthening partner accountability, fostering innovation and delivering customer and business impact in distributor markets.

AbbVie Behaviours and Values

* Seizes market opportunities through insight-led decisions, identifying customer, channel and distributor priorities to deliver sustainable impact.
* Collaborates across local, regional and distributor teams, prioritizing resources to achieve commercial objectives.
* Builds trusting relationships, understands customer needs and embeds customer-focused practices in distributor operations and field execution.
* Develops strategic networks and partnerships, communicates with energy and clarity, and builds commitment to shared success.
* Adapts to uncertainty and change, works effectively with ambiguity and anticipates evolving market, access and channel needs.
* Acts with integrity and authenticity, promotes trust, remains receptive to others’ ideas and demonstrates self-motivation, creativity, accountability and innovation.

 **Qualifications**

Education and Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in Medical, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Business Administration or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in business, management or marketing is an advantage.
* 12–15 years of progressive experience in the healthcare or pharmaceutical industry, preferably in a multinational organization, with significant experience in sales, distributor management, commercial operations, market planning or channel execution.
* Experience managing distributor-led or emerging markets; South Asia experience, including Bangladesh, Nepal and Sri Lanka, is preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, manage external partners, coach distributor teams and build execution discipline across matrix and third-party environments.
* Experience in sales planning, forecasting, budget management, distributor governance, key-account engagement, access coordination and compliant commercial execution.
* Fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders and external partners in a multicultural environment.

  
**Additional Information**

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

US & Puerto Rico only - to learn more, visit https://www.abbvie.com/join-us/equal-employment-opportunity-employer.html

US & Puerto Rico applicants seeking a reasonable accommodation, click here to learn more:

description:
**Who We Are**

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Join Kyndryl as an Application Consultant and become a catalyst for innovation and transformation. In this role, you'll be at the forefront of driving change and enabling our customers to harness the power of technology to achieve their wildest ambitions. From revolutionizing healthcare to shaping the future of finance, you'll collaborate with a diverse range of industries, tailoring cutting-edge solutions to meet each customer's unique needs.
  
  
As a trusted advisor, you'll forge strong relationships with our customers, gaining deep insights into their business objectives and long-term aspirations. Armed with this understanding, you'll provide expert guidance on how technology can be leveraged to propel them towards unprecedented success. From aligning processes to technology to developing and deploying bespoke solutions, you'll be the visionary architect behind their digital transformation journey. Your expertise in application development and deployment best practices will ensure seamless integration and optimized performance.
  
  
In this role, your impact will be immense. You'll conduct thorough needs assessments, uncovering the requirements for new applications or upgrades to existing ones, and document these specifications with utmost precision using cutting-edge Business Analysis (BA) methodologies. Whether it's crafting comprehensive use cases, tracing requirements meticulously, or visualizing process flows, your attention to detail will be unmatched.
  
  
Drawing upon your exceptional analytical prowess, you'll gather requirements from stakeholders and masterfully translate them into functional and nonfunctional specifications. As the driving force behind our customers' application modernization endeavors, you'll guide them through every step of the process, ensuring their systems are future-proofed and optimized for success. Your expertise will also come into play as you assist customers in selecting and customizing the perfect packaged solutions to fulfill their unique business needs.
  
  
Collaboration will be your cornerstone as you work closely with application architects and development staff to bring your visions to life. Your keen eye for detail will shine as you analyze requirements, meticulously plan design and implementation work, all while adhering to time, cost, and quality targets. You'll consult with customers on compatibility challenges, such as hardware and operating system considerations, data conversion processes, and training requirements, offering them holistic solutions that align seamlessly with their budgets.
  
  
In this fast-paced environment, you'll have the exhilarating responsibility of helping customers choose between multiple applications, including packaged solutions. Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
  
  
Our consultants are restless for innovation. They are at the edge of technology, changing the way our customers implement business solutions – so, if you’re a problem-solver, an innovative thinker, and a self-starter with a passion high impact assignments which align technology to business outcomes, then we want to hear from you! Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.
  
  
Your Future at Kyndryl
  
As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
Required Skills and Experience
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in application development and deployment
* 5+ years in application migration and modernization
* 5+ years in application architecture, middleware and data experience
* Variety of technologies including BI, database principles, programming fundamentals, SQL, hardware/software, operating systems and networking
* Strong technical acumen & deep working knowledge of Agile Methods, Service Architecture, and enterprise Cloud Integration
* Strong ability to influence, collaborate and build relationships with key stakeholders, vendors, and cross-functional teams

  
Preferred Skills and Experience
  
  

* SaaS application implementation experience: (Oracle E-Business Suite, NetSuite, Infor, Unit 4, PeopleSoft, Oracle Cloud ERP, SAP, Lawson, etc.)
* Application modernization tools, e.g. CAST
* Experience in using and implementing DevSecOps processes
* Past experience in assisting stakeholders in quantifying risks and developing mitigation and remediation strategies

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Engineering Manager
Manager Product Development
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.

Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

We're hiring a hands-on Engineering Manager in Bengaluru to lead a team that owns production software end to end — from what customers need, to how it's built, to how it runs. This is not a coordination role: you will still design systems, review code and get into incidents, while growing the people around you.

Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Y ou'll help shape how this team works, who joins it, and what it ships. Y ou'll report to the Director of Engineering and work closely with Product, Program Management, Customer Support and business stakeholders.

**What you'll own in your first year**

  

* A team and its outcomes. Lead a team of engineers (growing as we hire) and own what it delivers — measured by what changed for customers, not by tickets closed.
* Hiring. Help build the team: define what good looks like, interview, and close candidates.
* Quality as a first-class priority. Set the bar for testing, release and on-call so the team ships often without breaking customers.
* Technical direction. Make and document the architecture tradeoffs for your area, and stay close enough to the code to know when a design is wrong.
* People growth. Run 1:1s, give direct feedback, and create stretch paths so strong engineers grow faster than a standard promotion cycle.
* Own: Own it end to end with Speed, quality, depth and long term vision.

**What you must bring**

1. You have led engineers. At least 2 years directly managing a team — hiring, feedback,

performance conversations, growing people.

2. Tech-lead: A tech-lead role for at least 4 years.

3. You are still hands-on. Y ou've designed and built production systems in the recent

past, and you can review a pull request or a design doc and find the real problem in it.

4. You've owned multiple systems in production end to end. A system or product where

you were accountable for it working for customers — releases, incidents, and the

follow-through after.

5. You've delivered under ambiguity. You've taken a problem nobody had fully defined — a new product, an inherited system, a team in transition — and turned it into something

shipped.

We care how you engineer more than which language you did it in.

**Technical background**

  

* You've built and run production systems with a modern stack, such as: Cloud: AWS — you've designed, deployed and operated services on it, not just consumed them.
* Languages: one or more modern languages such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Frameworks: modern service frameworks such as FastAPI, Node.js or equivalents.
* Databases, in depth: data modeling, query and index optimization, and scaling (replication, partitioning, caching). Y ou can walk us through a data model you designed and a performance problem you fixed, with the before and after.

Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome.

**What sets great candidates apart**

  

* Impact you can explain. You can name a result, the baseline it moved from, and how your team got there. You've also stopped or cut something that wasn't working. Teams you've grown. People you hired or coached who went on to bigger roles, and a team that got measurably better at shipping under you.
* Scale and complexity. Y ou've handled real load, real data volume or a genuinely hard domain — and can tell the story of one hard technical problem in detail.
* Inherited systems. You've taken over a codebase or product from another team or location and made it better without stopping delivery.
* Quality discipline. Y ou've raised a team's bar on testing, releases or incident response, and can show what changed.
* Cross-functional range. You've worked directly with product, support and business partners, and made scoping calls rather than just executing them.
* Framework mindset: You have a framework mindset and find opportunities to covert a custom implementation into a framework.

**What we look for in everyone we hire**

Whatever the role, we hire for six things. For a manager, each one also shows up in the team you build.

  

* Customer obsession. Y ou know who uses what your team builds and what changed for them. Y ou treat support escalations and on-call as signal, not chores.
* Impact over activity. Y ou measure success by outcomes, not sprints delivered or meetings run. Y ou'll choose the boring solution if it ships sooner.
* Honesty. You give credit to your team and are specific about your own part. You tell leadership bad news early, and you say what didn't work.
* Independence. Y ou don't need a roadmap handed to you. Y ou find the problem worth solving and get it done with little hand-holding — and you build a team that works the same way. Y ou will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey.
* Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: something you kept going back to, a craft you kept deepening, people you kept teaching.
* Depth. At least one system or domain you could talk about for an hour, down to the internals and the tradeoffs. Y ears in a role aren't depth; complexity handled is.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.  
  
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.

Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

TERADYNE, where experience meets innovation and driving excellence in every connection. We are fueled by creativity and diversity of thought and in our workforce. Universal Robots, part of Teradyne Robotics, is the world market leader in collaborative robots (cobots), making products that empower our customers and positively transform the way they work. Teradyne Robotics is a division of Teradyne and includes Universal Robots and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR). Our global R&D organization of 200+ engineers builds the software and systems behind every cobot we ship.

**Opportunity Overview**

You will join a team of talented and passionate engineers developing, testing, and optimizing the software and systems that let us simulate our robot platforms and the environments they work in.

As a QA/QC Engineer on the Simulation team, you will own the quality of everything the team produces — simulation software and services, 3D assets, rendering output, and synthetic datasets. Engineers, ML teams, and customers rely on simulation to make real decisions about UR cobots and MiR mobile robots, so correctness and reliability are not optional.

This is a hands-on role combining test automation, quality engineering, and a sharp eye for detail. You will build test strategies and automated frameworks that cover application functionality, asset quality, rendering accuracy, and dataset integrity, and you will work closely with simulation engineers, dataset engineers, third-party asset vendors, and the wider R&D organization in Denmark and Bangalore.

**Your responsibilities and tasks include:**

* Define and own test strategies, test plans, and test cases for simulation software, tools, services, and web applications.
* Build and maintain automated test suites — functional, regression, integration, and performance — integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop automated quality checks for 3D assets, including geometry, real-world scale, pivots, materials, collision meshes, physics properties, and naming conventions.
* Validate synthetic datasets for label accuracy, annotation consistency, format compliance, and distribution coverage.
* Build image-based and visual regression tests for rendering and sensor simulation output.
* Verify that simulated robot behaviour matches expected results from real hardware and reference scenarios.
* Define acceptance criteria and quality benchmarks for deliveries from third-party asset vendors, and review their work against them.
* Log, triage, and track defects, and drive root-cause analysis together with engineering teams.
* Define and report quality metrics that give the team clear visibility of release readiness.
* Write clean, well-tested, and documented test code, and participate actively in code reviews.
* Continuously improve QA processes, tooling, and documentation across the team.

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you're ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

We value diversity in culture, competence, and experience. We expect you to bring a number of qualifications to be considered for this role.

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3+ years of professional experience in software QA, test automation, or quality control.
* Strong programming proficiency in Python for building automated tests and tooling.
* Hands-on experience with test frameworks such as pytest, Playwright, or Selenium.
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar).
* Solid understanding of QA methodologies, the software development lifecycle, and defect-tracking tools such as Jira.
* Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Comfortable working in a Linux environment with version control and modern development workflows.

**Proficiency required in at least four of the following qualifications:**

* Testing 3D applications, game engines, simulators, or graphics software.
* 3D formats and tools such as USD, FBX, glTF, Blender, Maya, or Houdini.
* Validation of computer vision datasets and annotation formats (COCO, KITTI, YOLO).
* Image comparison and visual regression techniques (OpenCV, perceptual diffing).
* Robotics software, ROS2, or robot simulation environments.
* Performance and load testing of services and GPU workloads.
* API testing for REST or GraphQL services.
* Docker and containerised test environments.
* Data analysis with pandas or NumPy for quality reporting.
* ISTQB or an equivalent testing certification.

**Personal Attributes**

Candidates should demonstrate ambition, organizational skills, and adaptability. Independence, initiative, responsibility, and ownership are vital. A pragmatic approach, commitment to continuous learning, and dedication to work quality are expected.

**What We Offer**

At Universal Robots we set a high bar and in return we provide an exciting career in a fast-growing, technology-driven company where you work alongside skilled and talented colleagues from around the world.

* **Global team, local impact** — Be part of a world-class R&D organisation managed from Denmark while making a tangible difference from our Bangalore office every day.
* **Growth and development** — A manager with continuous focus on team spirit, employee development, and skill building.
* **Empowerment** — Ownership of your work and the products you help create; we trust our engineers to make informed decisions that benefit the organisation.
* **Health insurance and additional benefits.**
* **On-site collaboration** with co-located product and software teams, fostering strong working relationships and rapid feedback.
  

*We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.*

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

**Job Segment:** Testing, Quality Assurance, QA Engineer, Computer Science, Engineer, Technology, Engineering
