You will work closely with research scientists on world models and 3D scene generation, with ML teams on robot learning, and with application engineers who understand real customer deployments.

**Your responsibilities and tasks include:**

* Own the end-to-end technical architecture of the simulation platform, including physics, robot and sensor models, scene management, and scenario orchestration.
* Define and drive the simulation technical roadmap in partnership with product, research, and engineering leadership.
* Lead the development of high-fidelity robot models — kinematics, dynamics, actuators, controllers, grippers, and contact behaviour — validated against real hardware data.
* Establish sim-to-real validation methodology, fidelity metrics, and benchmarks that tie simulation results to integration time and fleet performance.
* Architect scalable, GPU-accelerated, and parallel simulation for reinforcement learning, imitation learning, synthetic data generation, and large-scale testing.
* Guide multi-agent and fleet-level simulation for UR and MiR robots working together in shared environments.
* Evaluate, select, and integrate physics engines, simulators, and third-party tools, and make clear build-versus-buy recommendations.
* Mentor and grow simulation, graphics, and software engineers; lead design reviews and set engineering standards and best practices.
* Represent the Bangalore simulation team in cross-site technical forums and influence decisions across Teradyne Robotics.
* Partner with product, application, and customer-facing teams to translate real deployment challenges into simulation capabilities.
* Contribute directly to critical code paths, prototypes, and technical spikes to de-risk new directions.

**All About You**

We seek individuals who share our passion and determination. Our commitment to customer success drives us to go the extra mile. If you're ready to join us in this mission, take a closer look at the minimum criteria for the position.

We value diversity in culture, competence, and experience. We expect you to bring a number of qualifications to be considered for this role.

**Mandatory Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field.
* 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 7+ years in simulation, physics engines, or robotics systems.
* Expert-level programming in C++ and strong proficiency in Python.
* Deep understanding of rigid-body dynamics, contact and collision handling, numerical integration, and constraint solvers.
* Hands-on experience with ROS or ROS2 and robot description formats such as URDF, SDF, MJCF, or USD.
* Extensive experience with robotics simulation environments (e.g. Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo, Drake, or Webots).
* Proven track record of architecting and shipping large, performance-critical software systems.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and influencing across teams and sites.

**Proficiency required in at least five of the following qualifications:**

* GPU-accelerated simulation using CUDA, NVIDIA Warp, or Isaac Lab.
* Physics engine internals and tuning for contact-rich manipulation (PhysX, MuJoCo, Bullet, ODE).
* Reinforcement learning, imitation learning, and robot learning pipelines.
* Domain randomisation and sim-to-real transfer techniques.
* Manipulator robotics including motion planning, trajectory generation, and collision checking.
* Mobile robotics including SLAM, navigation, path planning, and fleet management.
* Multi-agent or fleet-scale simulation and coordination.
* Sensor simulation for cameras, depth sensors, LiDAR, and force/torque sensors.
* Digital twin development and system identification from real hardware data.
* Distributed computing and cloud orchestration (Kubernetes, Ray, Slurm).
* OpenUSD scene representation and asset pipelines.
* Publications, patents, or open-source contributions in simulation or robotics.

**Personal Attributes**

Candidates should demonstrate ambition, strong organizational skills, and adaptability. Technical leadership, sound judgement, and the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both engineers and stakeholders are vital. Independence, initiative, responsibility, and ownership are expected, together with a pragmatic approach, commitment to continuous learning, and genuine investment in the growth of others.

**What We Offer**

At Universal Robots we set a high bar and in return we provide an exciting career in a fast-growing, technology-driven company where you work alongside skilled and talented colleagues from around the world.

* **Global team, local impact** — Be part of a world-class R&D organisation managed from Denmark while making a tangible difference from our Bangalore office every day.
* **Growth and development** — A manager with continuous focus on team spirit, employee development, and skill building.
* **Empowerment** — Ownership of your work and the products you help create; we trust our engineers to make informed decisions that benefit the organisation.
* **Health insurance and additional benefits.**
* **On-site collaboration** with co-located product and software teams, fostering strong working relationships and rapid feedback.
  

*We are only considering candidates local to position location and are unable to provide relocation for this position.*

*This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.*

**Job Segment:** Cloud, Developer, Test Engineer, Testing, Open Source, Technology, Engineering

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
### **The Opportunity**

This role is an opportunity to build high-quality, scalable software that directly enables real-world infrastructure deployment across telecom, energy, utilities, and renewables. You will work in a modern engineering organization where craftsmanship, velocity, user empathy, and technical maturity are valued. Success will be measured by the quality of code, as well as collaboration, communication, understanding customer use-cases, and uplifting engineering excellence.

### **What You’ll Do**

As a Senior Software Engineer I, you will design and implement end-to-end features by partnering with Product, QA, and DevOps to translate complex requirements into implementation plans and maintainable code. You would architect scalable solutions by designing and building performant, reusable Apex and LWC components, focusing on advanced asynchronous patterns and state management, lead complex integrations by overseeing the design and execution of inbound and outbound integrations, drive engineering excellence by drafting Technical Design Documents (TDD), breaking down technical specifications, and advocating for architectural improvements.

You will optimize performance by focusing on database query performance and indexing to ensure the platform handles increasing loads efficiently. You would ensure quality and customer impact by building software that supports diverse user personas and real-world usage patterns, while leveraging AI tools for refinement and deliver with autonomy by managing project scope independently, providing accurate effort estimations, and maintaining a commitment to meeting deadlines.

### **The Skills You’ll Have**

#### **Technical Expertise & Architecture**

* Designs and builds complex, performant, and reusable Apex/LWC components that manage state and interact with external system
* Deep experience designing and executing both inbound and outbound integrations.
* Apex Mastery: Implements advanced async patterns (Queueable, Platform Events) and consistently writes reusable, efficient, and thoroughly tested Apex
* Proficient in Git version control, managing pull requests, and executing standard CI/CD deployment processes
* Understands modern design patterns and best-practice development approaches
* Writes extensible, test-friendly code
* Advocates for architectural improvements that benefit scalability and maintainability
* Experience utilizing AI coding assistants (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate code scaffolding and refactoring, while maintaining strict code quality and security standards
* Understands how their component fits into the larger system
* Approaches debugging analytically, identifying issues across multiple layers
* Recognises knowledge gaps and actively seeks learning

#### **Quality & Customer Focus**

* Learns the “why” behind requirements and user scenarios.
* Builds software that supports real-world usage patterns including offline and low-connectivity environments
* Writes code that reduces downstream testing risk and future defects
* Thinks empathetically about multiple product personas

#### **Work Management**

* Strong commitment to meet the delivery deadlines
* High autonomy in managing project scope
* Handling competing architectural priorities across multiple projects
* Helps drive clarity during technical discussions and team execution
* Sets a collaborative tone rooted in humility and shared learning

#### **Communication & Influence**

* Communicates clearly, frequently and successfully in both written and verbal formats
* Adapts style based on audience both technical or business
* Able to present work and demo functionality to groups
* Communicates well in both in-person and remote environments.

### **Within 90 Days, You’ll**

* Become an expert in the functionality and codebase of several modules across the Sitetracker product
* Complete your Development Plan and be fully ramped on our technology stack and established design patterns
* Be a consulted contributor as part of one of our delivery teams
* Deliver several enhancements and bug fixes
* Know the ins and outs of the Sitetracker product offering as well as how to build and extend the functionality
* Begin working with other senior developers to architect solutions for our customers
* Know the development best practices and begin to help junior developers with questions about development practices
* Work with junior and senior developers to perform code reviews that follow Sitetracker coding standards
* Work with your manager to learn our deployment process

### **Within 180 Days, You'll**

* Have built and shipped large modules
* Serve as a technical expert for modules and features built during requirement and design sessions
* Collaborate with external teams to debug issues raised by customers
* Volunteer on initiatives that advanced Sitetracker’s developer efficiency and best practices
* Use your expertise to identify technical debt and deliver an action plan to resolve it
* Take part in customers meetings to gather requirements, understand use cases, and be able to explain your solutions in a simplified non technical way
* Architect End-to-End Solutions
* Written clean, scalable code with solutions that results in features adopted and loved by customers
* Serve as subject matter export to other teams for features that you have developed

### **Within 365 Days, You'll**

* Mentor junior and mid-level developers on development practices
* Drive efficiencies in the team by being an advocate for process/coding standard improvement
* Define standards for new technologies
* Develop large scale modules in a generic way so that we can extend and enhance the Sitetracker offering
* Lead engineering initiatives within the team that are focused on continuous improvement or leveraging new technology that significantly enhances efficiency, quality, or the user experience
* Develop strong industry expertise in the industries we serve to better inform the software you develop
* Serve as a primary subject matter expert for other teams in several areas of the application that you were not directly a part of
* Have established strong bonds with your team members that ensures efficient completion and building of features that our customers love

title: Engagement Mgr
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**What you get to do in this role:**

The **Engagement Manager** oversees the on time, on budget delivery of the defined solution scope to meet the customer's desired results. This requires the EM to complete the project following ServiceNow's leading practice methodology, NowCreate, working in collaboration with the customer project team and any involved partner, ensuring governance is followed to gain team member support for the project, including risk and issue mitigation. The EM is also responsible for assembling and leading the ServiceNow resources on the project making sure they understand the planned tasks, tracking actual progress, and managing deviations through appropriate measures.

* Lead the delivery team throughout the engagement, often in collaboration with a services partner.
* Manage the engagement governance, timeline, scope, risk, change management, resourcing, reporting, and financials.
* Work with the Sales Account Team, partner, and customer to understand the customer and the engagement; including challenges, partners, issues, and value being delivered.
* Understand the goals and align the deliverables accordingly.
* Apply expertise from the Now Create methodology and prescriptive guidance to promote delivery of the engagement, including long-term customer success.
* Be the single contact to encourage collaboration and customer agreement on proposed solutions.
* Mentor Customer Outcomes or Partner team members to achieve the engagement's deliverables and promote the customer's desired results.
* Identify gaps between actuals and plan of record, proposing solutions, escalating as needed.

 **Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 5+ years progressive experience as part of a professional services organization; or equivalent education/experience
* Ability to travel up to 50%
* Industry domain expertise in <insert workflow>
* Creativity with comfort running projects independently
* Experience driving complex issues through analysis and resolution
* Experience working collaboratively
* ServiceNow certifications in aligned workflow

FD21

In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. title: Director of Global Account Management - India
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

### **About JumpCloud®**

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

### **JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

### **About the Opportunity**

We are looking for a Director of Global Account Management to lead, scale, and inspire our team of 20+ account managers and 3 team managers globally through our next phase of hyper-growth.

JumpCloud is a comprehensive cloud directory platform solving complex IT and cybersecurity challenges for organizations worldwide. Because our platform offers immense expansion potential, we need a revenue-focused leader who thrives in technically advanced environments, is genuinely fascinated by the cybersecurity landscape, and brings a track record of selling or expanding technical products. You don't need to be an engineer, but you must love getting into the weeds of a technical product and understanding how it transforms our customers' security posture.

In this role, you’ll be an active, hands-on leader who leads from the front. When a customer calls, you’re the type of leader who remembers their account context, steps into the trenches alongside your team, and jumps on calls to drive value. You will foster a culture of supportive coaching and continuous growth, pushing your account managers to excel while setting the bar through your own actions.  
This role reports directly to the SVP of Global Customer Success and collaborates closely with executive leadership across Product, Marketing, Alliances & Channel, and Professional Services.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Manage** AM Leaders and the existing 20+ person account management team to aggressively expand accounts, unlock cross-sell opportunities, and spearhead customer growth strategies across the Americas, EMEA, APAC and India.
* **Actively engage** with JumpCloud’s evolving product suite and cybersecurity ecosystem. Help AMs effectively translate complex platform capabilities into clear business value for technical buyers (CIOs, CISOs, IT Directors).
* **Own** global Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and expansion targets. Drive aggressive upsell, cross-sell, and platform adoption strategies within our existing customer base
* **Define** best practices, programs, standards, and processes, including account planning, ABM, pricing, and QBRs.
* **Partner** directly with Product Marketing, Product Management, Alliances, and Professional Services to voice customer feedback, shape product roadmaps, and ensure a seamless, high-touch customer journey.
* **Connect** directly with customers at all levels to support the development of a strong Account Management function within the organization
* **Drive** the delivery of strategic initiatives in collaboration with sales, professional services and product marketing
* **Partner** with marketing to ensure consistent brand experience across all customer interactions.

### **You'll Be a Great Fit if You Have:**

* 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams of account managers
* A demonstrated track record of driving proactive expansion within existing accounts, consistently increasing ARR and securing upsells while retaining key customers
* 3+ years of experience selling a SaaS platform for a high growth US-based company into customers in multiple geographies (including Enterprise in the US)
* Experience working with technically complex software platforms and selling into technical customers
* Strong ability to inspire all levels of your team.
* Ability to listen, articulate positions, and advocate for customers. And, challenge assumptions respectfully and give and receive feedback with grace
* Creative problem solving ability to identify obstacles and viable solutions
* Outcome-orientation. Ability to articulate the desired outcome and work collaboratively to create a path to achieve it.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, facilitation, and presentation skills, at all levels of the organization and with customers

### **Bonus points for:**

* Direct experience leading sales operations/deal desk team members
* Domain relevant experience with IT-related technologies such as directory services, LDAP, RADIUS, SAML, MultiFactor Authentication, MDM, or similarly complex technologies

###### **#LI-KF1**

**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

**Language:**

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

**Why JumpCloud?**

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®. Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

**Scam Notice:**

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.

All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice"

#LI-Remote #BI-Remote

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Journal Manager-1026-CHN-207
description:
**Journal Manager**
**Do you like managing teams to deliver success for customers?**
**Would you like to manage a diverse portfolio of journals?**
**About Our Team**
Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Journal Manager, you will be the first point of contact for customers on a portfolio of academic journals. Your focus will be on providing excellent customer service and ensuring the journals run smoothly. With a helicopter view, you'll spot problems before they happen, putting solutions in place to improve the journal publication process.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Employing the highest level of customer service, act as the primary day-to-day contact for queries for internal and external customers
* Completing tasks and re-plan issues in Elsevier’s workflow management system, ensuring accurate and timely status reporting
* Preparing standard or custom reports as needed to society editorial offices and journal publishers
* Participating continuous improvement, working with colleagues to review processes and performance, ensuring high levels of quality and customer satisfaction
* Managing the process for assigned journals, providing editorial process support to stakeholders, and ensuring timeliness and accuracy to production schedules

**Requirements**

* Be fluent in English (oral and written) and have excellent all-round communication skills
* Have solid organization, planning and change management skills
* Show an aptitude for proofreading and excellent attention to detail
* Be proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Have a Bachelor’s degree in English, communications, journalism or related field of study
* 5 years + Experience in a customer service role

**Work in a way that works for you**
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.
  
  

* Working remotely from home up to 3 days a week and in our office in a hybrid style
* Working flexible hours - flexing the times you work in the day

**Working for you**
**Benefits**
We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:
  
  

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.
* Flexible Working Arrangement: Achieve a harmonious work-life balance.
* Employee Assistance Program: Access support for personal and work-related challenges.
* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)

**About The Business**
A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world
  
  
**We know your well-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click here to access benefits specific to your location.**

title: Operations Support Senior Supervisor
description:
* Lead staff of 20-25 associates
* Direct all activities in the department
* Consistently reach business-defined performance indicators with urgency and commitment
* Responsible for achieving and monitoring team quality (online and offline), customer satisfaction, meet/exceed business plan financial commitments (unit cost)
* Conduct regular process reviews to identify improvements
* Motivate employee performance and continuously develop talent though encouragement, feedback and coaching
* Serve as a role model in a culture of accountability, integrity and respect
* Promote an environment of open communication
* In case of quality/navigation specialist role:

+ Review and maintain quality standards
+ Share regular feedback to agents/associates and also train and coach agents/associates
+ Ensure proper capacity planning and maintain work schedules as per requirements

**Key Responsibilities:**

+ Operational Leadership: Oversee the daily operations of customer service team, ensuring optimal staffing, efficient chat queue management, and adherence to digital communication policies and procedures.
+ Performance Management: Establish, monitor, and achieve critical chat-specific customer service KPIs, including Average Response Time (ART), Concurrent Chat Handling, Chat Abandonment Rate, Quality Assurance (QA) scores for written interactions, and First Contact Resolution (FCR) in digital channels. Develop and implement strategies to enhance these metrics.
+ Team Development & Coaching: Lead, coach, and mentor team members focusing on effective written communication, tone, multi-tasking skills in a chat environment, and efficient use of chat tools and resources. Conduct regular performance reviews and identify development opportunities.
+ Strategy & Planning: Contribute to the strategic development and execution of digital customer service initiatives, including integrating new chat technologies, optimizing chat flows, and exploring AI/chatbot synergies to improve efficiency and customer experience.
+ Process Improvement: Identify areas for improvement within chat operations, implement best practices for digital engagement, streamline chat processes (e.g., template usage, knowledge base integration), and reduce resolution times. Drive continuous improvement based on data analysis and customer feedback.
+ Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as Workforce Management, Technology, Bot team and Quality Assurance to ensure seamless integration of chat channels and alignment with overall business goals.
+ Reporting & Analysis: Analyze chat interaction data, generate comprehensive reports on team performance, chat trends, and bot performance. Provide actionable insights and recommendations to senior management for strategic decision-making.
+ Issue Resolution: Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues encountered via chat, ensuring timely and effective resolution while upholding service standards.
+ Compliance & Risk Management: Ensure all chat operations comply with internal policies, industry regulations, and legal requirements pertaining to digital communication and data privacy. Identify and mitigate potential operational risks.
+ Projects & Initiatives: Lead and participate in various projects and initiatives aimed at enhancing the chat platform, introducing new features, improving agent tools, or integrating with other digital channels to elevate the overall digital customer experience.

title: BFS – Domain Consultant
description:
**About The Role**
As a Banking & Financial Services Consultant – Business Development, you will make an impact by driving revenue growth across our Banking & Financial Services portfolio, translating deep domain knowledge into compelling value propositions, managing complex sales cycles, and serving as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders in the CX-CRM space. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with consulting, technology, delivery, legal, and finance stakeholders as well as client and industry decision-makers.
  
  
**In this role, you will**

* Serve as the Banking & Financial Services subject-matter expert across Retail Banking, Commercial & Corporate Banking, Wealth Management & Private Banking, Capital Markets & Investment Banking, Cards & Payments, and Asset & Investment Management throughout the end-to-end pursuit lifecycle, ensuring proposed CX-CRM solutions are designed around KYC, AML, consent management, and data privacy requirements.
* Design and deliver customised pitches, RFP responses, and solution demonstrations that articulate ROI and strategic differentiation for retail banks, commercial & investment banks, credit unions, asset managers, insurers, and fintech organisations.
* Lead and coordinate cross-functional proposal teams and negotiate commercial terms, MSAs, and SOWs with legal and finance to ensure profitable deal structuring.
* Develop and execute account growth strategies across existing client portfolios, maximising wallet share and client satisfaction, and represent the firm at industry conferences, roundtables, and regulatory forums to elevate brand presence and generate qualified leads.
* Provide market intelligence on regulatory shifts and emerging trends across North America and Europe, mentor junior BD analysts, and maintain accurate pipeline data, forecasting, and CRM hygiene to support leadership reporting.

**Work model**
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Bangalore, Chennai, or Hyderabad, India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
**What You Need To Have To Be Considered**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline, with 10-12 years of progressive experience in business development, sales, or client management within banking, financial services, or consulting.
* Demonstrated track record of independently closing large, complex deals in BFSI, with deep understanding of financial products across retail & corporate banking, treasury, wealth management, capital markets, cards & payments, and asset management.
* Proficiency in consultative selling methodologies (SPIN, Challenger, or similar) and strong commercial acumen with the ability to model business cases and ROI frameworks.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and executive stakeholder engagement skills.
* Familiarity with BFS compliance and regulatory requirements (KYC/AML, GDPR/CCPA data privacy & consent, US/EU/UK banking and financial regulator guidelines) and how they shape CRM solution design and customer journeys.

**These will help you stand out**

* An MBA or CFA qualification.
* Experience with digital transformation, core banking modernisation, or regtech/fintech solutions.
* Certifications such as CAMS, CRCM, or CIPP/E.
* Working knowledge of CRM and digital platforms such as Salesforce Financial Services Cloud, Temenos CRM, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle CX for Financial Services, Pega, or Creatio.
* Fluency in emerging technologies including Agentic AI, Next-Gen AI virtual assistants, hyper-personalization, unified omnichannel journeys, and compliance-first, consent-based CRM.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Digi SC-Planning-Kinaxis-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting–Kinaxis Maestro Planning – Manager (8+ years)**
**The opportunity**
EY GDS is a global major in value-added Digital Supply Chain services for its clients. As part of this rapidly growing business segment, you will play a critical role in developing solutions, implementations, and performance improvement of Kinaxis Rapid Response. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your key responsibilities As a Manager in this area, you will:**

* Provide solutions proficiency to analyse and identifying gaps, to lead the solution design, and implement the Rapid Response application to meet business requirements
* Lead in implementation, configurations, testing, training, knowledge transfer and documentation activities
* Able to conduct workshops to understand end to end business process requirements and propose the best possible solution
* Deliver high quality client solutions that meet and exceed client/EY expectations and are delivered on-time and on-budget
* Manage client solution delivery, including defining project approach, motivating project teams, monitoring, managing project risks, managing client and EY key stakeholders and successfully delivering client solutions
* Identifying new business opportunities, including building strong client relations, understanding client needs and EY solution offerings, communicating client opportunities to EY leadership, and helping develop client opportunities

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Gather Business requirements/ lead design discussions with customer & business teams
* Work on Proposal and RFP’s
* Lead the implementation and enhancement of Kinaxis Maestro solutions across supply chain domains
* Analyse business requirements and Perform Fit-Gap Analysis
* Develop detailed solution design based on business requirements
* Strong expertise in detailed configuration and testing of Kinaxis Rapid Response planning tool
* Assist customer/business teams during UAT phase
* Prepare and Review project documentations

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Functional: In-depth knowledge of demand planning ,supply planning, Inventory optimization, Constraints Planning .
* Technical: Workbook development – Table based, composite, data modification, Alerts – Monitoring, Hierarchies & Filters, Scenario hierarchy setup, Control Table Configuration, Planning Engine Knowledge, Data Model modification including custom fields and custom tables
* Knowledge of integrating Kinaxis with host ERP systems through Data Warehouses for both Inbound and Outbound Interfaces, workflows, query development, preparation of detailed functional specifications for enhancements, layouts and reports etc.
* 8+ years of experience in supply chain consulting or operations role with proven experience in Kinaxis Rapid Response
* Prior Implementation experience of end-to-end demand planning projects using the tool Kinaxis Rapid Response
* Good understanding of functional and technical architecture to support working on data integration skills with multiple source and target system

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Working experience with Onsite & Offshore delivery model environment is preferred
* Engaging with business partners and IT to understand requirements from various parts of an organization to drive the design, programming execution, and UAT for future state capabilities within the platform
* Working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while managing multiple projects and strict deadlines
* Good understanding of outsourcing and off shoring, building win/win strategies and contracts with suppliers

**What We Look For**

* Consulting experience, including assessments and implementations
* Functional and technical Experience SCM Planning
* Documenting requirements and processes (e.g., Process flows)
* Working collaboratively in a team environment
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Kinaxis Rapid Response Solution Architect certification will be an added advantage

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Program Director
description:
**Job Summary**
The Program Director will oversee large scale strategic programs with a strong focus on budget management resource optimization and disciplined planning and execution. The role manages complex client facing initiatives ensuring profitable delivery high quality outcomes and alignment with customer experience goals in a hybrid work model with day shifts and no travel requirements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive integrated program planning activities to align scope timelines and financial targets while ensuring clear visibility of milestones for all stakeholders
* Manage program budgets by tracking costs forecasting financials and optimizing spend to achieve profit objectives and sustainable margins for the organization
* Oversee end to end program execution by coordinating cross functional teams resolving delivery risks and maintaining adherence to schedule and quality expectations
* Coordinate resource management activities by balancing workload optimizing staffing levels and ensuring critical roles are filled to support program commitments
* Monitor key performance indicators across scope schedule cost and quality to provide timely status updates and actionable insights to senior stakeholders
* Engage with client teams to understand business objectives capture evolving expectations and translate customer experience needs into pragmatic delivery roadmaps
* Implement governance routines including steering forums risk reviews and issue tracking to maintain transparency accountability and timely decision making across the program
* Drive continuous improvement by analyzing delivery data identifying patterns in delays or defects and implementing corrective actions to enhance program efficiency
* Support change management by assessing impact on teams and systems planning adoption activities and ensuring that changes are introduced with minimal disruption to operations
* Collaborate with technology and business partners to ensure that program outcomes are aligned with enterprise strategies and generate measurable value for end customers
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies and regulatory guidelines by embedding required controls and documentation practices into daily program operations
* Foster a culture of collaboration and accountability within the program environment to encourage open communication timely risk escalation and a strong focus on customer value
* Utilize wealth management domain knowledge where applicable to interpret client requirements align solutions with advisory processes and improve outcomes for end investors
* Drive hybrid work practices by defining clear ceremonies communication channels and work agreements that support distributed teams operating in a day shift environment

**Qualifications**

* Require extensive experience in managing large programs with responsibility for cost control profit realization and financial performance within complex environments
* Require proven expertise in resource planning capacity management and workforce optimization to ensure that critical skills are available at the right time for program delivery
* Require strong capability in program planning and scheduling including creation of integrated roadmaps dependency maps and realistic release plans for multi team initiatives
* Require hands on experience in program execution with accountability for meeting client commitments managing scope changes and maintaining high levels of delivery quality
* Require demonstrated success as a customer experience focused program manager who can balance user needs operational constraints and business outcomes in each release
* Nice to have experience in wealth management or related financial services domains to better understand client journeys regulatory considerations and product operating models
* Require strong communication and stakeholder management skills to interact with senior executives cross functional teams and client representatives in a clear and structured manner
* Require familiarity with hybrid work models and collaboration tooling to effectively coordinate distributed teams ensure clarity of responsibilities and maintain productivity
* Require a track record of mentoring and supporting team members to build program management capabilities encourage accountability and promote continuous improvement across engagements

**Certifications Required**
Preferred certifications include Project Management Professional PMP or Program Management certification such as MSP or PgMP relevant to large scale program delivery

title: Journal Manager-1026-CHN-207
description:
**Journal Manager**

  

**Do you like managing teams to deliver success for customers?**

**Would you like to manage a diverse portfolio of journals?**

  

**About our Team**

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

**About the Role**

As a Journal Manager, you will be the first point of contact for customers on a portfolio of academic journals. Your focus will be on providing excellent customer service and ensuring the journals run smoothly. With a helicopter view, you'll spot problems before they happen, putting solutions in place to improve the journal publication process.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

* Employing the highest level of customer service, act as the primary day-to-day contact for queries for internal and external customers

* Completing tasks and re-plan issues in Elsevier’s workflow management system, ensuring accurate and timely status reporting

* Preparing standard or custom reports as needed to society editorial offices and journal publishers

* Participating continuous improvement, working with colleagues to review processes and performance, ensuring high levels of quality and customer satisfaction

* Managing the process for assigned journals, providing editorial process support to stakeholders, and ensuring timeliness and accuracy to production schedules

**Requirements**

* Be fluent in English (oral and written) and have excellent all-round communication skills
* Have solid organization, planning and change management skills
* Show an aptitude for proofreading and excellent attention to detail
* Be proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
* Have a Bachelor’s degree in English, communications, journalism or related field of study
* 5 years + Experience in a customer service role
  

**Work in a way that works for you**

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organisation. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

* Working remotely from home up to 3 days a week and in our office in a hybrid style
* Working flexible hours - flexing the times you work in the day
  

**Working for you**

We know that your wellbeing and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:

* Comprehensive Health Insurance: Covers you, your immediate family, and parents.
* Enhanced Health Insurance Options: Competitive rates negotiated by the company.
* Group Life Insurance: Ensuring financial security for your loved ones.
* Group Accident Insurance: Extra protection for accidental death and permanent disablement.

* Medical Screening: Your well-being is a top priority.
* Modern Family Benefits: Maternity, paternity, and adoption support.
* Long-Service Awards: Recognizing dedication and commitment.
* New Baby Gift: Celebrating the joy of parenthood.
* Subsidized Meals in Chennai: Enjoy delicious meals at discounted rates.
* Various Paid Time Off: Take time off with Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Privilege Leave, Compassionate Leave, Special Sick Leave, and Gazetted Public Holidays.
* Free Transport pick up and drop from the home -office - home (applies in Chennai)
  

**About the Business**

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals' advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world

title: Client Partner
description:
**Role: Client Partner - Growth & Business Development**

Location: [Delhi, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Kolkata, Chennai, Hyderabad, Ahmadabad]

Employment Type: Full-Time

Reports To: [Sales Manager]

Experience: 1-3 years

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a motivated Client Partner to join our growing sales team. This is a ground-floor opportunity for someone who wants to build a long-term career in business development and leadership. As a client Partner, you will identify new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, present our services, and convert prospects into long-term customers. High performers will follow a structured growth roadmap toward a State Head leadership role within approximately one year, based on defined performance milestones.

Client Partner roles typically involve new-business development, client relationship management, sales-cycle ownership, and revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, contact, and qualify prospective clients through field visits, calls, referrals and digital channels.
* Understand client requirements and recommend suitable products or services.
* Prepare and deliver clear presentations, proposals, and quotations.
* Build trust-based, long-term relationships with clients and decision-makers.
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.

**What We Offer**

* Manage the complete sales cycle: prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, closing, and onboarding.
* Maintain accurate client records, pipeline updates, and sales reports in the CRM.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery and client satisfaction.
* Represent the company professionally in the market and protect its brand reputation.
* Participate in sales reviews, training sessions, and business-planning meetings.
* Market-standard fixed salary, paid on time.
* A clear and transparent incentive structure, explained before joining.
* Family trips and recognition rewards based on target achievement.
* Health insurance coverage for employees, as per company policy.
* Sales training, product training, CRM tools, and continuous coaching.
* A defined career roadmap from Client Partner to Senior Client Partner, Team Lead and State Head.
* A performance-driven culture where achievement is recognized and rewarded.

**Career Growth Roadmap:**

Client Partner → Months 0–3 → Training, market onboarding, pipeline building,

initial closures

Senior Client Partner → Months 4–8 → Consistent target achievement and stronger client

portfolio

Team Lead / Assistant State Head → Months 9–12 → Territory ownership, team support, revenue accountability

State Head → 12+ months → State-level strategy, team leadership, and market

expansion

*Promotion to State Head will be based on achievement of revenue, client-acquisition, consistency, and leadership readiness milestones. \**

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is confident, disciplined, and genuinely interested in building a sales career.

**Education**

* B.Sc. in Computer Science is preferred.
* MBA in Marketing or a related field is preferred.
* Candidates with equivalent qualifications and relevant sales, business development, marketing, or client-facing experience may also apply.

A background in computer science, business, marketing, or a related discipline is commonly preferred for client facing and business-development roles; MBA qualifications are often listed as preferred rather than mandatory.

**Experience**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales, business development, client servicing, marketing, or customer relationship management.
* Prior experience in IT services, software, digital solutions, consulting, or B2B sales will be an added advantage.

**Skills Required**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to understand client needs and offer suitable solutions.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and comfortable with field work.
* Basic knowledge of CRM tools, MS Office, and email communication.
* Willingness to learn about technology-driven products and services.
* Professional appearance, positive attitude, and strong follow-up discipline.

**Success in This Role Looks Like**

* Building a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects.
* Converting leads into paying clients.
* Maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
* Meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly targets.
* Growing into a leadership role through consistent performance.

**How to Apply**

**1. Apply Through Our Website**

* Visit www.aasint.com
* Open the Careers section.
* Select the Client Partner job posting.
* Follow the application instructions.

**2. Apply by Email**

* Send your updated CV/resume to hr@aasint.com.
* Subject: Application - Client Partner - [Preferred City]
* Include a short note about your skills and experience.
* Freshers with strong communication skills are welcome.
* Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by HR.

*T&C\*: Preference will be given to candidates who are currently residing in the city for which they are applying.*

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹450,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chennai, Tamil Nadu

description:

title: Manager, Software Development Engineering
description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.

**About the Team**

Do you want to lead the team building the next generation of enterprise tooling that makes adopting Workday features faster, easier, and more reliable for our customers and implementation partners?
  
  
As a Manager, Software Development Engineering in DT (Deployment Technology), you will lead a team that designs and builds scalable tools to help customers move their data and configuration objects into Workday environments with confidence. You'll combine technical leadership, people management, and product-focused thinking to deliver modern platform capabilities that simplify deployment, improve adoption, and create a better implementation experience. Your team's work directly helps customers realize value from Workday more quickly.

**About the Role**

You will lead engineering teams working across multiple programming languages, technologies, and platforms, guiding the delivery of high-quality software that supports customer deployments and configuration movement across Workday environments.

  

**Team leadership**

* Mentor and develop your engineers, support their career growth, and build a positive, inclusive, high-performing team
* Hire and retain strong talent, set clear expectations, and give regular, honest feedback
* Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and accountability

**Delivery and operational excellence**

* Align technical execution with business priorities, and give your team the clarity, direction, and support to deliver
* Plan and deliver complex technical initiatives by ensuring requirements are well understood, risks are managed, and dependencies are coordinated
* Own the reliability, performance, and supportability of your team's services in production, including incident response and continuous improvement
* Hold your team to high standards for quality, predictable delivery, and operational readiness
* Plan capacity and priorities so your team can deliver sustainably

**Stakeholder partnership and communication**

* Partner with engineering, product, customer success, and implementation teams to define priorities and shape the roadmap
* Influence architectural and technical decisions, and build alignment across teams
* Communicate proactively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, surfacing progress, risks, and trade-offs early rather than waiting to be asked

**About You**

Basic Qualifications:
  

* 3+ years of experience building and directly managing engineering teams
* 8+ years of software development experience building cloud-based applications in an object-oriented language such as Java, Python, C#, or C++
* Experience owning delivery and production operations for software services, in partnership with product and other cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree in a computer-related field, or equivalent work experience

  
Other Qualifications:

* You see software development as a team sport and thrive in a collaborative, agile culture where you're always guiding and learning
* You focus on delivering high-quality software and continuous innovation, and you value performance engineering
* You're proactive and deliver on the initiatives you start
* You have the interpersonal skills to positively influence important decisions in a multi-functional environment
* You communicate technical complexity in simple terms to technical and non-technical audiences
* You have experience supporting team members' career growth and development
You put people first and ensure a psychologically safe environment for your team  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**

With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.

title: Solution Manager
description:
Greetings from Xerago,

Xerago is a global AI-driven digital impact consulting, products, and services company

We are looking for a **Solutions Manager / Team Lead** to lead and manage the Solutions Team, supporting the Sales and Account Management teams in acquiring new customers and growing revenue from existing customers. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in pre-sales and solutioning, a solid understanding of the sales process, and the ability to work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams with diligence and ownership.

The candidate should be passionate about exploring new technologies, understanding customer challenges, and translating business requirements into compelling, differentiated, and commercially viable solutions.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Team Management**

* Lead and guide the Pre-sales / Solutions team in preparing **strategy and pitch presentations, approach notes, Statements of Work (SOW), proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and other sales enablement materials**.
* Manage, mentor, and develop Solutions team members, ensuring quality, productivity, and timely delivery.
* Ensure high team morale, collaboration, and strong bonding within the team and with Sales, Account Management, and Practice teams.
* Standardize solutioning and pre-sales artifacts for reuse, faster turnaround, and improved quality.
* Ensure solution artifacts, templates, case studies, and collaterals are continuously updated with the latest capabilities, offerings, and market trends.

**Pre-Sales & Solutioning**

* Ensure timely delivery of sales support and solutioning materials to enable the Sales and Account Management teams.
* Lead **discovery workshops** with prospects and clients, working with team members and Practice teams to understand business challenges, identify opportunities, and define the scope of work.
* Translate customer business requirements into **solution approaches, service offerings, high-level architectures, workflows, and implementation roadmaps**.
* Demonstrate ownership by proactively supporting Sales and Account Management teams with insights, solution recommendations, and value propositions to navigate sales conversations and close opportunities effectively.
* Collaborate with Practice teams to understand technical capabilities, feasibility, effort requirements, dependencies, and delivery considerations.
* Support **effort estimation, resource planning, pricing, commercial modelling, and proposal development**.
* Review and ensure the quality, relevance, and commercial viability of solutions before they are presented to customers.

**Sales & Account Growth**

* Work closely with Sales and Account Management teams to identify, qualify, and develop new opportunities.
* Chart clear plans toward achieving company objectives and proactively collaborate with Sales, Account Management, and Practice teams to create and expand opportunities.
* Drive **account mapping and account growth planning** by identifying potential areas for cross-sell, upsell, and new solution adoption.
* Provide strategic inputs to sales teams based on customer business needs, industry trends, technology developments, and the company's capabilities.
* Participate in customer meetings, presentations, solution walkthroughs, negotiations, and executive discussions as required.
* Support the sales team throughout the opportunity lifecycle, from **discovery and qualification through solutioning, proposal, negotiation, and closure**.

**Collateral & Solution Development**

* Continuously improve the quality and effectiveness of sales collaterals and solutions to increase the **pre-sales win rate**.
* Apply customer-centric thinking and innovation to develop differentiated solution propositions.
* Actively contribute to the creation of **new solutions, accelerators, frameworks, offerings, and reusable solution components**.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies, digital trends, industry developments, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for innovation.
* Work with Practice teams to convert technical capabilities into commercially relevant and customer-focused solutions.

**Requirements & Skills**

* **6–10 years of experience in Pre-sales / Solutions / Solution Consulting** in a MarTech, Digital Services, Technology Consulting, or Digital Transformation company.
* At least **2 years of experience managing or leading a Solutions / Pre-sales team**.
* First-hand experience in **account planning, opportunity shaping, discovery workshops, pitch development, SOW creation, proposal development, and RFP/RFI responses**.
* Strong understanding of **MarTech, Digital Marketing, Analytics, Commerce, Customer Experience, Content Management/CMS, AI/ML, and Digital Transformation**.
* Good understanding of platforms and technologies such as **Adobe Experience Cloud, AEM, AEP, CDP, CRM, Marketing Automation, Analytics, Commerce, or equivalent enterprise platforms** is preferred.
* Ability to understand customer business challenges and **conceptualize end-to-end solutions** by combining multiple technology and service capabilities.
* Ability to create high-level **solution architecture, process flows, integration diagrams, and solution workflows** based on inputs from Practice and Engineering teams.
* Proven experience using **whiteboarding and solution visualization tools** to communicate solution concepts effectively.
* Strong commercial understanding, including **effort estimation, pricing, resource planning, scope definition, and proposal costing**.
* Excellent presentation, communication, storytelling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong documentation skills with **Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Excel**.
* Ability to confidently interact with **Sales, Account Management, Practice Heads, Architects, Delivery Leaders, senior management, and customer stakeholders**.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
* Passion for exploring **new technologies, digital trends, industry innovations, and emerging solution opportunities**.

**Key Success Measures**

* Pre-sales opportunity conversion / win rate
* Quality and turnaround time of proposals, SOWs, and RFP responses
* Revenue generated from supported opportunities
* New opportunities created through solutioning initiatives
* Account growth / cross-sell / upsell contribution
* Quality and adoption of reusable solution artifacts
* Customer and Sales/Account Management satisfaction
* Team productivity, capability development, and collaboration

Property Manager

The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property-management files.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of client outcomes, manage multiple properties and files simultaneously, and communicate professionally with property owners, tenants, internal teams and service providers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process-driven property-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.

**Requirements**

* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task-management system.
* Strong follow-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Direct property-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high-volume, service-based, operations-heavy or SLA-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.

Remote Technology Requirements
  
  

* Dual-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls

title: Front Office Manager
description:

Community Manager

**Reporting To:**
General Manager

**Functional Reporting:**
Assistant Director – Community

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

The Community Manager is the primary owner of the member experience at the club. This role leads day-to-day community operations, member engagement, renewals execution, and onboarding delivery, while coordinating closely with internal teams to ensure consistent service standards across all member touchpoints.

This is an execution-led role. While supported by Corporate Community for structure, tracking, and guidance, the Community Manager owns on-ground delivery, real-time decision-making, and outcomes at the unit.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Member Engagement & Relationships***

* Own member engagement at the unit, ensuring members feel recognised, welcomed, and valued at all times.
* Act as the face of the Community team on the floor, building strong relationships through regular interaction and personalised engagement.
* Maintain accurate member profiles, preferences, and interaction notes to enable personalised experiences.
* Address member concerns with empathy and discretion; resolve issues promptly or escalate when required.
* Track and share engagement insights, feedback trends, and key member inputs with leadership teams.

***2. New Member Onboarding (On-Ground Delivery)***

* Execute the new member onboarding experience at the unit, ensuring warm introductions and smooth integration.
* Coordinate with Membership Sales for structured handovers post-sale.
* Ensure new members are oriented to the space, offerings, and community culture.
* Collect early-stage feedback and act on gaps in the onboarding experience.
* Ensure onboarding steps are completed and tracked as per defined process.

***3. Club Floor & Community Operations***

* Own daily Community operations on the club floor, ensuring smooth functioning and high service standards.
* Actively manage the member journey from arrival to departure.
* Coordinate closely with F&B Service, Culinary, Operations, and Facilities teams to deliver seamless hospitality.
* Identify operational gaps, log issues, and drive resolution at the unit level.
* Ensure adherence to Community SOPs and service frameworks on the floor.

***4. Private Hires, Events & Reservations***

* Act as the unit coordination point for private hires, member events, and reservations.
* Redirect and align enquiries with Sales and Operations teams as per defined process.
* Ensure accurate communication of event requirements and flawless on-ground execution.
* Be the primary on-site contact for members during events.

***5. Team Coordination & Communication***

* Lead and guide the unit Community team in daily priorities, service standards, and member handling.
* Coordinate internal communication across departments for member-related requirements.
* Share updates, challenges, and best practices with Corporate Community and leadership teams.
* Support training, process adherence, and continuous improvement initiatives at the unit level.

**Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in hospitality, community management, guest services, or customer experience roles.
* Strong on-ground operational experience in premium or member-led environments.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with high emotional intelligence.
* Ability to manage pressure situations calmly and professionally.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Prior experience scaling post-sales technical teams in Sales Enablement, Enterprise Content Management, or MarTech SaaS platforms.
* Experience managing a dual-function team (combining professional services/implementation with post-sales advisory).

**Team Leadership, Mentorship & Enablement**

* Recruit, hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing team of Technical Account Managers and Solution Architects.
* Provide ongoing coaching, technical mentorship, and performance management to support individual career growth across both technical architecture and account management tracks.

* Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to communicate customer feedback, synthesize technical requirements, and influence product roadmap priorities.
* Collaborate with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Account Executives (AEs) to align technical delivery with commercial goals, contract renewals, and account expansion opportunities.
