title: Delivery Service Manager - RDT Biometrics and Clinical Evidence
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Job Description**
The Delivery Management Professional (SE6) leads moderately complex deliveries, proactively identifies improvements, manages diverse stakeholders, and contributes to strategic implementation. In this role, you will independently define and control the scope of medium to large initiatives, involving multiple multidisciplinary teams, utilizing effective facilitation and analytical skills to drive value delivery. While navigating intricate stakeholder environments, you will connect team development with broader business objectives. Depending on the organization's needs, you may operate within role archetypes such as Project Manager, Service (Delivery) Manager, ITSM Process SME, Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer (RTE), or Agile Coach.
  
  
Description of the area
  
  
This team plays a critical role in drug development, integrating clinical study data, real-world evidence, and enabling cross-ecosystem collaboration to drive operational excellence and scientific innovation. They also deliver real-time operational insights from clinical trials, enabling proactive management of study execution, improving enrollment strategies, and streamlining workflows for maximum efficiency. By fostering collaboration across registries and federated open science networks, they leverage shared data ethically to uncover new scientific insights and study long-term treatment outcomes. Additionally, the team harnesses RWE and secondary use of clinical trial data to understand real-world treatment effectiveness, utilization patterns, and patient health trends. This holistic approach ensures trials are efficient, evidence generation is robust, and therapies are aligned with real-world patient needs, accelerating development timelines and improving outcomes at every stage.
  
  
A key focus of the area will also be building AI-ready data foundations that support advanced analytics, machine learning, and emerging agentic AI capabilities. This includes engineering trusted, well-governed, and semantically rich datasets; enabling metadata-driven access; and providing reusable data products that allow autonomous and human-in-the-loop AI systems to safely explore, reason over, and act on complex clinical and real-world data.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities****

* Scope / (Content Leadership): Independently defines, manages, and controls the scope of medium to large initiatives involving multiple multidisciplinary teams, or significant workstreams with moderate complexity. Leads and facilitates the scope definition process, aligning with strategic objectives, stakeholder expectations, and team dependencies. Proactively identifies, analyzes, and mitigates scope-related risks, manages scope changes, and champions the adoption of scope management best practices within the Chapter
* Accountability/Problem Solving: Independently leads the analysis of moderate to complex delivery problems, driving root cause analysis and eliciting complex stakeholder needs. Accountable for comprehensive improvement plans and contributes to solution design and validation. Champions accountability, deals pragmatically with ambiguity, and uses effective facilitation techniques to guide teams while mentoring colleagues and building team spirit
* Stakeholder Management: Identifies a diverse range of stakeholders across functional areas and develops comprehensive stakeholder communication plans. Effectively manages relationships to act as a trusted advisor, proactively shapes stakeholder perspectives, and navigates intricate stakeholder environments by resolving conflicts to ensure alignment
* Impact/Strategy: Demonstrates consistent performance with an impact that typically extends to a specific product, initiative, or cluster. Contributes to achieving product or domain goals by ensuring value delivery, takes a proactive role in shaping team processes, and contributes to the implementation of strategic objectives for Informatics, the Chapter, and/or Domains
* Complexity / (Product Size): Manages moderately complex initiatives or workstreams extending across a product or service. Manages the delivery of complex features, services, or projects (e.g., a service transition, a product release, or an Agile Release Train (ART) increment). Selects and tailors delivery methodologies while managing dependencies between activities
* Business/Technical ability: Demonstrates strong business acumen by analyzing business needs and translating them into effective delivery strategies. Selects and adapts delivery methodologies to optimize results, manages complex delivery processes, and utilizes advanced delivery tools and techniques to address business challenges and contribute to planning.

**Qualifications**
****Education / Experience****

* Proven track record operating in a Delivery Management archetype (e.g., Project Manager, Service Manager, Scrum Master, RTE, Agile Coach) managing medium to large initiatives or significant workstreams
* Experience managing the delivery of complex features or projects (such as service transitions or ART increments) across functional areas
* Demonstrated experience translating requirements into strategic implementation plans and contributing to business planning and forecasting

****Technical Skills****

* Strong ability to select, adapt, and apply appropriate delivery methodologies to optimize results
* Proficiency in utilizing advanced delivery tools and techniques to manage complex processes and dependencies
* Strong analytical skills to drive root cause analysis and propose comprehensive improvement plans
* Experience with products deployed in cloud environments (preferably AWS) in order to understand the appropriate terminology and engineering capabilities of the teams involved

**Additional Qualifications**

* Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to facilitate workshops, resolve conflicts, and act as a trusted advisor to diverse stakeholders

title: Senior Staff Engineer (Salesforce, Service Ownership)
description:

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O – Finance and Costing Manager
description:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**What It Means To Be a Consultant At Crowe**
Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.
  
  
In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.
  
  
Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are hiring a
**Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations – Finance and Costing Manager**
to join our Customer Success team. This role is crucial in ensuring the efficiency, accuracy, and compliance of financial operations and costing practices in D365 F&O. You will collaborate with clients, functional teams, technical teams and developers to provide expert support, drive solutions, and improve financial process outcomes. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, fixed assets, budgeting, tax, cost management and cost accounting functions within D365 F&O, helping clients streamline their operations and achieve operational excellence.

* Support period-end/year-end business activities.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Charted Accountant.
* Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience with D365 F&O
* Strong understanding of D365 F&O functionalities related to financial management and costing.
* Microsoft certifications in D365 Finance (preferred).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, meticulous attention to detail and collaborative teamwork abilities.
* Clear, confident English communication – comfortable engaging directly with U.S. counterparts during the alternate shift.
* Ability to manage multiple client expectations and work in a fast-paced environment.

* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
* Exposure to project accounting and multi-entity finance implementations
* CPA/CMA or MBA in Finance a strong plus.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Overview**

Dynamics 365 and Power Platform depend on a core data platform that manages business data, transactions, security, extensibility and application lifecycle at enterprise scale. As customers modernize applications and adopt AI, the platform keeps data governed, available and economically sustainable, with the controls enterprise business systems require.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the administrator experience and self-service workflows on the shared Dataverse + Finance & Operations platform team. You will independently set the strategy and roadmap for experiences that make environments easier to understand, manage and trust, translating platform governance policies into clear administrator controls and actionable workflows. Through customer discovery, evidence-led prioritization and close engineering partnership, you will deliver measurable improvements in service awareness, administrator control and self-service, strengthening the application foundation that connected experiences depend on.

This Hyderabad-based role offers meaningful product ownership at an important point in the evolution of enterprise applications: improving the administration and governance experiences that help customers operate mission-critical applications (such as their ERP) and provide dependable foundations for business applications, analytics, and AI. You will work closely with engineering, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform teams, administrators, customers, and partner teams to turn operational needs into clear product priorities and measurable customer outcomes. The role is well suited to a product leader who enjoys understanding complex customer problems, shaping a focused roadmap, and making enterprise platforms easier to manage and trust.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Own product strategy, roadmap and outcomes for the F&O administrator experience and self-service workflows, grounded in user research, service signals and support insight.
* Define the experience for understanding service health, data and environment status, and the actions available to keep business operations dependable.
* Translate platform governance policies into administrator controls and lifecycle workflows that help customers understand usage, apply policies and manage their data with appropriate visibility and control.
* Set product requirements for availability, performance, observability, compatibility, administrator control and successful task completion.
* Use customer discovery, support insight and product evidence to identify administrator needs and prioritize reusable platform improvements with engineering.
* Make management and environment governance clearer and more proactive, helping administrators resolve needs and manage their environments with confidence and self-service.
* Partner with Dataverse, application and agent teams so reliable F&O operations and supported business data or actions can contribute to connected experiences as capabilities evolve.
* Define and review measures such as task success, service understanding, policy completion, successful self-service, customer effort and avoidable support demand; use results to refine the roadmap.

 **Qualifications**  

**Minimum qualifications**
==========================

* Bachelor's degree and 8+ years of experience in product, service or program management or software development, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred qualifications**
============================

* 2+ years of experience taking a product, feature, or customer experience from discovery and design through launch, including an internal tool or framework.
* 4+ years of experience improving an in-market product or experience using customer and product measures such as adoption, task success, usage, retention, or reduced support effort.
* Experience with enterprise SaaS, ERP, cloud platforms, or administrator-facing products.
* Familiarity with service telemetry, diagnostics, capacity or performance, and environment lifecycle concepts.
* Experience simplifying technically complex workflows for administrators or support teams.
* Experience with AI-assisted workflows or responsible automation, and the communication and influence to align engineering and partner teams.

Product leaders from outside Dynamics 365 bring valuable perspectives. We value curiosity, attentive customer listening and the ability to make complex systems easier to operate.

title: Systems Engineering Senior Specialist
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Senior Specialist to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Senior Systems Engineering Specialist with strong expertise in Apple macOS endpoint management using Microsoft Intune. The role will act as a technical SME and L3 escalation point for enterprise macOS environments, responsible for device lifecycle management, compliance enforcement, security configuration, application deployment, and endpoint modernization initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess deep knowledge of macOS administration, Microsoft Intune, Apple Business Manager (ABM), Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), Conditional Access, endpoint security, and automation. The individual will work closely with security, identity, service delivery, and infrastructure teams to ensure a secure, compliant, and seamless end-user experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
macOS Endpoint Management
  
  

* Administer and manage enterprise macOS devices through Microsoft Intune.
* Design and implement device enrollment strategies using Apple Business Manager (ABM) and Automated Device Enrollment (ADE).
* Manage the complete macOS lifecycle including provisioning, configuration, compliance, patching, retirement, and asset management.
* Configure and maintain device restriction policies, configuration profiles, Wi-Fi profiles, VPN settings, certificates, and software deployment policies.
* Support zero-touch deployment and automated provisioning initiatives.

Microsoft Intune Administration
  
  

* Design and implement Intune device compliance and configuration policies for macOS devices.
* Manage device groups, dynamic assignments, application deployment, and software update policies.
* Configure and maintain Conditional Access integrations with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Deploy and manage Company Portal and self-service application delivery models.
* Utilize Intune reporting and analytics to improve endpoint health and compliance.

Security Compliance
  
  

* Implement security baselines and hardening standards for macOS endpoints.
* Manage FileVault encryption deployment and recovery key management.
* Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration on macOS.
* Configure compliance policies aligned with organizational security requirements.
* Perform remediation of non-compliant devices and security findings.
* Support audit, governance, and compliance initiatives.

Application Patch Management
  
  

* Package, deploy, update, and retire applications on macOS devices.
* Manage App Store, Line-of-Business (LOB), and PKG application deployments through Intune.
* Oversee macOS operating system updates and application patching.
* Troubleshoot software deployment failures and policy conflicts.
* Ensure application lifecycle governance and compliance.

Incident Problem Management
  
  

* Act as an L3 escalation point for complex macOS and Intune-related incidents.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions.
* Troubleshoot enrollment issues, compliance failures, certificate problems, application deployment issues, and Conditional Access challenges.
* Participate in major incident and change management activities.

Automation Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Shell scripting, and Microsoft Graph API where appropriate.
* Implement proactive remediation and monitoring solutions.
* Drive operational improvements, process standardization, and service optimization initiatives.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with security, infrastructure, networking, and identity teams.
* Participate in customer governance and operational review meetings.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers.
* Support transition, transformation, and modernization projects.

Required Technical Skills
  
  
Primary Skills
  
  

* Microsoft Intune (macOS Management)
* macOS Administration
* Apple Business Manager (ABM)
* Apple Automated Device Enrollment (ADE/DEP)
* Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
* Conditional Access
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* Apple MDM Framework

Endpoint Management
  
  

* Device Compliance Policies
* Configuration Profiles
* Endpoint Security Policies
* Application Deployment
* Device Lifecycle Management
* Zero-Touch Provisioning
* Company Portal Administration

Operating Systems
  
  

* macOS Ventura / Sonoma and later
* iOS / iPadOS (basic administration knowledge)
* Windows Endpoint Management (good understanding)

Automation Scripting
  
  

* PowerShell
* Shell/Bash Scripting
* Microsoft Graph API
* Automation and Remediation Scripting

ITSM Processes
  
  

* ServiceNow (preferred)
* Incident Management
* Problem Management
* Change Management
* ITIL Framework

Preferred Certifications
  
  

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
* Microsoft Azure Administrator (AZ-104)
* Apple Device Support
* Apple Deployment Management
* ITIL Foundation Certification

Soft Skills

* Excellent troubleshooting and analytical thinking

title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

**About The Role**
PubMatic is looking for a strategic and commercially driven Associate Director, Advertiser Solutions to help grow our buyer-side business across South Asia. This role will focus on building and scaling relationships with advertisers, agencies, trading teams, and other demand-side stakeholders, while driving adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused programmatic solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in the programmatic advertising ecosystem, strong understanding of buyer and DSP workflows, and a proven ability to win new business, grow strategic accounts, and influence go-to-market priorities. This role requires strong direct brand relationships in addition to agency connectivity, with the ability to engage senior marketing, media, and programmatic decision-makers and translate PubMatic’s capabilities into clear commercial value.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Drive business growth
  
  

* Own and grow revenue for PubMatic’s Advertiser Solutions business across South Asia.
* Build, manage, and convert a strong pipeline of opportunities across advertisers, agencies, trading desks, and other buy-side partners.
* Identify, prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new business opportunities.
* Expand PubMatic’s footprint with both existing and new buyers through strategic account planning and targeted growth initiatives.
* Drive adoption of PubMatic’s buyer-side solutions, including private marketplace, preferred, programmatic guaranteed, curated, and Activate-led opportunities.

Build strategic client relationships
  
  

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with brands, agency investment teams, trading desks, and programmatic leads across South Asia.
* Strengthen PubMatic’s direct access to brand-side decision-makers across digital, media, and marketing teams.
* Build senior-level relationships with strategic clients and position PubMatic as a consultative partner for premium supply access, efficiency, transparency, and performance.
* Partner closely with agencies and advertisers to uncover growth opportunities and drive long-term adoption.

Lead strategic customer engagement
  
  

* Own strategic engagements with key accounts, ensuring high-quality pre-sales support, thoughtful solutioning, and strong post-sale alignment with internal teams.
* Map customer business goals to PubMatic solutions and develop account strategies that drive measurable outcomes.
* Support renewals, account expansion, and deeper buy-side integration through proactive relationship management and opportunity development.
* Provide clear market and customer feedback to improve solution adoption and account growth.

Influence product and market strategy
  
  

* Bring actionable customer feedback, market insight, and competitive intelligence into internal product and commercial discussions.
* Help shape go-to-market strategy based on customer needs and evolving buyer dynamics.
* Partner with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and Solutions teams to refine positioning, strengthen messaging, and improve sales readiness.
* Develop a strong understanding of PubMatic’s marketplace design, supply dynamics, and advertiser value proposition.

Represent PubMatic in market
  
  

* Build PubMatic’s visibility and credibility across the South Asia buy-side ecosystem.
* Stay current on industry trends, supply path optimization, privacy and addressability changes, and shifts in advertiser buying behavior.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Meets or exceeds monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets for Advertiser Solutions.
* Builds a strong pipeline and converts strategic opportunities into long-term customer value.
* Expands PubMatic’s direct relationships with both brands and agencies in South Asia.
* Increases adoption of PubMatic’s advertiser-focused solutions across key accounts.
* Contributes meaningful customer and market insight that helps shape strategy and execution.

Who You Are
  
  
**Must Have**

* 9–12+ years of experience in digital advertising, programmatic, AdTech, media sales, agency partnerships, DSP, SSP, or advertiser-facing platform roles.
* Strong understanding of the buyer-side and DSP ecosystem and how advertisers and agencies buy programmatically.
* Proven success in new business development, pipeline building, and strategic account growth.
* Strong direct relationships across brands, agencies, and trading teams in South Asia.
* Experience selling or positioning programmatic advertising solutions to advertiser and agency stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of private marketplace deals, programmatic guaranteed, supply path optimization, curation, and premium programmatic buying models.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Ability to translate technical and platform capabilities into compelling client value.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed environment with strong ownership and accountability.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior experience at an SSP, DSP, agency trading desk, media platform, or advertiser technology company.
* Experience managing strategic partnerships and complex commercial negotiations.
* Familiarity with South Asia market dynamics, major holding groups, independent agencies, and key advertiser categories.
* Experience contributing to product feedback loops, go-to-market planning, or market enablement initiatives.

**Additional Information**
**Return to Office**
: PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, and broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches, and much more!
  
  
**Diversity and Inclusion**
: PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
**About PubMatic**
PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies, and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
  
  
Founded in 2006 with the vision that data-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi-screen and multi-format content that consumers demand.

title: Associate Director — Agency Activation
description:
**About The Team**
JioAds help connect marketers and businesses to over hundreds of millions of Indian consumers. Our consumers spend more than seven hours a day with us. They connect to the internet via our Jio mobile network and JioFiber solutions. They engage with us across our media and connectivity solutions like JioTV, JioGames, JioChat and Jio Cinema to name a few. With unique first-party consumer insights, JioAds helps advertisers grow their business across their offline-online consumer purchase cycle. We deliver an optimized brand experience for both the advertiser and consumer across video, display, custom experiences, in-store experiences, digital OOH, audio, connected devices and coupons. All in a “brand-safe” omnichannel network. We also work with premium publishers, helping monetize their ad inventory. With high performing, customized ad formats including native, interstitial and pre-roll and mid-roll, JioAds helps drive revenue across all publisher platforms. With our powerful technology and insights, led locally by our Indian technology and product team, we are able to meet specific business and growth needs of advertisers and publishers effectively.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Director — Agency Activation is a senior commercial and relationship role responsible for building and deepening JioAds’ presence across India’s agency ecosystem. You will own two distinct but connected mandates~ activating JioAds within agency planning and buying teams across all holding groups, and delivering high-impact client activation events that drive brand consideration and pipeline.
  
  
This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable in a boardroom presenting JioAds’ data story to an agency CSO and on the ground running a brand engagement event in Bengaluru. You will be the face of JioAds to the agency world.
  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES~**
**Agency Evangelisation & Relationships**

* Own and deepen the JioAds relationship with all major agency holding groups at planning, strategy, and leadership levels.
* Build a structured evangelisation programme that gets JioAds on the standard media plan across agencies — not just as a one-off but as a consistent, preferred platform.
* To ensure agency partners are fully briefed on JioAds’ volume deal structure, cohort capabilities, and product benchmarks. Identify, recruit, and onboard agency champion groups that have historically been flat for JioAds and represent the single biggest growth opportunity in FY 26-27.
* Track agency-wise revenue, pipeline, and engagement — reporting weekly to the Business Head with clear visibility on what is converting and what is blocked.

**Client Activation & Events**

* Lead the planning and execution of JioAds’ client activation programme — brand engagement sessions, agency roadshows, and immersion events targeting senior brand marketing teams.
* Build a quarterly activation calendar that creates consistent touchpoints with the advertiser universe — covering South, North, and West markets.
* Work closely with the marketing team to ensure each activation event is supported by strong JioAds collateral — case studies, cohort playbooks, product decks — and that follow-through is tracked.
* Coordinate post-event CRM — ensuring every brand contact from an activation is logged, followed up by the relevant regional CP, and tracked through to pipeline.
* Represent JioAds at industry forums, agency summits, and trade events (FICCI, IAA, adtech, Goafest) as a visible platform spokesperson.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with regional sales leads to align agency activation with regional revenue priorities.
* Coordinate with the product and data teams to ensure the JioAds cohort story is always current, accurate, and differentiated in market.
* Provide regular market intelligence on agency sentiment, competitor activity, and pricing feedback to the Business Head.

**Skills & Attributes For Success**

* Outstanding relationship builder — able to open doors, build trust quickly, and sustain relationships over time at senior levels.
* Strong commercial instinct — understands how agency economics work (VDs, trading deals, margins) and can navigate them without losing the partnership.
* Credible presenter and storyteller — able to take complex data and audience proposition and make it land simply and compellingly for an agency planner or brand CMO.
* Organised and disciplined — can run multiple activation programmes and relationship tracks simultaneously without losing sight of pipeline impact.
* Comfortable working in a high-growth, high-ambiguity environment where structure is still being built.

**EXPERIENCE~**

* 8–12 years of experience in digital advertising, media, or marketing, with at least 5 years in a senior agency-facing or partnerships role.
* Demonstrable experience managing relationships with one or more major agency holding groups at a senior level
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth through agency channels — not just managing relationships but converting them to commercial outcomes.
* Experience owning or co-owning large-format brand events, immersion sessions, or industry roadshows.
* Prior experience in a programmatic, data-led, or audience-first advertising platform is strongly preferred.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About The Team**
The AI Architect team partners with organizations to turn OpenAI's most capable models into meaningful, real-world impact. We work with customers across industries and digital-native businesses to identify where AI can create value, design secure and scalable solutions, and help those solutions move from early exploration into sustained production adoption. The team brings together technical strategy, customer partnership, and practical deployment expertise, working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Research, and specialist delivery teams.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an AI Architect, you will be the senior technical owner for a named portfolio of customers and the primary technical counterpart to their leadership teams. You will act as the “CTO of your book of business”, shaping each customer's AI strategy and guiding their journey from pre-sales discovery and solution evaluation through deployment, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  
  
You will own the technical account plan across ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and other agentic AI solutions. In partnership with the Account Director, you will translate business priorities into a focused use-case portfolio, an actionable adoption roadmap, and a clear path to durable customer value and growth. The Account Director owns commercial strategy; you own the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value.
  
  
You will remain accountable for the technical outcome while bringing in the right specialists across deployment, implementation, enablement, security, product, and partners to provide deeper expertise and execute work where needed. This role calls for strong industry fluency, sound architectural judgment, and the ability to move confidently between executive strategy and hands-on technical conversations.
  
  
This role can be based in Delhi, Mumbai, or Bangalore. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the primary technical advisor and long-term technical relationship owner for a named portfolio of existing customers and pre-sales prospects.
* Partner with Account Directors on account strategy while owning the technical account plan, technical milestones, adoption priorities, and expansion opportunities.
* Lead discovery with executives and technical teams to identify, qualify, and prioritize use cases tied to meaningful business outcomes.
* Develop clear Applied AI Architectures spanning models, applications, data, integration, security, privacy, governance, evaluation, and deployment.
* Guide customers through technical evaluations, demonstrations, workshops, prototypes, and proofs of value, securing confidence in both the solution and its path to production.
* Maintain a focused use-case portfolio with clear decision criteria, ownership, blockers, success measures, delivery needs, and adoption plans.
* Develop trusted relationships and technical champions across CTOs, CIOs, CISOs, AI leaders, engineering teams, and other customer stakeholders.
* Qualify and coordinate support from Deployment Engineering, implementation, training and enablement, product and domain specialists, partners, and other delivery teams.
* Remain accountable for technical progress and customer outcomes while ensuring delivery teams own implementation execution once engaged.
* Track adoption, usage, account health, production readiness, and measurable customer impact, intervening early when risks threaten value realization.
* Apply industry or digital-native expertise to recognize repeatable patterns, sharpen customer priorities, and identify relevant expansion opportunities.
* Share customer insights with Product, Engineering, and Research, translating field learnings into better products, architecture guidance, and reusable practices.

**You Might Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have significant experience in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, solutions engineering, technical account leadership, AI deployment, or technical customer success.
* Have guided enterprise organizations from technical evaluation through production adoption and measurable business impact.
* Build credibility with senior technical and business leaders while communicating equally well with hands-on engineers.
* Bring strong software and cloud architecture foundations, including APIs, distributed systems, data integration, identity, security, and privacy.
* Understand modern AI systems, frontier LLM models, agentic applications, model evaluation, retrieval, or enterprise AI workflows.
* Can prototype, explain technical tradeoffs, and work confidently with APIs, SDKs, and languages such as Python or JavaScript.
* Exercise sound judgment about when to go deep personally, when to involve specialists, and how to define clear handoffs and ownership.
* Have experience developing technical account plans, prioritizing complex customer portfolios, and connecting adoption to measurable outcomes.
* Bring meaningful expertise in a relevant industry or strong fluency with the needs of digital-native businesses.
* Communicate clearly and can turn ambiguity into a practical technical narrative, executive decision, or action plan.
* Work collaboratively across disciplines and care deeply about helping organizations deploy advanced AI responsibly.

**About OpenAI**
OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
  
  
For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.
  
  
Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

description:

Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve.

You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally.

Come make an impact every day at Zebra.

**What We're Looking For:**

We are seeking a results-driven and market-savvy Territory Account Manager to lead our POS (Point of Sale) and Kiosk solutions expansion in the India market. You will be responsible for driving revenue growth, building and nurturing long-term relationships with clients in the retail, Grocery Chain Store, CVS, Quick Service Restaurant (QSR), and Food & Beverage (F&B) sectors. The ideal candidate must bring proven sales track records, an established customer base, deep market intelligence, and strong professional sales acumen to accelerate our market penetration and achieve ambitious sales targets.

Job Description

1. Develop and execute a strategic sales plan to penetrate the India retail, QSR/F&B, and brand/grocery chain store markets, focusing on POS systems, self-service kiosks, and related hardware/software solutions.

2. Identify, prospect, and acquire new clients (including national retail chains, CVS, regional QSR brands, and F&B operators) while maintaining and expanding existing customer relationships.

3. Leverage your existing customer base in the target sectors to generate qualified leads, conduct product demonstrations, and close high-value sales deals.

4. Collaborate with the product and marketing teams to tailor solutions to local market needs (e.g., compliance with India retail standards, payment system integrations).

5. Conduct in-depth market analysis to monitor industry trends, competitor strategies (pricing, product offerings, market share), and customer pain points; provide actionable insights on existing market players, ISVs (Independent Software Vendors), SIs (System Integrators), and VARs (Value-Added Resellers) in India to shape regional sales strategy.

6. Build and manage strategic partnerships with key ISVs, SIs, and VARs in India ecosystem to expand distribution channels and drive co-selling opportunities.

7. Negotiate contracts, pricing, and service level agreements (SLAs) to ensure customer satisfaction and maximize profitability.

8. Achieve and exceed quarterly/annual sales targets for revenue, new customer acquisition, and market share growth.

9. Coordinate with the customer success team/Pre-sales engineering team to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and post-sales support, fostering long-term customer loyalty.

10. Closely work with marketing to represent the company at industry events, trade shows, and networking functions in India to enhance brand visibility, build industry connections and capture valuable project leads, improve leads conversion to help sales revenue growth

* Bachelors or equivalent experience; advanced degree preferred
* 5-8 years of applicable work experience
* Uses advanced domain/solutions knowledge to competitive advantage
* Develops and adapts advanced sales strategies to unique customer needs; creates customer partnerships
Often leads others in their development; provides input to policies and practices  

  

**Benefits:**

We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success.

**Job Posting Statement:**

To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department.

Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. * Identify and qualify use-case-driven opportunities for CONNECT platform products, using a consultative, MEDDPICC-informed sales process

* Inform commercial model, onboarding approaches, and playbooks for future scale
* Collaborate closely with product, marketing, customer success, partnerships, sales enablement, and regional sales teams

* Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS or Cloud software roles (e.g., Account Executive, Account Manager, Solution Consultant)
* Proven track record owning and delivering against ARR targets and closing complex deals
* Strong sales acumen, including territory planning, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, and negotiation
* Experience working with (or selling into) asset-intensive industries like energy, chemicals, or manufacturing is a plus
* Comfort engaging both technical users and business decision-makers
* Experience driving product adoption and account growth post-sale

* A self-starter who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional teams

title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
description:
**About Onit**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary**

This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsoft's modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together.

**Onit's technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities.**

### **What This Role Is Expected to Deliver**

* Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS.
* Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation.
* Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users.
* Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover.
* EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management.
* Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations.
* Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders.
* Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting.
* Package, test and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store and line-of-business applications, including detection rules, dependencies, install/uninstall logic and remediation of failed deployments.
* Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for reporting, compliance, device operations, configuration validation and repetitive administration.
* Create and maintain proactive remediation/detection-remediation logic to address configuration drift, device health and recurring endpoint issues before they become tickets.
* Own Windows patch/update strategy using Windows Update for Business, update rings and related Microsoft capabilities; support application patching and verification processes.
* Implement and improve endpoint security controls including BitLocker, LAPS, attack-surface reduction/security baselines and integration with enterprise security tooling such as CrowdStrike or Microsoft Defender concepts.
* Support and progressively deepen macOS management capability using Jamf Pro/Apple Business Manager, ADE, FileVault and macOS compliance where applicable.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex enrollment failures, policy conflicts, Autopilot provisioning issues, application deployment failures and device compliance problems.
* Work across Microsoft 365 services such as OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Exchange Online where endpoint or identity policies intersect with the user experience.
* Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

### **Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune administration in an enterprise environment.
* Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic.
* Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access experience, especially device-based access and compliance scenarios.
* Strong L3 troubleshooting ability across enrollment, policy, application deployment, authentication and compliance issues.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and troubleshooting.
* Practical endpoint security knowledge including disk encryption, endpoint hardening, patching and least-privilege concepts.
* Ability to independently plan and execute technical changes/projects with pilots, rollback thinking, stakeholder communication and post-change validation.
* PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration.
* Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, FileVault and macOS administration.

### **Adjacent Skills - Good to Have / Learn Quickly**

* Microsoft Graph API automation and reporting.
* BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling.
* CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms.
* Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience.
* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems.
* Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets.
* Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical.
* Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist.
* Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others.

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 or equivalent Microsoft 365 administration certification
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) - preferred
* Jamf certification - advantage, not mandatory

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.

Family Support: ***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

Income Protection: ***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident***.***

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: ***Flexi, NPS***.

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Onit Values**

**Customer First -** Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

**Purposeful Innovation -** Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

**Win as One -** Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

**Intentional Growth -** Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Director Cloud Delivery Assurance
description:
At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold **“what if.”**

**What if** your ideas could ignite global innovation?

**What if** your curiosity could redefine the future?

We invite you to step into the next exciting chapter of **your** career journey. Bring your creativity, drive, your daring spirit, and feel what it’s like to thrive on a team big enough to make an impact, yet small enough to make a difference. Our cloud-first networking and security solutions already protect **70% of the Fortune 500** , and we’re looking for creative thinkers ready to push that influence even further. Join us and discover how far your bold “what if” can take the world, your community, and your career.

How we empower our people is extraordinary: we’re recognized as a **Glassdoor Best Place to Work 2025, Great Place to Work-Certified in five countries, and honored by Cigna as a Healthy Workforce honors for three consecutive years; and what we build is world class: named CybersecAsia’s Best in Critical Infrastructure 2024** — clear evidence that when first-class technology meets empowered talent, remarkable careers take shape. So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? **Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.”**

In a world where you can be anything, **Be Infoblox.**

**Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance**

**The Opportunity**

We have an opportunity for a **Director, Cloud Delivery Assurance** to build and lead our new Cloud Delivery Assurance team within SaaS Platform Engineering in Pune or Bangalore, India, reporting to the VP, Engineering.

In this pivotal role, you will make release readiness a defensible, engineering-owned decision. You will establish a team of automation and delivery-assurance engineers, define the roadmap from manual and inconsistent release checks to an automated artifact-promotion pipeline, and own the quality gates that govern promotion of SaaS software from development clusters through integration and staging environments into production.

Collaborating closely with Solutions QA, Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, you will create the integration-quality, automation, and production-readiness operating model that validates the combined system before customers experience it. You will establish trusted environments, shared tooling, and evidence-based release-readiness gates while complementing—not duplicating—the charters of Solutions QA, DevOps, and SRE.

You are the ideal candidate if you have built quality or delivery-assurance organizations from the ground up, are fluent in Kubernetes-based cloud platforms and CI/CD, and are comfortable making clear, data-backed decisions when the evidence does not support a release.

**Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do**

* Build the CDA strategy, roadmap, operating model, and staffing plan; align scope, milestones, investment, and success measures with the SVP, Platform Engineering and peer engineering leaders
* Hire, lead, coach, and develop a team of one technical project manager and eight software development engineers in test; establish the team charter, operating cadence, engineering standards, and inclusive culture
* Own the automated artifact-promotion pipeline from CI build and security-scan validation through development-cluster smoke testing, integration and certification runs, staging certification, and production promotion
* Define, implement, and enforce quality gates for each promotion decision, including entry and exit criteria, required evidence, hold-and-return behavior, risk acceptance, and rollback expectations
* Serve as the accountable approver for promotion of SaaS software across development, integration, staging, and production environments; make go/no-go recommendations defensible with data
* Establish a common test-automation framework, shared libraries, and fit-for-purpose test environments for API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and deployment-verification testing
* Apply AI-assisted engineering tools, including code assistants, test-generation capabilities, and intelligent analytics, to improve productivity, expand meaningful test coverage, identify risk patterns, and support—not replace—engineering judgment
* Govern responsible use of AI-generated code and test assets through human review, security and privacy controls, traceability, and measurable quality outcomes
* Deliver readiness scorecards, quality and risk heatmaps, coverage and escape-rate metrics, defect trends, mean-time-to-detect measures, and environment and release status for engineering leadership
* Partner with Solutions QA on end-to-end functional coverage and release sign-off, and with SRE on stress, scale, high availability, disaster recovery, and chaos testing

**Be Prepared — What You Bring**

* Fifteen or more years of experience in software engineering, quality engineering, test automation, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, or delivery assurance, including five or more years leading and growing engineering or QA teams
* Proven success defining and delivering quality, automation, and release-readiness strategies for cloud-native SaaS platforms
* Deep understanding of Kubernetes, Linux, containers, public cloud environments such as AWS or GCP, distributed systems, and microservices
* Strong command of CI/CD practices, including pipeline design, artifact promotion, progressive delivery, canary releases, deployment verification, and automated quality gates using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Argo, or Spinnaker
* Expertise in test-automation architecture across API, integration, end-to-end, regression, performance, and production-readiness testing, with the technical depth to review designs and code
* Experience building metrics-driven programs using measures such as coverage, escape rate, defect trends, mean time to detect, release risk, and environment stability
* Practical experience using AI-assisted development, test-generation, analytics, automation, content-generation, or decision-support tools, with an understanding of responsible AI practices and appropriate human oversight
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority across QA, SRE, DevOps, product, application, and platform teams while maintaining a consistent quality bar under delivery pressure
* Experience hiring and scaling engineering teams in India, preferably across distributed or multi-site environments, and building an inclusive, high-accountability culture
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related technical field; a master’s degree is a plus

**Be Successful — Your Path**

**First 90 Days:** Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors through Blox Buddies, and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long-term goals.

**Six Months:**

* Operate automated build and development-cluster validation gates for every release candidate, with promotion decisions recorded and evidence collected automatically
* Establish the common test-automation framework and shared libraries, with regression suites running on a predictable schedule against a protected certification baseline
* Launch readiness scorecards and quality-risk reporting, including AI-assisted aggregation and analysis of release evidence with human review and clear auditability
* Complete staffing and onboarding for the CDA team, with the technical project manager driving milestones, dependencies, and stakeholder communications
* Define baseline measures for coverage, escape rate, defect trends, environment stability, and release-cycle efficiency; use the data to prioritize improvements

**One Year:**

* Establish CDA as the mandatory release-readiness gate for the SaaS platform, with staging certification and production-promotion decisions consistently supported by objective evidence
* Automate critical regression coverage for release candidates and demonstrate measurable improvement in customer-found defects and release-time Sev 1 and Sev 2 incidents
* Validate Tier 1 services for high availability, scale, performance, recovery, and deployment safety in partnership with SRE
* Integrate AI-assisted test development and release analytics into the operating model with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human-review controls
* Establish a smooth interlock among CDA, Solutions QA, SRE, DevOps, CloudOps, application, and platform teams, with remediation routed and closed through a single visible workflow

**Belong —** **Your Community**

Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here.

**Be Rewarded —** **Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong**

* Comprehensive health coverage, generous PTO, and flexible work options
* Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops
* Sixteen paid volunteer hours each year, global employee resource groups, and a “No Jerks” policy that keeps collaboration healthy
* Modern offices with EV charging, healthy snacks, plus hackathons, game nights, and culture celebrations
* Charitable Giving Program supported by Company Match

**Ready to Be the Difference?**

*Infoblox is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis.*

**Ranks Group (India – EAU)**
· Lima, Perú · Tiempo completo
  
Sobre nosotros

Ranks Group es un fabricante y proveedor internacional de componentes de precisión para maquinaria de construcción y movimiento de tierras. Nuestra planta en India fabrica pines, bocinas (bushings), collarines y componentes de desgaste desde 2014. Nuestra línea principal son los repuestos genuinos JCB. Además, suministramos repuestos OEM y alternativos para Caterpillar, Komatsu, Hitachi y otras marcas, junto con pines y bocinas de fabricación propia. Contamos con un centro de distribución en Sharjah, Emiratos Árabes Unidos, y exportamos a Europa, Medio Oriente y otros mercados.

Estamos ingresando a Sudamérica con Perú como primer mercado. Buscamos a la persona que construirá nuestra presencia comercial desde cero y que, a medida que el negocio crezca, dirigirá nuestro futuro almacén y centro de distribución en Lima.

Tu misión

Abrir el mercado peruano para nuestros repuestos, con los repuestos genuinos JCB como línea principal: conseguir clientes, generar ventas recurrentes y preparar el terreno para nuestra operación local propia.

Responsabilidades

1. Identificar y desarrollar clientes que operan o atienden maquinaria pesada, con prioridad en flotas JCB: importadores y distribuidores de repuestos, talleres, flotas, empresas de alquiler de maquinaria, contratistas de construcción y minería.
2. Vender repuestos genuinos JCB (línea principal), repuestos OEM y alternativos para Caterpillar, Komatsu, Hitachi, Volvo y otras marcas, y nuestros pines, bocinas y kits de fabricación propia para retroexcavadoras, excavadoras y cargadores.
3. Negociar precios, condiciones y acuerdos con distribuidores, cuidando el margen.
4. Coordinar muestras, cotizaciones, pedidos e importaciones junto con nuestro equipo en India.
5. Levantar información del mercado: precios locales, competidores, marcas, modelos y números de parte con mayor demanda (JCB, CAT, Komatsu, Hitachi).

Ofrecemos

title: Territory Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
* You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area-level, product-level, and overall sales targets.
* You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
* You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
* You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential & preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-** Graduate with science background.  
  
**Minimum work experience-** 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.

  
**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong Decision making skills.

 **Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**
