title: Customer Collaboration Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Job Title : Customer Collaboration Manager
  
  
Level : 5A
  
  
**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and setting the standard for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Global Travel (GT) operates in the unique and exclusive Travel Retail (i.e. Duty Free) sector. Often referred to as the sixth continent, Travel Retail has its own set of inhabitants, geography and channels (international airport shops, international land border stores, on-board airlines, ferries and cruise ships, along with some non-retail and diplomatic sales) as well as its own unique commercial landscape (operating 24/7 across multiple languages and currencies with 200+ nationalities travelling annually).
  
  
From Bhutan to Botswana and from Venezuela to Vietnam, GT is the only market in Diageo which offers global scope and market accountability. Responsible for representing and selling Diageo products in more than 110 countries around the world, and with access to billions of potential shoppers globally, we are a strategically important market for Diageo in terms of both profit and NSV.
  
  
Alcohol is a £10 billion business in travel retail and with passenger and aircraft numbers expected to double in the next 20 years, we have endless opportunities for growth for Diageo. Travel retail is where luxury, exclusivity and innovation meet, and with our winning portfolio of brands, winning executions and winning team - we are excited about what the future holds.
  
  
We are a young, dynamic business and have recently reshaped our structure, mission and vision in order drive greater focus around the delivery of ambitious business goals. We are passionate about what we do and are looking for exceptional, like-minded people to join our diverse, energetic team.
  
  
**Market complexity**
The role offers you the opportunity to work in an international team, experiencing the diversity that is the GT business. Operating in a diverse, dynamic environment, this role functions across a multi-country, multi-currency and multiple time zonal setting, serving a wide diversity of customers and operating in a complex mix of regulatory environments.
  
  
Global Travel operates with c.900 SKU’s, 21 sourcing plants and a mixture of primary (export) and secondary supply chains.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Deliver our customer collaboration roadmap through:**

* Managing the customer relationship to deliver on target service metrics and optimise route to market for our key India and Middle East customers
* Work with Customer, planning, Customer services and commercial sales teams to build a robust relationship to drive agreed customer & Diageo outcomes on service, growth and joint value creation
* Ensure CS team and customers execute range changes and innovations flawlessly
* Co-ordinate necessary in market re-work requirements
* Ensure all order fulfilment issues are reported managed and reviewed weekly to ensure optimal delivery on time for all customer orders including order management rules, transport lead time and adherence to Supply Chain required rules(MOQs, CFR, Lead time.)

**Deliver The Value Creation Agenda For Global Travel Through**

* Ownership and delivery of Customer projects to drive cost, efficiency and productivity
* Implement cost to serve processes with key accounts to reduce end to end costs and simplified replenishment models
* Review our existing RTM’s/network by region and identify opportunities to simplify/codify
* Partner with Global Brands Supply on future tramlining initiatives, own the proposal, commercial alignment and implementation
* Define and implement process for ongoing portfolio management to deliver simplified assortment

**Top Accountabilities**

* Drive improvement in key service metrics for GT Customers within Region
* Owns and develops relationship with GT commercial teams
* Manage GT Inventory levels ensuring SLOB management in control
* Collaborate with the Market planning & operations export team to ensure OTIF supply for GT
* Partner with Planning and Logistics teams, & customers to identify and implement cost to serve opportunities including INCOTERMS reviews and impact to payment terms
* Work closely with central Planning functions to deliver all customer metrics & manage in month demand fluctuations closely with Commercial, Customer, Planning & Finance
* Resolve customer specific Supply Chain issues to minimise service & availability disruption
* Customer service: Ensure brilliant partner management with and own GT improvement agenda with CS teams in your region
* Provide key account insights to demand planning as input to the monthly cycle – changes to customer sourcing/SC’s, concession changes & customer consolidation
* Work with Commercial teams to drive collaboration and communication supporting and driving collaborative Customer forecasting monthly with the customers to drive plan stability for supply.
* Work directly with Commercial teams in region to ensure day to day delivery of operational needs and to be supply point of contact for the region for non-collaboration customers

**Key Metrics**

* Market Share / NSV growth
* Service As Measured By Customer (SAMBC)
* Case Fill Rate (CFR)
* OTIF (On time in full)
* Lead time to delivery
* COGS (meet reduction targets)
* IBP (Forecast accuracy & Bias) reporting increase visibility

**Qualifications And Experience Required**

* Excellent influencing, partner engagement and interpersonal skills
* Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and presentation
* Solid understanding of end to end supply chain operational processes e.g. DRP, MPS, inventory, conversion, logistics and customer service
* Experience in customer collaboration within a supply chain environment
* Numerate with broad statistical, analytical skills and attention to detail
* 3 years + Supply Chain planning experience in CPG (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, SMR, Logistics)
* Experienced user of a planning system (e.g. SAP APO preferred)
* Supply Chain experience/exposure preferable
* Customer service / Planning / Logistics experience
* Order management and SAP Reporting

**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to success in our business and many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time, compressed hours, flexible location. Please talk to us about what flexibility means to you and don’t let anything stop you from applying.
  
  
Join us and you can also expect a highly competitive and flexible rewards and benefits package.
  
  
Celebrating our inclusive and diverse culture is core to Diageo’s purpose of “celebrating life every day everywhere”. This purpose is, in itself, inclusive in nature, as it values everybody irrespective of background, disability, religion, gender identity, sexuality or ethnicity.
  
  
We know that for our business to thrive and for Diageo to realize its ambition, we depend on having diverse talent with a range of backgrounds, skills and capabilities in each of the 180 countries in which we operate and to reflect our broad consumer base. We view diversity as one of the key enablers that helps our business to grow and our values, purpose and standards set the conditions for us to respect the unique contribution each person brings.
  
  
**Worker Type**
Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Gurugram
  
  
**Additional Locations :**
**Job Posting Start Date**
2026-09-11

title: Technical Account Manager - 3
description:
**The Role:**

You own the technical success of Cashfree Payment’s largest merchants from first scoping call to scaled production. You're the person, merchant CTOs call when something matters and the person internal teams trust to bring order to complex, high-stakes integrations.

This role sits where engineering depth meets executive presence. You'll debug an API edge case before lunch and align a merchant's leadership on go-live readiness after it.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Enterprise implementations, end-to-end:**
  Scope, plan, integrate, launch, stabilize. You own the timeline, the risks, and the outcome.
* **Technical relationship:**
  You're the primary point of contact for merchant engineering, product and business stakeholders. You translate payment infrastructure into solutions that fit their architecture, growth stage and risk posture, not a standard playbook.
* **Program rigor:**
  Project plans with real dependencies. Risks surfaced before they bite. Internal coordination across Product, Engineering, Risk, Ops and Support to keep delivery on track.
* **Integration health, post go-live:**
  Monitor transaction performance and success rates proactively. Spot optimization opportunities before they become incidents and own resolution when they do.
* **Escalations:**
  You lead the response end-to-end. Root cause, stakeholder comms and resolution. Merchants walk away with the issue fixed and their confidence intact.
* **The merchant signal loop:**
  Patterns you see in the field, friction points, gaps, recurring asks! They become structured inputs into the product roadmap.
* **Launch readiness for high-stakes go-lives:**
  Scale tests, production readiness reviews, white-glove support during peak windows.
* **Solutioning from use case, not catalog:**
  You start with the merchant's business model and work backwards, mapping their use case to the right mix of Cashfree products, not the full suite.
* **SLA-grade resolution**
  When merchant revenue is on the line, you operate to stringent SLAs, coordinating engineering and ops in real time, holding the line on both speed and fixed quality.
* **Team leverage:**
  Better playbooks, sharper integration guides, faster onboarding for the next merchant and the one after that.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **4+ years**
  in technical account management, implementation engineering or solutions engineering, B2B SaaS or fintech, with end-to-end ownership of complex multi-stakeholder programs.
* **Trusted advisor on the highest-stakes integrations:**
  You're the TAM Cashfree puts on the launches that can't go wrong, new product lines, regulated flows & marquee logos.
* **Force multiplier for the team:**
  You mentor L1s and L2s through hard escalations, codify what works into playbooks the team actually uses and shape how Integration operates as a function.
* **Consultative with conviction:**
  You surface the unsaid constraints, challenge assumptions that don't hold and guide merchants to the right answer, not just the asked one.
* **Technically credible:**
  Strong fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns. You don't ship production code, but you read it, reason about it and hold your own in a technical war room.
* **Working knowledge of at least one modern language:**
  Go, Python or Java, with hands-on experience you can point to. Familiarity with mobile platforms (Android, iOS) is a plus, especially when integrations span SDKs.
* **Comfortable in the tools merchants live in:**
  Strong with SQL for slicing through transaction data and fluent with Postman (or equivalent) for testing and debugging APIs in real time.
* **Fintech context is a strong plus:**
  Payment flows, reconciliation, settlements or compliance frameworks, anything that lets you skip the ramp.
* **Range of audience:**
  You translate cleanly in both directions: technical complexity for business stakeholders, business context for engineering, without losing precision either way.
* **High ownership:**
  Merchant outcomes are your outcomes. You follow through without being chased and escalate with context, not noise.
* **Built for ambiguity:**
  Enterprise implementations rarely go to plan. You re-sequence, adapt and keep merchants confident through it.

.

**About The Job**
Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. title: RFP & Solutions Manager
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a strategic thinker to own Payoneer's RFP and solutions delivery capability. You will build a modern, knowledge-driven RFP function that leverages AI and automation to scale response quality. You will also serve as a Solution & Implementation Manager on enterprise deals, building deep product and customer knowledge that directly informs RFP accuracy and responsiveness.
  
  
**This Role Balances Two Complementary Responsibilities**

* Designing and evolving a scalable RFP capability through knowledge management and automation
* Acting as a hands-on SIM when RFP volume is lower. The SIM expertise is what enables RFP excellence—knowing our solutions intimately allows you to ensure responses accurately reflect product capabilities and implementation realities

Location: Gurgaon, India
  
  
Work Arrangement: Hybrid (to be coordinated to overlap with EMEA/Global teams)
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
Knowledge Management & RFP Strategy (Primary)
  
  

* Design and maintain a centralized knowledge management system that serves as the foundation for RFP responses
* Build automation and AI-assisted workflows to cover automated intake parsing, response drafting, versioning, knowledge management and quality gating
* Define RFP policies; ensure organization-wide understanding and adoption
* Lead continuous improvement: analyze win/loss themes, refresh content quarterly, incorporate feedback from Sales and delivery teams
* Own the accuracy of RFP responses by leveraging hands-on SIM knowledge to ensure solution descriptions and commitments reflect delivery reality
* Partner with Sales, Product, Ops, and Compliance to maintain content quality and relevance as our solutions evolve

Solution & Implementation Management (Primary when RFP volume is lower)
  
  

* Act as Solution & Implementation Manager on assigned enterprise deals, owning scoping, design, delivery and client success
* Build and maintain deep product and customer knowledge through hands-on implementation work
* Apply standard PS methodologies and client experience standards
* Bring implementation insights back into RFP process and knowledge base, ensuring responses reflect what we can actually deliver

Who You Are
  
  

* 5-7 years in enterprise presales, solution architecture, or technical account management
* 3-4 years leading RFP/RFI strategy and operations; passionate about knowledge management and process automation
* Demonstrated experience redesigning significant operational processes and driving organization-wide adoption
* Track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise implementations
* Ability to think systemically about workflows, automation, and tradeoffs (where automation adds value vs. where human judgment is required)
* Strong cross-functional influence skills to drive alignment with Sales, Product, Ops, Compliance
* High fluency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.); demonstrated experience using or building AI agents for workflow automation
* High standards for quality and accuracy; ownership mindset; bias toward action
* Excellent written and verbal communication; ability to learn new technical domains quickly
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

What We Value
  
  
A builder's mindset. You see a broken system and ask: 'How would I redesign this from scratch?'
  
  
Ownership and accountability. You own outcomes: when things go wrong, you diagnose and improve
  
  
Learning agility. You're comfortable with new domains and approaches; you adapt and grow
  
  
Customer empathy. You care about impact—for internal stakeholders and external clients
  
  
Humble collaboration. You elevate others, build trust, and lead through influence
  
  
Bias toward action. You move forward with incomplete information and iterate based on feedback
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Property Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
  
  
Property Manager
  
  
**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually | Full-Time | Remote | Eastern Time Hours**
The Opportunity
  
  
Royal York Property Management is hiring experienced Property Managers to manage the owner and tenant experience across active residential property-management files.
  
  
Direct property-management experience is preferred but not required. Strong account, portfolio or client-service managers with experience managing multiple files, relationships and escalations are encouraged to apply.
  
  
This role is for someone who can keep files moving, keep clients informed, manage urgent issues and remain organized in a high-volume environment. You will be responsible for communication, follow-up, documentation, issue resolution and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
  
  
This is not a basic customer-service position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of client outcomes, manage multiple properties and files simultaneously, and communicate professionally with property owners, tenants, internal teams and service providers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Act as the main point of contact for property owners and tenants throughout the management relationship.
* Manage multiple active clients, properties and files with strong organization and follow-through.
* Provide proactive updates so owners understand what is happening, what is pending and what comes next.
* Handle time-sensitive property and tenancy matters with urgency, professionalism and clear communication.
* Coordinate next steps between owners, tenants, internal departments, vendors and other service providers.
* Collect, review and track required property, owner and tenant documentation.
* Maintain complete CRM records, including notes, tasks, follow-ups, updates and file movement.
* Identify stalled files, missed follow-ups, client concerns and service problems before they escalate.
* Escalate serious issues promptly and use sound judgment to protect client satisfaction.
* Support a structured, process-driven property-management experience from onboarding through ongoing management.

**Requirements**

* Three to five or more years of property management, account management, client success, client services, relationship management or comparable client-ownership experience.
* Proven ability to manage multiple clients, properties, accounts or active files simultaneously.
* Strong communication skills and confidence handling owner, tenant or client concerns.
* Strong process discipline and comfort working within a structured CRM and task-management system.
* Strong follow-up habits, task management and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to remain calm under pressure and prioritize quickly in a high-volume environment.
* Professional judgment when handling complaints, escalations, deadlines and sensitive client matters.
* Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Direct property-management, leasing, real estate operations or housing-related experience.
* Experience supporting both clients and end users, such as owners and tenants or customers and service providers.
* Experience working with North American clients.
* Experience in a high-volume, service-based, operations-heavy or SLA-driven environment.
* Experience coordinating maintenance, leasing, payments, documentation or service-provider activities.
* Comfort using AI and other tools to improve documentation, reporting, summaries and internal efficiency.

Remote Technology Requirements
  
  

* Dual-monitor setup
* Computer with at least 16GB of RAM
* Reliable internet connection of at least 100 Mbps
* Webcam
* Noise-cancelling headset
* Professional and quiet environment for calls

**Compensation**
Total annual compensation ranges from
**C$30,000 to C$36,000**
, based on experience, qualifications and performance.
  
  
Candidates with direct property-management experience, strong owner and tenant communication skills, and proven success managing a high volume of active files may be considered near the top of the range.
  
  
Complete details regarding base compensation and performance bonuses will be shared during the interview process.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview from our recruitment partner within 24–48 hours of applying.
  
  
See All Open Roles

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
MongoDB Technical Account Managers are at the forefront of technical problem solving with key customers, working on some of the most complex and exciting application ecosystems built on the MongoDB platform. TAMs combine:
  
  

* Deep product knowledge and expertise across multiple domains
* Polished technical communications
* Strong account leadership, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the customer
* Ability to not only proactively engage, but anticipate and preempt needs a customer may have or issues they could experience
* A high degree of ownership and willingness to go above and beyond for our customers

The TAM’s primary remit is the cultivation of customer confidence and delivery of positive, account-wide technical outcomes that solve big customer problems while showcasing the capabilities of the MongoDB product portfolio. They do this through a systematic engagement process including deep discovery and the development of a roadmap of shared objectives. They are able to operate in complex environments where there may be shared or even ambiguous responsibilities between the customer and MongoDB. The TAM is able to shift gears between enabling, coaching and mentoring, and marshaling resources to get the right things done at the right time.
  
  
The TAM also acts as the eyes and ears of the product team while working with marquee customers as they will sometimes surface new requirements or potential areas of opportunity for future development. They work closely with these teams to understand these requirements, manage expectations, and ensure MongoDB is staying one step ahead of customer needs.
  
  
This role will be an early hire into the new Technical Account Management function and will help pioneer the new service offering for MongoDB.
  
  
Successful candidates will have the flexibility to work around the schedules of customers with 100% uptime systems while enjoying the life/work balance MongoDB promotes.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Why MongoDB is a fantastic place to work and build your career
  
  

* Be a part of the company that’s reinventing the database, focused on innovation and speed
* Enjoy a fun, inspiring culture that is engineering focused
* Work with exceptionally skilled people around the globe
* Learn, contribute, and make a positive impact on the product and community

Cool things you’ll do
  
  
MongoDB is on a mission to unlock the inner genius of our customers by making data stunningly easy to work with. Along the way, our customers encounter questions and issues about how our approach to databases works for their use case. In Technical Services, it's our job to help our customers succeed with MongoDB
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you’ll be highly engaged with a handful of our largest customers, building key relationships with technical leaders and collaborating with them on their projects to build and scale MongoDB solutions - resolving questions and demonstrating solutions related to architecture, performance, recovery, security, and everything in between
  
  
You'll be an expert resource on the best way to run MongoDB at scale, whatever that scale may be. You will identify deep dive opportunities to educate our customers on crucial topics of concern to them and either conduct those deep dives yourself or make timely connections between customers and subject matter experts within MongoDB
  
  
You will also mentor and ramp new team members, and take initiatives in building knowledge of new product lines within the MongoDB ecosystem
  
  
What you need
  
  
You should have 7+ years of relevant experience. We consider all candidates, with an eye for those who combine formal education with self-teaching, are insatiably curious, and are multi-faceted
  
  
It’s crucial for every candidate to check these boxes:
  
  

* Communicator:

Bonus Points

* Extensive experience with mass scale application architectures

+ Microservices/Serverless architectures
+ CI/CD tools and approaches
+ Containerization, orchestration and management tools
+ Enterprise Identity platforms

* Experience using or managing MongoDB

title: Infra Delivery Lead
description:
**Infra Delivery Lead**

*Integrated delivery owner for 24x7 L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations across all Infra towers.*

**Role level**

Delivery Lead

**Domain**

Infrastructure Operations (Infra)

**Scope**

Hosting, Connectivity(Network & Telephony), DBA, Data Tribe & Infra Command Center (L1.5)

Own delivery of the client's infrastructure operations end to end. Manage SLAs, escalations, MIM, invoicing, resourcing and contractual reviews across Hosting, Connectivity, DBA, Data Tribe and the Infra Command Center.

**Process**

**Service Delivery Ownership**

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations.

* Act as single point of contact for the client infrastructure leadership.
* Run daily stand-ups and weekly service reviews with tower leads.
* Drive service improvement plans to closure.

**SLA, Reporting and Governance**

* Track response and resolution SLAs across all infra towers.
* Publish weekly and monthly SLA, KPI and backlog reports.
* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.
* Review monthly capacity, utilisation and performance reports for servers and databases.
* Maintain the RAID log for infrastructure services.
* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality.

**Incident, Escalation and MIM**

* Attend MIM bridge calls for P1/P2 infrastructure and data platform incidents.
* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans.
* Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center.

**Change, Patching and Availability**

* Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers.
* Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance.
* Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills.
* Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions.
* Track platform software licences and expiry dates.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

**Compliance and Continual Improvement**

* Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies.
* Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.
* Lead onboarding and transition of new infrastructure services.

**Tools/Technology - knowhow**

* AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM)
* Microsoft Azure
* Windows Server and Linux / Unix
* Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers
* Firewalls & load balancers
* Cisco Call Manager / PBX
* Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases)
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards)
* Tableau, Power BI / Excel for service reporting (good to have)
* Jira and Confluence (good to have)

**Processes and Frameworks**

* ITIL service management: incident, problem, change, request
* Disaster recovery and business continuity
* Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have)
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform (good to have)

**Experience**

* 12+ years in IT infrastructure operations
* 5+ years as delivery lead in a managed services setup
* Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers
* Exposure to AWS, Azure, Windows, Linux, , Oracle, SQL Server and Datadog
* Oversight of data platform operations: Airflow, Talend, Snowflake, Tableau and Power BI
* SLA management, invoicing and contract reviews in an MSP model
* MIM participation and senior stakeholder escalation handling

**Shift: Rotational shifts**

**Support Model: 24/7 operations support**

**Work Location: Client office – 2 days per week**

**Joining: Immediate joiners preferred**

description:
**The team**

The eXperience and Deal Marketing Team (XDMT) is responsible for conceptualizing and delivering high-touch, high-impact experiences globally across three key charters:

1. Driving advisor-led high-intensity strategic deals across the deal lifecycle
2. Managing CECs driving brand and business experiences at our Noida and New Jersey centers and conceptualizing the new ones
3. Leading Client Visit Center of Excellence and managing high-impact client visits

The Client Visit CoE drives strategic engagement by curating high-impact, personalized and memorable experiences for top-tier client visits in line with the business priorities. The team collaborates closely with the ecosystem to showcase the latest and greatest at HCLTech, accelerating client growth and transformation while building and deepening relationships through meaningful engagements.

**Role Overview**

The
**Client Visit POD Lead**
will deliver high-impact client visit experiences across HCLTech’s global locations with a focus on the Top priority (Diamond / Platinum visits) in India to start with. This role is pivotal in shaping brand perception, reinforcing client relationships and driving business impact through structured, differentiated visit experiences aligned with HCLTech’s brand values and business priorities.

The POD Lead will be expert with proven experience in managing stakeholder expectations across multiple parallel client visits, understand requirements and plan CV experience for the POD, including a mix of verticals.

The Lead will be an expert in executing client visits end-to-end with a strong planning and operational rigor to manage client visits. The Lead would train team members on CV planning, execution. Should possess good understanding of the support functions, build right connections and collaborate for the client visit plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. High-touch Client Visit Experience orientation and planning**

* Understand client experience across all touchpoints considering the purpose and visit criteria to include the right set of high-touch experience ideas based on the need
* Proactive planning and on the job agility to understand customer’s moments of truth and attempt customer delight at all stages of their visit journey.
* Alignment with visit objectives and client personas to execute visits.
* Leverage insights from sales, pre-sales and relevant vertical marketing teams to craft purpose-driven, personalized high-touch client engagement journeys
* Align the Client Visit strategic framework with the Client Visit Playbook for scalable delivery
* Curate visit themes and narratives that highlight HCLTech’s brand story, innovation ecosystem and value proposition
* Plan client engagement initiatives such as thought leadership events/ fireside chats, CSR collaborations, cultural dinners, immersive experiences and other relationship-building activities to enhance brand affinity and strengthen client partnerships.
* Bring innovative ideas to the forefront, leveraging technology to create experiential engagements and establish a reputation as a tech-forward organization

**2. Execution and Governance**

* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for Diamond / Platinum tier client visits, ensuring flawless end-to-end delivery
* Govern adherence to the RACI chart across stakeholders (Sales, Marketing, GWS, Transport, Security, Hospitality, etc.), ensuring accountability and consistency across visit stages
* End-to-end client visit execution across touchpoints, channels, partners and sales teams
* Collaborate with functional teams to operationalize pre-visit planning, on-site experiences and closure activities such as feedback and memorabilia
* Partner with Sales leaders, BU Marketing team and solution SMEs to align visit experiences with live deal or account objectives.
* Engage creative and content teams to develop compelling visual storytelling and branded experiences - Pavilions, Experience zones for a high-touch customer experience
* Liaise with GWS, GIT and other enabling teams to ensure seamless synchronization of operational touchpoints
* Procurement and vendor co-ordination and relationship management for ensuring best-in-class delivery at optimized costs

**3. Team management, training and upskilling team to understand CV experience, planning and execution**

* Manage a team of 2-3 client visit executives
* Upskill the team on CV planning and execution
* Manage stakeholder expectations – join ongoing kick-off calls to gather requirements and present experience ideas to the stakeholders for client engagement.

**4. Outcome orientation - Insights, Metrics and Continuous Improvement**

* Gather client and sales feedback/ratings and draw insights to constantly enhance experiences
* Capture best practices and feedback loops to constantly refine templates, processes and content assets
* Maintain a repository of client visit artefacts, case studies and thematic frameworks to enable rapid reuse and improvement

**Qualifications and Experience**

* **Education:**
  Graduates or MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Communications or Business Management from a reputed institution.
* **Experience:**
  8-12 years in visit execution, pre-sales/marketing with proven expertise in client visit management, strong business acumen and creative excellence.

**Core skills required:**

Planning, collaboration and relationship building

* Proven experience managing cross-functional teams and engaging global stakeholders
* Ability to conceptualize and plan client visits across all touchpoints, ensuring seamless collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, GWS, GPS and other enabling functions
* Strong relationship-building skills to build trust and alignment across the ecosystem

Visit execution and management

* Expertise in end-to-end visit execution with a process-driven approach and sound financial acumen
* Strong project management capabilities, coupled with excellent communication and executive presentation skills
* Proficiency in leveraging technology to enhance client visit experiences

Business acumen

* Understanding of Client visit related marketing interventions.
* Understanding stakeholder personas.

Creative aptitude

* Content curation skills for impactful messaging and design.
* Creative lens to understand the client expectations and translate them into compelling experiences.
* Innovative approach to design client experiences with clear alignment to business context, purpose and expected outcomes.

**Desired skills**

* Out-of-the-box thinking with flexibility to incorporate fresh ideas from Sales and industry best practices.
* Stakeholder management skills, both internal and external.
* Familiarity with innovative tools, including Generative AI to boost productivity, visualization client experience.

title: Senior Manager, Talent Development
description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**

At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where *fun meets results*!

The Senior Manager, Talent Development oversees the strategy, implementation, and sustainment of leadership development programs across a global organization. This role leads a team of Talent Development specialists and ensures that strategies and initiatives align with global business objectives and deliver measurable value to clients. The Senior Manager partners with leaders worldwide to establish learning and sustainment tools that strengthen leadership capability, leverages AI-enabled coaching and training tools to optimize coaching effectiveness, and applies root cause analysis and program performance gap analysis to continuously improve program outcomes. They are accountable for leading coaching and leadership development programs, assessing their behavioral and operational impact, and driving continuous improvement in leadership effectiveness.

**What You'll Do:**

* Lead a global team of Talent Development professionals, fostering a collaborative, high-performance environment through coaching, mentoring, and professional development.
* Partner with global leadership to align leadership development strategies with organizational objectives and long-term business growth.
* Set the vision and roadmap for global leadership development and coaching initiatives, and manage priorities, resources, and budgets accordingly.
* Build relationships with leaders at all levels across global regions, partnering to define deliverables and establish timelines for leadership initiatives.

**AI-Enabled Coaching and Training**

* Leverage AI coaching and training tools to optimize coaching effectiveness, scale access to development, and personalize the leader experience.
* Evaluate, pilot, and implement AI-enabled solutions, and establish guidelines for their responsible and consistent use across regions.
* Use data and insights from AI tools to identify coaching trends, strengthen leader and coach capability, and improve learning outcomes.

**Program Performance, Root Cause, and Gap Analysis**

* Support leadership development through root cause analysis to understand why leadership behaviors, skills, or business outcomes are not meeting expectations.
* Conduct program performance gap analysis to compare intended and actual program results, and recommend targeted improvements that enhance program performance for our clients.
* Conduct needs assessments to identify knowledge, skill, and performance gaps, and recommend solutions to close them.
* Coordinate post-implementation reviews to measure program effectiveness, translate findings into action plans, and drive sustainment efforts.
* Analyze and report global trends and metrics in leadership development, providing executive-level insights and recommendations for improvement.

**Coaching and Program Design**

* Develop and sustain coaching methodologies, tools, and resources to ensure consistency across regions.
* Consult with leaders globally to design, implement, and sustain leadership development programs aligned to business goals.
* Design, develop, and facilitate training programs such as EOS and other leadership initiatives for global audiences.
* Facilitate regular coaching workshops and develop sustainment plans to embed effective leadership behaviors.
* Partner with the content development team to create and update globally relevant content and self-led programs
* Other duties as assigned

**Why Join Us?**

* **Growth Opportunities**: We believe in promoting from within and providing opportunities for career advancement.
* **Comprehensive Training**: We offer extensive paid training to ensure you’re equipped for success.
* **Team-Oriented Culture**: Work in a collaborative, supportive environment with peers who are passionate about what they do.

* **Fun Workplace:** Join a vibrant team that knows how to have fun! From team engagement activities to social events, we foster a lively and inclusive work environment where you’ll build strong connections.
* **State-of-the-Art Offices:** Work in our modern, well-equipped offices designed to enhance collaboration and productivity.
* **Rewarding Work:** Help businesses grow while making a real difference in people’s lives!

title: Engineer II (Infrastructure Engineer) 3+ YEARS
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next - together!

**Job Description: 3-5 YEARS**

We are seeking a skilled **Infrastructure Engineer** to join our global team and help design, implement, and maintain our private and public cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate will have experience in **NetApp storage**, server hardware management, **Grafana**, Linux system administration and automation tools like **Terraform** and **Ansible**. You will play a key role in managing and optimising our infrastructure, ensuring reliability, scalability, and security.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Configure, administer, and troubleshoot NetApp storage solutions.
* Manage and maintain Linux-based systems, ensuring optimal performance, security and uptime.
* Automate infrastructure deployment and configuration management using Terraform and Ansible.
* Monitor system performance, conduct regular updates, and perform issue resolution.
* Collaborate with development, operations, and security teams to support business needs.
* Document configurations, procedures, and best practices.
* Collaborate closely with onsite engineers to support hardware installations, upgrades, RMA processes, troubleshooting, maintenance, and other critical infrastructure tasks as needed.
* Participate in on-call rotations.

  

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Hands-on experience with NetApp ONTAP storage administration and troubleshooting, including on-premises MetroCluster deployments and FSxN and CVO in public cloud environments.
* Experience with server hardware management, including firmware upgrades, component replacements, and RMA processes.
* Strong Grafana proficiency: building and maintaining custom metric exporters and integrating externally provided exporters, designing dashboards, and managing alerting configuration as code, deployed via Terraform.
* 3+ years of experience in an infrastructure or systems engineering role.
* Strong expertise in Linux system administration (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu, CentOS).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation tools like Terraform and Ansible.
* Experience managing virtual machines on OpenStack, including provisioning, lifecycle management, and troubleshooting.

**Desirable Skills (Nice to Have):**

Proven scripting skills, ideally with Python.

  

If you have a passion for infrastructure, automation, and optimising IT environments, we'd love to hear from you!

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Director, Solutions Builder (Builder Portfolio Leader)
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Sales

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**The Experience**

  

Salesforce is hiring a Portfolio Leader to directly manage and grow a team of technical AI specialists deploying Agentforce solutions inside complex customer environments. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can drive engineering excellence while operating at the executive level. This is not a traditional people manager, but a mission-critical multiplier on the agentic frontier. You will lead a blended delivery team made up of two specialist functions: Forward Deployed Engineers (Technical Builders - who design, build, and deploy AI Agents directly in customer environments) and Deployment Strategists (Strategic Builders - customer-facing advisors who shape AI strategy, define use cases, and drive adoption). Together, these teams work alongside customers to co-build and deliver agentic AI solutions on a single large enterprise account or across multiple engagements simultaneously. You'll set the engineering standards, unblock complex customer deployments, and scale the talent that's shipping production AI today.

  

Production leadership required. Builder mindset non-negotiable.

  

The Builder Leadership Experience

* Delivery Team Coordination: You own the capacity planning, talent acquisition, and staffing that ensures your cross-functional squads have the horsepower to deploy Agentforce at enterprise scale.
* AI-Augmented Leadership: Your team ships solutions using a best-in-class suite of AI tools (Cursor, Claude, and Salesforce coding products like Vibes). You will foster an inclusive, high-energy, and psychologically safe engineering culture where builders iterate fast and continuously level up.
Direct Product Influence: You stand at the center of the product feedback loop. Partner directly with the Product and Engineering organizations on pilot programs and beta rollouts, turning raw field insights from high-stakes deployments into features on the Agentforce core roadmap.  

  

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Scale Elite Talent: Recruit, mentor, and develop the next wave of Technical and Strategic Builders. Drive technical excellence, structure career growth, and foster an environment where shipping high-quality, production-ready systems is the norm.
* Maintain Operational Velocity: Monitor key delivery metrics, coach your teams on optimization, and run hard on complex customer escalations. You ensure your teams move from sketch to deployable in weeks, not months.
* Ultimate Technical Authority: Serve as the final technical escalation point for your portfolio. Maintain deep architectural judgment across the Salesforce platform, advanced LLM techniques, data pipelines, and agentic orchestration.
* Guide Enterprise Implementations: Unblock complex data readiness, tool integration, and multi-agent orchestration challenges. Step in directly to help your teams assess customer technical readiness, remove deployment barriers, and codify standardized, repeatable delivery methodologies.
* Drive Agentic Adoption: Build and anchor strong executive-level relationships within your customer portfolio, ensuring flawless Agentforce activation, rollout, and sustained production value.
* Accelerate Portfolio Performance: Operationally run your account portfolio with engineering rigor - monitoring health, delivery velocity, and core consumption metrics to accelerate progress toward customer business outcomes.
Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner lock-step with Services, Account Success, and Product teams to help enterprises activate and consume Agentforce quickly, moving customers from pilot to production at hyper-speed.  

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Advanced Technical Depth: 15+years of Technical background with recent deep architectural understanding of AI, LLMs, and the Salesforce ecosystem. You have hands-on experience with enterprise software implementation, data modeling, API integration, and AI deployments.
* You Have Proven Leadership: 3+ years of direct people management or high-impact technical leadership steering cross-functional engineering or technical teams. You have a track record of hiring, mentoring, and scaling technical talent.
* You Own the Agentforce & Data Cloud Blueprint: You possess direct, hands-on experience architecting or deploying Salesforce Data Cloud and the Agentforce platform. You don't just understand the tech stack - you know how to orchestrate it to unblock enterprise scale and drive immediate production value.
* You Lead with an Enterprise Customer Focus: Strong background navigating high-touch customer strategies at a Global level, paired with exceptional executive-level communication and influence skills. You can hold your own in a room with customer CTOs and enterprise architects.
* You Have a Ship-It Mindset: Exceptional problem-solving instincts, extreme resourcefulness, and a "get-things-done" demeanor. You thrive at the technical helm where code is being actively shipped, not just talking about it.

**Even Better If...**

* Hands-on experience building multi-agent systems, prompt engineering pipelines, or deterministic AI guardrails.
* Familiarity with cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery) and enterprise data pipelines.
* Relevant Salesforce certifications (Advanced Admin, Service Cloud, Data Cloud, Sales Cloud, or Agentforce Specialist).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

**Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager**  
  
At Vrbo, part of Expedia Group, we’re committed to delivering world-class travel experiences by ensuring every customer interaction is handled with care, empathy, and excellence. Our mission is to support travelers and partners by resolving complex issues efficiently, while continuously improving our service standards.

**Introduction to the team**

  

The Product Team creates high-quality, end-to-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our focus on customer-centric innovation enables us to develop products that build loyalty and repeat business. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to drive growth and achieve results for our customers and the company.

We’re looking for a Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager, a dynamic, people-first leader who thrives in fast-paced, high-impact environments. In this role, you’ll oversee a team that manages Expedia Group’s most complex traveler situations in real time, ensuring every experience is handled with empathy, expertise, and resolution ownership.

As part of the VRBO Care leadership team, you’ll play a key role in building and scaling a premium capability designed to support our most valued travelers across all Expedia Group brands. This is an opportunity to shape the traveler experience at its most critical moments and contribute directly to our mission of making travel easier and more joyful for everyone.

**In this role, you will:**

As a Advanced Traveler Escalations Manager, you’ll lead a passionate team that resolves our most complex traveler cases with empathy, accountability, and care. You’ll help shape an exceptional service experience ~ one that earns traveler loyalty and reinforces Expedia Group’s mission & vision to make travel easier and more joyful for everyone. You thrive in ambiguity, excel at cross-functional collaboration, and are motivated by the opportunity to make an impact in the global travel industry.

* Build and nurture a high-performing team that’s connected to our mission of serving travelers with heart.
* Create an inspiring environment where people feel trusted, supported, and motivated to deliver their best.
* Coach and develop supervisors to grow as people leaders—fostering open, honest conversations that support individual development and team success.
* Champion a diverse and inclusive culture where every voice is heard, respected, and valued.
* Lead day-to-day operations with a clear focus on performance, quality, and traveler experience.
* Define and communicate KPIs, OKRs, and success metrics that keep the team aligned and accountable.
* Use data and operational reporting to identify opportunities, optimize processes, and drive continuous improvement.
* Translate real-world frontline insights into smarter workflows, better tools, and scalable solutions.
* Foster a **culture of ownership and resolution** —ensuring every traveler issue is handled end-to-end with care and accountability.
* Empower your team to make confident decisions that prioritize traveler trust and satisfaction.
* Champion traveler advocacy by listening, empathizing, and finding creative solutions that turn challenges into positive experiences.
* Strive to deliver service so great, it becomes the reason travelers choose Expedia again and again.
* Build strong, trusted relationships across partner teams, Operations, Training, Workforce, and beyond—to align on goals and remove roadblocks.
* Representing the Escalations function as a voice of expertise and insight, ensuring business and traveler needs stay connected.
* Collaborate across regions and function to drive consistency and share best practices across our global network.
* Review resource and skill requirements across teams, ensuring coverage, readiness, and cross-training for peak moments.
* Maintain business continuity plans that keep teams and travelers supported ~ even during unexpected disruptions.
* Anticipate future needs and build flexible, scalable solutions that keep the business running smoothly.
* Model Expedia Group’s values in everything you do ~ trust, accountability, inclusion, and transparency.
* Promote a sense of shared purpose ~ *we’re all Expedians* , working together to deliver on our commitments.
* Listen to team feedback, act on engagement insights, and drive initiatives that improve connection, trust, and retention.
Celebrate wins, learn from challenges, and create an environment where people grow and thrive.  

  

**Qualifications & Experience:**

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited university, or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum **8 years of relevant work experience** , including **3+ years in a people management role**
* Proven experience managing customer service or escalations teams in a large-scale, fast-paced environment
* Strong understanding of **process optimization, performance management, and operational excellence** principles
* Demonstrated success in **building, leading, and developing** high-performing teams
* Excellent **analytical, strategic planning, and problem-solving** abilities
* Solid understanding of **local employment laws and regulations**
* Experience in **cultivating cross-functional relationships** and collaborating effectively across business and technical teams
* Familiarity with **call center technologies and tools** (CRM, telephony, workflow systems, etc.)
* Experience working across **multiple geographies** and adapting to diverse cultural contexts
* Willingness and ability to **travel periodically** , both domestically and internationally
* **Travel industry experience** preferred
Willingness to work a rotating schedule across weekdays, and shifts as needed; adaptable to business needs across voice, chat, and email.  

If you are passionate about elevating customer experience, driving operational excellence, and shaping the future of travel, this is the role for you.

  

**Accommodation requests**

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job\_accommodation .

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

What you'll do

* Data Pipeline & Orchestration: Design, build, and run batch and scheduled data pipelines (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and lead orchestrator upgrades.
* Data Ingestion & Scraping: Own and extend data collectors and engines, including web/API ingestion, large-scale web scraping (Playwright, Selenium, Scrapy), parsing, normalization, and file merging.
* Distributed Processing: Build scalable distributed processing architectures (Spark on EMR, Databricks, Dataproc) and analytical query layers (Athena, Snowflake, BigQuery), including cross-cloud ingestion pipelines.
* Caching & Entity Matching: Improve entity matching and caching services (Redis, MemoryDB, DynamoDB) to optimize accuracy, latency, and operational cost.
* Data Access & APIs: Develop and maintain high-performance Python dataaccess layers and APIs for downstream ML and product teams.
* Data Quality & Observability: Own data quality initiatives, including validation frameworks, retention policies, backfills, monitoring, and OpenTelemetry-based observability.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data science, forecasting, and platform teams to ship features safely behind feature flags (LaunchDarkly, Unleash).
* Engineering Leadership: Raise engineering standards across the team through rigorous code reviews, technical design documents, and mentoring.

What you bring

* Experience: 6+ years of software or data engineering experience, including 3+ years of experience building and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Python Mastery: Strong Python development skills with a commitment to writing clean, tested code (using pytest, nox, or tox).
* Orchestration Expertise: Deep experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow DAG design, operators, scheduling, and failure handling) or modern alternatives like Dagster and Prefect.
* Data Ecosystems: Hands-on experience with distributed compute (Spark) and cloud data ecosystems (AWS EMR/Athena/S3, Databricks, Snowflake, GCP).
* Storage & Modeling: Solid SQL and data-modeling skills, alongside practical experience with NoSQL databases, caching layers, and message queues (MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Infrastructure Familiarity: Comfort deploying and managing containerized workloads on Kubernetes using Docker and Helm.
* Production Ownership: A proven track record of owning production pipelines, including participating in on-call rotations, incident response, and root-cause analysis.
* Communication: Clear written technical communication and a history of documenting architectural decisions.

Nice to have

* Scraping Infrastructure: Experience managing large-scale web datacollection and distributed crawler infrastructure.
* Data Science / ML Concepts: Familiarity with record linkage, entity resolution, fuzzy matching, and NLP preprocessing (spaCy, NLTK).
* Multi-Cloud Pipelines: Hands-on experience building multi-cloud datapipelines (e.g., bridging GCP/BigQuery and AWS).
* ML Ops: Experience designing data pipelines that directly feed machine learning or forecasting systems.

title: Key Account Executive
description:
Key Account Executive — Customer Success & Account Management

About Enlog

Enlog is an energy intelligence company helping businesses monitor, understand and optimize electricity consumption through IoT-enabled hardware and AI-driven automation.

Our solutions are deployed across PG accommodation, hotels, banks and commercial buildings. We aim to deliver long-term customer value through reliable installations, device visibility, responsive support and continuous energy optimization.

Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive Key Account Manager to own customer relationships and post-installation account management for Enlog's deployed properties and enterprise accounts.

The role begins with a formal handover from the Project Management team after installation and commissioning. The Key Account Manager will become the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring smooth onboarding, ongoing communication, timely issue resolution and a positive customer experience.

The candidate should be comfortable with customer relationship management, operational follow-ups, dashboards, issue tracking and cross-functional coordination.

Key Responsibilities1. Customer Onboarding & Project Handover

* Receive formal handover from the Project Manager after installation and commissioning.
* Understand customer requirements, installed devices, project scope, site contacts and outstanding issues.
* Verify that property details, device counts, room mappings, commissioning records and support information are available.
* Introduce customers to the appropriate support process and escalation channels.
* Maintain a complete account record for every customer and property.

2. Account Management & Customer Communication

* Act as the primary point of contact for assigned customers after project completion.
* Maintain regular communication with property managers, owners, facility teams and relevant stakeholders.
* Track customer concerns, service requests, complaints and commitments.
* Provide timely updates on issue status, corrective actions and expected resolution.
* Build strong relationships that encourage customer retention, satisfaction and long-term engagement.
* Coordinate account reviews and share relevant operational updates with customers.

3. Device Health & Service Coordination

* Review device status and property health dashboards regularly.
* Identify offline devices, recurring connectivity issues and unresolved service alerts.
* Coordinate with the technical support and Execution teams to investigate device-related problems.
* Arrange local electrician or contractor visits when remote resolution is insufficient.
* Track service requests until resolution and confirm closure with the customer.
* Maintain a record of recurring faults, service history, replacement requirements and customer feedback.
* Escalate critical or recurring technical problems to the appropriate technical owner.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with Project Management, Execution, Electrician & MEP, Delivery & Inventory and technical support teams.
* Ensure that customer commitments are assigned to the correct internal owner.
* Follow up on pending installations, replacement devices, service visits and unresolved complaints.
* Track action items, deadlines and escalation status.
* Avoid making technical commitments without confirmation from the responsible technical team.

5. Retention, Renewals & Account Growth

* Track subscription renewals, service agreements and relevant commercial commitments.
* Coordinate renewal discussions and ensure customers receive timely renewal communication.
* Identify opportunities for additional device deployments, new properties and expansion within existing accounts.
* Gather customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve product adoption and service quality.
* Work with the Sales team on qualified expansion opportunities while retaining ownership of ongoing account relationships.

6. Reporting & Documentation

* Maintain accurate customer, property, device and service records.
* Track open complaints, offline devices, service turnaround times and recurring issues.
* Prepare periodic account health reports.
* Maintain a clear record of customer communications, commitments and next actions.
* Identify accounts at risk due to recurring faults, poor service experience or unresolved concerns.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering and Operations.
* 2–3 years of experience in key account management, customer success, service operations or B2B client management.
* Strong customer communication, follow-up and coordination skills.
* Experience managing multiple customers, locations or service accounts.
* Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and CRM or ticket-tracking tools.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to understand technical issues, coordinate troubleshooting and communicate updates clearly.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in hospitality, facility management, banking, proptech, IoT, energy management or B2B technology.
* Experience managing geographically distributed properties or enterprise accounts.
* Familiarity with technical support workflows, device dashboards and service-level tracking.
* Experience handling subscriptions, renewals, customer retention and account expansion.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Customer satisfaction and account retention.
* Timely acknowledgement and coordination of service requests.
* Closure of customer complaints within agreed timelines.
* Percentage of open issues with clear owners and next actions.
* Reduction in recurring complaints and avoidable customer escalations.
* Timeliness of renewal follow-ups.
* Accuracy of account and property records.
* Identification of qualified expansion opportunities.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is organized, customer-focused and proactive. They should be comfortable managing multiple properties, monitoring operational dashboards, following up with technical teams and ensuring customers are kept informed until their issues are resolved.

This is an account ownership and customer success role, not a pure sales position. Technical troubleshooting is supported by the engineering team; the Key Account Manager is responsible for customer communication, coordination and closure follow-up.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Project Warranty Manager
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

Could you be the full-time Project Warranty Manager in Mumbai we’re looking for?

  

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Warranty Manager is responsible for managing all warranty obligations related to Digital & Integrated Systems (D&IS) projects during the Defects Liability Period (DLP) and warranty phase. The role ensures timely resolution of customer issues, contractual compliance, effective coordination with engineering and field teams, and protection of project profitability while maintaining high customer satisfaction.

The Warranty Manager acts as the primary interface between customers, project teams, engineering, supply chain, quality, and maintenance organizations for all warranty-related matters.

### **Warranty Management**

* Lead and manage warranty activities across D&IS projects during the contractual warranty period.
* Ensure compliance with contractual warranty obligations, service level agreements (SLAs), and customer commitments.
* Establish and maintain warranty management processes, governance, and reporting mechanisms.
* Monitor warranty claims from initiation through closure.

### **Customer Interface**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for customers regarding warranty issues.
* Conduct regular review meetings with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of customer concerns.
* Support customer satisfaction and maintain long-term business relationships.

### **Incident and Defect Management**

* Coordinate investigation of hardware, software, signaling, telecom, SCADA, ATS, PSD, and integrated system failures.
* Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Ensure timely restoration of system availability and performance.
* Monitor recurrent failures and drive permanent corrective actions.

### **Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Engineering, RAMS, Quality, Supply Chain, Project Management, Field Operations, and Product Development teams.
* Escalate critical issues impacting safety, availability, or contractual compliance.
* Support implementation of engineering modifications and corrective actions.

### **Commercial and Contractual Management**

* Assess warranty claims and determine contractual liability.
* Control warranty costs and monitor budget performance.
* Support claims management with customers, suppliers, and subcontractors.
* Ensure supplier warranty recoveries are pursued where applicable.

### **Performance Monitoring and Reporting**

* Track key warranty KPIs including:
  + Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
  + Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
  + Availability and reliability metrics
  + Warranty claim closure cycle time
  + Open defect aging
  + Cost of non-quality (CONQ)
* Prepare periodic reports for management and customers.

### **Risk Management**

* Identify warranty risks and develop mitigation plans.
* Support lessons learned initiatives and continuous improvement programs.
* Participate in risk reviews and operational governance meetings.

### **Key deliverables**

* Maintain warranty registers, defect logs, action trackers, and closure records.
* Ensure traceability of failures, investigations, corrective actions, and customer approvals.
* Support audits and compliance reviews related to warranty performance.
* Warranty claim management and closure.
* Defect tracking and corrective action implementation.
* Customer warranty review reports.

* Root Cause Analysis reports.
* Warranty cost control and recovery plans.
* Monthly warranty performance dashboard.
* Lessons learned and reliability improvement actions.

**Eligibility- Qualifications & experience**
--------------------------------------------

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electronics, Electrical, Telecommunications).
* 10 years of experience in railway signaling with minimum 3 years in CBTC metro rail systems operating in ATP/ATO/UTO modes
* Experience in project execution, commissioning, maintenance/ warranty management.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
-------------------------------------

* Warranty claim closure within agreed SLA.
* Reduction in repeat failures.
* Customer satisfaction score.
* Warranty cost versus budget.
* On-time RCA completion.
* Defect backlog aging.
* System availability and reliability targets achievement.
* Supplier recovery success rate.

**Things you’ll enjoy** Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from monotonous daily routines.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilize our inclusive and flexible working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership roles and other exciting career opportunities.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognizes your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.
