title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Why should you apply to this role?**
The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large-scale Cloud migrations.
  
  
You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:**
Lead end-to-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
  
  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision-making through data-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support & engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:**
Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior-level decision-makers and c-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

title: Microsoft-CRM Technical-Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions – Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Manager Specialized:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced MS CRM Technical Senior Manager to lead large-scale Dynamics 365 CRM engagements, drive solution excellence, and contribute to business growth. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic leadership, ensuring successful delivery, stakeholder alignment, and expansion of CRM capabilities across accounts. You will play a key role in shaping solutions, mentoring teams, and driving business development initiatives within the Microsoft Business Applications ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end design and delivery of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions across complex programs.
* Architect scalable, high-performance solutions aligned with business and technology strategies.
* Drive solution quality, governance, and best practices across implementations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define vision, roadmap, and transformation initiatives.
* Provide technical leadership across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to timelines and budgets.
* Mentor and guide teams, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Support pre-sales activities including solutioning, estimations, proposal development, and client presentations.
* Identify and drive business development opportunities, including account growth, pipeline creation, and cross-sell of CRM and related capabilities.
* Build strong client relationships and act as a trusted advisor for CRM transformations.
* Ensure risk management, issue resolution, and proactive escalation across engagements.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, etc.) and Power Platform.
* Deep understanding of CRM architecture, customization, configuration, and extension capabilities.
* Hands-on experience in integrations, data migration, and enterprise solution design.
* Proven leadership in managing large, distributed teams and complex programs.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to balance technical delivery with business priorities and growth objectives.
* Experience in Agile/DevOps methodologies and modern delivery practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with focus on quality, scalability, and performance.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills and experiences are preferred and will be considered an advantage:
  
  

* Power Pages
* Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps (Code Apps)
* PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) Controls
* Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus
* Data Migration using SSIS (KingswaySoft) and Azure Data Factory
* Copilot Studio
* Dynamics 365 Project Operations
* Dynamics 365 Field Service
* Dynamics 365 Contact Center

**What We Look For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Total Experience: 12+ years
* Relevant Experience: 12+ years
* Proven track record of delivering Dynamics 365 CRM programs at scale.
* Strong exposure to client-facing roles, including pre-sales and business development.
* Experience working in global delivery models and cross-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* Relevant Microsoft certifications are preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Data Cloud)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.

* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.

* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

title: Us Medical Health Care (Rcm) Buisness & Development Manager
description:
Company: Medcore pvt ltd Industry: US Healthcare – Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Location: Kolkata, India Employment Type: Full-time Experience: 4–7 years Role Focus: B2B Lead Generation, Client Acquisition & Revenue Growth About MEDCORE: MEDCORE is a growing company focused on the US healthcare medical billing and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) market. We aim to help healthcare providers streamline their billing operations and improve revenue cycle efficiency. We are seeking a highly driven Marketing & Business Development Manager to lead our client acquisition efforts, establish a strong presence in the US market, and drive business growth. This is a hands-on, revenue-focused role suited to someone who has successfully generated B2B leads, built sales pipelines, and acquired clients for a services business. The ideal candidate can work independently, develop acquisition strategies from scratch, and convert prospects into long-term business relationships. Key Responsibilities 1. Lead Generation & Prospect Acquisition - Develop and execute a scalable lead generation strategy targeting the US healthcare market. - Identify and reach decision-makers at physician practices, specialty clinics, medical groups, and other relevant healthcare organisations. - Generate qualified leads through cold email outreach, LinkedIn prospecting, cold calling, targeted campaigns, referrals, and other relevant channels. - Build targeted prospect databases using tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, and similar platforms. - Develop ideal customer profiles, prospect lists, outreach sequences, and lead qualification criteria. - Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified prospects and sales opportunities. 2. End-to-End Client Acquisition & Sales - Own the complete sales cycle, from initial prospecting and lead qualification to discovery calls, presentations, proposals, negotiations, and deal closure. - Conduct introductory calls and communicate Medcore service offerings and value proposition to potential clients. - Understand prospects' business challenges and identify opportunities where the company's medical billing and RCM services can add value. - Prepare proposals, coordinate pricing discussions with leadership, manage follow-ups, and negotiate commercial terms within approved guidelines. - Convert qualified prospects into signed contracts and establish strong client relationships. - Coordinate onboarding handovers with the operations team after a client is acquired. 3. US Healthcare Market Development - Research the US medical billing and RCM market, competitors, target segments, and emerging opportunities. - Develop targeted acquisition strategies for relevant medical specialties and healthcare provider segments. - Understand common provider challenges, including claim denials, reimbursement delays, billing inefficiencies, and accounts receivable management. - Develop compelling sales messaging that communicates OneMeds' capabilities and differentiates the company from competitors. - Build referral relationships and strategic partnerships that can generate qualified business opportunities. 4. Growth Marketing & Demand Generation - Plan and execute marketing initiatives that directly support lead generation and customer acquisition. - Coordinate targeted email marketing, LinkedIn campaigns, landing pages, website optimisation, SEO, and relevant digital campaigns. - Develop sales collateral, service presentations, case studies, and prospect-facing content in collaboration with internal subject-matter experts. - Test acquisition channels, messaging, and outreach strategies to improve lead quality and conversion rates. - Work closely with leadership to align marketing activities with revenue targets and business priorities. 5. CRM & Sales Pipeline Management - Maintain an organised CRM containing prospect information, lead sources, communication history, deal stages, and follow-up actions. - Track lead-to-meeting conversion, meeting-to-proposal conversion, proposal-to-client conversion, and sales cycle duration. - Provide weekly pipeline reports and monthly performance updates to management. - Analyse campaign and sales performance to improve acquisition efficiency and reduce wasted effort. - Build a repeatable client acquisition process that can scale as the business grows. Required Qualifications & Experience - 4–7 years of experience in B2B business development, client acquisition, demand generation, or growth marketing. - Demonstrable success in generating qualified B2B leads and converting prospects into paying clients. - Preference for candidates with experience in US medical billing, healthcare RCM, healthcare outsourcing, medical coding, or healthcare technology. - Experience selling services to international clients, particularly in the US market. - Hands-on experience with outbound prospecting, cold email, LinkedIn outreach, lead qualification, and sales presentations. - Proven ability to manage the sales pipeline and close B2B service contracts. - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in dealing with US-based decision-makers. - Ability to work independently, take ownership of revenue-generating activities, and operate effectively in a startup environment. Preferred Tools & Skills - LinkedIn Sales Navigator - Apollo or equivalent B2B prospecting tools - HubSpot, Salesforce, or another CRM - Email outreach and sales engagement platforms - Google Analytics and relevant marketing analytics tools - B2B sales presentations, proposal development, negotiation, and account management Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance will be evaluated primarily on measurable business development outcomes: - Number of qualified leads generated from the target US healthcare market. - Number of qualified sales meetings booked and completed. - Number of proposals submitted to prospective clients. - Number of new clients acquired and contracts signed. - Revenue and recurring business generated from new clients. - Lead-to-meeting and proposal-to-client conversion rates. - Cost per qualified lead and effectiveness of acquisition channels. - Consistency and accuracy of CRM updates and pipeline reporting. Specific targets will be agreed upon based on the company's service offerings, available resources, sales cycle, and growth objectives. Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is a commercially minded, proactive professional who combines strong lead generation capabilities with hands-on B2B sales and closing experience. They should have a proven track record of finding prospects, initiating conversations with decision-makers, creating qualified opportunities, and winning paying clients. They must be comfortable building processes from scratch, testing new acquisition channels, and being accountable for business growth rather than focusing solely on brand awareness or social media engagement. Application Requirements Candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting: - Relevant B2B client acquisition and lead generation experience. - Experience in US healthcare, medical billing, RCM, or related services, where applicable. - Previous client acquisition results and their individual contribution. - Sales channels, prospecting tools, and CRM platforms used. - Examples of measurable business development achievements.

Pay: ₹14,000.00 - ₹49,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Analyst, Cluster Head- Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.
* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.
* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.
* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.
* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.
* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.
* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
We are seeking a motivated and dynamic Relationship Manager to join our team in Tamil Nadu. The primary purpose of this role is to drive business through our channel partners' sales teams and distribution networks. As a Relationship Manager, you will be responsible for building strong relationships across the partner network and growing the business by driving sales of KLI products through these partners. title: Strategic Impact Partner
description:
GNOWGEN is a strategic sustainability organization committed to transforming sustainability ambitions into measurable actions, real-time insights, and business outcomes.

As regulatory requirements evolve and organizations increasingly prioritize Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) initiatives, the demand for effective sustainability reporting, compliance, impact measurement, and stakeholder transparency continues to grow. GNOWGEN addresses this need through innovative solutions, strategic advisory services, and ESGTwin, our sustainability intelligence platform.

We believe meaningful impact and commercial success should go hand in hand. Having already created significant sustainability impact across organizations and ecosystems, we are now seeking passionate professionals who can help convert that impact into sustainable business growth.

Position

**Role:**
 Strategic Impact Partner

**Location:**
 Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

**Employment Type:**
 Full-Time / Associate Partner

**Reporting To:**
 Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Chief Business Officer (CBO)

**Coordination With:**
 Client Partner Manager

Role Purpose

The Strategic Impact Partner serves as the bridge between GNOWGEN's sustainability impact and the market's growing need for ESG solutions.

This role is not a technical, implementation, consulting, or target-driven sales position. Instead, the focus is on building trusted relationships, engaging decision-makers, communicating sustainability value, and enabling organizations to understand how ESG reporting, compliance, and impact measurement can support their business objectives.

The ideal candidate is someone who can effectively translate purpose into opportunity and impact into revenue.

Key ResponsibilitiesRelationship Building

* Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing clients.
* Build trust with senior executives, sustainability leaders, compliance teams, and decision-makers.
* Act as a strategic ambassador for GNOWGEN and ESGTwin.

Impact Communication

* Understand and communicate the value of sustainability initiatives and ESG reporting.
* Present business benefits arising from ESG compliance and impact measurement.
* Explain regulatory developments and sustainability expectations in a clear and responsible manner.

Opportunity Development

* Identify organizations that can benefit from GNOWGEN's solutions.
* Facilitate discussions that lead to new business opportunities.
* Support customer expansion and long-term engagement.

Customer Success

* Maintain healthy customer relationships.
* Ensure customers remain engaged and satisfied.
* Collaborate with
  Client Partner Manager
  to support customer needs and expectations.

Market Engagement

* Participate in networking events, industry forums, conferences, and sustainability discussions.
* Build awareness around ESGTwin and GNOWGEN's sustainability capabilities.
* Help establish strategic partnerships and business collaborations.

What This Role Is Not

This role does 
**not**
 involve:

* Software development
* Product implementation
* ESG consulting delivery
* Technical configuration
* Project management
* Revenue targets or sales quotas
* Cold-calling driven sales activities

ExperiencePreferred

* 5+ years of professional experience in business development, consulting, sustainability, client management, relationship management, strategy, or leadership positions.
* Strong professional network is advantageous.
* Experience interacting with senior management and decision-makers.

Fresh Perspective Welcome

Individuals with leadership experience, entrepreneurial backgrounds, industry expertise, or strong relationship-building capabilities are encouraged to apply.

Prior ESG knowledge is beneficial but not mandatory.

Skills & Competencies

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong relationship-building ability
* Strategic thinking
* Professional networking capability
* Business acumen
* Stakeholder management
* Executive presence
* Passion for sustainability and positive impact

Training & Support

GNOWGEN will provide:

* ESG and sustainability awareness training
* Product and platform training
* Regulatory and compliance orientation
* Sales enablement and customer engagement guidance
* Continuous mentoring from ESG leadership

Performance Expectations

Unlike traditional sales roles, this position operates without rigid sales targets or quotas.

Success is measured through:

* Strength of customer relationships
* Quality of stakeholder engagement
* Customer retention and growth
* Business opportunities generated
* Contribution to sustainable revenue growth
* Alignment with GNOWGEN values and mission

Why Join GNOWGEN?

* Be part of a purpose-driven sustainability movement.
* Help organizations create measurable environmental and social impact.
* Work directly with senior leadership.
* Shape the future of ESG and sustainability transformation.
* Convert meaningful impact into lasting business value.
* Engage with industry leaders, governments, enterprises, and sustainability professionals.

**If you believe sustainability should create both positive impact and sustainable business outcomes, and you have the ability to build trusted relationships that transform purpose into growth, we would love to hear from you.**

title: General Manager
description:
**Company:** Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** Business Operations & Management  
**Reports To:** CEO / Managing Director  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

1. Job Purpose

The General Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall business operations of Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd., ensuring operational efficiency, business growth, profitability, customer satisfaction, and effective coordination across all departments. The role involves implementing management strategies, monitoring departmental performance, identifying operational gaps, and ensuring that company objectives are achieved.

2. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Business Operations & Strategy**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the company and ensure smooth functioning across departments.
* Develop and implement business strategies in line with company objectives.
* Identify operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish policies, procedures, SOPs, and performance standards.
* Ensure coordination between the Head Office, warehouse, and other business units.

**B. Sales & Business Development**

* Monitor sales performance and ensure achievement of monthly and annual targets.
* Develop strategies to increase revenue, customer acquisition, and repeat purchases.
* Identify new business opportunities, products, markets, and revenue streams.
* Analyse sales reports, customer trends, and competitor activities.
* Work with the sales team to improve productivity and conversion rates.

**C. Marketing & Ecommerce Management**

* Supervise marketing activities, campaigns, promotions, and digital marketing performance.
* Monitor website performance, online sales, product listings, and order conversion.
* Evaluate campaign ROI, customer acquisition costs, and marketing expenditure.
* Coordinate with marketing teams to improve brand visibility and customer engagement.
* Ensure promotional offers and product campaigns align with business objectives.

**D. Warehouse & Logistics Management**

* Monitor inventory management, stock accuracy, order processing, packing, dispatch, and returns.
* Ensure timely order fulfilment and efficient coordination with courier partners.
* Review shipping costs, delivery performance, RTO rates, and damaged or lost shipments.
* Implement procedures to minimise stock discrepancies, wastage, and operational losses.
* Ensure proper warehouse documentation, stock reconciliation, and safety standards.

**E. Financial & Cost Management**

* Monitor revenue, expenses, profitability, budgets, and operating costs.
* Coordinate with Accounts & Finance to review financial reports and cash flow.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Monitor outstanding payments, COD settlements, vendor payments, and logistics expenses.
* Ensure financial controls and compliance with company policies.

**F. Human Resources & Administration**

* Coordinate with HR on manpower planning, recruitment, employee performance, and training.
* Monitor attendance, productivity, discipline, and departmental staffing requirements.
* Ensure clear reporting structures, accountability, and performance evaluation.
* Supervise administrative functions, facilities, procurement coordination, and resource utilisation.
* Support employee engagement and the development of a performance-oriented work culture.

**G. Customer Service & Customer Retention**

* Monitor customer complaints, returns, refunds, and service quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer issues and escalations.
* Develop strategies to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and repeat purchases.
* Analyse customer feedback and implement corrective actions.

**H. Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage relationships with suppliers, courier partners, service providers, and business associates.
* Review vendor quotations, service quality, delivery commitments, and commercial terms.
* Negotiate favourable business terms and monitor vendor performance.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal teams for new product launches and business requirements.

**I. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Define KPIs and performance targets for departments and team leaders.
* Conduct regular departmental review meetings and track action items.
* Submit daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Identify deviations from targets and implement corrective and preventive measures.
* Ensure timely completion of management decisions and assigned projects.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of sales and revenue targets.
* Improvement in gross margin and overall profitability.
* Reduction in operational costs and logistics expenses.
* Order processing and dispatch efficiency.
* Delivery success rate and reduction in RTO percentage.
* Inventory accuracy and reduction in stock discrepancies.
* Customer satisfaction and repeat purchase rate.
* Departmental productivity and achievement of KPIs.
* Timely implementation of SOPs and management decisions.
* Vendor performance and cost optimisation.

4. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Management, or a related field.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Management is preferred.

5. Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in operations, business management, ecommerce, retail, or distribution.
* Prior experience managing multiple departments and cross-functional teams is preferred.
* Experience in ecommerce operations, warehouse management, logistics, sales, and business development will be an advantage.

6. Required Skills & Competencies

* Leadership, team management, and decision-making.
* Strong business planning and operational execution.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Financial awareness, budgeting, and cost control.
* Sales, marketing, and ecommerce understanding.
* Vendor negotiation and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, ERP, and business management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work towards deadlines.

7. Authority & Accountability

* Recommend and implement operational improvements within approved authority.
* Monitor departmental performance and require corrective action where necessary.
* Review departmental reports, budgets, and operational expenses.
* Recommend staffing, vendor, process, and resource changes to management.
* Escalate significant financial, operational, compliance, and customer-related risks to the CEO / Managing Director.
* Ensure confidentiality, compliance, and adherence to company policies.

8. Working Relationships

**Internal:** CEO / Managing Director, HR, Sales, Marketing, Accounts & Finance, Purchase, IT, Customer Relationship Management, Warehouse, and Administration.

**External:** Vendors, suppliers, courier partners, service providers, customers, and other business associates.

9. Overall Responsibility

The General Manager is accountable for ensuring that Phygicart Ecommerce Pvt. Ltd. operates efficiently, achieves its business targets, maintains cost discipline, improves customer experience, and develops a structured, accountable, and performance-driven organization

Pay: ₹80,000.00 - ₹110,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Product Support Associate
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
Product Support is the front line for resolving escalated issues that reach our internal teams and customers - the layer between day-to-day support and deep technical investigation. As a Product Support Associate, you'll own escalated cases end to end: diagnosing what's actually going wrong, resolving it directly when you can, and looping in engineering or product only when a case genuinely requires deeper investigation. Most cases you'll handle are resolvable with the right systems knowledge and a sharp eye for detail - this role is about speed, accuracy, and follow-through.This is a high-impact individual contributor role for someone who thrives on solving problems for people, is relentless about getting to the right answer, and wants to build the operating rhythm of a brand-new team.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Own escalation cases end to end - triaging incoming issues from internal teams and customers, diagnosing root cause, and resolving them directly whenever possible
* Ensure accuracy and clarity in every resolution: small errors here have outsized downstream impact
* Build fluency across the systems that matter for troubleshooting and backend tools (e.g., Datadog, Amplitude) to recognize when something is a known issue vs. something new
* Serve as a clear, responsive point of contact for the internal teams and customers who filed the case, keeping them updated and setting accurate expectations on timing
* Get on the phone with customers when a case calls for it, walking them through a solution or troubleshooting live rather than relying solely on written back-and-forth .While not all escalations will require customer interaction, this team will regularly be working with customers to ensure solutions are found through a good customer experience
* Meet defined service levels for response and resolution time, and hold yourself accountable to individual and team goals as the team's cadence gets established.
* Identify and recognize patterns when the same issue shows up repeatedly, flag it as a candidate for a permanent fix rather than a one-off resolution, and help build the internal knowledge base so recurring issues get faster to resolve over time

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 1-3 years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or a related troubleshooting role
* Comfortable working in Salesforce or equivalent case management/help desk software
* Strong analytical instincts and technical curiosity - you can navigate unfamiliar systems and figure out what's actually happening without needing everything explained
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a resolution clearly to both a frustrated customer and an internal stakeholder
* Highly organized, with a strong sense of ownership over open cases and follow-through on commitments

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***

description:
**MAIN DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE:**

* Act as first-line support for network and security operational requests, managing and resolving tickets logged via ServiceNow in line with agreed SLAs.
* Create, amend, and remove firewall rules on Palo Alto NGFW via Panorama and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM), following approved change requests and the firm's security policy.
* Administer and support Zscaler ZIA and ZPA policies, including URL/application access requests, policy exceptions, and troubleshooting user connectivity issues.
* Raise, track, and progress changes through ServiceNow change management, ensuring accurate documentation, approvals, and an audit trail for all firewall and network changes.
* Monitor network and security alerts, triaging issues and escalating to senior network engineers where deeper investigation or architectural change is required.
* Proactively review and improve the SNMP-based network monitoring and alerting setup, working with senior engineers to increase visibility, reduce noise, and mature alerting coverage across the estate.
* Perform routine access reviews, rule clean-up, and housekeeping tasks across the Palo Alto and Zscaler estates to maintain a clean and auditable policy base.
* Support incident response for network and security events, gathering diagnostic information and assisting senior engineers with resolution.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation of network configurations, firewall rule sets, and standard operating procedures.
* Liaise with global network engineering colleagues, business users, and other technology teams to understand requests and provide clear updates on progress.
* Assist with basic network troubleshooting (connectivity, routing, VPN, DNS) using standard diagnostic tools, escalating complex issues to senior engineers as appropriate.
* Participate in a shift or on-call rota providing regional support coverage outside of core hours as required.

**SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES**
(e. g. shifts, travel overseas, hours):
  
  

* Role based in the Bangalore office; shift patterns to be agreed, including a requirement to cover extended hours to support global operations
* Weekend and on-call work will also be necessary on a rota basis
* Occasional travel to other Brevan Howard offices may be required

**PERSON SPECIFICATION**
**WORK EXPERIENCE/BACKGROUND:**
**Essential**
**Desirable:**

* 5+ years' experience in a network or IT operations support role, ideally within a ticket-driven, process-controlled environment
* Demonstrable experience administering firewall rule changes and access requests in a live production environment
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow defined change management and security processes accurately
* Comfortable managing a high volume of tickets and requests, prioritising effectively to meet SLAs
* Good verbal and written communication skills, able to liaise clearly with global colleagues and business stakeholders
* Experience within a hedge fund, asset manager, or other financial services technology environment is strongly preferred
* Exposure to working within a regulated, compliance-driven environment
* Experience working within a global, follow-the-sun support model

**Essential**
**Desirable:**

* Palo Alto NGFW firewall rule administration via Panorama (essential)
* Palo Alto Strata Cloud Manager (SCM) — policy and object management (essential)
* Zscaler ZIA and ZPA — policy administration, access requests, and basic troubleshooting
* ServiceNow — incident, request, and change ticket management
* CCNP-level routing and switching knowledge, with solid core networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, OSPF/BGP basics
* Basic troubleshooting using tools such as ping, traceroute, and packet capture
* Familiarity with SNMP-based network monitoring and alerting tools, with an interest in helping to mature and improve monitoring/alerting coverage across the estate
* Ability to read and interpret firewall logs and basic packet captures to support issue diagnosis
* CCNA or an equivalent networking qualification
* Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE certification, or actively working towards one
* Exposure to Cisco switching and routing (IOS/NX-OS)
* Exposure to network monitoring tools such as LogicMonitor
* Basic scripting or automation exposure (e.g. Python)
* Exposure to cloud networking (AWS) fundamentals

**TECHNICAL SKILLS/KNOWLEDGE/PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:**
**COMPETENCIES/OTHER REQUIREMENTS:**
Proactive, self-starting approach — looks to identify and improve processes, monitoring, and tooling rather than simply responding to tickets
  
  
Methodical, process-driven approach with excellent attention to detail
  
  
Willingness to follow established change and security procedures accurately and without deviation
  
  
Calm and organised when managing a high volume of tickets and requests
  
  
Takes ownership of assigned tickets and follows through to resolution
  
  
Good written and verbal communication skills
  
  
Strong team player, comfortable working with colleagues across regions and time zones
  
  
A proactive willingness to learn and develop technical skills over time

title: Support Engineering Intern
description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
  
  
**The Position**
We are looking for a Support Engineering Intern to join our Level 1 technical support team for six months. You will work alongside experienced engineers on live customer cases: investigating issues, reproducing them in lab environments, and helping customers deploy and configure our products. This is not a shadowing program. From your first weeks you will own real tickets, with a mentor beside you.
  
  
We are especially interested in people who are curious about AI and automation. Every case we handle is different, and getting to an answer means digging through logs, documentation, and past investigations. AI and good internal tooling can make that work sharper and faster — better search across our knowledge base, quicker log analysis, cleaner first drafts of technical documentation. If that is something you enjoy exploring, you will have room to experiment here and a team that will adopt what proves useful.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Customer Issue Management**

* Work the queue of open support tickets alongside your mentor, helping ensure timely resolution.
* Investigate and diagnose reported technical issues — gather information, reproduce the problem, and narrow down the cause.
* Search internal knowledge systems (FAQs, troubleshooting guides, past tickets, product documentation, internal wikis) to find solutions before escalating.
* Escalate complex cases to senior engineers with clear, well-documented troubleshooting notes.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with customers via email, chat, and ticketing tools.

**Technical Assistance & Troubleshooting**

* Help customers with installation, configuration, and integration of OPSWAT products.
* Build and maintain lab environments used to reproduce customer scenarios.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and QA teams to get to the bottom of technical challenges.

**AI & Automation (where you can make a mark)**

* Identify repetitive, manual steps in the daily support workflow and propose ways to automate them.

title: Senior Technical Analyst - MECM, Intune
description:
**Life on the team**

* A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a technical role within Computacenter’s dynamic and rapidly expanding Digital Infrastructure group. You will join a global organisation delivering services across more than 70 countries.
* You will work with experienced infrastructure and workplace specialists, supporting a large, complex and business-critical Microsoft endpoint management environment from our Computacenter office in Bangalore.
* This role is primarily focused on BAU and project services, with ownership of the MECM platform and tooling, while supporting the customer’s phased transition towards Co-Management and Microsoft Intune.
* You will have exposure to enterprise-scale endpoint engineering, platform transformation, automation and modern management technologies.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own, administer, maintain and continuously improve the enterprise Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) platform and all associated tooling.
* Manage the full MECM infrastructure, including Central Administration Site where applicable, primary and secondary sites, management points, distribution points, software update points, reporting services points, service connection points, boundaries, boundary groups, collections and client settings.
* Lead MECM platform build, upgrade, hotfix, capacity, availability, performance, backup, recovery and disaster recovery activities across a large and complex environment.
* Engineer, maintain and troubleshoot Windows operating system deployment using task sequences, boot images, driver and BIOS management, PXE, USMT and standard enterprise build processes.
* Own enterprise patch management through MECM, including Software Update Point/WSUS integration, Automatic Deployment Rules, deployment rings, maintenance windows, compliance monitoring, remediation and vulnerability reduction.
* Manage the end-to-end software lifecycle through MECM, including application and package creation, testing, deployment, supersedence, dependencies, uninstall, retirement, content distribution and compliance reporting.
* Provide L3 support for complex MECM incidents, client health issues, site system failures, content distribution problems, deployment failures, patching issues and operating system deployment defects.
* Lead technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis using MECM logs, SQL queries, WMI, PowerShell, client diagnostics and server-side platform monitoring.
* Monitor platform health, component status, replication, inbox processing, site database performance, distribution status, client activity and overall service availability; implement proactive controls and alerts.
* Maintain MECM security and governance, including role-based administration, service accounts, certificates, PKI/HTTPS configuration, least-privilege access, audit controls and operational documentation.
* Design and support Co-Management workloads between MECM and Intune, including device enrolment, tenant attach, Cloud Management Gateway and the phased movement of workloads to cloud management.
* Support the customer’s Intune migration roadmap by assessing MECM workloads, dependencies, applications, policies and device readiness, and by developing controlled migration plans and pilot rings.
* Configure and troubleshoot relevant Intune capabilities, including compliance policies, configuration profiles, application deployment, Windows Update for Business, Autopilot and endpoint security policies.
* Develop PowerShell automation, health checks, operational dashboards and reports to improve platform reliability, deployment success, compliance and support efficiency.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, support procedures, build standards, patching runbooks, operating models and knowledge articles.
* Work closely with security, infrastructure, network, application packaging, service management and workplace teams to deliver stable services and planned platform transformation.
* Provide technical mentorship, contribute to service improvements and lead assigned platform projects and changes.

**What You’ll Need**

* Experience: Minimum 7+ years of hands-on experience supporting large enterprise endpoint management environments, with strong recent experience in MECM/SCCM platform engineering and L3 operations.
* MECM Platform Expertise: Deep hands-on knowledge of MECM current branch architecture, installation, configuration, site systems, hierarchy design, upgrades, hotfixes, backup/recovery, monitoring, performance and troubleshooting.
* Operating System Deployment: Strong experience with Windows 10/11 build engineering, task sequences, boot images, PXE, drivers, BIOS/firmware, USMT and operating system deployment troubleshooting.
* Patch Management: Advanced experience with WSUS/SUP, Automatic Deployment Rules, deployment rings, maintenance windows, servicing, compliance reporting and remediation across enterprise estates.
* Software Management: Strong experience with MECM applications, packages, collections, requirements, detection methods, dependencies, supersedence, content distribution and deployment troubleshooting.
* MECM Infrastructure: Strong knowledge of management points, distribution points, software update points, reporting services, boundaries, boundary groups, discovery methods, client installation and client health.
* Database and Reporting: Working knowledge of SQL Server, MECM database maintenance, SSRS reporting and SQL/WQL queries for operational analysis and compliance reporting.
* Troubleshooting: Proven ability to analyse MECM server and client logs, WMI, IIS, SQL, replication and content distribution issues and to lead complex root cause investigations.
* Co-Management: Strong experience implementing and supporting MECM and Intune Co-Management, tenant attach, Cloud Management Gateway and workload transition strategies.
* Intune: Practical hands-on experience with Intune configuration profiles, compliance, application deployment, Windows Update for Business, Autopilot and endpoint security. Intune is important for the migration roadmap, but MECM depth is essential for the immediate role.
* Cloud and Security: Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure services, certificates/PKI, Defender for Endpoint integration and enterprise endpoint security controls.
* Scripting and Automation: Strong PowerShell skills for MECM administration, automation, data collection, remediation, reporting and troubleshooting.
* Change and Service Management: Experience working within structured ITIL processes for incident, problem, change, release, capacity, availability and configuration management.
* Communication and Ownership: Strong written and verbal communication, documentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to take end-to-end ownership of a critical platform.
* Preferred: Relevant Microsoft certifications and experience delivering a phased transition from MECM-led management to Co-Management and Intune.

**About us**

* With over 20,000 employees across the globe, we work at the heart of digitisation, advising organisations on IT strategy, implementing appropriate technology, and helping customers source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure in more than 70 countries.

title: System Operations Engineer
description:
**About This Role**
Wells Fargo is seeking a System Operations Engineer.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Participate in complex technical issues and initiatives related to large scale applications, systems, databases, or other technical products and services
* Identify opportunity for process improvements within technical support strategies and plans
* Review and analyze technical queries to extract data, create standard databases, or perform limited programming to fine tune systems supporting low to medium risk technical deliverables
* Present recommendations for resolving complex technical queries
* Exercise some independent judgment to analyze performance trends and recommend process improvements while developing understanding of technical process controls or standards
* Work as an internal consultant regarding use of tools and processes
* Provide information related to supported system area to functional colleagues, internal partners and stakeholders, including internal customers

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Systems Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Minimum Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Good knowledge of Windows 10/11, macOS, Microsoft 365, hardware, and peripheral troubleshooting.
* Experience with end-user/desktop support, incident management, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of Intune, Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, Cloud PC/VDI, and device management is preferred.
* Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, and basic connectivity troubleshooting.
* Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with other technology teams.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 support, work in rotational shifts, and be flexible based on business requirements.
* Experience in System Administration & Desktop troubleshooting skills.
* Quickly adapt to the business objective of the organization and adhere to the policies and procedures.
* Proficient knowledge on Microsoft Operating System Windows 10 and Windows 11) is a Mandate.
* A good understanding of network terminologies, Cisco products and should have worked on basic to intermediary level on networks. (LAN/WAN)
* Should have working knowledge on Windows Server administration principles.
* Should have strong skills on incident management and should have understanding and participation skills on problem management space
* Knowledge of Apple hardware
* Microsoft Experience (preferably but not essential MSCE) – incl. AD, Exchange, Office 365, Intune MDM
* Experience of Network/Firewalls/Printers setup and maintenance Experience with Mobile Phone/iPad setup
* Ability to Manage SLA’s and Priorities
* Good Customer Service skills – Able to communicate clearly and precisely
* Excellent background in Technical Support – Managed services environment an advantage
* Knowledge of ITIL an advantage
* Minimum Degree
* ITIL certification
* Knowledge on VMWare Concepts, Azure Cloud Concepts, SNOW, OS troubleshooting skills

**Job Expectations**

* 24/7 Support Readiness: Be prepared to provide support during critical incidents, business-impacting issues, and planned activities outside standard working hours when required.
* Flexible Working: Demonstrate flexibility to work across different shifts, weekends, or extended hours based on business and operational requirements.
* FTS Operational Support: Provide effective onsite support for incidents, service requests, Tech Express activities, device provisioning, hardware/software issues, and user escalations.
* Business-Critical Support: Prioritize and respond promptly to high-impact issues to minimize disruption to business operations.
* Ownership & Accountability: Take end-to-end ownership of assigned issues and ensure appropriate follow-up through resolution or escalation.
* Cross-Team Collaboration: Work closely with Service Desk, infrastructure, network, security, and other technology teams for timely resolution.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for automation, knowledge-base creation, shift-left enablement, and reduction of recurring incidents.
* Adaptability: Be willing to support multiple technologies, locations, and changing business requirements as needed.

3 Nov 2026
  
  

* Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

title: L1 IT Specialist
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including University of Melbourne, University of New South Wales, Adelaide University, University of Sydney, Harvard University, Yale University, and Stanford University. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

This role works an early shift starting at 6:00 AM IST to align with our APAC teams and clients.

**The Role**

We are seeking an experienced L1 IT Specialist to provide responsive, hands-on technical support to JoVE employees across a distributed work environment. This role is focused on end-user and deskside support, including troubleshooting laptops, desktops, peripherals, software, user accounts, connectivity, and collaboration tools. The L1 IT Specialist will own routine support requests through resolution, document work clearly, and escalate more complex issues when appropriate. The ideal candidate combines strong customer service, practical troubleshooting skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.

**Responsibilities**

* Provide Level 1 technical support to employees through the ticketing system, remote support channels, and hands-on/deskside support when applicable.
* Troubleshoot and resolve common hardware, software, operating system, peripheral, printing, audio/video, and connectivity issues.
* Set up, configure, deploy, replace, and maintain laptops, desktops, monitors, mobile devices, printers, and other end-user equipment.
* Support Windows and macOS environments, standard productivity applications, browsers, email, collaboration tools, and remote-access tools.
* Diagnose basic network and connectivity issues, including Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP, and escalate infrastructure issues when required.
* Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including device preparation, account provisioning/deprovisioning, access changes, software installation, and equipment recovery.
* Perform routine user and access administration, including password resets, MFA enrollment, group membership, distribution lists, licenses, and approved permissions.
* Support and troubleshoot business phone/VoIP systems, including user provisioning, device/application setup, call-quality issues, and basic configuration for platforms such as GCF, RingCentral, 8x8, or similar solutions.
* Log, prioritize, update, and resolve support tickets within established SLAs; maintain clear troubleshooting notes, resolution details, and escalation information.
* Maintain accurate IT asset and inventory records, including device assignments, replacements, returns, repairs, and spare equipment.
* Follow IT security, access-control, data-protection, change-management, and support procedures; escalate suspected security issues promptly.
* Create and maintain support documentation, knowledge-base articles, setup instructions, and standard troubleshooting procedures.
* Coordinate hardware repairs, warranty/vendor support, and equipment replacements as needed; perform other IT support duties assigned by the Team Manager.

 **Requirements**  

* 3+ years of demonstrable experience in IT help desk, desktop support, deskside support, or a similar end-user technical support role.
* Strong troubleshooting skills for laptops, desktops, operating systems, applications, peripherals, and common end-user technology issues.
* Working knowledge of Windows 10/11 and macOS, with the ability to install, configure, update, and troubleshoot end-user devices.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace applications and common collaboration tools.
* Ability to diagnose basic network and remote-access issues involving Wi-Fi, VPN, TCP/IP, DNS, and DHCP.
* Experience with employee onboarding/offboarding, device deployment, account administration, MFA, permissions, and software installation.
* Experience with ticketing/ITSM platforms such as Zendesk, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Salesforce.
* Strong customer-service mindset with excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and troubleshooting steps clearly to both technical and non-technical users.
* Strong attention to detail, documentation habits, prioritization skills, and ability to manage multiple support requests.
* Basic understanding of IT service-management concepts, SLAs, KPIs, escalation practices, and frameworks such as ITIL.
* Ability to work independently on routine incidents while recognizing when an issue should be escalated.
* Computer Science, Information Technology, or related degree/diploma, or equivalent practical experience.

**Must Have Tools Qualifications at Admin (not user) level**

* + Google Admin Console / Google Workspace administration
  + Microsoft 365 Admin Center / Entra ID user and access administration
  + Slack Admin Console
  + Mac and Windows Support

**Nice to have Tools Qualifications at Admin (not user) level**

* Endpoint/device management tools such as Microsoft Intune, MDM, RMM, SCCM, or equivalent
* Apple Business Manager (ABM) knowledge, including device enrollment and assignment workflows.
* Experience supporting and administering phone/VoIP systems such as GCF, RingCentral, 8x8, or similar platforms.
* Active Directory / Entra ID group, user, and permission administration
* Atlassian Admin Suite / Jira Service Management
* ChatGPT and Claude administration consoles
* Salesforce, AWS, and Zoom administration
* Remote support tools and basic PowerShell or other scripting/automation experience.

 **Benefits**

* You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
* Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
* Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us
