title: IT Systems Administrator (Cloud, Identity, Endpoint & Security)
description:
**Transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully-autonomous food production sites**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At eternal.ag, we're building the future of sustainable food production. Our mission is to convert the world's existing greenhouses into fully automated facilities that can produce fresh food year-round - addressing the critical need to double food production by 2050 while facing severe labor shortages, water scarcity, and climate challenges.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an IT Systems Administrator to own and improve day-to-day IT operations across cloud services, identity, endpoint devices, and cybersecurity controls. You will manage AWS infrastructure basics, Microsoft 365 services, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and access, Windows PCs, and Ubuntu/Linux laptops. You will also implement and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) and help establish and enforce practical cybersecurity policies and best practices across the company.  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong troubleshooting skills, structured documentation habits, and the ability to balance user support with system reliability and security.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

**IT operations & user support**

* Provide Tier 1–2 support for employees across hardware, OS, identity/login, network access, and SaaS tools.
* Provision, onboard, and offboard users (accounts, groups, device enrollment, licenses, access rights).
* Maintain IT documentation (runbooks, onboarding/offboarding checklists, asset records, system diagrams).
* Manage IT vendors and service providers as needed (ISPs, equipment suppliers, security tools).

**Microsoft 365 administration**

* Administer Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive, and core admin settings.
* Manage licensing and service configuration aligned to business needs and cost control.
* Implement and monitor baseline security controls (e.g., MFA, security defaults/conditional access, mailbox security, secure sharing).
* Support email deliverability, domain/DNS records (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), and collaboration settings.

**Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) / Identity & Access Management**

* Administer Microsoft Entra ID tenant configuration, users/groups, role-based access controls, and identity lifecycle.
* Implement access policies such as MFA, Conditional Access, device compliance requirements, and least-privilege access.
* Manage SSO integrations for SaaS applications and troubleshoot authentication issues.
* Support secure onboarding/offboarding and periodic access reviews.

**Endpoint management: Windows + Ubuntu/Linux**

* Maintain Windows PCs (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, device encryption, local admin controls, endpoint security).
* Maintain Ubuntu/Linux laptops (user access, updates, disk encryption where applicable, security hardening, troubleshooting).
* Standardize device setup using repeatable processes (imaging, configuration scripts, endpoint policies).
* Maintain endpoint inventory (hardware specs, ownership, lifecycle, warranty, status).

**Mobile Device Management (MDM) & device compliance**

* Implement and administer an MDM solution to enforce device security, configuration, and compliance.
* Examples: Microsoft Intune, Jamf, Kandji, or equivalent (choose what fits your environment).
* Define and enforce device baselines (PIN/biometrics, encryption, auto-lock, OS update requirements, remote wipe).
* Manage BYOD vs corporate-owned policies, and align with privacy/responsible monitoring expectations.
* Ensure smooth enrollment and support for iOS/Android and laptops where supported.

**AWS administration (cloud operations & governance)**

* Administer AWS accounts and foundational services used by the company, such as:
* IAM (users/roles/policies), security groups, VPC basics, EC2, S3, RDS (as applicable), CloudWatch/logging.
* Improve AWS security posture (least-privilege IAM, MFA for privileged access, key/secret hygiene).
* Support backups, monitoring/alerting, and incident response procedures for cloud workloads.
* Assist with cost visibility and optimization (tagging, budgets, alerts, rightsizing recommendations).

**Cybersecurity policies & best practices**

* Help define, implement, and maintain company cybersecurity policies and standards, such as:
* Acceptable use, password/MFA, endpoint security, patching, backups, access control, vendor access, secure sharing.
* Implement practical security controls aligned with the company’s risk level: Endpoint protection, encryption, vulnerability management, audit logging, least privilege, secure onboarding/offboarding.
* Run security awareness basics (phishing awareness, secure handling of data, reporting procedures).
* Support security incident response: triage, containment, remediation, post-incident improvements.
* Coordinate with external security vendors (pentest, audits, SOC/SIEM support) if applicable.

**Who You Are**
---------------

#### **Core requirements**

* 3+ years in IT administration / systems administration / IT operations.
* Strong experience administering Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including MFA and SSO.
* Hands-on experience managing Windows endpoints (deployment, patching, troubleshooting, security controls).
* Hands-on experience supporting Ubuntu/Linux laptops (updates, access, security hardening basics).
* Experience implementing or administering an MDM platform and device compliance policies.
* Familiarity with AWS administration fundamentals (IAM, networking basics, monitoring, security concepts).
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals: least privilege, secure configuration, patch management, encryption, phishing, backups, incident response basics.
* Strong troubleshooting ability, ability to communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, and good documentation habits.

#### **Bonus points if you have**

* Experience with Microsoft security tooling (e.g., Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Office 365) or equivalent.
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001 concepts, SOC 2 readiness, GDPR awareness) as applicable.
* Experience with automation/scripting: PowerShell (Windows/M365), Bash (Linux), Python (optional), and/or Ansible for configuration management.
* Basic networking skills: DHCP/DNS/VPN/Wi‑Fi management, firewall concepts, zero-trust principles.
* Experience with ticketing systems (Jira Service Management, Zendesk, Freshservice, etc.).
* Experience building policies and controls in a startup/SMB environment with pragmatic constraints.

#### **Soft skills & working style**

* You prioritize security and reliability without blocking productivity.
* You can translate technical risk into business impact and propose practical mitigations.
* You’re comfortable owning problems end-to-end and escalating appropriately.
* You can create simple documentation others can follow.
* You handle confidential information responsibly.

#### **Tools & Systems**

* Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Exchange Admin, Entra ID, Intune (or Jamf/Kandji/other MDM)
* AWS Console + IAM + CloudWatch (and IaC tools if applicable)
* Windows 10/11, Ubuntu/Linux
* Endpoint security tooling (Defender/CrowdStrike/SentinelOne, etc.)
* Password manager and/or SSO provider integrations
* Ticketing + asset management system

**Apply Now**
-------------

Ready to help transform 800,000 hectares of greenhouses into fully automated food production sites? If you’re excited to build the IT and security foundation that lets a robotics team ship safely and move fast, we’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

*eternal.ag* *is building fully automated food production sites that can sustainably produce fresh food year-round. Backed by world-class investors and partnering with leading agricultural companies, we're turning the vision of fully-autonomous greenhouses into reality.*

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be part of a highly skilled talented Customer Support team who work with CrowdStrike customers globally. * Manage time and work to meet or exceed operational goals.
* Learn cutting edge technologies and new product features.

* Experience in a Product Technical support role supporting Global enterprise customers.

* Customer focus. Analytical thinking and Logical troubleshooting aptitude.

* Experience with Identity Protection and Zero Trust solutions.
* Excellent knowledge of authentication protocols - Kerberos, LDAP, NTLM, SAML.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP and troubleshoot network issues using Wireshark/PCAP analysis.
* Operational understanding of networking devices such as Routers, Switches and Firewalls would be a plus.

**Cloud Technologies:**

* Experience working and troubleshooting in a SaaS cloud environment.
* Proven experience debugging and troubleshooting customer facing API/REST interfaces at both the JSON/HTTPS browser/client side and server-side web service termination, but also navigating within the backend cloud architecture which is responsible for fielding the request.
* Good understanding of SaaS components and large-scale databases like Cassandra, Kafka, Elasticsearch, Splunk, etc, and the role that they play within a cloud service.
* Familiarity with cloud orchestration tools like Docker, Kubernetes, etc.
* Certification in any common Cloud platforms would be a plus.

**Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike:**

* Market leader in compensation and equity awards

Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

description:

At ITRS, we make society's critical technology work. Our mission is to deliver automated and holistic IT observability solutions that safeguard critical applications and enable innovation. We are the only monitoring and observability platform designed for the most demanding and regulated industries — trusted by 90% of Tier 1 capital markets firms.

With headquarters in London and teams across the US, Europe, and Asia, ITRS combines the agility of a high-impact tech business with the stability of a private equity-backed global partner.

Our clients choose Managed Services to ensure Geneos is kept up to date, operational and correctly configured. We also work with our clients to ensure their monitoring is taken to a higher advancement level, to allow them to get the most value out of the product.

Reporting to our Service Delivery Manager, our Managed Service team monitors all ITRS components in our client environment to ensure they are up and operational. We respond to client queries on how to use the product, requests to make changes and configuration requests where the client requires. Also, we perform project work which includes upgrading and enhancing the client's Geneos environment. We also work with our on-site team members who are based in Singapore and Mumbai working onsite our client premises.

* **Monitor**
  ITRS components in our client environment and resolve issues to ensure uptime and Client SLAs are met.

  providing clients with the information they need to use ITRS products and implementing changes to deliver the latest monitoring for the client.

  by investigating and resolving issues with ITRS components in our client environment with assistance.
* **Perform root cause analysis**
  using problem analysis methodology to assess and diagnose underlying causes of recurring Incidents
* **Hands-on implementation of technical solutions**
  to permanently fix reccuring incidents.
* **Monitor progress on the resolution of Known Errors**
  and ensure best available workaround for Incidents are documented and communicated.
* **Fulfil Client Configuration Requests**
  by gathering requirements and helping our client configure Geneos implementing within client SLA.
* **Document and share information**
  by updating the knowledge base to provide accurate troubleshooting for the Managed Services team.
* **Provide ideas and suggestions**
  improve products, services, or processes.

* Quality of client communication by providing concise information to the client.

* Quality of work to the client by meeting our defined standards including quality checks.
* Client satisfaction and feedback of your work.
* Positive contribution to the Managed Service workload by meeting the targets set by your line manager.
* Meet your ticket response and resolution time SLA.
* Meet Geneos uptime SLA by monitoring and resolving incidents.
* Expectation to perform according to our behaviour and values

**Requirements**

* Minimum 3 years' experience working in a client-facing environment preferably in a financial institution or vendor and preferably in an IT Operations role.

* Excellent written and oral English communication skills.
* Passionate about our client experience.
* Experience in Unix and Windows Operating Systems.
* Experience in one or more scripting languages such as Shell, Bash, Perl, XML.
* An understanding of Databases e.g. Oracle and an understanding of SQL.

* Experience using or administering a real-time monitoring tool, e.g. Geneos, BMC Patrol, AppDynamics, Nagios.

* Deliver continuous improvement

title: Associate Solution Consultant - IND

Chennai

title: Microsoft Purview SME _Security Specialist
description:
Job Location: Chennai, Noida, Pune
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 14020
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/29/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Microsoft Purview SME will be responsible for the implementation, administration, monitoring, and operational management of Microsoft Purview solutions. The role includes managing information protection, data loss prevention, data lifecycle management, records management, eDiscovery, insider risk, and compliance capabilities to ensure organizational data remains protected and governed according to business, security, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Microsoft Purview solutions in accordance with organizational security, compliance, and data governance requirements.
* Design, configure, and maintain sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption settings, and protection controls across Microsoft 365 services.
* Implement and manage manual, recommended, and automatic data classification and labeling capabilities.
* Configure and maintain Data Loss Prevention policies across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 applications, and managed endpoints.
* Monitor and investigate DLP alerts, policy matches, data leakage incidents, and user-reported data protection concerns.
* Analyze false-positive and false-negative DLP detections and perform policy optimization and tuning.
* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management, including retention policies and retention labels.
* Support Records Management requirements, including regulatory records, event-based retention, disposition reviews, and proof of disposition.
* Configure and support Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard and Premium capabilities.
* Assist Legal, Compliance, HR, and Security teams with legal holds, content searches, collections, review sets, investigations, and evidence exports.
* Configure and maintain Insider Risk Management policies, indicators, alerts, and investigation workflows.
* Support Communication Compliance policies and investigations in coordination with authorized business stakeholders.
* Manage Microsoft Purview Audit capabilities and assist with audit log searches, compliance investigations, and evidence collection.
* Develop and maintain data classification schemas, sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and keyword dictionaries.
* Support Microsoft Purview Data Map and Data Catalog capabilities where included within the organizational data governance scope.
* Perform periodic reviews of Microsoft Purview configurations, policies, alerts, incidents, and compliance posture.
* Troubleshoot Microsoft Purview policy behavior, configuration issues, service limitations, and integration-related problems.
* Support integrations between Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, and other security monitoring platforms.
* Collaborate with Security Operations Center, Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Messaging, Workplace, Infrastructure, and End User Support teams to resolve information protection and compliance-related issues.
* Coordinate with Microsoft Vendor Support for product defects, technical limitations, and complex service-related incidents.
* Generate operational reports, compliance dashboards, security metrics, policy effectiveness reports, and trend analysis for management and customer review.
* Participate in compliance assessments, security audits, service reviews, risk assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Translate business, legal, regulatory, and compliance requirements into appropriate Microsoft Purview technical controls.
* Maintain operational documentation, high-level designs, low-level designs, standard operating procedures, implementation standards, support runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
* Provide L3 technical support and subject matter expertise for Microsoft Purview-related incidents, service requests, changes, and projects.
* Provide technical guidance, knowledge transfer, and mentoring to operational and support teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Information Security, or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of experience in Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Compliance, Information Protection, Data Governance, or related technologies.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience implementing or administering Microsoft Purview solutions.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Purview Information Protection, including sensitivity labels, label policies, encryption, auto-labeling, and data classification.
* Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and tuning Data Loss Prevention policies across Microsoft 365 workloads and managed endpoints.
* Experience managing retention policies, retention labels, Data Lifecycle Management, Records Management, and disposition processes.
* Experience with Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Standard or Premium, including legal holds, collections, content searches, review sets, and evidence exports.
* Experience configuring or supporting Insider Risk Management and Communication Compliance solutions.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview Audit and audit log investigation capabilities.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 applications.
* Experience creating and managing sensitive information types, trainable classifiers, exact data match configurations, and data classification schemas.
* Understanding of information protection, data privacy, data governance, records management, regulatory compliance, and legal discovery requirements.
* Experience integrating Microsoft Purview capabilities with Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Sentinel, SIEM, or security monitoring platforms.
* Working knowledge of PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, KQL, and Microsoft 365 administrative tools.
* Experience in incident management, change management, service request fulfilment, root-cause analysis, and technical problem resolution.
* Experience working with Legal, Compliance, Risk, HR, Security Operations, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to translate compliance and business requirements into scalable technical controls.
* Experience producing technical designs, governance standards, operational reports, SOPs, runbooks, and audit evidence.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Purview licensing, role-based access control, administrative roles, and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder-management, communication, and documentation skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Information Protection and Compliance Administrator Associate (SC-400)
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert (SC-100)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102)
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
* Microsoft Certified: Security, Compliance, and Identity Fundamentals (SC-900)

Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Sr IT Security Specialist
description:
**Overview**

The Sr. IT Security Specialist serves as a senior technical authority and key operational lead within the IT Security Team. Scaled for an experienced security practitioner (9–15 years of experience), this role bridges tactical security operations, advanced incident handling, and cross-functional security guidance.  
  
While remaining hands-on and technical, the Sr. Specialist exercises broad independent judgment, takes ownership of enterprise risk mitigation, drives root-cause elimination, and guides junior and mid-level team members. The role works closely with Infrastructure, Network, OT, and Compliance teams to maintain resilient systems, optimize security controls, and strengthen the overall posture of the enterprise.

**Targeted Outcomes (12 Months)**

* **Escalation & Operational Leadership:** Act as the primary technical escalation point for junior and mid-level security staff, complex operational questions, and severe security events.
* **Advanced Incident Management:** Independently lead high-complexity security event investigations, forensic analysis, and end-to-end response coordination.
* **Root-Cause Elimination:** Drive deep-dive postmortems for recurring security issues and implement systemic long-term remediation actions.
* **Process & Control Refinement:** Lead initiatives to refine SIEM/EDR detection rules, security metrics, reporting frameworks, and incident response playbooks.
* **Autonomous Project Delivery:** Support major security engineering projects and infrastructure improvements with minimal supervision, strong decision-making, and high execution quality.

**Primary Focus**

* Advanced incident handling, forensic investigation, and escalation
* Mentorship, peer guidance, and technical leadership
* Root cause analysis, trend identification, and postmortem engineering
* Security monitoring, detection, and process optimization
* Cross-functional coordination across IT, Network, Cloud, and OT environments

**Key Responsibilities**

**Advanced Operations & Escalation**

* Provide expert guidance to junior and mid-level security resources, serving as the senior point of escalation within the IT Security Team.
* Perform advanced daily security telemetry analysis using modern SIEM, EDR, NDR, and threat intelligence tools, quickly isolating high-risk threats from background noise.
* Respond to, resolve, or escalate complex security incidents, including high-severity events escalated by the MDR provider.

**Incident Response & Forensic Analysis**

* Investigate enterprise security violations and lead thorough postmortem analyses to identify systemic vulnerabilities, threat trends, and remediation opportunities.
* Support updates and continuous testing for Incident Response (IR) and Disaster Recovery (DR) plans.
* Participate in a senior-tier on-call rotation for critical incident escalations.

**Vulnerability Management & Threat Mitigation**

* Research emerging cyber threats and zero-day vulnerabilities, translating threat intelligence into proactive defense measures.
* Review, prioritize, and execute remediation strategies for penetration test and vulnerability assessment findings.
* Recommend, schedule, or apply critical security fixes, patches, and defensive controls in response to active risks or breaches.

**Enterprise & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with the Infrastructure Team to secure and ensure the integrity of Windows, Linux, Active Directory, and hybrid cloud environments.
* Partner with the Network Team to maintain the security integrity of WAN, LAN, telephony systems, and Operational Technology (OT) networks.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to align daily security operations with the enterprise-wide risk management framework.

**Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement**

* Produce executive-level monthly exception, metrics, and incident reporting to inform leadership on enterprise security posture.
* Support annual IT security audits, regulatory compliance inquiries, and customer security assessments.
* Monitor policy adherence across the enterprise and execute corrective action plans where non-conformities are identified.
* Manage incident and change request service levels (SLAs) according to IT service management guidelines.
* Develop, standardize, and maintain technical documentation for security platforms and operational procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7 to 13 years of hands-on experience in IT security, security operations (SOC), threat management, or security engineering.
* Demonstrated track record of leading complex security investigations, root-cause analyses, and cross-functional remediation projects.
* Proven experience working across diverse environments, including on-premises infrastructure, cloud workloads, and network/OT environments.

**Education & Certifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Advanced industry certifications preferred (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, CEH, or CCSP).

**Key Skills & Capabilities**

* Technical Proficiency: Deep working knowledge of security operations, modern SIEM/EDR tools, threat hunting methodologies, network security protocols, and security frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK).
* Cross-Functional Influence: Proven ability to collaborate with and influence infrastructure, network, and application teams without formal authority.
* Problem Solving & Agility: Strong analytical skills with the ability to remain calm, focused, and decisive in time-sensitive incident scenarios.
* Communication & Mentorship: Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a natural propensity for mentoring peer engineers and explaining complex risks to non-technical stakeholders.

**Work Environment**

* **On-Call Availability:** Requires participation in an on-call rotation to respond to high-severity security incidents.
* **Travel:** Occasional travel (5–10%) may be required for conferences, business audits, or site assessments.
* **Autonomy:** Demands high independent judgment while operating effectively within a collaborative enterprise team.

title: Consultant - Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) - Tier 2 Product Support & Technology Operations Professional
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
GESTC is building a modern, event-driven, cloud-native GlobalAdvantage (GA) platform on Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  
  
Concretely, the environment you will operate includes:
  
  

* Backend for Frontend (BFF) APIs on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS); Angular micro-frontends in the GA Portal.
* Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)
* supported by an Amazon S3 data lake, AWS Glue, and Amazon OpenSearch Service, including the operational dashboards you will use daily.
* Azure DevOps continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), OpenTelemetry with Application Insights, and ServiceNow for IT service management (ITSM)

**Data:**
Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and Oracle as primary relational stores backbone where modules communicate through domain topics.
  
  
**Integrations:**
external and client-system integration through Boomi iPaaS and a client API gateway
  
  
**Workflow:**
human-in-the-loop processes on Pega bridged to Kafka
  
  
**Security:**
AWS Cognito with Amazon Verified Permissions (AVP) policy-based authorization
  
  
This role does not require you to build these components. It does require sufficient understanding of how they work together to diagnose issues that cross them, coordinate the right teams, validate fixes, and improve how the platform is run.
  
  
This is an experienced position. You will work with Tier 1 support personnel and provide Tier 2 support across the platform, supporting users from both a technical and functional perspective. More than resolving tickets, you will own assigned production issues through diagnosis, resolution, validation, communication, and closure, and continuously improve the reliability and supportability of the platform.
  
  
Because the platform is event-driven and multi-layered, a single incident may span a micro-frontend, a .NET API, an Aurora/Oracle query, a Kafka message routed to a dead-letter queue (DLQ), a Boomi HRIS feed, a Pega case, an AVP authorization decision, and a dashboard. With training, you will trace issues across those layers using correlation IDs and telemetry, isolate the failing hop, and coordinate resolution with engineering, product, integration, security, and data teams without needing to build or re-architect the components yourself.
  
  
This position requires significant client contact, so you must possess excellent communication, consulting, and probing skills to manage client expectations. Our applications are used by Deloitte's Global Employer Services member firms and clients, so strong client service and the ability to deliver on time in a dynamic team environment are essential. The candidate will receive training on existing as well as next-generation tools.
  
  
Key responsibilities:
  
  

* Own assigned production issues end to end - diagnosis, resolution, validation, stakeholder communication, and closure across the compensation and payroll vertical, working with Tier 1 personnel on escalations.
* Backend for Frontend (BFF) API, relational database, Kafka topics, Boomi integrations, Pega workflow, and reporting to isolate where a transaction broke.
* Support the investigation and controlled reprocessing of event failures, including reviewing dead-letter queue messages and following approved recovery procedures.
* Investigate and validate application data across Aurora PostgreSQL, Oracle, and comparable relational databases using SQL - querying, reconciling, and correcting under change control.
* Troubleshoot APIs and integrations - REST/BFF APIs, web services, Boomi HRIS inbound and client outbound flows, and cli ent API-gateway access - interpreting request/response payloads and determining whether an issue originates in source data, the API call, authentication/authorization (AVP/Cognito), transformation logic, the destination system, workflow, or the database.
* service-level agreement (SLA) timers, and follow the Pega-to-Kafka integration bridge when a case event does not propagate.
* Manage incidents, defects, changes, and work items through their full lifecycle in ServiceNow and Azure DevOps.
* Support release readiness - perform unit and system-level testing, validate deployments through Azure DevOps pipelines, and provide post-release stabilization and production monitoring.
* To assist with diagnosis of errors, latency, and transaction failures.
* Deliver reporting and operational insight - work with business owners to define information needs and build/maintain Bold Reports (and SSRS where applicable) and dashboards; use platform operational dashboards and event data to surface recurring issues, emerging risks, and service-improvement opportunities.
* Perform root-cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions rather than short-term workarounds.
* Improve supportability and automation - enhance logging, monitoring, diagnostics, runbooks, and knowledge articles; identify repetitive support activities as automation candidates; and use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate diagnosis and resolution.
* Act as a liaison between business and technology using AGILE methodologies - translating business requirements into functional specifications and test plans and ensuring they are fulfilled.
* Consistently meet client expectations and project deadlines, and provide logical, lasting solutions.

Shift Timings: 11:00 AM - 8:00 PM
  
  
Location: Hyderabad

We do not expect prior experience with every technology in the platform section above. We expect the transferable skills below and the ability to apply them to the platform stack.

contact-center environments.

impacting issues.

**Strong Understanding Of Voice And Telephony Protocols, Including**

* RTP/RTCP
* SDP
* SIP REGISTER, INVITE, ACK, BYE, CANCEL, REFER, and 200 OK flows
* DTMF, codecs, NAT traversal, and media negotiation

* Call drops and mid-call disconnects
* One-way or no audio
* Audio quality issues
* SIP registration failures
* DTMF failures
* Transfer and routing issues
* Carrier or SBC connectivity problems

* networking, and basic performance troubleshooting.

* Homer
* Grafana
* VoIP monitoring platforms
* Prometheus, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch, or equivalent tools

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

* environment.

* processes.

This role requires a mix of business and technical acumen, stakeholder engagement, and a process optimisation mindset. The expectation is you will be hands-on, driving the delivery of key outcomes and continuous improvement in the service.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Service Manager in triaging, assigning, resolving (and acting as escalation point for critical) incidents, both during office hours and occasionally out of hours, coordinating with the vendor and with key IT capability teams to assure the end to end service excellence.
  
  
You will support the AWMS Delivery Lead in partnering with local BU/OU key users to take ownership of the solution and build capability within their facility, with a ‘train-the-trainer’ culture to drive adoption and reduce dependence on the vendor as well as on the global Enterprise Solutions team.
  
  
A key element of the role will be in implementation, driving process adoption and supporting key users as they learn business and IT processes. Once live, you will support the ‘business as usual’ (BAU) service management, helping with prioritisation of change requests across OUs & new demand, and documenting best practices as Knowledge Base articles in ServiceNow.
  
  
The core application in scope, LEA Reply, is a business critical 24/7 operational application essential to enable the fulfilment of demanding customer service targets across PepsiCo, part of PepsiCo’s critical Make Move Sell (MMS) application portfolio. This criticality applies to the end to end process, including integrated systems – primarily SAP ECC, but in some cases local automation solutions driving warehouse productivity (eg. ASRS, autonomous VNAs, conveyoring). As such the role entails critical BIL 1 Application SME accountability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Incident resolution for WMS and integrations, including interfaces with ERP (e.g., SAP), automation systems, and warehouse IT hardware ie. handheld terminals (HHTs) & printers.
* Core IT functional ownership of LEA Reply Europe (and potentially LATAM, subject to global op model evolution) assignment group to ensure ServiceNow incidents and problems are resolved to meet service levels.
* Devises, owns and manages transition to sustain (T2S) approach and service plan and service management for BAU (“business as usual”) to assure PepsiCo standard service continuity for markets once live.
* Supporting the AWMS sites and markets in non-vendor defects and issues, especially business process errors, user application errors, or broader competency-based issues.
* Maintains ServiceNow knowledge base of key articles to ensure supporting materials meet the needs of the user base.
* Incident resolution for other platforms and applications in the scope of our team, including but not limited to Global Network Design (Lyric)

**Qualifications**

* Candidate should have 6-7 Years of experience
* Fluent English.
* Warehouse process knowledge.
* ITIL – industry standard IT service management knowledge & experience.
* SAP ECC process knowledge.
* Demonstrable capability of building trust across different cultures, ability to manage challenging stakeholders at all levels. Strong communication, interpersonal and mentoring skills. Proven ability to influence and collaborate cross-functionally and with vendors.
* Autonomous self-starter – not afraid to get stuck into the detail (technical or functional) to get things moving and drive delivery or problem-solving when required. Flexibility to adapt to the demands of the moment – self-reliance & ability to adapt to a changing environment, to achieve the desired outcome.
* Ideal: LEA Reply WMS experience, SAP ECC user experience, warehouse automation integration experience, and broad knowledge of PepsiCo’s Supply Planning processes & systems.
* Ideal: proficiency in Jira / Confluence / ServiceNow / ADO, with service management experience, reporting to leadership level.

description:
Job Description: System Administrator – Server & Network

**Job Title:** System Administrator

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced System Administrator with strong knowledge of server administration, network management, and IT infrastructure support. The candidate should be capable of managing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and securing servers and network devices to ensure smooth business operations.

Key Responsibilities

* Install, configure, manage, and maintain Windows and Linux servers.

title: IT Network Administrator
description:
**Job description**  
IT & Network Administrator

**Department:** Information Technology (IT)  
**Reporting To:** GM Operations / Head Administration  
**Location:** Head Office & Project Sites

**Job Summary**

The IT & Network Administrator is responsible for managing the organization's complete IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, desktops, laptops, email systems, data backup, cybersecurity, software support, AutoCAD installation, ERP support, CCTV, biometric systems, and IT asset management. The role ensures uninterrupted business operations by maintaining secure, reliable, and efficient IT services across all office and project locations.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. IT Infrastructure Management**

* Install, configure, and maintain desktops, laptops, workstations, printers, scanners, and other peripherals.
* Perform hardware troubleshooting, upgrades, repairs, and preventive maintenance.
* Install and configure Windows operating systems and required business applications.
* Maintain IT equipment for Head Office and project sites.

**2. Server Administration & Backup**

* Install, configure, and maintain Windows Servers.
* Monitor server performance and health.
* Manage server storage, shared folders, and user permissions.
* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly server backups.
* Restore data whenever required.
* Maintain disaster recovery plans and backup documentation.
* Monitor server logs and resolve issues proactively.

**3. Network Administration**

* Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, routers, switches, and firewalls.
* Ensure uninterrupted internet connectivity.
* Monitor network utilization and bandwidth.
* Troubleshoot network failures and connectivity issues.
* Maintain secure remote access for project locations.

**4. Microsoft 365 / Email Administration**

* Create, modify, and delete official email accounts.
* Manage Microsoft Outlook and Microsoft 365 administration.
* Configure email on desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.
* Maintain email backups and archive mailboxes.
* Troubleshoot email delivery and synchronization issues.
* Manage user permissions, groups, and shared mailboxes.

**5. Data Backup & Recovery**

* Schedule automatic backups for servers and critical user data.
* Maintain backup logs and recovery records.
* Test backup restoration periodically.
* Ensure business continuity through secure backup management.

**6. Software Installation & Licensing**

* Install and maintain licensed software including:
* AutoCAD
* Microsoft Office
* ERP Applications
* HRMS
* Accounting Software
* PDF and utility applications
* Antivirus software
* Maintain software license records and renewals.
* Resolve software-related issues.

**7. AutoCAD & Engineering Software Support**

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot AutoCAD.
* Support engineering teams with software installation and licensing.
* Coordinate software upgrades and version management.
* Ensure compatibility with project requirements.

**8. User Support (Helpdesk)**

* Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support.
* Resolve desktop, laptop, printer, software, and network issues.
* Maintain IT service request logs.
* Support users remotely and onsite.
* Minimize downtime through timely issue resolution.

**9. IT Asset Management**

* Maintain inventory of:
* Desktops
* Laptops
* Printers
* Network Devices
* Servers
* UPS
* Accessories
* Track asset allocation and returns.
* Maintain warranty, AMC, and vendor records.

**10. CCTV, Biometric & Access Control**

* Maintain CCTV surveillance systems.
* Support biometric attendance devices.
* Manage access control systems.
* Coordinate repairs and AMC support.

**11. Cybersecurity**

* Maintain antivirus and endpoint security.
* Configure firewall security policies.
* Monitor unauthorized access attempts.
* Ensure operating systems and applications are updated with security patches.
* Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments.

**12. Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain IT policies and SOPs.
* Prepare network diagrams and server documentation.
* Maintain backup reports, asset registers, software license records, and user access logs.
* Submit monthly MIS reports covering IT performance, asset status, backup completion, and support activities.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field.

**Preferred Certifications**

* CCNA
* Microsoft Certified (MCSA/MCSE or equivalent)
* CompTIA A+
* CompTIA Network+
* Microsoft 365 Administrator (preferred)

**Experience**

* Minimum 1-5 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, Network Administration, and Server Management.
* Experience in EPC, Construction, Manufacturing, or Corporate organizations is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Windows Server Administration
* Active Directory
* Microsoft 365 Administration
* TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
* VPN Configuration
* Firewall Management
* Router & Switch Configuration
* Server Backup & Recovery
* Desktop & Laptop Troubleshooting
* AutoCAD Installation & Support
* ERP & HRMS Support
* Email Administration
* Antivirus & Endpoint Security
* CCTV & Biometric Systems
* Hardware & Network Troubleshooting

title: Service Desk Specialist
description:
**Our Global Structure**

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our ET Service Desk is a global, 24x7 team that acts as the first line of defence for Deliveroo's internal technology, supporting employees across offices, care vendors, and remote locations worldwide. We work closely with Workplace Tech, Security, IAM, Networks and application owners to resolve issues end-to-end, escalating only when something is outside our tools, access or expertise.  
The team handles everything from access management for core platforms to device, basic networking and collaboration tooling issues, following robust runbooks and service management practices.  
We are a collaborative, metrics-driven group that continuously improves our knowledge base, processes and automation to deliver a consistently great experience for our internal customers.

We're looking for a **Service Desk Specialist** to join our **Service Desk** team located in **Hyderabad**. In this role, you will be owning complex tickets from first contact through to resolution and coordinating incident response for high-impact issues. You'll troubleshoot across Google Workspace, macOS, Windows, ChromeOS, MDM, Slack and core internal tools, using your depth of experience to unblock users quickly and safely.  
Beyond BAU support, you'll lead and contribute to the improvement of the projects, refine playbooks, and mentor other analysts to uplift the overall capability of the Service Desk.

Get to know our **Service Desk** team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

**Here's what your day-to-day might look like:**
------------------------------------------------

* Be the first point of contact in Operations, helping people resolve problems and delivering an excellent customer experience in a 24x7 environment.
* Take ownership of standard and complex technical issues, diagnosing, researching, tracking, and resolving them.
* Collaborate with colleagues across our global team to share knowledge and solve problems.
* Escalate and coordinate incident response for critical issues affecting the firm.
* Troubleshoot issues across hardware, software, user accounts, trading environments, operating systems, and mobile devices.
* Look for opportunities to improve how we work and share your ideas with the team and management.

**What You'll Need to Thrive**
------------------------------

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

* A passion for customer service and a commitment to delivering an outstanding support experience.
* More than four years of experience in IT Operations, IT Support, or Technical Support, working directly with users.
* A strong interest in technology and how it helps our people deliver for Deliveroo.
* Experience supporting Google Workspace (G Suite), macOS, Windows 10 and above, and MDM tools such as Mosyle and Intune.
* Experience in technical support within a growing technology company, bringing an understanding of effective service delivery.
* The ability to contribute to and lead projects that match your expertise, while guiding colleagues and sharing your knowledge.
* A collaborative approach, with experience mentoring, training, or creating knowledge resources for your team.
* Flexibility to work morning, afternoon, and night shifts as part of a 24x7 service desk supporting Deliveroo's global business.

**Experience That Will Help You Succeed**
-----------------------------------------

We'd love to hear from you if you have exposure to or experience with some of the following, you don't need to know them all:

* **Productivity and collaboration**: Google Workspace (G Suite), Slack, and Google Workspace admin tools.
* **Operating systems and devices**: iOS, macOS, Windows 11, and ChromeOS.
* **Device management**: MDM tools such as Mosyle and Microsoft Intune.
* **Service management and reporting**: Jira Service Management (JSM), Data Studio, and Looker.
* **Networking and access**: An understanding of networking fundamentals and Identity and Access Management (IAM).
* **Meeting room technology**: Supporting audiovisual (AV) and video conferencing systems, particularly Google Meet.
* **Service delivery**: Familiarity with ITIL principles and IT service management practices.
* Relevant professional certifications are also welcome.

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

**Solve meaningful problems at real scale**  
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.  
  
**See your impact, fast**  
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership  
environment.

**Grow through challenge and ownership**  
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

**A culture built for builders**  
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 2-3 stages.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**  
  
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: End User Support L1 Analyst II

End User Support L1 Analyst II

This role ensures the seamless operation of IT services by troubleshooting issues, documenting solutions, and collaborating with internal teams to resolve technical inquiries. The analyst applies company policies and procedures to address a variety of technical challenges and contributes to continuous service improvements. This is a non-managerial role that requires strong analytical skills, problem-solving capabilities, and effective communication with stakeholders.

**What You’ve Done**
Education and Work Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in a technical support or help desk role.
* Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools

**Preferred**

* Certification in ITIL or a similar IT service management framework.
* Experience working in the software industry, particularly within SaaS environments.
* Exposure to Active Directory, Microsoft 365, and cloud-based enterprise applications.

**Skills, Knowledge, Abilities, And Behaviors**

* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Proficient in troubleshooting software, hardware, and network issues.
* Familiarity with Windows and Mac operating systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong customer service orientation with a focus on user satisfaction.
* Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team.
* High attention to detail and a methodical approach to issue resolution.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to document processes and solutions clearly.
* Knowledge of incident management processes and best practices.
* Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and evolving IT environments.
* Experience using enterprise collaboration tools such as Teams, Slack, or Zoom.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity best practices related to end-user support.
* Ability to follow standard operating procedures and contribute to process improvements.
* Strong interpersonal skills for effective collaboration across departments.

CORE COMPETENCIES
  
  
Our team is built on strong core values that guide how we work and grow together. We prioritize clear and thoughtful communication, fostering open collaboration across diverse perspectives to achieve shared goals. We approach challenges with curiosity and critical thinking, seeking creative solutions while remaining adaptable in a fast-changing environment. We take accountability for our work and outcomes, holding ourselves to high standards of integrity and professionalism. Above all, we are committed to doing the right thing—treating others with respect, embracing continuous learning, and engaging inclusively across cultures and backgrounds.
  
  
LEARN MORE
  
  

* Company Website – Transforming Insurance with Duck Creek's SaaS Solutions
* Life at Duck Creek – Life at Duck Creek - Duck Creek
* Benefits & Rewards – Wellbeing & Rewards - Duck Creek

LOCATION & WAYS OF WORKING
  
  
Duck Creek is a flexible-first company, offering employees autonomy in how they manage their day-to-day work. As part of our Flying Together approach, we are thoughtfully increasing opportunities for in-person collaboration by focusing on hiring in designated locations.
  
  
This role is aligned to a specific location, and you are expected to reside within reasonable proximity to that location. You will partner with your leader to participate in meaningful in-person moments that support team connection, collaboration, and business priorities.
  
  
At the start of your employment, your work may be performed remotely, subject to business needs and company guidelines. As our Flying Together approach continues to evolve, you may be expected to transition to a hybrid work arrangement, including working from a designated office location on a schedule determined by your leader and organizational needs.
  
  
The Company reserves the right to modify your work arrangement, including location expectations and in-person requirements, based on business needs, organizational policy, or regulatory considerations.
  
  
**What We Stand For**
Our global team values the unique perspectives each employee brings. Our success is driven by an inclusive culture where everyone can learn from one another, regardless of role or background. This collaborative approach helps us continuously improve our products, services, and systems.
  
  
Duck Creek is committed to equal opportunity for all employees and applicants, with decisions based on skills, experience, and achievements—without regard to any protected status.
  
  
We strive to lead by example in inclusion, diversity, and equity, creating an environment where employees can be their authentic selves. Our values guide us: We Prioritize Respect, We Listen, We Care, We Add Value, and We Lead.
  
  
To learn more: https://www.duckcreek.com/life-at-duck-creek/

PRIVACY NOTICE
  
  
By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Duck Creek Technologies may collect and process your personal data – Refer Privacy Notice
  
  
NOTICE

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
Repligen is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Technical Support Engineer II to join our dedicated Service team. This role is responsible for providing technical support to customers, field service engineers, commercial teams, and internal stakeholders using Repligen bioprocessing products and technologies.
  
  
As a Technical Support Engineer II, you will help ensure customer success by responding to technical inquiries, supporting troubleshooting activities, documenting customer issues, and collaborating with internal teams to drive cases toward resolution. This position is ideal for someone with a strong technical foundation, excellent communication skills, and an interest in developing expertise in bioprocessing equipment, service support, and customer-facing technical problem solving.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Support:**
Provide timely and effective technical support to customers and Repligen team members via phone, email, video conferencing, and other communication channels. Support troubleshooting of product hardware, software, process, and system-related inquiries.
  
  
Product Knowledge: Develop and maintain a strong working knowledge of Repligen’s product portfolio, bioprocessing applications, system components, operating software, and related technologies.
  
  
**Customer Engagement:**
Communicate professionally with customers and internal stakeholders to understand reported issues, gather necessary information, provide updates, and support a positive customer experience.
  
  
**Troubleshooting and Problem Solving**
: Assist in analyzing and diagnosing technical issues, identifying possible causes, recommending next steps, and guiding customers or internal teams through the resolution process.
  
  
**Case Management and Documentation:**
Manage support cases using Salesforce to document customer inquiries, troubleshooting steps, technical findings, communications, and resolution details. Ensure case records are accurate, complete, and maintained in accordance with internal procedures.
  
  
**Technical Documentation:**
Assist in creating, reviewing, and updating technical documentation, including troubleshooting guides, FAQs, technical notes, work instructions, manuals, and internal knowledge articles.
  
  
**Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
Work closely with Technical Support, Field Service, Service Scheduling, Product Management, Engineering, Quality, Sales, and other internal teams to support customer issue resolution and communicate product feedback.
  
  
**Service Coordination:**
Support coordination of follow-up activities, including replacement part requests, RMA support, field service dispatch requests, and escalation of unresolved or complex technical issues.
  
  
**Training and Development:**
Participate in product training, technical workshops, and internal knowledge-sharing activities to build technical proficiency and improve customer support capability.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement:**
Identify recurring customer issues, documentation gaps, support process improvements, and opportunities to improve the customer and field service support experience.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree and or equivalent related experience in a relevant field (e.g., Bioengineering, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Life Sciences or Engineering related).
* A minimum of 3 years of experience supporting bioprocessing equipment, biopharmaceutical manufacturing operations, process development, applications, technical support, field service, or related life sciences activities.
* Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues using a structured and logical approach.
* Experience with or knowledge of tangential flow filtration (TFF), automation platforms, and related life sciences technologies is highly beneficial.
* Familiarity with Repligen's Systems portfolio including KrosFlo KR2i, KMPi, RS Systems, FS15, FS500, and related filtration and process control technologies is preferred.
* Excellent interpersonal skills, strong verbal/written communications skills and attention to detail are required.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM/service management systems to manage customer support activities.
* Experience with creating and updating technical documentation (Protocols, manuals, SOPs, work instructions, etc.)
* Experience installing, configuring, troubleshooting, or supporting software applications associated with bioprocessing equipment and automated manufacturing systems is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to interpret software alarms, system diagnostics, event logs, communication errors, and equipment-generated data to support technical investigations and issue resolution.
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals, Windows operating systems, software deployment, and remote support tools is beneficial.
* Familiarity with, or proficiency in, GMP, 21 CFR Part 11, and other life sciences related regulations is highly beneficial.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work well within a global, cross functional team.
* Ability to prioritize and work independently to achieve defined goals.
* Must be fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven experience supporting customers throughout Asia-Pacific markets.
* Additional proficiency in Japanese, Mandarin Chinese, or Korean is considered an advantage.
* Willingness to travel occasionally for customer site visits and training.

title: Learning Management System Administrator
description:
**Our Vision:**

Help IIT Bombay rank among the top engineering and technology institutes worldwide by fostering strong relationships with its alumni, corporations and philanthropists.

**About us:**

The Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay), established in 1958, is one of India’s premier institutions for science, engineering, and technology education and research. Recognised as an
*Institution of Eminence*
by the Ministry of Education, IIT Bombay consistently ranks among the top universities globally. With 17 departments, 35 centres, and three schools, IIT Bombay is home to world-class faculty and over 75,000 accomplished alumni worldwide. Through the
**Educational Outreach (EO) Office**
, IIT Bombay delivers continuing and executive education for working professionals in India and abroad. EO enables learners to access IIT Bombay’s world-class faculty and research expertise through online, hybrid, and in-person programs that blend academic depth with industry relevance.

**Role Overview :**

IIT Bombay’s Educational Outreach team is looking for an experienced
**Senior LMS Administrator**
to independently manage the configuration, administration, and day-to-day operations of its Moodle-based Learning Management System. The role will oversee platform administration, course and assessment management, integrations, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, and user support. The ideal candidate will bring strong hands-on Moodle expertise, technical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to manage a large-scale learning platform.

**Key Responsibilities**

**LMS Administration & Course Management**

* Administer Moodle, including users, courses, cohorts, enrolments, roles, permissions, and access.
* Configure courses, learning resources, SCORM packages, assessments, completion tracking, and course settings.
* Manage Moodle backups, archival, scheduled tasks, logs, and application-level processes.

**Assessments, Reporting & Integrations**

* Configure quizzes, assignments, question banks, grading, and gradebooks.
* Generate reports on learner participation, progress, assessments, and completion.
* Manage approved Moodle plugins and integrations with APIs, video platforms, virtual classrooms, proctoring, and certificate systems.

**Platform Customisation & Releases**

* Customise Moodle themes, dashboards, navigation, and course layouts using basic HTML/CSS.
* Test and validate configurations, plugins, integrations, and upgrades across Stage and Production.
* Maintain documentation, test results, issue logs, and release records.

**Troubleshooting, Security & Continuity**

* Troubleshoot LMS, access, enrolment, and assessment issues and coordinate infrastructure-related issues with technical teams.
* Support backup/restore and Disaster Recovery testing, VAPT, security remediation, and audit requirements.

**Learner & Stakeholder Support**

* Support learners, faculty, Teaching Assistants, and programme teams with LMS-related queries and orientation.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendors to ensure reliable and responsive LMS operations.

**Desired Experience/Skills :**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Educational Technology, or a related field.
* **5+ years’ experience in LMS administration or educational technology, including at least 3 years of hands-on Moodle administration.**
* Strong experience with
  **Moodle 4.x**
  , including installation, configuration, users, roles, courses, enrolments, assessments, gradebooks, and reporting.
* Experience with
  **SCORM, Moodle plugins, REST APIs, integrations, backup/restore, testing, and troubleshooting**
  .
* Working knowledge of
  **Ubuntu/Linux, Apache, PHP, PostgreSQL, and cron/scheduled tasks**
  .
* Experience with
  **Stage/Production environments**
  and Disaster Recovery.
* Strong analytical, communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Moodle Administrator certification/training and experience with
  **Moodle 4.5 LTS, AWS, large-scale LMS implementations, accessibility, VAPT, or information security**
  would be an advantage.

Please note: This is a Mumbai based on-campus
**role; only shortlisted candidates will be notified**
.

* Communicate technical issues, risks, dependencies, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Balance security requirements with the need to provide reliable and intuitive authentication and access experiences for practitioners.
* Demonstrate a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented approach to delivering identity services.

**Essential Traits**

* 3–5+ years of experience supporting or engineering enterprise Identity & Access Management technologies.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory.
* Experience implementing or supporting Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access.
* Experience integrating enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, or similar authentication standards.

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Business Analyst's role is to elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project stakeholders, be they customers or end-users. This includes interviewing stakeholders and gathering and compiling user requirements to create functional design specifications that can be used by development teams throughout the software lifecycle. In addition it is the responsibility of this role to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient business, financial, and operations systems in support of core organizational functions and business processes. This includes gathering and analyzing data in support of business cases, proposed projects, and systems requirements. The Business Analyst is also responsible for generating and compiling reports based on their findings, complete with probable causes and possible solutions to systems issues. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments. Moreover the Business Analyst will initiate the creation of test cases and lead business users through the testing of new solutions. Works with the QA and Training team to document system scenarios and identifies roles impacted
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with project managers and project sponsors to determine project scope.
* Clearly identify project stakeholders and establish user classes, as well as their characteristics.
* Conduct interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals, and identify and resolve systems issues.
* Develop and utilize standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirement specifications.
* Translate conceptual user requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Where necessary, develop prototypes of interfaces and attributes based on findings. Lead design sessions in prototyping new systems for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow
* Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Identify and establish scope and parameters of requirements analysis in order to define impact, outcome criteria, and measure-taking actions.
* Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications - verbally or through written documentation project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* Review and analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and develop strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems.
* Perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems to aid management in making implementation decisions.
* Coordinate and perform in-depth tests, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems, and other post-implementation support.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems.
* Assist in conducting research on software and hardware products to justify recommendations and to support purchasing efforts.
* Provide orientation and training to end users for all modified and new systems
* Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members.

**Knowledge Skills And Experience**

* College diploma or university degree in the field of business administration, computer science, finance, or information systems and 5+ years related work experience.
* Proven experience in overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software and hardware solutions, systems, or products
* Ability to create systematic and consistent requirements specifications in both technical and user-friendly language.
* Ability to apply statistical and other research methods into systems issues and products as required.
* Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including MS Project.
* Working technical knowledge of scripting languages, network and PC operating systems.
* Able to exercise independent judgement and take action on it.
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills.
* Excellent understanding of the organization's goals and objectives.
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
* Highly self motivated and directed.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Excellent English language skills

description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Job Title**
- Sr. Associate/Lead – SW Support
  
  
**Location**
– Pune
  
  
**Shift Coverage -**
North America business hours (8 AM – 5 PM CST)
  
  
**Job Summary**
The role is responsible for providing L2 operational and technical support within Omnium Application Support team with primary focus on reconciliation and control services, data onboarding, client data integrations, file processing and associated infrastructure components. The team acts as a critical liaison between business operations, clients, development teams, infrastructure teams, and external vendors to ensure uninterrupted service delivery across global markets.
  
  
The role involves monitoring critical production processes, troubleshooting application issues, managing incidents and service requests, supporting client onboarding activities, ensuring successful data processing and reconciliation workflows, and driving timely resolution of production issues while maintaining high service availability and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Provide Level 2 Application Support for various applications under Omnium platform.
  
  
Monitor critical production processes, services, jobs, application health, system performance, batch processing and service availability.
  
  
Investigate and resolve production incidents within agreed SLAs.
  
  
Analyze trends and identify recurring operational issues. Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and recommend preventive measures.
  
  
Coordinate Major Incident (P1/P2) handling and facilitate ITSM calls. Engage concerned Development and shared services teams during critical outages.
  
  
Support onboarding of new clients and data feeds into the Omnium platform. Coordinate setup, validation, and testing of inbound and outbound data interfaces.
  
  
Manage FTP onboarding and data delivery configurations.
  
  
Participate in application releases and production deployments. Perform application checkout activities following releases and infrastructure changes.
  
  
Drive automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve service quality. Develop and maintain monitoring procedures and operational dashboards where ever applicable.
  
  
Ensure all production alerts are acknowledged and addressed in a timely manner.
  
  
Serve as a point of contact for business users and operational teams. Provide regular communications and status updates during incidents.
  
  
Participate in service review meetings and operational governance forums.
  
  
Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction through professional communication and ownership.
  
  
**Technical Skills**
**Required Skills & Experience**
6-10 years of Production Application Support experience.
  
  
Unix/Linux command-line knowledge.
  
  
Experience with SQL and database troubleshooting.
  
  
Understanding of batch processing and scheduling tools (Control-M preferred).
  
  
Knowledge of FTP/SFTP, APIs, file processing workflows, and middleware technologies.
  
  
Familiarity with ServiceNow, monitoring tools, and incident management processes.
  
  
Experience supporting web applications and data integration platforms.
  
  
**Domain Knowledge**
**Financial Services / Asset Servicing Experience Preferred.**
Understanding of reconciliation, control functions, reference data management, and trade processing.
  
  
Knowledge of client onboarding and data integration processes.
  
  
Understanding of operational risk and production support best practices.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.
