title: Technical Support Engineer – Slurm
description:
NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for over 30 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and dynamic people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing—an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. NVIDIANs immerse themselves in a diverse, supportive environment that encourages everyone to do their best work. Join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
  
  
Slurm is a critical workload manager for many of the world’s most demanding AI and high-performance computing environments. We are looking for a Technical Support Engineer dedicated to supporting Slurm for NVIDIA’s customers. You will join a dedicated team of Slurm subject-matter guides, owning sophisticated support cases and helping customers run reliable, efficient, and highly scalable clusters. This role requires extensive production experience with Slurm and the ability to diagnose issues across the scheduler and the surrounding Linux, networking, storage, authentication, database, and GPU infrastructure.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Own Slurm support cases from initial investigation through resolution for customers running production AI and HPC clusters.
* Diagnose complex problems involving slurmctld, slurmd, slurmdbd, job scheduling, node management, resource allocation, accounting, authentication, and high availability.
* Solve Slurm configuration and policy features, including partitions, reservations, priorities, fair-share, quality of service, backfill, preemption, GRES/TRES, cgroups, and job constraints.
* Investigate performance, reliability, and scalability issues using logs, diagnostic data, configuration analysis, reproductions, and source-level debugging when required.
* Isolate problems across Slurm and its surrounding dependencies, including Linux, MUNGE, databases, networking, parallel storage, containers, GPUs, and cluster-management systems.
* Advise customers on Slurm configuration, upgrades, operational practices, managing system resources, and safe recovery from production incidents.
* Collaborate with engineering teams by producing clear technical descriptions, reproducible test cases, and well-supported defect reports.
* Develop guides, knowledge-base articles, diagnostic tools, and internal training that strengthen Slurm expertise across the support organization.

**What We Need To See**

* BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience administering and supporting Slurm in production HPC or AI environments including business-critical outage incidents.
* Expert-level understanding of Slurm architecture, daemons, configuration, scheduling behavior, accounting, resource management, and failure modes.
* Capacity to identify sophisticated Slurm incidents independently and guide them to a technically sound resolution.
* In-depth Linux system-administration and solve experience, including systemd, cgroups, authentication, networking, and database-backed services.
* Experience operating Slurm across multi-user clusters with complex scheduling policies and heterogeneous compute resources.
* Strong analytical and research skills, showing proficiency in distinguishing Slurm defects from configuration, integration, infrastructure, and workload problems.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn detailed technical findings into clear explanations and actionable recommendations.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience supporting large-scale Slurm environments containing thousands of nodes or GPUs.
* Experience diagnosing scheduler performance, job-throughput, controller-load, and database-scaling issues.
* Familiarity with Slurm source code, plugins, SPANK, Lua job-submit plugins, or upstream issue investigation.
* Experience with containers and HPC integration technologies such as Pyxis, Enroot, Apptainer, or Singularity.
* Previous experience integrating Slurm with NVIDIA Base Command Manager, Bright Cluster Manager, or another cluster-management platform.

title: Technical Account Manager - 2
description:
**The Role:**

You own the technical success of Cashfree Payment’s largest merchants from first scoping call to scaled production. You are the person, merchant CTOs call when something matters and the person internal teams trust to bring order to complex, high-stakes integrations.

This role sits where engineering depth meets executive presence. You'll debug an API edge case before lunch and align a merchant's leadership on go-live readiness after it.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Enterprise implementations, end-to-end:**
  Scope, plan, integrate, launch, stabilize. You own the timeline, the risks, and the outcome.
* **Technical relationship:**
  You're the primary point of contact for merchant engineering, product and business stakeholders. You translate payment infrastructure into solutions that fit their architecture, growth stage and risk posture, not a standard playbook.
* **Program rigor:**
  Project plans with real dependencies. Risks surfaced before they bite. Internal coordination across Product, Engineering, Risk, Ops and Support to keep delivery on track.
* **Integration health, post go-live:**
  Monitor transaction performance and success rates proactively. Spot optimization opportunities before they become incidents and own resolution when they do.
* **Escalations:**
  You lead the response end-to-end. Root cause, stakeholder comms and resolution. Merchants walk away with the issue fixed and their confidence intact.
* **The merchant signal loop:**
  Patterns you see in the field, friction points, gaps, recurring asks! They become structured inputs into the product roadmap.
* **Launch readiness for high-stakes go-lives:**
  Scale tests, production readiness reviews, white-glove support during peak windows.
* **Solutioning from use case, not catalog:**
  You start with the merchant's business model and work backwards, mapping their use case to the right mix of Cashfree products, not the full suite.
* **SLA-grade resolution**
  When merchant revenue is on the line, you operate to stringent SLAs, coordinating engineering and ops in real time, holding the line on both speed and fixed quality.
* **Team leverage:**
  Better playbooks, sharper integration guides, faster onboarding for the next merchant and the one after that.

**What We're Looking For:**

* **2+ years**
  in technical account management, implementation engineering or solutions engineering, B2B SaaS or fintech, with end-to-end ownership of complex multi-stakeholder programs.
* **Technically credible:**
  Strong fluency in REST APIs, webhooks, and integration patterns. You don't ship production code, but you read it, reason about it and hold your own in a technical war room.
* **Working knowledge of at least one modern language**
  : Go, Python or Java, with hands-on experience you can point to. Familiarity with mobile platforms (Android, iOS) is a plus, especially when integrations span SDKs.
* **Comfortable in the tools merchants live in:**
  Strong with SQL for slicing through transaction data and fluent with Postman (or equivalent) for testing and debugging APIs in real time.
* **Fintech context is a strong plus:**
  Payment flows, reconciliation, settlements or compliance frameworks, anything that lets you skip the ramp.
* **Range of audience:**
  You translate cleanly in both directions: technical complexity for business stakeholders, business context for engineering, without losing precision either way.
* **Consultative by default:**
  You ask before you prescribe. Merchants can tell the difference.
* **High ownership:**
  Merchant outcomes are your outcomes. You follow through without being chased and escalate with context, not noise.
* **Built for ambiguity:**
  Enterprise implementations rarely go to plan. You re-sequence, adapt and keep merchants confident through it.
* **Builder's instinct:**
  You leave the playbook, the process and the team better than you found them.

description:
**Job Description**
The OSS L2 Engineer acts as the second-level support for Operations Support Systems (OSS) servers including MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS,ZTS,NCP and NCOM. This role involves deeper technical troubleshooting, complex incident management, system administration, and coordination with L3 teams and vendors to ensure network performance, stability, and service continuity.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Perform advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex incidents related to OSS servers (MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS, ZTS).
* Handle escalations from L1 and ensure end-to-end incident closure according to SLA.
* Manage and administer OSS server environments including configuration, patching, upgrades, and performance tuning.
* Monitor system health, alarms, logs, and automate routine operational tasks for efficiency.
* Collaborate with L3 support teams, vendors, and cross-functional teams for problem resolution and service improvements.
* Maintain documentation including incident records, change management logs, and operational procedures.
* Execute backup, disaster recovery, and failover procedures ensuring data integrity and availability.
* Support integration, commissioning, and administration of OSS network elements and tools.
* Support ITIL-based processes including incident, problem, change, and configuration management.
* Create and update service requests, change requests, and maintain ticketing system accuracy.
* Assist in automation and scripting tasks (Shell, Python, Ansible) to enhance operational efficiency
* Provide L2 support and administration for OpenShift environments, including cluster monitoring, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

**Key Skills And Experience**
Must-have:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related field.
* Typically, 7-10 years of experience in OSS operations or telecom network support.
* Strong knowledge of OSS systems in telecom, especially MantaRay, NSP, ARC, SON, HP EMS, NCOM, NCP and ZTS platforms.
* Proficient in Linux OS (CentOS, RHEL, etc.) administration and troubleshooting.
* Experience in server and network monitoring tools, fault management, and alarm handling.
* Good scripting skills in Shell, Python or similar automation tools
* Good knowledge and hands-on experience with OpenShift and Kubernetes environments.

Nice-to-have:
  
  

* Relevant professional certifications are an advantage.
* RHCSA and OpenShift/Kubernetes Certificate will be added advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Good communication skills for clear interaction with technical teams and stakeholders.
* Experience with ticketing systems, ITIL processes, and incident management workflows.
* Ability to work in shifts and handle critical escalations under pressure.

* BE/BTech/MCA with a sound industry experience of 4-8 Years

+ Minimum 1 end to end implementation of SAP BRIM Subscription Order Management (SOM)
+ Ability to work with cross-functional teams (technical, middleware, business)

title: Telecom Engineer II – Avaya Voice
description:
**Keep a 24x7 contact centre talking. Own the voice platform behind it.**

We are hiring a Telecom Engineer for a leading US-based financial services company. You will support and maintain a complex enterprise telecom environment that runs a 24x7 call centre and internal voice services. The work spans Avaya administration, performance monitoring, production troubleshooting, design and automation.

**Why this role stands out**

* End-to-end ownership of an enterprise Avaya estate: CM, Session Manager, IVR, CMS, dialer and recording
* Engineering, not just support: architecture reviews, design, diagrams and project implementation
* Automation is part of the job, with Ansible, Python and GitLab
* Direct work with vendors and project managers on business initiatives

**Shift and work mode**

* US shift, aligned to Pacific Time (approx. 9:30 PM to 6:30 AM IST)
* Full-time, work from office
* On-call rotation

**What you will do**

* Support the telecom environment: Avaya Communication Manager and Session Managers, circuits, IVR, CMS, predictive dialer, call recording, and corporate voice and data hardware and software
* Install and configure telecom equipment; repair, reconfigure and test as needed
* Run daily, weekly and monthly health checks to find and fix issues before they hit service
* Monitor equipment, report performance issues and outages, and assess workload and capacity
* Automate tasks with Ansible, Python and GitLab
* Carry out architecture reviews of new and existing telecom products and share technical analysis
* Handle adds, moves and changes, and remove leavers from systems
* Patch and back up all telecom systems
* Keep documentation, topology, equipment and circuit inventory current

**What you need**

* Bachelor's in an engineering discipline, or a telecom certification (Avaya preferred), or equivalent experience
* 5+ years as a Telecom Engineer, with solid voice or data communications experience including project work
* Strong Avaya Communication Manager and Session Manager skills, including trunk creation between devices
* Experience implementing and managing SBCs (Oracle, Avaya or similar)
* Dialing protocols: SIP, H.323 and E.164
* Linux and VMware
* Familiarity with SQL and Oracle databases
* Automation with Ansible, Git and Python
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation and communication; works well with internal teams and vendors

**Good to have**

* IVR implementation experience
* Outbound dialer campaign experience
* Ability to diagram and design telecom environments
* Cisco, AWS or Avaya certifications

title: Systems Engineering Specialist
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Specialist to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a skilled Application Packager to join NTT DATA's India EPM delivery team. This mid-senior role involves independently managing complex packaging projects — handling difficult repackages, compatibility remediation, scripted deployments, and advanced Intune/SCCM integration — for large global enterprise clients. The packager will serve as a key technical contributor on the India packaging team, handling L2/L3 packaging requests, driving quality standards, and contributing to platform and tooling improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Advanced Application Packaging**

* Handle complex application repackaging scenarios including multi-component installers, 32/64-bit dual packages, per-user vs per-machine conflicts, and custom action remediation.
* Develop and maintain MSI packages from source using WiX Toolset or InstallShield IDE for applications without vendor installers.
* Apply Package Support Framework (PSF) fixups for MSIX compatibility including working directory, file redirection, and registry virtualisation fixes.
* Package and sequence App-V virtual applications including connection group configuration and dynamic composition.
* Design and implement Intune Win32 deployment strategies including staged rollouts, dependency chains, and supersedence workflows.
* Develop custom PowerShell pre-install, post-install, and detection scripts for complex packaging requirements.

**Compatibility & Remediation**

* Analyse and resolve application compatibility issues including DPI awareness, UAC elevation, write virtualisation, and Windows 10/11 API compatibility.
* Apply and test compatibility shims using Microsoft Application Compatibility Toolkit (ACT) or PSF.
* Identify and remediate packaging issues causing deployment failures — custom actions, hardcoded paths, registry ACLs, and service configurations.
* Collaborate with application owners and vendors to obtain silent install parameters and resolve licensing or activation issues.
* Assess applications for MSIX packaging suitability and document conversion feasibility with recommended approach.

**Deployment Integration & Automation**

* Build SCCM application models with complex detection methods, global conditions, requirement rules, and multi-deployment-type configurations.
* Develop PowerShell automation scripts for batch packaging operations, package validation, and SCCM/Intune inventory reporting.
* Integrate packaging workflows with software delivery pipelines — scripted uploads to Intune via Graph API, SCCM package import automation.
* Support Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline integration for automated package build and test workflows.
* Develop and maintain packaging test scripts for regression automation on golden image environments.

**Quality & Governance**

* Define and enforce packaging standards, quality checklists, and peer review processes for the India packaging team.
* Conduct technical review of packages produced by junior packagers and provide structured feedback.
* Maintain and improve the packaging knowledge base, SOPs, and runbooks.
* Contribute to SLA governance by tracking packaging queue metrics, turnaround times, and defect rates.
* Participate in client delivery reviews and contribute packaging status updates and quality metrics.

**Required Skills**

* Advanced MSI packaging — WiX Toolset, InstallShield, AdminStudio (expert-level repackaging and custom authoring)
* MSIX packaging — Package Support Framework, MSIX Packaging Tool, advanced compatibility fix development
* App-V sequencing — virtual application packaging, connection groups, dynamic configuration
* Intune Win32 and SCCM deployment — advanced deployment type configuration, Graph API integration
* PowerShell advanced scripting — detection scripts, pre/post-install automation, batch packaging operations
* Application compatibility — ACT, shims, PSF fixups, UAC/DPI/virtualisation remediation
* Windows internals — deep understanding of registry, file system, services, COM, WMI for packaging analysis
* Log analysis and troubleshooting — MSI verbose logs, AppEnforce.log, CMTrace, Event Viewer, Procmon

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AdminStudio's Automated Application Converter for bulk MSI-to-MSIX migration
* Azure DevOps or CI/CD pipeline experience for packaging automation
* Flexera Software Vulnerability Manager or third-party patch management integration
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator (MD-102) or equivalent

**MINIMUM EDUCATION**
Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech/BCA/B.Sc. IT/CS) or MCA from a recognised Indian university. Equivalent senior enterprise packaging experience will be considered.

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. title: SLIMS Technical Consultant
description:

**OpenLab Sync (formerly SLIMS)**
is a platform that allows supervision of all stages a sample follows to the result.
**OpenLab Sync**
captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.
  
  
If you decide to join our team, you will be working closely with our clients. The tasks to be performed are multifaceted, and a creative mind is needed to be able to identify and implement customer solutions and improve the quality of life in the lab environment. Want to learn more about OpenLab Sync? Visit OpenLab Sync for more information and even some videos.

As an
**Application Engineer**
part of the Customer Success team in India, you will support our valued customers across our Lab informatics product solutions. This role offers you the opportunity to travel and explore a variety of labs, so it is vital to have an appetite for continuously learning about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. In addition, applying communication skills, creativity, and a can-do approach is vital.
  
  
**Your main responsibilities will be:**

* Analyze customers' needs and translate them into OpenLab Sync workflows
* Configure the OpenLab Sync platform to match the lab's requirements
* Build plugins for connecting instruments or displaying custom forms or portals
* Act as the customer voice to influence future product design to meet customer needs
* Script a lab's in-silico tools into our integration framework

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who has a keen interest in Lab Informatics and is seeking a new challenge. A curious individual who is driven to learn and has the desire to understand and solve customer problems to deliver customer success will succeed in this position.
  
  
**Qualifications**
We are looking for motivated individuals with the following background:
  
  

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.

**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**

title: Senior VoIP Support Engineer (L2L3) – SIP, RTP, Softswitch/SBC & Linux - Onsite Ahmedabad - UK Overlap Hours
description:
We have a rare opportunity for an experienced
**Senior VoIP Support Engineer (L2/L3) based in Ahmedabad**
to join one of the UK’s most awarded and fastest-growing next-gen VoIP providers, delivering high-quality digital phone systems and broadband with 5-star service. Positioned as the UK’s No.1 VoIP provider ahead of the 2027 BT Landline Shutdown, this is a fast-paced, award-winning environment with strong opportunities to learn, grow and build your career.

**This is a hands-on support and operations role. It does not include software development, DevOps or SRE responsibilities.**

As the Senior VoIP Support Engineer, you’ll own the stability and quality of the company’s customers’ real-time communication platforms.
**You’ll be the escalation point (L2/L3) for complex SIP, media and platform issues,**
working with customers, NOC and engineering teams to diagnose problems quickly, restore service and prevent repeat incidents.

**Must Have Skills and Experience
*(These are minimum requirements, not nice to haves)***

* **4-7 years in VoIP/telecom**
  support or operations.
* Strong understanding of
  **SIP, SDP, RTP/RTCP**
  , and related protocols and call flows.
* Hands-on experience with at least one of
  **Kamailio, FreeSWITCH, or Asterisk.**
* Proficiency with packet analysis tools
  **(Wireshark, sngrep, tcpdump).**
* Solid
  **Linux**
  administration skills (CentOS/Debian/Ubuntu), including shell, logs, networking, and services.
* Understanding of
  **NAT, firewalls, TCP/UDP, DNS, and VPN/IPsec in VoIP**
  environments.
* Working knowledge of
  **MySQL/PostgreSQL**
  and basic querying for CDR analysis.
* Experience with monitoring and ticketing tools
  **(Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus, Nagios, Jira, or Zendesk)**
  .
* Strong English, both written and verbal communication, with the ability to handle customer escalations calmly.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Act as
  **L2/L3 escalation point for VoIP incidents,**
  including call failures, one-way audio, registration problems, poor call quality, and routing issues.
* **Troubleshoot SIP signalling and RTP media**
  using packet captures and call tracing (Wireshark, sngrep, tcpdump, HOMER).
* Support and maintain softswitch, SBC, and proxy platforms (
  **Kamailio, OpenSIPS, FreeSWITCH, Asterisk,**
  or similar).
* Monitor platform health and call quality
  **(ASR, ACD, PDD, jitter, packet loss, MOS**
  ) and act on alerts proactively.
* Work with carriers and interconnect partners to resolve routing, codec, and signalling issues.
* Own incidents through to closure, including clear customer updates, RCA reports, and corrective action plans.
* Handle configuration work: trunks, dial plans, number routing, codecs, NAT traversal, and security policies.
* Apply security practices such as fraud detection, rate limiting
  **, ACLs, and TLS/SRTP, a**
  nd help mitigate toll fraud and SIP attacks.
* Write and maintain runbooks, knowledge-base articles, and SOPs.
* Mentor junior support engineers and review their escalations.
* Give structured feedback to engineering on recurring defects and improvements.
* Available to attend periodic maintenance windows during off-peak hours.

**If you bring the skills and experience listed above, we’re excited to see your application.**

*Due to high application volumes, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted - but we genuinely review, appreciate and value every application and wish you the very best in your search. Please follow us for future roles.*

title: L3 - Network Deployment Specialist
description:
A NOC L3 Engineer (Network Operations Center Level 3 Engineer) is a senior-level technical professional responsible for managing and resolving the most complex network and system issues that cannot be resolved by Level 1 or Level 2 support.
  
  
Job Summary:
  
  
The NOC L3 Engineer provides expert-level support and resolution for escalated issues involving network infrastructure, systems, and applications. They act as the final point of escalation within the NOC and collaborate with engineering teams to identify and resolve root causes of incidents and performance issues. The L3 Engineer also contributes to the development and improvement of processes, tools, and documentation to enhance system reliability and NOC efficiency.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  
Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for network, server, and system issues.
  
  
Diagnose and resolve complex incidents involving routers, switches, firewalls, servers, and cloud services.
  
  
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and implement corrective actions.
  
  
Monitor system performance and network availability, using tools like SolarWinds, Zabbix, Nagios, or Splunk.
  
  
Create and maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and knowledge base articles.
  
  
Collaborate with L1 and L2 teams for training and knowledge transfer.
  
  
Work closely with network engineers, system admins, and security teams to deploy patches, upgrades, and enhancements.
  
  
Participate in on-call rotation for after-hours support.
  
  
Maintain high availability of all network and server infrastructure in accordance with SLAs.
  
  
**Requirements**
Requirements:
  
  
Education & Experience:
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  
  
5+ years of experience in a NOC or IT infrastructure environment, including 2+ years in a senior or L3 role.
  
  
Technical Skills:
  
  
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, etc.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or similar network equipment.
  
  
Proficiency with Windows and Linux server environments.
  
  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) is a plus.
  
  
Scripting knowledge (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation is preferred.
  
  
Certifications (preferred):
  
  
CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, RHCE, MCSE, or equivalent certifications.
  
  
Soft Skills:
  
  
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  
  
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
  
  
Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple high-priority issues simultaneously.
  
  
Team player with leadership qualities and a proactive approach.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Attractive Salary Benefits
* Statutory Benefits
* Career growth

title: Project Technical Support III – PSG Institute of Advanced Studies
description:
**Job Description:** Project Technical Support III – DHR Project – PSG Institute of Advanced Studies

**Employment Type**: Full-time

**Location**: Coimbatore  
**Industry:** Education

**Qualification**: M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or any other relevant Life Sciences discipline.

**Experience:** 0 - 5 years

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a Project Technical Support III professional to support research activities involving microbial isolation and identification, antimicrobial resistance profiling, biofilm studies, anti-infective coating development, biocompatibility evaluation, and gene expression analysis. The candidate will be responsible for conducting microbiological and molecular biology experiments, fabricating and characterizing coatings, evaluating their stability and efficacy, analyzing experimental results, and maintaining accurate research records in accordance with established laboratory protocols and biosafety standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

· Perform microbial isolation, identification, antimicrobial resistance (AMR) profiling, and biofilm studies.

· Develop, fabricate, and characterize anti-infective coatings using appropriate material characterization techniques.

· Evaluate coating stability, biocompatibility, antibiofilm activity, and antivirulence efficacy through microbiological and cell culture assays.

· Conduct molecular biology experiments, including DNA extraction, RNA isolation, and quantitative PCR (qPCR), for gene expression studies.

· Analyze experimental data, interpret research findings, and prepare technical reports and research documentation.

· Maintain accurate laboratory records, experimental data, and equipment logs in accordance with established protocols.

· Ensure compliance with laboratory safety, pathogen biosafety, and procedures for the handling, storage, and disposal of biological samples and laboratory waste.

· Coordinate with the research team to support experimental planning, project execution, and timely completion of research activities.

· Assist in other research and laboratory activities assigned by the Principal Investigator or Reporting Officer.

**Desired Candidates Qualifications**

· M.Sc. in Biotechnology, Microbiology, Biochemistry, or any other relevant Life Sciences discipline, with a good academic record.

· Relevant research or laboratory experience in microbiology, molecular biology, biomaterials, or related fields will be an advantage.

· Hands-on knowledge of microbial handling, pathogen biosafety, antimicrobial susceptibility testing, and biofilm assays.

· Practical knowledge of DNA extraction, RNA isolation, qPCR, and gene expression analysis.

· Understanding of anti-infective coating development, fabrication, material characterization, stability evaluation, and biocompatibility testing.

· Familiarity with cell culture techniques, antibiofilm assays, and antivirulence studies.

· Ability to analyze experimental data, interpret results, and maintain accurate technical documentation.

· Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively while adhering to laboratory safety protocols and research standards.

**About the Institution:**

PSG Institute of Advanced Studies (PSGIAS) was established with a vision to promote world-class education, research, and innovation. Functioning under the aegis of the PSG & Sons’ Charities Trust, PSGIAS serves as a bridge between global academic institutions and PSG institutions, facilitating international education and collaborative research.

At PSGIAS, we believe in nurturing intellectual curiosity and providing students with opportunities to pursue cutting-edge research and advanced learning. Our institute offers pathways to postgraduate and doctoral programs in collaboration with renowned universities across the globe, especially in countries like the USA, UK, Germany, and Australia.

title: Operations Team Lead (Night Shift)
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
As Stripe’s user base and global footprint grows dramatically, we have distinctly unique support problems resulting from both our type of scale and the type of businesses we partner with. The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. We strive to deliver frictionless experiences for all of our users, whether they are an Independent Business, Startup, SMB, or Enterprise and our mission is to provide all Stripe Users with the best support experience possible.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
You will manage a team of Seller Systems Operations Associates in a player-coach capacity. You’ll be accountable for your team’s operational performance, development, and engagement, while working closely with global operations specialists, business process owners, and cross-functional partners to improve workflows and user experiences.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the day-to-day operational performance of a team of Associates, including quality, productivity, service-level, and other team goals.
* Set clear expectations, priorities, and performance goals for individuals and the team.
* Manage team capacity, scheduling, and work allocation to ensure critical workflows are covered and work is completed accurately and on time.
* Coach Associates on troubleshooting, process knowledge, communication, and sound judgment in resolving user issues.
* Hold regular development conversations and provide timely, constructive feedback that supports growth and career progression.
* Complete performance reviews and address performance concerns in partnership with your manager and People team partners, as appropriate.
* Build a collaborative, inclusive team environment where Associates can raise risks, share ideas, and learn from one another.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex operational or user issues, using sound judgment to resolve issues or route them to the right partner.
* Partner with global operations specialists and business process owners to run critical Internal Systems workflows.
* Identify recurring issues, process gaps, and manual work.
* Lead or contribute to improvements that increase quality, reduce effort, and improve the user experience.
* Use operational data and team insights to surface trends, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to improve product offerings, processes, tools, and user-facing communications.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and ramping of new team members.
* Help build the operating culture, team practices, and capabilities of Stripe Delivery Centers.

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience leading, supervising, or formally mentoring an operations, support, or user-facing team.
* 9+ years of experience in customer support, technical support, operations, or another internal or external user-facing environment.
* Experience managing operational work against defined quality, productivity, or service-level goals.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to give clear, constructive feedback.
* Experience coaching others and supporting their professional development
* Strong SQL skills and experience working with API integrations, including diagnosing implementation issues, interpreting technical documentation, and guiding teams through ambiguous customer or system problems.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and make practical improvements.
* The ability to prioritize effectively and make sound decisions in a fast-moving, structured environment.
* A process-oriented mindset and a track record of improving workflows, reducing manual effort, or improving user experiences.
* Experience working effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
* A user-first mindset and interest in learning technical products, systems, and processes.
* The ability to work from the Bengaluru office in night shift

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience using operational data to manage performance, identify trends, and prioritize improvements.
* Experience supporting hiring, onboarding, workforce planning, or scheduling for an operations team.
* Experience working with global teams across time zones.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization.
* Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment.
* Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones.
* Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews.
* Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth.
* Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production).
* Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up.
* Demand Planning & S&OP
* Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan.
* Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering.
* Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions.
* Maintain a rolling 12–18 month supply and capacity outlook.
* Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives
* Design and implement the site's S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework.
* Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes.
* Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases.
* Production Planning & Control
* Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand.
* Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers.
* Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders.
* Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations.
* Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters.
* Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput.
* Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases.
* Material Planning & MRP

Existing responsibilities plus:
  
  

* Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan.
* Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints.
* Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including:

+ Lead times
+ Lot sizes
+ Safety stocks
+ Reorder levels
+ MOQ
+ Supplier lead times
+ Planning horizons

* Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts.
* Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production.
* Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness.

* Procurement & Supplier Management
* Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements.
* Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions.
* Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness.
* Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries.
* Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks.
* Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required.
* Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives.
* Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements.
* Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components.
* Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate.
* Inventory Management
* Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods.
* Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements.
* Drive reduction of:

+ Excess inventory
+ Obsolete inventory
+ Slow-moving inventory
+ Uncontrolled WIP

* Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes.
* Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity.
* Warehouse & Logistics

Existing responsibilities plus:
  
  

* Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations.
* Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production.
* Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable.
* Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials.
* Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability.
* Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments
* Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes.
* Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site.
* Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch.

Support implementation of traceability systems.
  
  

+ Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements.
+ Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions.
+ Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions.
+ Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions.
+ ERP / Digital Supply Chain

Existing responsibilities plus:

* Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems.
* Establish robust governance for:

+ BOM
+ Material master
+ Routings
+ Lead times
+ Planning parameters
+ Purchase orders
+ Production orders
+ Inventory records

* Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring.
* Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation.
* Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment.
* Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements.
* Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live.
* Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities.
* Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch.

* Risk Management & Business Continuity
* Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity.
* Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions.
* Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics.
* Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks.
* Continuous Improvement
* Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving.
* Improve:

+ Planning accuracy
+ Inventory turns
+ Supplier OTD
+ Material availability
+ Production plan adherence
+ Lead time
+ OTIF
+ Supply Chain cost

* Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization.
* Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs.
* Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness.
* Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable.

Candidate Profile
  
  
Education :
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent.
* Master's degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred.

**Experience**

* 10–15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred.
* Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization.

Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage
  
  

* Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment.
* Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment.
* Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up.

Technical Competencies
  
  
Existing competencies plus:
  
  

* S&OP / IBP
* MPS / MRP
* Production Planning & Control
* Material Planning
* Procurement
* Inventory Management
* Warehouse Management
* Supplier Management
* Capacity Planning
* ERP / MRP / PLM systems
* Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools
* Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma
* Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up
* Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up
* Project Management
* Program Management
* Change Management
* ERP Deployment & Go-Live
* Master Data Governance
* Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews
* New Product Introduction (NPI)

Leadership Competencies
  
  
Existing competencies plus:
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability
* Ability to manage cross-functional teams
* Strong stakeholder-management skills
* Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment
* Strong execution discipline
* Data-driven decision making
* Excellent communication and escalation management
* Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams
* Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up.
* Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth.
* Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities.
* Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments.

Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.
  
  
At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: EXIM - Manager
description:
**Job Description:**

**Coordination with internal and external stakeholders for export shipments. Prepare & verify export documentation (CIPL+ Shipping bills, customs documents) liaison with DGFT and Customs for Export, Duty Drawback etc.**

**Measuring performance, Negotiation with CHA, Freight Forwarders. Handle export-related banking activities. Contribute to the development of EXIM Logistics strategies.**

**Budget and cost management - total cost ownership to support profitability. Strictly compliance to Customs and other legislation and ensuring high level of ethics and transparency in day-to-day business.**

**Handling letter of credit documentation and coordinate with business team / customer on ensuring accuracy.**

**Experience: 15 - 20 years**

**Additional Job Description:**

**1. Work with business team on monthly Exports Dispatch plan.**

**2. Should be able to present monthly progress on EXIM metrics / review and MIS reporting.**

**3. Hands on with all new rules and regulations, tariff, incentives, Exim /export policies .**

**4. Ensure billing of all commercially and technically cleared orders within the same month and meet the Business plan.**

**5. Preparing KRA for Export logistics service providers and measure performance against them. Contribute towards reduction in Export freight and packing costs.**

**6. Well versed with process, procedure of applying advance licenses, DGFT coordination etc .**

**7. Engage teams and mentor them to achieve greater targets.**

title: Securities Operations Senior Manager - ED
description:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Securities Operations Senior Manager
  
  
**About This Role:**

* Lead large and complex LOB operations, managing a 50+ member team to deliver high‑quality, cost‑effective services for U.S. stakeholders.
* Own financial performance of the LOB, including budgeting, revenue management, expense control, and productivity improvement.
* Build strong relationships with U.S. partners and stakeholders, ensuring effective work planning, delivery, issue resolution, and business alignment.
* Drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, strong governance, proactive risk management, and robust internal controls.
* Develop a skilled, flexible workforce by enabling career growth, optimizing resource planning, and enhancing employee engagement and retention.
* Foster a high‑performance culture through effective leadership, recognition programs, and readiness to work night shifts to support U.S. operation
* Build high‑performance culture through effective leadership, recognition programs

**In This Role, You Will:**

* Provide leadership across Security Master, Pricing Account Maintenance, Reference Data Management, Remediation, Enterprise Integration and Institutional onboarding functions, with strong understanding of associated risks and regulatory requirements.
* Guide teams to improve processes, enhance controls, optimize resources, and deliver on WIM Operations’ strategic priorities.

* Leverage data‑driven insights to manage team performance, enhance decision‑making, and drive operational excellence. data‑driven insights to manage team performance, enhance decision‑making, and drive operational excellence.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 6+ years of Reference Data management functional leadership experience, or equivalent experience demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 3+ years of functional leadership experience
* Overall experience of close to 20 years in the above-mentioned functional areas.
* Lead Operations, managers for a large, complex LOB and/or multiple LOBs
* Build and lead a team of approximately 50+ across a LOB or LOBs. This span is based on the complexity of the process.
* Build and lead a team to deliver quality and cost-effective offshoring solutions to the global partners
* Manage the LOB’s budgets, revenues and expenses
* Engage and manage stakeholder relationships and provide solutions when needed
* Engage the global partners to plan, assign and manage the delivery of work
* Operational Excellence: focus on driving continuous improvement
* Risk Management: proactively identify risks and build robust internal controls
* Develop and maintain a flexible and skilled resource base for provision of the service collaborating with colleagues for efficient resource management
* Create opportunities for growth, both horizontal and vertical.
* Use Rewards and Recognition to motivate staff and encourage performance.
* Improve Staff Engagement and manage attrition.
* Should be willing to work in night shift

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Expertise in Wealth Management or Financial Services Industry business and operational capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability leading a major function or large geographic segment of a financial services organization
* Demonstrated ability to interact with effectively with a variety of contacts, primarily senior management
* Solid budget forecasting and risk management skills
* Demonstrated ability to manage through middle and upper-level managers
* Demonstrated ability to contribute to companywide strategy and to use strategy to drive results
* Demonstrates a high degree of reliability, integrity, and trustworthiness in all areas
* A seasoned, relationship-driven executive who will have the style and sensitivity to work within a highly complex business environment. Multi-cultural sensitivity a must.
* Exhibits excellent problem solving and analytical skills
* Good understanding of Six Sigma, Lean, etc. and a track record of continuous improvement through usage of the above quality tools. Experienced in process improvement and quality frameworks
* Excellent soft skills - communication skills and ability to influence at senior levels
* Strong people leadership experience, ability to navigate across global leaders.
* Demonstrate expertise in project management, stakeholder engagement, people leadership, delivery of quality work products
* Ability to articulate issues, risks, and proposed solutions to various levels of staff and management
* Ability to make timely and independent judgment decisions while working in a fast-paced and results-driven environment
* Ability to negotiate and facilitate issue resolution
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and across all organizational levels, where flexibility, collaboration, and adaptability are important
* Preferably with a FINRA Series 7/24/99
* Overall experience of close to 20 years in the above-mentioned functional areas.
* Solid understanding of Security Master, Pricing Account Maintenance, Reference Data Management, Remediation, Enterprise Integration and Institutional onboarding functions, with strong understanding of associated risks and regulatory requirements. Risk associated with the functional workflows
* Functional knowledge of different type of security set up, pricing updates and industry knowledge on the maintenance requirements – experience in working and managing complex regulatory changes
* Good understanding of different type of document types used for regular accounts & also trust, IRA, estate, UHNI & HNI accounts
* Understanding of reporting of performance
* Develop and execute processes and tools to hold individuals and teams accountable for progress.
* Contribute to the development of digital strategies to improve the client experience by usage of Automation and Ai tools
* Ensure all compliance and regulatory requirements are implemented, and SLAs to all partners and stakeholders are met.
* Participate in the review of end-to-end business processes to determine where we can simplify and create more efficiencies.
* Implement a continuous improvement program to ensure processes and procedures remain current and appropriate in line with the regulatory and legal changes

title: Stewarding Manager | Conrad Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You**
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You will lead the steward teams and ensure seamless operations to deliver exceptional guest experiences. As a
**Stewarding Manager**
, you’re not just supporting strategic oversight of all stewarding operations across the property – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:
  
  

* Support inventory control: Assist with daily coordination, distribution, storage and maintenance of essential items – including china, glassware, linen, and silver – ensuring accuracy and availability for all operations
* Monitor sanitation standards: Assist in implementing and overseeing sanitation procedures to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations
* Oversee equipment maintenance: Assist in securing, maintaining, and ensuring the functionality of food service equipment
* Assist with cost management: Track expenses and identify cost-saving opportunities to support departmental efficiency and profitability
* Support team performance and development: Assist with day-to-day team oversight, scheduling shifts, coaching and professional development, conducting evaluations, and recognizing achievements
* Uphold regulatory standards: Maintain compliance with health, safety, sanitation, and alcohol awareness regulations, ensuring the highest standards of guest and team member well-being

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
  
  
**In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum 5 years’ experience in a 5-star hotel, with at least 1 year as Assistant Chief Steward in an international brand.
* Strong leadership, organizational, and supervisory skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
* Knowledge of HACCP and hygiene standards.
* Ability to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

**About Us**
**Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture**
At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality.
  
  
Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel.
  
  
Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical.
  
  
Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Merchandising Operations Team Lead
description:
**Overview**
**Merchandising Team Lead**
The Team Lead will be part of Merchandising Operations Team where you will leverage your skills and
  
  
business acumen to achieve the organization and team goals.
  
  
**About Catalyst Brands**
Catalyst Brands is a leading U.S.-based retail organization formed in 2025 through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. The company manages a diversified portfolio of well-known brands including Aéropostale, Brooks Brothers, Nautica, Lucky Brand, and JCPenney. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Catalyst Brands focuses on delivering modern retail experiences while leveraging the heritage of established global brands. With a workforce of over tens of thousands and multi-billion-dollar revenue, the organization operates at a large scale across retail, e-commerce, and supply chain domains. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. Catalyst Brands is expanding its global presence, including a growing capability centre in India that supports technology, digital operations, and analytics. It aims to drive operational excellence and business growth by integrating technology, data-driven insights, and efficient retail practices.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and strategic Merchandising Operations Team Lead to oversee and optimize the end-to-end item creation and supplier onboarding processes across multiple business units. This role is critical in enabling seamless inventory execution and digital item setup, directly influencing speedto-market and customer experience.
  
  
The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of merchandise operations, item lifecycle management, and retail systems. The role requires interfacing with suppliers, merchants, digital operations, and inventory teams to ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and flawless execution in JCPenney’s ecosystem.
  
  
**Job Functions**

* 6 to 8 years of experience in Retail and Merchandising - Item Set Up, Category management and

catalogue management
  
  

* Communicates with various levels of management including merchandising managers, buyers,

assistant buyers and merchandising assistants
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Builds and Elevates Team Capability: Champions the development of team members through hands-on

mentoring, continuous feedback, and targeted skill-building initiatives. Cultivates bench strength to ensure
  
  
organizational agility, succession readiness, and long-term team sustainability.
  
  

* Operational Leadership & Workflow Excellence: Establishes and enforces standardized workflows to

streamline execution and ensure consistent delivery of high-volume, time-sensitive operational tasks.
  
  

* Support Services & SLA Management: Leads the team in providing exceptional user support by defining,

monitoring, and continuously improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Identifies skill and knowledge gaps,
  
  
driving the creation of training programs that elevate team performance and reduce support friction.
  
  

* Strategic Ownership of Item Creation: Lead the team responsible for execution of the item setup process for

both owned and factory-ship assortments. Ensure flawless execution and integration of orderable and sellable
  
  
attributes in alignment with divisional goals, merchandise strategies, and omnichannel readiness.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a liaison between merchants, planning teams, and suppliers to ensure

alignment on timelines, data requirements, and setup accuracy. Drive accountability across business units to
  
  
meet critical milestones for new item rollouts.
  
  

* Supplier Enablement & Communication: Establish strong supplier partnerships to ensure timely

submission of item setup data and compliance with JCPenney standards. Own post-setup supplier
  
  
communication including image submissions, content updates, and inventory availability.
  
  

* Process Optimization: Continuously assess and refine item setup workflows and systems to reduce cycle

time, eliminate errors, and improve scalability. Proactively identify bottlenecks and implement process
  
  
improvements in partnership with IT and business stakeholders.
  
  

* Digital Operations Integration: Lead the collaboration with the Digital Operations team to ensure readiness

for content deployment, image processing, and inventory loading into the eCommerce platform.
  
  

* Data Accuracy & Governance: Ensure all forms and data captured during the item setup phase are validated

and accurate. Implement processes and controls to maintain high data integrity across JCPenney’s ERP and
  
  
digital systems. Build and lead strong governance over item readiness for online and in-store visibility.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in Merchandising and Item Data Management
* Bachelor’s degree in related field (Masters will be added advantage)
* Critical thinking, Problem Solving, Mentoring & Decision-making
* Proficiency in Oracle RMS, data master, PIM or other related operating system
* Proficiency in intermediate excel
* Good Communication Skills both verbal & written

Enjoy a rewarding career at Catalyst Brands Business Services, where we offer a competitive benefits
  
  
package, a vibrant work environment, and the opportunity to make a difference at one of America's
  
  
most iconic retailers.
  
  

* Benefits: Medical insurance coverage, Accident insurance, Life and Gratuity insurance,

Employee assistance program, creche/day care support, adoption assistance program, paid
  
  
leaves, maternity leave, paternity leave, bereavement leave, adoption leave, compensatory
  
  
leave, free cab services(door pick up and door drop),Ekin Care.
  
  

* On-site amenities: Onsite sick/wellness room, office doctor visits, cafeteria services

(free lunch),tuck shop, nursing/lactation room, footstools for expecting mothers, gym,
  
  
innovation lab, recreation room, vibrant co-working spaces and meeting rooms.
  
  

* Exciting location: Our office is located in one of India's largest contiguous and most-well

known business parks. Spanning 15.2msf, Embassy Manyata is located in a prominent growth
  
  
corridor, which connects the international airport to the city centre.
  
  

* Opportunities for growth and development: We are committed to helping our employees

grow their careers and develop their skills. We offer a variety of training and development
  
  
programs, as well as opportunities for advancement.
  
  

* Collaborative and supportive culture: We believe in creating a workplace where everyone feels

valued and respected. We encourage teamwork and collaboration, and we are always looking for
  
  
ways to support our employees' success.
  
  
**Pay Range**
INR ₹0.00 - INR ₹0.00 /Yr.

title: Technical Account Manager (Offshore Delivery & People Management)
description:
**About the Role:**
The Technical Account Manager will lead and mentor a high-performing offshore team of approximately 30 professionals supporting an enterprise account. This role is responsible for delivery excellence, operational governance, client relationship management, technical leadership, and people development to ensure the successful execution of business objectives and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**

* Delivery & Account Management- Lead offshore delivery, ensuring quality, timely execution, resource optimization, KPI/SLA compliance, risk management, and continuous improvement while serving as the primary client contact
* Technical Leadership- Mentor technical teams, drive engineering best practices, DevOps and automation adoption, and support solution reviews, technical decisions, and issue resolution
* Operations & Performance Management- Oversee production support and operations, monitor performance metrics, and implement process improvements to enhance service delivery and operational excellence
* Client Engagement -Build strong client relationships, present delivery performance and risks, provide strategic recommendations, and align offshore execution with business objectives
* People Leadership- Lead and develop a team of ~30 associates, managing performance, career growth, succession planning, engagement, hiring, retention, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning

**What You Bring:**

* 10+ years of experience in software delivery, technical program management, or account management roles.
* Proven experience managing offshore delivery teams of 25-50 members.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and operational support models.
* Experience working with financial services or banking clients.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and executive presentation skills.
* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including performance management and career development.
* Experience working in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) environments, with hands-on exposure to Saviynt and Java-based solutions.
* Must be based in Bangalore and willing to work from the Bangalore office to effectively lead and manage the offshore delivery team

**Nice to Have:**

* Delivery quality and predictability
* Client satisfaction and stakeholder feedback
* Team productivity and operational efficiency
* SLA/KPI adherence
* Employee engagement, retention, and career progression
* Continuous improvement and innovation outcomes

**About Simeio And What We Do**
Simeio has over 650 talented employees across the globe. We have offices in USA (Atlanta HQ and Texas), India, Canada, Costa Rica and UK.
  
  
Founded in 2007, and now backed by private equity company ZMC, Simeio is recognized as a top IAM provider by industry analysts.
  
  
Alongside Simeio’s identity orchestration tool ‘Simeio IO’ - Simeio also partners with industry leading IAM software vendors to provide access management, identity governance and administration, privileged access management and risk intelligence services across on-premise, cloud, and hybrid technology environments.
  
  
Simeio provides services to numerous Fortune 1000 companies across all industries including financial services, technology, healthcare, media, retail, public sector, utilities and education.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
Simeio is an equal opportunity employer. If you require assistance with completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our recruitment team - recruitment@simeio.com.
  
  
**About Your Application**
We carefully review every application we receive. If your skills and experience match our needs, we’ll be in touch. If you don’t hear from us within 10 days, please don’t be discouraged. We may retain your application for future opportunities. We also encourage you to check our careers page for other openings.

title: Salesforce Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Service Delivery Manager – Application Managed Services**

* We are looking for an experienced Service Delivery Manager (SDM) with experience in managing enterprise applications like SAP and Salesforce to lead end-to-end Application Managed Services delivery for a large, multi-technology enterprise environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own overall service delivery and customer engagement for L2/L3 application support.
* Manage SLAs, KPIs, service quality, backlog, risks, escalations and capacity utilization.
* Lead major incident management, RCA, problem management and corrective actions.
* Conduct weekly/monthly service reviews and provide clear visibility into performance, risks, actions and improvements.
* Manage service transition, knowledge transfer, stabilization and steady-state operations.
* Coordinate across application teams, SMEs, customer stakeholders and third-party vendors.
* Drive effective Core/Flex capacity management aligned with workload and skill requirements.
* Ensure strong knowledge management through SOPs, runbooks and KEDB.
* Identify and drive continuous improvement, automation and operational-efficiency initiatives.
