title: Supervisor I, Client Services
description:
**Company Introduction**
Availity is one of the leading health information networks in the United States, processing more than 4 billion transactions annually and connecting more than two million healthcare providers and over two thousand technology partners to health plans nationwide. Our teams of technology, business, and customer service professionals in Bangalore, India, are working together to transform healthcare delivery in the United States through innovation and collaboration. Our technologists help develop cutting-edge revenue cycle solutions that help hospitals, health systems, and physicians maximize payments and optimize their workflows.
  
  
Availity is a diverse group of people whose talents, curiosity and passion steer the company to create innovative solutions for the US Healthcare industry. If you are a driven, creative and collaborative individual, with exceptional technology skills to drive innovation, we want to hear from you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Oversees the product support team, supervising representatives assisting customers via phone, email, chat, or fax. Establishes and maintains systems that provide answers to common questions and problems. Ensures representatives are properly trained when old products are upgraded or new products are released. Monitors key performance metrics and case management. Analyzes support data to identify trends and recurring issues and reports findings to design teams. Implements process improvements to optimize support delivery. Manages support resources, budgets, and vendor relationships. Ensures compliance with regulatory and contractual obligations related to product support.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**About Availity**
Availity is a leading healthcare technology company focused on simplifying healthcare administration and solving real-world challenges for healthcare providers, health plans, and patients. Our technology helps reduce complexity so providers can spend less time navigating administrative systems and more time focused on patient care.
  
  
**About Availity India**
Availity India is an important part of Availity's global growth journey. Based in Bengaluru, our India teams’ partner closely with U.S. and global stakeholders across technology, product, operations, customer support, and corporate functions.
  
  
Our India organization is being built with a strong focus on ownership, learning, collaboration, engineering excellence, and meaningful business impact. Associates in India have the opportunity to solve complex problems, contribute to global initiatives, and support products and services that are part of the U.S. healthcare ecosystem.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced Team Lead to oversee a high-volume inbound international voice support team and drive operational excellence. In this role, you will be responsible for achieving service, quality, and productivity goals while fostering a high-performance team culture. You will provide coaching, manage escalations, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve customer experience and business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Supervise and manage day-to-day operations of high-volume inbound international voice processes.
* Ensure service level agreements (SLAs), quality standards, and productivity targets are consistently met.
* Provide real-time coaching, feedback, and performance management to team members.
* Handle escalated customer issues and ensure effective resolution within defined timelines.
* Monitor call quality, compliance, and adherence to process guidelines.
* Prepare and share performance reports, root-cause analyses, and improvement action plans.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to support operational goals and continuous improvement.
* Support team training, onboarding, and knowledge enhancement initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in inbound international voice processes (US market preferred).
* Minimum 5+ years of experience in a supervisory role within a high call-volume customer support environment.
* Exposure to US Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and practice management software is an added advantage.
* Strong people management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
* Willingness to work in US shifts (India night shift).
* Willingness to work from office on all working days.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working in US Healthcare sector and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
* Experienced in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.

**Why Join Availity India?**

* Meaningful impact: Work on solutions that help simplify healthcare administration and support better provider and patient experiences.
* Global exposure: Partner with U.S. teams and leaders while contributing from India to global business priorities.
* Learning and growth: Be part of a culture that values continuous learning, mentoring, knowledge sharing, and career development.
* Flexible work experience: Work in a way that supports productivity, collaboration, and team needs across remote, hybrid, and office-based models.
* Holistic rewards: Benefit from competitive compensation, health and insurance benefits, paid time off, company holidays, leave benefits, Employee Assistance Program support, and learning programs.
* Inclusive workplace: Join a casual, collaborative, and inclusive environment where associates are encouraged to bring ideas forward.
* Office experience: For office-based associates, Availity India provides amenities such as coffee and tea, subsidized meals, recreation areas, and eligible night-shift transportation support.

**What To Expect From The Hiring Process**
Our hiring process is designed to be transparent and engaging. Depending on the role, it may include application review, recruiter discussion, technical or functional assessment, hiring manager interviews, team or leadership conversations, offer discussion, background verification, and onboarding support.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Statement**
Availity is committed to building an inclusive workplace where all associates feel valued, respected, and empowered to do their best work. We welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds and encourage individuals who are excited by collaboration, innovation, and meaningful impact to apply.
  
  
**Eligibility**
**Video Camera Usage**
*Availity fosters a collaborative and open culture where communication and engagement are central to our success. As a remote first company, we are also camera-first and provide all associates with camera/video capability to simulate the office environment. If you are not able to use your camera for all virtual meetings, you should not apply for this role.*
*Having cameras on helps create a more connected, interactive, and productive environment, allowing teams to communicate more effectively and build stronger working relationships. The usage of cameras also enhances security and protects sensitive company information. Video participation is required to ensure that only authorized personnel are present in meetings and to prevent unauthorized access, data breaches, preventing social engineering, or the sharing of confidential information with non-participants.*

title: Vice President Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Vice President Operations**
Lead the operational management and evolution of Domestic Payments, ACH(Automated Clearing House ), RTP(Real time payments) and other Emerging Payments processing within Payments Business Service. The role is accountable for safe, resilient and client-focused execution, driving end-to-end consistency of operational design, efficiency through standardisation and global solutions, and strong risk and control outcomes—while supporting ongoing market infrastructure change and new scheme adoption.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own day-to-day operational performance for Domestic, ACH, RTP and Emerging Payments processing, ensuring delivery against all agreed service levels/PLAs (cut-offs, quality, Audit & Risk outcomes, OOE and operational losses).
* Design, manage and report operational performance using robust MI/KPIs; ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to agreed standards and regulatory expectations. Drive client experience outcomes by reducing client effort and improving transparency (e.g., fewer avoidable rejects/returns, faster resolution of exceptions, clearer status/communications through agreed channels). Lead standardisation and simplification across the functional line, striking the right balance between global consistency and required local/scheme-specific needs.
* Drive productivity and cost transparency; identify and deliver efficiency opportunities through process redesign, automation and improved workflow/tooling. Ensure all change activities (scheme changes, platform upgrades, new products/rails, regulatory deadlines) are communicated, agreed and deployed with minimal operational disruption. Supervise migrations/transitions where applicable, leveraging existing expertise to shorten transition timelines and stabilise performance post-move.
* Ensure appropriate risk and control strategies are in place for all processes under remit; proactively identify control gaps and drive sustainable remediation. Manage incidents (including those caused by external factors such as scheme outages or market events) through effective co-ordination, timely escalation and stakeholder communications. Ensure operational readiness and resilience for evolving payments infrastructure (including new schemes and message format migrations), delivering solutions to mandatory timelines. Partner with Global Businesses, Transformation, Technology and other stakeholders to shape and deliver operational change programmes and innovation across payments workflows. Plan and manage ad-hoc tasks and senior management queries, ensuring relevant and timely responses.
* Build and lead a high-performing and engaged payments operations team; set clear direction, expectations and accountability. Retain talent, manage underperformance and attrition, and ensure development and career progression opportunities across payments talent pools. Role model Operational Excellence and continuous improvement; embed a culture of disciplined execution, learning and “fix it once, fix it properly”.
* Promote an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects HSBC values; operate effectively across cultures and geographies. Maintain strong working relationships with peer groups and senior managers to co-ordinate delivery, remove blockers and report progress and results. Contribute to the broader payments governance structure, including policy and decision-making, through active participation in committees/forums.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Recognised as a Subject Matter Expert in Payments Business Service / Payments Operations, with strong understanding of domestic clearing, ACH processing, RTP/instant payments and emerging payment rails (including exceptions, returns, rejects and operational controls).
* 10+ years’ experience in Operations Management, including strong operational control capability and a proven track record in delivery. Strong programme/change/project management skills; able to deliver standardisation, migrations and operational transformation safely. .
* Excellent planning, organising and commercial skills, including strong financial management capability and ability to drive cost transparency. Resourceful and outcome-focused; able to leverage available resources to achieve goals.
* Prior experience driving innovative operational solutions (process, automation, tooling, MI) is an advantage.
* Ensure employees apply compliance and operational risk controls in accordance with HSBC and regulatory standards and policies, recognising the heightened regulatory implications associated with payments. Continually reassess operational risks inherent in the role, considering changes in economic/market conditions, legal/regulatory requirements, operating procedures, organisational changes and new technology.
* Ensure incidents are reported per the incident escalation process in a timely manner; ensure root cause analysis is completed and corrective actions are implemented and sustained. Support ongoing market infrastructure change programmes (new schemes/rails, rulebook changes, message format migrations), ensuring solutions are delivered to regulatory/mandatory timelines.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. title: Head of Estate Operations
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly accomplished
**Estate Manager / Head of Estate Operations**
to manage the end-to-end operations of a large, ultra-luxury private residential estate.

The residence is a significant property complex comprising premium residential spaces and extensive lifestyle, hospitality, recreational, engineering, security, landscaping, wellness, entertainment, and support infrastructure.

The Estate Manager will have complete responsibility for ensuring that the residence operates seamlessly, safely, efficiently, and to exceptionally high standards at all times.

The role requires a strong
**operations leader**
with deep experience in managing complex facilities, large teams, multiple vendors, engineering systems, hospitality services, preventive maintenance, security coordination, budgets, and service standards.

The successful candidate should combine the operational discipline of a
**five-star hotel or luxury property**
, the technical understanding of a
**large facilities-management operation**
, and the discretion and service orientation required in a
**high-profile private household**
.

Key Responsibilities

Estate Operations Management

Take overall responsibility for the day-to-day operations of the entire residential estate and ensure all facilities, services, infrastructure, and amenities remain fully operational.

Develop and implement comprehensive operating procedures, service standards, preventive maintenance schedules, checklists, escalation protocols, and operational dashboards.

Conduct regular inspections of the estate to ensure the property is maintained to exceptionally high standards of cleanliness, safety, functionality, presentation, and readiness.

Ensure that all services operate seamlessly with minimal disruption to the Principal and family.

Establish a proactive operating culture where potential issues are identified and resolved before they impact residents or guests.

Engineering & Facilities Management

Oversee all engineering and technical infrastructure of the estate, including:

* Electrical systems and power distribution
* DG sets, UPS and backup power systems
* HVAC and air-conditioning systems
* Plumbing and water-management systems
* STP/WTP and water treatment systems
* Elevators and escalators
* Building Management Systems
* Fire detection and firefighting systems
* Home automation and smart-home systems
* Lighting-control systems
* CCTV and access-control systems
* Audio-visual systems
* Swimming pools and water features
* Kitchens and specialist equipment
* Solar and energy-management systems
* Networking and communication infrastructure

Establish robust preventive and predictive maintenance programs.

Ensure equipment warranties, AMCs, service contracts, maintenance records, and technical documentation are properly maintained.

Coordinate shutdowns, major repairs, upgrades, refurbishments, and equipment replacement without disrupting household operations.

Hospitality & Residential Services

Ensure consistently exceptional service standards across all guest-facing and household operations.

Supervise areas such as:

* Housekeeping
* Butler services
* Food & beverage operations
* Kitchens and pantry operations
* Guest rooms and suites
* Laundry and linen management
* Concierge services
* Chauffeur and transport services
* Events and private functions

Ensure the residence is always prepared for family members, VIP visitors, dignitaries, business guests, and private events.

Work closely with household teams to understand the preferences and requirements of the Principal and family.

Amenities Management

Ensure flawless operation and maintenance of all lifestyle and recreational amenities, which may include:

* Swimming pools
* Gymnasium and fitness facilities
* Spa and wellness facilities
* Salon
* Home theatre / private cinema
* Entertainment areas
* Banquet and event spaces
* Sports facilities
* Indoor and outdoor recreational areas
* Libraries and lounges
* Children’s areas
* Gardens and landscaped areas
* Water features
* Private offices and meeting areas
* Guest houses
* Parking and vehicle facilities

Develop operating and maintenance protocols for each amenity.

Security & Safety Coordination

Work closely with the Head of Security and specialist security agencies to ensure appropriate physical-security and access-control standards across the estate.

Ensure effective visitor-management, contractor-access, vehicle-movement, and staff-access procedures.

Coordinate emergency preparedness including fire safety, medical emergencies, evacuation protocols, power failures, flooding, equipment failures, and other contingencies.

Ensure regular emergency-response drills and safety audits are conducted.

Staff Management

Lead and manage a large multidisciplinary workforce comprising permanent employees, contract staff, specialists, and external service providers.

Functions may include:

* Engineering
* Housekeeping
* Hospitality
* Food & beverage
* Landscaping
* Security
* Drivers
* Laundry
* Concierge
* Administration
* Maintenance technicians

Establish clear roles, reporting structures, staffing levels, shift rosters, leave planning, and performance standards.

Develop training programs and ensure all employees demonstrate high standards of discipline, grooming, professionalism, confidentiality, and service.

Build a strong second line of leadership through departmental managers and supervisors.

* Resolve complex customer disputes and billing-related collection obstacles in partnership with customer-facing, legal, accounting, and revenue operations teams.
* Prepare and present collection performance metrics, risks, root causes, and recommended actions to Finance leadership.

Billing & Collections Transformation & Automation
  
  

* Lead initiatives to reduce, automate, or eliminate manual billing and collections work while protecting accuracy, controls, compliance, auditability, and customer experience.
* Document current-state process logic, identify root causes of inefficiency, translate billing and collections rules into automation requirements, and build or partner to build scalable workflows and exception-based review models.
* Redesign invoice quality review, dispute management, customer follow-up, collection prioritization, cash forecasting, AR reporting, and escalation processes using automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Establish an automation opportunity pipeline and track value delivered through time savings, cash acceleration, risk reduction, billing quality improvement, productivity gains, and cost reduction.
* Ensure proper change management, testing, documentation, approval, training, and control sign-off for process redesign and automation changes.

Team Leadership & Change Management
  
  

* Lead and coach billing and collections team members through the shift from manual process execution to exception management, analytics, automation ownership, customer issue resolution, and control oversight.
* Establish performance goals, KPIs, accountability measures, and operating routines that reinforce quality, speed, customer service, cash performance, and continuous improvement.
* Communicate complex billing, collections, systems, data, and automation concepts clearly to finance and non-finance stakeholders.
* Create a culture of curiosity, accountability, practical innovation, customer service excellence, and disciplined change management.

Data, Analytics & Financial Intelligence
  
  

* Develop dashboards, exception reporting, aging analytics, dispute trend analysis, collection prioritization models, and cash conversion reporting that reduce manual data gathering and improve operational visibility.
* Use analytics and AI-enabled capabilities to identify anomalies, explain billing and collection performance drivers, prioritize risks, and generate first-draft commentary for management review.
* Partner with FP&A, Accounting, Revenue Operations, and business leaders to convert billing and AR data into actionable insight, improved decision support, and measurable cash flow improvement.

Systems & Technology Leadership
  
  

* Serve as a Finance owner for billing and collections workflows, requirements, testing, data validation, controls, and system enhancements across ERP, CRM, payment, reporting, and workflow automation platforms.
* Use or help deploy tools such as Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Power Platform, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, SQL, D365 Finance, Salesforce, close or AR management tools, RPA, or similar technologies where appropriate.
* Improve data quality, customer master data governance, contract-to-bill data flows, integrations, workflow controls, and system controls that support scalable order-to-cash operations.
* Report operational performance and transformation updates to leadership, as applicable.

Compliance, Controls & Audit Readiness
  
  

* Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, customer contract requirements, revenue operations standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain proper documentation of billing and collections procedures, process logic, control evidence, system changes, and automation requirements.
* Support internal and external audit requirements and ensure transformation initiatives preserve auditability and financial reporting integrity.

**Education & Qualifications**
Education
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field required.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue operations, finance operations, or order-to-cash leadership.
* 5+ years of supervisory, team leadership, or project leadership experience.
* Experience with invoice generation, AR aging, collections strategy, customer disputes, billing controls, cash forecasting, reporting, audit support, and process improvement.
* Demonstrated success reviewing manual finance operations work while designing future-state automated processes and exception-based operating models.
* Experience designing automation in order-to-cash operations, collections prioritization, invoice quality controls, dispute analytics, anomaly detection, or continuous control monitoring capabilities.
* Hands-on ERP, CRM, reporting, workflow automation, AI, RPA, or finance systems experience required; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Salesforce experience preferred.

Skills & Knowledge
  
  

* Deep understanding of order-to-cash, billing, accounts receivable, collections, dispute management, customer account reconciliation, and cash conversion processes.
* Working knowledge of finance systems, data flows, contract-to-bill data, system controls, integrations, master data governance, and operational reporting.
* Experience with Salesforce, Copilot Studio, D365 Finance & Operations, AR management tools, RPA, Power Query, Power BI or similar technologies preferred.
* Strong analytical, process redesign, root-cause analysis, project management, communication, stakeholder management, and change leadership skills.
* High standards for accuracy, ethics, control discipline, governance, documentation, customer service, and financial reporting integrity.

Success Measures
  
  

* Improved billing accuracy and invoice cycle times leading to reductions in customer disputes and overall increased perception of Greenway invoicing.
* Reduction in DSO, past-due AR, dispute resolution cycle time, manual billing review effort, and recurring collections follow-up burden.
* Improved collection effectiveness, cash forecasting visibility, anomaly detection, control effectiveness, audit readiness, and time-to-insight.
* Quantified value delivered through cash acceleration, cost savings, productivity improvement, risk reduction, automation adoption, and business insight.

Work Environment / Physical Demands
  
  
This position is primarily sedentary and requires regular use of a computer, keyboard, financial systems, collaboration tools, workflow platforms, and data visualization tools. The role requires the ability to review information on a computer screen for extended periods and communicate clearly with internal stakeholders, external partners, customers, and team members.

title: Assistant Logistics Manager
description:

Assistant Logistics Manager.

**ABOUT UNILEVER**
: Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that strive to improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us every day. **Purpose of the Role**
To drive end-to-end warehouse, inventory, transportation, and 3PL operations across Distribution centres, ensuring superior customer service, safety, compliance, inventory accuracy, and cost optimization. The role is responsible for delivering operational excellence through effective management of Distribution Centres (DCs), transport partners, warehouse service providers, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Warehouse Operations**

* Manage day-to-day warehouse operations across assigned DCs and CFA locations.
* Ensure adherence to SOPs, safety standards, quality requirements, and statutory compliance.
* Drive warehouse productivity, space utilization, put-away efficiency, picking accuracy, and dispatch performance.
* Ensure optimal utilization of warehouse infrastructure, automation, conveyors, and MHE equipment.
* Lead warehouse audits and ensure closure of audit observations.

**Inventory Management**

* Maintain high inventory accuracy through regular cycle counts and reconciliation.
* Monitor stock ageing, slow-moving inventory, damages, and write-offs.
* Ensure FIFO/FEFO compliance across all product categories.
* Drive inventory productivity and minimize stock losses.
* Coordinate with Finance and Planning teams on inventory governance and stock adjustments.

**Transportation & Distribution**

* Manage secondary transportation operations to achieve service and cost targets.
* Ensure vehicle placement as per dispatch plans and business requirements.
* Monitor transporters' performance, vehicle turnaround time, detentions, POD compliance, and freight efficiency.
* Drive network optimization and loadability improvement initiatives.
* Ensure timely dispatch of customer orders and STO movements.

**Service & Customer Excellence**

* Deliver agreed service levels across GT, MT, QCom,E-commerce, CSD, and Key Accounts.
* Coordinate closely with Customer Service, Planning, Sales, and Finance teams to resolve execution challenges.
* Monitor fulfilment KPIs and implement corrective actions for service gaps.
* Support peak season planning and execution.

**Third-Party Logistics (3PL) Management**

* Manage warehouse and transport service providers.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with 3PL partners.
* Ensure contractual compliance and SLA adherence.
* Drive productivity improvements and cost-saving initiatives through vendor collaboration.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Deliver annual logistics cost targets.
* Identify and implement warehouse and freight optimization projects.
* Drive continuous improvement projects focused on productivity, automation, digitalization, and process simplification.
* Monitor warehouse cost, freight cost, manpower productivity, and overall cost-to-serve.

**Safety, Quality & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with EHS standards and company safety policies.
* Conduct safety reviews, risk assessments, and incident investigations.
* Drive a Zero Harm culture across warehouse and transport operations.
* Ensure statutory compliance related to warehousing and transportation activities.

**People Management**

* Lead DC warehouse executive, warehouse supervisors, operational teams, and outsourced manpower.
* Develop capability-building plans and training programs.
* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and operational discipline.
* Drive employee engagement and performance management initiatives.

**Digital & Continuous Improvement**

* Support Digital DC initiatives and automation projects.
* Drive dashboard governance, KPI visibility, and operational reviews.
* Lead process improvement projects to improve service, productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Champion digital adoption and data-driven decision-making across operations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Day 0 Dispatch %
* Dispatch Compliance

**Operations**

* Warehouse Productivity
* Throughput
* Loadability
* MHE Utilization
* Inventory Accuracy
* Buffer Compliance
* Detention
* POD Compliance
* TAT
* DOT

**Safety**

* Near Miss Reporting Rate
* Unsafe Act / Unsafe Condition Closure %
* Forklift/MHE Safety Compliance %

**Cost**

* Logistics Cost vs Budget
* Productivity Savings

**Qualification & Experience**
**Education**

* Graduate/Postgraduate in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, Operations Management, or related discipline.

**Experience**

* 5-8 years of experience in Warehousing, Logistics, Distribution, or Supply Chain Operations.
* Experience in FMCG, Consumer Goods, Retail, or 3PL operations preferred.
* Hands-on experience managing warehouses, transportation, inventory, and service providers.

**Technical Skills**

* SAP / ERP knowledge
* Advanced Excel and Power BI
* Warehouse Management Systems (WMS)
* Inventory Management
* Data Analytics and Dashboard Reporting

**Leadership Competencies**

* Customer Focus
* Operational Excellence
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management

* Team Leadership
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset.

title: Retail Store Manager
description:

title: TECHOPS-SAP-SA-SeniorManager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Senior Manager to join our TechOps team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. We are seeking a highly accomplished and experienced S4 CoE (Center of Excellence)/ AMS- Application Management Support Lead with 10-15 years of experience to spearhead the management and coordination of various SAP functional modules and IT governance activities within our support organization. The ideal candidate will be setting up and managing leading a team of SAP and Non- SAP support analysts responsible for FICO, MM, SD, PP, EPPM, Basis, MDM, Logical Access and integration functions, ensuring seamless operations, alignment with organizational goals, setting up the organization from scratch, developing policies, procedures, and KPIs, and driving innovation through their extensive expertise. L1, L2, L3 support, WRICEFs, Release management and system monitoring and integration platform support are in his/her scope. Strong FICO hands-on experience, Private Could – SAP on RISE experience, excellent communication skills and managing stakeholders is a must.

* People Management: Effectively lead the team with diverse skills and backgrounds and foster an innovative and inclusive team-oriented work environment.
* Delivery Management: Participate in large scale SAP client engagements. Consistently deliver quality client services, driving high-quality work products within the expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress, manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes. Manage expectations of client service delivery. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business. Should be a self-starter with excellent verbal and written communication skills. Should be comfortable interfacing with a client on a daily basis. This role requires daily interaction with the client at many levels.
* Support and Training : Address `How to questions` and provide L1 support, hand holding activities to the users wherever required, conduct training need assessment members and planning and delivery of these trainings.

* Policy and Procedure Development: Develop and implement comprehensive policies and procedures for SAP operations, ensuring adherence to industry best practices and organizational standards.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Define, track, and manage key performance indicators for the SAP CoE and functional modules, ensuring alignment with business goals and continuous improvement.
* Team Leadership: Provide guidance, mentorship, and performance management to a diverse team of SAP analysts, fostering a collaborative and results-oriented work environment.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements, align SAP strategies with business goals, and deliver effective solutions.
* Project Management: Lead SAP projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, and effective resource allocation to achieve project objectives.

* Demonstrate characteristics of a forward thinker and self-starter that thrives on new challenges and adapts quickly to learning new knowledge.
* Ability to lead a team of consulting professionals on multiple projects.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* A Bachelor's or Master’s degree and 15+ years of related work experience at minimum;
* A degree in computer science, accounting, finance or a related field (MBA or Business Undergraduate degree preferred). SAP certification/s highly preferred.
* Excellent leadership and people management skills, with a track record of leading diverse teams for at least 7 years.
* Must have managed 3 to 4 Managed Services or Application Support Engagements
* Excellent understanding of Incident, Service Request, Change Request, Release Management, OCM, Problem Management, Release Management etc.
* At minimum 7 to 10 years of experience working with any of the SAP modules below:-

+ SAP FICO (Finance & Controlling)
+ SAP SD (Sales & Distribution)

+ SAP PS (Project System)

**What We Look For**
**What we look for**

title: Sr. Production Planning Manager
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
  
  
Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.
  
  
**Your Role**
This role is responsible for the end-to-end production planning process at the Jigani manufacturing site. The Production Planning Manager translates demand signals and customer orders into executable manufacturing schedules, coordinates material availability and capacity utilization, and maintains cross-functional alignment across Supply Chain, Production, Procurement, Warehouse, Quality, Engineering, Logistics, and Customer Service to support on-time delivery and inventory performance targets.
  
  
**Key Accountability Area**

* Master Production Scheduling & Material Planning
* Develop and maintain the weekly rolling Master Production Schedule (MPS) for all SKUs.
* Run MRP reviews; align procurement plans and supplier lead times to ensure material availability prior to scheduled production.
* Own SAP PP planning parameters (lot sizing, safety stock, lead times) and master data accuracy (BOM, Routing, Material Master).
* Manage APO / IBP data flow; ensure data integrity and timely updates.
* Capacity Planning & Schedule Adherence
* Conduct Rough-Cut Capacity Planning (RCCP) to identify bottleneck constraints and support production commitments.
* Monitor and analyse Schedule Adherence; identify root causes and coordinate corrective actions.
* Incorporate maintenance shutdown windows and engineering changeovers into the production schedule.
* Track capacity utilisation (RCCP Loading %) and report to site management.
* Supply Review & Cross-functional Planning Alignment
* Coordinate the monthly supply review process; prepare supply-demand netting, order status, and inventory summary for cross-functional discussion.
* Track and follow up on actions agreed in supply review meetings; ensure timely closure of open items.
* Establish NPI planning checkpoints (material confirmation and capacity confirmation) prior to new product introduction.
* Maintain alignment between supply plan and downstream stakeholders including Trading SC, Warehouse, QC, and Customer Service.
* Inventory Strategy & Aging / E&O Management
* Monitor site inventory health; track aging inventory and Excess & Obsolescence (E&O) status.
* Define safety stock levels and buffer strategies to balance service level with inventory cost.
* Coordinate resolution of backlog orders and surplus materials in alignment with relevant stakeholders.
* Work with Finance to ensure inventory targets are aligned with site financial objectives.
* Cross-functional Coordination & Stakeholder Communication
* Serve as the planning interface between Commercial, Production, Procurement, Warehouse, Quality, and Logistics.
* Communicate supply risks, capacity constraints, and recovery plans to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.
* Support NPI product introductions by confirming material and capacity readiness prior to launch.
* Participate in cross-functional meetings and provide planning input to support business decisions.
* Team Development & Process Improvement
* Develop the local planning team's capability in system usage (SAP MM/PP/SD, APO/IBP) and planning methodology.
* Identify and implement process improvements to increase planning accuracy, schedule adherence, and inventory performance.
* Ensure planning platforms and dashboards are actively maintained and used as decision-support tools.
* Establish clear accountabilities, issue-tracking practices, and follow-up discipline within the planning team.

**Who You Are**

* Education: Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Chemistry, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience.
* Experience: 10 to 15 years in production planning, supply planning, or manufacturing planning within the chemical or life science industries, managing complex, multi-SKU portfolios.
* MRP / MPS: Strong command of Material Requirements Planning and Master Production Scheduling; proven ability to translate demand plans into executable manufacturing schedules.
* SAP proficiency: Hands-on experience with SAP ERP / S/4HANA, SAP APO, or SAP IBP; able to manage planning parameters, BOM/Routing validation, and system data independently.
* Data & analytics: Advanced Microsoft Excel; experience with Power BI or equivalent tools for data visualisation and KPI reporting.
* Analytical thinking: Ability to analyse demand patterns, model capacity scenarios, and identify root causes of supply or inventory issues using data.
* Business acumen: Understanding of P&L impact, cash-flow implications of inventory, and customer service priorities; able to connect planning decisions to business outcomes.

description:

Location:
  
  
Bangalore,IND

Position Summary
  
  
The Supplier Business Manager (SBM) is responsible for driving operational excellence and supplier performance across the Advanced Materials supply base, including Ceramics, Graphite, Quartz, and related engineered materials. The role partners closely with Supplier Account Managers (SAMs), Engineering, Quality, Planning, and Business Units to ensure supplier readiness, capacity, quality, cost competitiveness, and delivery performance.
  
  
This position is designed as a development path toward a future Supplier Account Manager role, with increasing exposure to supplier strategy, qualification, commercial engagement, and supply chain risk management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Supplier Performance & Relationship Management
  
  

* Manage day-to-day engagement with assigned suppliers and key sub-tier suppliers.
* Drive supplier performance against Quality, Cost, Delivery, Capacity, and Lead Time (QCDCL) metrics.
* Lead supplier business reviews and performance improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary operational escalation point for supplier issues.

Supplier Development & Qualification
  
  

* Support identification, assessment, qualification, and development of new suppliers.
* Partner with Engineering and Quality teams on supplier qualification activities.
* Conduct supplier capability, capacity, and risk assessments.
* Support supplier localization and ecosystem development initiatives.

Capacity & Supply Continuity
  
  

* Lead supplier capacity readiness and recovery programs.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain, capacity, and continuity risks.
* Drive actions to improve resilience and support business growth.

Cost & Commercial Support
  
  

* Support cost reduction, productivity, and value engineering initiatives.
* Assist with supplier negotiations through market intelligence and benchmarking.
* Provide analytical support for supplier reviews and business cases.

Project & Strategy Execution
  
  

* Lead supplier-related projects aligned with commodity and sourcing strategies.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to resolve systemic supply chain challenges.
* Support execution of supplier development, qualification, and capacity expansion programs.

**Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Materials, Ceramics, Manufacturing, Production, or related Engineering discipline.
* 7+ years of experience in Supplier Management, Supplier Development, Sourcing, Procurement, Manufacturing, or Supply Chain.
* Experience managing supplier performance, qualification, capacity planning, and operational escalations.
* Strong project management, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to influence cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment.
* Experience with Advanced Materials, Precision Manufacturing, Semiconductor, Aerospace, or Industrial Supply Chains preferred.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings and manufacturing processes.

Growth Opportunity
  
  
This role provides a structured pathway to a
**Supplier Account Manager (SAM)**
position within 1-2 years through progressive exposure to:
  
  

* Supplier and commodity strategy
* Executive supplier relationship management
* Commercial negotiations and contracting
* New supplier sourcing and qualification
* Market intelligence and risk management
* Advanced Materials supply chain leadership

A successful candidate will develop the strategic, commercial, and operational skills required to assume broader SAM responsibilities.
  
  
**Additional Information**
**Time Type:**
Full time
  
  
**Employee Type:**
Assignee / Regular
  
  
**Travel:**
Yes, 20% of the Time
  
  
**Relocation Eligible:**
Yes

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

title: Associate Director - Product Mgt - Resilient Operations
description:
**About the Team:**
Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.
  
  
Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The  Associate Director Resilient Operations is a pivotal and strategic role within our Global Supply Chain Digital & Tech (GSC D&T) site tech Resilient Operations team, tasked with driving key initiatives that enhance operational resilience, efficiency, and innovation across the global supply chain. This role focuses on the implementation and improvements of tools and services ex: Service now for Operational Technology (OT), ensuring we standardize and optimize critical service management processes for asset inventory, incident management, change management and risk and vulnerability management. This leader will play a vital role in bridging the gap between IT and OT systems, enabling seamless integration and consistent service management practices across diverse environments.
  
  
This individual will serve as Service Manager for GSC D&T, ensuring the service management framework is robust, effective, and aligned with the ITIL best practices and GSK’s strategic and compliance standards. This includes establishing key performance metrics, monitoring system performance, and ensuring operational incidents are managed efficiently and escalated appropriately when required.
  
  
The role will require strong collaboration with cross-functional teams, including local and global Engineering teams, the ServiceNow Product Team, and other stakeholders, to drive operational improvements and deliver consistent, high-quality service experiences across GSK’s global supply chain. By leveraging advanced technologies such as gen AI and data-driven insights, this individual will also focus on accelerating incident resolution, identifying root causes, and implementing proactive measures to prevent future disruptions.
  
  
With a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement, problem solving (like DMAIC) ( Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) innovation, and collaboration, this individual will identify and implement process enhancements that strengthen GSK’s resilience to industry challenges and evolving business needs. This role requires a deep understanding of ServiceNow, operational technology systems, crisis management and IT service management practices, alongside strong leadership skills to guide teams, manage stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Crisis Management Process**

* Own the Crisis Management Process.
* Define, introduce and dry-run the Crisis Management Process with respective stakeholders in GSC and in the matrix with Tech Infrastructure (DPTF) (Digital Platforms & Technology Foundations) and CISO (Chief Information Security Officer function) organization.

**IT Service Management**

* Develop and roll out a new IT service-management governance for GSC D&T (Digital & Tech) that aligns with ITIL best practices and GSK standards.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security standards during ServiceNow implementation and operations.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams (local and global) and the ServiceNow Product Team to ensure continued integration on IT and OT (Operational Technology) asset resilience.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security standards during ServiceNow-orchestrated operations.
* Act as the key point of contact for service-management practices, ensuring efficient coordination across product teams and central ITSM teams.
* Develop and maintain key performance metrics to monitor system performance and operational support, ensuring they meet or exceed expectations.
* Define outcomes for the OT service-management product, not only implementation milestones, and validate the value on a pilot before wider roll-out.
* Ensure critical incidents are escalated promptly to senior management and relevant stakeholders, providing clear and concise updates on status and resolution efforts.
* Develop and distribute a monthly stakeholder report summarizing key achievements, upcoming initiatives, and any critical issues.
* Integrate processes, tools, and innovation (AI) around observability in all resilience work for infrastructure, products, and services for GSC.
* Collaborate with the Observability Owner (DPTF), Application Owner, and Technology Teams to introduce the process where it is not implemented.
* Co-create the vision and roadmap for resilient operations and products with the business, and own value cases, including expected benefits and how they are measured.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Identify, plan, and implement process improvements to enhance the resilience and efficiency of global supply-chain operations.
* Leverage advanced technologies such as gen AI to accelerate incident resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Lead Resilience (matrixed) team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modeling responsible use and following GSK Responsible AI, privacy, and security requirements.
* Scan emerging service-management and OT-security capabilities, bring a ranked opportunity list into planning, and work with architects to shape design trade-offs.
* Create comprehensive process documentation and a training program for staff to ensure consistent application of new procedures.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Information Technology, Manufacturing Systems, or related technical discipline.
* Minimum 8+ year of professional experience and at least 3 years in similar service management role.
* Experience in implementing and managing ServiceNow capabilities.
* Experience in working with ServiceNow in OT environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master's Degree.
* Advanced degree (MS/MBA) in a related field is a plus.
* Orange Belt certified in Lean / Six Sigma principles.
* ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Foundation certificate.

Working closely with the founder and internal teams, the selected candidate will establish accountability, improve client satisfaction, optimize processes, and contribute to the agency's revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations & Process Management**

* Lead weekly internal team meetings to review progress, resolve challenges, and align priorities.
* Monitor client performance reports to identify significant changes in revenue, paid traffic, organic traffic, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct sprint planning and review meetings to ensure timely task execution and adherence to workflows in ClickUp.
* Coordinate with the founder to review operational performance, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Participate in client meetings to assess service quality, review deliverables, and ensure client expectations are met.
* Act as the primary escalation point for client issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.

* Identify workflow improvement opportunities and implement automation using Zapier, Slack, ClickUp, or equivalent platforms.

**2. Team Management & Performance Enablement**

* Ensure new employees complete onboarding, role-specific training, and assessments before independently handling deliverables.
* Develop structured assessments and evaluation frameworks to measure employee knowledge, skills, and role readiness.
* Coordinate with HR and team leads to ensure timely completion of employee performance reviews.
* Establish clear performance goals, accountability measures, and productivity benchmarks across teams.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and team performance.
* Support team leads in improving coordination, resource utilization, and delivery quality.

**3. Sales, Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Collaborate with the lead generation team to strengthen the sales pipeline and improve prospect conversion.
* Work with the founder on sales calls, prospect meetings, presentations, proposals, and business development initiatives.
* Independently identify and approach potential clients through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a personal sales pipeline to generate new business opportunities and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Establish and manage structured CRM processes for lead tracking, follow-ups, pipeline management, and conversion reporting.
* Develop lead-nurturing strategies through email marketing and consistent follow-ups to re-engage prospects.
* Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new service offerings, and alternative revenue streams.
* Explore industry awards, recognitions, and other initiatives to strengthen the agency's brand positioning and credibility.

**4. Freelancer & Resource Management**

* Identify and engage skilled freelancers through professional networks, industry communities, Fiverr, Upwork, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of specialized external resources to support project requirements.
* Prepare job descriptions, project briefs, and scope requirements for freelance assignments.
* Coordinate resource allocation based on project timelines, client requirements, and business priorities.
* Evaluate freelancers based on expertise, reliability, work quality, and ability to meet deadlines.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
* **Prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency is essential.**
* MBA preferred; candidates with relevant experience and strong business acumen may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, account management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, lead conversion, and revenue generation.
* Experience managing CRM systems, sales pipelines, client relationships, and prospect follow-ups.
* Hands-on familiarity with project management and automation tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Zapier, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to interpret client performance reports, identify potential risks, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Process-driven mindset with the ability to establish scalable systems and improve operational efficiency.
* Willingness to take ownership of both operational responsibilities and independent business development.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Consistent execution of internal workflows, sprint plans, and operational processes.
* Timely delivery of client commitments and effective resolution of escalations.
* Improved client satisfaction, service quality, and adherence to agreed SoWs.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Timely completion of employee onboarding, training, assessments, and performance reviews.
* Effective resource allocation, team productivity, and operational accountability.
* Implementation of structured CRM processes, consistent follow-ups, and improved pipeline visibility.
* Generation of qualified business opportunities, improved lead conversion, and contribution to revenue growth.

title: GDS Meetings and Events - M and E Program Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
  
  
**Job title:**
GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager
  
  
**Function:**
Ernst & Young Global Services – Supply Chain Services
  
  
**Role Summary**
The
**GDS Meetings and Events Program Manager**
is a highly responsible role who will oversee Meetings and Events related spend and support M&E program activities across GDS locations globally. The role will act as a key day-to-day point of contact for GDS stakeholders on program management, operational requirements, reporting, supplier performance, and process improvement initiatives supporting the Global M&E program.
  
  
The role will work closely with Meetings & Events colleagues, suppliers, internal business stakeholders, procurement, finance and other enabling teams to promote M&E policies, guidelines and procedures, drive compliance, improve stakeholder experience and support cost-saving opportunities.
  
  
The successful candidate will be expected to operate independently, influence stakeholders across levels and geographies, and contribute to the broader purpose and objectives of EY’s Travel, Meetings & Events program.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Program management and stakeholder partnership**

* Be the primary point of contact for GDS stakeholders on M&E program management, operational queries, reporting requirements and policy guidance.
* Support senior stakeholders across GDS locations and provide guidance on Meetings & Events related matters, ensuring alignment with global program objectives.
* Promote the values, objectives and strategy of the Meetings & Events program and broader procurement function in all stakeholder interactions.
* Influence change and support the implementation of the Global M&E strategy across relevant GDS locations and business groups.

**Event operations, sourcing and supplier management**

* Oversee and support venue sourcing, event planning and supplier engagement for GDS meetings and events, ensuring solutions are aligned to stakeholder requirements and business needs.
* Be the escalation point for supplier-related matters and help maintain strong supplier relationships through performance monitoring, policy alignment and contractual delivery.
* Support M&E related RFPs, vendor onboarding, supplier renewals and other procurement activities as required.

**Policy, compliance and governance**

* Promote and support compliance with EY’s Meetings & Events policies, Supply Chain Services policy, corporate meetings policy, procurement policy and related procedures.
* Ensure compliance with EY standardised meeting contracts, addendums, framework agreements and relevant internal processes.
* Review business compliance with the overall M&E program, including BRIDGE, Independence, Finance and Procurement processes.
* Influence policy and standards relating to M&E spend, including venue, meals, agencies and related event categories.
* Support adoption of viable process solutions aligned with global standards, including process governance and operational controls.

**Financial management, reporting and performance**

* Help prepare initial and final event or meeting budgets and support cost management throughout the event lifecycle.
* Drive cost efficiencies and supplier negotiations, ensuring value-add opportunities are reviewed and exhausted where applicable.
* Review data reporting, identify cost-saving opportunities and present relevant insights to stakeholders.
* Manage and report key performance indicators to monitor program effectiveness, supplier performance and operational efficiency

**Process improvement and global alignment**

* Lead and support GDS M&E projects, including expansion of the M&E catalogue across GDS locations and harmonisation of processes with global teams
* Identify and recommend best practices by networking with Travel Management Company colleagues, venue sourcing teams, suppliers and industry peers.
* Contribute ideas and best practices to improve M&E processes, stakeholder experience and program efficiency.
* Support use of relevant M&E tools and intake channels, including Cvent and other internal systems, to ensure event requests are accurately assigned and managed.

**Teaming and leadership**

* Work closely with direct reports, M&E support personnel and extended support teams to deliver consistent program outcomes.
* Provide guidance to meeting requestors, meeting planners, third-party providers and internal stakeholders on program requirements and event execution
* Demonstrate strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills when working with senior leaders, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

**Supervision Responsibilities**
This role will have responsibility for M&E support personnel and will work closely with the extended M&E support team to support program delivery across GDS locations.
  
  
**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* The ideal candidate will be an effective communicator, self-motivated, detail-oriented and results-driven, with the ability to work independently and engage confidently with stakeholders at all levels of seniority.
* The candidate should demonstrate strong organisational skills, the ability to prioritise effectively, commercial awareness, attention to detail, calmness under pressure and a passion for delivering high-quality event and program outcomes
* The role requires strong stakeholder management, supplier management, analytical thinking, process improvement orientation and the ability to support change across a complex, global and cross-cultural environment.

**Education**

* Fluent written and spoken English language skills are required
* A degree in Business, Hospitality, Travel, Procurement or a related discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
* Additional Asian language skills may be beneficial for broader regional stakeholder engagement, although they are not mandatory.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant corporate experience managing Meetings & Events programs or working in a senior role in the travel, hospitality, meeting planning, venue sourcing, destination management or travel management industry.
* Experience managing large, complex events or M&E programs in a multinational, service-focused or cross-cultural environment is highly beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, is required.
* Experience with Cvent, meeting intake tools, data reporting, Power BI, Power Platform, Ariba or related procurement and event technology platforms will be an added advantage.

**Job Requirements**
Due to the global nature of EY, the candidate will be expected to work flexibly with colleagues in person and virtually across multiple time zones.
  
  
A stable and reliable home internet connection is required for effective remote teaming, and the role may require working from the EY GDS office in India, based on local policies.
  
  
Some international travel may be required, and the candidate should have a valid passport or the ability to obtain one. There may also be occasions where work outside regular business hours is required due to collaboration across multiple time zones.
  
  
**What We Look For**
We are looking for a confident, collaborative and commercially minded program manager who can work with senior stakeholders, suppliers and global colleagues to deliver efficient, compliant and high-quality Meetings & Events outcomes. The right candidate will bring a calm-under-pressure mindset, strong ownership, excellent communication skills and the ability to influence change while continuously improving the stakeholder experience.
  
  
**Note**
This job description is intended as a guide to reflect the principal functions of the role. It is not an all-inclusive listing of required responsibilities, and duties may vary depending on business priorities, geographic location and management discretion.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Merchandising Operations Team Lead
description:
**Overview**

**Merchandising Team Lead**

The Team Lead will be part of Merchandising Operations Team where you will leverage your skills and  
business acumen to achieve the organization and team goals.

**About Catalyst Brands:**

Catalyst Brands is a leading U.S.-based retail organization formed in 2025 through the merger of JCPenney and SPARC Group, combining multiple iconic fashion brands under one umbrella. The company manages a diversified portfolio of well-known brands including Aéropostale, Brooks Brothers, Nautica, Lucky Brand, and JCPenney. Headquartered in Plano, Texas, Catalyst Brands focuses on delivering modern retail experiences while leveraging the heritage of established global brands. With a workforce of over tens of thousands and multi-billion-dollar revenue, the organization operates at a large scale across retail, e-commerce, and supply chain domains. The company emphasizes innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies to enhance brand value and consumer engagement. Catalyst Brands is expanding its global presence, including a growing capability centre in India that supports technology, digital operations, and analytics. It aims to drive operational excellence and business growth by integrating technology, data-driven insights, and efficient retail practices.

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and strategic Merchandising Operations Team Lead to oversee and optimize the end-to-end item creation and supplier onboarding processes across multiple business units. This role is critical in enabling seamless inventory execution and digital item setup, directly influencing speedto-market and customer experience.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, cross-functional collaboration, and a deep understanding of merchandise operations, item lifecycle management, and retail systems. The role requires interfacing with suppliers, merchants, digital operations, and inventory teams to ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and flawless execution in JCPenney’s ecosystem.

Job Functions:  

* 6 to 8 years of experience in Retail and Merchandising – Item Set Up, Category management and

catalogue management  

* Communicates with various levels of management including merchandising managers, buyers,

assistant buyers and merchandising assistants

Key Responsibilities:  

* Builds and Elevates Team Capability: Champions the development of team members through hands-on

mentoring, continuous feedback, and targeted skill-building initiatives. Cultivates bench strength to ensure  
organizational agility, succession readiness, and long-term team sustainability.  

* Operational Leadership & Workflow Excellence: Establishes and enforces standardized workflows to

streamline execution and ensure consistent delivery of high-volume, time-sensitive operational tasks.  

* Support Services & SLA Management: Leads the team in providing exceptional user support by defining,

monitoring, and continuously improving Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Identifies skill and knowledge gaps,  
driving the creation of training programs that elevate team performance and reduce support friction.  

* Strategic Ownership of Item Creation: Lead the team responsible for execution of the item setup process for

both owned and factory-ship assortments. Ensure flawless execution and integration of orderable and sellable  
attributes in alignment with divisional goals, merchandise strategies, and omnichannel readiness.  

* Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as a liaison between merchants, planning teams, and suppliers to ensure

alignment on timelines, data requirements, and setup accuracy. Drive accountability across business units to  
meet critical milestones for new item rollouts.  

* Supplier Enablement & Communication: Establish strong supplier partnerships to ensure timely

submission of item setup data and compliance with JCPenney standards. Own post-setup supplier  
communication including image submissions, content updates, and inventory availability.  

* Process Optimization: Continuously assess and refine item setup workflows and systems to reduce cycle

time, eliminate errors, and improve scalability. Proactively identify bottlenecks and implement process  
improvements in partnership with IT and business stakeholders.  

* Digital Operations Integration: Lead the collaboration with the Digital Operations team to ensure readiness

for content deployment, image processing, and inventory loading into the eCommerce platform.  

* Data Accuracy & Governance: Ensure all forms and data captured during the item setup phase are validated

and accurate. Implement processes and controls to maintain high data integrity across JCPenney’s ERP and  
digital systems. Build and lead strong governance over item readiness for online and in-store visibility.

Minimum Requirements:
