title: Associate Director - Product Mgt - Resilient Operations
description:
**About the Team:**

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

  

Enterprise Systems Management & Business Operations delivers digital solutions that support Enterprise Systems running as a high-performing organization. This team drives financial discipline, operational rigour and strategic alignment across the ES portfolio that safeguard GSK’s integrity and reputation globally. By joining this team, you’ll help shape systems that support thousands of employees worldwide, driving innovation and reliability in the tools that keep GSK moving forward.

**Job Purpose:**

The Associate Director Resilient Operations is a pivotal and strategic role within our Global Supply Chain Digital & Tech (GSC D&T) site tech Resilient Operations team, tasked with driving key initiatives that enhance operational resilience, efficiency, and innovation across the global supply chain. This role focuses on the implementation and improvements of tools and services ex: Service now for Operational Technology (OT), ensuring we standardize and optimize critical service management processes for asset inventory, incident management, change management and risk and vulnerability management. This leader will play a vital role in bridging the gap between IT and OT systems, enabling seamless integration and consistent service management practices across diverse environments.

This individual will serve as Service Manager for GSC D&T, ensuring the service management framework is robust, effective, and aligned with the ITIL best practices and GSK’s strategic and compliance standards. This includes establishing key performance metrics, monitoring system performance, and ensuring operational incidents are managed efficiently and escalated appropriately when required.

The role will require strong collaboration with cross-functional teams, including local and global Engineering teams, the ServiceNow Product Team, and other stakeholders, to drive operational improvements and deliver consistent, high-quality service experiences across GSK’s global supply chain. By leveraging advanced technologies such as gen AI and data-driven insights, this individual will also focus on accelerating incident resolution, identifying root causes, and implementing proactive measures to prevent future disruptions.

With a commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement, problem solving (like DMAIC) ( Define, Measure, Analyze, Improve, Control) innovation, and collaboration, this individual will identify and implement process enhancements that strengthen GSK’s resilience to industry challenges and evolving business needs. This role requires a deep understanding of ServiceNow, operational technology systems, crisis management and IT service management practices, alongside strong leadership skills to guide teams, manage stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Crisis Management Process**

  

* Own the Crisis Management Process.
* Define, introduce and dry-run the Crisis Management Process with respective stakeholders in GSC and in the matrix with Tech Infrastructure (DPTF) (Digital Platforms & Technology Foundations) and CISO (Chief Information Security Officer function) organization.

**IT Service Management**

  

* Develop and roll out a new IT service-management governance for GSC D&T (Digital & Tech) that aligns with ITIL best practices and GSK standards.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security standards during ServiceNow implementation and operations.
* Collaborate with Engineering teams (local and global) and the ServiceNow Product Team to ensure continued integration on IT and OT (Operational Technology) asset resilience.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and security standards during ServiceNow-orchestrated operations.
* Act as the key point of contact for service-management practices, ensuring efficient coordination across product teams and central ITSM teams.
* Develop and maintain key performance metrics to monitor system performance and operational support, ensuring they meet or exceed expectations.
* Define outcomes for the OT service-management product, not only implementation milestones, and validate the value on a pilot before wider roll-out.
* Ensure critical incidents are escalated promptly to senior management and relevant stakeholders, providing clear and concise updates on status and resolution efforts.
* Develop and distribute a monthly stakeholder report summarizing key achievements, upcoming initiatives, and any critical issues.
* Integrate processes, tools, and innovation (AI) around observability in all resilience work for infrastructure, products, and services for GSC.
* Collaborate with the Observability Owner (DPTF), Application Owner, and Technology Teams to introduce the process where it is not implemented.
* Co-create the vision and roadmap for resilient operations and products with the business, and own value cases, including expected benefits and how they are measured.

**Continuous Improvement**

  

* Identify, plan, and implement process improvements to enhance the resilience and efficiency of global supply-chain operations.
* Leverage advanced technologies such as gen AI to accelerate incident resolution and root-cause analysis.
* Lead Resilience (matrixed) team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modeling responsible use and following GSK Responsible AI, privacy, and security requirements.
* Scan emerging service-management and OT-security capabilities, bring a ranked opportunity list into planning, and work with architects to shape design trade-offs.
* Create comprehensive process documentation and a training program for staff to ensure consistent application of new procedures.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Information Technology, Manufacturing Systems, or related technical discipline.
* Minimum 8+ year of professional experience and at least 3 years in similar service management role.
* Experience in implementing and managing ServiceNow capabilities.
* Experience in working with ServiceNow in OT environments.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Master's Degree.
* Advanced degree (MS/MBA) in a related field is a plus.
* Orange Belt certified in Lean / Six Sigma principles.
* ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library) Foundation certificate.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Security Controls, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

title: Executive Director - Global Confirmations & RCO Data Exchange Operations
description:

title: Global Billing Operations - Emerging Lead
description:

The Invoice Review Associate will be responsible for certain aspects of the invoice billing process, such as invoice raising, OOPS (Out of Pocket Expenses) invoicing, and invoice review across State Street global businesses spread across countries & regions.

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Campus Facility Manager
description:
**Recruiting for: CAMPUS FACILITY COORDINATOR (Multiple positions for our campuses in South Bengaluru)**  
**Recruited by: Sri Kumaran Children’s Home Educational Council | Bengaluru**

About the Sri Kumaran Group of Institutions

The Sri Kumaran Group of Institutions is one of South Bengaluru’s oldest and largest school groups. It has grown over six decades and four generations of family stewardship from a single SSLC building at Tata Silk Farm. Today it educates about 8,300 students across seven campuses under the State, CBSE and ICSE boards. Our values are Sincerity, Kinship, Commitment and Integrity, and Harmony. A school of this size is also a substantial physical estate, and safe, clean, well-run campuses are part of what parents trust us with. You can find more information about us at www.kumarans.org.

Reports to: Deputy Director, with a secondary reporting line to the campus Principals

About the role  
The Facility Coordinator owns campus readiness. They ensure the campus is safe, secure, clean, compliant, and ready every working day, and that it recovers quickly and orderly when something fails. The role leads the campus support workforce: housekeeping, maintenance and gardening staff, and outsourced service providers. It supervises qualified contractors and ensures each problem is fixed properly. You don’t need to be a technical expert in every system. You do need to check things personally, keep accurate records and escalate promptly.

Key responsibilities

· **Campus readiness:** Run opening and closing rounds every day: classrooms, toilets, drinking water, essential systems, fire exits and security posts. Barricade or isolate any hazard before students arrive.

· **Support staff:** Brief and deploy housekeeping, maintenance and gardening teams. Assign each zone to a named person, manage rosters and cover, train staff, and maintain discipline fairly and respectfully.

· **Maintenance:** Run a preventive-maintenance calendar and a defect register. Carry out pre- and post-monsoon inspections, use vacations for major works, and supervise civil and engineering repairs.

· **Safety and compliance:** Keep fire NOCs, electrical and lift certification, water testing, pest control, food safety, barrier-free access and insurance current through a compliance calendar.

· **Security:** Oversee the security agency, gate and visitor control, CCTV and key control. Support safe arrival and dispersal with the transport team.

· **Emergencies:** Keep the campus ready for fire, medical, utility and security emergencies. Run drills and act as ground coordinator during incidents under the Principal’s lead.

· **Stores and procurement:** Maintain asset and inventory registers, compare vendor proposals on quality and total cost, inspect deliveries, and manage lawful scrap disposal.

· **Vendors:** Manage outsourced services against agreed scopes and service levels. Verify manpower, check invoices against work actually done, and track AMCs and renewals.

· **Utilities and events:** Monitor and reduce electricity, water and fuel use. Plan the facilities and logistics for examinations, sports days, annual days and other large events.

What we’re looking for

· A graduate qualification. A technical, engineering, administration or facilities-management background is an advantage.

· At least 10 years in facilities, estates, administration, engineering support, security or institutional operations, including at least 5 years running a site and supervising a support workforce.

· Experience in a large institutional, campus, hospital, hotel, industrial or cantonment environment is strongly desirable.

· Working English for reporting, and fluent Kannada and/or Hindi for directing on-site staff.

· Comfortable with MS Excel, Word and digital ticketing or facilities-management systems.

· A safety-first mindset, the habit of checking personally rather than accepting a verbal assurance, integrity in procurement and stores, and calm judgement under pressure.

· Physically fit for daily walking inspections across the campus, and available beyond school hours for emergencies, examinations and events.

Retired Armed Forces personnel are strongly encouraged to apply, particularly those with Quartermaster, unit or station administration, ASC, AOC, EME, MES or Defence Security Corps experience.

What we offer

· Salary commensurate with experience and competence, with all relevant benefits

· A key safety role in a respected institution with six decades of history

· Professional growth through KATALYST, Kumarans’ competency-based development framework for operations staff

How to apply  
Send your CV and cover letter to humanresources@kumarans.org with the subject line “Campus Facility Coordinator”. We’ll share the detailed job description with shortlisted candidates.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Global End-to-End Onboarding Operations Support Lead
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.

Within Group People & Culture, we are establishing a global End-to-End Onboarding Competence and Support Center to create a connected, intuitive, and scalable experience for new colleagues, hiring managers, and P&C teams. Join us to help countries operate and continuously improve onboarding across Volvo Group.

**What you will do**
--------------------

Based in India, you will lead the operational support, monitoring, coordination, and continuous stabilization of global onboarding, from preboarding through the subsequent onboarding journey. You will report functionally to the Global Head of People Operations & Experience.

* Provide practical functional support to country P&C teams, hiring managers, and other users; investigate issues, coordinate resolution, and maintain clear escalation paths.
* Maintain onboarding journeys, task libraries, templates, guidance, knowledge articles, and country-specific content within the agreed governance model.
* Monitor adoption, outstanding activities, data quality, recurring issues, and service indicators; turn operational data into clear insights and follow-up actions.
* Support country readiness, testing, training, rollout, and hypercare, working closely with the Global Process & Deployment Lead and local P&C Solution teams.
* Coordinate functional readiness for releases and ensure documentation, communications, and operational support are updated before changes go live.
* Use feedback and service data to identify root causes and propose improvements to processes, journeys, configuration, documentation, and user support.
* Connect countries with the Global Center team in Poland, Stable Teams, Product Owners, P&C Digitalization, and HR technology teams.
* Simplify recurring work before automating it and explore responsible AI and self-service opportunities that improve user experience and service performance.

**Who are you?**
----------------

You combine a strong service mindset with operational discipline and curiosity about how work can be improved. You manage details without losing sight of the complete onboarding journey, follow issues through to resolution, and communicate clearly across countries, functions, and technology teams.

You bring:

* Relevant experience in People Operations, shared services, employee lifecycle support, or a related field.
* Experience supporting global or multi-country processes, users, and stakeholders.
* Strong service-management skills, including issue investigation, resolution coordination, escalation, and operational follow-up.
* Experience maintaining process documentation, knowledge content, user guidance, or country-specific information.
* The ability to monitor operational performance and translate data, feedback, and recurring cases into actionable improvements.
* Strong organization, communication, and stakeholder-management skills in a global matrix environment.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Experience with SuccessFactors Onboarding or Preboarding, case management, release coordination, journey mapping, Agile delivery, automation, analytics, or AI is an advantage.

**What’s in it for you?**
-------------------------

* An opportunity to shape the operational foundation of a global onboarding experience and make a tangible difference for new colleagues, hiring managers, and P&C teams.
* An international, cross-functional assignment connecting India, Poland, and country teams.
* The chance to combine service delivery, user experience, continuous improvement, and digital innovation in one role.

**Ready for the next move?**
----------------------------

If you want to make onboarding support simpler, more connected, and more valuable for the people who use it, we look forward to hearing from you. Bring your service mindset, curiosity, and ideas to Group People & Culture.

**Location:** India; Bangalore.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

**Who we are and what we believe in**  
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.

At **Group People & Culture**, a part of Volvo Group, we create the foundation and frameworks for people growth and organizational development, to drive the people agenda that enables the realization of the Volvo Group aspirations through people strategy and commitment. You will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

title: Production Manager
description:
Impaqt Robotics is at the forefront of industrial automation, developing intelligent robotic systems and modular automation solutions for manufacturing and logistics. Our mission is to simplify robotic deployment through robust software, smart hardware design, and production-ready systems. As we expand our robotics platform, we are building core capabilities in motion planning, manipulation, and intelligent automation.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on Production Manager to lead shop-floor operations and production planning and control (PPC). You will manage two assembly technicians and one QC inspector, taking ownership of production planning, assembly, quality control and shipment readiness.

You will translate customer orders into achievable build plans, coordinate material availability, maintain a safe and organised production floor, and ensure finished systems are tested and ready for dispatch. This role requires close collaboration with engineering, procurement and logistics teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Team leadership:**
  Lead, schedule and develop two assembly technicians and one QC inspector. Set daily priorities, train the team on standard operating procedures (SOPs) and review performance.
* **Production planning:**
  Develop and execute weekly production and service plans. Track capacity, material availability and delivery commitments.
* **Shop-floor management:**
  Manage production layout, 5S, housekeeping, tools, materials and safety compliance. Conduct regular audits to maintain shop-floor discipline.
* **Engineering-to-production handover:**
  Interpret engineering bills of materials (BOMs) and CAD assemblies, validate BOM completeness and buildability, upload BOMs into Odoo ERP, and translate engineering requirements into clear SOPs and work instructions.
* **Assembly and testing:**
  Own assembly from kitting through final testing. Work with engineering to develop and maintain jigs and fixtures, and ensure their consistent use to achieve repeatable, right-first-time assembly.
* **Quality control:**
  Own incoming, semi-finished and finished-goods quality control, including inspection standards, checklists and acceptance criteria.
* **Vendor development and coordination:**
  Support purchasing in assessing new vendors’ technical capabilities and approving samples and first articles. Follow up on component delivery and quality.
* **Shipment readiness:**
  Coordinate with logistics to ensure finished systems are ready for shipment in line with agreed delivery dates.
* **Process documentation:**
  Develop and maintain SOPs for production planning, assembly, inspection and dispatch.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.E., B.Tech or Diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Production or Industrial Engineering.
* 6–10 years of shop-floor experience in manufacturing.
* At least 2 years of direct supervisory experience managing technicians or inspectors.
* Strong manufacturing fundamentals, including machining processes, fits and tolerances, assembly practices and engineering drawing interpretation.
* Ability to interpret engineering BOMs and CAD assemblies and translate them into practical build instructions.
* Demonstrated experience implementing 5S and maintaining shop-floor discipline, developing or qualifying vendors, and building or specifying assembly fixtures.
* Hands-on ERP experience covering BOMs, manufacturing orders, purchasing and inventory. Odoo experience is preferred; experience with SAP, Tally Prime or a comparable system is also suitable.
* Hands-on experience with CNC machining or metal fabrication is required.

**Why Join Us?**

* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Take responsibility for the complete production cycle, from BOM validation and material planning to assembly, testing and shipment readiness.
* **Build automation products for global markets:**
  Contribute to cobot-based products sold through distributors and system integrators in more than 38 countries.
* **Shape how we manufacture:**
  Develop practical SOPs, quality standards and assembly fixtures that improve consistency and make the production floor more effective.
* **Lead a hands-on team:**
  Develop a focused team of technicians and a QC inspector, with a direct impact on build quality and delivery performance.
* **Work across disciplines:**
  Collaborate closely with engineering, procurement and logistics, combining shop-floor problem-solving with production planning and ERP execution.

We welcome applications from motivated candidates with strong fundamentals and a passion for robotics, even if they do not meet every qualification listed.

Apply now to join Impaqt Robotics and help build the next generation of intelligent automation solutions.

****Job Description****
**Who we are looking for**
In this role, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead a team supporting multiple global premier investment management clients. You will have leadership and strategy responsibility to oversee and deliver all day-to-day transactional responsibilities of the transaction management team, with specific consideration given to Exchange Trader Derivatives, in a fast-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Transaction Management team, within Middle Office Services. This Transaction Management Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible for trade confirmation, trade process, trade settlement, and reporting of trade instructions from clients. The team is also responsible for processing directed lending instructions, wire transfers, and trade exceptions. The candidate should be a hands-on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client-initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution solution.
  
  
****What You Will Be Responsible For****

* Oversee and provide day to day management of Transaction Management team in location for responsible client
* Drive transaction management and settlement discipline excellence though proactive management of the trade lifecycle
* Drive transformation initiatives, including automation and process improvements
* Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and manage associated risks.
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Identify, recommend and drive process improvement initiatives
* Conduct high-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.
* Support and proactive manage on Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models
* Communicate effectively on issues / problems to the Client and to SSC management and ensure a proper and timely follow-up to ensure resolution.
* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze on the spot

****What We Value****
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Extensive asset management experience, including investment operations, fund accounting and portfolio valuation
* Deep understanding of the Transaction Lifecycle as it relates to Exchange Traded Derivatives.
* Broad and in-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working in a variety of asset management disciplines.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision-making skills
* Trade and reconciliation break investigations experience
* Strong communication and presentation skills to audiences of different sizes and levels of seniority
* Must be self-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
* Good team working skills.
* Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise.

****Education & Preferred Qualifications****

* Degree in finance, business, technology or equivalent or relevant industry experience
* Proven experience in client communication and interaction at all levels
* In depth understanding of Middle Office operations, preferably Trade Management Operations inclusive of trade confirmation, settlement & reconciliation. Product and Industry knowledge, particularly in Exchange Traded Derivatives, and preferable across – Equity, FI, FX and inclusive of Global Markets.
* Understanding of key technology within the support of investment management operations
* Experience of driving organizational change, with an understanding of change management principles, techniques & tools.
* Experience in leveraging technology solutions including low-code tools, SQL, Python or similar is advantageous
* Strong MS Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint skills necessary
* Strong English written and spoken ability

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Senior Manager WOP
description:
Who are Inchcape
  
  
At Inchcape Shipping Services, our vision is to create a connected world where customers can trade successfully and make informed decisions in every port, everywhere. We achieve this by combining our worldwide infrastructure with local expertise, through our global network of more than 250 proprietary offices and a team of over 3,000 dedicated professionals. Our diverse customer base includes owners and charterers in the oil, cruise, container, and bulk commodity sectors, as well as naval, government, and intergovernmental organizations.
  
  
We have an ambitious growth model, and a career here is certainly going to be a rewarding one that will allow you to bring your skills & experience. We embrace change and are open to new thinking and pushing for positive change in our industry.
  
  
Main Purpose of Job :
  
  

* Lead the World of Ports (WOP) marine data and operational delivery function, acting as the senior maritime subject-matter expert between global Inchcape teams, product, technology and customers.
* Own delivery against KPIs for collection, verification, validation and publication of port, terminal, berth, vessel and marine-operational datasets and APIs, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and operational relevance.
* Translate practical seagoing and port-operational expertise into product requirements, customer use cases and continuous improvements that support safe, efficient and commercially sound maritime decision-making.

Key Accountabilities :
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the WOP marine/data operations team, setting clear standards for performance, quality and professional growth.
* Act as the senior marine subject-matter expert for port, terminal, berth, vessel and cargo operations across WOP products and services.
* Own marine-data governance, validation standards and quality controls to ensure data is operationally credible, consistent and fit for customer use.
* Engage directly with shipowners, operators, charterers, terminals, ports and other customers to understand operational needs and convert feedback into actionable requirements.
* Build strong working relationships across the Inchcape global network to improve source coverage, verification discipline and timeliness of marine information.
* Partner with Product, Technology and Data teams to define specifications, acceptance criteria and priorities for maritime data and digital solutions.
* Provide marine-operational oversight for new datasets, APIs and product features, ensuring outputs reflect real-world shipping and port workflows.
* Use data and domain insight to identify gaps, trends and opportunities, providing clear recommendations that support the WOP product roadmap.
* Manage multiple workstreams and improvement initiatives, balancing operational delivery, customer priorities, risk and strategic objectives.
* Establish and maintain SOPs, controls, documentation and audit trails that strengthen operational resilience and data quality.
* Represent WOP in customer and stakeholder forums, communicate progress to senior management, and support sprint/release readiness from a marine-business perspective.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Demonstrable senior-level maritime experience with strong practical knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo operations and port agency workflows.
* Strong marine assurance and operational risk mindset, with the ability to assess the reliability and operational relevance of maritime information.
* Consistently high data quality, verification and service performance against agreed KPIs and customer expectations.
* Successful conversion of marine-domain knowledge and customer feedback into clear product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Effective leadership of a geographically dispersed team, with measurable improvements in capability, accountability, quality and productivity.
* Trusted engagement with senior internal stakeholders and external maritime customers, supported by clear, credible and concise communication.
* Successful delivery of marine-data, API and digital initiatives in partnership with Product, Technology and Data teams.
* Well-governed processes, SOPs and controls that support traceability, continuous improvement and operational resilience.
* Proactive identification of data gaps, customer pain points and maritime-market opportunities that inform the WOP roadmap and priorities.

Skills and Experience required :
  
  

* Marine Operations Expertise: In-depth knowledge of vessel operations, ports, terminals, berths, cargo handling, port agency processes and ship/shore interfaces.
* Seagoing / Marine Background: Senior officer-level seagoing or equivalent shore-based marine operations experience, with strong practical understanding of shipboard and port operations.
* Marine Assurance & Risk: Sound knowledge of marine assurance, operational risk, HSSE principles and safe operating practices relevant to vessels and terminals.
* Data Governance: Ability to define verification rules, quality controls and governance standards for critical maritime operational data.
* Customer & Stakeholder Engagement: Credible communication with shipowners, operators, charterers, ports, terminals, agents and senior internal stakeholders.
* Product & Business Translation: Ability to convert marine workflows, operational pain points and customer needs into product requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.
* Digital Maritime Transformation: Strong understanding of maritime digitalisation, data platforms, APIs, vessel/port intelligence and technology-enabled operational decision support.
* Team Leadership: Proven ability to lead, coach and develop multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams while setting clear performance standards.
* Project & Delivery Management: Ability to manage concurrent workstreams, priorities, risks, dependencies and delivery milestones in a fast-paced environment.
* Commercial Awareness: Understanding of how reliable port and vessel intelligence supports voyage planning, chartering, operations, demurrage, risk and customer value.
* Analytical Capability: Ability to interpret complex maritime datasets, identify anomalies and trends, and communicate practical insights to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Change & Continuous Improvement: Ability to improve processes, introduce new standards and guide teams through operational and technology change.
* Communication & Reporting: Strong written and verbal communication skills, including senior-management reporting and customer-facing presentations.
* Problem Solving & Judgement: Sound operational judgement with a structured approach to resolving data, process, customer and delivery issues.

Experience :
  
  

* Maritime Experience: Typically 10+ years in shipping, marine operations, ports, terminals, vessel operations or closely related maritime roles.
* Senior Marine Responsibility: Experience at senior officer level at sea (preferably Master Mariner / Chief Engineer / Chief Officer / Second Engineer) or equivalent senior shore-based marine responsibility.
* Port & Terminal Operations: Hands-on exposure to port calls, berth/terminal operations, cargo operations, marine services and ship/shore coordination.
* Marine Assurance: Experience applying marine assurance, HSSE, operational risk or compliance principles in vessel, port or terminal environments.
* Leadership & People Management: Proven experience leading teams, setting standards, managing performance and developing capability.
* Maritime Data / Digital Solutions: Experience using or delivering maritime data, port intelligence, vessel-tracking, API, analytics or other digital shipping solutions.
* Customer Relations: Experience engaging maritime customers and stakeholders, gathering requirements and resolving operational or service issues.
* Product / Project Delivery: Experience contributing to or leading product, data or technology initiatives from requirement definition through implementation.
* Data Quality & Governance: Experience establishing validation processes, quality controls, SOPs and traceable governance for operational information.
* Cross-functional Working: Demonstrated ability to work effectively across marine operations, commercial, product, technology and data teams.
* Global / Distributed Operations: Experience working across different geographies, cultures and time zones in a global maritime environment.
* Change Management: Track record of implementing process or technology change while maintaining operational delivery.
* Executive Communication: Experience providing concise progress, risk and recommendation updates to senior management and external stakeholders.
* Continuous Improvement: Demonstrated record of improving operational quality, efficiency, customer outcomes or data reliability

Education and Professional Qualification :
  
  
Essential: Recognised marine qualification and substantial maritime operating experience.
  
  
Preferred: Master Mariner (STCW II/2), Chief Engineer (STCW III/2), or equivalent senior deck/engine certification. Alternatively, a degree in Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Maritime Studies or Marine Operations supported by significant vessel, port or terminal experience. A relevant management, project-management or digital/data qualification is advantageous.
  
  
Why Inchcape Shipping Services?
  
  
We believe in building a diverse and high-performing workforce that works together to provide our customers with the exceptional service they deserve. To reach the highest standards, we depend on our people, their welfare, training and expertise. We realize the value of our staff and know that your unique experiences, skills and passions will help you to build a rich and rewarding career in our dynamic industry.
  
  
Our values are at the centre of everything we do, and the successful candidate will be expected to demonstrate and fully adopt these:
  
  
Global Perspective - we connect the world and see the bigger picture.
  
  
The Power of People - we rely on the strength of local agent knowledge and relationships.
  
  
Progress - we adopt new thinking and push for positive change in our industry.
  
  
In return, we will offer you:
  
  
A diverse range of benefits, depending on your geographical location. Globally, as a minimum, you will receive:
  
  

* A retirement savings plan
* Holiday
* Competitive salary
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Career development and progression opportunities
* Values Award celebration events

Plus, much more!
  
  
If you think that you have the right skills, knowledge and attitude to join our team, then we invite you to apply by simply clicking at the top of this advert!
  
  
#ISSthebiggerpicture
  
  
Appointment to this role will be subject to satisfactory references and possession of a valid Right to Work documentation depending upon your geographical location.
  
  
Inchcape is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer and equality, diversity and inclusion are at the centre of everything we do. We recognise that our customers, colleagues, contractors and other partners are central to our success and that we work in a diverse society. We acknowledge not only our legal, but also our moral responsibility to ensure all groups have equality of opportunity.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**RAMCO CONGLOMERATE**

Ramco Systems is part of the
**$1 billion+ diversified Ramco Group**
, a legacy enterprise with deep roots in industries such as cement, textiles, engineering, software, energy, and biotech. With over 75 years of heritage and innovation, the Ramco Group is a global powerhouse that blends traditional business values with modern technologies.

is the Group’s technology arm, delivering
**next-gen enterprise software**
across
**Global Payroll**
,
**HR**
,
**Aviation MRO**
,
**ERP**
, and
**Logistics**
. Headquartered in Chennai, India, Ramco serves over 1,000 customers across 35+ countries and is recognized for its
**AI/ML-based**
,
**bot-enabled**
, and
**cloud-native**
solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The
**Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau**
oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.

The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.

The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Regional Compliance Ownership & Governance**

* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end-to-end statutory updates —
  **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release**
  — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit-ready documentation standards.

**Regulatory Interpretation & Technical Oversight**

* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.

**Leadership, Team Management & Capability Building**

* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Confidence**

* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end-to-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.

**Strategic Initiatives & Innovation**

* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future-readiness.

**Training & Knowledge Enablement**

* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness**
  — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
  *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy**
  — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
  *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation**
  — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality**
  — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign-off.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance**
  — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence**
  — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement**
  — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Qualified
  **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer**
  with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10+ years in multi-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI-assisted regulatory research tooling.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

Job Location:
**Chennai, India**
**Join Us!**

The Engineering Manager leads the multidisciplinary engineering team assigned to one major project, or to several projects in parallel, within the High Voltage (HV) substation EPC business. **What will you do?**

* Manage, coordinate, and develop the project engineering team, covering primary (substation layout, electrical calculations, studies), secondary (protection, control, automation, SCADA), BIM/3D modelling, and civil/structural engineering disciplines.
* Allocate engineering resources and Distribute workload across the allocated resources of the project team based on project phase, milestones, and priorities; scale the team up or down as projects move through ECI, detailed engineering, and site support phases.
* Set individual and team objectives, mentor engineers, and support technical skill development within the discipline groups.
* When responsible for multiple projects simultaneously, arbitrate priorities and resource allocation across projects in line with overall business objectives.

* Attend weekly internal design review and monthly project plan review meetings.

**Engineering Delivery & Technical Ownership**

* Resolve interdisciplinary technical conflicts (e.g., primary/civil layout clashes, secondary/primary interface issues) and ensure design freeze milestones are met.
* Review and approve Guarantee the review and the approval of the key technical documents and design packages before issue to client or procurement according to project delivery plan.

**Vendor & Supplier Interface**

* Act as the senior technical point of contact toward equipment vendors and subcontractors.
* Support technical clarification meetings, technical bid evaluations, factory acceptance tests (FAT), and design review meetings with suppliers.
* Ensure vendor technical documentation (drawings, datasheets, calculations) is reviewed, commented, and approved in line with project schedule.

**Internal Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Interface with the wider project engineering organization (project management, procurement, construction, commissioning, QA/QC) to align engineering priorities with overall project schedule and deliverables.
* Represent the engineering function in internal project review meetings, steering committees, and client-facing technical discussions.
* Communicate risks, technical constraints, and schedule impacts clearly and proactively to project leadership and internal stakeholders.
* Act as a credible, senior technical voice able to defend engineering positions and priorities in front of internal stakeholders and management.

**Experience, Education And Other Required**

* Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor'S or Master's level).
* Minimum 18+ years of experience required, with a solid background in the HV EPC substation business (design, engineering, and/or execution of AIS/GIS substations, HV equipment, protection & control systems).
* Proven experience managing or leading a multidisciplinary engineering team (primary, secondary, civil, and/or BIM disciplines).
* Track record of managing engineering scope on EPC substation projects, ideally with exposure to both single-project and multi-project engineering management.
* Direct experience interfacing with equipment vendors and subcontractors on technical matters (technical clarifications, bid evaluation, design reviews, FAT).
* Experience working within a structured project engineering environment, coordinating with project management, procurement, and construction functions.
* Strong technical grounding across HV substation engineering disciplines, sufficient to arbitrate between primary, secondary, civil, and BIM inputs.
* Solid understanding of project engineering processes: design freeze, document control, interdisciplinary coordination, schedule-driven deliverables.
* Strong leadership and people-management skills, with the ability to organize, motivate, and hold a technical team accountable.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable presenting and defending positions to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Strong personality and presence, with the seniority and confidence to front demanding internal stakeholders and represent engineering interests at project level.
* Fluent in English (additional languages an advantage depending on project geography).

**What We Offer**
In return, we offer a wide range of rewards and benefits,
  
  

* 20 days Privilege Leave, 13 days Emergency leave and 14 Public holidays per year
* Medical Insurance, Life Insurance and Career Progression
* When it comes to diversity and inclusion, we see things differently at Linxon - we encourage applications from people of all races, ages, genders, religions, sexual orientations and more - so whoever you are, we hope you'll see things our way, too.

Shaping energy solutions to empower sustainable connectivity.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Type**
Full-time
  
  
**Description**
**About CloudBees**
CloudBees helps organizations build, run, and govern software factories, giving enterprises the confidence to ship software better, faster, and safer.
  
  
Writing code is no longer the bottleneck. Governing what reaches production and validating its impact is. As enterprises adopt agentic coding, software is created faster than most teams can review, secure, and validate. Without consistent governance, organizations risk shipping code they cannot explain, audit, or trust.
  
  
CloudBees addresses this challenge without asking teams to replace the tools they already use. Across every toolchain a customer runs, CloudBees makes each change, human or AI, visible, auditable, and accountable before it reaches production. CloudBees Unify is the product behind this: a governance layer, with context and control-plane capabilities, that enforces consistent policy and evidence across every tool, team, and workflow.
  
  
Founded in 2010, CloudBees is backed by Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Bridgepoint Capital, HSBC, Golub Capital, Delta-v Capital, Matrix Partners, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
Visit us at www.cloudbees.com.
  
  
**About The Team**
CloudBees builds CloudBees Unify, a governed software delivery platform spanning CI/CD, release orchestration, and feature management. Feature Management is the capability that lets teams ship code with a feature turned off, roll it out gradually, and kill it instantly if something breaks, no redeploy needed.
  
  
This team is moving into a new org, and that's where you come in.
  
  
You'd inherit a team spread across three continents and about ten time zones, and likely pick up one or two additional small teams alongside it. The team includes engineers who do not need you to tell them how to write code. What they need is someone who clears the path between them and shipping and treats "I don't know, let me find out" as a perfectly good answer in a 1:1.
  
  
This is the role today. If you do it well, there's room to take on more.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own delivery and team health for Feature Management
* Steer decisions with questions, then let your engineers own the architecture. If you're the one drawing the boxes, something's gone wrong
* Give feedback in the moment, not in a surprise essay once a year
* Hire, grow, and have the hard conversations when someone isn't where they need to be
* Cut process that exists because someone was once scared
* Use AI agents to run your own job faster: pull together who's on PTO next week, the lead time of your team's PRs, what ticket needs attention, what shipped and what it broke, instead of digging through five tools by hand

Not write code. Not approve every PR. Not sit in on every incident call because you don't trust the on-call rotation.
  
  
**Requirements**
**What we're looking for**
**Must have**

* A track record of improving automation and developer tooling, not just using what's handed to you
* At least 5 years as a software developer before moving into management, so the technical instincts below are earned, not borrowed (ideally, you have developed in Go)
* 5+ years as an actual engineering manager, with 5 or more direct reports at once. Not a tech lead with 3 reports and half a week of coding
* Genuinely technical: enough hands-on background in CI/CD, feature flagging, or platform engineering to ask a sharp question in a design review, plus real experience managing engineers who are better coders than you, and you're comfortable with that
* A track record of running distributed, multi-timezone teams: clear owners, clear deadlines, decisions that don't wait on a meeting that nine time zones won't allow
* You take the heat for your team and hand them the credit
* The instinct to measure what shipped and what it did for customers, not green dots in Slack. You know deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore, and you use them to start conversations, not to rank people
* A real appetite for AI: recent, hands-on use of at least one coding agent (Claude Code, Gemini, Cursor, Kiro, or similar) to run your own work, not necessarily to ship product code. You push your team to try these tools too, and have opinions about where they help and where they don't, not secondhand takes from a keynote you watched once
* Experience taking over a team mid-transition

**Nice to have**

* A sense of humor. You'll need one some days, and it'll help on the good ones too
* Prior exposure to release orchestration
* Java development experience

**Who This Is For**
You'd rather ask what's actually blocking someone than "why isn't this done yet." And when the unpopular call is needed, you make it, even when the timing is inconvenient.
  
  
You're fine with ambiguity that has a shape, not ambiguity that's just chaos with a Jira board. Sharp and a little irreverent beats technically flawless but rigid, as long as you still ship.
