title: Procurement Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Procurement Manager, Procurement Operations leads direct reports responsible for purchase order administration, supplier lifecycle operations, and Oracle supplier profile maintenance and support. The manager owns workload allocation, service levels, queue management, quality, coaching, escalation, and continuous improvement. The role ensures that purchase orders are created, fulfilled, amended, and closed accurately and on time; suppliers are onboarded and offboarded through approved controls; and supplier records remain complete, current, and properly supported.
  
  
This is not a category management, strategic sourcing, or contract-administration role. The position is the operational people leader and primary coordination point for PO and supplier operations, partnering with Sourcing, Contracts, Finance, Accounts Payable, Legal, IT, InfoSec, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, maintain segregation of duties, manage exceptions, and provide transparent performance reporting. The role also requires working knowledge of U.S. and India tax requirements relevant to procurement and supplier operations, including U.S. 1099 reporting requirements and associated supplier tax documentation.
  
  
**Team Summary**
Serving as the local team lead for the Procurement team within the Finance division, this role is integral to the procurement lifecycle at athenahealth. You will support backend procurement operations for a U.S.-based procurement team, including requisition compliance, purchase order creation, supplier registration, maintenance of records within enterprise resource planning/procure-to-pay (ERP/P2P) tools, supplier due diligence, annual supplier monitoring, contract coordination, internal and external communications, reporting, and related operational work.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to help ensure procurement activities are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. The position requires strong organization, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured environment. You should be comfortable working across teams, reviewing data for accuracy and trends, and identifying practical solutions to operational challenges. Experience supporting a team and helping improve operational results will be valuable in this role.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* People Leadership & Operational Management
* Lead, coach, and develop direct reports supporting PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, and Oracle supplier profile maintenance across U.S. and India operations.
* Establish individual objectives, service expectations, quality standards, development plans, and measurable accountability for results.
* Allocate workloads, monitor capacity and coverage, conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely performance feedback, and address execution or capability gaps.
* Build cross-training and succession coverage for critical PO and supplier processes, including planned and unplanned absences.
* Create an accountable, service-oriented culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, control adherence, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement.
* Purchase Order Administration & Fulfillment
* Oversee end-to-end PO administration, including validation of approved requisitions, contract and budget alignment, PO creation, dispatch, acknowledgement, change orders, issue resolution, receipt coordination, and closure.
* Ensure POs contain accurate supplier, entity, currency, payment term, accounting, tax, line-item, period-of-performance, and supporting-document information before release.
* Monitor PO fulfillment status and coordinate with requestors, budget owners, suppliers, Sourcing, Accounts Payable, and Finance to resolve missing receipts, invoice mismatches, exhausted balances, blocked invoices, overdue commitments, and other transaction exceptions.
* Maintain clear controls for non-PO spend, after-the-fact requests, emergency purchases, one-time suppliers, blanket POs, contract renewals, and other approved exception pathways.
* Coordinate timely PO amendments for approved scope, quantity, price, term, accounting, or supplier changes while preserving approval evidence and audit history.
* Lead periodic PO close reviews to identify completed, expired, inactive, duplicate, or no-longer-needed POs and confirm closure with the appropriate business and Finance stakeholders.
* Ensure PO records and supporting documentation are complete, accurate, accessible, and audit-ready throughout the PO lifecycle.
* Promote appropriate use of P-Cards, purchase orders, catalogues and other purchasing channels based on established buying and payment policies.
* Monitor P-Card transaction compliance, aging items, missing documentation, recurring exceptions, and other control issues; escalate and drive corrective actions where required.
* Maintain operational reporting and audit-ready supporting documentation for P-Card activity and associated controls.
* Supplier Onboarding & Offboarding
* Lead supplier onboarding from validated intake through activation, including required forms, tax and banking documentation, business ownership, approvals, sanctions and compliance checkpoints, risk-review status, and supplier communication.
* Confirm that supplier onboarding requests are complete and appropriately approved before Oracle supplier-profile creation or activation; return incomplete requests with clear remediation requirements.
* Support controls associated with supplier tax classification and U.S. information-reporting requirements, including collection and maintenance of appropriate supplier tax documentation used in 1099 reporting.
* Coordinate with Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, and business owners to ensure required reviews are completed and documented before the supplier becomes transaction-ready.
* Oversee supplier offboarding, including validation of termination or inactivity, review of open POs and invoices, closure of remaining commitments, deactivation of purchasing use, profile-status updates, and retention of supporting evidence.
* Maintain controls for one-time suppliers, reactivation requests, supplier legal-name changes, mergers or acquisitions, address changes, and payment-information changes, including required out-of-band verification where applicable.
* Prevent duplicate or fragmented supplier records by applying standardized search, matching, naming, and documentation requirements before creating or reactivating a supplier.
* Oracle Supplier Profile Maintenance & Support
* Own operational governance for Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, activation, inactivation, and user support in accordance with approved access and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Ensure supplier master data is accurate and complete, including legal name, tax identifiers, addresses, contacts, business classifications, payment terms, purchasing sites, entities, currencies, and supporting documentation.
* Oversee controlled updates to supplier profiles, including name, address, contact, tax, banking, payment, and site changes, with appropriate approvals and verification evidence.
* Monitor duplicate records, incomplete profiles, inactive suppliers, expired documentation, conflicting data, and other master-data quality issues; assign remediation actions and track them through completion.
* Triage Oracle supplier and PO transaction issues, document root causes and resolutions, coordinate system support with IT and Finance, and communicate status to affected stakeholders.
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, procedure updates, training, and adoption for approved Oracle/P2P process or system changes affecting supplier or PO operations.
* Service Levels, Controls & Operational Metrics
* Define and manage service-level targets for PO creation, PO changes, supplier onboarding, supplier offboarding, supplier-profile updates, issue resolution, and PO closure.
* Maintain dashboards and weekly operating reviews covering queue volume, completed transactions, aging, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, backlog, and control compliance.
* Measure PO fulfillment and close performance, including open-PO aging, past-due POs, completed POs awaiting closure, closure cycle time, dormant POs, remaining commitment value, and percentage closed within target.
* Track supplier operations metrics, including onboarding cycle time, first-pass completeness, profile-update cycle time, duplicate-prevention findings, offboarding completion, and aged requests.
* Analyze recurring defects and bottlenecks, identify root causes, assign corrective actions, and verify that improvements reduce cycle time, rework, and control failures.
* Escalate material service, control, data-quality, or capacity risks with a clear statement of impact, owner, corrective action, and expected resolution date.
* Maintain audit-ready evidence, support internal and external audit requests, and track remediation actions through verified closure.
* Process Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Support
* Maintain current SOPs, process maps, RACIs, control narratives, job aids, templates, intake requirements, and exception procedures for PO and supplier operations.
* Develop and deliver training for Procurement team members, requestors, approvers, and business stakeholders on PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, Oracle supplier requirements, receipt responsibilities, and PO closure.
* Publish clear operating guidance through approved Procurement repositories and communication channels; archive obsolete materials and maintain version control.
* Facilitate operational reviews, document decisions and actions, and drive routine follow-up without unnecessary escalation to senior Procurement leadership.

**Expected Education & Experience**

* Undergraduate degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business, Operations, or a related discipline preferred.
* Approximately 7–10 years of experience in procurement operations, procure-to-pay, purchasing operations, supplier master data, Accounts Payable operations, or a related function.
* Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax requirements relevant to procurement, supplier onboarding, invoicing, and supplier master-data operations.
* Experience supporting U.S. 1099 reporting processes, including supplier tax-document collection, supplier classification/data validation, exception resolution, and coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable.
* Experience managing or supporting P-Card programs, including transaction controls, cardholder support, exception management, documentation, and compliance monitoring.
* Experience managing catalog purchasing and other guided-buying channels, including operational support, transaction troubleshooting, and stakeholder coordination.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders and Accounts Payable to resolve PO/invoice/receipt mismatches and other procure-to-pay exception
* Demonstrated experience leading direct reports, including goal setting, coaching, performance feedback, workload management, capacity planning, and employee development.
* Hands-on leadership experience with end-to-end PO administration, including requisition validation, PO creation, changes, fulfillment support, receipt and invoice issue resolution, and PO closure.
* Demonstrated experience leading supplier onboarding and offboarding processes, including documentation, approvals, compliance checkpoints, stakeholder coordination, activation, inactivation, and exception handling.
* Demonstrated experience administering Oracle supplier profiles or comparable ERP supplier-master records, including data quality, duplicate prevention, profile updates, controls, and user support.
* Experience defining and managing operational service levels, transaction queues, aging, cycle-time reporting, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and close-performance metrics.
* Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls, segregation of duties, supplier master-data governance, three-way match concepts, invoice and receipt exceptions, and audit evidence requirements.
* Experience collaborating with Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, IT, InfoSec, Compliance, Sourcing, Contracts, and business stakeholders.
* Experience with Oracle/P2P, ServiceNow or comparable intake tools, SharePoint, Teams, and reporting or dashboard tools is preferred.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* People leadership, coaching, performance management, delegation, workload prioritization, capacity planning, and team development.
* Purchase order administration, fulfillment support, change management, commitment cleanup, and PO closure.
* Supplier onboarding and offboarding, supplier master-data governance, documentation validation, and duplicate prevention.
* Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, troubleshooting, data quality, access controls, and segregation of duties.
* Operational service management, including queue management, service levels, aging analysis, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and escalation.
* Procure-to-pay controls, audit readiness, exception management, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
* Strong stakeholder service, written communication, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
* Process mapping, SOP development, training, change management, continuous improvement, and AI-enabled operational opportunities.
* Sound judgment, attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to operate independently during U.S. business hours.
* P-Card program management, purchasing controls, transaction review, exception management, and cardholder support.
* Catalog purchasing operations and purchasing-channel management.
* Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax considerations affecting procurement, suppliers, and procure-to-pay transactions.
* U.S. 1099 reporting support, supplier tax documentation, tax-data validation, and cross-functional coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable.
* PO, invoice, and receipt mismatch resolution, including effective coordination among business requestors, suppliers, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and Finance.

**Success Measures**

* Direct reports have clear objectives, balanced workloads, regular coaching, documented development plans, and measurable accountability for results.
* POs are created and changed accurately within established service levels, with complete approvals and supporting documentation.
* Open-PO aging, overdue commitments, completed POs awaiting closure, and dormant POs are actively managed and reduced against established targets.
* PO closure reviews occur on schedule, closure decisions are documented, and completed or no-longer-needed commitments are closed promptly and accurately.
* Supplier onboarding and offboarding requests are completed within service levels, with required approvals, risk checkpoints, documentation, and stakeholder communication.
* Oracle supplier profiles remain complete, current, properly supported, and compliant with duplicate-prevention, access, approval, and segregation-of-duties controls.
* P-Card operations are administered within established controls, with timely documentation, transaction review, exception resolution, and corrective action for recurring issues.
* Catalog purchases are processed through appropriate purchasing channels, with operational issues and exceptions resolved promptly.
* PO, receipt, and invoice mismatches are proactively identified and resolved through effective coordination with business stakeholders, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and Finance.
* Supplier tax documentation and master data required to support applicable U.S. 1099 reporting are complete, accurate, current, and available to Tax and Accounts Payable within established timelines.
* Procurement operations appropriately support U.S. and India tax requirements while tax determinations and specialized interpretations are escalated to the appropriate Tax stakeholders.
* Operational dashboards provide reliable visibility into volume, cycle time, aging, backlog, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, and close performance.
* Recurring defects and bottlenecks have documented root causes, owners, corrective actions, and measurable improvements.
* Procedures, controls, job aids, and training materials remain current, approved, accessible, and audit-ready.

* Use industry knowledge and market insights to define and strengthen SCM consulting offerings.
* Lead advisory services, process consulting and business analysis across supply chain functions such as planning, sourcing and procurement, manufacturing, warehousing, logistics and fulfillment.
* Manage and drive consulting engagements with clients to discover and propose transformation opportunities, design high-value solutions and develop roadmaps.

* Design and strengthen production and supply planning processes, including work-order generation, production scheduling and alignment between demand, supply and execution teams.

* Translate planning business requirements into functional solution requirements, transformation roadmaps and implementation-ready process designs.
* Support clients in improving planning governance, decision cadence, exception handling and cross-functional planning alignment.

Business Development
  
  

* Collaborate with client partners and business development teams to create high-impact proposals.
* Lead market research and analysis to develop relevant insights for client conversations and solution development.

Thought Leadership
  
  

* Drive the thought leadership agenda for supply chain functions through white papers, webinars and analyst engagement.
* Lead creation and delivery of points of view on supply chain functions, operating models and technology trends.

People Development
  
  

* Mentor and coach consulting associates; lead people development and community-building activities.

**Other Requirements**

* Proven experience in creating, growing or leading a high-performance and outcome-driven consulting practice.

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Join athenahealth as a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a newly formed engineering team advancing our Integration Platform. You will build and develop the team, guide technical direction, and own the delivery of scalable, reliable integration solutions.
  
  
Working closely with engineering, product, architecture, and operational stakeholders, you will help simplify healthcare data exchange and improve the experience of developers, customers, and integration partners. A key focus will be advancing automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve engineering productivity.
  
  
**Team Summary**
The Integration Platform is part of the athenahealth Data and Ecosystem Platform subdivision. It supports internal data exchanges and connections between athenahealth and laboratories, imaging providers, registries, health information exchanges (HIEs), payers, other electronic health record (EHR) systems, faxing services, and third-party vendors serving healthcare practices.
  
  
A core component is our proprietary HL7 engine, which supports more than 15,000 contexts, approximately 20,000 connections, and millions of subscriptions. These connections use protocols and connectivity methods such as SFTP, HTTPS, APIs, and VPN sockets, making scalability, performance, and reliability central to the team’s work.
  
  
The platform supports inbound and outbound HL7 connections, alongside custom integrations for specific customer needs. Self-service tools and a dedicated advisory team support the onboarding, development, and validation of new integrations.
  
  
The Chennai team will expand these capabilities through platform improvements, process automation, and AI-powered tools that simplify integration development, testing, and onboarding.
  
  
**Essential Job Responsibilities**

* Drive the adoption of AI-assisted development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices across planning, design, implementation, testing, and maintenance, with appropriate engineering review and quality controls.
* Identify and deliver opportunities for automation, self-service, and AI-powered tooling to reduce integration turnaround time and improve developer and customer experiences.
* Establish and track meaningful measures of delivery predictability, software quality, platform reliability, engineering productivity, and integration turnaround time.
* Lead the evolution of existing systems while supporting new functionality and maintaining operational continuity.
* Foster agile / AIDLC development practices and use delivery outcomes and team feedback to improve how the team works.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing engineering team, establishing clear goals, accountability, and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Coach and mentor engineers through regular feedback, career development, and opportunities to strengthen technical and leadership skills.
* Own engineering planning and delivery for integration and faxing solutions, managing priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
* Partner with product, architecture, and engineering leaders to translate business objectives into a technical roadmap and achievable delivery plans.
* Guide architectural decisions and engineering practices that improve platform scalability, performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.

**Additional Job Responsibilities**

* Contribute to the long-term architecture and modernization strategy for the Integration Platform.
* Lead recruiting, onboarding, and talent development to build the capabilities needed for the team’s roadmap.
* Partner with operational and advisory teams to identify recurring integration challenges and translate them into reusable platform capabilities.
* Maintain productive relationships with internal stakeholders, external partners, and vendors.
* Support production readiness, incident resolution, and follow-up improvements that strengthen platform reliability.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and AI development tools through focused experiments with measurable outcomes.
* Share technical knowledge and effective engineering practices across teams.

**Expected Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or related field.
* At least 12 years of experience across software development and engineering leadership, including experience managing engineering teams.
* Demonstrated ability to build and develop teams, manage performance, and deliver complex software initiatives.
* Strong technical background in Java and experience designing, developing, or operating scalable enterprise software.
* Experience guiding architectural decisions, managing technical trade-offs, and improving software quality and operational reliability.
* Experience with agile development methodologies and continuous improvement practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted software development and opportunities to apply AI and automation to engineering workflows.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical audiences

title: uPVC Production Manager
description:
**Company:** Xindo Window Pvt Ltd  
**Location:** SriCity, Andhra Pradesh  
**Department:** Production / PPC  
**Job Type:** Full-Time, On-site  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Salary:** ₹50,000–₹70,000 per month (negotiable based on experience)

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Production Manager with strong knowledge of uPVC doors and windows manufacturing to manage overall production operations and Production Planning & Control (PPC). The candidate must be capable of leading production engineers and supervisors, planning production schedules, monitoring daily output, managing manpower, and ensuring production targets and delivery timelines are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage overall uPVC doors and windows manufacturing operations.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly production plans based on customer orders and delivery schedules.
* Handle PPC activities, production scheduling, order tracking, and work allocation.
* Lead and supervise Production Engineers, Supervisors, and shop-floor workers.
* Monitor the progress of engineers and supervisors and ensure planned activities are completed on time.
* Track planned versus actual production and take corrective action when targets are missed.
* Coordinate production activities across cutting, welding, fabrication, hardware fitting, assembly, and finishing.
* Ensure the availability of raw materials, components, manpower, and machines to meet production schedules.
* Coordinate with Stores, Purchase, Quality, Sales, and Dispatch teams for smooth operations.
* Identify production bottlenecks, reduce downtime and wastage, and improve productivity.
* Review daily production reports, pending orders, productivity, and manpower utilization.
* Ensure production orders are completed on time while maintaining required quality standards.
* Develop and implement process improvements to improve efficiency and reduce manufacturing costs.
* Maintain discipline, safety, and effective communication across the production team.

Required Skills

* Strong experience in uPVC doors and windows manufacturing.
* Excellent knowledge of PPC, production planning, and scheduling.
* Proven ability to manage production teams, engineers, and supervisors.
* Experience monitoring production progress and achieving daily and monthly targets.
* Good knowledge of shop-floor operations, manpower planning, and resource utilization.
* Ability to identify production delays and implement corrective actions.
* Experience with production reporting, MS Excel, and order tracking.
* Strong leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.

Educational Qualification

Diploma or B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* 5–10 years of relevant manufacturing experience.
* Candidates from uPVC doors and windows manufacturing are strongly preferred.
* Candidates from aluminium doors and windows manufacturing may be considered if they have relevant production management and PPC experience.
* Must have hands-on experience managing both production planning and shop-floor operations.
* Must be capable of leading engineers and supervisors, assigning responsibilities, and checking their progress.
* Candidates whose experience is mainly Quality Inspection, QA/QC, or documentation without production ownership are not suitable.

Work Location

SriCity, Andhra Pradesh.

**Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume, current salary, expected salary, notice period, and details of their production team-handling experience. Contact:** 93448 14634 (Keerthiga – HR)

Ensono is a hybrid IT services provider that sees a world in transformation. We understand the world of business has become more complex, layered, and interdependent because we're enabling the IT infrastructure for that transformation. Our clients are some of the most innovative and forward-thinking companies in the world and we help keep their businesses thriving. With nearly 50 years of experience, we optimize and modernize IT infrastructure by amplifying the power of mainframes and mid-range servers with the agility of cloud. Check us out at www.ensono.com.

  

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to caste, colour, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, HIV status, or any other status protected by law. Candidates with disabilities who require accommodations during the recruitment process are encouraged to contact our Talent Acquisition team to place a request.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**India Operations Development & Leadership:**

* Design and build a managed, scalable India-based Revenue Operations capability across sales operations, analytics, revenue insights, and GTM support
* Establish the operating model between India and US teams, including coverage areas, handoff protocols, quality standards, and SLAs
* Recruit, onboard, and develop India-based talent and emerging leaders; create career pathways and build high-performing remote teams
* Scale India operations from embedded individual contributor seats to a structured, managed function with clear accountability and growth trajectory
* Serve as regional operational leader, managing India team budget, resource allocation, and capability investments

**Operating Cadence & Executive Reporting:**

* Own and run the recurring sales operating cadence — pipeline reviews, QBRs, and forecast calls — as the operational throughline for the business
* Own forecasting and pipeline reporting accuracy that anchors Board/ELT reporting and executive decision-making

**Revenue Operations Architecture & Scale Readiness:**

* Audit current revenue operations processes, systems, and organizational structure to identify gaps and constraints at $2B+ scale
* Design and implement scalable revenue operations infrastructure (processes, systems, tools, governance frameworks) to support accelerated growth
* Establish comprehensive revenue metrics, dashboards, and analytics platforms that provide real-time visibility and actionable insights
* Own key revenue lifecycle components including territory and quota design, pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and deal operations
* Reassess segmentation, coverage model, and quota-to-comp linkage as part of a broader sales motion redesign for scale; partner with Finance on deal-desk process evolution
* Build standardized, documented operational playbooks and best practices across the revenue organization

**Systems & Technology Optimization:**

* Partner with technology and finance leadership to optimize the CRM and revenue technology stack (Salesforce, CPQ, BI tools, revenue intelligence platforms)
* Ensure data integrity, governance, and automation across revenue systems to enable advanced analytics and predictive modeling
* Identify and implement technology solutions that enhance revenue team productivity and decision-making velocity

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Strategic Alignment:**

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Delivery leadership on go-to-market planning, resource allocation, compensation design, and commercial strategy
* Communicate revenue operations roadmap and progress to executive leadership; translate operational insights into strategic recommendations
* Champion a culture of operational excellence, data-driven decision-making, and continuous improvement across the revenue organization

**Transformational Initiatives:**

* Lead strategic initiatives and large-scale transformation projects to enhance sales effectiveness, accelerate pipeline velocity, and support Ensono's growth objectives
* Identify organizational design constraints and recommend structural improvements to enable scale
* Drive adoption of best practices and standardization across the global revenue organization
* Stay ahead of industry trends and evolving competitive dynamics; evolve revenue operations capabilities to support innovation and market competitiveness

  

**We want all new Associates to succeed in their roles at Ensono. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Required Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.**

  

**What You Will Need:**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field
* 12–15+ years of progressive experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or commercial operations in a technology, SaaS, or managed services environment
* Direct experience operating inside a business that scaled through a significant revenue inflection (ideally toward or past $1B–$2B in ARR/revenue)
* Proven track record of building and leading high-performing revenue operations teams, including recruiting, developing, and scaling talent in distributed environments
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing revenue operations processes and infrastructure at scale, including territory design, quota modeling, forecasting methodologies, and compensation structures
* Deep expertise with Salesforce, advanced Excel, revenue analytics platforms, and business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent)
* Demonstrated ability to operate with ambiguity, define strategy in unstructured environments, and drive operational rigor in high-growth contexts
* Strong communication and executive presence; proven ability to influence C-level executives and cross-functional stakeholders
* Agile, adaptable, and customer-centric mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, global environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 15+ years of Revenue Operations or Sales Operations experience
* Direct experience building or managing offshore/India operations capability from the ground up, including talent recruitment, team structure, and operational governance
* Track record in PE-backed or high-growth SaaS environments with board-level reporting and governance cadence
* Experience with revenue intelligence platforms, sales analytics automation, and advanced forecasting methodologies
* Master's degree, MBA, or advanced business certification
* Knowledge of the managed services, cloud, and hybrid IT industry landscape
* Experience with CPQ systems, deal desk operations, and revenue recognition processes

  

**Bonus Qualifications**

* Experience leading revenue operations transformations or large-scale organizational restructuring
* Familiarity with global distributed team operations and cross-timezone collaboration models
* Background in financial operations, FP&A, or business operations that required deep revenue system expertise

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Front Office Manager
description:
**Designation:**
Community Manager

**Reporting To:**
General Manager

**Functional Reporting:**
Assistant Director – Community

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

The Community Manager is the primary owner of the member experience at the club. This role leads day-to-day community operations, member engagement, renewals execution, and onboarding delivery, while coordinating closely with internal teams to ensure consistent service standards across all member touchpoints.

This is an execution-led role. While supported by Corporate Community for structure, tracking, and guidance, the Community Manager owns on-ground delivery, real-time decision-making, and outcomes at the unit.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Member Engagement & Relationships***

* Own member engagement at the unit, ensuring members feel recognised, welcomed, and valued at all times.
* Act as the face of the Community team on the floor, building strong relationships through regular interaction and personalised engagement.
* Maintain accurate member profiles, preferences, and interaction notes to enable personalised experiences.
* Address member concerns with empathy and discretion; resolve issues promptly or escalate when required.
* Track and share engagement insights, feedback trends, and key member inputs with leadership teams.

***2. New Member Onboarding (On-Ground Delivery)***

* Execute the new member onboarding experience at the unit, ensuring warm introductions and smooth integration.
* Coordinate with Membership Sales for structured handovers post-sale.
* Ensure new members are oriented to the space, offerings, and community culture.
* Collect early-stage feedback and act on gaps in the onboarding experience.
* Ensure onboarding steps are completed and tracked as per defined process.

***3. Club Floor & Community Operations***

* Own daily Community operations on the club floor, ensuring smooth functioning and high service standards.
* Actively manage the member journey from arrival to departure.
* Coordinate closely with F&B Service, Culinary, Operations, and Facilities teams to deliver seamless hospitality.
* Identify operational gaps, log issues, and drive resolution at the unit level.
* Ensure adherence to Community SOPs and service frameworks on the floor.

***4. Private Hires, Events & Reservations***

* Act as the unit coordination point for private hires, member events, and reservations.
* Redirect and align enquiries with Sales and Operations teams as per defined process.
* Ensure accurate communication of event requirements and flawless on-ground execution.
* Be the primary on-site contact for members during events.

***5. Team Coordination & Communication***

* Lead and guide the unit Community team in daily priorities, service standards, and member handling.
* Coordinate internal communication across departments for member-related requirements.
* Share updates, challenges, and best practices with Corporate Community and leadership teams.
* Support training, process adherence, and continuous improvement initiatives at the unit level.

**Skills & Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in hospitality, community management, guest services, or customer experience roles.
* Strong on-ground operational experience in premium or member-led environments.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with high emotional intelligence.
* Ability to manage pressure situations calmly and professionally.
* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

title: Robot Operator Supervisor
description:
**Job Description**
Company: Nextpower
  
  
Location: Hyderabad, India
  
  
Job Title: Robot Operator – Operations
  
  
Experience - 4-6yrs
  
  
**About The Role**
NextPower is expanding its global robotics operations and building an India-based team to support remote robotic inspection missions across solar sites worldwide. The Robot Operator Supervisor – India Operations will serve as a key leader within this growing organization, combining hands-on robot operation with team leadership, operational excellence, and cross-regional coordination.
  
  
This role will work closely with Robot Operators in India while maintaining daily communication with supervisors and operations leaders based in the United States to ensure alignment on scheduling, performance expectations, quality standards, and mission execution.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
As a Robotics Operations Supervisor you will operate robotic systems while supporting and guiding a team of Robot Operators in India. You will help drive operational consistency, ensure high-quality mission execution, coach operators, and act as the primary communication bridge between the India Operations team and U.S.-based leadership.
  
  
This position is ideal for someone who is both technically capable and comfortable leading people in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Robot Operations (Player/Coach Role)
  
  

* Remotely operate and monitor robotic missions to maintain operational proficiency
* Support complex or high-priority missions as needed

Team Support & Oversight
  
  

* Provide day-to-day guidance to Robot Operators in India
* Monitor operator performance, productivity, and adherence to operational standards
* Assist with onboarding and training of new operators

Cross-Regional Coordination
  
  

* Maintain regular communication with California-based supervisors, leads, and operations teams
* Participate in shift handoffs, mission reviews, and operational meetings
* Ensure India operations remain aligned with global processes and expectations

Scheduling & Workflow Support
  
  

* Assist in managing daily operator schedules and coverage
* Help coordinate workload distribution and mission prioritization

Quality & Performance Management
  
  

* Review mission execution, documentation quality, and operator feedback
* Identify process improvements and escalate operational challenges

Technical Troubleshooting & Escalation
  
  

* Support operators in resolving technical issues and determining escalation paths
* Coordinate with engineering or technical support teams when needed

Reporting & Documentation
  
  

* Provide operational updates and performance insights to leadership
* Ensure accurate documentation of incidents, anomalies, and mission results

Safety & Compliance
  
  

* Reinforce company safety standards and operational best practices
* Promote a culture of accountability, communication, and continuous improvement

**Qualifications**
Required
  
  

* English fluency (spoken and written) with daily communication with US teams
* Prior experience in one or more of the following:

○ Remote operations or robotics
  
  
○ Technical support or customer service leadership
  
  
○ Operations supervision or team coordination
  
  

* Demonstrated leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work from the India office while supporting U.S. operational hours, including evening or overnight shifts as required.

**Preferred**

* Familiarity with remote operations, robotics, or industrial automation.
* Exposure to robotics, industrial systems, or solar operations
* Experience leading teams in a 24/7 operations environment.

Why Join Nextpower
  
  

* Lead a growing robotics operations team in India
* Collaborate with international teams and advanced AI-driven technology
* Opportunity to influence processes and team development during early growth
* Clear career path into senior leadership as operations scale

Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.
  
  
**We are Nextpower**

title: Vice President Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Vice President Operations**
Lead the operational management and evolution of Domestic Payments, ACH(Automated Clearing House ), RTP(Real time payments) and other Emerging Payments processing within Payments Business Service. The role is accountable for safe, resilient and client-focused execution, driving end-to-end consistency of operational design, efficiency through standardisation and global solutions, and strong risk and control outcomes—while supporting ongoing market infrastructure change and new scheme adoption.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Own day-to-day operational performance for Domestic, ACH, RTP and Emerging Payments processing, ensuring delivery against all agreed service levels/PLAs (cut-offs, quality, Audit & Risk outcomes, OOE and operational losses).
* Design, manage and report operational performance using robust MI/KPIs; ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to agreed standards and regulatory expectations. Drive client experience outcomes by reducing client effort and improving transparency (e.g., fewer avoidable rejects/returns, faster resolution of exceptions, clearer status/communications through agreed channels). Lead standardisation and simplification across the functional line, striking the right balance between global consistency and required local/scheme-specific needs.
* Drive productivity and cost transparency; identify and deliver efficiency opportunities through process redesign, automation and improved workflow/tooling. Ensure all change activities (scheme changes, platform upgrades, new products/rails, regulatory deadlines) are communicated, agreed and deployed with minimal operational disruption. Supervise migrations/transitions where applicable, leveraging existing expertise to shorten transition timelines and stabilise performance post-move.
* Ensure appropriate risk and control strategies are in place for all processes under remit; proactively identify control gaps and drive sustainable remediation. Manage incidents (including those caused by external factors such as scheme outages or market events) through effective co-ordination, timely escalation and stakeholder communications. Ensure operational readiness and resilience for evolving payments infrastructure (including new schemes and message format migrations), delivering solutions to mandatory timelines. Partner with Global Businesses, Transformation, Technology and other stakeholders to shape and deliver operational change programmes and innovation across payments workflows. Plan and manage ad-hoc tasks and senior management queries, ensuring relevant and timely responses.
* Build and lead a high-performing and engaged payments operations team; set clear direction, expectations and accountability. Retain talent, manage underperformance and attrition, and ensure development and career progression opportunities across payments talent pools. Role model Operational Excellence and continuous improvement; embed a culture of disciplined execution, learning and “fix it once, fix it properly”.
* Promote an inclusive environment that supports diversity and reflects HSBC values; operate effectively across cultures and geographies. Maintain strong working relationships with peer groups and senior managers to co-ordinate delivery, remove blockers and report progress and results. Contribute to the broader payments governance structure, including policy and decision-making, through active participation in committees/forums.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Recognised as a Subject Matter Expert in Payments Business Service / Payments Operations, with strong understanding of domestic clearing, ACH processing, RTP/instant payments and emerging payment rails (including exceptions, returns, rejects and operational controls).
* 10+ years’ experience in Operations Management, including strong operational control capability and a proven track record in delivery. Strong programme/change/project management skills; able to deliver standardisation, migrations and operational transformation safely. .
* Excellent planning, organising and commercial skills, including strong financial management capability and ability to drive cost transparency. Resourceful and outcome-focused; able to leverage available resources to achieve goals.
* Prior experience driving innovative operational solutions (process, automation, tooling, MI) is an advantage.
* Ensure employees apply compliance and operational risk controls in accordance with HSBC and regulatory standards and policies, recognising the heightened regulatory implications associated with payments. Continually reassess operational risks inherent in the role, considering changes in economic/market conditions, legal/regulatory requirements, operating procedures, organisational changes and new technology.
* Ensure incidents are reported per the incident escalation process in a timely manner; ensure root cause analysis is completed and corrective actions are implemented and sustained. Support ongoing market infrastructure change programmes (new schemes/rails, rulebook changes, message format migrations), ensuring solutions are delivered to regulatory/mandatory timelines.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

**About the Company**

A growing restaurant group operating in the United States and India is establishing a Global Capability Centre (GCC) in Hyderabad to support its US restaurant operations and Indian outlets.

The GCC will bring together key business support functions to ensure seamless restaurant operations, consistent service delivery, efficient coordination and business growth across locations.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced and dynamic
**Head – Business Operations / Head – GCC**
from the QSR, F&B or restaurant industry to establish, lead and manage the Restaurant Support Center in Hyderabad.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for building the operating model, developing teams, implementing processes and performance standards, coordinating with US restaurant leadership, and ensuring effective support across business functions. The role will also oversee coordination for new store openings and drive operational excellence across customer experience, people, sales and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

**1. GCC**
Setup & Operating Model

* Establish and develop the GCC operating model, processes and workflows from the ground up.
* Define service standards, operational guidelines, reporting structures and performance metrics.
* Establish effective coordination between the Hyderabad GCC and US restaurant operations.
* Ensure business continuity through proper resource planning, shift coverage, backup arrangements and process documentation.
* Drive operational KPIs across customer experience, people, sales and profitability.

2. Business Operations & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact between the GCC, US restaurant leaders, the founder, agencies and external partners.
* Align business priorities, deliverables, timelines and performance expectations across teams.

* Manage escalations, resolve operational issues and ensure timely execution of business requirements.

5. New Store Opening & Expansion

* Act as the single point of contact for coordinating new restaurant and outlet openings.
* Work closely with the Purchase team to coordinate procurement and ordering of furniture, equipment and other opening requirements.
* Coordinate with GCC functional teams, agencies and restaurant leadership to ensure pre-opening readiness.
* Oversee coordination of pre-opening marketing, launch activities and operational preparedness.
* Ensure smooth launch execution and provide post-opening support to restaurant teams.

6. Compliance & Data Security

* Ensure confidential handling of US restaurant, business and customer information.
* Implement and monitor compliance with applicable company policies and agreed data protection and information security standards.
* Identify operational risks and ensure appropriate controls and escalation procedures are in place.

* Graduate degree in any relevant discipline; MBA/PGDM preferred.

* Strong experience in QSR, F&B, restaurant chains or hospitality operations.

* Experience managing cross-functional teams, agencies, vendors and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience working with founders, senior leaders and business heads.

Good to Have

* **Ownership:**

* **Business Acumen:**
  Understanding of restaurant operations, cost control, sales and profitability.
* **Decision-Making:**

Compensation & Benefits

An experienced business operations leader from the QSR, F&B or restaurant industry who has managed multi-outlet operations, built centralised support teams, established operational processes and coordinated new store openings. title: Director - Transformation Office
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Director – Transformation Office to drive business transformation across the organisation. The role will focus on identifying opportunities to move suitable activities to offshore teams, automate processes, and reduce operating costs.

The person will work closely with business leaders, operations, technology and finance teams to identify improvement opportunities and ensure that these are implemented successfully. The objective is to improve productivity, service quality and turnaround time while building efficient, scalable and cost-effective delivery models.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Offshoring and Process Transition**

* Identify business processes that can be moved to offshore teams or centralised delivery centres.
* Work with business teams to assess process suitability, volumes, costs, resource requirements and operational risks.
* Develop plans for transitioning activities, including process documentation, knowledge transfer, training and handover.
* Ensure that transitioned processes meet agreed quality standards and service levels.
* Work with business development teams to identify potential offshoring opportunities for clients and support solution proposals.

**2. Automation and Technology**

* Identify manual and repetitive activities that can be automated using technology, RPA, AI and other digital solutions.
* Work with technology teams to assess and implement suitable automation solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, errors, duplication and processing time.
* Track the benefits of automation in terms of cost savings, productivity and quality improvement.
* Ensure that appropriate controls are in place for data security, compliance and the use of AI.

**3. Continuous Improvement**

* Review existing processes and identify areas where work can be simplified or made more efficient.
* Identify bottlenecks, unnecessary steps, delays and activities that result in rework.
* Drive initiatives to improve turnaround time, productivity, accuracy and service quality.
* Introduce standard processes, operating procedures and performance measures across teams.
* Encourage employees and managers to identify and implement improvement ideas.

**4. Transformation Project Management**

* Prepare and maintain a transformation plan covering offshoring, automation, cost optimisation and process improvement initiatives.
* Prioritise projects based on business impact, cost, feasibility and expected benefits.
* Work with relevant teams to define timelines, responsibilities and deliverables.
* Monitor progress, resolve issues and ensure that projects are completed as planned.
* Provide regular updates to senior management on progress, challenges, cost savings and business benefits.

**5. Cost Optimisation and Pricing**

* Work with Finance and business teams to understand the cost of delivering different services.
* Identify opportunities to reduce costs through better resource utilisation, process redesign, automation and offshoring.
* Help develop cost-per-unit models for services such as applications processed, invoices handled, reports prepared or tickets resolved.
* Support the development of outcome-based pricing models for clients.
* Track whether the expected cost savings and productivity improvements are actually achieved.

**6. Performance Tracking and Reporting**

* Define measures to track the success of transformation initiatives.
* Monitor cost savings, productivity, turnaround time, quality, automation benefits and service-level performance.
* Establish dashboards and periodic reviews to track progress against targets.
* Ensure that the benefits achieved are properly measured and reported.
* Highlight risks, delays and areas requiring management intervention.

**7. Stakeholder Management and Change Management**

* Work closely with business heads, functional leaders, technology, finance and operations teams.
* Explain proposed changes to stakeholders and obtain their support for implementation.
* Support teams in adopting new processes, tools and ways of working.
* Identify training and capability-building requirements arising from transformation initiatives.
* Share successful practices across teams and service lines.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations, IT or a related field. An MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification would be an advantage.
* Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in business transformation, operations, offshoring, shared services, process improvement or consulting.
* Experience in leading transformation projects involving multiple teams or business functions.
* Good understanding of offshore delivery models, process transitions and shared services.
* Exposure to automation, AI-based solutions and technology-enabled process improvement.
* Experience in process improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma would be an advantage.
* Understanding of cost optimisation, productivity measurement, business cases and return on investment.
* Strong project management, analytical and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with senior management and drive initiatives from planning through implementation.

**Key Success Measures**

* Successful transition of identified processes to offshore or centralised teams.
* Reduction in operating costs and cost per unit of service delivered.
* Improvement in employee productivity and utilisation.
* Reduction in manual effort, processing time and rework.
* Successful implementation of automation initiatives.
* Improvement in quality and adherence to service-level targets.
* Timely completion of transformation projects.
* Achievement of planned cost savings and other business benefits.
* Development of scalable and commercially viable service delivery models.

title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
description:
**Description**
Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.
  
  
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.
  
  
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities Of a NOC Manager I**
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.
  
  
In this role, the manager will work with stakeholders from multiple partner teams to manage Integrated Centralised Monitoring and Response System Auditing function & improve program performance along with lead a team of people managers overseeing operations for a team size of 30+ associates. Manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance - 6PM IST OR 8PM IST onwards) depending on business requirements.
  
  
The Manager would be responsible to evolve the processes and mechanisms with the growing complexities in the network by working across multiple stakeholders like configuration and design teams. The individual will drive improvements and automations to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.
  
  
This position also manages the planning and execution of the team’s goals, including segmentation of business goals, measurement of goal attainment, evolving and driving various improvements in Business to increase its effectiveness in driving results. They would drive quality and productivity in the team via continuous coaching and feedback mechanisms, scope out team's career development plans through performance assessment, drive associate engagement through 1-1s and team building activities, dive deep and drive action on insights from connection scores, manage exceptions and prepare dive deeps on escalations from Ops, represent the team in Business reviews (WBRs/MBRs), strategize and implement the associate shift planning and rostering to effectively meet the program requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL would be an added advantage. They should be be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will need have excellent communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Responsible for performing operational audits across miles in FCs, SCs, Lastmile and GSF.
* Prepare audit reports enclosed with findings, visual interpretations captured during audits.
* Working with operational stakeholders to aligning audit related binaries, key operational processes to be covered in audits
* Preparing SOPS, weekly business reviews, newsletters, help-texts, simulations to assist associates in performing audits
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Track the deliverables of the NOC-ICMRS team, work closely with the operations leadership and drive audit closures.
* Must be willing to share on-call rotations in support of alarms, security incidents, and critical service outages.
* Enhance, track, and report on metrics which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements so that the desired outcomes are achieved to plan and in a timely manner.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, training and documentation
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all key goals and metrics

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree or 3+ equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of experience in control room management, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Good critical thinking skills and attention to detail
* Experience with security equipment such as CCTV cameras and video review system

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Be solutions-focused, customer-focused, and always deliver excellent follow-up.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Amazon Flex Investigation and Offboarding (Flex I&O) is looking for a Team Manager to directly supervise a team of individual contributors across our investigations, quality assurance, and offboarding operations. The Flex I&O team’s mission is to protect the Amazon Flex Brand and Customers by adjudicating Delivery Partner incidents that warrant offboarding after a single offense. In this role, the problem, strategy, and opportunity are already defined — your key responsibility is directing who does which tasks to meet daily goals while fostering a culture where team members feel valued, trusted, and connected.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on people leader who excels at coaching specialists and analysts, auditing work queues, managing SLA adherence, and driving team-level performance metrics. You will play a critical role in ensuring your team consistently meets performance, quality, and compliance standards across investigations, case audits, appeals processing, and partner liaison activities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Directly supervise a team of Investigation specialists, quality analysts, and investigation liaisons, providing day-to-day direction, coaching, and mentorship
* Hire and onboard bar-raising talent, ensuring new team members are effectively integrated and trained on Flex I&O processes, tools, and SOPs
* Conduct regular one-on-ones, career development conversations, and performance reviews, helping reports define short- and mid-term goals
* Evaluate employees against role guidelines and participate in calibration sessions with your manager to ensure fair and consistent performance assessments
* Audit work queues and monitor SLA adherence across investigations, quality audits, and offboarding cases, identifying priorities and managing trade-offs between time and resources
* Monitor team performance metrics, identifying trends and implementing action plans to maintain and raise the performance bar
* Recommend improvements to tools, procedures, and workflows to enhance operational efficiency and case quality
* Manage straightforward problems using technical and domain knowledge, escalating roadblocks to leadership when needed
* Ensure compliance with Flex/SLS policies, regulatory requirements, and established procedures across all queues and markets
* Communicate performance regularly in 1:1s and support promotion discussions for high performers, fostering a culture of accountability and professional growth
* Collaborate with Quality Analysts, Program Managers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate audit findings into actionable coaching and process improvements
* Support escalation management by ensuring time-sensitive cases within your team are triaged and resolved with urgency and accuracy

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of team management experience
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with experience using data to identify trends and drive decisions
* Excellent organization skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**About Invesco**

If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

* Explore AI-enabled solutions that improve analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to thought-leadership reports and innovative uses of location intelligence.
* Use Power BI, Python, SQL, and Excel effectively, and promote their use across the team.
* Guide GIS and spatial analysis for market mapping, site assessment, and investment decisions.

* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in relevant quantitative, business, finance, real estate, technology, or analytics discipline.

**II. Experience:**

* At least 2-3 years of people leadership experience in an analytical or research environment.
* Proven experience managing global stakeholders, projects, automation initiatives, and cross-functional delivery.

**III. Skills:**
**Core Technical Skills**

* Power BI, Python, SQL, advanced Excel, and PowerPoint.

Full time

Employee
