title: Kandou Template
description:
**About Kandou AI**
Kandou AI is a fast-growing semiconductor company developing advanced connectivity and memory fabric solutions for AI infrastructure. India is an important part of our global engineering organization, with growing teams in Hyderabad, Bangalore and Pune.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Administration & Procurement Manager to support our expanding India operations.
  
  
**The Role**
Based in Hyderabad, you will manage key procurement and administrative processes for Kandou India, working closely with our Finance team in Switzerland, India Operations, employees, vendors, banks, Kandou’s external accounting and compliance provider and other external service providers.
  
  
This is a hands-on role requiring strong ownership of the procure-to-pay process, vendor coordination, payment and import documentation, and day-to-day administration. The role has a strong international dimension, with regular interaction with global teams and overseas suppliers, including management of cross-border payments and the related banking and regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage procurement activities across Kandou India, including sourcing, quotations, vendor selection, negotiations, purchase orders and delivery follow-up.
* Manage vendor onboarding, contracts and supplier relationships, ensuring appropriate commercial terms and documentation.
* Coordinate the procure-to-pay process, including PO and invoice matching, approvals, payment documentation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Manage the administrative requirements related to payments to foreign vendors, working with banks and external service providers to ensure complete and timely documentation for cross-border transactions.
* Support import and logistics administration, including bills of entry, airway bills, E-Way Bills and other customs or banking documentation.
* Work closely with the India Operations Manager on equipment shipments, customs clearance and inter-office movements.
* Working closely with Kandou’s external accounting and compliance provider to ensure accurate and timely ERP transactions/journal entries and supporting Kandou Finance with month-end activities, reconciliations and maintenance of complete, audit-ready documentation.
* Support office administration, facilities and employee onboarding requirements in Hyderabad.
* Maintain clear reporting on procurement, contracts, payments and key open items, and drive process improvements as the business grows.

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 10+ years of relevant experience in procurement, administration, finance operations or supply chain.
* Experience working in an international or multinational environment, with regular interaction across countries, cultures and time zones.
* Good understanding of end-to-end procurement and procure-to-pay processes.
* Experience with vendor sourcing, commercial negotiation, purchase orders and contract administration.
* Practical experience managing payments to overseas vendors, including banking documentation, foreign remittances, regulatory requirements and resolution of payment-related exceptions.
* Comfortable working with and holding accountable an outsourced accounting/compliance provider – reviewing their output, resolving issues, chasing turnaround times, and escalating issues rather than waiting passively for resolution.
* Working knowledge of India payment, GST, E-Way Bill and import/export documentation requirements.
* Experience working with ERP systems; Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central is an advantage.
* Strong Excel, organizational and analytical skills.
* Strong communication skills and professional fluency in English.
* Proactive, hands-on approach with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow issues through to resolution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, engineering or technology companies.
* Experience with imported technical or laboratory equipment.
* Familiarity with STPI requirements.
* Hindi or Telugu language skills.

title: Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager, Infra Networking
description:
**Description**
Today, Amazon Web Services provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world.
  
  
The AWS Cloud infrastructure is built around Regions and Availability Zones (AZs). AWS Regions provide multiple, physically separated and isolated Availability Zones which are connected with low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant networking. These Availability Zones offer AWS customers an easier and more effective way to design and operate applications and databases, making them more highly available, fault tolerant, and scalable than traditional single data center infrastructures or multi-data center infrastructures. How would you like to come be part of the team that builds out that low latency, high throughput, and highly redundant network?
  
  
Amazon Web Services is looking for a highly motivated, technically savvy Network Infrastructure Deployment Manager to help develop and scale one of the world’s largest and most complex networks. The Deployment Manager (DM) is responsible for managing some of the most technical, cost efficient, and fast paced communication construction project schedules achievable. AWS Deployment Managers are constantly challenged to drive continuous improvement and deliver the highest quality, most technically efficient connectivity solutions in the world.
  
  
As a Deployment Manager you will be a part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling the most fascinating and challenging problems in fiber construction. AWS Deployment Managers are always at the forefront of the network construction industry in terms of innovation, and maintain a focus to deliver the most innovative products to our customers. Our networks are industry leading in terms of capacity and cost effectiveness. The DM is ultimately responsible for end to end network delivery and management of the contractors. The DM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, fiber splicing, OSP Design, ISP Construction or system installation/commissioning) and be responsible as a team member for delivering some of the most complex networks in the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As NW Infra Deployment Manager working within AWS Infrastructure you will:
  
  

* Interface with key internal stakeholders to understand the technical requirements and ensure the completed project meets these requirements.
* Project management of construction related activities and DWDM network rollout for new builds or general capital projects. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget;
* Ensure that the construction, fiber and optical network adheres to the defined standards;
* Perform quality audits and ensure issues are remediated;
* Understand the metro fiber market segments, customer base, and industry verticals;
* Drive scaling designs to meet the demand of our customers;
* Interface with data center providers to drive equipment and circuit installations;
* Create detailed network planning packs to build scalable and future proof infrastructure;
* Program management, risk mitigation and reporting status reviews to management and internal customers.
* Develop long-term strategic partnerships in support of our key markets;
* Understand the mechanisms used to operate and maintain one of the world’s most complex networks;
* Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time;
* Ability to work across multiple time zones;
* Willing to travel 25-50% of the time.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with fiber optic and copper cabling standards, testing equipment & troubleshooting methodologies
* Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
* Knowledge of software development practices and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies
* 5+ years of technical infrastructure management experience, including network construction management and/or program management in a telecom environment
* Strong technical understanding of transport technologies (Fiber, DWDM, etc.) and data center/infrastructure/networking technologies

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of network engineering and deployments for large-scale networks in a corporate environment, including hands-on physical infrastructure installations, hardware integration, racking, and cabling experience
* Experience communicating to a diverse, global audience
* Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification with experience leading multiple large network construction programs
* Familiarity with GIS platforms, quality assurance processes, and strong knowledge of long-haul transmission systems and regional construction standards
* Experience working in a fast-paced, international environment with strong contacts in fiber, transport, and infrastructure markets

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: HR Operations Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**HR MANAGER**

People Operations | Payroll & Compliance | Performance Management

**ROLE OVERVIEW**  
We are seeking a detail-oriented HR Manager to oversee payroll, HRMS, attendance, employee documentation, performance processes, statutory compliance and day-to-day HR administration. The ideal candidate will bring strong Keka HRMS expertise, sound knowledge of HR operations and the ability to maintain accurate, compliant and efficient processes.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Payroll & Compensation**

Manage monthly payroll through Keka HRMS for 100+ employees, ensuring accurate and timely salary processing.

Validate attendance, leave, LOP, overtime, incentives, reimbursements, salary revisions and joining or exit inputs before payroll finalisation.

Review salary calculations and deductions, generate payslips, maintain payroll records and coordinate salary-related queries with Finance.

2. **Keka HRMS & Employee Lifecycle**

Maintain employee master data, HRMS workflows, reporting structures, compensation details and employee records.

Manage onboarding administration, probation and confirmation tracking, employee status changes, transfers, salary revisions and exit documentation.

Coordinate full-and-final settlement inputs and resolve HRMS-related queries within agreed timelines.

3. **Attendance, Leave & Workforce Administration**

Monitor attendance, late arrivals, early departures, absenteeism, overtime, shifts, weekly offs and holiday calendars.

Manage leave applications, balances, regularisation and attendance corrections in line with company policy.

Coordinate biometric and Keka attendance records, investigate discrepancies and submit verified monthly payroll inputs on time.

4**. Employee Documentation & Records**

Maintain complete, accurate and confidential employee files in physical and digital formats.

Prepare and update employment letters, contracts, policy documents, employee forms and other HR correspondence.

Ensure employee records are securely maintained and readily available for authorised audits or internal reviews.

5. **Performance Management & Employee Relations**

Coordinate probation evaluations, performance reviews, appraisal cycles, employee feedback and confirmation processes.

Support salary revisions and compensation decisions in consultation with leadership, based on performance and approved policies.

Handle employee concerns professionally and assist managers with performance documentation, disciplinary processes and policy communication.

title: Manager I, Operations, Centralised Monitoring Response System Auditing
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Looking for a career at a company that seeks to be Earth’s most customer-centric company? If so, meet Amazon.  
  
Over the past 20 years, Amazon has reinvented on behalf of customers and has become the largest internet retailer and marketplace in the world. NOC (Network Operation Center) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon's transportation network. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon fulfillment centers (FC) and from Amazon FCs to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem solving, NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
  
Within NOC’s umbrella, resides a fast-growing Last Mile support function – AMZL CO (Amazon Logistics Central Operations). AMZL CO is responsible for centrally supporting daily planning and execution of functions that impact Delivery Station (DS) operations across Routing, Scheduling, On-Road and Payments workstreams. The Marcopolo program under AMZL CO strives to operate heavily repetitive processes for NA, EU and JP COs, with standardized mechanisms, tools and technology and with a vision is to build a global Center of Excellence for Last Mile (LM) CO services across WW marketplaces in next 3 years. As a Manager I, Operations in the organization, this role will lead the operations management (tactical execution) charter for Driver support workstream supporting NA/EU. This role will influence and advice multiple senior level leaders and stakeholders.  
  
Responsibilities of a NOC Manager I:  
We are looking for an experienced Manager to coordinate and lead efforts across operations, and program teams. We're looking for a hands-on and motivated self-starter who's passionate about using data to help us measure every area of the business, drive efficiencies, optimizations and influence decision-making.  
  
In this role, the manager will work with stakeholders from multiple partner teams to manage Integrated Centralised Monitoring and Response System Auditing function & improve program performance along with lead a team of people managers overseeing operations for a team size of 30+ associates. Manager may be expected to operate in different shift structures (for instance - 6PM IST OR 8PM IST onwards) depending on business requirements.  
  
The Manager would be responsible to evolve the processes and mechanisms with the growing complexities in the network by working across multiple stakeholders like configuration and design teams. The individual will drive improvements and automations to the reporting tools, methods, and processes utilized by the team to increase the availability and granularity of actionable data to internal and external partners.  
  
This position also manages the planning and execution of the team’s goals, including segmentation of business goals, measurement of goal attainment, evolving and driving various improvements in Business to increase its effectiveness in driving results. They would drive quality and productivity in the team via continuous coaching and feedback mechanisms, scope out team's career development plans through performance assessment, drive associate engagement through 1-1s and team building activities, dive deep and drive action on insights from connection scores, manage exceptions and prepare dive deeps on escalations from Ops, represent the team in Business reviews (WBRs/MBRs), strategize and implement the associate shift planning and rostering to effectively meet the program requirements.  
The successful candidate must have very strong analytical skills and expert in excel. Knowledge of SQL would be an added advantage. They should be be passionate about their work, detail-oriented, analytical, and have excellent problem-solving abilities. They will need have excellent communication and customer-relationship skills, good analytic insight, and be a passionate advocate of operations team to other stakeholders.. They will drive towards simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems, have excellent project-management skills, and be able to communicate complex analytical results, both written and verbally, in a clear and easy-to-understand way.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Responsible for performing operational audits across miles in FCs, SCs, Lastmile and GSF.
* Prepare audit reports enclosed with findings, visual interpretations captured during audits.
* Working with operational stakeholders to aligning audit related binaries, key operational processes to be covered in audits
* Preparing SOPS, weekly business reviews, newsletters, help-texts, simulations to assist associates in performing audits
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Track the deliverables of the NOC-ICMRS team, work closely with the operations leadership and drive audit closures.
* Must be willing to share on-call rotations in support of alarms, security incidents, and critical service outages.
* Enhance, track, and report on metrics which are key performance indicators, allowing performance improvements so that the desired outcomes are achieved to plan and in a timely manner.
* Recognize and adopt best practices in reporting and analysis: data integrity, test design, analysis, validation, training and documentation
* Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all key goals and metrics

  
Basic Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s Degree or 3+ equivalent professional experience
* 2+ years of experience in control room management, risk management, supply chain management, or other related field
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
* Good critical thinking skills and attention to detail
* Experience with security equipment such as CCTV cameras and video review system

  
Preferred Qualifications  

* Be solutions-focused, customer-focused, and always deliver excellent follow-up.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced ambiguous environment
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple responsibilities

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. * Demonstrates a strong sense of responsibility for safeguarding the bank’s reputation.
* Proactively seeks root cause solutions to recurring false positive trends.

This newly created role will build upon our existing quality audit and failure demand analysis and translate them into proactive, systemic initiatives that address root causes and prevent recurring customer friction.
  
  
The (CX Improvement Manager) will identify the root causes of both reasons that drive users to seek help (i.e. contact our Customer Service teams) and also reasons for customer dissatisfaction (DSAT). Using these insights the role holder will partner cross-functionally with CS, Quality, Operations, Product and Tech teams to project-manage operational solutions - such as proactive incident communications, automated surge protocols, improvements to our AI Virtual Assistant and social media engagement playbooks.
  
  
If you are a data-driven operations specialist who thrives on solving systemic friction, building scalable workflows, and directly moving CX metrics, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**

* Strategic Program & Project Management

Execute High-Impact CX Initiatives: Project-manage core quality programs
  
  
30-60-90 Day Impact Roadmaps: Design and execute structured roadmaps focused on addressing top customer contact and DSAT drivers (e.g. bet settlement queries, policy related concerns and deposit/withdrawal challenges).
  
  
Maintain, triage and manage (i.e. verify, categorise, prioritise) the operational backlog of bugs, intent gaps, and UX improvements for the AI Virtual Assistant, serving as the bridge between frontline CS teams and Product to drive continuous bot performance.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Alignment

Product & Tech Integration: Partner with CS, Product, Ops and Tech teams to implement initiatives like dynamic, event-driven in-app alerts and automated IVR messaging to deflect/intercept inbound ticket surges before they reach live agents.
  
  

* Metric Ownership & Performance Analytics

CSAT & DSAT Management: Own overall CSAT/DSAT performance, linking root causes for dissatisfaction to improvement initiatives and measuring the direct benefit of changes made.
  
  
Social Media & ORM Optimization: Revamp Online Reputation Management (ORM) playbooks for X (Twitter), Telegram and Facebook, transitioning teams from highly manual and robotic responses to more automated and efficient ways of working whilst retaining a context-aware engagement approach.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**

* Experience: 5+ years in Customer Operations, Quality Management or CX Project Management, preferably in high-volume environments (Fintech, iGaming, E-commerce or Tech)
* Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Tech, and Customer Operations using methodologies like Agile or Lean.
* Data & Analytics Proficiency: Strong proficiency in customer support analytics, queue management metrics (AHT, FCR, ART, Shrinkage), and identifying trends within unstructured customer feedback (verbatims/DSAT surveys).
* Technical Savvy: Comfort with API-driven integrations, IVR routing logic, automated helpdesk workflows and social media management tools.
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to distill complex technical outages into simple, empathetic customer-facing copy and clear executive updates.

**Even better if**

* Prior experience operating in high-volatility, real-time event industries (e.g., sports betting, live payments, or trading platforms).
* Direct experience writing SOPs, designing automated ticket routing workflows, and establishing disaster recovery/surge protocols.
* Certified 6 Sigma Green or Blackbelt

If you're interested, we encourage you to apply! Every application is reviewed by a member of our team (AI is not used in our recruitment process), and we aim to respond within 48 hours.

title: Senior Manager – Design Execution | Bespoke Interiors & Installations
description:
**Location:**
Mumbai (Lower Parel)

**Role Type:**
Full-time

Who We Are

Baaya Design is an award-winning spatial design studio creating bespoke art installations, lighting, and crafted environments for hospitality, airports, institutions, public spaces and premium residences. We work with over 70 artisan and material techniques, combining traditional craftsmanship with contemporary design. Every project is unique, requiring creativity, precision and exceptional execution.

Why This Role is Exciting

This is an opportunity to build one of India's most distinctive project execution platforms. You will work directly with the founders, architects, designers, artisans and clients on landmark projects across India. You will have significant autonomy to improve systems, build vendor relationships and shape how Baaya delivers projects as it grows.

Role Overview

You will be the single point of ownership for converting Baaya's designs into beautifully executed reality, from design handover through fabrication, logistics and final installation. You will coordinate with designers, artisans, vendors, contractors and clients to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to Baaya's quality standards.

·       Develop project budgets, BOQs and procurement plans while protecting project margins.

·       Manage fabrication quality, production schedules and logistics.

·       Lead site installations and resolve on-site challenges quickly.

·       Take ownership and work independently.

·       Remain calm under deadline pressure.

·       Are comfortable travelling across India.

·       Balance creativity with commercial discipline.

·       Identify execution risks early and proactively resolve issues affecting cost, timelines or quality.

·       Degree in Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Project Management or a related discipline.

·       Satisfied clients, architects and designers.

·       Reliable vendor and artisan ecosystem.

·       Continuous improvement in execution systems and processes.

https://bit.ly/BaayaBrandManifesto

Reports directly to the CEO / Founder.

We are looking for the right person. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

Send your CV and portfolio to

**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services forsavings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. description:

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced and hands-on
**Associate Director – Accounts Payable**
to lead the Accounts Payable function, drive payment operations, and ensure robust financial controls and process efficiency. The role will oversee a team of 15–20 professionals and take ownership of end-to-end AP operations, month-end closing, vendor management, and payment processing.

The ideal candidate will be a qualified Chartered Accountant with 10+ years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in Accounts Payable, preferably within a large manufacturing organization with a turnover of approximately ₹1,000 crore or more. Experience in Accounts Receivable will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounts Payable Operations & Leadership**

* Lead and manage a team of 15–20 professionals, ensuring effective workload distribution, performance management, and delivery against defined service levels.
* Oversee the end-to-end Accounts Payable cycle, including invoice receipt, verification, processing, accounting, approvals, and vendor reconciliations.
* Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices, employee reimbursements, expense claims, and other payables.
* Establish robust processes to manage invoice backlogs, resolve discrepancies, and minimize payment delays.
* Drive standardization, productivity, and continuous improvement across AP operations.

**2. Payments & Treasury Coordination**

* Oversee domestic and other applicable vendor payment cycles, ensuring payments are accurate, timely, and compliant with internal policies.
* Monitor payment schedules, due dates, cash flow requirements, and payment priorities in coordination with Treasury and Finance.
* Ensure appropriate authorization, segregation of duties, and controls across payment processing.
* Manage payment exceptions, failed transactions, urgent payment requests, and vendor escalations.
* Strengthen controls to mitigate duplicate payments, fraudulent transactions, and other payment-related risks.

**3. Month-End Closing**

* Own the Accounts Payable month-end close process, ensuring timely closure and accurate reporting.
* Review AP-related general ledger balances, vendor reconciliations, outstanding invoices, accruals, provisions, and advances.
* Ensure accurate accounting of expenses, liabilities, and cut-off entries in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
* Reconcile AP sub-ledgers with the general ledger and investigate discrepancies.
* Provide timely schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for financial reporting and audits.

**4. Vendor Management & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Drive effective vendor account management, statement reconciliations, and timely resolution of invoice and payment disputes.
* Build strong working relationships with Procurement, Business Teams, Plant Operations, Treasury, Tax, and Finance.
* Establish clear escalation mechanisms to resolve vendor issues and improve stakeholder experience.
* Monitor vendor ageing, overdue liabilities, and payment commitments to support working capital management.

**5. Compliance, Controls & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, tax regulations, GST, TDS, and internal financial control policies relevant to AP.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and audit trails for invoices, payments, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors and ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to strengthen governance and reduce operational risk.

**6. Process Improvement & Systems**

* Identify opportunities to streamline AP processes, improve turnaround times, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Drive automation and effective utilization of ERP systems and finance tools.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including invoice processing turnaround time, overdue invoices, payment accuracy, and reconciliation status.
* Develop dashboards and management reports to provide visibility into AP performance, risks, and process bottlenecks.

**7. Accounts Receivable – Additional Advantage**

* Provide oversight or support to Accounts Receivable operations, where required.
* Support process integration and improved coordination between AP, AR, and other finance functions.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory.**
* 10+ years of overall experience in Finance & Accounts.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience managing Accounts Payable operations, including payment processing and month-end closing.
* Demonstrated experience leading large teams
* Prior experience in a large organization, ideally with a turnover of approximately ₹1,000 crore or more, is preferred.
* Experience in Accounts Receivable will be an added advantage.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 will be preferred.
* Candidates from both multinational corporations and large Indian organizations are welcome.

title: Head - Projects & Engineering
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

Shalina Healthcare is one of the largest pharmaceutical companies in sub-Saharan Africa. For the last 40 years we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory, and nutrition. We have a track record few can match and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa.

We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities we serve.

Everyone in our company has a crucial role to play, and we are looking for people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

The Global Supply Organization is a multi-continental Function that comprises of the entire Value Chain from product conceptualization to delivery to the commercial front. Within the Global Supply Organization are included, Research & Development, Project Management, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain Management and Logistics.

**Role:**
Head - Projects

**Designation :**
DGM - Projects

**Base location:**
Turbhe Navi Mumbai (with frequent travel to Africa & Pune)

**Reporting To:**
Manufacturing Head

**Role Scope:**
Multi-country | Greenfield & Brownfield Projects

**Role Purpose**

The Head – Projects is the single-point owner for all capital projects across Shalina’s manufacturing and supply network. This includes greenfield manufacturing facilities, plant expansions, capacity upgrades, utilities, and major engineering initiatives.

The role is responsible for end-to-end project lifecycle management – from project conception and charter approval through engineering design, contractor selection, execution, commissioning, and handover to operations.

The incumbent will lead projects centrally, while supervising site-based teams who are accountable for on-ground execution. This role ensures standardization, cost discipline, timeline adherence, and governance across geographies.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Project Strategy & Portfolio Governance

* Own the global project portfolio aligned to Shalina’s manufacturing and supply chain expansion strategy.
* Translate business and capacity requirements into clearly defined project charters, scope, timelines, and budgets.
* Establish project governance frameworks, stage gates, and approval mechanisms for all CAPEX projects.

2. Project Planning & Engineering Oversight

* Lead conceptualization, feasibility assessments, and engineering strategies for greenfield and brownfield projects.
* Oversee preparation and approval of concept layouts, master plans, and detailed engineering drawings (civil, MEP, utilities, and process).
* Ensure alignment of designs with manufacturing, quality, EHS, and regulatory requirements.

3. Budgeting, Cost Control & Commercial Management

* Own CAPEX budgeting, cost estimation, and board-level project approvals.
* Drive contractor and vendor selection, tendering, technical evaluations, and commercial negotiations.
* Ensure tight cost control, value engineering, and adherence to approved budgets across projects.

4. Project Execution & Delivery

* Oversee execution of multiple concurrent projects across geographies through site-based Project Managers.
* Monitor progress against master project schedules and key milestones; intervene and escalate where required.
* Ensure timely installation, commissioning, and readiness for validation and operations.

5. Vendor, Contractor & Stakeholder Management

* Manage relationships with EPC contractors, consultants, equipment suppliers, and statutory authorities.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders including Manufacturing, Quality, EHS, Supply Chain, and Finance.
* Ensure smooth coordination between central teams and site-level execution teams.

6. Compliance, Quality & Risk Management

* Ensure all projects meet GMP, regulatory, safety, and corporate quality standards.
* Identify project risks proactively and implement mitigation plans.
* Ensure proper documentation, audit readiness, and formal project handover to operations.

7. Team Leadership & Capability Building

* Lead and develop the Projects organization, including mentoring site-based teams.
* Drive standardization of project management tools, templates, reporting, and best practices.
* Build long-term internal capability to manage complex, multi-country capital projects.

**Key Interfaces**

* Manufacturing & Quality Assurance
* Engineering, EHS & Utilities
* Finance & Procurement
* Supply Chain & Operations
* External Consultants, EPC Contractors, and Equipment Vendors

**Qualifications, Experience & Skills**

Education

* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical electrical, Civil, or Chemical Engineering.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Management preferred.

Experience

* 18–22 years of experience in industrial or pharmaceutical project management.
* Proven track record of delivering greenfield manufacturing facilities and large-scale expansions.
* Strong exposure to GMP environments, utilities, process equipment, and regulatory compliance.
* Experience managing projects in Africa or other emerging markets is strongly preferred.

Skills & Attributes

* Strong project governance and execution mindset.
* Ability to manage complexity across geographies, cultures, and regulatory environments.
* Commercial acumen in contractor negotiations and CAPEX control.
* Executive presence with the ability to engage Board-level and CXO stakeholders.

Success Measures / KPIs

* On-time and on-budget delivery of approved projects
* CAPEX adherence and cost optimization
* Readiness for validation and commercial operations
* Safety, quality, and compliance outcomes
* Effectiveness of site Project Managers and delivery governance

**Work Environment**

This position is based at the Global Supply Organization office in Navi Mumbai. The role will require travel domestically/ internationally up to 25% of the time.

description:

With procurement operations transitioning to the Finance organization, this role will focus on front-end commercial strategy, contract management, and risk oversight, ensuring robust commercial outcomes from early design through construction completion.

* Work with Engineering, Project Directors, and Operations to validate design-to-budget alignment and incorporate lessons learned into future contracts.
* Interface with JV partners, lenders, and hyperscale customers on commercial matters and reporting.

* Champion the use of commercial management tools and data analytics to drive visibility and continuous improvement.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of commercial management experience in large-scale data-center, mission-critical infrastructure, or major construction projects, including 5+ years in a regional leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of contract law, cost control methodologies, and risk management frameworks.
* Proven ability to manage high-value contracts across multiple Asian markets and to collaborate effectively with Finance-led procurement teams.

* Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
* RICS, MRICS, or equivalent commercial management certification preferred..

**Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.**

Responsable des investissements existants dans la dette et/ou les actions, mais ne participe pas à la création de ces investissements. Gère la relation quotidienne avec tout client existant dans le portefeuille. Interprète les enjeux commerciaux internes et externes simples et recommande des meilleures pratiques pour améliorer les produits, processus ou services. Reste informé des tendances de l'industrie susceptibles d'influencer son travail.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Responsable du conseil pour les activités liées aux risques d'ingénierie, de construction et d'exploitation associés aux investissements en fonds propres et aux prêts relatifs aux projets existants et nouveaux. Responsable de l'identification et de la proposition des indicateurs d'atténuation à destination de la souscription et de la gestion de portefeuille.
* Exige des connaissances spécialisées approfondies et/ou une expertise étendue au sein de leur discipline. Peut nécessiter une forte sensibilité commerciale et est censé influer sur l'élaboration d'une stratégie dans son propre domaine, notamment en matière de contrôle des ressources et de formulation des politiques.
* Dirige, s'il y a lieu, des équipes fonctionnelles ou des projets dont les besoins en ressources, les risques et/ou la complexité sont réduits. Exprime des concepts difficiles et peut influencer les opinions de ses collègues sur des sujets particuliers. Peut amener autrui à envisager une question selon un point de vue différent.
* Agit sur la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre les objectifs en matière de service, de qualité et de respect des délais. Ses tâches sont soumises aux objectifs de la politique fonctionnelle. Conseille régulièrement la direction de la fonction et/ou de l'entreprise. Joue un rôle de soutien dans la prise de décision sur des sujets importants. Des niveaux élevés de discernement sont nécessaires pour obtenir les résultats escomptés.
* Fait preuve d'un haut niveau de discernement pour prendre des décisions, et gérer des tâches ou des problèmes complexes ayant une incidence sur la fonction. Possède la capacité d'évaluer la qualité des informations fournies et sait poser des questions pertinentes aux parties prenantes. Est capable de résoudre des problèmes avec des solutions innovantes qui sortent du cadre des paramètres établis, mais aussi d'élaborer des recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.

**Qualifications De Base**


* Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis - Ce rôle nécessite une expérience avancée de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une maîtrise dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. Compétences établies en gestion de projet.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

title: Customer Service Manager- Out of Home & Value Leadership
description:
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities :**

* OOH & Institutional Channel Customer Service & Fulfillment
* Order-to-Delivery Operations: Own end-to-end customer service operations for HoReCa, Travel Retail, QSRs, Airlines, Canteens, and Institutional clients.
* Service Level Excellence: Drive high fulfillment metrics (Case Fill Rate / Order Fill Rate / On-Time In-Full) while minimizing transit damages and turnaround time.
* Customer Collaboration: Build strong collaborative relationships with key accounts, understanding their unique delivery constraints, order cycles, and customized packaging/palletization needs.
* Claims & Dispute Management: Ensure seamless invoice matching, credit note management, and swift reconciliation of returns and claims
* Logistics Network & Route-to-Market Execution (OOH)
* Distribution Strategy: Partner with Regional Logistics Managers to optimize regional warehousing, cross-docking, and last-mile freight for non-traditional channel routes.
* Cold-Chain & Freshness Governance: Maintain strict product integrity and temperature control for temperature-sensitive confectionery across direct and indirect distribution points.
* Inventory & S&OE Integration: Participate actively in weekly S&OE / DMR reviews to ensure stock availability and forecast alignment for high-volatility institutional orders
* Value Leadership & Continuous Improvement (Cross-Functional)
* VL Pipeline Stewardship: Serve as the CS&ML PMO lead for Value Leadership, identifying, validating, and tracking cost-reduction and productivity projects (e.g., freight optimization, warehouse productivity, packaging simplification, payload maximization)
* Cost-to-Serve Optimization: Model and monitor channel-wise Cost-to-Serve (CTS) analytics to deliver sustainable margin improvements.
* Process Standardization & Digitalization: Lead Lean/CI initiatives to eliminate waste, standardize SOPs, and automate reporting/analytics across regional logistics hubs

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Operations, or Supply Chain; MBA / Post-Graduate Diploma from a tier-1/2 business school preferred

**Knowledge / Experience**

* 5–9 years of progressive experience in Supply Chain, Customer Service, Logistics, or Route-to-Market operations in FMCG / CPG / Food & Beverage
* Customer Centricity: Strong negotiation, customer relationship management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Analytical & Financial Acumen: Strong proficiency in cost modelling, Cost-to-Serve analysis, and supply chain P&L levers.
* Tool & Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA / SD / MM), WMS/TMS, and BI tools (Power BI / Excel)

**Key Competencies**

* Strong stakeholder and conflict management skills with effective priority setting.
* Thrives in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining professionalism and urgency.
* Balances competing priorities and provides clear direction and focus to meet business needs.

title: Casting Yard Incharge – Pre-Tensioning
description:
**Company Description**
ARVIND TECHNO ENGINEERS PRIVATE LIMITED is an engineering company headquartered in New Delhi, India, with operations supporting infrastructure and construction projects. Located at A-22, Green Park (Main), Aurobindo Marg, the company is positioned in a key commercial area of Delhi. It focuses on delivering reliable engineering solutions and services to clients across regions. Team members benefit from exposure to diverse projects and opportunities to contribute to high-impact work in the engineering sector.

**Role Description**
The Casting Yard Incharge – Pre-Tensioning role is a full-time, on-site position based in Mumbai. The role involves supervising daily operations of the casting yard, including pre-tensioning activities for precast elements, monitoring production schedules, and ensuring adherence to design specifications and quality standards. The person in this role will coordinate with site teams and suppliers, manage workforce allocation, and maintain safety and compliance in all yard operations. Responsibilities also include documentation of production, reporting progress to project management, and resolving operational issues to maintain smooth workflow.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Communication and Customer Service skills for effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess Team Management and Team Leadership skills to supervise yard staff and guide daily operational activities.
* Candidates should possess basic Broadcasting or information-sharing skills to ensure clear dissemination of instructions, updates, and safety guidelines.
* Relevant experience in precast concrete, pre-tensioning processes, or casting yard operations is highly beneficial.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering or a related field is preferred.
* Knowledge of safety standards, quality control practices, and construction industry regulations is advantageous.
* Ability to work on-site in Mumbai and manage physically demanding tasks in an outdoor industrial environment.

Master's Degree

title: Senior Clinical Trial Manager (Sr. CTM) - Internal Medicine
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
PPD’s (a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific) mission is to improve health. It starts as an idea to find a cure. It becomes a life saved. All in-between, it’s you! We know that meaningful results not only require the right approach, but also the right people. We invite you to re-imagine health promoting protocols with us, working alongside our talented, bright and energetic teams.
  
  
Our therapeutic team directs, coordinates and manages the technical and operational aspects of projects, securing the successful completion of clinical trials. The team is therapeutically aligned to respond better to our customer needs.
  
  
**The therapeutic scope includes Cardiovascular & Internal Medicine**
**-**
Dermatology, GI, (UC/CD), Cardiovascular, Liver, Nephrology, Immunology, Rare Disease, Diabetes, Obesity, Dyslipidemia, Women's Health.
  
  
As a Senior Clinical Team Manager (Sr. CTM), you combine deep knowledge, therapeutic expertise, and robust tools to help our clients deliver life-changing therapies to market. You take ownership of all start-up and clinical deliverables, anticipate problems, find solutions and deliver results; coordinating the activities of start-up and clinical team members which are allocated to a project on a Regional or Country basis.
  
  
You will work in partnership with the Project Manager to ensure the necessary training, tracking and quality systems are in place for the clinical management team and be primarily responsible for the start-up and clinical deliverables of the Project within agreed timelines and budget. Clinical Team Managers provide contact and support to the project sponsor for all clinical aspects.
  
  
At PPD we hire the best, develop ourselves and each other, and recognize the power of being one team. We offer continued career advancement opportunities, award winning training and benefits focused on the health and wellbeing of our employees.
  
  
Summarized Purpose:
  
  
Accountable for achieving the final start-up and clinical deliverables (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. Interprets data on complex issues and makes good business decisions with support from line management. Works to ensure that all start-up and clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring start-up and clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the country start-up and clinical team. Typically works independently on projects of moderate to high complexity and may assume regional lead or Clinical Study Manager responsibilities.
  
  
Essential Functions:
  
  

* Manages all clinical and start-up activities, operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of moderate to high complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Lead CTM responsibilities on regional level, Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities or take on additional responsibilities; e.g. process improvements, manage complex programs, have wider management or project coordination responsibilities.
* Acts as the primary point of contact for study start-up activities and site activation across the assigned region and/or globally, driving timelines and ensuring operational excellence.
* Develops start-up and clinical tools (e.g. Essential Document Checklist, Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the study requirements and Data Quality Plan. Contributes to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensures timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborates with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings.
* Collaborates with the start-up country team, regulatory, clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicates with the team and leads team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department.
* Ensures achievement of the start-up and clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring start-up and clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. May routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials.
* Communicates with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues.
* Coordinates all start-up activities and ensures that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Ensures timely regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Reviews and follows up on all questions raised by ethics committees. Responsibilities may vary based on project timelines.
* Provides input into preparation of forecast estimates for start-up and clinical activities. Responsible for start-up and clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements.

Education and Experience:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
* Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years).
* In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
  
  

* Strong experience managing end-to-end clinical trial start-up (SSU) activities
* Experience leading cross-functional collaboration with CAS, RAL, ICF PM, GCS, Contract Management, and other stakeholders to ensure seamless study execution.
* Strong leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams
* Strong planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload and workload of team members
* Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization
* Solid understanding of change management principles
* Comprehensive understanding of the practices, processes, and requirements of start-up and clinical monitoring
* Strong judgment, decision making, escalation, and risk management skills
* Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency
* Capable of evaluating own and team members workload against project budget and adjust resources accordingly
* Strong financial acumen and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management
* Strong attention to detail
* In-depth understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc.
* Strong computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.
* Capable of independently managing clinical only studies

Working Environment:
  
  

* PPD, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role:
* Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner.

**Support deployment of OPEX practices**
across GSC, including Visual Management, Performance Dashboards, Daily Management Boards, A3 Problem Solving, Kaizen, Action Planning, and leadership routines linked to business outcomes.

description:
**Job Description**
This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role.

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

* Agree the project deliverables and programme.

* Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme.

* Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff

* Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice.
* Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution.

**Establishment and growth of GCC**

* Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC

* Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
* Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity.
* Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
* Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe.
* Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below.
* Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

**Technical and Project Management**

* Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
* Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
* Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
* Promote technical excellence in all our projects
* Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
* Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

**Commercial**

* Implement the project delivery systems and structures
* Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
* Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
* Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

**Qualifications**

* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record.
* The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services.
* Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux.
* A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential.
* Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology.
* A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential.

title: Head of Finance Operations - India
description:
**About the Company**

At Opella Healthcare, we are united by one shared Mission: putting Health in Your Hands. We aim to make healthcare as simple as it should be, empowering people to take care of themselves. As a

top-three global player in Consumer Healthcare, we strive to build an agile and high-performing

organization that outpaces the market.

To achieve this ambition, we rely on exceptional talent who embrace our Challenger spirit—

Outcome-obsessed, Courageous, Radically Simple, and All-In Together.

**About the Job**

The India Head of Finance Operations is responsible for leading all end-to-end finance operations and accounting activities across legal entities in the country.

The position ensures:

• accuracy, completeness and compliance of financial statements,

• strong governance, internal control and audit readiness,

• operational excellence across Shared Services and local retained teams,

• support to the India Head of Finance and senior leadership on statutory, technical accounting, tax, and treasury related matters.

The role guarantees the integrity of the financial data used for Group reporting, statutory accounts, tax filings, and key business decisions across markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

**A. Financial Accounting & Statutory Reporting**

• Support the end-to-end accounting processes for all legal entities in India.

• Ensure accurate and compliant production of monthly, quarterly, and annual IFRS, local GAAP and

statutory accounts.

• Own the quality of group reporting submissions.

• Coordinate preparation of statutory financial statements, tax packages, and annual filings.

• Review and validate complex accounting treatments, contracts, and transactions.

• Oversee local GAAP adjustments (payroll, pension, amortization, provisions, tax).

• Manage actuarial processes and commitments (IFC, long-service awards, pre-retirement schemes).

**B. Reporting**

• Ensure accurate, complete and timely preparation, loading and publication of all Group reporting

packages required by Finance Operations, including: Polo D1/D5 (Sales & Inventory), ISC uploads,

Marco Budget (preparation and loading), reconciliation between Marco and Solar, Solar package

(monthly and quarterly), TWIN reporting, Spring package, Trema report, MyTax reporting, TaxRisk

reporting.

• Lead the preparation and submission of the FCT cashflow forecast in SAP FC, ensuring alignment

with Treasury requirements.

• Oversee the preparation and submission of the Country-by-Country Reporting (CbCR) in

collaboration with the Tax department.

• Sign off SAP FC / SEAL reporting package for the legal entities under responsibility.

**C. Audit, Governance & Compliance**

• Serve as the primary point of contact for statutory auditors and internal auditors.

• Define audit scopes, coordinate missions, ensure timely resolution of findings.

• Guarantee full compliance with internal and external accounting standards.

• Ensure internal control framework effectiveness (including SOX, segregation of duties).

• Deploy Group accounting procedures;

• Listed entity oversight: Lead quarterly and annual closing activities, financial audits, and disclosures in compliance with SEBI LODR requirements including Related Party Compliances. Coordinate Board and Audit Committee reporting and presentations, including quarterly results, annual budgets, and related party transactions.

• Tax audit: Lead the preparation, coordination, and timely submission of all documentation required for tax audits, ensuring completeness and accuracy, ensure oversight of all tax compliance activities performed by GBS, maintaining accountability for accuracy and completeness, particularly for OneERP countries

**D. Collaboration with finance community**

**•**
Ensure high-quality, timely, and compliant execution through GBS hubs

• Build strong collaboration between GBS and finance teams in each country.

**E. Business Partnership**

• Provide the Head of Finance and Regional Finance operations & A2R Head with financial analysis of the legal entities.

• Support strategic projects:

o legal restructuring,

o acquisition/divestiture accounting,

o Capex evaluation,

o performance measurement and target achievement (e.g., bonus schemes).

• Present revenue and performance analyses to social partners or workers' councils where required.

• Partner with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations, Finance Performance, HR, Tax, Legal, and

Corporate.

**F. People Leadership**

• Develop a team of finance professionals in India

• Build capabilities for future-ready finance (automation, digital tools, data literacy).

• Oversee recruitment, performance management, succession planning, and coaching.

• Promote corporate values and a culture of accountability, cooperation, and continuous development.

• Support HSE requirements where applicable.

**G. Process Excellence, Systems & Transformation**

• Support continuous improvement and harmonization of accounting processes across countries.

• Lead or contribute to Finance transformation initiatives:

o ERP changes,

o new digital tools (automation, workflow tools, BI),

o process standardization,

o M&A integration / carve-out.

• Collaborate with Process & Systems teams to deploy tools for controllers and managers.

• Ensure successful adoption of automation and new ways of working.

**Expected Skills**

**Technical Skills**

• Strong technical expertise in IFRS, local GAAP , tax accounting, statutory reporting.

• Deep understanding of end-to-end accounting and finance operations in multinational environments.

• Experience working with Shared Services / GBS organizations.

• Strong audit and internal controls background (SOX preferred).

• Ability to review and challenge complex accounting topics.

**Soft Skills**

• Strong leadership and communication skills across cultures and functions.

• Ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority.

• High agility, resilience, and change-management capability.

• Strong analytical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving.

**Experience**

• 12–15+ years of increasing responsibility in Finance, Accounting, Audit, or Controlling.

Demonstrated experience in regulatory compliance and corporate governance, especially in the

context of Indian listed companies.

• Experience in preparing financial presentations for Boards, Audit Committees, and investors,

including handling disclosure obligations under SEBI/LODR.

• Familiarity with IFRS and Ind-AS accounting standards, and experience in using ERP systems (e.g.,

SAP) and financial reporting tools.

• Proven track record in statutory reporting, closing processes, and audit management.

• Experience in transformation programs is a strong plus.

**Education**

• Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) is mandatory; additional certifications such as CPA or ACCA will be considered an advantage
