title: Business analysis and technology operation - Senior Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Sr. Manager – Technology Operations & Business Analysis**

LMS,Securitisation, BA, Regulatory Technology and IT Budget Control

**Designation** - Sr.Manager

**Department** - Technology & Operations

**Reports to** - Chief Technology Officer (dotted line to CFO, CBO)

**Team** - Individual contributor, in future team of 1–3 (business analysts, tech ops and MIS analysts)based on business growth; work with external vendors and system integrators

**Location** - Mumbai

**Experience** - 6-9 years in an NBFC/HFC, bank or fintech, with at least 3-4 years in a lead level role in technology programs, business analysis or operations

**1. Role Summary**

The AVP owns the interface between Treasury, Compliance, Finance and Technology. The role is accountable for the systems, data and controls that support securitisation, with priority on pass-through certificate (PTC) transactions, as well as direct assignment (DA), for translating RBI regulations into timely system and process changes, and for governing the technology budget so that spend stays aligned to business priorities.

The AVP leads a small team, represents Technology in senior management and committee forums, and is the single point of accountability for regulatory and securitisation data quality on the technology side. The role also carries technology-side ownership of data protection (DPDP Act) readiness and adherence to the company's IT governance framework.

**2. Key Responsibilities2.1 Securitisation and loan transfer (HFC) – PTC as priority**

* **PTC transactions (priority):** Own the technology and data readiness for pass-through certificate (PTC) issuances through an SPV/trust: pool cut, loan-level data tape, tranche-wise reporting and post-closing servicing, with faster and error-free turnaround on each deal.

* **Tranche structure:** Apply a working understanding of senior, mezzanine and junior (equity/first-loss) tranches, and of credit enhancement (overcollateralisation, excess spread, cash collateral, first-loss facility), when defining system logic, data fields and reports.

* **Cashflow waterfall:** Specify, build and validate the cashflow waterfall model: collections and prepayments, servicer and trustee fees, senior interest and principal, mezzanine and junior payouts, priority of payments, triggers and early-amortisation conditions, and reserve/escrow movements.

* **Reconciliation and controls:** Ensure each monthly waterfall run ties to servicer collections, escrow and trustee statements, and to tranche-wise investor payouts; investigate breaks and record sign-offs.

* Own the end-to-end technology and data framework for securitisation, DA and co-lending: pool selection, pool cut, loan-level data tapes from the LMS/LOS, and post-transfer servicing.

* Define and govern pool eligibility logic (seasoning, LTV, DPD, ticket size, ROI, product mix) against RBI norms, investor and rating agency criteria.

* Ensure system-level compliance with RBI's securitisation and transfer of loan exposures directions, including minimum holding period (MHP), minimum retention requirement (MRR), true-sale conditions and disclosures.

* Lead data and due-diligence support to Treasury, trustees, servicers, rating agencies, auditors and legal counsel; sign off on data integrity before submission.

* Drive automation of servicer and investor reporting, collection and escrow reconciliation, waterfall checks and pool performance MIS (collection efficiency, prepayments, delinquency).

* Ensure sold and reversed loans are correctly tagged in the core system, and that charge creation and satisfaction (CERSAI, ROC) and servicing flags remain consistent after transfer.

**2.2 RBI regulatory compliance (technology and data)**

* Run the regulatory change process: track RBI circulars and master directions for HFCs and NBFCs (scale-based regulation, IT governance, outsourcing of IT services, digital lending, KYC, fair practices, credit information reporting), assess impact and drive delivery to deadline.

* Own impact analysis, BRD/FRD approval, UAT governance and go-live sign-off for regulatory changes.

* Ensure the accuracy of regulatory returns and submissions through data mapping, source reconciliation, maker-checker controls and audit trails.

* Serve as the technology counterpart to Compliance, Risk and Internal/IS Audit; own closure of IT-related audit observations and report status to management.

* Support regulatory examinations and IT-related inspection queries with accurate, evidence-backed responses (see 2.6 for governance and data protection).

**2.3 IT budget control and vendor governance**

* Own the annual IT budget (CapEx/OpEx) across projects, vendors and cost centres; present budget-versus-actual and forecast to the CTO/COO and CFO monthly.

* Approve or challenge vendor invoices, SOWs, change requests and AMC/licence renewals against contracts and approved budgets.

* Lead business cases, TCO and ROI analysis for new initiatives; run the prioritisation of the change backlog with business heads.

* Flag overruns and forecast variances early and present corrective options; enforce spend discipline and approval workflows.

* Lead vendor negotiations, SLA reviews and contract renewals; maintain vendor scorecards.

**2.4 Technology operations**

* Govern the change request pipeline, release calendar, and incident and problem management for LMS, LOS, collections, treasury and finance systems.

* Set and track SLA and turnaround targets; ensure root-cause analysis and permanent fixes for repeat issues.

* Ensure process maps, data dictionaries, runbooks and SOPs are current and audit-ready.

* Oversee production support, reconciliations, and month-end and quarter-end closures with IT, operations and business teams.

**2.5 Team leadership and stakeholder management**

* Lead, coach and set objectives for the team; build depth in securitisation, regulatory and budgeting skills.

* Represent Technology in forums with senior management, auditors, rating agencies and, where required, RBI inspection and supervisory interactions.

* Build a risk and controls culture: documented ownership, segregation of duties and evidence retention.

**2.6 Data protection (DPDP) and IT governance**

* **DPDP Act readiness:** Lead the technology side of compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules: data inventory and mapping across LOS, LMS, collections and vendor systems, consent and notice capture, purpose limitation, data principal rights (access, correction, erasure, grievance), retention and deletion, and personal data breach detection and reporting.

* **Data sharing in securitisation and vendor flows:** Ensure loan-level tapes shared with investors, trustees, rating agencies and vendors carry only necessary data, with masking or anonymisation where possible, and that data-processor contracts and access controls meet DPDP and RBI outsourcing requirements.

* **Governance framework:** Operate within RBI's IT governance, risk, controls and assurance requirements: maintain IT policies and their review cycle, prepare papers for the IT Strategy Committee, IT Steering Committee and Board, and track committee decisions to closure.

* **Three lines of defence:** Keep clear ownership, segregation of duties, access reviews and evidence retention for technology controls, and work with Risk, Compliance and Internal/IS Audit as first-line owner of remediation.

* **Third-party and resilience oversight:** Own IT vendor risk assessments, exit plans and BCP/DR test evidence, and review cyber incident reporting and information security controls with the CISO and Compliance.

* **Awareness:** Run periodic briefings for the team and business users on data handling, privacy and governance expectations.

**3. Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Commerce, Finance or a related field; MBA (Finance), CA, CS or equivalent is a strong advantage.

* 10–14 years in an NBFC, HFC or bank, with hands-on exposure to securitisation, particularly PTC transactions, plus DA or co-lending operations.

* Strong understanding of securitisation structures: senior, mezzanine and junior tranches, credit enhancement, rating agency methodology and the cashflow waterfall, including the ability to build or review waterfall models in Excel/SQL.

* Deep working knowledge of RBI regulations for NBFCs/HFCs and how they translate into systems, data and controls.

* Working knowledge of the DPDP Act, 2023 and its Rules, and of RBI IT governance, outsourcing and cyber security requirements, with experience applying them in systems and vendor arrangements.

* Experience presenting to or preparing papers for IT/Board-level committees and handling audit or regulatory inspections.

* Proven experience owning IT budgets and vendor contracts, including variance management and business case approval.

* Strong SQL and Excel skills; experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau or similar); ability to review and challenge analyst work.

* Track record of delivering BRDs/FRDs, UAT and regulatory go-lives under fixed deadlines; familiarity with Agile and SDLC.

* Prior experience leading a team and presenting to senior management or committees.

**4. Preferred**

* Experience of end-to-end PTC issuance (arranger, trustee, rating agency and investor interactions) and of trustee/investor reporting platforms.

* Experience with LMS/LOS platforms used in housing finance, and with treasury tools.

* Understanding of housing loan products, LTV, PMAY subsidy processes and CERSAI/ROC filings.

* Familiarity with IS audit, ISO 27001 or COBIT, and API/integration basics.

* Certifications such as CBAP, PMP, CISA, CISM, CIPP/CIPM or Scrum, or data privacy certifications (e.g. DCPP).

**5. Key Competencies**

* Structured-finance thinking: comfort with tranching, credit enhancement and waterfall mechanics, and the ability to explain them to non-specialists.

* Strategic thinking with strong attention to data accuracy and control.

* Influence and communication with senior stakeholders, auditors and external counterparties.

* Prioritisation across regulatory, treasury and IT deadlines.

* Financial discipline and commercial judgement in vendor and budget decisions.

* Privacy and governance mindset: default to data minimisation, documented approvals and evidence.

* Ownership, integrity and people leadership in an audit-sensitive environment.

**6. Success Metrics (First 12 Months)**

* Zero data-quality exceptions in securitisation pool submissions and investor reports, with PTC deals executed on schedule.

* Tranche-wise waterfall reports reconciled to servicer, escrow and trustee statements every month with no unresolved breaks.

* All regulatory changes delivered on or before RBI deadlines.

* IT spend variance within the agreed tolerance of approved budget.

* Measurable reduction in change request turnaround time and in ageing of audit observations.

* DPDP data inventory, consent and breach-response process documented and approved, with gaps tracked to closure against the applicable timelines.

* IT governance committee papers and policy reviews delivered on schedule, with no overdue IT audit observations.

* Documented PTC data, waterfall and reporting framework, with automated reconciliations in place.

Pay: ₹1,800,000.00 - ₹2,200,000.00 per year

title: Deputy Manager/Manager - Foreign Trade India
description:
**Role Overview**
The Manager / Senior Manager – Foreign Trade India will be responsible for leading and managing all Foreign Trade, Customs, Export Control, and Trade Compliance activities across MAHLE India operations. The role will ensure complete compliance with customs laws, DGFT regulations, export control legislation, and international trade requirements while optimizing duty structures, leveraging government incentive schemes, and supporting business growth through efficient trade processes.
  
  
The incumbent will serve as the key interface with Customs Authorities, DGFT, Government Agencies, Logistics Service Providers, and internal stakeholders to drive compliance, cost optimization, risk mitigation, and continuous process improvements across the organization.
  
  
**Your Contribution**
**Foreign Trade & Customs Management**

* Lead all customs and foreign trade activities across MAHLE India entities.
* Ensure legally compliant import and export operations at the lowest lawful cost.
* Manage customs clearance processes, import/export documentation, tariff classification, and valuation activities.
* Drive optimization of customs duties through applicable schemes and regulatory provisions.
* Coordinate with Customs Authorities, DGFT, Chambers of Commerce, and other government bodies.
* Manage customs brokers, consultants, and logistics service providers.
* Ensure robust and compliant inbound and outbound customs processes.

**Export Control & Trade Compliance**
  
  

* Ensure compliance with global and local Export Control Regulations.
* Manage Export Control classifications for products, technology transfers, and software.
* Implement and govern:

+ Sanctioned Party Screening
+ Embargo Country Checks
+ End-use Verification
+ Export Authorization Requirements

* Conduct periodic audits and compliance reviews across locations.
* Provide guidance to business functions on export control obligations.
* Possess authority to stop transactions or exports that violate export control regulations.

**Government Incentives & Trade Programs**
  
  

* Drive implementation and effective utilization of government export incentive schemes.
* Manage:

+ RoDTEP
+ Duty Drawback Schemes
+ AIR and Brand Rate Schemes
+ Section 74 Refund Claims

* Ensure timely claim filing and maximize incentive realization with minimum pendency.
* Support implementation of AEO, MOOWR, and similar trade facilitation programs.

**Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* Monitor changes in customs, DGFT, and international trade regulations.
* Evaluate regulatory impact on business operations and advise management accordingly.
* Handle legal notices, investigations, summons, SCNs, DRI and SIIB matters.
* Mitigate customs and trade compliance risks through robust internal controls.
* Lead external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings.

Process Improvement & Digitalization
  
  

* Drive standardization and continuous improvement of foreign trade processes.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings and operational efficiencies.
* Support digitalization initiatives and automation of trade compliance activities.
* Define regional requirements and integrate them into global standards.
* Develop sustainable solutions for customs and trade-related challenges.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with Purchase, Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance, Legal, IT, and Engineering teams.
* Act as the primary liaison for trade compliance matters with authorities and external agencies.
* Support strategic business initiatives involving international trade activities.
* Regularly communicate compliance status, risks, and improvement initiatives to management.

**Leadership Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and mentor the Foreign Trade team.
* Build organizational capability in customs and export control compliance.
* Conduct training and awareness programs across business functions.
* Promote a culture of compliance and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance to plant Export Control Officers and other compliance stakeholders.

**Your Experience And Qualification**

* 10+ years of experience in Foreign Trade, Customs, Export Control, and Trade Compliance.
* Strong experience managing import/export operations in a manufacturing environment.

**Expertise In**
  
  


* Customs Laws and Procedures
* DGFT Regulations
* Export Control Legislation (EU, US and India)
* Origin Management and Free Trade Agreements
* Government Export Incentive Schemes
* Experience handling customs investigations, audits, legal notices, and regulatory interactions.
* Knowledge of AEO, MOOWR, and other trade facilitation programs preferred.
* Strong exposure to working with government authorities and regulatory agencies.
* Proven people leadership and stakeholder management capability.
* Graduate or Post-Graduate in Foreign Trade, International Business, Commerce, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related disciplines.
* Professional certifications in Customs, Trade Compliance, Export-Import Management, or Supply Chain Management will be an advantage.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The ideal candidate is a proven people manager with a solid technical foundation in cloud-native infrastructure, including Kubernetes and containerized platforms, and a background in platform engineering or site reliability engineering. You should be comfortable managing technical teams, understanding operational challenges, facilitating cross-team discussions, and making sure priorities and expectations are clear.
  
  
**Note:**
There will be 2–3 hours of daily overlap with US Pacific Time
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Team Leadership
  
  

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of Infrastructure Platform Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers through regular 1:1s, performance feedback, goal setting, and career development.
* Set clear expectations and development plans that grow engineers toward greater technical ownership, communication skills, and independence.
* Own the team’s day-to-day execution, workload prioritization, and delivery commitments.
* Lead hiring and onboarding as the team grows.

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Collaborate with TechOps leaders to define and maintain the team’s operating standards, including on-call, change management, incident response, and post-incident follow-up, in line with global SRE and Platform Engineering practices.
* Lead the team’s incident response and work with Problem Management to drive corrective actions to completion.
* Balance operational responsibilities, project work, automation, technical debt, and reliability improvements.
* Identify recurring operational challenges and drive lasting improvements with the team and partner technical leads.

Cross-Team Partnership
  
  

* Serve as the primary infrastructure engineering representative within the India office.
* Build working relationships with software engineering, data science, program management, release teams, and other partner organizations, and resolve priorities and dependencies across teams.
* Represent the team in planning, release, and operational discussions, making sure reliability, supportability, and operational concerns are raised early and addressed.
* Keep the India team aligned with the broader global Platform Engineering organization.

**About You**

title: Director- Cloud Data Platform Operations
description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**Role purpose**
Own the strategy, product roadmap, engineering direction, adoption, reliability and end-to-end service performance of enterprise data and database platforms.
  
  
**Platform scope**
Analytical platforms and services, including Snowflake, Databricks and Microsoft Fabric, together with OLTP and operational database services such as Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle and Azure Cosmos DB.
  
  
**Operating model**
Lead platform engineering and product ownership while partnering closely with Operations Service Delivery Managers (SDMs) and support teams for stable, secure and efficient day-to-day service delivery.
  
  
**Leadership profile**
A technically credible platform leader who can translate business demand into product capabilities, influence vendors and stakeholders, and grow adoption across the enterprise.
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Cloud Data Platform Product & Engineering Leader is accountable for the full lifecycle of enterprise data and database platform services. The role combines deep technical leadership with product ownership, service management and commercial influence. It covers analytical and AI-enabled platforms as well as operational and transactional database services, ensuring that the portfolio evolves as a coherent enterprise capability rather than a collection of individually managed technologies.
  
  
The leader will define the platform vision and multi-year roadmap, prioritize investment, guide engineering standards, drive adoption, and ensure reliable and secure service delivery. The role will work closely with Operations SDMs, platform engineering teams, architecture, security, risk, application teams, data engineering teams and strategic technology vendors to ensure smooth day-to-day operations while progressing modernization, automation and customer-led product outcomes.
  
  
This is not a traditional people-manager or operations-only position. It requires a leader who can move comfortably between executive strategy, architecture and engineering decisions, product prioritization, vendor negotiations, operational governance and direct engagement with internal platform consumers.
  
  
Scope boundary: This team will provide Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform Engineering as a product. It will build and operate the shared infrastructure, platform services, automation, controls and self-service capabilities that enable data engineering, analytics, data science and AI/ML teams. It will not perform the application-level data engineering or data scientist activities owned by those consuming teams.
  
  
Role Mandate
  
  

* Own the enterprise product strategy and roadmap for Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform services supporting analytics, AI/ML, data engineering, OLTP and operational database workloads.
* Run the platform portfolio as a set of secure, resilient, scalable, cost-effective and consumable enterprise products.
* Establish clear service boundaries: the team owns Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform Engineering as a product, while consuming teams retain responsibility for data pipeline development, data transformation, analytical model development, data science and business use-case implementation.
* Balance innovation and modernization with operational stability, regulatory obligations and service performance.
* Increase adoption through clear service offerings, reusable patterns, self-service capabilities, simplified onboarding and an improved developer and customer experience.
* Provide the technical depth and leadership needed to challenge design decisions, guide engineering priorities and build credibility with highly technical teams.
* Create an effective partnership between product and engineering ownership and Operations SDMs responsible for service delivery, support coordination and operational governance.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Platform Product Strategy & Roadmap
* Own and communicate the vision, product strategy and multi-year roadmap for the enterprise cloud data and database platform portfolio.
* Define the target Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform portfolio across analytical platforms, AI/ML enablement, OLTP databases, NoSQL services, integration foundations and associated platform capabilities.
* Translate business, application, analytics and engineering demand into prioritized product capabilities, investment proposals and measurable outcomes.
* Manage the full product lifecycle, including capability discovery, business case development, prioritization, delivery, adoption, modernization and retirement.
* Build and maintain a transparent roadmap that balances strategic transformation, regulatory commitments, technical debt, resilience, customer demand and cost optimization.
* Establish product principles, service boundaries, service tiers, consumption models and a clear platform service catalog.
* Broad Data & Database Platform Ownership
* Own enterprise infrastructure platform direction and service outcomes for Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric and other cloud data platform services.
* Own platform direction and service outcomes for OLTP and operational database technologies including Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Azure Cosmos DB and relevant managed cloud database services.
* Ensure appropriate patterns exist for relational, NoSQL, distributed, streaming and analytical workloads, with clear guidance on technology selection and fit-for-purpose use.
* Drive interoperability across analytical and transactional platforms so that application data, operational data and analytical data can be governed and consumed effectively.
* Partner with architecture and application teams on modernization, database migration, platform consolidation and cloud-native adoption decisions.
* Technical Leadership & Platform Engineering
* Provide hands-on technical leadership across cloud architecture, database platform engineering, reliability engineering, infrastructure as code, DevSecOps, shared data integration foundations and platform automation.
* Define and govern reference architectures, engineering standards, reusable patterns, deployment approaches, observability requirements and operational readiness criteria.
* Guide the design of secure, scalable, resilient and cost-efficient platform services across Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Challenge designs constructively, lead technical trade-off decisions and ensure engineering investment addresses reliability, maintainability, performance and customer experience.
* Drive automation, policy as code, self-service provisioning, standardized onboarding, automated controls and self-healing capabilities.
* Sponsor technical debt reduction and platform modernization while maintaining service continuity.
* Adoption, Customer Experience & Internal Client Partnership
* Drive adoption of Cloud Data Infrastructure Platform products by application engineering, data engineering, analytics, data science, AI/ML and business-aligned technology teams.
* Build a structured engagement model with internal clients to understand demand, pain points, onboarding barriers and future capability needs.
* Simplify the customer journey from discovery and architecture consultation through provisioning, onboarding, production readiness and ongoing support.
* Develop platform documentation, reference architectures, reusable infrastructure patterns, onboarding guidance, training and community engagement that accelerate responsible platform usage.
* Measure adoption, consumption, customer satisfaction, onboarding lead time, developer productivity and realized business value.
* Act as the senior escalation and relationship owner for strategic platform consumers.
* Operations Partnership & Service Delivery
* Work closely with Operations SDMs to ensure smooth, reliable and predictable day-to-day running of the platform portfolio.
* Define clear accountability and handoffs across product, engineering, operations, managed service providers and vendor support organizations.
* Partner with SDMs on service reviews, incident trends, problem management, change quality, capacity, availability, support demand, service risks and continual improvement.
* Ensure new capabilities and major changes meet operational readiness, supportability, monitoring, documentation, resilience and recovery requirements before production adoption.
* Provide technical and product leadership during major incidents, recurring service issues and high-risk changes, while ensuring long-term corrective actions are prioritized on the roadmap.
* Ensure runbooks, support models, escalation routes, knowledge management and service ownership remain current as the platform evolves.
* Align engineering automation and SRE priorities with recurring operational pain points to reduce manual effort, incident volume, risk and support cost.
* Reliability, Security, Risk & Governance
* Own platform outcomes for availability, performance, scalability, recoverability, security, compliance and operational resilience.
* Define and govern SLAs, SLOs, service health indicators, capacity thresholds, recovery objectives and key risk measures.
* Ensure backup, disaster recovery and business continuity capabilities are designed, documented, tested and improved.
* Partner with cyber security, technology risk, compliance and data governance teams to embed controls into platform architecture and engineering workflows.
* Drive timely remediation of vulnerabilities, audit findings, control gaps, end-of-life technologies and operational risks.
* Ensure regulated and sensitive workloads are supported through appropriate access controls, encryption, segregation, monitoring and evidence.
* Vendor, Commercial & Ecosystem Influence
* Own strategic relationships with technology vendors such as Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft, AWS, Oracle and other relevant partners.
* Influence vendor roadmaps by articulating enterprise requirements, service gaps, control needs, adoption barriers and future use cases.
* Lead executive and technical governance with vendors, including product reviews, escalation management, support effectiveness and roadmap alignment.
* Partner with sourcing and finance on commercial strategy, licensing, consumption commitments, contract outcomes and value realization.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor capabilities using clear architectural, operational, commercial, security and adoption criteria.
* Hold managed service providers and support partners accountable for service quality, engineering outcomes, skills, productivity and continuous improvement.
* Financial Management & FinOps
* Own platform cost transparency, forecasting, unit economics, optimization and investment planning.
* Establish showback or chargeback-ready consumption views where appropriate and help consumers understand the cost impact of design and usage decisions.
* Drive optimization across licensing, compute, storage, data movement, retention, reservations, support models and platform consolidation.
* Balance cost efficiency with reliability, performance, security and strategic growth requirements.
* Stakeholder Influence & Executive Communication
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior technology, architecture, engineering, risk and business stakeholders.
* Present product strategy, roadmap choices, investment cases, platform health, adoption, risk and value outcomes to executive forums.
* Influence priorities across teams without relying solely on direct authority, and resolve competing interests through clear data, principles and enterprise outcomes.
* Create clear decision papers, executive scorecards and recommendations that connect technical choices to business value and risk.
* People & Capability Leadership
* Lead, mentor and develop a high-performing, globally distributed team spanning platform engineering, database engineering, reliability and operations capabilities.
* Build deep technical capability while strengthening product thinking, customer orientation, ownership and commercial awareness.
* Establish clear objectives, accountability, development plans, succession coverage and communities of practice.
* Create a culture of engineering excellence, experimentation, learning, constructive challenge and operational discipline.
* Attract and retain talent capable of operating across legacy, current and emerging data and database technologies.

Platform Scope
  
  
**Domain**
**Representative Technologies**
**Leadership Focus**
**Analytics & AI**
Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Spark
  
  
Infrastructure platform engineering, governed self-service, workload enablement and scale
  
  
**OLTP & Relational**
Microsoft SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, managed relational database services
  
  
Transactional performance, availability, migration, modernization and lifecycle management
  
  
**NoSQL & Distributed**
Azure Cosmos DB and relevant cloud-native NoSQL services
  
  
Global distribution, scalability, data modelling, consistency and cost management
  
  
**Integration & Pipelines**
Airflow, dbt, Kafka, cloud-native integration and orchestration services
  
  
Shared integration foundations, reusable infrastructure patterns, interoperability, observability and deployment automation
  
  
**Engineering Foundation**
Terraform, GitHub, CI/CD, containers, Kubernetes, monitoring and policy as code
  
  
Secure self-service, standardization, automation, controls and reliability
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related discipline. A master's degree is preferred.
* 15+ years of overall technology experience, including significant experience in cloud, data, database, platform engineering or infrastructure services.
* 10+ years of relevant experience across platform engineering, database engineering, cloud engineering, data engineering, SRE or technology product leadership.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with accountability for globally distributed engineering and/or operations teams.
* Proven ownership of an enterprise technology platform, product or service portfolio, including strategy, roadmap, investment prioritization and adoption.
* Demonstrated experience with both analytical data platforms and OLTP or operational database platforms.
* Experience leading enterprise-scale services in Azure and/or AWS, preferably within a regulated environment.
* Proven success influencing senior stakeholders, architecture forums, strategic vendors and internal clients.
* Experience partnering with service delivery leaders, operations teams and managed service providers to deliver stable and continuously improving services.
* Demonstrated ability to convert technical strategy into funded roadmaps, measurable delivery outcomes and increased platform adoption.

Required Technical & Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Deep knowledge of at least two major analytical or data engineering platforms, such as Snowflake, Databricks or Microsoft Fabric.
* Strong knowledge of OLTP database platforms, including Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL, with working knowledge of Oracle and Azure Cosmos DB or comparable services.
* Strong understanding of database architecture, performance, availability, backup and recovery, replication, security, migration and lifecycle management.
* Practical experience with cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Terraform, GitHub-based CI/CD, automation, observability and secure deployment practices.
* Understanding of data pipelines, streaming, orchestration and engineering frameworks such as Spark, Airflow, dbt and Kafka.
* Ability to lead architecture and engineering discussions while remaining outcome-oriented and accessible to non-technical stakeholders.
* Product management capability, including discovery, roadmap prioritization, customer feedback, adoption measurement and value realization.
* Strong commercial judgment and experience managing vendor performance, support relationships, licensing and consumption-based services.
* Executive communication, negotiation, conflict resolution and the ability to influence across organizational boundaries.
* People leadership with a track record of mentoring technical leaders, developing talent and building accountable teams.

Key Success Measures
  
  

* Clear, funded and actively governed multi-year product roadmap aligned to enterprise technology and business priorities.
* Increased adoption and responsible consumption of analytical, AI/ML and OLTP platform services.
* Reduced onboarding time and improved customer experience through standardized, automated and self-service capabilities.
* Consistent achievement of reliability, performance, security, recoverability and compliance objectives.
* Effective partnership with Operations SDMs, demonstrated through clear accountability, improved service performance and closure of recurring operational issues.
* Reduced incident recurrence, manual effort, technical debt, operational risk and support cost through engineering-led improvements.
* Improved productivity for application, data engineering, data science and analytics teams through reusable infrastructure patterns, platform services and standards.
* Measurable cost efficiency and transparent consumption management across the platform portfolio.
* Strategic vendor relationships that improve support outcomes, influence roadmaps and deliver commercial value.
* Strong stakeholder confidence in the platform organization as a product, engineering and service partner.

Leadership Profile
  
  
The successful candidate will be a technically strong, commercially aware and customer-oriented platform leader. They will combine the discipline required to run critical enterprise services with the ambition to modernize the portfolio and grow adoption. They will be equally credible with engineers, Operations SDMs, architects, risk partners, vendors, application owners and executives, and will create alignment around a clear product strategy and measurable enterprise outcomes.
  
  
**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

Eaton announced, on June 11, 2026, the intent to combine its Mobility Group (including both the Vehicle and eMobility segments) with a new company. The compensation and benefits that will initially be offered for this position are based on Eaton's plans, programs and practices. The role will direct a glpbal multidisciplinary team of 20+ engineers responsible for new product and technology development, product launches, and current-product engineering across switches, keypads, electronic control modules, wireless and connected devices, and associated embedded hardware and software. The position will align with the Vehicle Control & Wireless business and collaborate with Strategy, Sales & Marketing, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, Quality, and Finance to define strategic priorities and deliver growth, profitability, quality, and customer commitments. title: Talent Attraction and Process Excellence Manager
description:

Cummins is seeking a dynamic and innovative Employer Branding & Process Excellence Manager to support Talent Acquisition across India and the Pacific region. This role will lead initiatives that strengthen our employer brand, enhance recruitment processes, advance technology and AI adoption, improve diversity hiring outcomes, and deliver actionable talent insights. * Support and advance diverse hiring strategies across India and the Pacific region.
* Develop partnerships and sourcing channels that broaden access to diverse talent pools.
* Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, and HR leaders to promote inclusive hiring practices.
* Monitor hiring trends and recommend initiatives that strengthen workforce representation.

Reporting & Analytics
  
  

* Develop and maintain talent acquisition dashboards, reports, and insights.
* Analyze recruiting trends, labor market data, and talent metrics to support business decisions.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to Talent Acquisition and business leaders.
* Support workforce planning, forecasting, and executive reporting activities.

Stakeholder & Project Management
  
  

* Lead cross-functional projects and Talent Acquisition initiatives.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, Communications, Technology, and business leaders.
* Coordinate regional and global programs that support Talent Acquisition transformation.
* Drive communication, governance, and knowledge-sharing across the Talent Acquisition community.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, HR Operations, Process Improvement, HR Technology, or related areas.

* Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

Human Resources Business Process Execution - Manages the execution of Human Resources business processes, seeking efficiency, accuracy, positive business performance outcomes and operational agility; integrates activities across processes as needed; assures compliance with process and legal requirements; effectively balances process requirements and business leader needs.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
Interpersonal savvy - Relating openly and comfortably with diverse groups of people.
  
  
Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  
  
Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  
  
Demonstrates self-awareness - Using a combination of feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into personal strengths and weaknesses.

Education, Licenses, Certifications: Professional certifications in project management, HR management, or directly related to the 30% or equivalent experience are preferred.

This role operates across the India and Pacific region, partnering with global Talent Acquisition, HR Technology, Communications, and business leaders to drive strategic talent initiatives. title: Digital Shelf Manager
description:
**About the Role:**
The Digital Shelf Manager is responsible for maximizing product visibility, discoverability, content quality and conversion across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms. The role will own digital shelf excellence by ensuring accurate and compelling product content, high availability, strong search performance, pricing compliance and competitive visibility. This position will work closely with internal cross-functional teams, platform partners and external agencies to drive best-in-class online shopper experiences and support sustainable e-commerce growth.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities:**
Digital Shelf Management
  
  

* Own and manage digital shelf health across marketplaces, quick commerce and eB2B platforms.
* Ensure complete and accurate product content across all online channels, maintaining high standards of digital shelf excellence.
* Drive continuous improvements in product page quality, visibility and shopper experience.

**Product Content & Catalog Management**

* Manage end-to-end product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, videos, A+ content, keywords, attributes and product page optimization.
* Ensure all product content aligns with brand guidelines and platform requirements.
* Identify and address gaps in hero images, pack shots, product claims, benefit communication and conversion-driving content.

**Search & Discoverability Optimization**

* Improve organic search rankings and product discoverability across platforms.
* Optimize keyword strategies and content to increase share of shelf for priority SKUs.
* Monitor and enhance product visibility through ongoing search performance analysis.

**Availability, Pricing & Compliance Monitoring**

* Track product availability, out-of-stock levels and assortment performance across platforms.
* Ensure pricing hygiene and compliance with platform-specific pricing policies.
* Monitor content compliance, ratings, reviews and platform standards to maintain brand consistency.

**Competitive Intelligence**

* Monitor competitor listings, content quality, pricing, assortment, promotions, ratings, reviews and search visibility.
* Identify marketplace trends, emerging opportunities and competitive threats.
* Translate competitive insights into actionable recommendations for business growth.

**New Product Launch Support**

* Support new product introductions through timely listing creation, content readiness, keyword mapping and platform asset deployment.
* Ensure seamless execution of launch plans across digital commerce platforms.
* Track launch performance and provide recommendations to improve visibility and sales outcomes.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner closely with Brand, Category, E-Commerce, Media, Supply Chain and Agency teams to execute digital shelf initiatives.
* Work with platform teams and account managers to resolve catalog, content, listing and visibility issues.
* Coordinate stakeholder alignment to ensure timely implementation of content and visibility enhancements.

**Review & Consumer Insights Management**

* Monitor consumer ratings and reviews across platforms.
* Identify recurring product, content and service-related improvement opportunities based on shopper feedback.
* Collaborate with relevant teams to address consumer concerns and improve overall customer experience.

**Performance Tracking & Reporting**

* Develop and maintain digital shelf scorecards covering content quality, search performance, availability, pricing, ratings and competitive benchmarks.
* Analyze digital shelf performance metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Prepare weekly, monthly and quarterly business reports with insights, action plans and accountability tracking.

**About You:**

* 5-8 years of experience in E-Commerce, Digital Commerce, Digital Shelf Management, Category Management or Online Marketplace Operations
* Experience working with major marketplaces, quick commerce platforms and eB2B channels
* Strong understanding of digital shelf analytics, marketplace algorithms and content optimization practices

title: Associate Manager - Instock
description:
**Job Description**
****ASSOCIATE MANAGER, IN-STOCK OPERATIONS****
****Role Summary****
**The Associate Manager, In-Stock Operations leads a team of In-Stock Specialists, translating individual execution into consistent team-wide performance. You own the team's output quality, capacity, and development - setting priorities, unblocking your team, and driving the projects that move inventory health metrics forward. You are accountable for your team's results, not just your own.**
****What You'll Do****

* Manage a team of In-Stock Specialists (I, II, and Senior) - setting goals, assigning work, and monitoring performance against SLAs and inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate).
* Own hiring, onboarding, performance reviews, coaching, and career development for direct reports.
* Run team rituals (1:1s, stand-ups, retros) and maintain a clear view of team capacity, workload distribution, and coverage.
* Lead cross-functional projects end-to-end (e.g., WBR, new brand onboarding, expiration-date programme) - defining scope, timelines, and success metrics, and coordinating across brand management, the US team, and leadership.
* Identify and prioritize automation and process-improvement opportunities across the team, and hold owners accountable for shipping them.
* Own and present WBR-level reporting and inventory health metrics to leadership, translating data into a clear narrative and action plan.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex vendor, catalogue, or marketplace issues that require cross-team coordination or leadership visibility.
* Partner with brand management and marketplace leads to align on inventory strategy and proactively manage risk.
* Build and maintain team documentation, training materials, and onboarding processes so the team scales without you as a bottleneck.

****What Success Looks Like****

* Team consistently meets or exceeds SLAs
* Your team's capacity and skills grow over time - specialists are promoted, and the team absorbs more scope without proportional headcount growth.
* Cross-functional projects you own land on time and deliver measurable results.
* You spend meaningfully more time on planning, coaching, and problem-solving than on individual task execution.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in inventory operations, supply chain, or e-commerce operations, including direct ownership of core inventory processes.
* Prior experience managing or leading a team - formally or informally - including hiring, coaching, and performance management.
* Strong project management skills - able to scope, sequence, and drive cross-functional projects to completion.
* Deep fluency in inventory health metrics (DIO, in-stock rate) and the forecasting/ordering mechanics that drive them.
* Comfortable pulling and synthesizing data from multiple systems (e.g., Snowflake, brand selling accounts) to build a narrative for leadership.
* Track record of identifying and shipping process or automation improvements using AI tools, scripts, or workflow automation.
* Experience with e-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Chewy, Australia marketplace, or equivalent) strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to build trust with stakeholders across functions and time zones.

Standardize prioritization, escalation, handovers, ticket quality, runbooks and service acceptance criteria. Run weekly operational reviews, monthly service reviews and quarterly improvement reviews; track actions, exceptions and overdue commitments.

Coordinate root cause reviews and verify that corrective actions reduce recurrence. Improve self-service, knowledge reuse, routing and shift-left resolution. title: GM - Employee Experience Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced employee experience professional to lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the end-to-end employee experience across VOIS. This role will shape employee journeys throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business strategy, organisational culture, employee value proposition (EVP), workplace experience priorities and transformation ambitions.
  
  
Working across multiple geographies and national cultures, the successful candidate will combine strategic thinking with hands-on delivery to create meaningful, engaging and data-led employee experiences that improve engagement, productivity, retention, wellbeing and organisational effectiveness. The role will also champion AI-enabled and technology-driven employee experience solutions, ensuring that the employee voice is at the centre of decision-making and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and drive the Employee Experience (EX) strategy aligned with business goals, EVP, culture ambitions and talent priorities.
* Design and continuously improve end-to-end employee journeys across onboarding, development, mobility, career progression and offboarding.
* Leverage employee feedback, engagement data and workforce insights to identify priorities and deliver impactful interventions.
* Lead employee listening programs, surveys and feedback mechanisms, translating insights into measurable actions.
* Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Culture and Communications teams to create seamless and consistent employee experiences.
* Drive adoption of digital, workplace and AI-enabled solutions through effective change management and employee engagement initiatives.
* Develop recognition, appreciation and belonging programs that strengthen employee engagement and connection to the organization.
* Establish employee experience KPIs, dashboards and reporting frameworks to measure program effectiveness and business impact.
* Introduce innovative practices and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity and retention.
* Collaborate with business leaders, Group HR and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, influence decision-making and deliver sustainable employee experience outcomes

**Who You Are**

* Significant experience in employee experience, engagement, organisational effectiveness or related people functions
* Proven success designing and improving employee journeys across the employee lifecycle
* Experience delivering people initiatives across global, multi-cultural and matrixed organisations
* Strong analytical capability with experience translating data and employee insights into meaningful business outcomes
* Skilled in stakeholder engagement, collaboration and influencing across diverse functions and leadership levels
* Strong understanding of employee listening methodologies, engagement frameworks and experience design principles
* Knowledge of AI-enabled ways of working, technology adoption and modern workplace practices
* Excellent communication, change enablement and relationship management skills
* Ability to balance long-term strategy with pragmatic execution
* Passion for creating inclusive, employee-centred environments where people can thrive and perform at their best

**Not a perfect fit?**
Worried that you don’t meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* Opportunity to shape the employee experience strategy for a large, global organisation
* Exposure to senior leaders and key stakeholders across HR, business functions and Group teams
* Ability to influence culture, EVP activation, employee engagement and organisational transformation
* Opportunity to lead innovative employee listening, workplace and AI-enabled experience initiatives
* Work across multiple countries, cultures and business environments
* Play a visible role in driving organisational effectiveness, productivity and employee satisfaction

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced employee experience strategy and lifecycle design
* Employee listening, sentiment analysis and data-driven decision-making
* Global stakeholder management and influencing within complex matrix organisations
* AI-enabled employee experience and workplace transformation practices
* Organisational culture, EVP activation and engagement programme leadership
* Experience measurement, analytics and impact assessment methodologies
* Cross-functional collaboration across HR, Technology, Communications, Property and business teams

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

title: Facilities Engineer - Senior
description:
**Job Summary**
The Facilities Engineer – Senior is responsible for managing and maintaining plant facilities, building systems, infrastructure, and site services while ensuring safe, reliable, compliant, and efficient operations.
  
  
The role provides technical and project leadership for complex facilities and capital projects, including planning, design, budgeting, execution, contractor management, risk management, and project closeout. The position works closely with Operations, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Security, Engineering, and site leadership to deliver infrastructure solutions aligned with business requirements, operational continuity, sustainability objectives, and long-term site strategies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Facilities Operations & Maintenance**

* Oversee the operation, maintenance, repair, and reliability of plant facilities, buildings, grounds, and associated infrastructure.
* Manage building systems including electrical, HVAC, structural, mechanical, fire/life safety, and other facility systems .
* Ensure preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities are planned and completed effectively.
* Identify facility risks and implement appropriate corrective and preventive actions to maintain safe and reliable operations.
* Document repairs, maintenance activities, inspections, and facility-related work completed.
* Provide technical guidance on complex facility maintenance and repair requirements.
* Train, coach, and mentor less experienced Facilities Engineers, technicians, and line personnel on complex maintenance activities and facility systems.

**Capital Project & Project Governance**

* Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of complex facilities and capital projects, including planning, scope definition, design, budgeting, execution, commissioning, and project closeout .
* Develop and manage project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables.
* Establish appropriate project governance, decision-making processes, reporting mechanisms, and stakeholder alignment.
* Prioritize facilities projects based on business requirements, operational needs, site infrastructure strategies, risk, cost, and available resources.
* Oversee complex renovation and infrastructure projects involving mechanical, structural, HVAC, electrical systems, production floor arrangements, and other facility modifications.
* Monitor project performance against scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and business objectives.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, and changes and implement appropriate mitigation and corrective actions.
* Ensure effective project closeout, documentation, lessons learned, and realization of intended project outcomes.

**Financial & Resource Management**

* Develop and manage capital expenditure and operational budgets for facilities projects and activities.
* Monitor project costs, forecasts, commitments, cash flow, and financial performance.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimization while maintaining safety, quality, compliance, and project requirements.
* Manage resource requirements across multiple projects and ensure effective allocation of internal and external resources.
* Support business cases, investment evaluations, project prioritization, and financial decision-making as required.

**Contractor, Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and oversee contractors, consultants, suppliers, and service providers involved in facilities projects and maintenance activities.
* Define expectations, monitor performance, manage deliverables, and ensure contractor compliance with site requirements.
* Support procurement and vendor selection activities in collaboration with Procurement and other relevant functions.
* Manage vendor risks, project dependencies, and performance issues to maintain project continuity.
* Serve as a key interface between Facilities, Operations, Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Security, Engineering, and site leadership.
* Communicate project status, risks, decisions, financial performance, and key issues to appropriate stakeholders.

**Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**

* Ensure facilities operations and projects comply with applicable corporate policies, statutory requirements, building codes, environmental regulations, and health and safety standards.
* Support site emergency preparedness programs and identify risks associated with events such as power outages, flooding, fire, and other facility emergencies .
* Develop and implement risk mitigation plans and ensure emergency systems are maintained and available.
* Monitor and report impairments affecting fire protection, flood protection, emergency systems, or other critical infrastructure.
* Ensure construction and renovation activities are executed safely and in compliance with applicable standards.
* Support regulatory inspections, audits, permits, compliance activities, and required documentation.

**Sustainability & Environmental Stewardship**

* Support and drive site environmental stewardship and sustainability initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency, resource utilization, environmental performance, and facility sustainability.
* Incorporate sustainability considerations into facilities planning, design, construction, and operational decisions.
* Support implementation of recognized environmental and sustainability programs applicable to the site.

**Facilities Technology & Infrastructure**

* Plan, manage, and support facility management technologies and operational systems.
* Evaluate and implement appropriate facility management technologies and integrated workplace management solutions.
* Assess facility technology requirements, including audio-visual systems, IT capacity, communication/phone systems, and related workplace technologies .
* Collaborate with relevant IT and business stakeholders to ensure facility technology supports operational and workplace requirements.

**Continuous Improvement & Business Support**

* Identify opportunities to improve facilities processes, reliability, cost effectiveness, service quality, and operational efficiency.
* Support infrastructure planning aligned with future business growth, capacity requirements, employee experience, and operational needs.
* Develop and maintain appropriate facilities standards, processes, procedures, and documentation.
* Provide technical expertise and decision support for facilities-related business requirements.
* Ensure continuity of critical facility services and minimize potential disruption to business operations.

**Competency**
**Technical & Functional Competencies**

* Facilities Design and Development: Plans and manages facility design and development activities considering the needs of owners, occupants, operations, and applicable building standards.
* Project Management: Manages project scope, schedule, resources, budget, risks, stakeholders, and deliverables across the project lifecycle.
* Project & Program Governance: Establishes appropriate governance, decision-making, reporting, and prioritization processes for facilities projects and programs.
* Strategic Planning & Execution: Aligns facilities infrastructure plans and project portfolios with business objectives, operational requirements, and long-term site strategies.
* Emergency Preparedness: Plans and supports emergency preparedness programs, risk assessments, emergency systems, and response readiness.
* Environmental Stewardship and Sustainability: Supports environmental performance and sustainability initiatives through appropriate programs, practices, and facility solutions.
* Facility Technology Management: Evaluates and manages facility management technologies and workplace infrastructure to meet operational requirements.
* Financial & Resource Management: Manages budgets, resources, cost controls, forecasts, and financial priorities across facilities activities and projects.
* Risk & Change Management: Identifies, assesses, and manages project, operational, safety, compliance, and change-related risks.
* Regulatory Compliance: Ensures facilities activities and projects meet applicable statutory, environmental, building, safety, and corporate requirements.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Builds effective relationships and aligns diverse stakeholders to support timely decisions and successful project execution.
* Vendor & Contractor Management: Establishes accountability and manages contractor, consultant, and supplier performance.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Action Oriented: Takes ownership of opportunities and challenges with urgency, energy, and accountability.
* Collaboration: Builds effective partnerships and works across functions to achieve shared objectives.
* Effective Communication: Communicates project, technical, financial, and operational information clearly to different audiences.
* Customer Focus: Understands stakeholder needs and delivers practical, reliable, and customer-focused facilities solutions.
* Optimizes Work Processes: Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement, efficiency, and cost optimization.
* Situational Adaptability: Adjusts approach effectively based on changing operational, project, and business requirements.
* Decision Quality: Makes timely, fact-based decisions considering safety, cost, quality, compliance, and business impact.
* Team Leadership & Coaching: Develops technical capability and provides guidance, mentoring, and coaching to team members.
* Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives and experiences across teams and stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent college/university degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline .
* Relevant professional certifications in facilities management, project management, safety, energy management, or related areas may be advantageous.
* Additional qualifications or certifications may be required based on applicable statutory, regulatory, safety, or site requirements.
* The position may require licensing or other compliance credentials depending on local regulations and responsibilities.

**Required**
**Skills & Experience**

* 7–8 years of relevant experience in facilities engineering, plant engineering, infrastructure management, or a similar field.
* Strong experience managing facility operations, plant infrastructure, building systems, and maintenance activities .
* Hands-on understanding of electrical, HVAC, mechanical, structural, fire/life safety, and other facility systems.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex capital projects and facility renovation projects from planning through execution and closeout.
* Strong project management skills, including scope, schedule, budgeting, resource allocation, risk management, contractor coordination, and project governance.
* Experience managing significant capital expenditure and operational budgets , including cost control, forecasting, and financial tracking.
* Experience managing contractors, consultants, suppliers, and other external service providers.
* Strong knowledge of applicable facilities, construction, environmental, health and safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience with emergency preparedness, business continuity, facility risk management, and critical infrastructure.
* Understanding of sustainability, environmental stewardship, energy efficiency, and resource optimization.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining operational continuity.
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills.
* Ability to lead, coach, and mentor Facilities Engineers, technicians, and other team members.
* Strong documentation, reporting, and project governance capabilities.

**Preferred**

* Experience with large manufacturing plants or industrial facilities.
* Experience managing multidisciplinary infrastructure projects involving HVAC, electrical, mechanical, structural, production floor layouts, and fire/life safety systems.
* Experience with facility management or integrated workplace management technologies.
* Knowledge of facility-related IT, audio-visual, communication, and workplace technology requirements.
* Experience supporting sustainability or environmental management programs.
* Experience working with cross-functional leadership teams on long-term infrastructure planning and business growth initiatives.
