title: Manager / Senior Manager – Design & Engineering
description:
About Kirloskar Solar: It was the year 1888. A seed was planted. It has been a long and wonderful journey and the main constants have been our integrity, our innovation and our wonderful customers. Our group's scope of operations span across a vast spectrum of industries. Kirloskar Solar is propelled by a leading multi-engineering conglomerate, backed by 133 years of glorious legacy and undisputed leadership in giving cutting edge technology – The Kirloskar Group. We offer turn-key solar solutions, products, and services to all segments, from residential to large scale commercial and industries. We have an extensive portfolio of customers in all segments like Residential, Commercial, Industries, SMEs across sectors like Health care, Hospitality, Automotive, Commercial, Education, Agriculture and Manufacturing. We provide sustainable energy efficient solution to serve the entire spectrum of electricity consumers from those who have zero power cuts to those who have frequent power cuts. Product basket consists of solar PV modules, On-Grid String Inverters, On-Grid Central Inverters, Off-Grid Inverters, Off-Grid and On-Grid Power Packs. Please feel free to peruse our website www.kirloskarsolar.com for in depth details about our organization.

**Position Overview:**
We are seeking an experienced, technically strong, and detail-oriented Manager / Senior Manager – Design & Engineering to lead basic and detailed engineering for rooftop and ground-mounted solar power projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing optimized, technically compliant, and cost-effective engineering solutions from initial feasibility and concept design through detailed engineering, final Bill of Materials (BOM), and execution support. The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on experience in solar EPC design, electrical and civil/structural engineering coordination, engineering calculations, equipment selection, technical specifications, and design optimization. The candidate should be capable of balancing technical performance, safety, constructability, project cost, and contractual requirements while leading a multidisciplinary engineering team.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

A. Basic and Detailed Engineering: Lead basic and detailed design engineering for rooftop and ground-mounted solar PV projects across different capacities. Review project inputs, site surveys, feasibility assessments, client specifications, tender documents, and contractual requirements. Develop concept designs, design philosophies, engineering criteria, system configurations, and technical design packages. Ensure seamless transition from preliminary engineering to detailed design and execution ready drawings. Coordinate with project execution, procurement, quality, commissioning, and O&M teams to ensure design practicality and constructability.Provide technical support during project execution and resolve site-related engineering issues.

B. Solar PV System Design and Optimization: Prepare and review PV module layouts, string configurations, inverter sizing, DC/AC ratios, equipment placement, and plant capacity optimization. Optimize module orientation, tilt angle, row spacing, shading losses, cable routing, and energy yield. Evaluate rooftop structural constraints, available installation areas, roof loading, access pathways, and maintenance clearances. Develop ground-mounted plant layouts considering topography, grading, drainage, access roads, soil conditions, setbacks, and evacuation infrastructure. Evaluate alternative design configurations to improve generation, reduce electrical losses, minimize material consumption, and lower overall project costs. Support energy yield assessments and performance calculations using appropriate engineering tools and simulation software.

C. Electrical Design and Engineering: Prepare and review single-line diagrams (SLDs), DC and AC schematics, string layouts, cable schedules, cable sizing calculations, and electrical load calculations. Perform voltage-drop, short-circuit, fault-level, earthing, lightning protection, and electrical equipment sizing calculations. Design and review inverter transformer systems, HT/LT switchgear, protection systems, metering arrangements, and auxiliary power systems. Develop earthing layouts, lightning protection layouts, cable trench and tray routing, and electrical equipment layouts. Prepare protection coordination requirements, relay setting inputs, and grid interface engineering in coordination with relevant specialists. Review grid connectivity requirements and coordinate technical submissions for utility approvals and electrical inspections. Ensure appropriate consideration of electrical safety, system reliability, maintainability, and applicable grid requirements.

D. Civil, Structural and Mechanical Engineering Coordination: Coordinate structural engineering for rooftop mounting systems and ground-mounted module mounting structures (MMS). Review structural loading, wind loads, foundations, pile design inputs, soil investigation reports, and mounting structure specifications. Coordinate civil drawings for foundations, inverter and transformer platforms, control rooms, cable trenches, roads, drainage, and associated infrastructure. Review roof load assessments, waterproofing requirements, structural adequacy, and installation constraints for rooftop projects. Verify alignment between module dimensions, mounting structure design, equipment foundations, and electrical layouts. Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants to resolve interdisciplinary engineering conflicts.

E. Engineering Calculations, Standards and Compliance • Perform, review, and approve engineering calculations and design documents within the assigned technical authority. • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian Standards (IS), relevant IEC standards, IEEE standards, and other applicable national and international codes. Apply relevant CEA regulations, electrical safety requirements, grid codes, and applicable DISCOM/utility technical specifications. Ensure that the latest applicable standards, client specifications, and statutory requirements are incorporated into engineering deliverables. Review design assumptions, calculation methodologies, technical deviations, and engineering risks. Maintain engineering design criteria, calculation templates, standard drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.

F. Bill of Materials (BOM) and Cost Optimization: Develop and finalize detailed project BOMs covering PV modules, inverters, MMS, DC and AC cables, connectors, junction boxes, transformers, switchgear, earthing, lightning protection, and other associated equipment. Prepare accurate material quantity take-offs from approved engineering drawings and calculations. Coordinate with procurement and SCM teams to finalize technical specifications, equipment selection, and vendor documentation. Identify value-engineering opportunities through optimized equipment sizing, cable selection, structural design, layout efficiency, and material utilization. Evaluate alternate makes, technologies, and technical configurations without compromising safety, quality, performance, or contractual compliance. Minimize design changes, excess material consumption, wastage, and avoidable procurement costs. Ensure alignment between the final BOM, approved drawings, project budget, and execution requirements.

G. Technical Specifications and Vendor Engineering: Prepare technical specifications, datasheets, tender drawings, equipment schedules, and technical evaluation documents. Review vendor drawings, datasheets, design calculations, quality documents, and technical submittals. Conduct technical bid evaluations and support procurement in selecting technically suitable and commercially competitive equipment. Coordinate with manufacturers and suppliers for technical clarifications, deviations, and engineering approvals. • Ensure consistency between equipment interfaces, project specifications, design calculations, and approved drawings.

H. Design Review and Quality Assurance: Establish design review procedures, interdisciplinary checks, and engineering document control systems. Conduct design reviews, constructability assessments, and internal technical audits before drawing release. Implement revision control, approval workflows, and document traceability. Ensure timely issuance of approved-for-construction (AFC) drawings and other execution critical documents. Resolve engineering comments from clients, consultants, utilities, and project execution teams. Maintain a repository of standard designs, lessons learned, and engineering best practices.

I.Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Coordination: Lead, mentor, and develop design engineers and multidisciplinary engineering resources. Allocate engineering deliverables, define priorities, monitor productivity, and ensure adherence to project schedules. Establish clear accountability for design accuracy, technical quality, document release, and engineering cost optimization. Coordinate effectively with Projects, Procurement, SCM, Business Development, O&M, Quality, and Commissioning teams. Provide technical guidance on complex design issues and support resolution of site engineering challenges. Develop standardized engineering processes and continuously improve design efficiency and quality.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.

• 10–15 years of relevant experience in solar or renewable energy design and engineering, preferably within a Solar EPC organization.

• Strong hands-on experience in basic and detailed design of both rooftop and ground-mounted solar PV projects.

• Proven experience preparing and reviewing engineering calculations, technical drawings, specifications, equipment sizing, and final BOMs.

• Strong understanding of DC and AC electrical design, cable sizing, voltage drop, short-circuit calculations, earthing, lightning protection, and protection systems.

• Practical experience in layout optimization, equipment selection, structural and civil engineering coordination, and value engineering.

• Working knowledge of applicable IS, IEC, IEEE, CEA, and utility-specific standards and requirements.

• Experience coordinating with procurement, project execution, vendors, clients, and statutory authorities on technical matters.

• Willingness to travel 20–30% across India for site surveys, design reviews, technical discussions, and project support.

title: Plant Manager

title: Assistant Manager - Planning - EPC / Heavy Engineering
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of combustion and environmental solutions for the refining, petrochemical, power, production, and pharmaceutical industries. With operations across the globe, Zeeco delivers industry-leading combustion equipment, flares, burners, thermal oxidizers, and vapor control systems through innovative engineering, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused project execution.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**Planning & Project Control Engineer**
with
**10–12 years of experience**
in
**project planning, production planning, and project controls**
within the
**heavy engineering, fabrication, pressure vessel, process equipment, or EPC industry**
.
  
  
The incumbent will be responsible for developing and monitoring project schedules, coordinating with cross-functional teams, tracking production progress, ensuring on-time execution, and driving planning excellence throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
**Experience in the manufacturing of combustion equipment, burners, flares, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, or similar fabricated equipment will be considered a strong advantage.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project Planning & Scheduling**

* Review customer Purchase Orders, technical specifications, engineering drawings, and project requirements to prepare detailed execution plans.
* Develop baseline project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project covering engineering, procurement, manufacturing, inspection, and dispatch activities.
* Conduct internal Kick-Off Meetings (KOM) and establish project milestones and communication plans.
* Prepare manufacturing schedules aligned with customer delivery commitments and resource availability.
* Monitor project progress against planned schedules and identify schedule deviations, risks, and bottlenecks.

**Production Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Production, Quality, Stores, and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth execution of manufacturing activities.
* Release jobs for manufacturing after verifying engineering readiness and material availability.
* Track fabrication progress and ensure timely completion of manufacturing stages.
* Coordinate material planning, procurement follow-up, and production sequencing to avoid delays.
* Monitor WIP, production capacity, inventory levels, and resource utilization to maximize operational efficiency.

**Project Controls & Reporting**

* Prepare weekly and monthly progress reports highlighting Planned vs. Actual performance.
* Track critical milestones and recommend recovery plans for schedule slippages.
* Maintain project dashboards and management reports.
* Manage schedule revisions arising from engineering changes, customer revisions, or production constraints.
* Document planning challenges, corrective actions, and lessons learned for continuous improvement.

**Customer & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as a coordination point between customers and internal departments regarding project schedules and execution status.
* Participate in customer review meetings and internal project review meetings.
* Follow up with customers for approvals, engineering documents, and outstanding deliverables.
* Coordinate with subcontractors and vendors to ensure timely completion of outsourced activities.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Support Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, TPM, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Contribute towards improving On-Time Delivery (OTD), Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), and planning efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to quality systems and project documentation requirements.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Project Planning & Project Controls
* Expertise in Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project
* Good knowledge of production planning in heavy fabrication environments
* Experience in capacity planning, resource planning, and manufacturing scheduling
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, fabrication sequences, and technical documentation
* Working knowledge of ERP systems (SAP, Sage X3, Oracle, or equivalent)
* Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills
* Excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving abilities

**Preferred Experience**
Candidates with experience in one or more of the following industries will be preferred:
  
  

* Heavy Engineering
* Fabrication
* Pressure Vessels
* Heat Exchangers
* Process Equipment
* Oil & Gas Equipment
* EPC Projects
* Industrial Manufacturing

**Added Advantage**

* Experience in planning and production of Burners, Flares, Thermal Oxidizers, or Combustion Equipment
* Exposure to ASME, IBR, or international fabrication standards
* Knowledge of Critical Chain Project Management (CCPM)

**Qualifications**
  
  

* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in Project Planning, Production Planning, or Project Controls.
* Hands-on proficiency in:

+ Primavera P6
+ Microsoft Project
+ MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint)
+ ERP Systems

title: Assistant Manager - Operations ROI
description:
The **Assistant Manager – Operations ROI** is responsible for managing daily operations and driving the performance of a frontline team to ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality services. This role serves as a critical liaison between management and operational staff, with a strong focus on compliance with healthcare regulations, including HIPAA, and adherence to client-specific requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Team Management & Leadership**: Supervise, lead, and motivate a team of 30+ associates and Team Leaders. This includes managing attendance, leave approvals, and overall team dynamics.
* **Performance Monitoring & Coaching**: Monitor individual and team performance metrics (KPIs) such as Average Handle Time (AHT), Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Quality Assurance (QA) scores. Conduct regular coaching sessions, provide constructive feedback, and perform performance reviews to drive continuous improvement.

* **Experience**: Minimum 3 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory role within a BPO setting, with specific experience in healthcare processes (e.g., claims, prior authorization, revenue cycle management, life sciences etc.)

* **Knowledge**: A strong understanding of healthcare regulations, compliance standards (like HIPAA), and industry-specific practices is essential.

* **Core Competencies**:
* + Strong leadership, people management, and motivational skills.
  + Excellent communication (verbal and written), interpersonal, and problem-solving abilities.
  + Strong organizational, time-management, and decision-making skills.
  + Proficiency in tools/software, performance dashboards, and MS Office (especially Excel & Power point).
  + Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage under pressure.

title: Area Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kofi Kafi is a fast-growing, bootstrapped coffee chain rooted in New Delhi, focused on redefining how coffee is experienced in India. The brand is driven by a vision to make quality coffee more accessible and affordable, tailored to diverse local preferences and requirements. Kofi Kafi aims to build a welcoming, community-centered environment where guests can enjoy consistent products and friendly service. As an emerging brand, it offers team members the chance to contribute to something ambitious and expanding in the Indian coffee market. Joining Kofi Kafi means being part of an energetic, mission-led company at an early and impactful stage of its growth.

**Role Description**
The Area Manager role at Kofi Kafi is a full-time, on-site position based in Delhi, India, overseeing multiple outlets within the assigned region. This role involves managing day-to-day store operations, including staffing, inventory control, service quality, and adherence to brand standards. The Area Manager monitors sales performance, implements local marketing initiatives, and identifies growth opportunities to improve revenue and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities include coaching and developing store teams, conducting regular site visits, resolving operational issues, and ensuring compliance with safety and hygiene guidelines. title: Retail Store Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Petworx is a petcare brand dedicated to creating a better lifestyle for pets and pet parents through thoughtfully curated essentials and experiences. Every product is designed with a focus on love, quality, and care, reflecting a deep passion for animals and an understanding of their needs. Based in India, Petworx is committed to raising the standards of petcare across categories such as food, grooming, wellness, and accessories. The Retail Store Manager at Petworx - Moti Nagar Outlet , will be responsible for overseeing daily store operations, ensuring an engaging and supportive experience for customers and their pets. * Genuine interest in pets and petcare, with willingness to learn about Petworx products and services.

title: Senior Movement Operations Associate
description:
**Job Description**
Since the inception of IOM in 1951, Movement Operations have been and continue to be a fundamental
  
  
pillar of the Organization’s work. The organized movement of persons in need of international
  
  
migration assistance is a primary mandate of the Organization and a cornerstone of IOM’s operations.
  
  
Movement Operations Units in various IOM Country Offices, coordinated under the Resettlement
  
  
and Movement Management (RMM) Unit in the Division of Movement, Resettlement and Labour
  
  
Pathways (MRLP) at IOM’s Headquarters, are responsible for all aspects of travel for migrants and
  
  
refugees under IOM’s auspices, in accordance with the various framework agreements with
  
  
resettlement and receiving Governments and partners across the spectrum of the Organization's
  
  
programmes. Under the direct supervision of the Head of Office, the Senior Movement Operations Associate, is responsible for supervising responsible for supervising movement operations activities in
  
  
the field, with the following duties and responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Actively participate in the day-to-day implementation of beneficiary-facing movement operations
  
  
activities, working alongside team members as operationally required. This includes directly
  
  
supporting field activities, coordinating services, assisting beneficiaries, resolving operational
  
  
issues, and ensuring the timely and effective delivery of assigned tasks in accordance with
  
  
applicable standard operating procedures and programme requirements.
  
  

* Supervise teams of staff undertaking beneficiary-facing activities under the Field Support and Data

Processing Pillar within IOM’s movement operations for various types of migrants and migration
  
  
pathways, across multiple countries in the assigned area in the country or across multiple
  
  
countries in the region, ensuring compliance with their respective standard operating procedures
  
  
and programme requirements. This includes overseeing staff development processes such as
  
  
hiring, providing training, assigning duties, and giving regular performance feedback to ensure highquality
  
  
work and accurate completion of activities.
  
  

* Oversee the field support activities relating to IOM’s movement operations in an assigned area

or areas in the country or across multiple countries in the region, such as at an airport, seaport,
  
  
transit center, third-party facility, camp-based operations or sub-office to ensure beneficiary
  
  
movements are conducted safely and appropriately. If required, provide assistance for extended
  
  
periods and during overnight periods and weekends, ensuring the needs of individuals are met
  
  
throughout their stay.
  
  

* Oversee the coordination of transportation of beneficiaries to and from designated consolidation

points, locations, and facilities in the country or across multiple countries in the region, working
  
  
with relevant units and service providers to help ensure that vulnerable individuals are assisted in
  
  
a manner that ensures their safety, security and comfort. Coordinate liaison with service
  
  
providers, supervise staff as they ensure the identity verification, readiness and organization of
  
  
individuals being transported, and prepare and supervise relevant briefings.
  
  

* Oversee the timely and appropriate provision of food and other essential items to beneficiaries

during IOM movement operations. Lead the collaboration with the relevant IOM units and service
  
  
providers to ensure that assistance meets established standards of quality.
  
  

* Oversee the coordination of cases or indiviuals with with special needs or equipment receive

appropriate support. In particular, monitor and ensure the staff members handle sensitive cases
  
  
in accordance with IOM’s policies, and existing institutional guidance, including the assistance to
  
  
unaccompanied and separated children and at-risk cases.
  
  

* Oversee the pre-departure formalities such as processing of travel documents and exit permits

in close coordination with relevant external partner agencies, and authorities.
  
  

* Coordinate and/or provide selection mission support, and/or interpretation services for

individuals at airports, in transit centers, camps, consolidation points and third-party facilities or during transport by air, ground or water.
  
  

* Upon request from the government agencies, coordinate provision of the visa applicants with application assistance such as initiating contacts, scheduling appointments, capturing biometrics, filling the relevant forms, and collecting relating documents as needed.
* Under the guidance of the supervisor, liaise as needed with other teams and units in IOM Country Office and with external partners such as airport and government authorities, embassies, and the UN agencies. Provide regular feedback on work being accomplished to the supervisor and keep the supervisor informed of issues that arise.
* Coordinate with the administrative heads, relevant units, partners, and vendors when unexpected issues arise and work towards their resolutions, as needed.
* In close coordination with the direct supervisor, oversee beneficiary-facing activities in the assigned area ensuring programme integrity and local implementation of programmatic and organizational policies, requirements, and guidelines. As required, assist with relevant policy and operational input for programmatic reviews to safeguard programme implementation.
* As needed, and under the close supervision of the supervisor, assist with financial activities related to movement operations, such as petty cash payments and reports.
* Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of relevant Movement Operations SOPs and Movements-related systems and databases, as well as the ability to remain professional, impartial and unbiased during all interactions with migrants and colleagues per the IOM Standard of Conduct and instruction on the prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA).
* Undertake duty travel as needed to participate in meetings and trainings, and to carry out pre-departure assistance if needed.
* Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of applicable SOPs, related systems and databases, and IOM Standards of Conduct. Maintain and ensure the confidentiality and integrity of all relevant paperwork in line with SOPs, Standards of Conduct and relevant data protection rules.
* Uphold RMM Protection Mainstreaming Minimum Standards while carrying out all duties and responsibilities and demonstrate the ability to remain professional, impartial and unbiased during all interactions with migrants and colleagues per the IOM Standards of Conduct and instruction on the prevention of sexual exploitation and abuse (PSEA). Alert the supervisor or management of any non-compliance to SOPs, RMM Protection Mainstreaming Minimum Standards or IOM Standards of Conduct by IOM personnel or partners.
* Perform such other duties as may be assigned.

**Education**
**QUALIFICATIONS**

* High school diploma with seven years of work experience; or
* Bachelor’s degree in social science, International Relations, Regional Studies or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant work experience.

**Experience In**

* Prior Movement Operations, transportation-related and/or management experience is strongly preferred.
* Work experience in programmes, including movement operations component, particularly in resettlement programmes.
* Experience with supervising multiple teams.
* Experience with communicating with beneficiaries and external partners.
* Experience with handling issues in other countries in the Region.
* Experience with handling complex cases and workflow.
* Experience with filling management-level roles.

title: Senior Proposal Manager
description:

The BD Ops team is looking for this candidate to have strong technical writing experience, capable of conflating complex technical ideas into succinct prose.
  
  
The candidate should also have excellent verbal communication and team coordination skills to facilitate contributions from teams across the Shield AI team. * Lead India proposal efforts, align stakeholders, and communicate key customer, market, and BD strategy insights.
* Strong communicator: Strong oral and written communication skills. (Technical writing experience preferred.) Strong presentation skills. Ability to communicate seamlessly at all levels of Shield AI and customer organizations.
* Attention to detail in a fast-paced environment: Be rigorous and go fast is one of Shield AI’s leadership traits and, possibly, the most relevant one for BD Ops. Our ideal candidate must always work with efficiency and a keen attention to detail. Both are critical to supporting on time, compliant Bids/Proposals and related deliverables.

We manage the proposal lifecycle from start to finish including kickoff, collaboration with stakeholders, color reviews, and management reviews with senior leaders/executives. We are ultimately responsible for everything that does or does not happen in the Bid/Proposal process.
* The ideal candidate will demonstrate the ability to be flexible, work hard, hold themself and others to high standards, embrace teammates, and act with kindness.

* Continuously improve proposal processes, tools, templates, and best practices.
* Mentor proposal contributors and foster high-performing, collaborative teams.
* Support India GTM team with briefing and presentation development for customer engagements.
* Support customer meetings, demonstrations, and GTM events as required.

* 2-4+ years of Government of India / Indian Ministry of Defence or international government proposal development or BD operations experience.

* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, marketing, engineering, or equivalent industry experience.

* Experience with proposal methodologies (e.g. Shipley), compliance matrices, and implementing project management tools and processes.
* Proven record of leadership in a professional setting.
* Ability to communicate complex, technical ideas effectively – both orally and in writing.
* Ability to work collaboratively and flexibly as part of a team, embrace the startup environment.
* Ability to work effectively with people at all levels of an organization.
* Demonstrated record of hard work, trustworthiness, holding oneself and others to high standards, and being kind to others.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Strong technical background especially with unmanned/uncrewed systems and/or autonomy software. \
* Demonstrated understanding and knowledge of military operations and India defense acquisition processes.
* Understanding of international markets/geopolitical trends in aerospace / defense industry.
* Experience managing Foreign Military Sale and Direct Commercial Sale bids/proposals.
* Active Indian security clearance.

**Job Description:**
**About the Role:**
In this Senior Manager level role, you will help shape and deliver evidence generation strategy across India and Southeast Asia. You will play a key role in identifying local evidence gaps and translating them into scientifically rigorous, feasible, patient-focused, and compliant research plans. As part of the Global Evidence Generation organization, you will connect local medical and healthcare needs with regional and global evidence priorities, helping inform research plans and investment decisions. Your work will contribute to high-quality studies across peri-approval and post-approval research, including real-world evidence and observational research. Through scientific leadership, cross-functional collaboration, and innovative approaches, you will strengthen evidence generation, synthesis, and portfolio decision-making while supporting consistent standards and meaningful research outcomes across India and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**

* **Lead evidence strategy development:**
  by identifying and prioritizing local evidence gaps and translating them into robust, feasible research plans.
* **Guide studies through their lifecycle:**
  from concept and protocol development through execution, analysis, reporting, closeout, and dissemination.
* **Align local and global priorities:**
  by representing India and Southeast Asia evidence needs in regional and global planning and governance.
* **Coordinate cross-functional delivery:**
  with medical, research, regulatory, access, data, legal, compliance, procurement, and finance partners.
* **Manage external research partners:**
  against agreed expectations for scope, quality, budget, and timelines.
* **Oversee portfolio planning and performance:**
  by prioritizing activities, forecasting budgets, monitoring progress, and escalating material risks or variances.
* **Apply innovative research approaches:**
  using digital tools, advanced analytics, data visualization, and artificial intelligence-enabled tools to support planning and decisions.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in medicine, pharmacy, life sciences, public health, epidemiology, health economics, or a related field.
* Eight to ten years of relevant experience in the pharmaceutical industry, healthcare research, academia, or a related environment.
* Experience owning evidence generation strategy and leading or overseeing observational, database, real-world evidence, or other medical research studies.
* Strong knowledge of research methods, good research practices, and applicable ethical and regulatory requirements.
* Ability to translate medical and healthcare questions into clear evidence needs and executable research plans.
* Demonstrated project, portfolio, vendor, and budget management skills across multiple complex studies and priorities.
* Strong scientific judgment, stakeholder influence, written and verbal communication, facilitation, presentation, and professional English-language skills.

title: Project Leader – AMS Automotive
description:
**About Us**
Bain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition, and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
  
  
In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network), with its nodes across various geographies.
  
  
BCN is an integral and largest unit of ECD (Expert Client Delivery). ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutions across all industries and specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence, or Bain intellectual property.
  
  
The BCN comprises Consulting Services, Knowledge Services, and Shared Services.
  
  
Who You Will Work With
  
  
This is an opportunity to be a part of Bain’s AMS CoE, based out of the Gurugram office, and specifically support Bain Global case teams on live cases, client development, and proposal support.
  
  
AMS CoE consists of 70+ team members, organized into approximately 18 teams, working across various sectors such as real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport, and automotive & mobility.
  
  
You will work on AMS projects and get exposed to various BCN products ranging from go-to-market strategies, industry analysis, and competitive benchmarking to Excel models, survey analysis, and ad-hoc studies, on live client cases as well as for business/client development.
  
  
Project Leaders lead teams of analysts and associates to produce client-ready research and analysis, generating strong business insights and providing implications.
  
  
Project Leaders work under the guidance of a Manager/Sr. Manager, playing a key role in driving the team’s overall answer and final materials, client communication, work planning, and team management.
  
  
The expectation is to eventually provide significant direction and support to resolve complex issues and effectively manage client and team meetings.
  
  
As a Project Leader, the individual would mostly be working in the Automotive & Mobility sector, with possible future opportunities in other AMS sub-sectors, including real estate/construction, heavy machinery, commercial aviation, logistics & transport.
  
  
**About You**

* For candidates with undergraduate qualifications: 5–8 years of experience in consulting, research, or analytics, with hands-on experience in the AMS-Automotive sector. Prior experience or familiarity with the AMS sector is a must.
* For candidates with postgraduate qualifications: 3–6 years of experience in consulting, research, or analytics, with hands-on experience in the AMS-Automotive sector. Prior experience or familiarity with the AMS sector is a must.
* The incumbent should be a graduate or postgraduate from a top-tier institute or have pursued a commerce, statistical, or analytical course from a Tier 1 university.
* Strong understanding of the automotive players' ecosystem, including OEMs and suppliers, battery chemistries, the battery value chain, emission regulations, and emerging industry trends.

What You’ll Do
  
  

* Take project management responsibility, including leading a team of Analysts and Associates to execute a case.
* Understand client needs and situations and adapt to case expectations; demonstrate the ability to resolve discrete issues and/or drive consensus.
* Communicate data, knowledge, and insights to the entire team; generate and screen realistic solutions based on sound reality checks and recommend actionable solutions.
* Provide content thought leadership, build forecast modeling logic, and potentially manage simple cases and intellectual property (IP) projects independently.
* Ensure timely, high-quality, zero-defect research, analysis, and output, while demonstrating the acumen to solve open-ended problems.
* Effectively manage client and team meetings and deliver effective presentations to the team, team leaders, and managers/partners across the Bain system.
* Serve as the single point of contact for case teams, handling follow-ups and sharing the existing portfolio of IPs and off-the-shelf knowledge to help them quickly get up to speed on focus areas.
* Demonstrate proficiency in research, analysis, and Excel modeling, as well as sound business judgment to derive answers in situations where data is not easily available or explicitly published.
* Take first-level team management responsibility, which may involve allocating and reviewing work for a small team of analysts and conducting performance and feedback discussions.

**Additional Skills And Requirements**

* Candidate should currently be working in a strategy consulting or research-oriented setup and possess the acumen to solve open-ended problems.
* Proficiency in research, analysis, and Excel modeling, with the ability to apply sound business judgment when data is not easily available or explicitly published.
* Ability to interface with primary client contacts, including Bain case teams from global offices.
* Play a bigger role in long-term AMS IPs with frequent interactions with Practice stakeholders, Partners, and case teams (on cases typically lasting 3–12 months), and potentially end clients whenever opportunities arise.
* Demonstrate independent secondary research, analytical, and storylining skills.
* Think outside the box to solve niche case scenarios through baselining and benchmarking of global best practices.
* Be open to intermittent travel to other Bain offices or client locations for live cases.

What Makes Us a Great Place to Work
  
  
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity, and a model of social responsibility.
  
  
We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years.
  
  
We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities, and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally.
  
  
We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor, and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ, and parents.

title: Warehouse Operations Manager
description:
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Team leadership**

· Lead, train and supervise the operations team; assign daily tasks and set priorities.

· Monitor workload, output quality and deadlines; step in on escalations.

· Run short daily or weekly team check-ins and report progress to VSTL management.

· Conduct performance reviews and support hiring and onboarding of new team members.

**Order and inventory operations**

· Oversee the full order cycle: purchase orders (PO), proforma invoices (PI), commercial invoices and delivery.

· Supervise physical stock counts at warehouses and PO reconciliation reports (ordered vs. received quantities).

· Make sure CPUs, HDDs and other items are correctly described, graded (good/bad) and recorded.

· Keep inventory records and the CRM/ERP system (e.g., Zoho CRM) accurate and up to date.

**Shipping and documentation**

· Review and approve packing lists, carton markings, invoices and export documents before dispatch.

· Coordinate with freight forwarders, couriers and warehouses on pickups, shipments and tracking.

· Ensure documents meet customs and destination-country requirements (e.g., India, Hong Kong).

**Customer and vendor coordination**

· Act as the escalation point for customer and vendor issues; resolve them quickly and professionally.

· Handle shortage and bad-item claims: verify counts, prepare claim reports and follow up to settlement.

· Build good working relationships with key suppliers, buyers and logistics partners.

**Reporting and process improvement**

· Prepare daily, weekly and monthly operations reports (orders, shipments, claims, pending issues).

· Create and maintain standard formats and SOPs for packing lists, reconciliation and claim reports.

· Find delays, errors and repeated issues, and put fixes in place.

· Ensure company data and documents are handled securely and confidentially.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS**

**Required**

· Graduate in any discipline (commerce, business or supply chain preferred).

· 5+ years in operations, logistics or trade back-office work, including 2+ years leading a team.

· Working knowledge of export/import documents: PI, commercial invoice, packing list, airway bill.

· Strong MS Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliation sheets).

· Experience with a CRM or ERP system; Zoho CRM preferred.

· Clear written and spoken English for daily communication with Hong Kong and international partners.

**Preferred**

· Experience in IT hardware or electronic components trading (CPUs, HDDs, memory, used/refurbished equipment).

· Basic knowledge of computer hardware and product identification.

· Familiarity with customs rules for India and Hong Kong shipments.

**Personal qualities**

· Detail-oriented, organized and able to handle many orders at once.

· Calm problem-solver who follows issues through to closure.

· Leads by example; coaches and motivates the team.

· Honest and reliable with company stock, money and data.

**PERFORMANCE MEASURES (KPIS)**

**KPI**

**What it measures**

**On-time dispatch**

Share of orders shipped by the committed date

**Document accuracy**

Packing lists and invoices issued without errors or revisions

**Reconciliation turnaround**

Time from warehouse count to final reconciliation report

**Claim resolution**

Shortage/bad-item claims raised and settled within target time

**Issue response time**

Speed of replies to customer and vendor queries

**Team performance**

Task completion, accuracy and staff retention

title: Facility Manager - Soft
description:
Facility Manager
  
  
Work Dynamics
  
  
  
  
What this job involves:
  
  
  
  
Leading on-site operations
  
  
Are you a pro at giving on-site support? Working with a team, you’ll oversee the day-to-day client activities for the assigned property or facility. You’ll also implement building procedures and performance measures—and ensure that they are maintained at all times. Likewise, you’ll boost on-site operations by promoting best practices and creating better processes. This job will also entail the question “How do I ensure the safety of my colleagues?” You will do this by promoting adherence to health and safety standards.
  
  
Winning our clients’ trust
  
  
As the facilities manager, you’ll be working frequently with clients, so you’ll need to build strong relationships with them. Likewise, you’ll need to be proactive and engaging; and make sure that the clients’ expectations are met each and every time.  You will also be the go-to person for any facilities-related concerns.
  
  
Keeping an eye on budget and contracts
  
  
Do you have a solid background in finance management? As the person in charge, you will take care of the site’s financial operations. Also part of your job is to coordinate with vendors and suppliers, and make sure that they deliver quality work practices according to the contract, and at the right cost.
  
  
Promoting teamwork across the board
  
  
At JLL, we strongly believe that teamwork is the secret behind every successful company. Do you share our thoughts? If so, then you are what we’re looking for.  In this role, you will support our people’s growth and development through effective training and coaching sessions. Likewise, you’ll promote a culture that upholds the ‘I am JLL’ core behaviours and fosters teamwork, cooperation and performance excellence. Also part of your job is to ensure that the team is constantly motivated, and that trust and work ethics prevail among members.
  
  
  
  
Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:
  
  
  
  
Competent and goal-driven
  
  
Do you have three to five years’ experience of managing a property? If so, you will be a perfect fit for the role. Likewise, an experience in managing commercial contracts and budgets may just help you land this job. You’ll also need to be a goal-oriented individual who’s an ace in health and safety requirements, vendor management and property technical systems management
  
  
Organised and analytical
  
  
We’re looking for a self-motivated and quick-thinking facilities manager who can solve problems using quantitative methods and holistic approaches. Likewise, we’re on the lookout for well-organised leaders who plan tasks in advance and constantly stay ahead of deadlines.
  
  
Engaging and professional
  
  
A passion for excellence is what makes a great facilities manager. We’ll need someone who can do more than the bare minimum to meet our clients’ expectations. In this role, you’ll also be working with different kinds of people, so you’ll need to be an expert in handling them professionally. Likewise, you’ll need to effectively manage, train and inspire the team to always do better. You’ll also need to take the time to listen to your people to create better work impact.
  
  
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
  
  
Apply today!

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of creative production, film-making, photography, printing, events and emerging AI tools.

The position requires a proactive, agile and solution-oriented professional who can coordinate multiple projects and stakeholders, manage production readiness and ensure consistent quality across creative and on-ground outputs.

* Manage project schedules, studio bookings, budgets, quotations, invoices and cost tracking.

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across internal teams, agencies and external partners.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high-quality work within tight timelines.

title: Customer Collaboration Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Job Title : Customer Collaboration Manager
  
  
Level : 5A
  
  
**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and setting the standard for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**About The Function**
Global Travel (GT) operates in the unique and exclusive Travel Retail (i.e. Duty Free) sector. Often referred to as the sixth continent, Travel Retail has its own set of inhabitants, geography and channels (international airport shops, international land border stores, on-board airlines, ferries and cruise ships, along with some non-retail and diplomatic sales) as well as its own unique commercial landscape (operating 24/7 across multiple languages and currencies with 200+ nationalities travelling annually).
  
  
From Bhutan to Botswana and from Venezuela to Vietnam, GT is the only market in Diageo which offers global scope and market accountability. Responsible for representing and selling Diageo products in more than 110 countries around the world, and with access to billions of potential shoppers globally, we are a strategically important market for Diageo in terms of both profit and NSV.
  
  
Alcohol is a £10 billion business in travel retail and with passenger and aircraft numbers expected to double in the next 20 years, we have endless opportunities for growth for Diageo. Travel retail is where luxury, exclusivity and innovation meet, and with our winning portfolio of brands, winning executions and winning team - we are excited about what the future holds.
  
  
We are a young, dynamic business and have recently reshaped our structure, mission and vision in order drive greater focus around the delivery of ambitious business goals. We are passionate about what we do and are looking for exceptional, like-minded people to join our diverse, energetic team.
  
  
**Market complexity**
The role offers you the opportunity to work in an international team, experiencing the diversity that is the GT business. Operating in a diverse, dynamic environment, this role functions across a multi-country, multi-currency and multiple time zonal setting, serving a wide diversity of customers and operating in a complex mix of regulatory environments.
  
  
Global Travel operates with c.900 SKU’s, 21 sourcing plants and a mixture of primary (export) and secondary supply chains.
  
  
**Position Overview**
**Deliver our customer collaboration roadmap through:**

* Managing the customer relationship to deliver on target service metrics and optimise route to market for our key India and Middle East customers
* Work with Customer, planning, Customer services and commercial sales teams to build a robust relationship to drive agreed customer & Diageo outcomes on service, growth and joint value creation
* Ensure CS team and customers execute range changes and innovations flawlessly
* Co-ordinate necessary in market re-work requirements
* Ensure all order fulfilment issues are reported managed and reviewed weekly to ensure optimal delivery on time for all customer orders including order management rules, transport lead time and adherence to Supply Chain required rules(MOQs, CFR, Lead time.)

**Deliver The Value Creation Agenda For Global Travel Through**

* Ownership and delivery of Customer projects to drive cost, efficiency and productivity
* Implement cost to serve processes with key accounts to reduce end to end costs and simplified replenishment models
* Review our existing RTM’s/network by region and identify opportunities to simplify/codify
* Partner with Global Brands Supply on future tramlining initiatives, own the proposal, commercial alignment and implementation
* Define and implement process for ongoing portfolio management to deliver simplified assortment

**Top Accountabilities**

* Drive improvement in key service metrics for GT Customers within Region
* Owns and develops relationship with GT commercial teams
* Manage GT Inventory levels ensuring SLOB management in control
* Collaborate with the Market planning & operations export team to ensure OTIF supply for GT
* Partner with Planning and Logistics teams, & customers to identify and implement cost to serve opportunities including INCOTERMS reviews and impact to payment terms
* Work closely with central Planning functions to deliver all customer metrics & manage in month demand fluctuations closely with Commercial, Customer, Planning & Finance
* Resolve customer specific Supply Chain issues to minimise service & availability disruption
* Customer service: Ensure brilliant partner management with and own GT improvement agenda with CS teams in your region
* Provide key account insights to demand planning as input to the monthly cycle – changes to customer sourcing/SC’s, concession changes & customer consolidation
* Work with Commercial teams to drive collaboration and communication supporting and driving collaborative Customer forecasting monthly with the customers to drive plan stability for supply.
* Work directly with Commercial teams in region to ensure day to day delivery of operational needs and to be supply point of contact for the region for non-collaboration customers

**Key Metrics**

* Market Share / NSV growth
* Service As Measured By Customer (SAMBC)
* Case Fill Rate (CFR)
* OTIF (On time in full)
* Lead time to delivery
* COGS (meet reduction targets)
* IBP (Forecast accuracy & Bias) reporting increase visibility

**Qualifications And Experience Required**

* Excellent influencing, partner engagement and interpersonal skills
* Exceptional communication skills – verbal, written and presentation
* Solid understanding of end to end supply chain operational processes e.g. DRP, MPS, inventory, conversion, logistics and customer service
* Experience in customer collaboration within a supply chain environment
* Numerate with broad statistical, analytical skills and attention to detail
* 3 years + Supply Chain planning experience in CPG (Demand Planning, Supply Planning, SMR, Logistics)
* Experienced user of a planning system (e.g. SAP APO preferred)
* Supply Chain experience/exposure preferable
* Customer service / Planning / Logistics experience
* Order management and SAP Reporting

**Working with Us**
Flexibility is key to success in our business and many of our staff work flexibly in many different ways, including part-time, compressed hours, flexible location. Please talk to us about what flexibility means to you and don’t let anything stop you from applying.
  
  
Join us and you can also expect a highly competitive and flexible rewards and benefits package.
  
  
Celebrating our inclusive and diverse culture is core to Diageo’s purpose of “celebrating life every day everywhere”. This purpose is, in itself, inclusive in nature, as it values everybody irrespective of background, disability, religion, gender identity, sexuality or ethnicity.
  
  
We know that for our business to thrive and for Diageo to realize its ambition, we depend on having diverse talent with a range of backgrounds, skills and capabilities in each of the 180 countries in which we operate and to reflect our broad consumer base. We view diversity as one of the key enablers that helps our business to grow and our values, purpose and standards set the conditions for us to respect the unique contribution each person brings.
  
  
**Worker Type**
Regular
  
  
**Primary Location:**
Gurugram

2026-09-11

title: Project Leader (Procurement) - Performance Improvement CoE
description:
**About us**

Bain & Company is a global management consulting firm that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 65 offices in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.

In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN is an integral and largest unit of (ECD) Expert Client Delivery. ECD plays a critical role as it adds value to Bain's case teams globally by supporting them with analytics and research solutioning across all industries, specific domains for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.

  

**Who you will work with**

This is a full-time role based in Bain’s Gurugram (India) office and is part of the Performance Improvement Center of Expertise (PI CoE).

The PI CoE partners with Bain case teams globally to drive cost transformation and operational improvement programs across industries. The team supports a broad range of client engagements spanning: 1) Procurement optimization (spend analytics, category strategy, vendor strategy, procurement maturity assessment), 2) Supply chain optimization (inventory diagnostics, network optimization, manufacturing diagnostics, integrated business planning), 3) Working capital and cost diagnostics and post-merger integration and synergy analysis.

The team combines consulting problem-solving with advanced analytics and technology-enabled solutions, leveraging tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, and Power BI to deliver actionable insights and scalable solutions. The PI CoE also plays a key role in developing Bain intellectual property, reusable toolkits, and next-generation AI/automation-enabled solutions, including practical applications of GenAI tools to accelerate diagnostics, improve insight generation, and scale repeatable delivery models.

  

**What you'll do**

**Client Delivery & Problem Solving**

* Support Bain case teams in diagnosing client problems and deploying the most appropriate tools, methodologies, and solutions
* Analyze complex client data from ERP systems, budgeting platforms, and operation data sources to generate actionable insights
* Guide team in developing client-ready deliverables including presentations, analytical models, dashboards, and visualizations
* Develop practical, data-driven recommendations focused on EBITDA improvement

**Stakeholder & Team Management**

* Lead case team meetings, working sessions, and workshops with senior leadership teams
* Monitor project progress, proactively address risks and roadblocks, and provide updates to Bain leadership

**Capability Building & Innovation**

* Collaborate with Bain Partners and experts on intellectual property development, proposals, go-to-market materials, and capability-building initiatives
* Enhance and scale existing solutions through advanced analytics, automation, and practical GenAI applications, including tools such as Claude and other AI-enabled platforms where relevant
* Identify opportunities to codify repeatable casework into reusable products, accelerators, diagnostics, and delivery assets

  

**About you**

1. Undergraduate degree with 5–8 years of relevant experience in consulting, operations/ cost transformation roles, or
2. Postgraduate degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in consulting, procurement/ operations/ cost transformation
3. Build and apply deep expertise in cost optimization and EBITDA improvement programs, including diagnostics, value identification, initiative design, and implementation support
4. Excellent problem solving, analytical, communication skills (ability to deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders), stakeholder & team management and project management skills
5. Experience with analytics and visualization tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, and Power BI

8. Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution
9. Strong collaboration and leadership orientation

  

**What makes us a great place to work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the #1 consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion, and collaboration are key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

About the Role

Maxima Apparel is hiring a Manager — Accounts Receivable to lead end-to-end Accounts Receivable and order-to-cash operations across wholesale, e-commerce, online marketplaces and payment platforms spanning the US, Canada, UK, Cyprus, Australia, Mexico and Brazil. description:
**Role Overview**
Minfy is seeking a senior professional with experience working within a hyperscaler or leading cloud partnership programs at a systems integrator or cloud consulting firm.
  
  
You will lead the execution of strategic collaboration programs with major hyperscalers, translating joint business plans into coordinated action across sales, delivery, alliances, technology practices and finance.
  
  
The role requires firsthand understanding of how cloud partnerships operate, including co-sell programs, partner investments, capability development and executive business reviews, and the ability to turn these mechanisms into measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Working closely with Minfy’s executive leadership and senior cloud partner stakeholders, you will own the several programs, performance visibility, governance and resolution of cross-functional execution challenges.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Joint Business Planning and Program Ownership**
Translate partnership objectives and agreed commitments into an integrated plan with owners, milestones, dependencies and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Coordinate joint business planning and align functional priorities, resources and capability development with program objectives.
  
  
Maintain a clear baseline of commitments and manage changes through appropriate review and approval.
  
  
**Cross Functional Execution**
Mobilise sales, delivery, alliances, practices and finance teams to execute agreed priorities and resolve dependencies.
  
  
Coordinate program workstreams covering market initiatives, co-sell activity, customer adoption and partner capability requirements.
  
  
Identify execution gaps, agree recovery plans with accountable leaders and drive actions to closure.
  
  
**Partner Engagement and Executive Governance**
Act as the central program coordination point for cloud partner stakeholders, working alongside Minfy’s alliance leadership.
  
  
Lead program reviews and prepare executive business reviews with clear performance assessments, recommendations and decision requests.
  
  
Escalate risks and unresolved issues early, presenting practical options and the impact of delayed decisions.
  
  
**Commercial Oversight and Performance Management**
Work with Finance to track approved investments, expenditure and benefits, and coordinate applicable partner submissions and reconciliation.
  
  
Maintain reliable dashboards and supporting evidence; distinguish planned, forecast and realised outcomes.
  
  
Monitor program obligations, approval requirements and deadlines, maintaining confidentiality and audit readiness.
  
  
**Required Experience And Capabilities**
Typically 12–18 years of relevant experience, including at least five years leading complex, cross-functional programs with executive visibility.
  
  
Direct experience in partner programs, partner business operations, strategic initiatives or business planning at a hyperscaler; or cloud alliance programs and strategic collaboration execution at a systems integrator or cloud services partner.
  
  
Demonstrated ownership of joint business plans, executive reviews, program commitments and partner investment processes.
  
  
Working knowledge of cloud partner ecosystems, co-sell motions, commercial models and capability development requirements.
  
  
Strong program governance, financial tracking, risk management and analytical skills, with evidence of delivering measurable outcomes.
  
  
Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountability across functions without direct reporting authority.
  
  
Clear executive communication and commercial judgment, combined with hands-on ownership of plans, dashboards and issue resolution.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Exposure to cloud migration, modernization, managed services, data or AI programs.
  
  
**Experience Coordinating Programs Across Geographies And Multiple Business Functions.**
Experience building or improving a program office or partnership operating model. Relevant program management qualifications are useful.
  
  
**Measures of Success**
Delivery and acceptance of agreed commitments and milestones within planned timelines.
  
  
Validated business outcomes and effective use of approved program investments.
  
  
Timely closure of cross-functional dependencies, corrective actions and partner submissions.
  
  
Accurate executive reporting, complete evidence, and early visibility of material risks.
  
  
**Working Relationships**
The role will work closely with Minfy’s executive sponsor, alliance leadership and functional heads, alongside senior cloud partner stakeholders.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Bring your experience into a role with broad program ownership, executive visibility and the opportunity to help shape Minfy’s growth across cloud, data and AI.

title: Senior Manager, Global Procurement - Men's Apparel
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
We are looking for an exceptional
**Senior Manager, Global Procurement**
for Men's Apparel Category.
  
  
You will own and drive cost structures and savings. This role is critical to our goal of delivering the highest quality products, at radically low prices, done right. Reporting to the Head of Procurement, the ideal candidate will leverage their deep expertise in commodity costing, clean sheet, manufacturing excellence & efficiency (consumption,C&M excellence), harvest timing, raw material availability to craft a competitive costing environment where major T1 and T2 suppliers are being challenged to provide transparent and competitive pricing to achieve a win win supply chain for both Quince and our partners.
  
  
Success in this role means achieving product cost at or near should-costing, securing supply continuity, and contributing to product excellence by aligning material procurement processes with the company’s innovation and sustainability goals. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on our business, contribute to company growth, and shape the future of our global sourcing strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Procurement Category Strategy: Define and execute the commercial roadmap and vendor distribution strategy for assigned categories to improve margins as Quince scales. Establish short- and long-term procurement targets aligned to business growth.

+ Consistently deliver exceptional product cost without sacrificing product quality or ESG considerations, including Procurement.
+ Partner with the technology team to embed procurement capabilities and playbook into the Vendor Portal and Product Catalog tools.
+ Identify and deliver 700 bps product cost reductions over the next 12 months.

* RFP Ownership & Execution: Structure and run competitive, end-to-end bidding processes to secure optimal cost and commercial terms with manufacturing partners. Own the full lifecycle from vendor identification through award.

+ Deliver immediate, best-in-class product cost savings through rigorous negotiation, while simultaneously institutionalizing repeatable negotiation frameworks to build long-term category maturity and sustainable competitive advantage.
+ Build AI agent to help us run RFP systematically in 2026 with the capability to build scenario analyses.

* Clean Sheet & Buy Plan Approvals: Create and utilize component-level “clean sheets” to drive pricing transparency; review, approve, and solution to optimum cost for all buy events within your categories.

+ Current mature / scale categories: Ensure scale / cleansheet costing with Finished Goods Manufacturers / Negotiate upstream of Finished Goods to secure best pricing and availability of (inputs (e.g. fabrics, yarns, fibers, commodities, trims) new categories & new products
+ Lead Buy Plan margin review to govern company margin targetPartner with material sourcing team to ensure transparent, competitive pricing from all key material suppliers (we own material, we own costing)
+ Negotiate reasonable launch costing and set schedule (monthly, quarterly, at trigger points) to renegotiate for scale pricing as the business grows
+ Support merchandising team by providing scale costing targets (i.e. what cost is achievable at scale)

* Upstream Sourcing: Partner directly with the Material Manager, Sourcing Teams and Tier 1 and Tier 2 vendors to align on, and implement, material benefits into finished goods costing.

+ Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate upstream material availability into product design and development cycles, ensuring early-stage cost optimization and seamless material-to-finished-good transitions.

* Value Creation: Identify and execute on opportunities to reshape the supply chain and extract new financial value beyond traditional sourcing boundaries, including verticalization and volume consolidation plays.

+ e.g. How do we become a market maker for Cashmere, Silk, etc? Could we sell cashmere and silk to other retailers? How can we partner with other mills or manufacturers to build a verticalized supply chain for critical materials, like linen, from French/Belgian farms and scutchers to linen mills? How do we buy/sell commodities to manage price fluctuations (e.g. gold pricing, Cashmere pricing)?

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in global procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in retail apparel environment
* Proven track record running competitive RFP processes with international manufacturing partners
* Hands-on experience building and leveraging clean sheets for cost negotiation
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with data-driven decision making
* Experience working cross-functionally with merchandising, materials, and production teams
* Technical aptitude for leveraging AI-powered platforms (e.g., LLMs) to conduct scenario analysis and automate complex procurement tasks
* Excellent negotiation skills and commercial acumen
* Experience in apparel, soft goods, or home goods strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree a plus

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

description:
