And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.

description:

Delivery Lead

Infrastructure Operations (Infra)

Hosting, Connectivity(Network & Telephony), DBA, Data Tribe & Infra Command Center (L1.5)

* Own end-to-end delivery of L1.5 and L2 infrastructure operations.
* Lead the Infra Command Center (L1.5) and the Hosting, Connectivity, DBA and Data Tribe pods.
* Act as single point of contact for the client infrastructure leadership.

* Drive service improvement plans to closure.

* Present service performance at monthly and quarterly governance reviews.

* Enforce ServiceNow ticket hygiene, CMDB accuracy and closure quality.

* Own client and internal escalations through to closure.
* Drive RCA, problem management and defect elimination plans.
* Coordinate with SecOps towers, OEM and hardware vendors, telecom carriers and client L3 teams.
* Drive repeat-incident reduction and alert tuning with the Command Center.

**Change, Patching and Availability**

* Govern change requests and maintenance windows across all infra towers.
* Track monthly OS, VMware, database and zero-day patch compliance.
* Oversee backup success, restore tests and DR / BCP drills.
* Oversee server, database and network builds and decommissions.
* Track platform software licences and expiry dates.

**Commercials and Contract**

* Own monthly invoicing inputs and reconciliation for infrastructure services.
* Track deliverables against SOW scope and contractual obligations.
* Raise and manage change requests for scope changes.
* Lead contractual reviews, including service credits and penalties.

**Resourcing and People**

* Plan capacity, shift rosters and 24x7 on-call coverage.
* Hire, onboard and retain engineers; manage backfills and leave cover.
* Maintain the skill matrix and cross-skilling plan across pods.
* Run performance reviews, coaching and career plans for the team.

**Compliance and Continual Improvement**

* Ensure adherence to client infrastructure standards and security policies.
* Track OS hardening, system agent and audit-log compliance.
* Support internal and external audits with evidence.
* Drive automation of routine tasks, patching and deployments.
* Keep SOPs, runbooks and knowledge-base articles current.
* Lead onboarding and transition of new infrastructure services.

**Tools/Technology - knowhow**

* AWS (EC2, S3, ELB, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM)
* Microsoft Azure
* Windows Server and Linux / Unix
* Cisco routers, switches and WLAN controllers
* Firewalls & load balancers
* Cisco Call Manager / PBX
* Databases (Oracle, MS SQL, Cloud databases)
* Datadog
* PagerDuty
* ServiceNow (ITSM, CMDB, reporting and dashboards)
* Tableau, Power BI / Excel for service reporting (good to have)
* Jira and Confluence (good to have)

* Disaster recovery and business continuity
* Automation and scripting: PowerShell, Bash, Python (good to have)
* Infrastructure as code: Terraform (good to have)

* Led 24x7 multi-tower infrastructure operations for a global enterprise
* Managed onshore and offshore teams of 20+ engineers

title: Senior Manager, Supply Chain & QA - India
description:
**Who We Are**
We’re not in the wing business. We’re in the flavor business. It’s been our mission to Serve the World Flavor since we first opened in 1994, and we’re just getting started. 1997 saw the opening of our first brand partner operated Wingstop location, and by 2002 we had served the world one billion wings. It’s flavor that defines us and has made Wingstop one of the fastest growing brands in the restaurant industry.
  
  
Above all else – our success is largely due to our people and our core values, or what we call The Wingstop Way of being entrepreneurial, service-minded, fun, and authentic. We believe having a strong people foundation centered on these collective values creates a crave-worthy culture and talented team, as well as ensures our brand is poised for accelerated growth. We all win together.
  
  
**What We’ll Need**
As Supply Chain Manager for India, you will play a critical role in establishing, scaling, and optimizing our supply chain infrastructure in one of our key growth markets. You will partner closely with Brand Partners, global teams, and regional stakeholders to ensure consistent supply, cost efficiency, and adherence to Wingstop’s quality and food safety standards.
  
  
This role is both strategic and hands-on, requiring a builder mindset to support market entry, expansion, and ongoing operations.
  
  
Build & Support India Supply Chain Operations
  
  

* Establish and manage a reliable end-to-end supply chain network across India
* Ensure continuity of supply by proactively identifying risks and mitigating disruptions, whilst identifying opportunities.
* Partner with franchisees and distributors to oversee demand forecasting for suppliers.
* Monitor and manage cost of goods (COGS) and identify cost optimization opportunities
* Ensure all suppliers meet Wingstop’s quality assurance and food safety standards

Supplier Sourcing & Management
  
  

* Source, qualify, and onboard nominated suppliers (food, packaging, equipment). Approve locally (franchisee) managed suppliers and distributors.
* Lead supplier negotiations, contracts, and performance management. In line with regional and global framework
* Implement Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) practices including QBRs, Scorecards and continuous improvement plans
* Strategically map out the next 1-3 years sourcing plan, based on the development pipeline for India. With risk, quality and commercials at the forefront.
* Be a critical thinker and where appropriate identify opportunities that expand the sourcing opportunities outside of India.
* Ensure suppliers are meeting Wingstop governance and regulation on operational and product standards. Full due-diligence and transparency required.

New Market Entry & Expansion
  
  

* Lead supply chain workstreams for new restaurant openings across India
* Build scalable procurement and distribution models to support rapid growth
* Coordinate importation (if required), regulatory compliance, and customs processes
* Support BP in Identifying and approving logistics partners.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Innovation
  
  

* Partner with Marketing and Consumer Insights teams on product localization and new menu development
* Support Operations in testing and rollout of equipment and packaging solutions
* Collaborate with global and regional teams to align on standards, leverage scale, and share best practices
* Analyze market trends and provide insights to maintain competitive advantage

Analytics, Reporting & Strategy
  
  

* Develop and manage reporting on suppliers, costs, logistics, and performance metrics
* Use data-driven insights to improve efficiency and support strategic decisions
* Contribute to long-term supply chain strategy for India and broader APAC region
* Conduct risk assessments and develop contingency plans

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, or related field
* 6 -8+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, or logistics
* Experience in QSR, foodservice, industries preferred
* Strong understanding of the Indian supplier landscape and regulatory environment
* Proven experience in supplier sourcing, negotiation, and contract management
* Experience building or scaling supply chains in a growth or startup environment is highly valued
* Strong analytical, project management, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work cross-functionally and influence stakeholders
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, etc.)

**Who You Are**
No job is too small. You recognize that the real work happens in the restaurants, and everything we do should support their success. You stay humble, roll up your sleeves, and always look for ways to help. You learn from others and contribute wherever you can.
  
  
You care deeply about doing great work and driving results. You’re curious, ask questions, and seek out opportunities to improve. You don’t just point out problems—you bring solutions, ideas, and perspectives that move the team forward.
  
  
You take full responsibility for your work and see things through to completion. You aren’t afraid to fail because you know that failure is a part of learning and growth. You take action, move fast, and keep pushing forward.
  
  
You lead with empathy, respect, and emotional intelligence. You collaborate effectively, fostering a culture of trust and constructive feedback. You understand the importance of teamwork and ensure that your actions build others up rather than break them down.
  
  
You push yourself and others to be better. You embrace healthy conflict, knowing that great ideas and strong teams emerge from honest, constructive conversations. You believe that leaders create leaders and are committed to fostering a culture of growth, challenge, and continuous improvement.
  
  
Wingstop provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch

The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.

At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every

aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.

With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.

How will we do it?

There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:

Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.

Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.

Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.

Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:

* Individuals & Families
* Landlords & Second Home Owners
* Developers & RWAs
* Corporates

*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family*

A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.

*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager*

1. Customer Onboarding

* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold & onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.

2. Solution Deployment

* Define & agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day-to-day chores, & undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.

3. Partner Management

* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.

4. Customer Lifecycle Management

* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight & transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.

5. Customer Feedback & Service Improvement

* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify & work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise & highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.

Who are we looking for?

* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start-up
* Self-motivated & loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, & is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity & uncertainty
* Focused on problem-solving, has a solution-oriented mindset
* Hard-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure

Qualifications:

* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

title: Client Visit POD Lead- Manager
description:

1. Driving advisor-led high-intensity strategic deals across the deal lifecycle
2. Managing CECs driving brand and business experiences at our Noida and New Jersey centers and conceptualizing the new ones
3. Leading Client Visit Center of Excellence and managing high-impact client visits

The Client Visit CoE drives strategic engagement by curating high-impact, personalized and memorable experiences for top-tier client visits in line with the business priorities. The team collaborates closely with the ecosystem to showcase the latest and greatest at HCLTech, accelerating client growth and transformation while building and deepening relationships through meaningful engagements.

**Role Overview**

The
**Client Visit POD Lead**
will deliver high-impact client visit experiences across HCLTech’s global locations with a focus on the Top priority (Diamond / Platinum visits) in India to start with. This role is pivotal in shaping brand perception, reinforcing client relationships and driving business impact through structured, differentiated visit experiences aligned with HCLTech’s brand values and business priorities.

The POD Lead will be expert with proven experience in managing stakeholder expectations across multiple parallel client visits, understand requirements and plan CV experience for the POD, including a mix of verticals.

The Lead will be an expert in executing client visits end-to-end with a strong planning and operational rigor to manage client visits. The Lead would train team members on CV planning, execution. Should possess good understanding of the support functions, build right connections and collaborate for the client visit plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. High-touch Client Visit Experience orientation and planning**

* Gather client and sales feedback/ratings and draw insights to constantly enhance experiences

  Graduates or MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Communications or Business Management from a reputed institution.

Planning, collaboration and relationship building

* Proven experience managing cross-functional teams and engaging global stakeholders
* Ability to conceptualize and plan client visits across all touchpoints, ensuring seamless collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Delivery, GWS, GPS and other enabling functions

Visit execution and management

Business acumen

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**
SisuCare is dedicated to making healthcare careers more accessible across the U.S., especially for individuals who face barriers related to cost, location, or background. The organization offers flexible, affordable training programs that are closely connected to real job opportunities, including hybrid classes and options for employer-sponsored tuition.

We are seeking a strong, hands-on Operations Manager to serve as the senior management presence during the IST shift, overseeing the effective functioning of approximately 20 employees across multiple teams.

Team Leads will continue to manage their respective functions. This Manager will work across teams to ensure that work gets done on time, company standards and SOPs are followed, quality is maintained, and Team Leads and employees remain accountable.

This is not an administrative office-management role. It is an execution, accountability, quality and operational leadership position with authority to independently audit work across the organization.

Key responsibilites:

* Maintain a visible, hands-on management presence throughout the IST shift.
* Oversee daily execution across teams and ensure priorities, deadlines and deliverables are achieved.
* Hold Team Leads accountable for their teams' performance, productivity, quality and follow-through.
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, recurring mistakes and operational issues before they escalate.
* Ensure every significant issue has clear ownership, corrective action and a deadline.
* Conduct random and scheduled audits across departments to verify quality, accuracy, documentation and adherence to company standards and SOPs.
* Identify root causes of recurring errors and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
* Monitor operational KPIs, productivity, outstanding tasks and quality indicators.
* Ensure company policies, processes and management instructions are consistently followed.
* Coordinate cross-functional issues and prevent work from falling between departments.
* Recommend improvements to processes, SOPs, controls and operational workflows.
* Escalate significant performance, conduct, quality or compliance concerns to Executive Management.
* Provide a concise
  **daily management report**

  covering exceptions, missed deliverables, audit findings, corrective actions, recurring issues and matters requiring executive attention.

Ideal Candidate:

* **7–12+ years of professional experience**

  , with significant operations/management responsibility.
* Proven experience managing Team Leads, supervisors or multi-functional teams.
* Experience overseeing approximately
  **15–50+ employees**

  preferred.
* Strong background in operations, quality assurance, process management, audits or compliance.
* Highly organized, analytical and comfortable holding people accountable.
* Strong problem-solving and root-cause-analysis skills.
* Confident working directly with founders and senior management.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Experience in healthcare, education, technology, BPO/KPO or another process-driven/regulated environment is advantageous.

What success looks like:

Success means stronger operational discipline, fewer recurring errors, higher SOP compliance, timely completion of deliverables, faster resolution of issues, stronger Team Lead accountability and consistently high-quality work across the organization.

We are looking for someone who is visible, proactive and execution-focused—someone who does not wait for problems to reach them, but actively understands what is happening across teams, identifies gaps early and ensures that commitments are followed through to completion.

title: Lead - Program Management
description:
About the role

Adani Realty is hiring a Lead – Program Management to run the PMO for large infrastructure and urban redevelopment programmes from Noida. You will keep every workstream tied to one master schedule, budget and financial model, and give leadership early, evidence-based warnings with clear corrective actions.

Key responsibilities

Project monitoring & execution

• Track progress against the master schedule and milestones; keep the Strategic Master Plan current with all dependencies, linkages and budgets.

• Monitor contractor and consultant performance on scope, quality and timelines.

• Identify bottlenecks, drive corrective actions with the teams, run periodic project reviews and escalate critical issues to management.

Financial & budgeting

• Co-own the programme financial model with the Finance & Strategy team and keep refining it to maximise benefits.

• Run a monthly Earned Value Analysis against the baseline plan, reporting cost and schedule variances, root causes and CAPA.

• Measure project ROI every month and run sensitivity analysis to flag drag-down factors and course corrections.

• Assess the impact of key decisions on contracts, cost, schedule and manpower, and recommend adjustments.

Quality & compliance

• Ensure compliance with procurement, contracting, safety and regulatory requirements.

• Maintain quality controls that keep defects within defined limits.

• Keep execution aligned with ESG, Smart City and Net Zero commitments.

Stakeholder coordination

• Resolve issues with internal teams, contractors and consultants; hold regular reviews with department heads.

• Liaise with regulatory bodies to stay within statutory guidelines.

Risk management & reporting

• Identify risks and own mitigation plans.

• Report exceptions, safety concerns and non-compliance, along with project status, cost variances and corrective actions.

You will work with

Internal: CEO and senior leadership, Finance, Project Execution, Engineering & Design, Techno-Commercial, Legal & Compliance, Facilities Management, Safety, IT, and HR & Administration.

External: regulatory authorities, government bodies and municipal corporations, contractors and vendors, consultants and advisory firms, investors and financial institutions, technology partners, and the local community and residents.

What we are looking for

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration or a related field; a Master's degree is preferred.

• 12–14 years of experience in project execution, infrastructure or urban redevelopment.

• Strong grounding in project governance, financial tracking (EVA, ROI, sensitivity analysis), risk mitigation and impact analysis.

title: Program Manager, Climate Operations
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in program or project management.
* 5 years of experience with carbon accounting and methodologies or energy markets.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience in climate science, Green House Gas (GHG) Standards and accounting, or the energy industry.
* 8 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* Experience leading and executing complex strategic and operational initiatives for large organizations.
* Experience developing data-driven insights and translating and presenting these into meaningful recommendations for multiple audiences, including the C-Suite level.
* High-sense of organization and oriented towards execution.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
  
  
APAC is a key region of focus for our operational and value chain decarbonization roadmap, as well as other climate-related goals.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for leading strategic projects and provide clear, high-impact analysis and deliverables that help to evolve our regional strategy and accelerate carbon reduction. As part of these efforts, you will turn strategic insights/recommendations into action by working with various stakeholders, including key cross-functional leadership. You will partner with external experts to shape our perspective on carbon, energy, and other efforts and enable the broader decarbonization ecosystem.
  
  
The Global Sustainability team enables Google to build a more sustainable future for everyone by driving strategy and solutions. We drive the development and implementation of Google’s global sustainability strategy to further empower action, ensure alignment and prioritization, identify leadership opportunities, and mitigate risks. We drive sustainability strategy and programs on carbon, circular economy, water, product integration, reporting, and employee engagement, while serving as a sustainability leadership advocate internally and externally.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight for our carbon reduction, clean energy, and water strategy in APAC.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration to develop and execute strategic initiatives in pursuit of Google’s net zero and related sustainability commitments.
* Lead efforts with external experts and industry partners to drive progress on regional climate priorities.
* Manage an evolving portfolio of strategic projects and initiatives that advance the climate operations organization and enable its core objectives.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Deputy Manager - Quality (Incoming)
description:
**Job Description**
The Deputy Manager - Incoming Quality is responsible for ensuring the quality and compliance of incoming raw materials, sheet metal parts, electrical components, busbars, switchgear, and bought-out items used in the manufacturing of electrical switchboards and IEC 60947 products. The role involves supplier quality management, incoming inspection, customer and audit support, team leadership, and driving continuous improvement initiatives while ensuring compliance with ISO 9001 and applicable IEC standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead Incoming Quality Control (IQC) activities and ensure conformity of incoming materials to specifications and standards.
* Develop and implement inspection plans, sampling plans, and quality control procedures.
* Manage supplier quality performance, supplier audits, NCRs, and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with ISO 9001, IEC 60947, IEC 61439, and customer requirements.
* Analyze supplier defects and drive root cause analysis using 8D, 5 Why, and CAPA methodologies.
* Coordinate with Procurement, Engineering, Production, and Suppliers to resolve quality issues.
* Lead and develop the incoming quality team to achieve quality objectives.
* Support customer audits, certification audits, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor quality KPIs including Supplier PPM, Incoming Rejection Rate, NCR Closure, and Cost of Poor Quality.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma/BE/B.Tech, preferably in Electrical Engineering.
* 6+ years of relevant experience in the Quality department within the electrical switchgear/switchboard industry.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), ERP systems, and technical tools such as SPC, SOC, and other quality tools.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

title: Assistant Facility Manager Tech
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**Job Description:** Assistant Facility Manager (AFM) – TechnicalLocation: Client Site (24x7 Critical Operations Environment)
  
**Department:** Integrated Facilities Management Reports To: Facility Manager / Site Lead
  
**Work Schedule:** Client facility requires availability to support a 24x7 operational schedule, including rotational shifts, weekends, and emergency response as needed.
  
Position OverviewJLL is seeking an experienced Assistant Facility Manager – Technical to support critical facility operations at a client site operating on a 24x7 basis. The role is responsible for ensuring uninterrupted availability of critical equipment and infrastructure, driving preventive and proactive maintenance programs, coordinating annual maintenance contracts (AMCs), supporting sustainability initiatives, and consistently meeting and exceeding client service level agreements (SLAs). The ideal candidate combines strong technical knowledge of building and MEP systems with excellent vendor management and client-facing communication skills.
  
Key ResponsibilitiesCritical Equipment Operations and High Availability The AFM Tech will oversee day-to-day operations of critical infrastructure including HVAC systems, electrical distribution, UPS and DG sets, fire and life safety systems, BMS, and other mechanical and electrical assets, ensuring maximum uptime and availability in a round-the-clock operational environment. This includes managing shift schedules and technical teams to guarantee continuous coverage, responding promptly to equipment breakdowns, and minimizing downtime through structured root-cause analysis and corrective action. Track all events and activities for audit, governance and improvements
  
Preventive and Proactive Maintenance The role requires developing, implementing, and monitoring preventive maintenance (PM) calendars for all critical and non-critical assets in line with OEM recommendations and client requirements. The AFM Tech will drive proactive maintenance practices through condition monitoring, predictive maintenance techniques where applicable, and trend analysis of equipment performance data to anticipate failures before they occur, thereby reducing reactive maintenance incidents.
  
AMC Coordination Responsibilities include managing annual maintenance contracts with OEMs and third-party vendors, ensuring timely renewal and execution of AMCs, tracking vendor visit schedules and service reports, verifying compliance with contracted scope of work, and escalating gaps in vendor performance. The AFM Tech will maintain updated AMC documentation and ensure spare parts availability is aligned with contract terms.
  
Vendor Management The incumbent will coordinate with multiple vendors and service providers across MEP, housekeeping, security, and specialized technical services, ensuring work is executed to quality standards, within timelines, and in compliance with safety protocols. This includes vendor performance reviews, invoice verification support, and maintaining strong working relationships to ensure responsiveness during emergencies.
  
SLA Management and Service Excellence The AFM Tech is accountable for tracking and achieving all defined SLAs and KPIs related to equipment uptime, response and resolution times, and maintenance compliance, with a focus on consistently exceeding client expectations. This involves regular SLA reporting, dashboard updates, and participation in governance reviews with the client.
  
Sustainability Initiatives The role includes supporting and driving site-level sustainability programs such as energy optimization, water conservation, waste management, and emissions tracking in alignment with JLL and client sustainability goals. The AFM Tech will assist in data collection and reporting for sustainability metrics and identify opportunities for efficiency improvements across facility operations.
  
Client Handling and Stakeholder Communication The AFM Tech will serve as a key technical point of contact for the client on-site, managing day-to-day communication, addressing escalations promptly, and building strong working relationships with client stakeholders. This includes participating in periodic review meetings, presenting maintenance and performance updates, and ensuring transparent communication during incidents or planned shutdowns.
  
Documentation, Compliance, and Safety The role requires maintaining accurate records including PM logs, breakdown reports, AMC files, statutory compliance documentation, and safety checklists, while ensuring all work is carried out in accordance with EHS standards and statutory requirements.
  
Required Qualifications and ExperienceCandidates should hold a diploma or bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Electronics Engineering, with a minimum of 4 to 7 years of relevant experience in facility management or technical operations, preferably within a critical 24x7 environment such as a BFSI or related high regulated environemts and compliance requirements to support regular audit requirements . Demonstrated experience in handling HVAC, electrical, fire and life safety systems, and BMS is essential, along with proven experience in vendor and AMC management.
  
Key Skills and CompetenciesStrong technical troubleshooting ability across MEP systems, working knowledge of preventive and predictive maintenance practices, familiarity with CAFM/CMMS tools for maintenance tracking, and sound understanding of EHS and statutory compliance requirements are required. The candidate should demonstrate strong vendor negotiation and coordination skills, excellent client relationship management, and effective communication abilities, along with the capability to work under pressure in a high-availability, time-critical environment, including flexibility to work rotational shifts.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

Job Summary

Ompee Tower is looking for an experienced and responsible **Facility Manager** to manage the day-to-day operations, maintenance, safety, cleanliness, and overall upkeep of the tower. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring that all building facilities function efficiently and that tenants, occupants, visitors, and staff have a safe and comfortable environment.

**1. Building Maintenance**

* Oversee the maintenance of electrical systems, lifts, DG sets, HVAC/air-conditioning, plumbing, water supply, and other building equipment.

* Monitor equipment performance and coordinate with technical teams to resolve breakdowns.

* Ensure proper waste disposal, pest control, and hygiene standards.
* Conduct regular inspections of all common areas.

* Coordinate with security personnel and security agencies.
* Ensure proper functioning of CCTV, access-control systems, and other security equipment.
* Monitor fire alarms, firefighting equipment, emergency exits, and safety procedures.
* Coordinate emergency response and fire drills.

* Coordinate with maintenance vendors, electricians, plumbers, lift-service providers, and other contractors.
* Monitor the quality and timely completion of work.
* Maintain records of Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), service reports, and vendor bills.

* Leadership and staff supervision

* Safety awareness and emergency management
* Good communication and reporting skills

Promoting teamwork across the board

Competent and goal-driven

**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.CompensationAt Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. title: Senior Branch Manager
description:
Hiring: Senior Branch Manager – Kolkata

**Company:**
HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd.

**Job Title:**
Senior Branch Manager

**Location:**
Kolkata, West Bengal

**Industry:**
Gold Buying | Silver Buying | Gold Loan Settlement | Financial Services

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | On-Site

**Experience:**
3–5 Years (Gold Loan Industry Experience Required)

**Department:**
Branch Business & Sales Operations

About HNS Gold

HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. is a growing company specializing in gold and silver buying, gold loan settlement, and customer-focused financial services.

We purchase gold and silver from customers at competitive rates based on prevailing market prices, with a transparent valuation process and prompt payment.

As part of our business expansion in Kolkata, we are looking for experienced, result-oriented
**Senior Branch Managers with a strong background in the Gold Loan Industry**
to lead branch operations, drive business growth, and build high-performing teams.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Branch Business Development & Target Achievement**

* Take complete ownership of branch business performance, profitability, and growth.
* Drive monthly and daily business targets for gold buying, silver buying, gold loan settlement, and other company products.
* Develop and execute effective business generation strategies to consistently achieve branch targets.
* Identify high-value customers and generate business through direct customer meetings, referrals, and local market activities.
* Monitor business pipelines, customer appointments, and prospective transactions to ensure timely closures.

**2. Customer Acquisition & Sales Conversion**

* Generate new business through customer acquisition, existing customer engagement, and referral development.
* Ensure effective handling and conversion of walk-in customers, digital leads, and customer enquiries.
* Personally handle high-value customers, critical negotiations, and business closures.
* Build strong relationships with customers to encourage repeat transactions and referrals.
* Conduct field visits, customer meetings, and local business development activities as required.

**3. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, motivate, train, and monitor the branch team.
* Assign individual targets and monitor daily productivity and performance.
* Conduct daily business reviews and ensure effective follow-up on commitments.
* Coach team members on customer handling, sales conversion, and business development.
* Build a performance-driven culture with clear accountability and teamwork.

**4. Branch Operations & Compliance**

* Oversee daily branch operations, customer service, transaction processing, and documentation.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, KYC requirements, valuation procedures, and internal controls.
* Coordinate with the Operations Department for transaction approvals and operational matters.
* Maintain proper records, transaction accuracy, security procedures, and audit readiness.
* Ensure high standards of customer service and operational discipline.

**5. Local Market Development**

* Develop strong business networks within the branch catchment area.
* Establish relationships with potential customers and relevant local business contacts.
* Monitor competitor activities, local market opportunities, and customer requirements.
* Execute local marketing initiatives to increase branch visibility, customer footfall, and business volume.

**6. MIS Reporting & Business Reviews**

* Prepare and submit daily business reports, sales pipelines, and performance updates.
* Track business targets, walk-ins, conversion ratios, lead follow-ups, and customer acquisition.
* Identify performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
* Coordinate with Area Sales Managers and senior management to achieve business objectives.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
* **Minimum 3- 5 years of relevant experience in the Gold Loan Industry.**
* **Previous experience as a Branch Manager, Senior Branch Manager, or in a comparable branch leadership role within the gold loan sector.**
* **Proven track record of branch business development, target achievement, and team management.**
* **Strong knowledge of gold loan business operations, gold valuation processes, customer acquisition, and KYC requirements.**
* **Experience in handling branch sales, high-value customers, and business conversion.**
* **Good understanding of the Kolkata market and local customer segments.**
* **Proficiency in CRM systems, MS Excel, and business reporting.**

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Professionals currently working or previously employed in established gold loan companies, NBFCs, or relevant financial services organizations.
* Strong business development orientation with the ability to generate business independently.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, customer relationship management, and leadership skills.
* Ability to work in a target-driven business environment.
* Willingness to undertake local market visits and customer meetings.
* Experience managing branch profitability and building productive sales teams.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to take a leadership role in a growing organization.
* Performance-driven work environment.
* Career growth opportunities aligned with business expansion.
* Compensation based on relevant experience and role suitability.
* Performance-linked incentives as per company policy.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant gold loan industry experience are invited to apply through LinkedIn.

**Join HNS Gold and be part of our growing Kolkata branch network.**

* **HNS Gold Pvt. Ltd. | Kolkata, West Bengal**

title: Director, Technical Consulting (Salesforce Data Cloud)
description:
**Description**
Salesforce Professional Services - Global Delivery Centre (GDC) focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and execution of change programs. We are the trusted delivery partner for Salesforce Professional Services that ensures end to end multi-cloud delivery capabilities across all Salesforce technologies and scales with agility for successful customer outcomes! We at GDC strive to foster growth & innovation and enable for Salesforce Professional Services with focus on performance, productivity & impact.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Director, Technical Consulting (in the Architects’ Practice) to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. We are looking for an experienced professional services leader who has experience in scaling professional services delivery centers across the world. The Director, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in enabling, deploying, and building the careers of our technical architects team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You’ll be responsible for planning capacity, hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Architects, as well as guide them on their CTA journey and their upskilling path across modern AI platforms.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the Industries Architects’ consulting practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, specifically driving the evolution of an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology within the practice.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI environments, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Industries Clouds, ensuring teams leverage developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery and enforce platform security.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to establish evaluation frameworks that measure AI performance and business value.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Establish trust with the customer’s leadership, promoting and/or implementing best practices with SFI and Salesforce.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 18+ years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Expertise in leading Salesforce Field Service or Salesforce Data Cloud implementations.
* Expertise in one or multiple domains of → Financial Services, Health & Life Sciences, Manufacturing and Automotive, Retail and Consumer Goods, etc.
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Platform Security (Must have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security
* Sharing and Visibility (Must have)
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Apex Design Patterns (Must Have)
* Salesforce/Apex, Triggers, Lightning Flows, Lightning, LWC, and experience with modern web and mobile technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Web Components, others).
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* CTA
* Salesforce Certifications (Admin, Developer, Sales, and Service Clouds, System and Application Architect).
* OmniStudio Developer/Consultant
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, including hands-on delivery patterns for generative AI and agentic frameworks.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation frameworks, and outcomes.

title: Co-Founder
description:
**Company Description**
Worklance Connect is an India-focused talent acquisition and workforce solutions company that helps organizations build capable, scalable, and high-performing teams across white-collar, grey-collar, and blue-collar segments. The company delivers permanent recruitment, bulk hiring, specialized talent acquisition, and industry-focused staffing solutions, supported by structured candidate screening and dedicated hiring coordination. Worklance Connect operates a collaborative hiring ecosystem backed by an expanding network of recruiters and partners, including 1Hire, a dedicated platform for blue-collar and frontline workforce hiring. With multi-location and pan-India hiring capabilities, the company emphasizes transparent, professional processes that serve both employers and candidates. Its mission is to simplify recruitment, connect businesses with the right people, and create meaningful employment opportunities through a reliable, scalable hiring ecosystem.
  
**Role Description**
The Co-Founder role at Worklance Connect is a full-time, on-site position based in the Greater Kolkata Area, focused on building and scaling the company’s India-wide recruitment and workforce solutions business. This role involves defining and executing business strategy, overseeing key client relationships, and driving growth across permanent, bulk, and specialized hiring offerings. The Co-Founder will work closely with internal teams and recruitment partners to strengthen the hiring ecosystem, optimize processes, and ensure consistent delivery quality. Daily responsibilities include identifying new market opportunities, shaping sales and marketing initiatives, monitoring performance metrics, and making data-informed decisions to improve operational efficiency. The role also requires active involvement in team leadership, talent development, financial planning, and collaboration on product and platform enhancements such as the 1Hire blue-collar hiring platform.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills to interpret recruitment data, market trends, and performance metrics for strategic decision-making.
* Excellent communication skills for stakeholder management, client engagement, negotiation, and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven experience in sales, including business development, client acquisition, and revenue growth within HR, staffing, or related services.
* Marketing and research skills to shape go-to-market strategies, understand industry segments, and position Worklance Connect’s solutions effectively.
* Demonstrated leadership experience in building or scaling a business, startup, or high-growth team environment.
* Knowledge of recruitment, staffing, or talent acquisition operations across multiple workforce categories is highly beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area and collaborate closely with local and remote teams.
* Relevant bachelor’s or master’s degree in business, management, HR, or a related field preferred; entrepreneurial experience is a strong advantage.

title: ADN-Canada NFS-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior Associate**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
* Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
* Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
* Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
* 0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Risk Consulting-Digital Risk-Senior-IT Control
description:
