And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – Digital Risk – Senior – IT Internal Controls:**
At EY, we are all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We will help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Are you a tech-savvy professional with a risk mindset who is passionate about building a better working world through the power of people, technology, and innovation? We have an incredible opportunity for you to join our dynamic Digital Risk team and make a real impact in the rapidly evolving world we live in. Within Risk Consulting, you will focus in the areas of areas of IT Risk Management, IT SOX, IT Regulatory Compliance, IT Audits, IT and Digital Transformations (including ERP and Cloud transformations), while enabling technology to better manage risk. As a member of our team, you will have the chance to work with industry leaders and help transform businesses by tackling the most complex challenges with our clients.
  
  
This is client-facing role in a rapidly growing practice, where you’ll build client relationships with key stakeholders, including management executives for some of the most globally recognized brands. It makes this the perfect place to gain a deeper understanding of complex businesses transactions, all the while recommending solutions to some of the most pressing business challenges and process inefficiencies. You will also team up with our global professionals in multidisciplinary engagements, helping major global clients transform and sustain business performance. You will be leveraging emerging technologies like AI, ML, to build and enhance new solutions and actively work in building multiple tools and assets for efficient and effective client delivery. By plugging into our market-leading global network, you'll gain the experience you need to become an exceptional IT Risk Advisor.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Consistently deliver quality client services. Drive high-quality work products within expected timeframes and on budget. Monitor progress manage risk and ensure key stakeholders are kept informed about progress and expected outcomes.
* Foster relationships with client personnel to analyse, evaluate, and enhance information systems to develop and improve security at procedural and technology levels.
* Use knowledge of the current IT environment and industry trends to identify engagement and client service issues and communicate this information to the engagement team and client management through written correspondence and verbal presentations. Stay abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business.
* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and professional knowledge. Demonstrate ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge.
* Partnering with onshore teams to understand client’s business & related industry issues / trends for global clients.
* Contribute to new solution development basis the industry trends and client’s problem statement.
* Conduct knowledge sharing discussions & contribute to EY thought leadership.
* Understanding our clients’ overall technology strategy to effectively manage risk while transforming their business.
* Manage day-to-day client relationships, leading client meetings, working sessions, and status reporting.
* Stay up to date with emerging industry trends and technologies, suggest innovative solutions to engagement teams and provide recommendations to clients on potential risks and opportunities.
* Suggest ideas on improving engagement productivity and identify opportunities for improving client service.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of IT risk, information security frameworks such as COSO, COBIT etc.
* IT Risk and Controls assessment with exposure of any of the technologies such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, MS Dynamics or emerging technologies such as Cloud, RPA, AI/ML
* Cognitive problem-solving capabilities, quick decision-making skills and ability to handle complex situations with a calm demeanour.
* Exceptional interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills
* Effective organization and time management skills with the ability to work under pressure and adhere to project deadlines.
* Team player with strong interpersonal skills
* Ability to think differently and innovate

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Chartered accountant (CA) or Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Management, Information Systems/ Technology, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* Passion for technology and an ardent desire to work in risk management.
* Approximately 3-6 years of related work experience in Risks & Controls, IT Risk Management, IT Audit.

**Additionally, Good To Have**

* Proven experience in direct client facing roles, collaborate with cross functional teams including internal audits, IT security and business stakeholders to assess control effectiveness and facilitate remediation activities.
* Good to have relevant industry certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant).

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Prior Big 4 or consulting leadership experience.
* Demonstrated success in market development or sector focused propositions.
* Responsible for the performance and appraisal of direct reports, including training and developing necessary skill sets to enable them to grow in their careers.
* Coach junior team members, enabling them to meet their performance goals and successfully grow their careers.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Operating advanced recycling facilities equipped with special authorizations from the Government of India, the company processes high-grade recycled polymers and authorized imported raw materials from Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia. Under the leadership of Founder and Managing Director Mr. Rakesh Aggarwal, Recycle Plastics actively partners with urban local bodies (ULBs) and multinational corporations across Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) frameworks and plastic credit mechanisms to eliminate landfill waste.**

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for a detail-driven and experienced Assistant Manager EXIM & Banking Documentation**
to join our manufacturing and processing unit at the
**Kandla Special Economic Zone (KASEZ)**
.

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end management of import/export trade paperwork, customs documentation, and trade finance banking operations. You will act as the operational bridge between plant logistics, customs authorities, banks, customs house agents (CHAs), and internal finance teams to ensure zero demurrage, complete regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-border transactions.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Export & Import Documentation**

* Prepare, audit, and finalise pre- and post-shipment documents: Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Bills of Lading (BL), Certificates of Origin (COO), and declarations.
* Oversee import clearances of raw materials arriving at Kandla / Mundra ports, ensuring prompt filing and assessment of Bills of Entry (BOE).
* Coordinate export consignments, including Shipping Bills, factory-stuffing permissions, and container movement to port terminals.
* Coordinate with Custom House Agents (CHAs), freight forwarders, and shipping lines for vessel bookings, container tracking, and delivery orders.

**2. SEZ Online & Regulatory Compliance**

* Manage day-to-day operations on the
  **SEZ Online portal**
  (Bill of Entry, DTA procurement/sales, Sub-contracting challans, and SEZ-to-SEZ transfers).
* Ensure strict adherence to KASEZ customs guidelines, SEZ Act & Rules, foreign trade policy (FTP), and relevant clearance permissions.
* Maintain comprehensive registers for bonding, debonding, material inward/outward reconciliation, and assist in preparation for periodic SEZ/Customs audits.

**3. Banking & Trade Finance Paperwork**

* Handle all international trade banking paperwork, including inward and outward remittances (Advance Payments, Direct Remittances, and Open Account trade).
* Manage the application, vetting, submission, and retirement of import/export
  **Letters of Credit (LCs)**
  and
  **Bank Guarantees (BGs)**
  .
* Oversee regulatory trade compliance portals:
  **EDPMS**
  (export tracking/e-BRC generation) and
  **IDPMS**
  (import payment knock-offs and BOE settlement) to prevent RBI/EDPMS cautionary listings.
* Interface with partner banks trade finance desks to resolve documentation discrepancies, track forward exchange contracts, and negotiate transactional charges.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce (B.Com / M.Com), International Trade, Supply Chain, or Business Administration. A diploma/certification in Foreign Trade / EXIM is a strong advantage.
* **Experience:**
  3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in import-export documentation, trade finance banking, and customs clearance ideally within an SEZ manufacturing environment (Kandla / Mundra region preferred).
* **Technical Proficiency:**
* **Hands-on working knowledge of SEZ Online**
  and
  **ICEGATE**
  .
* Thorough operational understanding of
  **IDPMS, EDPMS, and DGFT portals**
  .
* Familiarity with ERP software (SAP / Tally) and advanced MS Excel.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Firm grasp of Incl terms 2020, customs tariff heads (HS codes), FEMA guidelines for trade credit, and UCP 600 rules for Letters of Credit.
* **Core Competencies:**
  High attention to procedural detail, strong communication skills for multi-stakeholder management (customs, banks, overseas suppliers), and proactive problem-solving.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be an integral part of an industry leader shaping circular economy solutions and sustainable polymer supply chains in India.
* Dynamic work environment with high autonomy in international trade operations.
* Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and regional expertise.

title: Director, Manufacturing Operations
description:
**Role purpose**
Own end-to-end manufacturing performance at a new, highly automated beverage plant: safe, compliant, on-plan delivery at the right quality and cost. The role leads production, warehouse operations, maintenance and production planning as one integrated system, and builds an organization where decisions sit with the people closest to the work.
  
  
The plant, systems and team are new. The incumbent will take operations from ramp-up to stable, benchmark performance, and will shape the standards, routines and culture the site runs on for years.
  
  
The role is part of Plant leadership team and provides an opportunity to shape the strategy and vision for the site.
  
  
The context you will lead in-
  
  
**Highly automated plant.**
Liquid manufacturing, high-speed filling lines and a fully automated warehouse (ASRS, robotic palletizing, AGVs and AMRs), integrated through SAP, MES and batch control.
  
  
**Lean, ownership-based operating model.**
Area Owners operate and maintain their equipment; Technical Associates provide electrical and instrumentation depth on demand. There is no team lead layer by design.
  
  
**Phased ramp-up.**
Additional lines and manufacturing rooms come online in phases while running lines must hit committed market volumes.
  
  
**Excellence built in.**
Autonomous Maintenance, reliability-centred maintenance and structured capability building are being embedded from day one.
  
  
Key accountabilities
  
  

* Safety and compliance
* Lead a safety culture where everyone stops unsafe work and owns their risk: LOTO, permit to work, pre-task risk assessment and behaviour-based safety as daily routine.
* Ensure operational compliance with labour, factory safety, food safety, environmental and equipment regulations, with clear owners and evidence for every obligation.
* Production delivery and ramp-up
* Deliver the ramp-up plan for each line and product family, including qualification and verification of new lines.
* Drive OEE, right-first-time quality and conversion cost through structured loss analysis.
* Partner with Quality to build in-process quality ownership on the shop floor, reducing reliance on downstream inspection.
* Production planning and customer delivery
* Own the master production schedule and finite schedule, balancing customer demand, changeovers, maintenance windows and material availability.
* Deliver OTIF and plan adherence; lead the operations input to S&OP.
* Manage exceptions (material shortages, demand changes, breakdowns) through defined decision rights, not escalation.
* Warehouse operations
* Stabilise and optimise automated warehouse performance: availability, throughput, inventory accuracy and dispatch OTIF.
* Integrate warehouse, production and planning so material flow is seamless end to end.
* Hold automation partners to performance through clear SLAs and joint problem solving.
* Maintenance and asset reliability
* Lead a maintenance strategy built on three pillars: reliability-centred maintenance, Autonomous Maintenance and capability building.
* Shift the maintenance mix from reactive to planned; drive MTBF, MTTR and PM compliance.
* Own critical spares strategy and maintenance cost.
* People, capability and culture
* Build leader-leader behaviours: push decisions to where the information is, coach rather than direct.
* Progress every associate up a visible capability ladder; build succession for each functional lead.
* Establish standards, daily management routines and a no-blame, high-accountability culture.
* Continuous improvement and digital
* Run structured loss elimination and continuous improvement routines across all four functions.
* Use MES, SCADA and warehouse system data to make decisions on the floor; drive adoption of digital tools that make execution easier.
* Build a pipeline of improvements that sustain gains after ramp-up.

**Experience**

* 10 to 12 years in manufacturing operations, with at least 5 years leading multi-function plant operations (production plus maintenance and/or warehouse).
* Track record in FMCG or similar process and packaging environment.
* Led a greenfield / brownfield start-up, major expansion or ramp-up through to stable performance.
* Demonstrated results in IWS / IL6S or equivalent operational excellence programs, demonstrating deep understanding of autonomous Maintenance, reliability engineering, capability building and structured loss elimination.
* Exposure to automated warehousing, MES or digitally integrated plants (strongly preferred).

Education
  
  

* Engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, chemical or electronics). MBA or post-graduate qualification in industrial engineering or operations preferred.

**Job Purpose:**

**Responsibilities**
**Network & Cloud CyberSecurity Specialist**
**Network Security Tools And Technologies Management**
Configuration and management of network security tools (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring platforms, proxy, NAC etc).
  
  
Ensure network security technologies are properly tuned, updated, and optimized to detect and prevent security incidents.
  
  
**Network Security Operations Management**
Manage the day-to-day operations of the network security team, ensuring effective monitoring, detection, and response to network security incidents.
  
  
Ensure that network security controls (e.g., firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, network monitoring tools) are deployed and optimized to protect the organization’s infrastructure.
  
  
Establish and lead a proactive approach to identifying and addressing emerging network threats, vulnerabilities, and attack patterns.
  
  
**Incident Response And Risk Management**
Assist organization’s network incident response plan, ensuring rapid identification, containment, and mitigation of security incidents and breaches.
  
  
Lead root cause analysis of network security incidents, ensuring lessons learned are applied to enhance security measures.
  
  
Conduct risk assessments of network systems and lead efforts to implement appropriate risk mitigation strategies and controls.
  
  
**Cloud Security & Zero Trust**
Implement and oversee cloud security controls and cloud firewalls.
  
  
Support Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) strategies, ensuring robust authentication, authorization, and micro-segmentation.
  
  
Manage privileged access controls and enforce security policies to mitigate insider threats and external risks.
  
  
**Collaboration With Cross-Functional Teams**
Partner with other departments, such as IT, compliance, legal, and risk management, to ensure alignment of network security strategies with broader organizational objectives.
  
  
Work closely with senior executives to provide updates on network security risks and vulnerabilities, offering recommendations for improvement.
  
  
Collaborate with other cybersecurity leaders to develop a cohesive, integrated approach to security across the enterprise.
  
  
**Continuous Improvement And Innovation**
Stay informed on the latest network security trends, technologies, and emerging threats to ensure the organization is protected from evolving risks.
  
  
Drive the evaluation and implementation of new network security technologies and tools to enhance the organization’s cybersecurity capabilities.
  
  
Promote a culture of continuous improvement within the network security operations team by encouraging innovation and operational excellence.
  
  
**Regulatory Compliance**
Ensure that network security operations adhere to relevant compliance requirements, ISO 27001
  
  
Oversee internal and external audits related to network security, ensuring all necessary documentation and evidence are provided.
  
  
Maintain a strong understanding of global regulatory trends and ensure that network security practices meet the highest industry standards.
  
  
**Network Security Reporting And Documentation**
Prepare and deliver regular reports to executive leadership on the health of the network security program, including threat intelligence, incident status, risk assessments, and compliance status.

Maintain and manage key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to track the effectiveness of network security initiatives.

This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

title: Analyst, Cluster Head- Current Account, Consumer Banking Group
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Cluster Business Ownership
* Deliver new-to-bank current-account acquisition, account activation, average quarterly balance growth, transaction throughput and fee-income targets for the cluster.
* Build and execute a catchment-led acquisition strategy for high-potential business segments such as wholesalers, distributors, manufacturers, traders, schools, hospitals, clinics, professional firms and service establishments.
* Translate cluster targets into branch-, team- and individual-level productivity plans.
* Own the current-account business plan, sales funnel, conversion pipeline and weekly performance rhythm.
* Improve portfolio quality by prioritising transaction-active, balance-building and cross-sell-ready relationships over dormant or low-value acquisition.
* Sales Leadership and Channel Execution
* Lead, coach and motivate a field-sales organisation to consistently deliver acquisition and value-build targets.
* Establish a disciplined sales cadence covering joint calls, market visits, lead reviews, branch huddles, pipeline reviews and conversion tracking.
* Ensure each relationship manager follows a profile-based sales approach rather than a generic product pitch.
* Develop market intelligence on competitor propositions, local business clusters, referral sources and emerging commercial hubs.
* Build productive referral ecosystems with Chartered Accountants, trade associations, market intermediaries, merchant networks, developers, institutional administrators and existing clients.
* Current-Account Activation and Value Build-Up
* Ensure newly acquired accounts become transaction-active within defined activation timelines.
* Drive operating balances, inward credits, collections, payment activity and digital banking adoption.
* Track early-warning indicators including low funding, non-activation, declining balances, low transaction velocity and potential attrition.
* Build strategies to migrate primary transaction flows—collections, vendor payments, payroll, taxes and operating cash—to the bank.
* Improve account quality by monitoring average balance, debit transactions, credit transactions and account profitability.
* Solution-Led Cross-Sell
* Use the current account as the primary operating hub for business clients and identify the appropriate product solution based on the customer’s business model.
* Drive adoption of corporate internet banking and mobile approvals; cash management and bulk payment solutions; POS, Android POS, QR and Soundbox; sweep-in / sweep-out or FFD structures; debit cards; collections and transaction banking solutions; and promoter, family, wealth and premium savings propositions.
* Partner with product teams to convert business pain points into integrated propositions—for example, POS for collections, Internet Banking for payment controls, FFD for temporary balances and Aspire/premium banking for promoter wallet deepening.
* Customer Relationship and Service Governance
* Build senior-level relationships with anchor clients and participate in strategic joint calls for high-value prospects.
* Ensure timely resolution of onboarding, account-opening, transaction, service and digital-banking issues.
* Work with branches and operations teams to reduce turnaround time, improve onboarding quality and strengthen client experience.
* Review top customers and at-risk accounts regularly to protect balances, transactions and wallet share.
* Drive customer retention through proactive engagement, problem solving and relevant product deepening.
* Risk, Compliance and Portfolio Quality
* Ensure all sourcing, onboarding and account activation follows internal policies and applicable KYC, AML, fraud-risk and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain high standards of customer due diligence, documentation quality, source-of-funds understanding and business-profile validation.
* Monitor exceptions, unusual transaction behaviour, documentation gaps and operational risks; escalate promptly where needed.
* Build a culture of right-first-time acquisition, with no compromise on compliance for target achievement.
* People Leadership
* Recruit, develop, retain and performance-manage a high-quality current-account sales team.
* Set clear scorecards covering acquisition, activation, AQB/AMB, transaction activity, fee income, cross-sell, productivity, service quality and compliance.
* Conduct structured coaching through joint market visits, call observations, weekly reviews and capability-building sessions.
* Identify skill gaps and develop targeted interventions around sales planning, segment understanding, solution selling, digital banking and compliance.
* Maintain a strong talent pipeline and manage attrition proactively.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. **The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced
**Manager – Microsoft Purview**
to design, implement, and support enterprise data protection and compliance solutions. The ideal candidate will possess strong expertise in Microsoft Purview Data Security services, including
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Classification and Sensitivity Labelling, Insider Risk Management, and Data Lifecycle Management**
. The candidate should also possess sound understanding of
**DSPM for AI and Data Governance.**
The professional will work closely with business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technical teams to protect sensitive information, reduce insider risks, and ensure regulatory compliance across the organization's data estate.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Data Loss Prevention (DLP)**

* Design, implement, and optimize Microsoft Purview DLP policies across Microsoft 365 services, endpoints, and supported third-party repositories.
* Define detection logic using Sensitive Information Types (SITs), trainable classifiers, custom classifiers, and EDM.
* Monitor DLP incidents and provide recommendations for policy tuning and risk reduction.
* Support deployment of Endpoint DLP controls for data exfiltration prevention.

**Data Classification & Labelling**

* Develop enterprise data classification frameworks aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Configure and manage Sensitivity Labels, Label Policies, Auto-labelling, and Mandatory Labelling strategies.
* Perform data discovery and classification workshops with business stakeholders.
* Support protection technologies including encryption, content markings, and access controls.

**DSPM for AI**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI policies, assessments, and risk monitoring.
* Investigate AI-related data exposure, oversharing, and compliance risks.
* Develop AI governance use cases focused on responsible AI adoption and data protection.
* Deliver AI risk insights, posture reports, and executive dashboards.

**Data Governance**

* Configure and manage Microsoft Purview Data Governance capabilities and services.
* Drive data discovery, classification, cataloguing, and lineage initiatives.
* Develop governance frameworks for data quality, ownership, compliance, and lifecycle management.
* Produce governance metrics, compliance reports, and executive dashboards.

**Insider Risk Management**

* Configure and manage Insider Risk Management policies and analytics.
* Investigate insider risk alerts and collaborate with security, legal, compliance, and HR teams during investigations.
* Develop insider risk use cases focused on data theft, data leakage, security policy violations, and privilege misuse.
* Produce risk reports and executive dashboards.

* Implement retention labels, retention policies, disposition reviews, and records management controls.
* Support regulatory and compliance requirements through information governance processes.
* Assist in defining data retention schedules and defensible data disposal strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to automate lifecycle management processes.

* Conduct workshops, assessments, and requirement-gathering sessions.
* Develop solution designs, implementation plans, and governance frameworks.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), pilot deployments, and production rollouts.
* Create technical documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Provide troubleshooting support and operational guidance for Purview solutions.
* Stay current with Microsoft Purview roadmap, emerging data protection trends, and compliance requirements.

+ Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
+ Sensitivity Labels and Information Protection
+ Data Classification and Governance
+ Insider Risk Management
+ DSPM for AI
+ Data Governance
+ Data Lifecycle Management (desirable)
+ Records Management (desirable)

* Experience with Microsoft 365 Compliance Centre and Microsoft Purview Portal.

* Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Microsoft Security ecosystem integrations.
* Knowledge of cloud security and Microsoft 365 architecture.

**Professional Attributes**

* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Ability to translate business requirements into security controls and governance policies.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Consulting mindset with client-facing experience.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* 9+ years of experience in data protection, information security, compliance, or Microsoft 365 security technologies.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
* Excellent analytical skills and knowledge of data analytics methods
* Demonstrated leadership abilities
* Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, communication, and presentation skills

The ideal candidate will have:

* **5+ years** of experience in scanning, digitization, **Business Process Outsourcing (BPO)** , document management, or high-volume operations, with at least 3 years of team leadership experience managing teams of 30 or more.

* **Fluent communication skills in Tamil** (spoken, read, and written) with a **notice period of less than 30 days** (immediate joiners preferred); a Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Commerce, or a related field is preferred.

title: Sr Supply Chain Executive
description:
Job Summary\*\*
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr Supply Chain Executive to join our dynamic team at Unilever Plc. This role is crucial in optimizing our supply chain operations, ensuring efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery of products to our global customers.
  
  
Job Responsibilities\*\*
  
  

* Develop and implement supply chain strategies to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and improve service levels.
* Manage end-to-end supply chain processes, including demand planning, procurement, logistics, warehousing, and inventory management.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., manufacturing, marketing, sales) to align supply chain activities with business objectives.
* Lead and mentor a team of supply chain professionals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.
* Identify and mitigate supply chain risks, including supplier disruptions, transportation issues, and inventory obsolescence.
* Analyze supply chain data to identify trends, opportunities for optimization, and areas for improvement.
* Negotiate contracts with suppliers and logistics partners to ensure favorable terms and conditions.
* Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations, quality standards, and company policies throughout the supply chain.
* Drive the adoption of new technologies and best practices in supply chain management.
* Prepare and present regular reports on supply chain performance to senior management.

Job Qualifications\*\*
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive experience in supply chain management, preferably within the FMCG sector.
* Proven track record of successfully managing complex supply chain operations and achieving measurable results.
* Strong understanding of supply chain principles, methodologies, and best practices (e.g., S&OP, Lean, Six Sigma).
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed decisions.
* Proficiency in supply chain planning software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, JDA) and advanced Excel skills.
* Exceptional leadership and team management abilities, with experience in mentoring and developing staff.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills, capable of building effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and innovation in supply chain processes.

title: MSFDL-Manager - Data Audit Framework
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: Manager – Data Operations**
**Summary:**
We are looking for a skilled and experienced Manager – Data Operations to manage the day-to-day operation of enterprise data pipelines and platforms supporting corporate finance transformation.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operational oversight, service management, and team leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with data engineering, platform, governance, and business teams to support finance processes across P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A.
  
  
You will be accountable for operational performance, incident coordination, data quality monitoring, and continuous improvement within the assigned service scope, helping business users and clients access trusted data within agreed service levels.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

title: Tech S And T-Cloud AI Platform Engineer-ISR-Senior-GDSF02
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description – Manager (Cloud AI Platform Engineer)**
**Experience:**
10–13 years
  
  
**Role Overview:**
The Manager will play a pivotal role in building and scaling EY GDS's AI Strategy & Transformation practice. This leadership role combines hands-on cloud and AI platform engineering expertise with consulting excellence, driving end-to-end AI platform implementation, infrastructure modernization and enterprise deployment programs while managing senior client relationships and CxO engagements. The position demands deep technical implementation skills in AI platform and infrastructure engineering, multi-cloud architecture, automation and deployment engineering, MLOps enablement and operationalization of AI workloads alongside proven program leadership across industries like BFSI, manufacturing and regulated sectors.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering Leadership**

* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI platforms that support AI/ML, GenAI, Agentic AI and RAG workloads across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Architect scalable cloud-native AI foundations using AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure ML and Azure OpenAI, GCP Vertex AI and enterprise Kubernetes platforms such as EKS, AKS and GKE.
* Build secure and resilient infrastructure for AI model development, training, deployment and runtime operations including compute, GPU environments, storage, networking, secrets management and access control.
* Design reusable platform services for model hosting, inference endpoints, vector databases, prompt orchestration, agent runtime support and enterprise API integration.
* Establish platform observability with centralized logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, performance diagnostics and cost optimization for AI systems.
* Enable secure AI platform controls with policy enforcement, access governance, auditability and support for Responsible AI, compliance and risk requirements.
* Drive standardization of AI platform architecture through reusable patterns, landing zones, environment templates and enterprise engineering best practices.

**Client & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as primary technical advisor to CxOs, account leadership teams and enterprise engineering stakeholders on AI platform strategy, cloud modernization and deployment architecture.
* Conduct technical workshops demonstrating platform blueprints, deployment models, MLOps capabilities, observability approaches and AI operational readiness.
* Bridge platform engineering with business strategy by translating complex infrastructure capabilities into scalable business outcomes and delivery roadmaps.
* Build trusted relationships through hands-on PoC delivery, architecture discussions and strategic guidance on AI platform adoption.

**Cloud, Automation & Deployment Engineering Leadership**

* Lead automation of AI infrastructure provisioning using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates and CloudFormation.
* Design and implement CI/CD and CT pipelines for AI platforms, model deployment services, APIs, microservices and environment lifecycle management.
* Drive containerization and orchestration patterns using Docker and Kubernetes including workload isolation, autoscaling, high availability and release automation.
* Build deployment frameworks for AI and GenAI applications using REST services, FastAPI, model serving frameworks, serverless patterns and integration middleware.
* Automate configuration management, secrets handling, policy validation, artifact promotion and environment provisioning across dev, test and production landscapes.
* Implement release engineering practices including blue-green deployment, canary rollout, rollback mechanisms and platform upgrade planning.
* Ensure platform reliability, scalability and supportability through automated testing, operational runbooks, resilience engineering and incident readiness.

**MLOps, Data Pipelines & Operationalization Leadership**

* Lead the setup and scaling of MLOps and LLMOps capabilities including experiment tracking, model versioning, model registry, artifact management, pipeline orchestration and deployment governance.
* Establish standardized operationalization pipelines for model training, validation, packaging, deployment, monitoring and retraining across enterprise AI use cases.
* Drive integration of AI platforms with batch and real-time data pipelines using Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks and cloud-native data services.
* Design and govern reliable data flows for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, feature engineering, feature store integration, vector store enablement and metadata lineage.
* Implement monitoring for models and services covering drift detection, latency, throughput, failure diagnostics and service-level performance.
* Collaborate closely with data science, AI engineering and application teams to productionize prototypes, notebooks and GenAI use cases into enterprise-grade deployments.
* Drive operational best practices around reproducibility, traceability, auditability and support for regulated or risk-sensitive environments.

**Asset and Accelerator Development**

* Lead creation of EY IP including AI platform reference architectures, reusable IaC modules, deployment blueprints, MLOps templates and observability accelerators.
* Develop reusable frameworks for secure AI environment setup, platform monitoring dashboards, model deployment factories and RAG infrastructure enablement.
* Package technical accelerators as EY market offerings for rapid client deployment across industries and cloud ecosystems.

**Business Development & GTM Initiatives**

* Lead technical solutioning for AI platform transformation RFPs including architecture blueprints, deployment approaches, cloud landing patterns and live PoC demonstrations.
* Develop industry-specific GTM strategies that combine EY assets with hyperscaler AI platform services and enterprise automation capabilities.
* Collaborate with sales teams to position EY as a trusted partner for AI platform engineering, cloud AI operationalization and secure enterprise AI deployment.

**Program Governance & Delivery Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end AI platform transformation programs from infrastructure discovery through production deployment, operational handover and value realization.
* Manage cross-functional delivery teams including cloud engineers, platform engineers, ML engineers, DevOps specialists and data engineers across multiple workstreams.
* Ensure technical excellence, risk mitigation and KPI achievement in complex enterprise AI platform and deployment programs.

**Practice Development & Team Leadership**

* Mentor consultants and seniors in AI platform engineering, cloud architecture, automation practices and MLOps operationalization across the broader EY GDS AI practice.
* Lead technical recruitment and capability building for cloud AI platform engineering excellence.
* Drive innovation PoCs showcasing enterprise AI platforms, scalable GenAI deployment models, advanced observability and sovereign AI infrastructure capabilities.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**
**Education:**
B.Tech/B.E. (Computer Science / IT / AI / ML mandatory); M.Tech / MS in Cloud Computing, AI, Data Engineering or Machine Learning (preferred).
  
  
**Core Technical Expertise (Hands-on Implementation Required):**

* AI Platform & Infrastructure Engineering: Strong hands-on experience in designing and managing enterprise AI platforms, model hosting environments, inference systems, vector database infrastructure, API-based AI services and secure runtime environments.
* Cloud Platforms: Deep expertise in AWS, Azure and GCP with focus on AI and infrastructure services such as SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure ML, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AKS, EKS, GKE, IAM, networking, storage and monitoring.
* Automation & Deployment Engineering: Strong knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, ARM, CloudFormation, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, Kubernetes, deployment automation, microservices architecture and release engineering.
* MLOps / LLMOps: Experience with MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML pipelines, Vertex AI pipelines, model registry, experiment tracking, model serving, deployment governance and monitoring.
* Data Engineering & Operationalization: Understanding of ETL and ELT pipelines, Airflow, Prefect, Spark, Kafka, Databricks, feature stores, streaming and batch processing and production data pipelines for AI workloads.
* Programming & APIs: Proficiency in Python, shell scripting, YAML, JSON, REST APIs, FastAPI and automation scripting for platform and cloud operations.
* Security & Governance: Familiarity with platform security, secrets management, policy controls, auditability, observability and support for Responsible AI and enterprise governance requirements.

**AI and Data Science Certifications (Good to have):**

* Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate / Azure DevOps Engineer / Azure Solutions Architect
* AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty / AWS DevOps Engineer / AWS Solutions Architect
* Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer / Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
* Additional: Kubernetes certifications (CKA / CKAD), Terraform Associate, Databricks certifications, MLOps or cloud platform engineering certifications

**Consulting & Leadership Experience:**

* 10–13 years in cloud platform engineering, AI platform engineering, DevOps, MLOps or AI consulting (Big 4 / tech preferred).
* Proven track record leading enterprise AI platform implementations across BFSI, manufacturing, healthcare or public sector.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated industry deployments and multi-cloud architecture programs.

**Soft Skills:**

* Exceptional technical storytelling for CxO audiences.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders through working prototypes, architecture deep dives and platform transformation roadmaps.
* Leadership of diverse technical teams with clear delivery focus.

**Portfolio Requirements:**
Hands-on experience in building production-grade cloud AI platforms, automated deployment frameworks, MLOps pipelines and enterprise AI infrastructure is mandatory for interview stage.

* Serving as the Finance single point of contact for Engagement Partners and Managers, offering guidance and overseeing all aspects of the Opportunity Engagement Lifecycle (OEL).
* Overseeing the completion of OEL tasks by delegating to Centres of Excellence (CoEs), and monitoring progress to ensure timely delivery.
* Proactively managing financial and quality related risks across your engagement portfolio, intervening where needed to provide strategic advice to uplift the compliance and revenue stability of your portfolio.
* Ensure compliance with service line specific policies and parameters.
* Supporting the annual external audit process.

This is a dynamic and rewarding role that contributes to profitable growth and high-quality client service.

* Manage a portfolio of client opportunities and engagements, acting as the Finance single point of contact for the Engagement Partners with complex portfolios.
* Manage the professional development, coaching and upskilling of other EBPs in the team.

+ Apply knowledge of service line specific OEL policies and guidelines to ensure compliance across the OEL lifecycle.
+ Monitor and advise on risk assessment and compliance processes.
+ Advise on pricing models and engagement budgets.
+ Assess financial implications of engagement structures and budgets.
+ Support and challenge the Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) processes and related financial updates.
+ Support the portfolio’s working capital activity.

* Provide challenge and best practice insights to client servers where required such as through optimal margin, pricing plans or engagement structures.

* Share best practices across the EBP group to drive consistency and excellence.
* Engage with CoE Managers to flag issues, trends or knowledge required for CoE upskilling.
* Provide subject matter expertise in delivering training on OEL best practices for CoEs.
* Support continuous improvement through identifying opportunities for innovation and automation.

* Confident communicator who can challenge constructively and influence outcomes.
* Excellent analytical and commercial acumen, with high attention to detail.
* Take ownership of monthly activities, driving progress and proactively managing business outcomes to meet deadlines and performance targets.
* Quick learner with a proactive approach and eager to share knowledge with others.
* Ability to translate complex technical system language into business-relevant terms.
* Skilled listener with sound judgment and the ability to escalate appropriately.
* Ability to lead others and support team development.

* A minimum of two to three years’ experience in a client-facing or finance-related role within a professional services or corporate environment.
* Experience managing stakeholders and delivering high-impact client service.
* Ability to lead others in hybrid and fast-paced environments.
* Used to working in a fast-paced environment with a strong work ethic.
* Ability to build relationships with people at all levels within the firm.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint).
* Adaptability and resilience in fast-paced environments.

title: General Manager - Administration & Operations
description:
NAVERA BUILDERS PVT. LTD.JOB DESCRIPTION – GENERAL MANAGER – OPERATIONS

**Department:** Administration & Operations  
**Location:** Thrissur, Kerala  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Designation:** General Manager – Operations  
**Working Hours:** 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday

1. Job Summary

Navera Builders Pvt. Ltd. is seeking an experienced, strategic, and result-oriented **General Manager – Operations** to oversee and streamline the overall business operations of the company. The role involves coordinating construction projects, site operations, procurement, administration, human resources, customer relations, and interdepartmental activities to ensure operational efficiency, cost control, quality, and timely project execution.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, extensive experience in the construction or building industry, and the ability to manage multiple departments while achieving organizational objectives.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Overall Operations Management**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations of the company, including office administration, project execution, and site activities.
* Develop and implement operational policies, procedures, and systems to improve efficiency and productivity.
* Ensure smooth coordination between management, project teams, sales, finance, purchase, HR, and customer relationship management (CRM) departments.
* Monitor operational performance and ensure that company objectives and targets are achieved.

**B. Construction Project & Site Coordination**

* Monitor the progress of all ongoing construction projects and ensure timely completion as per approved schedules.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Senior Project Engineers, Site Engineers, QS, QA/QC teams, and contractors.
* Review project progress reports, site requirements, manpower deployment, material availability, and work schedules.
* Identify project delays, operational challenges, and resource gaps, and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to approved drawings, technical specifications, quality standards, and safety procedures.

**C. Cost Control & Resource Management**

* Monitor operational expenses, project budgets, and resource utilization.
* Coordinate with Finance, Accounts, Purchase, and Quantity Surveying teams to control costs and minimize wastage.
* Ensure effective utilization of manpower, materials, machinery, and other resources.
* Review material consumption, procurement schedules, and project-related expenditure.
* Identify opportunities for cost reduction without compromising quality or safety.

**D. Procurement & Vendor Management**

* Oversee procurement activities and ensure timely availability of construction materials and equipment.
* Coordinate with the Purchase and Stores departments to maintain appropriate inventory levels.
* Evaluate vendor performance, pricing, delivery schedules, and service quality.
* Ensure proper documentation of purchase orders, material receipts, stock movements, and related records.
* Maintain effective relationships with suppliers, contractors, and service providers.

**E. Administration & Human Resource Management**

* Supervise administrative functions, office facilities, and general operational support.
* Coordinate with HR regarding recruitment requirements, manpower planning, attendance, discipline, and employee performance.
* Ensure that employees follow company policies, procedures, reporting structures, and working schedules.
* Identify training requirements and support employee development initiatives.
* Promote accountability, teamwork, and a professional work culture across departments.

**F. Sales, CRM & Customer Coordination**

* Coordinate with Sales and CRM teams to ensure smooth communication between customers and project teams.
* Monitor customer commitments, project-related updates, handover schedules, and service requests.
* Support timely resolution of customer complaints and operational issues.
* Ensure effective coordination between sales commitments and actual project execution.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and recommend improvements in service delivery.

**G. Quality, Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements, company policies, and construction safety standards.
* Coordinate with QA/QC teams to maintain construction quality and resolve quality-related issues.
* Ensure proper site housekeeping, safety practices, and use of personal protective equipment.
* Monitor documentation, approvals, inspections, and other project compliance requirements.
* Escalate significant operational, safety, quality, or compliance risks to senior management.

**H. Reporting & Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare and review periodic operational reports for management.
* Monitor project timelines, operational costs, manpower productivity, material utilization, and departmental performance.
* Conduct regular operational review meetings with department heads and project teams.
* Establish measurable KPIs and follow up on corrective actions.
* Provide management with recommendations for improving profitability, efficiency, and business performance.

3. Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA or postgraduate qualification in Operations or Management will be an added advantage.
* Minimum **8–12 years of relevant experience**, preferably in the construction, building, or real estate development industry.
* Previous experience in senior operations management or multi-department coordination is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of construction project execution, procurement, cost control, manpower management, and administration.
* Experience managing multiple projects and coordinating with cross-functional teams.

4. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership, decision-making, and team management skills.
* Excellent planning, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of construction operations, budgets, schedules, and resource planning.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve operational challenges.
* Proficiency in MS Office, Excel, reporting tools, and project management software.
* Strong focus on productivity, quality, cost efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of projects and operational activities.
* Effective control of operational costs and project expenditure.
* Improved manpower productivity and resource utilization.
* Timely availability of construction materials and equipment.
* Reduction in material wastage, rework, and operational delays.
* Compliance with quality, safety, and statutory requirements.
* Improved coordination and performance across departments.
* Customer satisfaction and timely resolution of complaints.
* Achievement of operational targets and management objectives.

6. Reporting Structure

**Reports To:** Managing Director / Chief Executive Officer

**Key Coordination With:** Project Managers, Engineering Team, QA/QC Team, Quantity Surveying, Purchase & Stores, Finance & Accounts, HR & Administration, Sales & Marketing, and CRM.

7. Working Conditions

* Full-time position based at the corporate office in Thrissur, Kerala.
* Regular coordination with construction sites and project teams.
* Site visits and travel between project locations as required.
* Must be available for operational reviews, urgent project issues, and management meetings when necessary.

8. Expected Outcome

The General Manager – Operations is expected to establish efficient operational systems, improve coordination across departments, maintain project schedules and cost controls, strengthen accountability, and ensure that all construction and business operations are carried out efficiently in line with the company's quality standards and business goals.

**Navera Builders Pvt. Ltd.**

:
  
  
Help manage Europe performance, supporting profitable P&L delivery and manage month-end, quarter-end and year-end reporting processes, with the following specific responsibilities:
  
  

* Partner with the European Commercial team to prepare monthly P&L landing estimates by analyzing business trends, key drivers, and emerging opportunities.

**COMMERCIAL DECISION SUPPORT:**
Act as Business partner to Sales Managers and Customer Marketing Managers with the following specific responsibilities:
  
  

* Support the Commercial team in identifying pricing opportunities to improve margin and drive profitable growth.
* Maintain accurate Volume, NSV, and GP forecasts through continuous review and improvement of forecasting tool.

title: Senior Manager / AVP – Finance - Private Equity
description:
**About the company:**
The company operates in the investment management space, focusing on providing portfolio management and wealth advisory services to clients.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Finance, accounting and reporting**

* Own the accounting function fully, including timely monthly, quarterly and annual closes and preparation of financial statements.
* Prepare and review portfolio and consolidated MIS: P&L, balance sheet, cash flows, investment valuations, asset-wise yield and IRR, and portfolio value or NAV-style reporting.
* Own the monthly and quarterly business updates to the Chairman, Board and stakeholders, covering portfolio, financials, pipeline and operations. This includes the monthly financial MIS and the quarterly stakeholder MIS.
* Set annual budgets and cash-flow forecasts, and monitor actual performance, expenses and funding needs against approved plans.
* Oversee investment accounting, income recognition (including InvIT and AIF distributions split into interest, dividend and capital repayment), tax provisions, reconciliations, and fee and expense allocations.
* Coordinate periodic valuations with the investment team and external valuers, ensuring consistent methods and supporting documents.
* Provide financial analysis, dashboards, and Board and Investment Committee materials to support decisions
  **.**

**2. Treasury and investment operations**

* Manage liquidity, fund movements, payments, banking and demat operations, reconciliations and custody instructions.
* Execute investment and divestment settlements in listed and unlisted securities, bonds, InvITs and AIFs.
* Manage AIF commitments, drawdowns and distributions, and the related KYC and onboarding.
* Oversee the operational execution of investments, capital contributions, distributions and exits, including checking approvals and payment conditions.
* Maintain investment and portfolio trackers.
* Monitor asset and SPV cash flows, capital expenditure and debt servicing with the investment team.

**3. Capital raising: debt and equity (a full workstream)**

* Lead debt raising from banks, NBFCs and other lenders, from start to finish: work out the funding need and structure, prepare the information memorandum and financial model, approach and shortlist lenders, and manage term sheets and negotiation.
* Take each debt proposal through lender appraisal, credit queries, due diligence, rating (where needed), sanction, documentation and disbursement.
* Negotiate commercial and legal terms with lenders and counsel: pricing, tenor, repayment profile, security and guarantees, covenants and conditions precedent (CPs) and conditions subsequent (CSs).
* Track and satisfy all CPs before drawdown and all CSs after it, including security creation, charge filings (ROC/CERSAI), insurance endorsements and other documentation.
* Monitor financial covenants (e.g. leverage, DSCR, LTV) and non-financial covenants on an ongoing basis.
* Prepare compliance certificates and periodic lender reporting, give early warning of any potential breach, and manage waivers and consents.
* Manage the debt book: repayment and interest schedules, rate resets, prepayment and refinancing opportunities, and lender relationships.
* Support the CEO on equity raises from investors and co-investors: data rooms, financial models, investor presentations and Q&A, due diligence coordination, and term sheet and shareholder agreement documentation.
* Run post-closing for equity raises: share or unit allotments, regulatory filings (including FEMA where relevant), investor onboarding and KYC, and ongoing investor reporting and rights tracking.

**4. Board meetings and corporate governance**

* Act as the governance lead for the Board and its committees, including the Investment Committee.
* Appoint, coordinate and oversee the external Company Secretary (a CS qualification is not required for this role).
* Review their output and ensure all secretarial work is complete, accurate and on time.
* Plan the annual board calendar. Prepare agendas, notices and board packs, and circulate them on time.
* Draft minutes, resolutions (including circular resolutions) and action-taken reports, and track decisions through to closure.
* Onboard independent directors and support them on an ongoing basis: induction, information requests, disclosures, declarations of independence and interest, sitting fees and D&O insurance.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and the related-party and conflict-of-interest registers.
* Coordinate shareholder meetings, filings and secretarial audit where applicable.

**5. Compliance, taxation and audit**

* Own corporate, tax and regulatory compliance across platform entities: Companies Act and LLP requirements, ROC filings, income tax, TDS, GST and RBI/FEMA requirements, and SEBI requirements where relevant.
* Maintain a single compliance calendar covering filings, payments, board and partner meetings, disclosures and contractual deadlines.
* Manage statutory and internal audits: schedules, query resolution, finalising financial statements and closing audit observations.
* Coordinate tax planning and transaction tax advice with external specialists, and manage tax notices, assessments and disputes.
* Track regulatory changes affecting the platform and lead the required implementation.

**6. Legal coordination and transaction documentation**

* Own coordination with external legal counsel on investment documents, financing, and corporate and commercial matters.
* Coordinate financial, tax and legal due diligence, ensuring material findings are addressed before completion.
* Work with the CEO and counsel on investment agreements, shareholder agreements, loan and security documents, and other material contracts.
* Track conditions precedent and subsequent, contractual obligations, covenants, consent requirements, and investor and shareholder rights.
* Maintain a central, organised repository of executed agreements, approvals, investment records and security documents.
* Coordinate legal notices, disputes and litigation with external counsel, and monitor them through to resolution.

**7. Operations, controls and administration**

* Set up accounting systems, SOPs, reporting formats and delegation-of-authority arrangements suited to a growing investment platform.
* Run practical controls over payments, reconciliations, valuations, documents and approvals, including maker checker controls.
* Monitor related-party transactions, conflicts of interest and the allocation of costs between entities, including any service arrangements with the parent group after the demerger.
* Manage office administration, vendors and service providers (office, IT, accounting tools), payroll and HR administration, insurance, and data and document security.
* Act as the main point of contact for banks, auditors, regulators, custodians, registrars and other service providers.
* Maintain an exception tracker and promptly escalate material financial, compliance, contractual or operational issues to the CEO and Board.

Bachelor’s degree preferably in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Management or a technical or quantitative discipline

* Excellent communication skills, with ability to influence diverse stakeholders
* Collaborative mindset with ability to work in partnership with other stakeholders; good team player with professional attitude
