title: Dashboard and Reporting Analyst
description:
**Job Title:**
DAnR Python Dashboard Developer

**Experience:**
2 to 5 years of relevant development experience

**About the Job:**

We are looking for a Python Dashboard Developer within DAnR to own custom web-based monitoring dashboards for Tonik's lending scorecards. You will build flexible analytical applications with an open-source Python stack and deploy them on Tonik's internal web server in partnership with IT.

The priority is to give Risk, DS and business teams timely visibility into scorecard performance, data coverage and operational issues. Dash and Plotly with enterprise authentication are a preferred approach. You will use reusable components and, where appropriate, AI-assisted development to accelerate delivery while maintaining reviewed code and verified calculations.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain interactive Python web dashboards using Dash and Plotly, or an agreed comparable open-source framework. Deliver clear navigation, filters, drilldowns and export capabilities for internal users.

* Develop a reusable monitoring framework so new or refreshed scorecards can be onboarded quickly. Target operational dashboards within one week of model go-live, with outcome-based measures becoming available as repayment cohorts mature.

* Implement monitoring views for underwriting, behavioural and offer scores, collections, payroll-backed lending and other assigned models. Support component and stacked-score views, product segments and model-version comparisons.

* Work with DS and Risk to define and implement Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, calibration, deciles, approval rates and bad rates. Capture agreed cohort, numerator, denominator and outcome-maturity rules rather than hard-coding ambiguous definitions.

* Separate input and score monitoring available at launch from performance metrics that require matured outcomes. Clearly label reporting windows, sample sizes, data freshness and insufficient-data conditions.

* Connect to BigQuery and approved data sources using efficient SQL and reusable data-access layers. Use pre-aggregation, caching and controlled refreshes to keep dashboards responsive and query costs manageable.

* Build visibility into partner coverage, missingness, API failures and score-range changes. Implement agreed threshold alerts and exception views with enough detail for teams to investigate.

* Deploy and maintain dashboards on the internal web server with IT, including service configuration, dependencies, logging and health checks. Integrate enterprise authentication and appropriate access controls for sensitive lending data.

* Reconcile dashboard results to independently checked SQL or DS calculations. Use tests, code review and user acceptance testing to prevent misleading metrics, filter behaviour or exports.

* Use approved AI coding tools where useful; review generated code and validate logic before release. Maintain version control, technical documentation and a prioritized backlog with users.

* Migrate and retire legacy BI (Power BI) dashboards as the Python stack matures, so refresh cycles are no longer constrained by the old setup.

**Required Experience and Qualifications:**

* 2 to 5 years of relevant Python dashboard, analytical application or web development experience, with examples of applications deployed for business users.

* A bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, data analytics or a related discipline, or equivalent practical development experience.

* Strong Python and SQL skills, including pandas and experience building interactive applications with Dash and Plotly or a comparable Python web framework.

* Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, responsive layouts, callback or application state management, APIs and debugging web applications.

* Experience connecting dashboards to databases, validating calculated metrics, managing performance and maintaining production applications.

* Practical knowledge of Git, testing, Linux-based deployment, authentication and authorization. Ability to work with IT on secure internal hosting.

* Ability to clarify business metric definitions, present data accurately and collaborate with analysts, Data Scientists and Risk users.

**Preferred Experience and Qualifications:**

* Prior lending or credit risk scorecard monitoring experience, including Gini, KS, PSI, CSI, vintage analysis, deciles and matured bad-rate reporting.

* Experience with GCP and BigQuery, query optimization, caching, scheduled data refreshes and monitoring multiple model versions.

* Experience with enterprise SSO, role-based access, Docker, reverse proxies or deployment through CI/CD.

* Experience using AI-assisted development productively while retaining code review, tests, data protection and calculation validation.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A reusable dashboard framework makes monitoring available quickly after go-live and supports frequent scorecard refreshes.

* Metrics reconcile to agreed definitions, with clear maturity, freshness and sample-size information.

* Dashboards remain responsive, secure and useful for identifying degradation and directing investigation.

**Who are we looking for?**

We value teamwork, honesty, reliability, practical problem-solving and a sense of humour. You take ownership of your work, communicate early when something is wrong, and challenge assumptions respectfully. You are comfortable collaborating across locations and improving how the team works.

* Willingness to go the extra mile for success.

* Energetic and lively, and street smart.

* As our approach to banking is far from ordinary, we are looking for an innovative and creative individual to join our team.

* Above all, a great team player and proactive communicator. This is a table-stake criterion.

**About Tonik:**

We are a transformative digital bank with a mission to revolutionize the way money works. We create better financial products for the world by encouraging inclusivity through simplifying processes, reducing costs, improving transparency, and embracing flexibility to empower more people with unique financial needs. All these are on the most secure mobile banking platform. To enable this, innovation is woven into the DNA of our company. We do not just search for the best talent, but for people who seek to challenge the status quo and are passionate about transforming the impossible into reality.

Tonik (www.tonikbank.com) is the first digital-only neo bank in the Philippines, providing loan, deposit, payment, and card products to consumers on a highly secure digital banking platform. The neo bank operates based on the first private digital bank license issued by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas. Tonik is led by a team of retail finance veterans who have previously built and scaled multiple retail banks and fintechs across the global emerging markets. It is backed by top international venture capital funds. Tonik operates out of hubs in Singapore (HQ), Manila, Chennai, and Kyiv.

Our Data team works with Risk, Product, Technology and business teams to improve lending decisions and customer outcomes through reliable data, analytics and machine learning.

title: Operations Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Operations Support Specialist 5**
is a Retail Banking Operations & Process Specialist role responsible for executing, streamlining, and maintaining core retail banking Back-office transaction support, account lifecycle servicing, and operational workflow integrity. Operating at the intersection of transaction processing, data control, and client account administration, the specialist ensures rigorous adherence to operational standards, documentation policies, and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Beyond day-to-day operations, this role actively contributes to operational excellence by identifying process enhancement opportunities, eliminating repetitive manual effort, and supporting process re-engineering initiatives. The specialist serves as a key liaison across upstream and downstream processing teams, Team leaders, managers, and internal/external stakeholders, leveraging strong domain knowledge of retail banking products, core banking systems, ledger accounting, AI governance, and automation tools to minimize operational risk and elevate efficiency.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Review, post, and validate financial and non-financial accounting entries across retail banking General Ledger (GL) and Subledger accounts.
* Identify, research, and reconcile ledger/subledger breaks, balancing discrepancies, and transaction mismatches to ensure accurate financial reporting and audit readiness.
* Analyze daily transaction journals and system suspense accounts to verify proper fund allocation, interest calculations, fee adjustments, and postings.
* Navigate and leverage Core Banking Platforms to execute customer account adjustments, verify balance histories, monitor transaction status, and validate operational controls.
* Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel functions (e.g., dynamic formulas, pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, index-match, conditional formatting, and data validation models) to analyze structured financial datasets, spot anomalies, and compile operational tracking metrics.
* Proactively analyze end-to-end workflows to identify inefficiencies, manual handoffs, and repetitive operational tasks.
* Drive process re-engineering and simplification initiatives to eliminate redundancies, reduce manual operational touchpoints, accelerate turnaround times, and mitigate human error.
* Collaborate with transformation and technology teams to evaluate and deploy automation tools, robotic process automation (RPA), workflow automations, and digital tools to enhance team productivity and process scalability.
* Prepare recurring and ad-hoc operational MIS reports, exception dashboards, and root-cause analysis summaries for management review.
* Drive proactive escalation and resolution tracking for critical high value transactions/account breaks, transaction bottlenecks, and service delivery roadblocks.
* Assist in workflow management and distribution, supporting peer guidance, on-the-job training for onboarding team members, and process walkthroughs for audit reviews.
* Track record of managing operational data with complex spreadsheets and structured databases.

**Experience & Functional Skills:**

* 3–4 years of relevant professional experience within banking operations, financial services processing, or a corporate business operations environment.
* Proven experience working with retail banking products, transaction processing, and customer account maintenance.
* Demonstrated hands-on capability in performing financial reconciliations, ledger posting verification, or discrepancy investigations.
* Strong analytical problem-solving to dissect complex financial data, conduct root-cause analysis on recurring breaks, and implement corrective operational controls.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact seamlessly with upstream/downstream partners, operational leads, internal audit, and business stakeholders.
* Familiarity with AI governance standards, model risk controls, or participating in digital transformation projects.
* Knowledge of Automation Tools: Experience with or working knowledge of process automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, RPA platforms, Python, VBA, or low-code automation tools) is considered a strong added advantage.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s Degree / University Graduate in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Commerce, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical work experience).

**Work Schedule & Shift Details**

* Work Timing: India Core Night Shift Hours (supporting US Business Hours / US Operations).
* Flexibility: Willingness to support peak processing periods, month-end/quarter-end financial close, and critical operational deliverables.

The position is the operational people leader and primary coordination point for PO and supplier operations, partnering with Sourcing, Contracts, Finance, Accounts Payable, Legal, IT, InfoSec, and business stakeholders to resolve issues, maintain segregation of duties, manage exceptions, and provide transparent performance reporting. You will support backend procurement operations for a U.S.-based procurement team, including requisition compliance, purchase order creation, supplier registration, maintenance of records within enterprise resource planning/procure-to-pay (ERP/P2P) tools, supplier due diligence, annual supplier monitoring, contract coordination, internal and external communications, reporting, and related operational work.In this role, you will partner with internal stakeholders and external suppliers to help ensure procurement activities are completed accurately, consistently, and on time. The position requires strong organization, sound judgment, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a structured environment. You should be comfortable working across teams, reviewing data for accuracy and trends, and identifying practical solutions to operational challenges. Experience supporting a team and helping improve operational results will be valuable in this role.Essential Job Responsibilities People Leadership & Operational Management Lead, coach, and develop direct reports supporting PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, and Oracle supplier profile maintenance across U.S. and India operations. Establish individual objectives, service expectations, quality standards, development plans, and measurable accountability for results. Allocate workloads, monitor capacity and coverage, conduct regular one-on-ones, provide timely performance feedback, and address execution or capability gaps. Build cross-training and succession coverage for critical PO and supplier processes, including planned and unplanned absences. Create an accountable, service-oriented culture focused on accuracy, responsiveness, control adherence, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement. Purchase Order Administration & Fulfillment Oversee end-to-end PO administration, including validation of approved requisitions, contract and budget alignment, PO creation, dispatch, acknowledgement, change orders, issue resolution, receipt coordination, and closure. Ensure POs contain accurate supplier, entity, currency, payment term, accounting, tax, line-item, period-of-performance, and supporting-document information before release. Monitor PO fulfillment status and coordinate with requestors, budget owners, suppliers, Sourcing, Accounts Payable, and Finance to resolve missing receipts, invoice mismatches, exhausted balances, blocked invoices, overdue commitments, and other transaction exceptions. Maintain clear controls for non-PO spend, after-the-fact requests, emergency purchases, one-time suppliers, blanket POs, contract renewals, and other approved exception pathways. Coordinate timely PO amendments for approved scope, quantity, price, term, accounting, or supplier changes while preserving approval evidence and audit history. Lead periodic PO close reviews to identify completed, expired, inactive, duplicate, or no-longer-needed POs and confirm closure with the appropriate business and Finance stakeholders. Ensure PO records and supporting documentation are complete, accurate, accessible, and audit-ready throughout the PO lifecycle. Promote appropriate use of P-Cards, purchase orders, catalogues and other purchasing channels based on established buying and payment policies. Monitor P-Card transaction compliance, aging items, missing documentation, recurring exceptions, and other control issues; escalate and drive corrective actions where required. Maintain operational reporting and audit-ready supporting documentation for P-Card activity and associated controls. Supplier Onboarding & Offboarding Lead supplier onboarding from validated intake through activation, including required forms, tax and banking documentation, business ownership, approvals, sanctions and compliance checkpoints, risk-review status, and supplier communication. Confirm that supplier onboarding requests are complete and appropriately approved before Oracle supplier-profile creation or activation; return incomplete requests with clear remediation requirements. Support controls associated with supplier tax classification and U.S. information-reporting requirements, including collection and maintenance of appropriate supplier tax documentation used in 1099 reporting. Coordinate with Legal, InfoSec, Privacy, Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, and business owners to ensure required reviews are completed and documented before the supplier becomes transaction-ready. Oversee supplier offboarding, including validation of termination or inactivity, review of open POs and invoices, closure of remaining commitments, deactivation of purchasing use, profile-status updates, and retention of supporting evidence. Maintain controls for one-time suppliers, reactivation requests, supplier legal-name changes, mergers or acquisitions, address changes, and payment-information changes, including required out-of-band verification where applicable. Prevent duplicate or fragmented supplier records by applying standardized search, matching, naming, and documentation requirements before creating or reactivating a supplier. Oracle Supplier Profile Maintenance & Support Own operational governance for Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, activation, inactivation, and user support in accordance with approved access and segregation-of-duties requirements. Ensure supplier master data is accurate and complete, including legal name, tax identifiers, addresses, contacts, business classifications, payment terms, purchasing sites, entities, currencies, and supporting documentation. Oversee controlled updates to supplier profiles, including name, address, contact, tax, banking, payment, and site changes, with appropriate approvals and verification evidence. Monitor duplicate records, incomplete profiles, inactive suppliers, expired documentation, conflicting data, and other master-data quality issues; assign remediation actions and track them through completion. Triage Oracle supplier and PO transaction issues, document root causes and resolutions, coordinate system support with IT and Finance, and communicate status to affected stakeholders. Coordinate user acceptance testing, procedure updates, training, and adoption for approved Oracle/P2P process or system changes affecting supplier or PO operations. Service Levels, Controls & Operational Metrics Define and manage service-level targets for PO creation, PO changes, supplier onboarding, supplier offboarding, supplier-profile updates, issue resolution, and PO closure. Maintain dashboards and weekly operating reviews covering queue volume, completed transactions, aging, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, backlog, and control compliance. Measure PO fulfillment and close performance, including open-PO aging, past-due POs, completed POs awaiting closure, closure cycle time, dormant POs, remaining commitment value, and percentage closed within target. Track supplier operations metrics, including onboarding cycle time, first-pass completeness, profile-update cycle time, duplicate-prevention findings, offboarding completion, and aged requests. Analyze recurring defects and bottlenecks, identify root causes, assign corrective actions, and verify that improvements reduce cycle time, rework, and control failures. Escalate material service, control, data-quality, or capacity risks with a clear statement of impact, owner, corrective action, and expected resolution date. Maintain audit-ready evidence, support internal and external audit requests, and track remediation actions through verified closure. Process Documentation, Training & Stakeholder Support Maintain current SOPs, process maps, RACIs, control narratives, job aids, templates, intake requirements, and exception procedures for PO and supplier operations. Develop and deliver training for Procurement team members, requestors, approvers, and business stakeholders on PO administration, supplier onboarding and offboarding, Oracle supplier requirements, receipt responsibilities, and PO closure. Publish clear operating guidance through approved Procurement repositories and communication channels; archive obsolete materials and maintain version control. Facilitate operational reviews, document decisions and actions, and drive routine follow-up without unnecessary escalation to senior Procurement leadership.Expected Education & Experience Undergraduate degree in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Business, Operations, or a related discipline preferred. Approximately 7–10 years of experience in procurement operations, procure-to-pay, purchasing operations, supplier master data, Accounts Payable operations, or a related function. Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax requirements relevant to procurement, supplier onboarding, invoicing, and supplier master-data operations. Experience supporting U.S. 1099 reporting processes, including supplier tax-document collection, supplier classification/data validation, exception resolution, and coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable. Experience managing or supporting P-Card programs, including transaction controls, cardholder support, exception management, documentation, and compliance monitoring. Experience managing catalog purchasing and other guided-buying channels, including operational support, transaction troubleshooting, and stakeholder coordination. Demonstrated experience partnering with business stakeholders and Accounts Payable to resolve PO/invoice/receipt mismatches and other procure-to-pay exception Demonstrated experience leading direct reports, including goal setting, coaching, performance feedback, workload management, capacity planning, and employee development. Hands-on leadership experience with end-to-end PO administration, including requisition validation, PO creation, changes, fulfillment support, receipt and invoice issue resolution, and PO closure. Demonstrated experience leading supplier onboarding and offboarding processes, including documentation, approvals, compliance checkpoints, stakeholder coordination, activation, inactivation, and exception handling. Demonstrated experience administering Oracle supplier profiles or comparable ERP supplier-master records, including data quality, duplicate prevention, profile updates, controls, and user support. Experience defining and managing operational service levels, transaction queues, aging, cycle-time reporting, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and close-performance metrics. Working knowledge of procure-to-pay controls, segregation of duties, supplier master-data governance, three-way match concepts, invoice and receipt exceptions, and audit evidence requirements. Experience collaborating with Finance, Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, IT, InfoSec, Compliance, Sourcing, Contracts, and business stakeholders. Experience with Oracle/P2P, ServiceNow or comparable intake tools, SharePoint, Teams, and reporting or dashboard tools is preferred.Key Skills & Competencies People leadership, coaching, performance management, delegation, workload prioritization, capacity planning, and team development. Purchase order administration, fulfillment support, change management, commitment cleanup, and PO closure. Supplier onboarding and offboarding, supplier master-data governance, documentation validation, and duplicate prevention. Oracle supplier-profile creation, maintenance, troubleshooting, data quality, access controls, and segregation of duties. Operational service management, including queue management, service levels, aging analysis, cycle time, first-pass accuracy, rework, backlog, and escalation. Procure-to-pay controls, audit readiness, exception management, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking. Strong stakeholder service, written communication, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination. Process mapping, SOP development, training, change management, continuous improvement, and AI-enabled operational opportunities. Sound judgment, attention to detail, analytical thinking, and the ability to operate independently during U.S. business hours. P-Card program management, purchasing controls, transaction review, exception management, and cardholder support. Catalog purchasing operations and purchasing-channel management. Working knowledge of U.S. and India tax considerations affecting procurement, suppliers, and procure-to-pay transactions. U.S. 1099 reporting support, supplier tax documentation, tax-data validation, and cross-functional coordination with Tax and Accounts Payable. PO, invoice, and receipt mismatch resolution, including effective coordination among business requestors, suppliers, Accounts Payable, Procurement, and Finance.Success Measures Direct reports have clear objectives, balanced workloads, regular coaching, documented development plans, and measurable accountability for results. POs are created and changed accurately within established service levels, with complete approvals and supporting documentation. Open-PO aging, overdue commitments, completed POs awaiting closure, and dormant POs are actively managed and reduced against established targets. PO closure reviews occur on schedule, closure decisions are documented, and completed or no-longer-needed commitments are closed promptly and accurately. Supplier onboarding and offboarding requests are completed within service levels, with required approvals, risk checkpoints, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Oracle supplier profiles remain complete, current, properly supported, and compliant with duplicate-prevention, access, approval, and segregation-of-duties controls. P-Card operations are administered within established controls, with timely documentation, transaction review, exception resolution, and corrective action for recurring issues. Catalog purchases are processed through appropriate purchasing channels, with operational issues and exceptions resolved promptly. PO, receipt, and invoice mismatches are proactively identified and resolved through effective coordination with business stakeholders, Accounts Payable, suppliers, and Finance. Supplier tax documentation and master data required to support applicable U.S. 1099 reporting are complete, accurate, current, and available to Tax and Accounts Payable within established timelines. Operational dashboards provide reliable visibility into volume, cycle time, aging, backlog, first-pass accuracy, rework, exceptions, and close performance. Recurring defects and bottlenecks have documented root causes, owners, corrective actions, and measurable improvements. title: Relatiebeheerder MKB
description:
Wegens groei van de organisatie zijn wij op zoek naar een:
  
  
Relatiebeheerder MKB
  
  
Over de functie
  
  
Als Relatiebeheerder MKB ben je hét aanspreekpunt voor ondernemers en begeleid je hen bij belangrijke financiële keuzes. Je beheert je eigen klantenportefeuille, helpt bedrijven écht verder en krijgt volop doorgroeimogelijkheden, afhankelijk van jouw eigen ambities en carrièrewensen. In deze rol combineer je jouw vaktechnische kennis met persoonlijk advies, zodat klanten met vertrouwen hun onderneming laten groeien.
  
  
Wat ga je doen
  
  

* Beheren van je eigen klantenportefeuille en fungeren als eerste aanspreekpunt.
* Samenstellen van jaarrekeningen en opstellen van periodieke rapportages.
* Verzorgen van aangiftes omzetbelasting, vennootschapsbelasting en inkomstenbelasting.
* Adviseren en begeleiden bij herstructureringen, financieringsaanvragen en subsidies.
* Actief bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van onze digitale dienstverlening.

Kortom: een veelzijdige rol waarin je ondernemers begeleidt, advies geeft en bouwt aan langdurige relaties.
  
  
Over het team
  
  
Je komt te werken in een betrokken en zelfsturend team bestaande uit ongeveer 50 collega’s, verdeeld over twee locaties; Staphorst en Hattemerbroek. Wij werken voor een diverse klantenkring waaronder het MKB en de Agrarische sector. Onze cultuur is open, sociaal en gedreven. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat we ondernemers écht verder helpen – en dat doen we met plezier.
  
  
Wat neem je mee
  
  

* Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld Bedrijfsadministratie, Accountancy of Bedrijfskunde.
* Minimaal 2 à 3 jaar ervaring binnen een accountants- of administratiekantoor.
* Nauwkeurigheid, cijfermatig inzicht en oog voor kwaliteit.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om vertrouwen op te bouwen bij klanten.
* Ambitie om jezelf te ontwikkelen richting diverse rollen, zoals manager, belastingadviseur of accountant.

Wat krijg je van ons
  
  

* Alle ruimte voor ontwikkeling: opleidingen, cursussen en begeleiding om verder te groeien in jouw vakgebied.
* Balans werk en privé: flexibele werktijden, 30 verlofdagen (op fulltime basis).
* Uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden: een goed salaris, pensioenregeling en reiskostenvergoeding of auto van de zaak. De mogelijkheid bestaat om op den duur door te groeien naar vennoot/mede eigenaar.
* Een fijne werkomgeving: een betrokken en zelfsturend team van 50 collega’s, met een informele en collegiale sfeer.
* Persoonlijke benadering: bij ons staat de mens altijd voorop – zowel de klant als onze medewerkers.

Reageer direct!
  
  
Ben jij enthousiast geworden na het lezen van deze mooie vacature? Neem dan contact op met ons: 0522 – 462 495 of stuur je sollicitatie met CV naar: tinabouwhuis@harke.nl. Wij nemen dan zo spoedig mogelijk contact met je op. Bekijk onze website: www.harke.nl

title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

title: Sr. Analyst FP&A, SKYWAVE
description:
**Join Us as FP&A Manager, SKYWAVE!**
Are you a hands-on finance professional who thrives on turning complex data into actionable business insights? We are seeking an analytical and detail-oriented FP&A Manager to play a key role in driving financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and business decision support across a global organization for SKYWAVE, an ORBCOMM company.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a finance leader with a strong accounting and analytical foundation, ideally gained through a Big 4 accounting firm and global business exposure.
  
  
**Why You'll Love Working Here**
As an FP&A Manager, you will be a critical partner to finance and business leaders, supporting strategic planning, forecasting, reporting, and commercial decision-making.
  
  
Based in Hyderabad in a hybrid work environment, you will collaborate closely with managers and stakeholders located in the United States and Canada, gaining exposure to global operations and cross-functional business initiatives.
  
  
This role offers a highly visible opportunity to influence business performance through rigorous analysis, financial modeling, and insightful recommendations.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Support the annual budgeting process, including development of assumptions, detailed financial models, and budget consolidations.
* Support periodic and rolling forecast processes by updating models, analyzing trends, and validating assumptions.
* Maintain and enhance revenue, backlog, and headcount forecasting models.
* Develop and track business unit capital expenditure ( CapEx ) and operating expenditure ( OpEx ) performance.

**Financial Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Support monthly financial reporting processes, including Flash reporting and Growth Day materials.
* Maintain key financial and operational metrics used for performance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting.
* Perform variance analysis, including actual versus budget and forecast bridge analyses with clear driver-based commentary.
* Provide insights and recommendations to support business performance and decision-making.

**Business Partnering & Commercial Finance Support**

* Prepare initial deal models and supporting CRB presentation materials.
* Partner with Sales teams to validate deal assumptions and assess financial impacts.
* Conduct account-level pricing, profitability, and revenue impact analyses.
* Support budget control activities, including purchase requisitions (PRs), purchase orders (POs), invoicing, and related processes.

**Data Management, Modeling & Operational Support**

* Perform ad hoc financial analyses, reporting, and scenario modeling as required.
* Support month-end close activities and planning/BI data integrity initiatives.
* Work with large datasets and reporting tools to ensure accuracy, consistency, and actionable insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting processes, financial models, and analytical capabilities.

**Who You Are**
You are a highly analytical finance professional who enjoys solving business problems through data, financial modeling, and collaboration. You are comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and partnering with stakeholders across multiple geographies and functions.
  
  
**If You Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance , Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
* CPA, CA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.
* Experience within a Big 4 accounting firm strongly preferred.
* Progressive experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Corporate Finance, or Commercial Finance.
* Experience supporting global organizations and collaborating with international stakeholders.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and business analysis skills.
* Experience performing variance analysis and translating financial results into business insights.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial modeling techniques.
* Experience working with ERP systems, planning tools, business intelligence platforms, and large datasets.
* Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence business partners.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Experience in a private equity-backed company preferred.
* Leverage AI-enabled tools and automation to support daily tasks and productivity.
* Commitment to continuous learning in digital and AI literacy.

Then we want to meet you!
  
  
**The Benefits Of Working Here**
A career with ORBCOMM offers a unique opportunity to grow your skills and expand your expertise in a collaborative, innovative environment. Beyond being part of an exceptional team, we provide a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support our employees around the world. Benefits vary by location and include health and wellness coverage, paid time off, retirement or savings programs, flexible work arrangements, insurance coverage, lifestyle perks, and access to employee discounts—helping you thrive both professionally and personally.
  
  
**How We Hire**
ORBCOMM uses technology-enabled tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by people, as part of our human-led, tech-enabled culture.
  
  
**About Us**
At ORBCOMM, we’re pioneers in IoT technology that drives innovation and empowers our clients to make data-driven decisions. Our industry-leading solutions enable customers to boost productivity, streamline operations, and increase their bottom line. With over 30 years of experience and the most comprehensive solution portfolio in the industry, we enable the management of millions of assets worldwide across diverse sectors, including transportation, heavy industries, satellite, and maritime. Discover how ORBCOMM is transforming industries and unlocking the potential of data to drive meaningful change at  www.orbcomm.com !
  
  
**Ready to Join Us?**
We believe that our people are our greatest asset. Your skills and passion can help us achieve remarkable things! If you’re seeking a thrilling career opportunity in a vibrant, growth-oriented environment, ORBCOMM is the perfect fit for you.
  
  
We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and appreciate all applicants for their interest in joining our team. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
  
  
At ORBCOMM, we are also dedicated to ensuring accessibility and are pleased to offer accommodations for individuals with disabilities upon request throughout all aspects of the selection process.

title: Financial Control Manager
description:
**About The Role**
Responsible for managing assigned legal entities, ensuring accurate and timely financial closure, maintaining strong internal controls, supporting management reporting and statutory audits, and driving process efficiencies through ERP systems and automation.

The ideal candidate should possess a strong understanding of accounting principles, the ability to independently manage finance operations, and a continuous improvement mindset.

**What You'll be Responsible for?**

**1.Financial Accounting & Entity Controllership**

* Manage day-to-day general ledger accounting and ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records.
* Review and oversee journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, amortisation and other month-end adjustments.
* Prepare and review balance sheet schedules, account reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment in accordance with applicable Ind AS and company accounting policies.
* Monitor ledger balances, identify unusual movements and resolve accounting discrepancies.

**2.Month-End, Quarter-End & Year-End Closing**

* Drive timely closure of assigned legal entities in accordance with the financial closing calendar.
* Prepare and review trial balances, reconciliations, closing schedules and financial reporting deliverables.
* Ensure completeness of revenue, expenses, liabilities, provisions and other material balances.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve open items and ensure reporting deadlines are met.

**3. Financial Reporting & Compliance**

* Prepare financial statements, management reporting schedules and other financial information required for internal and external reporting.
* Support quarterly and annual financial reporting requirements under applicable Ind AS.
* Ensure consistency between general ledger balances, financial statements and supporting schedules.
* Maintain adequate documentation for accounting judgments, estimates and significant transactions.

**4. Intercompany Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Manage intercompany receivables, payables and general ledger balances across legal entities.
* Perform periodic intercompany reconciliations and investigate differences between counterparties.
* Coordinate with entity finance teams to resolve mismatches, timing differences and incorrect postings.
* Ensure timely confirmation and settlement of intercompany balances, wherever applicable.

**5. Budgeting, MIS & Expense Analysis**

* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasting and expense planning processes.
* Analyse expenses by legal entity, general ledger account, vendor and expense category.
* Prepare management information reports and provide actionable insights to finance leadership.
* Monitor provisions, prepaid expenses and recurring expenditure to support accurate financial reporting.

**6. Audit, Internal Controls & Governance**

* Coordinate with statutory auditors and internal auditors for assigned entities and processes.
* Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents and responses to audit queries.
* Ensure adherence to internal financial controls, accounting policies and delegated approval procedures.
* Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions to strengthen the financial reporting process.

**7. ERP, Data Management & Finance Automation**

* Work with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) or comparable ERP platforms for accounting, reporting and financial data extraction.
* Analyse financial data extracted from ERP systems and perform validation and reconciliation checks.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive accounting, reconciliation and reporting activities.
* Leverage advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, Python or other relevant tools to improve efficiency and accuracy.
* Support ERP enhancements, finance transformation initiatives and standardisation of accounting processes.

**8. Stakeholder Management & Process Ownership**

* Coordinate with accounts payable, procurement, treasury, tax, business teams and other finance stakeholders.
* Independently manage assigned deliverables and ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
* Maintain process documentation, trackers and standard operating procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement in reporting accuracy, turnaround time and process controls.

Ideal Candidate Profile

**Ideal Candidate Profile,**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI).
* Approximately 3-5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in finance and accounts.
* Strong hands-on experience in general ledger accounting, month-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations and financial reporting.
* Experience in a corporate, technology, SaaS, IT services or multi-entity environment will be preferred.
* Exposure to group reporting, intercompany accounting and management reporting is desirable.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**

**Essential**

* Strong knowledge of accounting principles and applicable Ind AS.
* Hands-on experience in financial closing and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to investigate accounting differences.
* Advanced working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
* Experience working with ERP systems and large financial datasets.
* Ability to manage multiple deliverables within tight reporting deadlines.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
* Continuous improvement and process automation mindset.
* Ability to identify risks, resolve issues and recommend practical solutions.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Ensure timely and accurate financial closure for assigned entities.
* Maintain complete and well-supported balance sheet reconciliations.
* Ensure reliable financial reporting and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
* Resolve intercompany differences and outstanding accounting issues within agreed timelines.
* Provide meaningful financial analysis to support management decisions.
* Maintain audit readiness and effective financial controls.
* Improve finance productivity through standardization, automation and process optimization.

**Why join us?**

* **Impactful Work:**
  Play a pivotal role in safeguarding Tanla's assets, data, and reputation in the industry.
* **Tremendous Growth Opportunities**
  : Be part of a rapidlygrowing company in the telecom and CPaaS space, with opportunities for professional development.
* **Innovative Environment:**
  Work alongside a world-class team in a challenging and fun environment, where innovation is celebrated.

Tanla is an equal opportunity employer. We championdiversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**www.tanla.com**

title: FinOps Engineer
description:
**Overview**
JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source-to-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.
  
  
Our 1,300+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products - ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.
  
  
For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Finops Engineer to support our Cloud FinOps practice. This role will work closely with the FinOps Manager and CloudOps team.
  
  
We’re looking for Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. This role needs a self-starter who drives cost initiatives to closure with minimal hand-holding - flags issues before they’re asked to, follows up without being chased, and treats savings targets as something they’re personally accountable for.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end validation of cost optimization opportunities (rightsizing, idle resource clean-up, storage optimization) - not just flagging them, but following through to closure.
* Act as the technical liaison with engineering/tech teams when recommendations are challenged or denied, bringing data-backed validation and alternative options rather than escalating every pushback upward.
* Independently prepare and distribute regular cloud cost and usage reports, proactively surfacing anomalies or trends rather than waiting to be asked.
* Drive daily follow-up on open optimization opportunities - ownership means nothing sits stale in a tracker; you chase it until it’s implemented.
* Execute optimizations directly: rightsizing, terminating idle resources, scheduling non-prod resources, applying storage lifecycle policies.
* Maintain FinOps hygiene - tagging governance, anomaly detection, budget adherence — as an ongoing discipline, not a periodic task.
* Keep a clear, self-maintained progress tracker on savings initiatives and proactively update leadership without being chased for status.
* Monitor usage trends across cloud providers (including GCP, if multi-cloud) to catch new/unexpected usage early rather than after it hits the bill.
* Support RI/Savings Plan lifecycle management — tracking expirations, recommending renewals or exchanges, and coordinating sign-off with relevant stakeholders (e.g., DBA, engineering).
* Contribute to monthly/quarterly cost forecasting and variance analysis (actuals vs. budget/forecast).

**Position Requirements**

* 4–6 years in cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred).
* Solid understanding of AWS services (EC2, EBS, S3, RDS, etc.) and their cost drivers.
* Demonstrated ownership mindset - someone who takes an opportunity from identification to closure without needing to be reminded.
* Familiarity with savings instruments such as RIs and Savings Plans.
* Exposure to FinOps principles and frameworks (e.g., FinOps Foundation).
* Hands-on experience with AWS Cost Explorer, CUR, and reporting/monitoring tools (Athena, QuickSight, or equivalent third-party tools).
* Strong communication and follow-up discipline - able to coordinate with tech teams and push initiatives to execution, not just raise them.
* Ability to analyze reports and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Scripting ability (Python or SQL) for automation of reporting/optimization tasks - mandatory, at least one.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proven track record of operating independently with minimal supervision - this role requires someone who proactively drives initiatives forward, not someone who waits for direction.
* Prior experience owning a cost-optimization book of work end-to-end (not just execution of assigned tasks).
* Exposure to multi-cloud environments (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS.
* Familiarity with tracking cost/usage for AI tooling or token-based consumption models – a plus

**What We Offer**
At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family’s well-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life.
  
  
**Our Values - T.E.A.M**
At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the teams behind them–the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.
  
  

* Transparency - Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision-making, and ensures problems are solved together—with customers, teammates, and partners.
* Entrepreneurial Spirit – Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem-solving mindset is at the cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth
* Accountability – Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere
* Metrics-Driven Results – Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course-correct quickly, and ensure we’re delivering real impact.

title: Principal Analyst, Escheatment & Unclaimed Property
description:
**Job Summary**
Own and scale Blackbaud’s U.S. escheatment and unclaimed property program, including overpayments, credits, and dormant customer balances. This role is responsible for building processes, ensuring multi-state compliance, and reducing financial and regulatory risk across the Order-to-Cash lifecycle.
  
  
**Work Location & Schedule**
**Work Location:**
Sky tech, Financial District, Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Work Schedule**

* This role supports customers and stakeholders primarily during U.S. business hours.
* Expected working hours are 11:00 AM to 08:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility required to support collaboration with U.S.-based teams and business needs.
* Participation in after-hours support rotations and select holiday coverage may be required based on product, region, or business needs.

**Position Summary**
Blackbaud is seeking a Principal Analyst, Unclaimed Property & Escheatment to establish, own, and scale a new U.S. unclaimed property compliance program from our Hyderabad location. This individual contributor will serve as the operational and technical subject matter expert for the end-to-end lifecycle of unclaimed property, including identification, research, due diligence, reporting, remittance, reconciliation, audit support, and ongoing monitoring.
  
  
The Principal Analyst will build the program foundation, create sustainable processes and controls, and partner across Finance, Order-to-Cash, Accounting, Treasury, Payroll, Legal, Tax, and Financial Systems. The role is designed for a hands-on program owner who can independently translate regulatory requirements into practical operations, reduce compliance risk, and develop a scalable model that supports Blackbaud as the business grows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Build and Own the Program
  
  

* Create and operationalize Blackbaud's U.S. unclaimed property and escheatment program from the ground up.
* Establish the program governance model, property-type inventory, state compliance calendar, risk assessment, roles and responsibilities, approval framework, and escalation paths.
* Develop policies, standard operating procedures, process maps, decision documentation, work instructions, and evidence-retention standards.
* Serve as the primary operational owner and internal subject matter expert for holder-side unclaimed property compliance.

Compliance, Due Diligence, and Reporting
  
  

* Own the end-to-end compliance cycle for applicable U.S. states, legal entities, and property types.
* Interpret and maintain state-specific requirements, including dormancy periods, due diligence thresholds, owner outreach, reporting formats, filing deadlines, and remittance requirements.
* Prepare, review, and submit accurate and timely state reports and payments through applicable portals or third-party filing tools.
* Monitor regulatory changes, assess operational impacts, and coordinate required updates to processes and controls.
* Coordinate owner outreach and due diligence efforts to return funds to rightful owners whenever possible.

Research, Reconciliation, and Root-Cause Reduction
  
  

* Identify and investigate potentially escheatable property, including customer credit balances, unapplied cash, unidentified remittances, refunds, vendor payments, payroll items, and other dormant obligations.
* Analyze large datasets from ERP, billing, CRM, banking, payroll, and related systems to determine ownership, jurisdiction, dormancy, and appropriate disposition.
* Reconcile unclaimed property populations and filings to general ledger balances, subledgers, bank activity, and supporting schedules.
* Partner with operational teams to resolve aged balances and address root causes such as duplicate payments, application issues, billing errors, and incomplete owner information before property becomes reportable.

Controls, Audit Readiness, and Risk Management
  
  

* Design, document, and execute preventive and detective controls supporting complete, accurate, and timely compliance.
* Maintain audit-ready support for research conclusions, due diligence, approvals, filings, remittances, reconciliations, and exceptions.
* Lead operational support for internal audits, state examinations, voluntary disclosure efforts, regulatory inquiries, and remediation activities.
* Identify compliance gaps and emerging risks, recommend practical solutions, and communicate issues clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Automation, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Develop dashboards, compliance trackers, aging views, key risk indicators, and performance metrics that provide visibility to program health.
* Use Excel and available analytics, automation, and AI capabilities to reduce manual effort, strengthen data quality, and improve repeatability.
* Partner with Financial Systems and process owners on system enhancements, data requirements, testing, and future-state process design.
* Create a scalable operating model that can support additional property types, legal entities, jurisdictions, and future team growth.

Cross-Functional Leadership
  
  

* Build strong working relationships across Order-to-Cash, Accounting, Treasury, Payroll, Tax, Legal, Financial Systems, Internal Audit, and other business teams.
* Provide practical guidance and training to stakeholders on unclaimed property requirements, responsibilities, and prevention opportunities.
* Influence outcomes without direct authority and drive decisions through clear analysis, documented requirements, and effective stakeholder communication.

**Required Qualifications**

* 7 or more years of experience in U.S. unclaimed property, escheatment, regulated financial compliance, accounting operations, controllership, treasury, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated holder-side experience with multistate U.S. unclaimed property compliance, including due diligence, reporting, remittance, and reconciliation.
* Experience independently building, stabilizing, or materially improving a compliance process or program.
* Ability to interpret state requirements and translate them into clear operational processes and controls.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, including experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong documentation, project ownership, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Ability to manage fixed regulatory deadlines, competing priorities, and complex issues with a high degree of independence and accuracy.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills and experience partnering with U.S.-based stakeholders.

Leverage AI-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality and actively experiment with emerging capabilities as they evolve.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience owning state audits, voluntary disclosure agreements, regulatory examinations, or penalty-resolution activities.
* Experience in a U.S. public company, SaaS organization, global business services environment, or India GCC / shared services model.
* Knowledge of customer credit balances, unapplied cash, refunds, vendor payments, payroll property, and related accounting flows.
* Experience with Power BI, Alteryx, SQL, workflow tools, or similar reporting and automation capabilities.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Workday, SAP, or comparable ERP, CRM, billing, and financial systems.
* Relevant accounting, finance, audit, compliance, project management, or unclaimed property training or certification.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, X, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube

*Intelligence for Good®*
vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

description:
Your opportunity
  
  
At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
  
  
Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region
  
  
The Schwab Asset Management (SAM) Technology organization is a part of Schwab Technology Services that is responsible for Schwab's investment management, operations, data, and research platforms. Everything that SAM Tech builds serves Schwab’s mission of helping clients reach their financial goals.
  
  
What you have
  
  
**Key Responsbilities**
As a Quantitative Analyst - Investment Research in the SAM Investment Research Technology group, you will play a critical role in delivering cutting-edge research and product development capabilities designed to advance SAM business opportunities and to support the Schwab Center for Financial Research (SCFR) in its mission to provide clients and advisors actionable investment advice. We curate structured and unstructured datasets for both exploratory and product-focused research, and we implement and maintain investment models across multiple asset classes and product categoriess, including equity and fund ratings, thematic investing baskets, multi-asset solutions, factor strategies, and more.
  
  
This role will interact with researchers and other business users to help bring together data, analytics, modeling, and operational capabilities into a common ecosystem for all research teams. You will help establish the foundational capabilities, frameworks, and workflows that enable innovative research products, accelerate time-to-market, and promote greater reuse of data and technology assets across the organization. This is an opportunity to help define the future state of quantitative research technology at Schwab.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
▪ Degree in computer science, information systems, mathematics, engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience
  
  
▪ Five or more years of business systems analysis and/or software engineering experience working with data-intensive applications, quantitative systems, or analytical platforms built with Python and/or similar languages (e.g. R, Matlab, Julia)
  
  
▪ Knowledge of financial markets, the investment management business, and associated research practices
  
  
▪ Experience partnering with researchers, analysts, product owners, or business stakeholders to gather requirements and implement technology solutions that support data-driven decision-making
  
  
▪ Strong background working with large, complex datasets and applying data science methodologies to extract meaning and value for business partners
  
  

* Expertise to create data visualizations that drive effective decision-making

▪ Familiarity with data models that enable efficient storage, integration, retrieval, and analysis of complex datasets
  
  
▪ Experience designing data quality frameworks and controls, including monitoring, validation, lineage tracking, governance processes, and observability
  
  
▪ Proven ability to collaborate effectively within Agile and DevOps environments, partnering with Product Owners, Architects, engineers, and governance teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet enterprise standards for quality, reliability, and supportability
  
  
**Preffered Qualifications**
▪ Advanced degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, quantitative finance, or a related technical discipline
  
  
▪ Experience supporting quantitative investment research, model development, backtesting, portfolio analytics, performance attribution, or other investment management workflows
  
  
▪ Demonstrated ability to uncover complex patterns and insights through advanced analysis of large and diverse datasets
  
  
▪ Experience developing data visualization, self-service analytics, and researcher-facing tooling that transforms data into actionable insights and improves decision-making
  
  
▪ Experience evaluating and applying emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, generative AI, or advanced analytics techniques, to improve platform capabilities and researcher productivity
  
  
▪ Strong verbal and written communication skills, including experience presenting technical concepts, architectural proposals, and analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  
  
▪ Track record of championing innovation, experimentation, and continuous improvement through the adoption of new technologies, engineering practices, or operating models
  
  
What’s in it for you
  
  
At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long-term financial security.

* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more

**. Month-End, Quarter-End, and Year-End Close Support**

* Ensure accounting processes comply with SOX requirements, company policies, and internal control standards.
* Design, execute, and improve controls over technical accounting areas, journal entries, reconciliations, estimates, analytics, and reporting support.
* Identify control gaps, process weaknesses, and recurring audit issues; develop remediation plans and monitor progress.
* Promote proactive issue identification and escalation
* Build a culture of accountability, transparency, and strong documentation across the GCC controllership team.

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that modernize accounting processes and enhance the GCC’s strategic value.
* Key responsibilities include:
* Identify opportunities to automate manual accounting processes, reconciliations, reporting schedules, variance analyses, and exception reviews.
* Partner with IT, Analytics, Finance Transformation, and global process owners to implement scalable solutions using Oracle Fusion, reporting tools, workflow tools, RPA, and analytics platforms.
* Support the design of future-state accounting processes for the GCC, including standard work, global process ownership, and service-level expectations.
* Lead projects to improve close efficiency, reduce manual entries, improve reconciliation quality, and increase visibility into accounting risks.
* Help define KPIs and operational metrics for accounting and analytics processes.
* Promote adoption of AI-enabled and analytics-driven finance practices, while ensuring appropriate governance, controls, and data quality.

* CPA preferred or Chartered Accountant
* (8-12) years of progressive accounting experience, preferably including public accounting and public-company controllership experience.
* Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP; IFRS knowledge is a plus.
* Experience supporting month-end close, financial reporting, technical accounting, audit, and internal controls.
* Strong analytical skills with experience interpreting large data sets and identifying accounting risks or unusual trends.
* Experience working in a global finance environment, shared services center, global capability center, or multinational organization.
* Strong understanding of SOX controls, audit requirements, documentation standards, and control evidence.
* Ability to prepare high-quality accounting memos, management summaries, and audit support.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills across global teams and time zones.
* Strong leadership skills with experience managing teams, developing talent, and leading process improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
