title: Engagement Manager
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

title: Senior Associate, Fund Accounting
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
We are seeking a Senior Associate with experience in private equity fund accounting to support the review and delivery of financial statements, fund accounting records, and client reporting requirements. The role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of financial data, NAV calculations, valuations, and other fund accounting deliverables in accordance with client-specific requirements, fund governing documents, and applicable accounting standards. The successful candidate will possess a strong understanding of fund accounting principles, financial reporting, and review processes, while contributing to operational excellence, stakeholder engagement, and the consistent delivery of high-quality client service.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus
  

* Support leadership in the implementation and execution of accounting review standards, controls, and best practices to enhance the quality and consistency of fund accounting deliverables.
* Identify and assess operational risks, cost-efficiency opportunities, and process improvement initiatives to support effective service delivery and operational excellence.
* Lead the preparation of fund accounting activities, financial statements, NAVs, and client reporting deliverables to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with client requirements and accounting standards.
* Support the management of complex fund structures, transactions, and reporting requirements by applying technical expertise and sound professional judgment.
* Provide oversight of key fund accounting and investor-related activities, ensuring timely execution and adherence to established controls and procedures.
* Prepare and validate management fee calculations, carried interest allocations, and other complex fund accounting activities to ensure accuracy and compliance with governing agreements.
* Support senior leadership in the implementation and execution of accounting review standards, controls, and best practices to enhance the quality and consistency of fund accounting deliverables.
* Identify and assess operational risks, cost-efficiency opportunities, and process improvement initiatives to support effective service delivery and operational excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement by recommending enhancements to review processes, controls, and reporting practices to improve efficiency, scalability, and service quality.
* Act as a subject matter resource for fund accounting and financial reporting matters, providing technical guidance and knowledge sharing within the team.
* Contribute to the successful delivery of strategic client objectives by ensuring high-quality, timely, and consistent service across assigned fund portfolios.
* Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous learning through active participation in team development and best-practice initiatives.

  
Operational Management
  

* Oversee the preparation and delivery of financial statements and other accounting reports, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion in accordance with established quality standards.
* Ensure accounting review procedures and practices are aligned with US GAAP, IFRS, and other applicable accounting standards, including the research and application of technical accounting guidance.
* Maintain a high standard of client service by reviewing client reports and financial statements for accuracy, quality, and completeness while ensuring adherence to agreed timelines.
* Ensure all accounting review activities are appropriately documented and performed in accordance with organizational policies, procedures, and quality standards.
* Analyze, address, and resolve issues relating to technical accounting pronouncements, financial statement disclosures, and reporting requirements.
* Identify review efficiencies and recommend process improvements to enhance quality, consistency, and operational effectiveness.
* Review client deliverables, audit support documentation, and reporting packages to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable requirements.
* Leverage accounting systems and reporting tools to support efficient review processes and enhance reporting quality.
* Collaborate with global client service teams in accordance with established procedures to ensure consistency, quality, and efficiency of service delivery.
* Provide guidance on client queries and reporting matters, ensuring timely communication and issue resolution.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships while serving as a key point of contact for accounting review matters.
* Demonstrate ownership of assigned fund relationships and review deliverables, ensuring quality and timely completion.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to support the development of junior team members.
* Support team objectives by promoting collaboration, consistency in review practices, and effective workload management.

People leadership:

* Provide clear and timely updates and respond effectively to stakeholder requests.
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Support team learning through knowledge sharing and the promotion of best practices.
* Contribute positively to team objectives and support colleagues as needed.
* Deliver high-quality service and foster trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Continuously enhance fund accounting, reporting, and technical expertise.

  
Governance & Risk
  

* Prepare and present performance and risk reports, proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks while ensuring compliance with applicable policies and requirements.
* Escalate issues and incidents appropriately and in a timely manner to support the effective management of operational and business risks.
* Communicate issues, risks, and remediation actions clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.
* Review and challenge risk-related findings to support the accuracy and completeness of reporting and controls.
* Support audits, regulatory reviews, and compliance activities through effective coordination and timely reporting.
* Lead the escalation and resolution of exceptions, incidents, and control issues, ensuring appropriate stakeholder involvement.
* Promote adherence to governance frameworks, policies, and established risk management practices.
* Communicate governance, risk, and compliance matters effectively while maintaining trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Continuously enhance technical, regulatory, and risk management knowledge to support effective decision-making and oversight.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience 
  

* Chartered Accountant / Master’s degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance
* Minimum of 2 years of experience in operations / accounting within the financial services industry.

  
Personal Attributes
  

* Strong and analytical and problem-solving skills and ability to lead a medium-sized team
* Support senior leadership in adoption and execution of accounting review standards and best practices.
* Ability to analyse, resolve and document problems and resolutions.
* Ability to work as part of a cross-cultural team.
* Strong organization and time management skills
* Continuous improvement focus, with the ability to identify risks, cost efficiencies, and operational improvements.
* Strong presentation and communication skills with ability to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels.
* Self-driven and motivated with a focus on operational efficiency and continuous improvement.

description:
**About The Team**
Clearwater Analytics' Managed Services team runs the day-to-day middle- and back-office operations — trade operations, NAV accounting, reconciliation, and regulatory reporting, for hedge funds and asset managers operating on the Enfusion platform. MS teams work inside a SOC 1 Type II control environment across break analysis & resolution, daily NAV production, trade affirmation using industry-standard platforms such as CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, and DTCC ALERT. As an intern on this team, you'll get first-hand exposure to how a fund's operations actually run behind the scenes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Reconciliation Support: assist in matching internal transaction records against custodian, broker, and bank statements, and help log discrepancies for the team to investigate.
* Data Entry & Validation: help record investor inflows, redemptions, corporate actions, and trade bookings accurately into the core portfolio accounting system (Enfusion).
* Trade Support: observe and support daily trade affirmation workflows across platforms including CTM, NYFIX, and Traiana.
* NAV & Reporting: shadow the daily NAV process & monthly trial balance reconciliation and help prepare operational reports.
* Records and reports the status of daily and monthly operational delivery.

**What You'll Gain**

* Direct, hands-on exposure to how a real fund's middle and back office runs on a daily market cycle.
* Training on Enfusion and industry-standard platforms — CTM, NYFIX, Traiana, DTCC ALERT, and EMIR reporting tools.
* Mentorship from experienced fund operations professionals across reconciliation, NAV accounting, and trade lifecycle management.
* A front-row seat to how a SOC 1 Type II controlled operating environment is run in practice.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Currently pursuing, or recently completed, a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Commerce, Accounting, Business Management, or a related quantitative field.
* Certifications (Bonus): Progress toward CFA Level I, NISM, or another relevant local market certification is a plus, though not required.

**Hard Skills**

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills — comfortable with VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and handling large data sets without errors.
* Basic understanding of financial statements, general ledger accounting, and how corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, dividends) affect fund valuations.
* Asset Classes: Intermediate understanding of fixed income and equity investments and a basic knowledge of alternative security types
* Strong accounting and/or finance skills.
* Familiarity with core operational concepts — how NAV is calculated daily, and the trade settlement lifecycle (e.g., clearing, custodian communication, T+1 settlement).

**Soft Skills**

* Hyper-attention to detail — accuracy matters; a single misplaced decimal or swapped account number can cause real compliance and financial issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication for presenting findings and handling internal or client queries.
* Process orientation — able to follow structured SOPs precisely while spotting opportunities to improve them.
* Time management under pressure — comfortable working to firm daily market cut-off times.
* A proactive, eager-to-learn attitude toward new financial software and workflows.

title: Associate Director, Commercial
description:
**Who we are:**

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

**Our values:**

* **Responsibility:**
  We take ownership of our actions and outcomes.
* **Innovation:**
  We embrace change and create bold solutions.
* **Strive:**
  We show grit, resilience and relentless drive.
* **Excellence:**
  We pursue the highest standards in all we do.
* **Respect:**
  We act with integrity and treat others with dignity.

**What we need:**

We are seeking an Associate Director, Commercial to join our Design & Construction (D&C) team.

This senior leadership role provides commercial governance and strategic cost control across a multi-campus portfolio of hyperscale and build-to-suit data-center projects across India.

With procurement operations transitioning to the Finance organization, this role will focus on front-end commercial strategy, contract management, and risk oversight, ensuring robust commercial outcomes from early design through construction completion.

You will partner closely with Procurement, Engineering, Project Delivery, and Corporate Development to ensure cost certainty, contractual compliance, and risk mitigation across all projects in the region.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Commercial Strategy & Governance**

* Collaborate with Senior Director, Commercial (Head of Platform D&C Commercial) to implement and maintain the commercial management framework, covering cost planning, contracting models (GMP, cost-plus, hybrid), and risk management.
* Lead commercial input during early feasibility and RIBA stage development, ensuring budgets, benchmarks, and cash-flow forecasts align with business objectives.
* Maintain commercial playbooks and oversee implementation within India to ensure alignment across regions, including T+X months milestone and S+X months capital deployment strategies.

**Contract Management & Risk Control**

* Drive end-to-end contract administration - from pre-contract strategy, tender review support, and commercial negotiations to final account settlement.
* Provide oversight of major EPC, D&B, and framework agreements, including change-order management, claims avoidance, and dispute resolution.
* Monitor commercial risk exposure across all projects and escalate issues with clear mitigation plans.

**Cost Planning & Reporting**

* Lead regional cost planning and benchmarking for all major construction and MEP packages.
* Maintain a standardized reporting dashboard tracking CAPEX burn, S+X months vs. T+X months spend buckets, forecast-to-complete, and variance analysis, providing leadership with clear portfolio-wide visibility.
* Support Finance on funding calls and cash-flow management by providing accurate spend projections and scenario modelling.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance-led Procurement to ensure sourcing strategies and vendor selections meet D&C technical and schedule requirements.
* Work with Engineering, Project Directors, and Operations to validate design-to-budget alignment and incorporate lessons learned into future contracts.
* Interface with JV partners, lenders, and hyperscale customers on commercial matters and reporting.

**Leadership & Team Development**

* Build and mentor a regional commercial management team skilled in cost planning, contract administration, and project controls.
* Champion the use of commercial management tools and data analytics to drive visibility and continuous improvement.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**Candidate Profile:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of commercial management experience in large-scale data-center, mission-critical infrastructure, or major construction projects, including 5+ years in a regional leadership role.
* Strong knowledge of contract law, cost control methodologies, and risk management frameworks.
* Proven ability to manage high-value contracts across multiple Asian markets and to collaborate effectively with Finance-led procurement teams.
* Familiarity with international contract standards (e.g., FIDIC) and regional construction norms.
* Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
* RICS, MRICS, or equivalent commercial management certification preferred..

**Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.**

title: Associate, Fund Accounting
description:

Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
Support the administration and financial operations of private equity funds by assisting in the preparation of net asset valuations (NAVs), portfolio valuations, capital calls, distributions, investor allocations, and management fee calculations. Maintain accurate fund accounting records, perform reconciliations, and contribute to financial reporting, audit support, and client deliverables. Ensure all activities are executed in compliance with fund governing documents, valuation policies, regulatory requirements, and internal control standards while delivering high-quality service to stakeholders.
  
**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic Focus 
  

* Support the preparation and review of Net Asset Values (NAVs), fund accounting records, accruals, and account reconciliations to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Assist in the valuation of portfolio investments by applying established valuation methodologies, validating pricing inputs, and ensuring adherence to fund documentation, accounting standards, and valuation policies.
* Execute and monitor investor transactions, including capital calls, distributions, subscriptions, redemptions, and investor allocations, while maintaining accurate investor records and reporting.
* Calculate management fees, carried interest, and distribution waterfall allocations in accordance with fund governing agreements and partnership terms, ensuring accuracy and transparency.

  
Operational Management 
  

* Deliver NAVs, valuations, and fund accounting activities accurately and within established timelines.
* Maintain data accuracy through reconciliations, reviews, and compliance checks.
* Collaborate with clients, auditors, and internal teams to ensure timely delivery of key deliverables.
* Ensure adherence to fund documentation, valuation policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Effectively prioritize tasks and manage deadlines across multiple funds and reporting cycles.
* Support operational efficiency initiatives and process improvement efforts.

* Build and maintain strong working relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrate ownership of assigned deliverables and consistently meet deadlines.

Governance & Risk

* Maintain a strong control environment through reconciliations, reviews, and validation processes.
* Ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial and investor records.
* Support audits and regulatory reviews by providing timely and accurate documentation.
* Promptly escalate and resolve exceptions, discrepancies, and control gaps.
* Comply with established procedures, service standards, and governance frameworks.
* Deliver high-quality service and foster trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Continuously enhance fund accounting, reporting, and technical expertise.

  
**Experience & Personal Attributes**
  
Experience

* Exposure to private equity, investment funds, or financial reporting is an asset.
* Experience with NAV Preparation – Understanding of fund accounting principles and NAV calculations.
* Reconciliation Experience – Cash, security, and portfolio reconciliation experience preferred.
* Financial Reporting Exposure – Experience supporting audits, financial statements, or regulatory reporting is beneficial.
* Microsoft Excel – Strong proficiency required, including financial analysis and data management.
* Professional Qualifications – CPA, ACCA, CMA, or progress toward a designation is considered an asset.

  
Personal Attributes

* Effectively manages multiple deadlines and priorities.
* Proactively identifies issues and implements practical solutions.

* Performs well under pressure in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

title: Capital Deployment and Liquidity Management, Private Financing Solutions (PFS), Associate
description:
**About This Role**
HPS Investment Partners is a credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offer the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Capital Deployment & Liquidity Management team is responsible for the liquidity management, allocations and fundings for the Private Credit platform. The team works very closely with the Portfolio Manager, and Investment Teams on the allocation and funding of all investments, along with various other internal teams across infrastructure (Treasury, Fund Accounting, etc.) on the liquidity management of each individual fund.
  
  
**Description**
HPS is currently seeking an Associate level candidate to join the Capital Deployment & Liquidity Management team in Mumbai. This position will primarily support deal closings and ratings maintenance for Private Credit investments, with a focus on Private Ratings, Middle Market CLOs, and High-Grade Credit. The ideal candidate will have 3-6 years of relevant deal execution experience, preferably in private ratings management, as well as strong attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and excellent communication skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* Support investment operations across private credit, direct lending, high-grade credit, and CLO portfolios.
* Manage the full lifecycle of private rating requests, working closely with Fitch, Moody's, S&P, and KBRA from initial submission through the issuance of rating letters, credit estimates, and credit opinions.
* Oversee PPN and CUSIP request workflows and maintain supporting transaction documentation throughout the investment lifecycle.
* Review, validate, and maintain ratings information in internal systems, ensuring the accurate capture of rating actions and security-level data.
* Create and maintain rating letter templates and trackers, and coordinate the timely distribution of ratings-related information to investors and key stakeholders.
* Manage rating agency invoices, fee administration, and related operational processes.
* Coordinate preliminary and final private ratings required for certain accounts, including organizing meetings and calls between HPS and the rating agencies.
* Support insurance investment portfolios through reporting, data analysis, and ad hoc requests.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3-6 years of relevant work experience, asset management industry preferred.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Collaborative mindset, and diligent with demonstrated skills problem-solving.
* Strong technical skills, with a willingness to learn and implement new software applications.
* Ability to liaise with key stakeholders of all levels throughout the firm.
* Excel/MS Office Proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality while adhering to the highest ethical standards, both personally and professionally.

**Location**

* Mumbai, India

**Hybrid Work Schedule**

* 4/1 split (M-Th from office, F work from home)

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Manager- BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's India PIPE Practice Area, you will work in a growing team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute to cases through thought partnership in your area of expertise, deliver original analyses and insights helping drive strong impact with clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, providing insights & advice for proposals and client workshops. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you may lead development of intellectual property & assets for the business and mentor and guide junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise.
  
  
BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area is one of the firm's largest and fastest-growing practices, working with the world's leading investment firms across the full deal and value-creation lifecycle — from thesis generation and commercial due diligence through 100-day planning, hold-period value creation, and exit readiness.
  
  
To succeed in this environment, our teams blend deep investor perspective with digital and human capabilities, bringing rigorous diligence discipline, portfolio operating expertise, and proprietary data and tools to every engagement. You will support commercialization efforts across PIPE topics and asset classes — contributing diligence-ready analysis, benchmarking, and insights to proposals, investment committee materials, client workshops, and marketing content
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3+ years consulting experience in relevant PIPE required, candidates with private equity, investment banking, or transaction advisory consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4+ years minimum industry experience required (e.g., private equity, investment banking, corporate development, portfolio operations); 5-8+ years of relevant industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree, e.g., MBA or CFA, preferred)
* Fluency in English; Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholders — including deal teams, investor clients, and portfolio company executives — while working in a collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g., APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the diligence and analytics landscape evolves
* Familiarity with investor workflows and terminology (e.g., LOIs, IC memos, LBO mechanics, value creation plans, GP/LP reporting) a strong plus
* Strong problem solving skills

Who You'll Work With
  
  
As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path, you will work face to face with clients and with BCG Project Leaders, Associates and Consultants in India, for India. In the period between cases, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients. Our team is made up a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
  
  
With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight & expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
  
  
**Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)**

* Integrates into client-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know-how, and proprietary tools and assets

**Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool & Data Solutions)**

* Combines deep domain insights with our know-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients

**Research (Practice Topic and Sector-Aligned Research and Insights)**

* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro-economic, commodities and trade data

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Solving complex investor and portfolio-company problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions across one or more PIPE topic areas or asset classes (e.g., commercial due diligence, value creation, exit readiness, private credit, infrastructure investing)
* Engaging senior stakeholders and client team members, delivering targeted communication based on stakeholder settings - deal partners, portfolio operating executives, and investor clients — demonstrating the ability to engage a sophisticated, deal-focused audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance diligence quality, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable and knowledge frameworks tailored to investor workflows
* Managing projects with ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment, demonstrating business sense and adaptability
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast-paced environment

*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork*

title: Financial Systems Architect - OneStream
description:
**Job Title**
Financial Systems Architect - OneStream
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
**Job Description**
The
**Financial Systems Architect**
is a key member of the
**Technology and Data Solutions (TDS)**
team, responsible for supporting and enhancing Cushman & Wakefield's OneStream SaaS platform. This role focuses on ensuring security, governance, stability, and continuous improvement of enterprise financial processes, including financial consolidation, close, reporting, forecasting, planning, and analysis (xP&A).
  
  
Working closely with Product Managers, Finance leaders, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technology teams, the Senior Financial Systems Engineer designs, develops, and implements scalable solutions that improve automation, data quality, reporting capabilities, and financial decision-making. Serving as both a technical expert and strategic business partner, this individual translates business requirements into sustainable OneStream solutions through application configuration, business rules, integrations, and platform enhancements.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, Master Data Management, and IT stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.
* Drive the delivery of scalable solutions that align with strategic business objectives and enterprise finance transformation initiatives.
* Collaborate with Product Managers and business users to define requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap execution.

**Application Configuration & Governance**

* Configure and maintain OneStream metadata, business rules, workflows, dashboards, reporting objects, and application settings.
* Ensure adherence to governance standards, development best practices, and change management processes.
* Support platform upgrades, releases, and ongoing optimization initiatives.

**Financial Close & Reporting Support**

* Provide system support during monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close cycles.
* Participate in consolidation processes, workflow execution, reporting deliverables, and issue resolution to ensure timely and accurate financial results.
* Partner with Finance teams to identify and resolve data, process, and report discrepancies.

**Platform Ownership & Administration**

* Administer and maintain OneStream environments, including Development, Test/Pre-Production, and Production.
* Monitor system performance, availability, and operational health while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Coordinate deployments and migration activities across environments.

**Security, Controls & Compliance**

* Support management of application security, role-based access controls, segregation of duties, and user provisioning processes.
* Perform periodic access reviews and support internal and external audit activities.
* Ensure compliance with corporate governance policies, regulatory requirements, and security standards.

**Technical Leadership & Problem Resolution**

* Serve as the point of technical escalation for complex application, data, consolidation, and integration issues.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions to prevent recurring problems.
* Document system solutions, support procedures, and technical standards.

**Planning, Forecasting & Analytics (xP&A)**

* Support and enhance budgeting, forecasting, scenario modeling, planning, and analytical capabilities within OneStream.
* Develop solutions that improve planning accuracy, reporting efficiency, and management insights.
* Partner with business stakeholders to expand adoption of xP&A capabilities across the organization.

description:

HC Global Fund Services, LLC (“HC Global”) is a privately owned fund administrator serving fund managers and investment advisors in the alternative investments industry.

*Middle and Back Office Functions*

* Gathers all information required (i.e. external statements, i.e., prime broker reports and custodian statements, supporting documents for recurring expenses including legal fees, audit fee, admin fees, tax fees, director’s fee, etc.).

* Monitors client mailboxes/distribution lists and saves all necessary emails and supports on a timely manner.

* Prepares working papers in a way that ensures that all audit requirements are handy for the auditors.
* Prepares year-end schedules for independent auditors including cost roll forward, cash reconciliation, statement of cash flows, and financial highlights and other working papers supporting the balances and disclosures in the financial statements.
* Prepares each fund’s financial statements and works closely with the respective fund’s auditors for note disclosures.
* Prepares and submits draft financial statements on a timely basis for next level review.

* Graduate of Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy
* Preferably a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) or Chartered Accountant (CA)
* Preferably with at least 1 year of experience in financial accounting or equivalent
* A team player; must be able to work individually and as part of a team
* Has a good business understanding of financial concepts and procedures
* Analytical and very detail-oriented
* Flexibility to expand work hours as necessary and support business needs
* Non-CPAs are welcome to apply

**Benefits**
To be discussed during the application process.

description:
**COMPANY OVERVIEW**

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.

  

JOB OVERVIEW

The General Mills Financial Systems Integration (FSI) team oversees a global financial systems, data and process ecosystem that enables business growth and evolution, with uncompromising fiduciary integrity. The agile & experienced team governs systems and data, leads close and consolidation processes and provides strategic guidance on key enterprise and portfolio shaping initiatives.

General Mills is in the process of transitioning our global close & consolidation platform from HFM to the OneStream platform. We are seeking a motivated individual to assist in building, sustaining and optimizing this new core platform. The Global Consolidation Administrator (OneStream) will report to the Global Consolidation Steward and oversee the administration and day-to-day support of the OneStream application. This role is integral to the Financial Systems Integration (FSI) Team and involves close collaboration with various members of the global finance and accounting organization across the company.

  

**SHIFT TIMINGS- 1.30 PM TO 10.30 PM**

  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

* Perform primary duties within OneStream application, including, but not limited to, entity hierarchies, rules, workflows, dashboards, and reporting views/packages.
* Develop and maintain various reporting solutions (OneStream Cube Views and Excel Add-in) as needed by Accounting and other Finance teams.
* Create, maintain, and update financial reports and forms and perform training and end-user education of the system functionality, as needed
* Troubleshoot and partner with D&T resources on technical issues related to the OneStream system.
* Support integrations and data quality processes (validations, mappings, transformations, confirmations) from source systems (SAP, other) in OneStream.
* Partner with SOX team to ensure internal control governance (including SOX requirements), documentation and coordination with internal and external auditors as it relates to system access and change management.
Provide support for users and maintain system protocols in troubleshooting data validation, access, and reporting issues.  

  

MINIMUM QUALIFICATION

* Education – Full time graduation from an accredited university (Mandatory- Note: This is the minimum education criteria which cannot be altered)
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
* 5+ years of experience in Financial Consolidation system administration, specifically in OneStream, with experience in Hyperion HFM is a plus
* Strong documentation and communication skills, to support interaction with Finance customers and IT partners
* A strong background in accounting and finance
* Detail oriented, highly accurate, and conscientious with strong written and verbal communication skills
* Exhibit strong problem solving, deductive reasoning and decision-making skills
* Work independently as well as in a team environment
* Demonstrate our core values of ambition, innovation, integrity and teamwork

  

**ELIGIBILITY**

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

**Job Overview**
----------------

Individuals in Product Controls are responsible for establishing, managing, and mitigating operational, compliance, and regulatory risks across various business lines and products. Professionals within this profile work collaboratively with product management, operations, technology, and second/third-line risk partners to design, implement, and maintain a robust, compliant, and sustainable risk-mitigated environment that supports safe business growth.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

* Help assess the effectiveness of existing controls, executing routine control testing checklists and identifying potential exceptions.
* Help drive control testing enhancements focused on increasing operational execution efficiency and reducing process-level risks.
* Help assist in the execution of the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and verify personal adherence with Risk Management and Compliance Policies.
* Contribute to the oversight of the MCA program, including performing daily/weekly testing scripts and compiling monthly reporting data.
* Help assist in the execution of the MCA program in accordance with the ORM Policy & Framework, as well as applicable Policies, Standards, and Procedures.
* Perform assessment activities and testing processes as per required Policies, Standards, and Procedures to strengthen risk management quality.
* Help with the coordination and administrative management of issues and corrective action plans with key stakeholders.
* Participate in issue quality reviews, verifying that logged corrective action items comply with Issue Management Policy standards.
* Develop standardized risk and control testing reports to ensure sound, reliable, and consistent data exists for team leaders.
* Be involved in the operations of governance committees, including scheduling meetings, distributing agendas, and tracking follow-up action items.
* Prepare and organize documentation for internal and external audits and regulatory reviews, participate in walkthroughs, and assist in drafting responses to examiner requests.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Role Summary:**

The C12 Assistant Vice President, Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management team, is a key individual contributor or team lead responsible for supporting the execution of Business and function specific Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management activities. This role involves performing detailed quality reviews, supporting project execution, and ensuring adherence to established policies and standards for issue resolution and audit and regulatory stakeholder engagement. The Assistant Vice President will apply their analytical skills to support root cause analysis, assess control performance, and contribute to the overall effectiveness and sustainability of Business and function specific Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management, directly impacting the strengthening of Citi's control environment. This includes interpreting audit and regulatory expectations and translating them into actionable plans to strengthen the control environment.

* Identifies and analyzes issue trends and insights to support broader remediation efforts and process improvements for Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management.
* Reviews new or enhanced controls and one-time actions within corrective action plans, evaluating their design and effectiveness.
* Identifies potential process inefficiencies or control gaps related Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management and proposes solutions to management.
* Maintains a strong understanding of relevant policies, standards, and regulatory expectations related to issue management and internal audit.
* May provide guidance to junior analysts, including oversight of daily tasks and project contributions.
* Upholds Citi's ethical standards and reputation by ensuring compliance with applicable laws, rules, and regulations, and escalating control issues transparently.
* Prepares reports and presentations on Audit Prep and Regulatory Review Management review findings and remediation status for various stakeholders.
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency, as well as effectively supervise the activity of teams and create accountability with those who fail to maintain these standards.

**Qualifications:**

* 8+ years of experience in operational risk management, compliance, audit, regulatory or other control-related functions in the financial services industry.
* Understanding of compliance laws, rules, regulations, and corporate Policies and Standards; appreciation of Wholesale Credit Risk (WCR) policies and processes is a must.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
* Strong knowledge in the development and execution of control testing workpapers and testing evidence collection.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and collaborate with various stakeholders.
* Good understanding of risk and control frameworks and their practical application.
* Capable of working independently on assigned tasks and managing multiple priorities.

By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

  

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.

  

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

**Divisional Overview:**

The GCIO function oversees group-wide technology, operations, and our data office. Our purpose is to support Nomura’s business strategy and deliver consistent group-wide services based on common operating principles. We are aligned to our key businesses across the group and operate enterprise-wide functions for risk management, governance and controls, supply chain and infrastructure.

The Chief Controls Office (CCO) is a key function within GCIO and our purpose is aligned to the GCIO Strengthen & Protect strategic pillar. We are a global team focused on strengthening our non-financial risk management framework enabling the business to accelerate strategic delivery, whilst enhancing our ability to dynamically manage risks and evidence that we are operating in control.

CCO function is on a multi-year global transformation journey which starts with building the right foundations especially the right skills and capabilities within our global team.

  

**Business Overview:**

Nomura in Powai is looking for a Controls Assurance Analyst to join the Global Controls Assurance Centre of Excellence. The candidate will be responsible for design adequacy and operating effectiveness testing of controls relevant to GCIO risks – such as Information Technology (IT), Information Security (IS), Data Management etc.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Controls Tester looking for a career development opportunity. They will play a pivotal role within GCIO – CCO in managing the Global GCIO controls assurance function.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in controls testing within financial services and excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Role & Responsibilities:**

* Execute controls testing procedures in accordance with the established methodology and testing plans, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of testing activities.
* Document testing workpapers clearly and concisely, providing sufficient evidence to support findings and conclusions, including recommendations for remediation and management action.
* Identify and escalate potential control deficiencies and areas for improvement, providing supporting documentation and analysis.
* Analyse testing results, identify trends and patterns that may indicate control weaknesses or areas of heightened risk.
* Collaborate with various departments within GCIO for control walkthroughs, sampling, evidence collection etc.
* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of industry standards and best practices related to controls testing.
* Support the creation of GCIO Controls Assurance management information (MI)
* Participate in audits and assessments, providing support and insights as needed.
* Actively participate in team meetings and discussions, contributing ideas and insights to enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of controls assurance activities.
* Support Controls Assurance Lead to continuously identify and implement improvements within the assurance framework.
  

**Mandatory Skill Set :**

* 7 to 9 years’ experience in Information Security controls testing.
* Strong understanding of Information Security, for example, data protection, vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, security events and monitoring, data loss prevention, endpoint detection and response, network security etc
* Knowledge of industry standards like NIST and ITIL
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
* Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels.
* Experience operating in a regulated environment and managing stakeholders across the Three Lines of Defense.

title: Business Intelligence Senior Associate
description:
**About The Role**
Your role as a Business Intelligence Senior Associate is to work with the product and machine learning team to automate the process of manual forecasting and identify the root causes. You are expected to detect anomalies/issues early, identify root causes, track revenue and spend trends on an hourly/daily/weekly/monthly basis against the forecast. Coordination with multiple teams to fix problems with rollouts/ releases and ensure leadership always has an accurate view of performance.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Monitor the health of the business via tools such as our anomaly detection software and other dashboards, and keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on the health of key input metrics.
* Hourly and daily (Real-time monitoring): Monitor the hourly trend continuously.
* Revenue declines must be assessed to find the root cause and verify if the decline is associated with any product release.
* Executive Communication: Share insights and learnings on long-term and short-term trends with a broader set of stakeholders to inform strategic planning and GTM execution.
* Allocate the identified cause to the corresponding teams and assess the next actions.
* Inform the Network Operations Center team to trigger P1/P2 alerts based on the severity of the revenue decline.
* Weekly (Medium Term Monitoring): Own the revenue forecasting process and provide executive updates.
* Define variance thresholds that trigger deeper analysis to understand reasons behind movements of key dimensions.
* Investigate any metrics that show signs of decay or are deviating from the norm and find the root cause.
* Monthly (Long Term Monitoring): Lead the monthly review process with Marketplace, Product, and Engineering stakeholders to track the key drivers of our spend on an ongoing basis.
* Be intimately involved in the quarterly and annual planning process and be aware of what assumptions went into the plan.
* Act as the project manager of investigations. Cross-functionally manage workstreams with account stakeholders to complete analyses and troubleshooting.
* Provide regular updates on Steering Committees. Revenue Monitoring Process Improvement.
* Reduce “blind spots” by developing new monitoring frameworks and incorporating new data sources into existing monitoring processes.
* Collaborate with Product Management and external vendors to improve existing anomaly detection solutions, based on KPI performance.
* Rollout and Recovery Tracking: Work closely with the monetization product team to track and quantify the impact of product releases.

**We'd Love for You to Have**

* Proven 5 to 8 years of experience in data analysis, or a similar role, is preferred.
* Communication Skills - Ability to present complex findings in a clear, concise, and actionable way to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Technical skills such as Excel, Looker, MYSQL, forecasting, impact measurement, AB Testing, are a must.
* Knowledge of Excel macro/VBA, Python, and Ad Tech experience is good to have.
* Experience with GenAI-based tools like Cursor and Claude will be an added advantage.
* Strong knowledge of data manipulation and analysis.
* Familiarity with anomaly detection techniques, including supervised and unsupervised learning methods, time-series analysis, and outlier detection algorithms.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.
* Problem Solving - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and the ability to work with ambiguous data.
* Attention to Detail - High level of accuracy and attention to detail in all work.
* Shift Timings - 3.00 PM to 12 midnight.
* Understanding big data technologies and tools like Hadoop, Spark, or cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, etc.) is a plus.

**Qualifications**

* Should have a Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**About Robokidz**

Robokidz Eduventures Limited is a Pune-based, BSE SME-listed K-12 STEM, Robotics and AI education company. We set up turnkey labs in schools across India, deliver curriculum and teacher training, and run the YEA! (Young Engineers' Academy) learning-centre network through our subsidiary.

**Role Summary**

We are hiring a hands-on
**Senior Accountant**
to run day-to-day accounting, GST and TDS compliance, and monthly closing for the company and its group entity. You will work in
**Tally and Zoho Books every day**
, keep the books audit-ready, and support the reporting timelines of a listed company.

**Mandatory: hands-on working experience in BOTH Tally (TallyPrime / Tally ERP 9) and Zoho Books. Applications without both will not be considered.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting & Books**

* Record sales, purchase, journal, payment and receipt entries in Tally and Zoho Books; maintain ledgers, debtors and creditors.
* Carry out bank, vendor and customer reconciliations; keep balances in both systems accurate and matched.
* Close the books every month by the agreed deadline; prepare year-end closing schedules.
* Verify vendor bills against POs, GRNs and approvals before payment; track payables and receivables ageing.

**GST, TDS & Compliance**

* Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B; reconcile GSTR-2B and track input tax credit.
* Generate e-invoices and e-way bills; ensure every invoice is GST-compliant.
* Handle TDS deduction, payment, quarterly returns (24Q/26Q) and Form 16/16A.
* Support income tax, advance tax and other statutory filings with our tax consultants.

**Reporting & Audit**

* Prepare monthly MIS, P&L, balance sheet schedules and cash-flow reports in Excel.
* Prepare audit schedules and coordinate with statutory, internal and tax auditors.
* Support half-yearly and annual financial results as per listed-company timelines.
* Maintain documentation and follow internal controls for every transaction.

**Team & Coordination**

* Guide junior accounts staff and review their entries.
* Work with sales, procurement, HR and operations on reconciliations and expense validation.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA (Finance). CA Inter / CMA Inter candidates are welcome.
* 3–6 years of hands-on accounting and tax compliance experience.
* **Tally (TallyPrime / ERP 9) and Zoho Books: both mandatory, with day-to-day working experience.**
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and income tax, with returns you have prepared and filed yourself.
* Strong Excel skills: Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS.
* Familiarity with Accounting Standards and general ledger operations.
* Experience in a listed or IPO-bound company, or handling books for more than one entity, is an advantage.

**What We Expect**

* High accuracy and attention to detail.
* Ownership of deadlines: closing, GST and TDS due dates are never missed.
* Integrity and confidentiality with financial data.
* Comfort working in a fast-growing company where priorities change quickly.

**Work Location**

Pune, on-site, full-time. Monday to Saturday, 9:30 am to 6:30 pm (2nd and 4th Saturdays off).

**Accounting Manager - APAC/APJ**
**What Your Impact Will Be.**
We are seeking a Manager, APAC Accounting to join our team at EDB, reporting directly to the Director, Assistant Controller. In this hands-on leadership role, you will lead our India-based APAC accounting team of three, supported by outsourced accounting providers in selected jurisdictions, and own accounting, month-end close and statutory compliance across EDB’s APAC entities. You will partner closely with the global Controllership team, Treasury Operations and our local advisors. This role offers broad regional ownership and close partnership with EDB’s global Finance leadership.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a qualified accountant who combines strong technical accounting and APAC statutory knowledge with the ability to lead and develop a team, and who brings a strong controls mindset to a fast-paced, growing, multi-entity company.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead, mentor and develop the APAC accounting team, setting priorities, managing performance and ensuring coverage and cross-training across entities.
* Oversee outsourced accounting providers in selected jurisdictions, ensuring accurate and timely delivery.
* Serve as the regional finance lead and escalation point for APAC accounting, partnering with senior leaders across functions.

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting
  
  

* Own the APAC month-end close across all entities, including journal review and approval, accruals, intercompany entries and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Own monthly PO and sales commission accruals, and prepare the workings for bonus, retention and cash awards.
* Review and approve payroll journal entries and reconciliations, and review APAC payroll payments prior to release.
* Prepare and review entity financial statements and monthly flux analysis, and support the group consolidation and financial reporting package.
* Calculate APAC entity funding requirements for Treasury Operations, and reconcile intercompany funding received at month-end.

Statutory Compliance & Tax
  
  

* Own the APAC entity compliance calendar, covering statutory and tax audits, corporate income tax, GST/VAT, withholding tax, payroll and secretarial filings, coordinating local advisors to meet every deadline.
* Manage India-specific requirements, including SEZ/STPI, GST, TDS, ROC filings and transfer pricing documentation.
* Review and approve tax payments across the APAC entities prior to execution by Treasury Operations.
* Support tax and transfer pricing assessments and audits across the region.

Controls, Audit & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Maintain strong internal controls and segregation of duties across the region, certifying close checklists and reconciliations.
* Execute and document key internal controls for assigned processes, and coordinate external audit requests.
* Drive process improvement and standardization, championing automation and AI across the close.

**What You Will Bring.**
We are looking for candidates with the following qualifications:
  
  

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA.
* 7+ years of experience in accounting or controllership, including 2+ years leading a finance team.
* Strong multi-entity, multi-currency accounting and month-end close experience across APAC.
* Working knowledge of APAC statutory compliance and tax, with India essential and exposure to other APAC jurisdictions preferred.
* A strong internal controls mindset; SOX experience a plus.
* Advanced Excel skills; NetSuite and FloQast strongly preferred.
* Experience managing outsourced accounting providers preferred.
* Audit experience preferred, ideally Big 4, or experience in a US-headquartered multinational.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with flexibility to overlap with US and EMEA hours during close and audit.

title: Internal Control Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms. About the organization: www.skf.com/in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

**Role Title:**
Internal Control Manager

**Reports to:**
Head of Internal Control

**Role Type:**
Stakeholders Management

**Job Location:**
Chinchwad, Pune

Internal Control within Risk and Assurance is responsible for maintaining and enhancing the control environment across SKF Industrial to ensure accurate and reliable financial reporting.

As Internal Control Manager, you will support the Head of Internal Control and contribute to the development, implementation, and monitoring of internal control frameworks.

You will be part of a global team and collaborate closely with stakeholders across the organization.

**Mission**

The Internal Control function sets the strategy and direction for internal control over financial reporting in SKF Industrial.

As Internal Control Manager, you will help translate this strategy into operational execution, ensuring controls are effectively designed, implemented, and monitored.

You will support process development, risk-based control adaptation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aligned with policies, directives, and regulatory requirements.

****Main Activities And Responsibilities****

**As Internal Control Manager, your key responsibilities include:**

* Support the development and maintenance of group-wide internal control requirements
* Assist in the implementation and follow-up of controls across business processes
* Coordinate and execute internal control testing activities
* Contribute to the development and enhancement of the internal control framework and tool, ServiceNow IRM
* Monitor compliance with internal control policies and procedures
* Collaborate with process owners to ensure control design and effectiveness
* Participate in risk assessments and identify control gaps
* Prepare reports and updates for management and relevant committees
* Promote awareness and understanding of internal control principles across the organization
* Deliver training and guidance to stakeholders as needed
* Be part and contribute with internal control expertise in global and/or regional projects

**Critical competencies for the position**

You hold CA or CMA / MBA finance degree in finance and have at least 8 years of experience in Internal Control or Financial Reporting. Experience in an audit firm or a multinational organization is considered an advantage.

The preferred candidate has a solid background in both governance and hands-on execution within finance or accounting. You demonstrate strong collaboration skills and a supportive approach, and you are effective at building professional relationships across functions and geographies.

In this role, you will need a proactive mindset and experience working in both project-based and process-oriented environments. You are comfortable operating in a decentralized organization and bring a high level of integrity to your work.

To succeed, you are solution-oriented with a strong attention to detail and a focus on practical execution. You bring analytical thinking, problem-solving capabilities, and a can-do attitude. Strong communication skills are essential, including the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders at various levels, in both written and spoken English.

Interested candidate/s can share their resume to
**hema.chaudhary@skf.com**

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.
