title: Accountant
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Accountant
  
  
**Overview**
About Mastercard
  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven Accountant to lead and manage the accounting operations within our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of accounting activities, supporting both corporate and statutory reporting requirements.
  
  
This position primarily involves (but not limited to) managing Cash Accounting, Reconciliations and Month-end closing for Mastercard entities worldwide, and may further evolve for managing complex accounting with greater responsibilities.
  
  
This role involves collaboration with international stakeholders and various cross-functional teams to manage daily accounting operations, address queries, and implement continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for preparing and reviewing General Ledger reconciliations and journal entries as part of month-end close activities.
* Review Cash and sub-ledger transactions, perform foreign exchange (FX) analysis, and variance analysis to support accurate financial adjustments.
* Understand the financial impacts and intricate accounting treatments, ensuring strict compliance with regulations, laws, and reporting standards.
* Support reporting activities preparing various reports, scorecards and dashboards etc.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and handles process improvements, escalations, and BAU tasks.
* Support internal and external audits, including SOX compliance, and contribute to strengthening control frameworks
* Identify process gaps, assess and mitigate risks, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
* Independently determines complexity of issues, escalates and makes recommendations to leadership.
* Support the business partner relationship and applies a client-service mentality by addressing ad-hoc requests and queries effectively.
* Manage special projects and initiatives, including entity transitions, process improvements, and new acquisitions.
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness.

**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; MBA, CA, CA Inter or equivalent certification preferred.
* 4+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1 years in Cash accounting role.
* Strong understanding of subledger and controlling accounts for Cash, AP, AR, Intercompany etc
* Strong technical expertise in accounting operations, including GL management, reconciliations, and close processes.
* Fair knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Proficiency in Oracle systems is must
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical, problem-solving skills and learning agility
* Strong commitment to customer service excellence, featuring a customer-centric mindset
* Good understanding of MS Excel (Knowledge in PowerBI/Power Automate is beneficial)
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job Description**
Ecolab is seeking a Billing Analyst supporting our Global Business Services team in Pune, India. This role will operate in a UK shift.
  
  
The Billing department is responsible for ensuring sales orders and contracted services are billed in a timely and accurate manner. This department’s responsibility includes daily review and resolution of blocked sales orders, processing of documents blocked from posting to accounting, set-up of new list pricing, set-up of campaigns per direction of marketing, and execution of all SOX controls tied to pricing and corrections.
  
  
The primary objective of the Billing Analyst is to execute the daily invoice audit to ensure all invoices generated were distributed and accurate, review and resolve errors identified on the VFX3 report, and maintain and set-up list pricing and campaigns. This position has a high level of responsibility in ensuring SOX controls are executed effectively, pricing and campaigns are set-up accurately and timely and acting as the subject matter expert for billing processes. The Billing Analyst is expected to embrace the Ecolab culture and ensure the billing department consistently meets service level agreements and timely revenue recognition
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Complete daily invoice audit to ensure invoices are accurate and distributed
* Ensure all appropriate approvals were obtained prior to processing corrections, and enter corrections based on department guidance
* Administer invoice updates and corrections for billing activities
* Provide expert insight into billing processes operational effectiveness
* Establish strong working relationships with division finance and CBC peers
* Perform problem solving analysis and implement corrective action when needed
* Prepare and maintain process documentation
* Compile and publish monthly activity tracking reporting
* Assist with validating RQF and list pricing uploads
* Provide prompt follow-up actions to internal and external inquiries and issues
* Respond timely to incoming communications
* Adhere to company and department policies and procedures

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, or related field
* Master’s Degree strongly preferred
* A minimum of 4 years of related experience
* Proficient in Microsoft Office application Excel
* Fluent in English
* Fluent in Spanish preferred

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
* Demonstrated problem solving ability to resolve problems independently and take appropriate action in a timely manner
* Previous analytical experience with high aptitude for research, analysis, and problemsolving.

A trusted partner for millions of customers,

Building on a century of innovation, Ecolab has annual sales of $14 billion, employs more than 47,000 associates and operates in more than 170 countries around the world. The company delivers comprehensive science-based solutions, data-driven insights and world-class service to advance food safety, maintain clean and safe environments, and optimize water and energy use. Ecolab’s innovative solutions improve operational efficiencies and sustainability for customers in the food, healthcare, life sciences, hospitality and industrial markets. www.ecolab.com

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior Accountant
  
  
**Job Description**
Role: Senior Accountant
  
  
**About Mastercard**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and results-driven Senior Accountant to lead and manage the accounting operations within our Global Business Solutions (GBS) organization. This role will play a critical part in ensuring the accuracy, timeliness, and compliance of accounting activities, supporting both corporate and statutory reporting requirements.
  
  
This position primarily involves (but not limited to) managing Daily Cash Accounting, Reconciliations and Month-end closing for Mastercard entities worldwide, and may further evolve for managing complex accounting with greater responsibilities.
  
  
This role involves collaboration with international stakeholders and various cross-functional teams to manage daily accounting operations, address queries, and implement continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Responsible for preparing and reviewing General Ledger reconciliations and journal entries as part of month-end close activities.
* Review Cash and sub-ledger transactions, perform foreign exchange (FX) analysis, and variance analysis to support accurate financial adjustments.
* Understand the financial impacts and intricate accounting treatments, ensuring strict compliance with regulations, laws, and reporting standards.
* Support reporting activities preparing various reports, scorecards and dashboards etc.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and handles process improvements, escalations, and BAU tasks.
* Support internal and external audits, including SOX compliance, and contribute to strengthening control frameworks
* Identify process gaps, assess and mitigate risks, and implement improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
* Independently determines complexity of issues, escalates and makes recommendations to leadership.
* Support the business partner relationship and applies a client-service mentality by addressing ad-hoc requests and queries effectively.
* Manage special projects and initiatives, including entity transitions, process improvements, and new acquisitions.
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness.

**All About You**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; MBA, CA, CA Inter or equivalent certification preferred.
* 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 2 years in Cash accounting role.
* Strong understanding of subledger and controlling accounts for Cash, AP, AR, Intercompany etc
* Strong technical expertise in accounting operations, including GL management, reconciliations, and close processes.
* Fair knowledge of GAAP, IFRS, and statutory reporting requirements.
* Proficiency in Oracle systems is must
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with learning agility
* Strong commitment to customer service excellence, featuring a customer-centric mindset
* Thorough understanding of MS Excel (Knowledge in PowerBI/Power Automate is beneficial)
* Drive usage of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automations for process efficiencies and effectiveness
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

**Job Title**
Manager - Finance
  
  
**Job Description Summary**
Manager- Finance
  
  
**Job Description**

* Track all project invoices from raising to payment, and maintain an updated status report (raised, submitted, approved, pending, paid).

description:
**Job Title:**
Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis
  
  
**Location:**
Noida
  
  
**About Springer Nature Group**
Springer Nature opens the doors to discovery for researchers, educators, clinicians and other professionals. Every day, around the globe, our imprints, books, journals, platforms and technology solutions reach millions of people. For over 180 years our brands and imprints have been a trusted source of knowledge to these communities and today, more than ever, we see it as our responsibility to ensure that fundamental knowledge can be found, verified, understood and used by our communities – enabling them to improve outcomes, make progress, and benefit the generations that follow.
  
  
Visit group.springernature.com and follow @SpringerNature /@SpringerNatureGroup
  
  
**About The Brand**
Macmillan Education provides world-class content in the most relevant, engaging and flexible formats to support students, teachers and institutions in lifelong learning. Visit macmillaneducation.com and follow @MacmillanEducation / @MacmillanELT
  
  
**About The Role**
As Finance Manager, you will serve as a strategic business partner to senior leadership, driving financial planning, commercial decision support, and business performance across Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and corporate functions. The role combines FP&A, commercial finance, business partnering, and financial analysis, requiring strong financial acumen, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to translate complex financial insights into actionable business outcomes.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role offering the opportunity to influence growth strategy, evaluate new products and business initiatives, and lead finance transformation efforts while partnering closely with the CFO, Managing Director, and cross-functional leaders to drive profitability and sustainable business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Finance**

* Lead the annual and quarterly planning processes, working closely with functional and business leaders, demonstrating strong stakeholder management, strategic mindset, and effective communication skills.
* Partner with functional heads to understand the key business drivers behind financial performance, leveraging business insights, consulting skills, and financial acumen.
* Analyse historical performance and develop forward-looking insights to support management decisions, utilizing data analytics, quantitative skills, and a strategic mindset.
* Own monthly financial reviews and provide insightful analysis of actuals vs. plan, trends, risks, and opportunities through strong financial acumen, business insights, and data analytics capabilities.
* Prepare high-quality financial analysis and management information for the CFO, MD, and senior leadership team, communicating complex financial matters effectively through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and stakeholder management.
* Support strategic and ad hoc business analysis as required, applying business insights, financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a global perspective where relevant.

**Commercial Finance & Revenue Planning**

* Lead the planning process for annual and quarterly revenue/sales plans in partnership with the National Sales Head, CFO, and MD, balancing stakeholder expectations while applying financial modelling, strategic mindset, and financial acumen.
* Understand sales trends, market dynamics, product performance, and commercial drivers through strong business insights, data analytics, and a global perspective.
* Provide financial insights to help leadership identify growth opportunities and emerging risks, utilizing financial acumen, strategic thinking, and consulting skills.
* Analyse profitability and margins across products, customers, and business segments using financial modelling, data analytics, and quantitative skills.
* Support management in making data-driven commercial decisions through robust financial analysis, business insights, consulting skills, and effective stakeholder engagement.

**Finance Partner to the Publishing Business**
This is where the role gets particularly interesting. Work closely with the Publishing and Editorial teams to:
  
  

* Lead the annual planning process for Publishing Plans and Editorial Budgets, applying financial acumen, stakeholder management, and a strategic mindset.
* Evaluate the financial viability of new products and publishing initiatives using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and strong business insights.
* Drive feasibility analysis across products, verticals, and business opportunities through quantitative analysis, financial modelling, and strategic thinking.
* Analyse production economics, costs, and margins leveraging financial acumen, data analytics, and business insights.
* Own Gross Margin analysis, including identifying and explaining key drivers and variances through strong quantitative skills, financial analysis, and effective communication.
* Support decisions around product investments, pricing, volumes, and profitability using financial modelling, valuation methodologies, and a strategic mindset.
* Act as the finance partner who connects creative/publishing decisions with commercial outcomes through strong consulting skills, stakeholder management, business insights, and effective communication.

**Author & Content Economics**

* Act as the Finance SPOC for the Author Engagement Programme, building trusted relationships through strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Manage financial aspects relating to author royalties and contracts, applying financial acumen, quantitative skills, and sound commercial judgment.
* Analyse royalty structures and their impact on product economics and margins through data analytics, financial modelling, and business insights.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure commercial and financial considerations are incorporated into author/content decisions, leveraging consulting skills, stakeholder management, and effective communication.

**Process Excellence & Finance Transformation**

* Identify opportunities to make commercial finance processes simpler, faster, and more effective through business insights, data analytics, and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Develop and implement robust finance processes across business functions, balancing stakeholder requirements while demonstrating strong consulting skills and stakeholder management.
* Drive standardisation and consistency in financial processes and reporting through strong financial acumen, communication skills, and process discipline.
* Develop a strong understanding of financial reporting systems and data architecture, leveraging data analytics, quantitative skills, and a global perspective on best practices.
* Ensure accuracy and integrity of financial information, including cross-charges and recharges, through strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and analytical rigor.
* Look for opportunities to improve reporting, analytics, and decision-support capabilities using data analytics, business insights, and financial modelling techniques.

**Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management**

* Become the Finance face and SPOC for business and functional leaders, demonstrating exceptional stakeholder management, consulting skills, and communication effectiveness.
* Build strong relationships across Finance, Sales, Publishing, Editorial, and other functions by effectively balancing stakeholder needs and fostering collaboration.
* Be comfortable working across different levels of the organisation, including senior management, demonstrating strong communication skills, business partnering capability, and a global perspective.
* Challenge constructively, influence decisions, and bring a commercial finance perspective to business discussions through strong consulting skills, strategic mindset, financial acumen, and business insights.

*At Springer Nature, our mission is to be part of progress – and that begins with inclusion: of people, perspectives, and ideas. We believe that diverse perspectives drive progress, and we are committed to creating an environment where people and ideas can flourish. If you have any access needs related to disability, neurodivergence or a chronic condition, please contact us so we can make all necessary accommodation.*

description:
About Kanpeki: Kanpeki is an Indian professional care brand offering skin, hair, home care and pedicure solutions, along with a newly launched derma and aesthetic range. We serve salons, clinics and professionals in India and across international markets.

1. Role Purpose - The Associate Business Analyst will turn Kanpeki's sales, market and operational data into clear insights that help leadership make faster, better decisions. Working closely with the Sales Head and the domestic and international sales teams, the role will track performance, identify growth opportunities and support planning across India and export markets.
2. This role suits an analytical, detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with numbers and can explain what the data means in simple business terms.

Key Responsibilities

1. 1. Sales and Performance Analysis
2. Track and analyse sales performance by product, category, territory, channel and country.
3. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports and sales dashboards for management.
4. Monitor sales against targets and highlight gaps, trends and risks early.
5. Analyse team and distributor performance to support target setting and incentive calculations.
6. 2. Market and Competitor Research
7. Research market size, customer segments and growth opportunities in India and international markets.
8. Track competitor products, pricing, promotions and positioning across the professional salon, derma and aesthetics segments.
9. Support market-entry assessments for new countries and channels.
10. 3. Business Planning and Forecasting
11. Support annual and quarterly sales planning, budgeting and target setting.
12. Build demand forecasts by product and market to support production and inventory planning.
13. Analyse pricing, margins and product profitability, and recommend improvements.
14. Evaluate the impact of schemes, discounts and promotional campaigns.

Process and Requirement Analysis

1. Map current sales, order and reporting processes and identify inefficiencies.
2. Gather business requirements from sales, marketing and operations teams, and document them clearly.
3. Support the setup and adoption of CRM, ERP and reporting tools.
4. Help standardise data collection and reporting formats across the domestic and international teams.
5. 5. Insights and Communication
6. Convert data into concise insights, presentations and recommendations for leadership.
7. Prepare business review decks for internal meetings and key partners.
8. Respond to ad-hoc data and analysis requests from management.
9. Qualifications and Skills
10. Essential
11. Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Economics, Statistics, Engineering or a related field.
12. 1–3 years of experience in business analysis, sales analytics, MIS or a similar role.
13. Advanced MS Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and charts.
14. Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with high attention to detail.
15. Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to present findings simply.
16. Ability to manage multiple requests and meet deadlines.

Preferred

1. MBA or PGDM in Marketing, Business Analytics or Finance.
2. Experience in FMCG, cosmetics, personal care, salon or pharmaceutical businesses.
3. Working knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, Google Looker Studio or SQL.
4. Exposure to CRM or ERP systems such as Zoho, Salesforce, SAP or Tally.
5. Understanding of export markets, distributor models or B2B sales.

Ideal Candidate Profile

1. **Numbers-driven:**
    comfortable working with large datasets and spotting what matters.
2. **Business-minded:**
    understands how sales, pricing and distribution drive revenue and margin.
3. **Clear communicator:**
    turns analysis into simple, actionable recommendations.
4. **Curious:**
    asks why the numbers moved, not just what moved.
5. **Organised and reliable:**
    delivers accurate reports on time, every time.
6. **Collaborative:**
    works easily with sales teams in India and international markets.

title: Finance Analyst- Global Record to Report
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Join us as we embark on a journey to transform BCG’s Finance organization. “Future Finance” is a multi-year journey to prepare the Finance function for the BCG of the future: a BCG that continues to grow, and one that has become more complex, more diverse and more interdependent. By rethinking structures and standardizing processes across geographies and business entities, we will make it simpler and more efficient to work together and flex to meet the needs of BCG.

As a part of the Global Finance & Operations Services team, you will support and deliver on day-to-day activities in the Record-to-Report (RTR) function including finance & accounting management process of collecting, processing, consolidating, closing and reporting on relevant, timely and accurate information used to provide financial, strategic and operational feedback which aids in decision making process. You should have experience in financial accounting and reporting, revenue accounting. fixed assets and lease accounting, intercompany accounting, accrual/prepaid accounting and reconciliations, month end/year end close, accounting systems and procedures, consolidation of financials, audit controls and governance etc. Your key stakeholders will include various internal BCG functions and the local finance teams located in multiple geographies.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Master accounting principles and financial systems, manage data flow, consolidation processes, and system hierarchies.
* Support Financial statement and related schedule preparation for Indian Legal entity.
* Support Indirect tax activities.
* Execute monthly accounting tasks, including revenue and expense recording, ledger management, accruals, and journal entries, ensuring compliance with relevant standards.
* Review and reconcile financial statements, focusing on consolidation, accruals, and variance analysis.
* Reconcile balance sheet and expense accounts according to BCG policies.
* Collaborate with IT and finance teams to resolve month-end system issues.
* Maintain strong internal controls and support the development of accounting procedures.
* Work independently, handle ad hoc requests, and contribute to key projects.
* Assist the team in developing and documenting accounting procedures to ensure a seamless monthly, quarterly, and annual close process.
* Actively participate in organization-wide projects and initiatives, contributing effectively to their success.

What You'll Bring

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in accounting or finance or CA, with experience and strong interest in accounting concepts.
* 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial accounting and reporting, fixed assets and lease accounting, accrual/prepaid accounting and reconciliations, month end/year end close, accounting systems and procedures, consolidation of financials, audit controls and governance etc.
* Prior experience in taxation would be preferred.
* Must be able to perform successfully in a fast-paced, intellectually intense, service-oriented environment and to interpret rules and guidelines flexibly to enhance the business and in keeping with BCG’s values and culture.
* Willingness to provide a wide range of financial services from routine tasks to intricate financial management data
* Oracle experience a plus (GL, Fixed Assets and AP), Hyperion, SAP Business Objects, MS Access and other comparable ERP systems experience preferred
* MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word proficiency and adaptable to different software applications
* Advanced Excel skills and/or experience with other analytical tools (such as Tableau, Alteryx, etc.) will be added advantage.

Who You'll Work With

We pride ourselves on a collaborative working environment and utilize digital tools to foster that collaborative environment across a global company. The Global Finance Operations Centre aims at providing best in-class operational excellence and execution through partnership, building trust and credibility. It provides a foundation to ensuring smooth finance operations, coordinating change and ensuring performance of individual processes with high service levels.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT:**

* Proficiency in Excel, including complex spreadsheet and database management.
* Ability to analyze and synthesize data from multiple perspectives.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful in cross-validating results.
* Strong judgment, initiative, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and detail-oriented, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, effective in both independent and team settings.
* Proven ability to prioritize and perform under pressure.
* Experience in matrix-structured organizations and driving process improvements.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Derivative Pricing Analyst
description:
Job Description

**Job Summary**

Evalueserve is seeking a highly motivated Senior Quantitative Developer (5-8 years' experience) to support the development, validation, governance, and enhancement of quantitative pricing models and libraries. The role combines quantitative finance, development, requiring strong expertise in C++, option pricing methodologies, and pricing library development. The successful candidate will work closely with teams to implement validation frameworks, strengthen model governance, and drive automation initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance quantitative pricing libraries and model infrastructure using Python/C++.
* Implement model validation tests, benchmarking frameworks, and control processes to support model governance requirements.
* Prepare and maintain model documentation, technical specifications, validation evidence, and governance deliverables.
* Review and uplift existing pricing libraries to align with internal model risk, control, and governance standards.
* Support the validation and testing of pricing models across derivatives and structured products.
* Analyze model behavior, investigate discrepancies, and assist in the resolution of model-related issues.
* Automate manual processes and develop tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability of quantitative workflows.
* + Participate in code reviews, testing, and deployment activities to ensure production-quality deliverables.
* Contribute to continuous improvements in quantitative development standards, documentation, and validation frameworks.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Quantitative Finance, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Senior Quant Developer: 5-8 years of experience in quantitative development, model validation, or pricing library development within investment banking or financial services.
* Strong programming skills in C++, with experience working on quantitative libraries and pricing systems.
* Solid understanding of option pricing methodologies and derivatives valuation techniques.
* Experience with model testing, validation, benchmarking, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment involving quant, technology, and business stakeholders.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for professionals with sound working knowledge in Indian transfer pricing regulations and international tax law matters.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
The primary area of focus for this position is ensuring transfer pricing compliances (amongst other corporate tax compliances as well), compiling information and drafting submissions for defending tax litigation for the group of entities, visiting income-tax department to represent before the transfer pricing officer in relation to any transfer pricing litigation matters, working on APA and other advisory related work. * Preparing submissions/appeals/letters in relation to transfer pricing litigation, appearing before the tax authorities, preparation of supporting work papers for transfer pricing related matters
* Coordinating with Auditors for Annual Statutory Audit / Tax Audit and other Internal Audit requirements.

* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.

**Capital Market/Treasury Implementation Consultant**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets/Treasury Implementation Consultant (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, post-trade operations, and technology transformation. The role involves supporting end-to-end delivery of platform implementation and modernization initiatives across trade confirmations, settlements, securities processing, treasury operations, and regulatory reporting. The consultant will work closely with business, operations, risk, and technology stakeholders to design, configure, test, deploy, and stabilize solutions across Capital Markets and Treasury ecosystems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in the implementation, enhancement, and modernization of Capital Markets and Treasury platforms.
* Support business and technology workstreams across platform configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and production stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams to deliver transformation programs.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solutions.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and gap assessments to identify platform configuration and customization requirements.
* Support trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, accounting, and reporting.
* Assist with system integrations using industry-standard interfaces and messaging protocols.

* Prepare project documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and test artifacts.
* Participate in Agile or Waterfall project delivery methodologies and contribute to project governance activities.
* Guide junior team members and support successful workstream execution.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Capital Markets & Treasury Domain Knowledge
* Strong understanding of Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, and Post-Trade Operations.
* Knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, matching, settlements, accounting, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Experience in trade confirmations, settlement processing, securities operations, SSI management, exception handling, and counterparty management.
* Understanding of operational controls, regulatory reporting, reconciliation processes, and settlement fail management.
* Experience across one or more asset classes including:


+ Foreign Exchange (FX)
+ Fixed Income
+ Equities
+ Money Markets
+ Derivatives (Futures, Swaps, Options)

**Platform & Implementation Experience**

* 5-8 years of experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, supporting, or integrating Capital Markets and Treasury platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+/Fusion Kondor
+ Finastra Fusion
+ SunGard Treasury
+ Broadridge Gloss
+ Fidessa
+ MarkitSERV
+ Summit
+ Or equivalent Treasury and Capital Markets platforms

* Experience supporting large-scale transformation, implementation, or modernization programs.
* Ability to conduct gap analysis between business requirements and standard platform capabilities.

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Java, Python, PL/SQL, .NET, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent databases.
* Unix/Linux shell scripting experience.
* Understanding of enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, XML, MQ, and messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of financial market connectivity standards including SWIFT MT/MX, FIX, ISO 20022, and settlement interfaces.
* Exposure to DevOps, release management, deployment processes, and environment management.
* Experience supporting system integrations, data reconciliations, and operational issue resolution.

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to propose scalable, configuration-driven solutions.
* Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect triage, and production validation.
* Ability to review test cases and collaborate with QA and testing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong communication and client-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and mentor junior consultants.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience with market infrastructure and utility platforms such as SWIFT, DTCC, Omgeo CTM, Traiana, MarkitSERV, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of valuation, pricing, risk management, VaR, P&L, and treasury operations workflows.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant financial markets certification is advantageous.
* 5-8 years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury Technology, Post-Trade Operations, or Financial Services technology implementation.
* Experience working with banks, broker-dealers, custodians, market infrastructure providers, treasury functions, or financial institutions.
* Proven track record of contributing to Capital Markets or Treasury transformation and implementation programs.

title: Category Associates in Chennai, Coimbatore, Kochi
description:

As we continue to grow into new markets and strengthen existing ones, we’re hiring category associates across 2 locations: Kochi and Coimbatore.

About Company: Urban Company, originally launched as UrbanClap in November 2014 by Abhiraj Bhal, Raghav Chandra, and Varun Khaitan, aimed to transform the disorganized and offline home services industry. title: Senior Associate - Resource Management
description:
**Position Summary**
The Senior Associate, Resource Management supports staffing, scheduling, capacity planning, workforce analytics, and resource optimization activities for the India Tax practice. This role works closely with the Manager, Talent Optimization and Tax leadership to facilitate effective resource deployment, monitor capacity and utilization, support staffing decisions, and maintain accurate workforce data.
  
  
The Senior Associate serves as a key contributor to workforce planning efforts by providing reporting, analysis, and operational support to help ensure resources are aligned with business demands while supporting employee development, engagement objectives, and operational excellence across U.S. and India teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Scheduling & Staffing Support**

* Support the scheduling of tax professionals across multiple industries within the India Tax team.
* Assist with processing staffing requests and ensuring schedules remain accurate, current, and aligned with business needs.
* Monitor resource availability, capacity, PTO, training, and other scheduling commitments.
* Identify potential scheduling conflicts, capacity constraints, or workload imbalances and communicate findings to the Manager, Talent Optimization.
* Assist with work transitions, reassignments, and workload balancing activities as directed.
* Maintain accurate staffing information in scheduling tools, trackers, reports, and workforce planning systems.

**Capacity, Utilization & Workforce Analytics**

* Prepare and analyze capacity, utilization, staffing, and availability reports for leadership review.
* Track employee availability, chargeable hour projections, and scheduled commitments to support workforce visibility.
* Monitor schedule changes and ensure updates are reflected in timely reporting systems.
* Identify trends in staffing, utilization, and resource availability and communicate insights to support decision-making.
* Support data validation efforts to improve reporting accuracy, workforce visibility, and data integrity.
* Assist in workforce planning activities by monitoring forecasted workload, resource demand, and skill requirements.
* Provide scheduling, utilization, and capacity-related information as requested by management.

**Coordination & Stakeholder Communication**

* Serve as a resource for routine scheduling inquiries from team members, managers, and engagement teams.
* Coordinate with U.S. and India Tax teams to gather staffing information, scheduling updates, and resource needs.
* Build effective working relationships with U.S. and India leadership teams to support resource deployment decisions.
* Facilitate communication regarding staffing conflicts, priorities, workload balancing, and schedule changes.
* Escalate staffing concerns, scheduling issues, or capacity risks to the Manager, Talent Optimization when appropriate.

**Process & Administrative Support**

* Follow established scheduling procedures, guidelines, and best practices.
* Assist with maintaining scheduling documentation, process materials, and training resources.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance scheduling efficiency, reporting quality, and data accuracy.
* Participate in team meetings, scheduling calls, capacity review exercises, and workforce planning discussions.
* Assist with onboarding and training activities related to scheduling tools, reporting processes, and resource management procedures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, Accounting, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, or related fields.
* 2-4 years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, professional services operations, project coordination, or related discipline.
* Experience in a CPA firm, tax practice, public accounting, or professional services environment preferred.
* Strong Excel and reporting skills, including pivot tables, data analysis, and report preparation.
* Experience with resource management, workforce planning, scheduling, ERP, or reporting platforms; Microsoft Dynamics or similar systems preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, organization, critical thinking, and follow-through.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across teams and levels.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and shift business needs in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify issues, summarize findings, and support practical solutions.

**Core Competencies**
Resource Coordination
  
  
Relationship Management
  
  
Schedule Management
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Capacity Planning & Tracking
  
  
Business Acumen
  
  
Workforce Analytics
  
  
Time Management
  
  
Operational Support
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Data Accuracy & Reporting
  
  
Adaptability
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Accuracy and integrity of staffing, scheduling, and workforce planning data.
* Timely and effective processing of staffing requests and schedule updates.
* Quality, reliability, and usefulness of capacity, utilization, and availability reporting.
* Proactive identification and communication of capacity constraints, staffing risks, and workload imbalances.
* Responsiveness to scheduling inquiries and ability to support timely decision-making.
* Effective support of workload balancing, resource deployment, and staffing processes across U.S. and India teams.
* Positive stakeholder feedback from leadership, managers, and engagement teams.
* Contribution to improved scheduling efficiency, utilization of visibility, and resource management processes.

title: Power BI Developer
description:
One of our clients, a growing technology solutions and IT services organization, is looking for an experienced Power BI Developer to design and develop interactive dashboards and reports, transform complex data into meaningful business insights, and support data-driven decision-making.

**Experience :**
3-5 years

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

• Reports & Dashboards: Independently design Power BI Desktop reports and Service dashboards; translate requirements into agreed KPIs, intuitive visualizations, and self-service analytics.

• Data & Modeling: Transform and integrate data using SQL and Power Query/M; build star-schema semantic models, reusable DAX measures, and consistent business definitions.

• Security & Releases: Implement row-level security, configure gateways and scheduled refresh, and manage testing and deployment pipelines within established access and release controls.

• Quality & Performance: Tune DAX, queries, models, and report performance; troubleshoot refresh failures, reconcile results, and maintain data quality, lineage, and governance documentation.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Gather requirements with U.S.-based stakeholders, estimate work, coordinate user acceptance testing, document solutions, and support adoption with business and data teams.

• AI-Assisted Development: Use approved AI-assisted tools to draft DAX/M, troubleshoot, document solutions, and explore insights; validate results and protect client data.

**REQUIREMENTS**

Experience ranges are indicative; equivalent demonstrated capability will be considered.

• Required - Experience: Typical range: 3-5 years in BI/reporting, including 3+ years of hands-on Power BI development. Demonstrate independent delivery from requirements through transformation, modeling, visualization, deployment, and support.

• Required - Core Skills: Strong Power BI Desktop/Service, DAX, Power Query/M, SQL, and star-schema modeling; practical experience with row-level security, gateways, refresh, deployment pipelines, and performance tuning.

• Required - Working Style: Ability to validate business metrics, manage delivery commitments, apply data quality/governance practices, and communicate clearly with U.S.-based stakeholders and distributed teams.

• Preferred - Azure & Fabric: Experience with one or more of the following is a strong plus: Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Lakehouse, semantic models).

• Preferred - Integration & Certification: API/data-source integration (REST, JSON, authentication) is a plus. PL-300 certification is preferred; equivalent practical experience is welcomed.

title: Senior Privacy Analyst – DSAR & Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Privacy Operations Analyst drives the day-to-day execution of the company’s global privacy compliance program, spanning UK/EU, US, APAC, and other regions in which the business operates. This role goes beyond individual task execution to own program-level activities: coordinating data subject rights requests, running and reporting on privacy risk assessments, maintaining data mapping and records of processing activities (ROPA), and using work-management and privacy automation tooling (e.g., Azure DevOps/Jira, OneTrust, Power Automate) to scale the privacy program’s operational cadence and reporting. The role partners closely with the Privacy Operations Lead, Legal, Information Security, and business stakeholders across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Privacy Program Management & Reporting
  
  

* Structure and maintain privacy operations work in Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar work-management tools, including custom work item types and fields mapped to privacy concepts (jurisdiction, data type, risk tier).
* Build and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting (e.g., DSAR SLA compliance, assessment backlog age, incident response times) for privacy program leadership, using ADO Analytics, Power BI, or similar tools.
* Track cross-functional privacy work items that depend on Legal, Security, and Product teams, and proactively surface bottlenecks and at-risk items.
* Coordinate responses to data subject access requests (DSARs) and other data subject rights requests, ensuring timely resolution within statutory timelines across jurisdictions.
* Track and report on privacy program metrics and KPIs for leadership and relevant stakeholders.

Privacy Risk Assessments
  
  

* Conduct and document privacy impact assessments (PIAs), data protection impact assessments (DPIAs), and transfer impact assessments (TIAs) for new products, features, and vendor engagements.
* Support automated assessment workflows that trigger and assign PIAs/DPIAs based on risk-based conditional logic (data type, processing purpose, jurisdiction, vendor risk tier), escalating high-risk triggers for senior review.
* Support efforts to reduce manual effort in assessment scoring and risk rating, applying sound judgment on what can be automated versus what must remain human-reviewed.

Data Mapping & ROPA Maintenance
  
  

* Maintain and update the company’s records of processing activities (ROPA), tying outputs directly to data mapping and risk assessment findings.
* Support data discovery and data flow mapping efforts across the organization’s systems, environments, and third-party integrations, leveraging data discovery tooling where available.
* Support an ongoing ownership and maintenance model for the data map/ROPA, including monitoring for drift as systems or vendors change and reconciling against discovery tool outputs.

Privacy Compliance & Risk Management
  
  

* Monitor and track changes in privacy regulations across jurisdictions, and support compliance with key regulations including UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable regimes.
* Support privacy incident response and breach notification processes, including incident documentation and breach register maintenance.
* Support privacy audits and assessments of internal processes and third-party vendors.

Privacy-by-Design & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Support the intake and triage of privacy-related inquiries from internal stakeholders and customers.
* Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, Product, and Business teams to support the integration of privacy-by-design principles into the product development cycle.
* Assist with privacy training content delivery and tracking across the business.
* Support vendor and partner reviews to ensure contractual privacy obligations are met, and help identify current sub-processors for contractual documentation updates.

Documentation & Governance
  
  

* Contribute to internal privacy policy, procedure, and operational playbook documentation.
* Maintain privacy metrics, dashboards, and reports for leadership and relevant stakeholders.
* Provide guidance and quality review to junior privacy operations team members on documentation and process adherence.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5-7 years of experience in a privacy, compliance, legal operations, or similar role, supporting a global or multi-jurisdictional privacy program.
* Working knowledge of UK GDPR/EU GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable global data subject rights frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with privacy management platforms (e.g., OneTrust, TrustArc) configuring or running DSAR, PIA/DPIA, and data mapping workflows.
* Experience using work-management tools (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira) to structure and track privacy operations work, including building reporting dashboards and KPIs for leadership.
* Exposure to or experience with automation of privacy workflows (e.g., Power Automate, API integrations between privacy platforms and ticketing systems) to reduce manual effort in DSAR, assessment, and data mapping processes.
* Understanding of data discovery and data mapping tooling and techniques to keep ROPA records current and minimize drift.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills; comfortable managing multiple deadlines across time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to brief stakeholders on program status and risk.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CIPP/E, CIPP/US, or CIPM certification, or actively pursuing.
* Experience building ADO/Jira custom work item types, boards, and Power BI or analytics dashboards for privacy KPI reporting.
* Experience with data discovery/classification tools (e.g., OneTrust Data Discovery, BigID, Collibra).
* Prior experience in a shared services, global operations, or multinational organization.
* Familiarity with basic scripting or low-code automation (e.g., Power Automate) to support privacy workflow automation.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across global teams and time zones
* Adaptability to changing regulatory landscapes
* Cultural sensitivity for working in a global environment
* Technical aptitude for understanding data flows, systems, and automation tooling

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. title: Manager - Legal Counsel
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
Provide sound and independent legal counsel and advice across corporate, commercial, contract, compliance, litigation and regulatory matters. Partner with business leaders and functions to identify legal risks, develop pragmatic solutions, and support the organization in achieving its business objectives while maintaining very high level of legal and compliance standards. Support the business as a strategic legal partner across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR, Finance and other functions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Legal Advisory & Business Partnering:**

* Provide day-to-day legal advice to business functions on operational, commercial, and strategic matters.
* Understand business requirements and provide practical legal solutions while identifying and mitigating legal and commercial risks.
* Partner with stakeholders across Operations, Technology, Purchasing, Sales & Marketing, HR and other functions on legal matters.
* Conduct and coordinate legal research on a variety of legal issues.

**Contracts & Commercial Matters**

* Draft, review, negotiate and finalize a variety of commercial contracts, NDAs, SLAs, and SOWs.
* Conduct due diligence reviews considering applicable global and local requirements, business complexity and organizational policies, with a focus on mitigating legal and commercial risk.
* Review commercial terms relating to purchase orders, invoices, letters of credit, bank guarantees, etc.

**Corporate, Compliance & Regulatory**

* Advise on applicable corporate, commercial, labour and other regulatory requirements.
* Strengthen legal compliance processes and support internal audits of legal documentation and processes.
* Provide compliance awareness trainings.
* Liaise with various regulatory authorities and respond to legal notices, regulatory queries, etc.

**Litigation & Dispute Management**

* Manage and coordinate civil, criminal, consumer, arbitration, product liability, service liability, IPR and labour-related disputes.
* Develop litigation strategy, coordinate with external counsel and support matters through investigation, documentation, negotiation and resolution.
* Draft/review legal notices, petitions and documents in consultation with management & external counsel.
* Ensure timely follow-up, effective case management and speedy resolution of disputes.
* Support litigation avoidance and legal risk minimization through stronger contracts, processes and preventive legal controls.

**Intellectual Property & Technology**

* Provide legal support on intellectual property, trademarks, technology-related matters, software licensing, IT services and digitalization initiatives.
* Review technology and digital business arrangements and advise on related legal and commercial risks.
* Provide legal guidance on new products, technologies, AI initiatives and digital transformation projects, coordinating with specialist teams where required.

**E-Legal / Legal Digitalization**

* Support implementation and effective use of legal digitalization tools.
* Review relevant checklists and coordinate with stakeholders for effective implementation.
* Identify opportunities to improve legal processes and systems, enabling effective compliance, efficient ways of working, and better coordination with internal teams.

**Data Privacy, AI & Cybersecurity**

* Design and implement Data Privacy and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) framework, with an understanding of GDPR and other applicable privacy frameworks.
* Draft, review and negotiate privacy-related clauses, agreements, notices and policies.
* Support data mapping, data retention, consent management, and cross-border data transfer reviews.
* Provide legal guidance on AI/Generative AI governance and associated legal or compliance risks, as well as new products, technologies and digital transformation initiatives.
* Understand cybersecurity / information security legal risks sufficiently to identify key legal implications, ask the right questions, and coordinate with specialist teams.
* Coordinate with IT, Cybersecurity, HR, Procurement and business teams on privacy and technology-related compliance initiatives.

Knowledge of handling assets and employee-related insurance matters, including insurance renewal requirements and claims support, will be an advantage.
  
  
**Who are you?**
You are a LLB or LLM from a leading University with 10–15 years of relevant legal experience, preferably with strong in-house legal exposure in a multinational, automotive, manufacturing and technology organization, including exposure to R&D environments. You can work independently, manage multiple priorities, and advise senior stakeholders with sound legal judgement under high-stress, time-critical conditions. You have strong capabilities in contracts, commercial law, corporate law, IPR, compliance, litigation, and legal risk management. Exposure to Data Privacy/DPDP, AI, and Cybersecurity related legal topics are an additional advantage. Excellent analytical, legal research and problem-solving skills with the capability to challenge status quo. You can take a firm stand, are a team player, maintain a positive and collaborative approach, and handle conflicts constructively. You have experience in a global organization and exposure to international stakeholders. You have very good written and oral communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex legal matters clearly and simply to business stakeholders. If you can read and write Kannada, it will be an added advantage.
  
  
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Group Legal & Compliance**
contributes to realizing the vision of the Volvo Group by coordinating and providing services within the following areas: Legal, Governance, Security and Internal Audit. With Volvo Group Legal & Compliance you will be part of a global and diverse team of highly skilled professionals who work with passion, trust each other and embrace change to stay ahead.

* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. **About Commvault**
Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

* Working knowledge of the technology sector, particularly SaaS, cloud services, and related vendor agreements.

title: Human Capital Management - Employee Relations - Vice President - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**OUR IMPACT**
As a division, Human Capital Management (HCM) is at the forefront of supporting business growth and change at Goldman Sachs by recruiting, developing, and rewarding the people of Goldman Sachs. Our teams advise, design, and implement strategies, processes, and technologies that help our people advance professionally, drive productivity, and help the firm and our clients achieve superior results. We look for individuals with strong problem solving and analytical skills, innovative thinking and intellectual curiosity who want to make an impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset, our people.
  
  
**THE EMPLOYEE RELATIONS (ER) TEAM**
The Employee Relations team, which is part of the Human Capital Management division, is dedicated to advising and coaching managers and employees on all aspects of the employment relationship. Working with managers and employees to prevent, advise and resolve challenging and complex workplace situations, the ER Advisor will work to protect and support the firm's culture in accordance with firm policies, our business principles, and applicable legal standards. The work is invariably of a sensitive nature and requires a unique combination of skills to deliver workable solutions on a diverse range of issues.
  
  
**YOUR IMPACT**
Are you looking for a new opportunity to showcase your employment relationship, performance management, disciplinary actions, and business restructurings skills? Do you have excellent communication, problem solving and leadership skills? We have an excellent position in the Human Capital Management (HCM) division’s Employee Relations function, located in the firms’ Bengaluru or Hyderabad Office.
  
  
You will be valued for your intellectual curiosity and your innovative approach to problem-solving. You will have direct impact on the success of the firm’s most valuable asset: Our people.
  
  
**How You Will Fulfill Your Potential**

* Handle HR investigations to confirm issues are solved in adherence to policies.
* Senior contact for disciplinary actions, escalations & issue remediation.
* Provide advice to managers regarding all aspects of the employment relationship, including performance management, disciplinary actions, terminations, and business restructurings.
* Investigate allegations of unfair or unlawful treatment and/or inappropriate behavior.
* Counsel individual employees regarding problems in the office and advising on health and personal issues that may impact work.
* Oversee adherence to firm policies regarding, among others, use of firm resources including e-mail and Internet access, protection of confidential information, etc.
* Oversee all terminations and implementation of severance policy.
* Assist in formulating, interpreting, and communicating policies that pertain to employee relations issues.
* Conduct training programs to educate employees about firm policies regarding employee relations issues.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel as necessary to resolve employee issues.
* Stabilize, motivate, bind teams create and uphold strong Goldman Sachs culture.

**Skills & Experience We’re Looking For**
Highly motivated HR professional or Employment Lawyer, with a solid understanding of employment issues and a proven track record of the following:
  
  

* 9+ years of relevant work experience in HR and Employee Relations
* Managing complex issues, identifying potential risk, and driving resolution
* Leveraging analytical, teamwork and project management skills to undertake thorough investigations.
* Ability to develop and build relationships at all levels, with a proven track record of acting in an advisory capacity.
* Developing and building effective relationships at all levels to advise and influence effectively.
* Bringing groups with diverse views/priorities to a common resolution through use of strong negotiation and facilitation skills
* Approaching issues strategically; anticipating consequences and navigating around unforeseen obstacles
* Listening actively and thinking creatively to deliver commercially pragmatic solutions and resolve conflicts.
* Ability to demonstrate approachability and empathy so that employees are comfortable raising concerns.
* Well-developed organizational and multi-tasking skills, with strong attention to detail

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html

Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer Female/Minority/Disability/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity

title: Sr. Manager - Paralegal
description:
**About**
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.
  
  
Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As Senior Manager, Paralegal, you lead the GBS Paralegal function within Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") GBS India Legal Center of Excellence, reporting to the Director of Legal. You own paralegal service delivery, setting standards that hold up across genuinely different subject matters while keeping day-to-day delivery consistent and dependable for Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance, and business stakeholders worldwide. This role calls for an experienced legal operations leader with strong people leadership, sharp organizational instincts and real depth across legal documentation, contract administration, entity governance and regulatory support.
  
  
FME is looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who can build a high-performing team from the ground up, push continuous improvement, and keep service quality high in a complex, multinational, tightly regulated environment.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
***Paralegal Leadership***

* Lead and manage the GBS Paralegal function, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across OHS, corporate/M&A, and litigation workstreams
* Set standards, policies, procedures and service-delivery models for paralegal activities that work across genuinely different subject matters without forcing artificial uniformity
* Build team capability, set operating priorities, and keep the function aligned with Global Legal Function objectives

***Corporate Governance & Entity Management Oversight***

* Oversee board and committee support activities - resolutions, minutes, governance documentation, statutory filings, ensuring accuracy and consistency
* Ensure corporate records are maintained accurately and in line with legal and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, company secretaries and local legal teams to support governance obligations across jurisdictions
* Monitor governance calendars and filing requirements across the entity portfolio

***Legal Documentation Oversight***

* Provide leadership and oversight for preparation, review, administration and maintenance of legal documentation across the paralegal team

***Compliance, Regulatory & Risk Support***

* Partner with Legal, Compliance, Privacy, Risk and Regulatory Affairs teams to support key compliance initiatives, including OHS regulatory matters
* Coordinate legal documentation and responses related to audits, investigations, regulatory inquiries and litigation support activities
* Support implementation of governance and compliance programmes across regions
* Identify operational risks across the paralegal function and put appropriate mitigation measures in place

***Process Excellence & Operational Improvement***

* Drive continuous improvement to lift service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction
* Maintain standard operating procedures, process maps, templates and playbooks across paralegal workstreams
* Monitor key performance indicators and service-delivery metrics for the function

***Knowledge Management & Legal Operations Support***

* Oversee legal knowledge repositories, templates and document management systems used by the paralegal team
* Ensure legal information is maintained, organized, accessible and properly governed
* Contribute to broader legal transformation initiatives and best-practice implementation led by the Director
* Promote knowledge sharing and operational consistency across the paralegal function

***Stakeholder Management***

* Build strong relationships with Legal leadership, Compliance, Finance, HR, Procurement, Internal Audit and business stakeholders
* Act as a trusted advisor on paralegal processes, governance matters and legal operational support requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, regulators, government authorities and third-party service providers where required

***People Leadership & Talent Development***

* Lead, coach and develop the team members
* Drive talent management, succession planning and employee engagement across the team
* Foster collaboration across the team's different workstreams and subject-matter areas
* Create an inclusive, supportive, high-performance team environment

**Our Requirements**
***Education***

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Legal Studies, Business Administration, Corporate Governance, or a related field

* Advanced degree or relevant professional certifications are an advantage

***Professional Experience***

* 10+ years of experience in Paralegal, Corporate Governance, Legal Operations, or related legal support functions
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing teams
* Extensive experience supporting multinational organizations in a complex regulatory environment
* Demonstrated experience in corporate governance, entity management, contract administration and legal documentation
* Experience within healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, medical technology, or other highly regulated industries preferred
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and operational excellence initiatives

**Leadership Competencies**

***Strategic Execution***
