title: Specialist – IP (Patents)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Specialist – IP (Patents) plays a critical role in supporting Haleon by providing high-quality intellectual property intelligence, analysis and strategic insight across the full innovation lifecycle for our R&D organisation and Cross Category IP issues and initiatives.
  
  
Working within the Legal function and under the direction of our Patent Attorneys, the role partners very closely with R&D stakeholders, including the Senior Directors, Platform Leads and Project Leads, to inform innovation, technology and partnering decisions. The role combines deep expertise in patent searching, information science and intelligence analysis with the ability to synthesise complex patent, scientific and commercial information into clear, actionable business and IP recommendations.
  
  
The Specialist – IP (Patents) supports the identification of innovation opportunities, assessment of external technologies and partners, development of IP strategies and roadmaps, and execution of patent protection and freedom-to-operate activities. The role is instrumental in helping Haleon make informed decisions about where to innovate, how to protect valuable innovations and how to manage intellectual property risks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Innovation Intelligence, White Space & Technology Insights**

* Proactively engage with scientists, innovation teams and project stakeholders to identify emerging technologies, concepts, invention opportunities and potential external partnerships at the earliest stages of development, ensuring IP opportunities, risks and strategic considerations are identified even before formal project briefs, invention disclosures or prototype designs are available.
* Develop and deliver patent landscapes, white space analyses and technology assessments to support innovation strategy and investment decisions.
* Identify emerging technologies, scientific developments, competitor activities and patent filing trends relevant to Haleon's strategic priorities.
* Conduct analyses to support "where-to-play" decisions for R&D programmes.
* Integrate patent, scientific, technical and commercial information to identify opportunities, risks and areas for strategic focus.
* Monitor evolving technology areas and provide regular intelligence updates to stakeholders.
* Translate complex datasets into concise, actionable recommendations for technical and business audiences.

**External Innovation & Partner Assessment**

* Support the evaluation of external innovation opportunities, including universities, start-ups, technology companies and other potential collaboration partners.
* Conduct IP due diligence and assess the strength, quality and strategic relevance of third-party patent portfolios.
* Identify opportunities, risks, ownership considerations and potential freedom-to-operate issues associated with prospective partnerships and licensing opportunities.
* Provide IP intelligence and analysis to support partnership, licensing and collaboration recommendations.

**IP Strategy Support**

* Provide analytical support to the Patent Attorney in the development of IP strategies and portfolio roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities for patent protection and portfolio development arising from R&D activities.
* Contribute to the assessment of potential IP risks and support the development of risk mitigation strategies.
* Support strategic decision-making through the delivery of evidence-based insights and recommendations.
* Help ensure alignment between innovation objectives, commercial priorities and IP strategy

**Patent Searching & Analytical Support**

* Design and execute sophisticated patent searches using a range of commercial and public databases.
* Conduct prior art, patentability, state-of-the-art, validity and invalidity searches.
* Analyse patent portfolios and competitor patent activity.
* Develop search methodologies and analytical frameworks to support complex research questions.
* Prepare clear reports and presentations communicating search findings and their commercial implications.

**Filing, Prosecution & Freedom-to-Operate Support**

* Support invention harvesting activities and facilitate invention disclosure generation across the innovation portfolio.
* Work directly with inventors and project teams to identify, capture and develop patentable inventions.
* Prepare patent application materials, invention summaries and supporting documentation for Patent Attorney review and filing.
* Support delivery of annual patent filing objectives through proactive identification and development of patent opportunities.
* Support the Patent Attorney in patent drafting, filing and prosecution activities as required.
* Conduct and support freedom-to-operate analyses and investigations.
* Assist with evidence gathering, prior art evaluation and technical analyses relevant to patent prosecution and portfolio management.
* Support ongoing portfolio reviews and maintenance activities.
* Contribute to IP risk assessments associated with research, development and commercialisation activities.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* The role will work across Legal and R&D, collaborating with a diverse network of stakeholders to provide timely and high-quality IP intelligence and support. Key stakeholders include:

**Legal**

* Patent Attorneys
* Members of the wider Legal and Intellectual Property teams

**Research & Development**

* Senior Directors, Platform Leads, Project Leads, Scientists, researchers and innovation teams.
* The successful candidate will be able to communicate complex IP concepts and analyses clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, influencing decisions through insight, evidence and sound judgement.

**Skills & Experience:**
**Essential**

* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Information Science, Library and Information Science, or another relevant scientific, technical or information management discipline.
* 5 - 7 years' experience in patent searching, patent information, IP intelligence or a related intellectual property role.
* Experience supporting front-end innovation, breakthrough innovation, technology development, technology scouting and/or early-stage R&D programmes.
* Demonstrated experience conducting patent landscapes, white space analyses and technology trend assessments.
* Experience supporting freedom-to-operate, patentability and prior-art analyses.
* Experience assessing patent portfolios and conducting IP due diligence.
* Proven ability to synthesise large and complex datasets into clear business-focused recommendations.
* Demonstrated experience applying information science principles and methodologies to the collection, organisation, analysis and synthesis of patent, scientific, technical and commercial information.
* Experience developing complex search strategies across multiple information domains and translating diverse datasets into actionable business intelligence.

**Preferred**

* Experience within FMCG, consumer health, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices or broader life sciences sectors.
* Experience supporting external innovation, licensing, collaboration or technology acquisition activities.
* Experience working closely with patent attorneys, scientists and senior innovation leaders.

**Technical Knowledge**

* Strong understanding of patent systems, patent searching methodologies and intellectual property principles.
* Expertise in developing and executing advanced search strategies across multiple information sources.
* Strong analytical and information science capabilities, including data gathering, interrogation and synthesis.
* Knowledge of patent portfolio analysis, competitor intelligence and technology trend assessment.
* Understanding of freedom-to-operate considerations and patent lifecycle management.
* Strong grounding in information science principles, including information retrieval, search strategy design, taxonomy development, knowledge organisation, analytical methodologies and insight generation.
* Ability to integrate and synthesise information from patent, scientific, technical and commercial sources to support strategic decision-making.

**Job Posting End Date**
2026-10-14
  
  
**Equal Opportunities**
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.
  
  
**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

Engineering
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**Product Compliance Engineer – Genset Compliance Management**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented
**Product Compliance Engineer**
to lead product safety and compliance management activities for generator set (Genset) products across countries in Rest of World (RoW - Europe, Middle-East, Africa, Asia Pacific, Australia-NZ and Latin America other than United States and Canada). This role is responsible for ensuring products meet all applicable regulatory, safety, and industry certification requirements.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the primary interface between the engineering organization and certification agencies in respective regions that could include UL, CSA, and other recognized certification and regulatory bodies, ensuring timely certification, maintenance of approvals, and resolution of compliance-related issues. The role requires close collaboration with Engineering, Sales, Operations, Quality, and external agencies to support product development, certification, and market access objectives.
  
  
This position also requires periodic travel to test laboratories and certification facilities to witness product testing, support certification activities, and ensure compliance requirements are met. In addition, the role will be responsible for establishing and continuously improving compliance management processes and governance frameworks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Compliance Management**

* Manage regulatory and compliance requirements for generator set products marketed in countries other than the United States and Canada.
* Knowledgeable in applicable standards, codes, and regulations relevant to gensets and associated electrical systems.
* Ensure products maintain compliance including new product development, product changes, and sustaining engineering activities.
* Monitor evolving regulatory and certification requirements and assess impact on products and business operations.

**Certification & Agency Management**

* Serve as the primary technical contact for certification agencies,

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Regulatory & Certification requirements covering the Machinery, EMC, RoHS & Noise Directives
+ Other certification, testing, and regulatory organizations as required

* Coordinate certification projects, audits, inspections, and follow-up activities.
* Manage certification documentation, test reports, technical files, and approval records.
* Drive timely closure of certification findings, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.

**Engineering Support**

* Provide compliance guidance to product development and engineering teams during design and development phases.
* Review product designs, drawings, specifications, and change requests for compliance impacts.
* Support root cause investigations and corrective actions related to compliance issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance requirements are incorporated into product designs.

**Regulatory Support & Consultation**

* Respond to compliance and regulatory inquiries from:

+ Engineering teams
+ Sales and commercial teams
+ Operations and manufacturing teams
+ Quality and service organizations

* Provide technical guidance on the application of standards and certification requirements.
* Support customer and regulatory compliance documentation requests.

**Testing & Validation**

* Coordinate compliance testing activities with internal teams and external laboratories.
* Develop test plans and compliance validation strategies.
* Travel to certification laboratories and test facilities to witness testing and represent the company during certification evaluations.
* Review and approve testing documentation and certification evidence.

**Process Development & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop, implement, and maintain compliance management processes, procedures, and governance models.
* Establish compliance metrics, reporting mechanisms, and tracking tools.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to improve compliance efficiency, reduce certification lead times, and improve product readiness.
* Support compliance training and awareness programs across the organization.

**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering / Power Generation, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* Master's Degree is preferred but not required.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience in product compliance, certification, regulatory engineering, or related technical roles.
* Experience with generator sets, power generation equipment, industrial electrical products, or similar engineered products preferred.
* Strong experience working with certification agencies and notified bodies for EU Regulatory certification. Working knowledge on RoHS, Outdoor Noise and other related EU Directives.
* Experience managing third-party testing and certification projects.
* Experience interpreting and applying Global product safety and compliance standards.

**Technical Skills (Top Skills Required)**
**Regulatory & Compliance Expertise**

* Strong knowledge of RoW product compliance requirements for electrical and power generation equipment.
* Ability to interpret and apply regulatory requirements and industry standards.

**Certification Management**

* Experience coordinating certifications with:

+ UL / CSA Group
+ EU Notified Bodies
+ Africa & Middle-East regulatory agencies
+ Nationally Recognized Testing Laboratories (NRTLs)
+ Certification and inspection bodies

**Product Safety Standards**

* Knowledge of applicable standards and codes, including:

+ UL standards
+ CSA standards
+ Electrical safety requirements
+ Applicable NFPA and industry requirements
+ Generator set and power system compliance requirements
+ All related ISO / IEC / EN Standards

**Product Development Support**

* Design review and compliance assessment capability.
* Engineering change impact assessment from a regulatory perspective.
* Risk assessment and compliance validation planning.

**Testing & Validation**

* Product certification testing coordination.
* Test plan development and execution.
* Test witnessing and compliance verification.

**Documentation & Compliance Systems**

* Technical documentation management.
* Certification file maintenance.
* Compliance records and audit preparation.
* Process development and governance documentation.

**Project Management**

* Managing multiple certification and compliance projects simultaneously.
* Planning, tracking, and reporting compliance activities.
* Coordination of cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.

**Soft Skills**
**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to communicate complex regulatory requirements to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management capabilities.

**Relationship Management**

* Ability to build effective working relationships with certification agencies, regulatory bodies, laboratories, and internal stakeholders.
* Strong customer-focused mindset when supporting internal and external compliance inquiries.

**Analytical Thinking**

* Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to evaluate technical data and make sound compliance-related decisions.

**Attention to Detail**

* High level of accuracy in reviewing standards, certifications, test reports, and compliance documentation.
* Strong focus on quality and risk mitigation.

**Leadership & Influence**

* Ability to influence engineering and business teams without direct authority.
* Drive compliance requirements effectively across cross-functional organizations.

**Adaptability**

* Ability to manage changing regulatory requirements and evolving business priorities.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic product development environment.

**Collaboration**

* Strong teamwork skills with the ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Service, and Sales organizations.

**Initiative & Ownership**

* Self-motivated with strong ownership of compliance deliverables.
* Ability to independently drive certification and compliance activities to successful completion.

**Travel Requirements**

* Willingness and ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Travel to certification laboratories, customer locations, manufacturing sites, and testing facilities to support compliance testing, certification activities, regulatory audits, and technical reviews.
* Estimated travel: 5-10%, depending on project and certification needs.

**Success Measures**
**The Product Compliance Engineer Will Be Successful When**

title: GLOBAL TRADE SERVICES ANALYST II
description:
**At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.**
**Job Overview**
TE Connectivity has built a world-class Global Trade Services (GTS) organization, including Operational Service Centers (OSCs) focused on delivering critical trade compliance services. This position is part of the Trade Jurisdiction & Classification Operational Service Center, which is responsible for supporting centralized activities associated with export and import jurisdiction and classification determinations across TE's global operations.
  
  
The
**Analyst, Trade Jurisdiction & Classification**
plays a key role in ensuring the timely and accurate assessment and classification of goods, software, technical information, and services for global trade compliance purposes. The successful candidate will support export control and customs classification activities across EMEA and other international jurisdictions, including the UK Strategic Export Control Lists, EU Dual-Use Regulations, India's SCOMET controls, Wassenaar Arrangement controls, and the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS).
  
  
This role joins a highly collaborative team of global trade professionals dedicated to enabling business growth through effective compliance solutions and trade risk management. The ideal candidate will thrive in a global environment, demonstrate strong integrity and accountability, and embrace collaboration, continuous improvement, and operational excellence. The role requires strong analytical skills, the ability to interpret complex technical and regulatory information, and a commitment to maintaining accurate and defensible trade classifications in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibility**

* Assess and determine the jurisdiction and classification of goods, software, technical information, and services for export and import compliance purposes.
* Perform export control classifications under applicable regulations and control regimes, including UK Strategic Export Control Lists, EU Dual-Use Regulations, India's SCOMET controls, Wassenaar Arrangement controls, and other relevant international export control frameworks.
* Conduct customs tariff classifications using the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS) and applicable national tariff schedules.
* Interpret technical documentation, engineering specifications, and product information to support accurate and defensible trade classifications.
* Maintain classification records and supporting rationale in accordance with applicable regulatory and company requirements.

Additional Details
  
  
**Required Qualifications & Experience**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Law, Trade Compliance, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years' experience in international trade compliance, with a primary focus on jurisdiction and classification activities.
* Demonstrated experience classifying products under export control regulations, including:

+ UK Strategic Export Control Lists
+ EU Dual-Use Regulation
+ SCOMET (Special Chemicals, Organisms, Materials, Equipment and Technologies)
+ Wassenaar Arrangement-based controls and other international export control frameworks

* Demonstrated experience classifying products under the Harmonized Tariff System (HTS) and related customs tariff nomenclatures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to evaluate complex technical and regulatory information.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Knowledge of U.S. export control regulations, including the U.S. Commerce Control List (CCL) and U.S. Munitions List (USML).
* Experience working within multinational manufacturing, industrial, technology, or electronics organizations.
* Familiarity with trade compliance software, product data management systems, and classification databases.
* Experience supporting automation, data management, or digital transformation initiatives within trade compliance.
* Understanding of global customs and export control regulations across multiple jurisdictions.

**Additional Competencies**
  
  

+ Strong understanding of the General Rules for Interpretation (GRIs), Harmonized System Explanatory Notes, and customs classification methodologies.
+ Ability to research, interpret, and apply multi-jurisdictional export control regulations and product classifications to complex technical products and technologies.

**About Te Connectivity**
TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.
  
  
Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).
  
  
**What Te Connectivity Offers**
We are pleased to offer you an exciting total package that can also be flexibly adapted to changing life situations - the well-being of our employees is our top priority!
  
  

* Competitive Salary Package
* Performance-Based Bonus Plans
* Health and Wellness Incentives
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Community Outreach Programs / Charity Events
* Employee Resource Group

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity
**never requests payment or fees**
from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come
**only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**
. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.
  
  
Across our global sites and business units, we put together packages of benefits that are either supported by TE itself or provided by external service providers. In principle, the benefits offered can vary from site to site.

title: Project Associate
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Supplier & Service Provider Due Diligence**

* Conduct due diligence reviews of all suppliers, contractors, and service providers in accordance with Volvo Group Compliance Policies, Guidelines, and internal procedures.
* Verify relevant statutory registrations, licenses, certifications, compliance records, and supporting documentation.
* Identify compliance gaps and risks, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure timely closure of pending observations.
* Maintain proper records of due diligence reviews, approvals, and compliance assessments.

**Contractor Documentation & Statutory Registers**

* Ensure timely updating and maintenance of Form 12 (List of Contractors) and other applicable statutory records, as required under the relevant legislation.
* Ensure that Form 5 is issued to all eligible contractors promptly, in accordance with applicable statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date contractor master data, statutory documentation, and compliance records.
* Monitor document validity and ensure timely renewal, submission, and record retention.

**Statutory Compliance Audits**

* Plan and conduct on-site statutory compliance audits of all service providers and contractors on a monthly and quarterly basis.
* Verify compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory registrations, licence conditions, wage and employment records, social security contributions, and other relevant statutory obligations.
* Identify non-compliances, document audit findings, and prepare audit reports with corrective and preventive action plans.
* Follow up with service providers to ensure timely closure of audit observations and maintain evidence of compliance.
* Escalate critical or recurring compliance deviations to the appropriate management team.

**Electronic Records & Monthly Self-Certification**

* Collect, verify, and maintain all statutory documents and compliance records electronically from service providers.
* Obtain monthly self-certification reports from all service providers confirming adherence to applicable statutory requirements and company policies.
* Review submitted records for completeness, accuracy, and consistency with statutory and contractual obligations.
* Maintain a centralised electronic repository for audit trails, statutory documents, certifications, and compliance reports.
* Track pending submissions and ensure timely follow-up and closure.

**Government & Regulatory Coordination**

* Coordinate and follow up with relevant government departments, labour authorities, and other regulatory agencies on statutory compliance matters.
* Facilitate statutory inspections, document submissions, clarifications, and other regulatory requirements, as authorised.
* Ensure that all interactions and submissions are conducted transparently and in accordance with Volvo Group policies, guidelines, and applicable laws.
* Maintain records of regulatory correspondence, inspection reports, notices, and actions taken.
* Escalate regulatory concerns, notices, and potential compliance risks to the appropriate internal stakeholders.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LL.B.), Commerce, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification or certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, Contract Management, or Compliance Management will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* Min. 3 years of relevant experience in statutory compliance, contractor compliance, labour law administration, contract management, or supplier compliance.
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, industrial operations, or a large corporate environment will be preferred.
* Practical experience in statutory audits, contractor documentation, service agreements, and coordination with government authorities is desirable.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong working knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws and contractor-related statutory compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with contract drafting, review, execution, and document management.
* Strong analytical, audit, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and electronic document management systems.
* Excellent coordination, communication, follow-up, and stakeholder management skills.
* High standards of integrity, confidentiality, attention to detail, and professional conduct.
* Ability to manage multiple service providers, compliance deadlines, and audit requirements independently.

**Work Location**

* Hosakote, Karnataka. The position shall be based at the Hosakote facility and requires regular on-site coordination with contractors, service providers, internal departments, and relevant government authorities.

**Employment Type**
: Fixed-term employment.

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.

contributes to realizing the vision of the Volvo Group by coordinating and providing services within the following areas: Legal, Governance, Security and Internal Audit. title: Information Security Manager
description:
**Department:**

Security Governance and Management Department

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a strategic and experienced
**Information Security GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) Manager**
to lead and mature our enterprise-wide GRC program across information security, data privacy, and telecommunications regulatory compliance. This role owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of the GRC function — managing a team of specialists, driving risk-informed decision-making, and serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and the CISO.

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in security frameworks, regulatory landscapes, and telecom-specific compliance requirements, combined with the leadership capability to build high-performing teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders at all levels.

**Responsibilities & Duties**

**GRC Program Leadership**

* Own and drive the organization's GRC strategy, roadmap, and operating model across information security, data privacy, and telecommunications compliance.
* Build, lead, and mentor a team of GRC specialists, setting clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans.
* Report program health, risk posture, and compliance status to the CISO and senior leadership on a regular cadence.
* Define and track GRC program KPIs and OKRs (Key Performance Indicators / Objectives and Key Results), ensuring measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.

**Policy & Standards Governance**

* Oversee the lifecycle management of the organization's information security, privacy, and telecom compliance policy framework — including development, review, approval, and enforcement.
* Ensure policies and standards are aligned with applicable regulatory requirements, industry frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST CSF), and business objectives.
* Establish governance processes to ensure consistent communication, acknowledgment, and enforcement of policies across all business units and personnel.

**Risk Management**

* Lead the enterprise information security risk management program, including periodic risk assessments, risk register maintenance, and risk treatment planning.
* Provide risk-based guidance to business and technology stakeholders, translating complex risk findings into clear, actionable recommendations for executive and operational audiences.
* Develop and maintain risk appetite and tolerance statements in alignment with organizational strategy, with particular attention to telecom-specific threat vectors (e.g., SS7/Diameter signaling, SIP/VoIP, BGP/DNS, mobile core).
* Oversee third-party and vendor risk management processes, ensuring supply chain risks are identified, assessed, and mitigated.

**Compliance & Audit Management**

* Manage the organization's compliance posture across applicable standards and regulations, including ISO 27001, GDPR, telecom-specific regulations, and other relevant frameworks.
* Direct and coordinate internal and external audit activities — including scoping, evidence collection, stakeholder preparation, and findings remediation.
* Oversee remediation tracking for audit findings and compliance gaps, ensuring timely closure with appropriate accountability.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for regulators, external auditors, and certification bodies on all GRC-related matters.

**Training & Security Awareness**

* Oversee the design and delivery of a role-based security awareness and compliance training program, ensuring coverage of telecom-specific regulatory obligations.
* Drive a culture of security and compliance awareness across the organization through targeted campaigns, metrics, and executive sponsorship.
* Measure training effectiveness and adjust programs based on outcomes and emerging risk areas.

**Incident & Crisis Governance**

* Provide GRC oversight for security, privacy, and telecom compliance incidents — ensuring regulatory notification obligations, documentation requirements, and post-incident review processes are met.
* Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal, state, and international privacy laws, telecommunications regulations, and accreditation standards.
* Collaborate with the Security Operations and Legal teams to ensure incident response plans reflect regulatory and contractual obligations.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Executive Advisory**

* Act as a trusted advisor to the CISO, executive leadership, and the Board on matters of information security risk, compliance posture, and regulatory change.
* Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, Product, Engineering, and Network Operations to embed GRC practices into business processes and technology delivery.
* Represent the GRC function in cross-functional governance forums, steering committees, and customer-facing engagements where security assurance is required.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Law, Business Administration, or a related field.

**Certifications
*(one or more preferred)***

* **CISM**
  (Certified Information Security Manager)
* **CISSP**
  (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)
* **CISA**
  (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* **CIPP**
  (Certified Information Privacy Professional)
* **ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor**
* Additional telecom or risk-focused certifications are a plus

**Experience**

* **Minimum 7–10 years**
  of progressive experience in information security, GRC, or a related field.
* **Minimum 3–5 years**
  in a people management or team leadership role, with demonstrated ability to build and develop high-performing teams.
* Proven track record of designing and maturing GRC programs in complex, regulated environments — ideally within telecommunications, enterprise software, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Hands-on experience managing compliance programs against ISO 27001, GDPR, NIST CSF, and telecom-specific regulatory frameworks.
* Experience engaging with external auditors, regulators, and certification bodies.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Strategic thinking:**
  Ability to translate regulatory requirements and risk findings into business-aligned programs and roadmaps.
* **Leadership:**
  Demonstrated ability to lead, influence, and develop teams and cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
* **Communication:**
  Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to present complex risk and compliance topics clearly to both technical and executive audiences.
* **Analytical rigor:**
  Strong risk assessment, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
* **Telecom domain knowledge:**
  Familiarity with telecom network security concepts, signaling protocols, and sector-specific regulatory obligations is highly desirable.

title: Sr. Manager - Paralegal
description:
**About**  
Fresenius Medical Care is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.

Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are: We Care. We Connect. We Commit.  
  
**Position Summary**

As Senior Manager, Paralegal, you lead the GBS Paralegal function within Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") GBS India Legal Center of Excellence, reporting to the Director of Legal. You own paralegal service delivery, setting standards that hold up across genuinely different subject matters while keeping day-to-day delivery consistent and dependable for Legal, Compliance, Corporate Governance, and business stakeholders worldwide. This role calls for an experienced legal operations leader with strong people leadership, sharp organizational instincts and real depth across legal documentation, contract administration, entity governance and regulatory support.

FME is looking for a collaborative, forward-thinking leader who can build a high-performing team from the ground up, push continuous improvement, and keep service quality high in a complex, multinational, tightly regulated environment.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

***Paralegal Leadership***

* Lead and manage the GBS Paralegal function, ensuring consistent, high-quality support across OHS, corporate/M&A, and litigation workstreams
* Set standards, policies, procedures and service-delivery models for paralegal activities that work across genuinely different subject matters without forcing artificial uniformity
* Build team capability, set operating priorities, and keep the function aligned with Global Legal Function objectives
* Drive resource planning, workload balancing and operational efficiency across the paralegal team
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and service excellence

***Corporate Governance & Entity Management Oversight***

* Oversee entity management activities delivered by the M&A/Corporate Paralegal workstream, including incorporation, dissolution, restructuring, maintenance, and governance compliance support
* Oversee board and committee support activities - resolutions, minutes, governance documentation, statutory filings, ensuring accuracy and consistency
* Ensure corporate records are maintained accurately and in line with legal and regulatory requirements
* Coordinate with external counsel, company secretaries and local legal teams to support governance obligations across jurisdictions
* Monitor governance calendars and filing requirements across the entity portfolio

***Legal Documentation Oversight***

* Provide leadership and oversight for preparation, review, administration and maintenance of legal documentation across the paralegal team
* Ensure legal documentation processes are standardized, compliant and efficient
* Maintain document quality standards and governance controls

title: Manager, Hub - IP (Trademarks)
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role**

  

The Manager, Hub - IP (Trademarks) will support Haleon’s global trademarks legal function by managing and coordinating trademark-related legal activities across the brand lifecycle. The role will partner closely with internal trademark attorneys, marketing, innovation, regulatory and business teams, and external counsel to support trademark clearance, filing, prosecution, portfolio management, enforcement coordination and legal risk assessment across multiple jurisdictions. The role requires strong trademark legal expertise, operational discipline, sound judgement, effective stakeholder management and consistently high attention to detail in a fast-paced global consumer healthcare environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Trademark Portfolio, Clearance & Risk Assessment**

* Support global trademark portfolio activities, including trademark clearance, filing coordination, prosecution tracking, renewals coordination and portfolio maintenance.
* Conduct and coordinate preliminary trademark searches, screening reviews and availability assessments in collaboration with internal and external counsel.
* Review, analyse and summarise trademark search reports, identifying potential legal or commercial risks for escalation to the relevant trademark attorney.
* Review trademark watch notices and determine which results require escalation to the relevant trademark attorney.

**Filings, Prosecution & Legal Documentation**

* Coordinate trademark filings, office action responses, oppositions, cancellations, coexistence matters and related prosecution activities with external counsel globally.
* Support the drafting, review and management of trademark-related legal documentation, including assignments, coexistence agreements, consent letters, powers of attorney, declarations and related filings.
* Monitor trademark deadlines, prosecution developments and portfolio status across jurisdictions, ensuring timely follow-up and escalation.
* Coordinate with external counsel on the implementation of trademark strategies, legal updates, filings and prosecution activities.

**Portfolio Governance, Records & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate and complete trademark portfolio records, including thorough docketing and effective management of documentation and legal correspondence.
* Prepare trademark portfolio reports, status summaries, dashboards and legal updates for internal stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Support the development and maintenance of trademark legal templates, guidance notes, standard operating procedures, playbooks and internal knowledge resources.

**Enforcement, Transactions & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Support trademark enforcement and brand protection activities, including watch notice coordination, infringement escalations, online enforcement support and cease-and-desist coordination.
* Assist with trademark due diligence for acquisitions, divestitures, licensing arrangements, collaborations and corporate transactions, as required.
* Liaise with marketing, regulatory, business and other internal teams regarding brand name reviews, launch timelines, trademark risks and filing strategies.
Partner with global legal and business stakeholders to align trademark protection strategies with commercial objectives.  

  

**Qualifications & Skills:**

**Essential:**

* Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) or equivalent legal qualification
* Additional certification or specialisation in intellectual property law or trademark practice would be advantageous.
* 6-8 years of relevant experience in trademark legal support, trademark prosecution, trademark portfolio management, or intellectual property legal or paralegal functions.
* Strong experience supporting global trademark portfolios within multinational corporations, law firms, consumer healthcare or FMCG organisations, or IP-focused legal teams.
* Experience coordinating trademark filings, oppositions, prosecution matters, enforcement support and portfolio maintenance activities across multiple jurisdictions.
* Experience in trademark search analysis, risk assessment and trademark-related legal documentation support.
Prior experience in a shared services or GCC environment supporting global legal teams would be advantageous.  

  

**Preferred:**

* Strong legal and analytical thinking capability.
* Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines in a fast-paced global environment.
* Strong stakeholder management and written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound judgement and the ability to escalate legal risks and sensitive matters appropriately.
* Collaborative, practical and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively across global teams and external counsel.
High degree of professionalism, confidentiality, accountability and ownership.  

  

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of global trademark prosecution and portfolio management processes.
* Familiarity with trademark lifecycle management, clearance processes, enforcement coordination and legal documentation management.
* Experience using trademark docketing or IP management systems, such as Anaqua or equivalent tools.
* Ability to review and interpret trademark search reports and identify legal risk considerations for escalation.
* Familiarity with trademark filing and prosecution processes across major jurisdictions, including the United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and emerging markets.
* Strong legal drafting, documentation and contract review capability in relation to trademark matters.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience in legal reporting, portfolio tracking and records management is preferred.  

**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-27  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

description:

,

**AI/ML-based**
,

solutions.

Our platform is designed for digital operations—trusted by governments, Fortune 500 companies, and high-growth enterprises alike.

If you’re looking to be part of a company that combines innovation, global exposure, and a mission to disrupt legacy systems with intelligent enterprise applications
**Ramco is the place to be.**

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The
**Manager / Senior Manager – Payroll Bureau**
oversees payroll compliance across a region or multiple countries, leading a team to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality statutory compliance within the payroll product.

The role is pivotal in strengthening compliance governance, driving statutory development cycles, and enabling scalable, standardised processes across countries.

The individual is the primary owner of compliance delivery for assigned regions — representing the compliance function to internal and external stakeholders, holding service quality, and building a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Regional Compliance Ownership & Governance**

* Lead compliance operations across the assigned region and ensure full statutory coverage in the payroll product.
* Ensure end-to-end statutory updates —
  **monitoring, interpretation, communication, development, testing, release**
  — are executed with precision and timeliness.
* Act as the escalation point for complex compliance interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes.
* Own relationships with authorities, consultants, and regulatory bodies for assigned geographies.
* Build compliance governance frameworks, SOPs, and audit-ready documentation standards.

**Regulatory Interpretation & Technical Oversight**

* Review product requirements, interpretation notes, change impact assessments, and compliance documentation prepared by the team.
* Guide the team on complex multi-country regulatory analysis and accurate statutory interpretation.
* Evaluate regulatory changes for business impact, system updates, and operational feasibility.
* Provide clear guidance on ambiguous legal scenarios and edge cases.

**Leadership, Team Management & Capability Building**

* Lead the team with effective workload allocation, quality checks, and timely delivery.
* Mentor, coach, and upskill team members through structured training, feedback, and development plans.
* Drive a culture of accuracy, ownership, accountability, and excellence in interpretation and documentation.
* Conduct performance evaluations, workforce planning, and capability development initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Confidence**

* Partner with Product Engineering and other cross-functional teams to ensure accurate and timely implementation of regulatory requirements in the product.
* Lead end-to-end review of existing statutory setups for critical countries and implement product enhancements.
* Ensure timely, clear communication of regulatory changes to internal and external stakeholders.
* Oversee responses to complex customer compliance queries, ensuring accuracy, logical reasoning, and consistency.
* Represent Payroll Bureau in customer meetings and compliance deep-dives, building credible relationships with clients, consultants, and internal partners.

**Strategic Initiatives & Innovation**

* Lead initiatives to scale compliance operations through automation, templates, frameworks, and standardised processes.
* Partner with technology teams on AI-driven compliance research tools, dashboards, analytics, and automation projects.
* Build compliance assets including whitepapers, statutory summaries, and marketing and thought-leadership content.
* Identify and implement opportunities for continuous improvement, standardisation, and future-readiness.

**Training & Knowledge Enablement**

* Drive internal and external training programmes on payroll compliance, regulatory frameworks, and statutory updates.
* Strengthen organisation-wide compliance capability through structured enablement sessions.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Full statutory coverage for the region, delivered ahead of regulatory effective dates.
* Complex interpretations and disputes resolved at this level rather than escalated upward.
* A team whose documentation needs progressively less correction.
* Customers and consultants who trust the Bureau’s statutory position without needing to verify it.
* Compliance operations that scale through standardisation rather than added headcount.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIS)**

*Performance in this role is measured against the following indicators. Targets are set annually with the Head – Payroll Bureau and reviewed on the cadence noted.*

* **Statutory coverage and release timeliness**
  — statutory updates for the region delivered into the product ahead of their effective dates, with full coverage maintained.
  *(Per release)*
* **Compliance accuracy**
  — statutory defects reaching production for the region, and defects traced to an interpretation error.
  *(Per release)*
* **Governance and escalation**
  — frameworks, SOPs, and documentation standards current and audit-ready; complex interpretations, exceptions, and regulatory disputes resolved within the agreed timeline.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Technical review quality**
  — team documentation reviewed and signed off, and rework arising after sign-off.
  *(Monthly)*
* **Team capability and performance**
  — performance evaluations and development plans completed, and capability gaps closed against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*
* **Customer and stakeholder confidence**
  — complex compliance queries resolved accurately within the agreed window, and customer deep-dives supported to a satisfactory outcome.
  *(Quarterly)*
* **Scale and enablement**
  — automation, template, or framework initiatives delivered, and training programmes and compliance assets published against plan.
  *(Half-yearly)*

**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS**

* Qualified
  **Chartered Accountant, Company Secretary, or Lawyer**
  with 7 to 10 years of relevant payroll compliance experience, or another qualification with 10+ years in multi-country payroll or statutory compliance roles.
* Experience in team leadership, stakeholder engagement, and managing multi-country compliance.
* Strong analytical, logical, and interpretation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex regulations into clear, implementable guidance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* High integrity, professionalism, and ownership, with pride in the quality of work and curiosity to keep learning.
* Builds strong working relationships within and across teams, and coaches team members to succeed through guidance and clarity.
* Adapts quickly to changing demands and shifting priorities, and takes ownership to deliver solutions.
* Builds trust with internal teams, customers, and external partners, and gives them confidence through clear communication of statutory coverage in the product.
* Brings structure and strategic thinking to compliance operations, and continuously improves processes.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Knowledge of Ramco tools is an added advantage.
* Experience owning authority and regulator relationships in more than one jurisdiction.
* Exposure to compliance automation, analytics dashboards, or AI-assisted regulatory research tooling.

**WHY JOIN RAMCO SYSTEMS**

* Own payroll compliance for a full region on a platform used across 35+ countries.
* Direct influence on how regulation is built into the product.
* Lead a compliance team and represent the function to clients and regulators.
* Be part of a fast-evolving, innovation-led enterprise software company.

description:

description:

**Job Description**
**Job Description:**

* The team member is responsible for ensuring accounts impacted by bankruptcy are handled in strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This role involves reviewing and processing bankruptcy notifications, and updates, received from approved vendors or mail, coding accounts as bankrupt in the appropriate system of record, and excluding them from collection activities to prevent violations of the automatic stay.
* The Associate researches and resolves match criteria exclusions, manages manual coding for exceptions, and monitors joint filings and community property cases. Additional duties include quality assurance reviews, maintaining accurate documentation, collaborating with attorneys and account holders, and supporting compliance through regular training and adherence to procedural controls.
* The position covers a range of consumer and small business products, including credit cards, lines of credit, and installment loans. Strong attention to detail, excellent Microsoft suite skills, ability to complete complex tasks with minimal oversight and critical thinking skills.
* Experienced paralegal responsible for legal research, preparation of legal documents, file management and other assigned or routine tasks. Works under direct supervision using established principles, practices and procedures. Ability to determine and use appropriate internal and external resources.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Proofs of Claim are legal documents submitted to bankruptcy courts to assert the bank’s claim for amounts owed. Filing must meet strict court deadlines (“Bar Dates”).
* Not all accounts require a POC. Automated and manual reviews ensure only eligible, compliant claims are filed (e.g., not out-of-statute, not low-value, not fees/interest only).
* Every POC undergoes multi-level review—first by the preparer, then by an approved designee, with checklists and system controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Claims are filed electronically (ECF/PACER) or manually, depending on court requirements. Special handling is required for certain jurisdictions and product types.
* Claims can be amended or withdrawn for valid reasons (e.g., errors, payments, jurisdictional issues), but require management/designee approval.

**Competencies:**

* Bankruptcy Regulatory Compliance
* Account Review and Judgment
* Attention to Detail and Accuracy
* Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving
* Risk Identification and Mitigation
* Quality Assurance and Control Execution
* Independent Execution and Accountability
* Documentation and Recordkeeping

* Adaptability and Continuous Learning

**Skills:**

* Bankruptcy account coding and collection exclusion, Bankruptcy notification review and processing.
* Automatic stay compliance.
* Match criteria research and exclusion resolution.
* Manual coding and exception processing.
* Joint filing and community property case management.
* Quality assurance review and control validation.
* Account documentation and audit-ready recordkeeping.
* Microsoft 365 proficiency.
* Complex task management and stakeholder communication

**Qualifications:**
Basic Qualifications - Paralegal certification from an accredited program, or equivalent degree or experience Preferred Skills/Experience - Three to five years of relevant experience - Strong analytical, organizational and communication skills - Strong commitment to client service - Ability to work independently - Ability to organize and manage a large volume of detailed tasks.

* Collaborate and consult with leaders and executive management
* Provide work direction to less experienced Strategy and Execution staff

**Required Qualifications**

* 2+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* Possess strong knowledge of banking products and services across key lines of business, including Consumer Lending, Commercial Banking, Wealth & Investment Banking, Trade Finance, and Capital Markets.
* Manage third-party due diligence activities across the relationship lifecycle, including planning and intake, onboarding, risk assessment, contracting, ongoing monitoring, change events, renewal, and termination.

**Job Expectations**

* Assess and document the business rationale for engaging a third party, including the nature, scope, criticality, data access, technology dependency, regulatory considerations, and inherent risks associated with the proposed service.
* Apply in-depth knowledge of third-party risk management principles to identify, assess, document, escalate, and support the mitigation of risks related to cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, operational resilience, business continuity, regulatory compliance, financial viability, subcontractor use, concentration, and reputational exposure.
* Evaluate different service types, delivery models, engagement structures, and third-party dependencies to determine applicable due diligence requirements, risk domains, control expectations, and level of ongoing oversight.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather complete and accurate information regarding the service, data flows, system access, locations, subcontractors, critical processes, and intended use of the third party.
* Review submitted documentation and stakeholder responses for completeness, consistency, and accuracy; identify information gaps; obtain clarifications; and ensure due diligence records are maintained in the designated system with a clear audit trail.
* Coordinate with Lines of Business, Risk Partners, Legal, Compliance, Technology, Information Security, Sourcing, and other subject matter experts to resolve questions, address control gaps, and support timely completion of risk evaluations.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for new and existing third-party relationships by interpreting policy requirements, identifying material risks, advising stakeholders on required actions, and supporting risk-based decisions.
* Translate complex risk, policy, and control requirements into clear, practical, and actionable guidance for business stakeholders, enabling them to understand their responsibilities and meet established requirements.
* Exercise independent judgment and effective challenge when business responses, proposed controls, risk acceptance decisions, or supporting evidence do not adequately address identified exposure or policy expectations.
* Provide timely interim updates, escalation communications, final assessment outcomes, and recommended next steps to relevant stakeholders, ensuring transparency regarding open issues, dependencies, and potential delays.
* Monitor remediation plans, control gaps, exceptions, and outstanding actions through closure; escalate overdue or material items in accordance with governance and risk-management requirements.
* Identify areas of operational strength and opportunities to improve business execution, workflow discipline, documentation quality, stakeholder experience, cycle time, control effectiveness, and adherence to service-level expectations.
* Research, develop, and recommend process improvements, action plans, standard procedures, controls, reporting mechanisms, and strategic approaches that improve the effectiveness and scalability of the third-party risk management program.
* Track performance against established metrics and policy requirements, analyze trends and recurring issues, and present clear recommendations to management for strengthening risk governance and business performance.
* Maintain current knowledge of enterprise third-party risk management policies, standards, procedures, regulatory expectations, and industry practices, and apply that knowledge consistently across assigned engagements.
* Assess third-party technology, cloud, software-as-a-service, and artificial intelligence use cases in coordination with relevant specialists, considering factors such as data handling, access controls, model governance, human oversight, transparency, resilience, subcontractor dependencies, and compliance with technology and vendor-management requirements.
* Support an accountable, collaborative, and risk-aware culture by managing multiple priorities, meeting committed timelines, maintaining high-quality documentation, and communicating professionally with stakeholders at all levels.

title: Sr Manager- Commercial
description:
*Earlier this year, building on the strong foundation of Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) as a fund manager, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform, with three platform companies providing services to CIP. To learn more, please refer to the CIP Platform section below.*
*In our optimized CIP Platform, CIP Terra Technologies – a project delivery company delivering projects from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure – is currently looking for a Development Manager, to join the team in Mumbai, India*
**Role**
The Commercial Manager will oversee commercial and contractual management for our renewable energy project through development, construction and commissioning. The role will ensure that project contracts are commercially robust, contractual obligations are actively managed, changes and claims are controlled, and commercial risks are identified and mitigated to protect project returns and delivery timelines.This is a high-visibility position with direct exposure to senior management, the Steering Committee and international shareholders. It suits a commercially minded finance professional who is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance, contracts and operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
Strategic decision support
  
  

* Support the management in strategic decision-making through robust commercial analysis, scenario modelling and clear recommendations.
* Evaluate options relating to financing, offtake, O&M, curtailment, merchant exposure, refinancing, asset optimisation and potential M&A / divestment, and articulate trade-offs and risks.

Board and Steering Committee material
  
  

* Prepare periodic reporting materials, SteerCo decks and supporting papers, consolidating inputs from Finance, Operations, Legal, Construction / Technical and external advisors.
* Ensure board material is accurate, concise, decision-oriented and delivered on time; track and close out SteerCo action items.

Contract management
  
  

* Perform the commercial evaluation of new contracts and contract amendments
* Assess commercial exposure, liquidated damages, claims, change orders, delay and performance entitlements; quantify financial impact for negotiation strategy.
* Support the evaluation, response and management of commercial disputes and notices (including claims, change in law, and termination-related notices) in coordination with Legal and external counsel.
* Maintain a contract register, key dates and obligations tracker.

Quarterly fair value
  
  

* Determine and recommend key valuation assumptions (e.g. power price and curtailment, generation / P50-P90, opex, inflation, discount rate, tax, and macro inputs) in line with the valuation policy
* Perform quality assurance on the financial model and results, including reconciliation to prior quarter, variance and sensitivity analysis, and review with auditors / valuers where required.
* Prepare and present the quarterly fair value reporting material to the management.

Budget and liquidity management
  
  

* Monitor Estimate at Completion (EAC) versus approved budget; analyse variances, forecast cost-to-complete and flag overruns early with proposed mitigations.
* Own the sources and uses of funds, rolling cash-flow forecasts and funding requirements (equity, debt drawdowns, working capital), and liaise with Treasury / Finance and the Sponsor on funding calls.

Risk management
  
  

* Maintain the project risk register: identify, quantify, assign owners and track mitigations across commercial, financial, construction, operational, regulatory and counterparty risks.
* Escalate key risks and present risk updates to management and the SteerCo.

Monitoring of financing, offtake and operations
  
  

* Financing: track debt covenants, compliance certificates, drawdowns, hedging, DSRA / reserve requirements and lender relationships.
* Offtake: monitor PPA terms and performance, tariff, payment and receivables, curtailment, deviation settlement and grid / counterparty developments.
* Operations: track generation, availability, O&M performance, opex versus budget and key operational KPIs, and translate them into commercial impact.
* Keep abreast of regulatory and policy developments in the Indian power sector (CERC / SERC / MNRE, open access, transmission charges, RPO / GNA, etc.).

**You**
You should have a Chartered Accountant (CA), CFA, MBA, BE from a reputed institute, or an equivalent professional qualification, with 8–10 years of relevant experience in commercial, finance, or project management roles, within the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors. Practical experience with the construction and/or operation of large-scale wind, solar, or hybrid projects in India is required. You should also have experience in valuation and fair-value reporting, financial modelling, and investor or board reporting, with prior exposure to an international sponsor, private equity/infrastructure fund, or Big 4/advisory firm.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Commercial acumen and structured judgment; ability to form a view and recommend a decision.
* Clear and effective communication, both written and spoken;
* High attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple deadlines and recurring reporting cycles.
* Integrity, discretion with confidential information, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
**CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.
  
  
**About CIP Terra Technologies**
CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.
  
  
We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.
  
  
We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.
  
  
**Optimized CIP Platform**
Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.
  
  
We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.
